name: detL_swapAdj
statement:
theorem detL_swapAdj (k : Nat) (m : Mat) (hk : k + 1 < m.length) :
    detL (ground.adjSwap k m) = (detL m).swap
proof:
:=
  detO_swapAdj (R := bpairEqRead) bpairEqCore k m hk

name: detO_rows_equal
proof:
:= by
  have him : i < m.length := Nat.lt_trans hij hjm
  have hne : i ≠ j := fun he => Nat.lt_irrefl i (he ▸ hij)
  have hterm : ∀ p : List Nat,
      0 < ground.countOf p (places.perms m.length) →
      R.rel (termO ops m (places.swapPair i j p)) (termO ops m p) := by
    intro p hp
    have hplen : p.length = m.length := (places.perm_member_reads hp).1
    have hswlen : (places.swapPair i j p).length = m.length := by
      rw [places.length_swapPair i j p]
      exact hplen
    rw [termO_fold ops m (places.swapPair i j p) hswlen.symm,
      termO_fold ops m p hplen.symm]
    refine ground.famFold_bij_ov (commLawsMulOf L.toDCore) ops.one _
      (fun t => ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] m t)
        (ground.getAt 0 p t))
      (ground.distinctList_range m.length)
      (g := swapIx i j) (h := swapIx i j)
      (fun t _ => swapIx_invol i j t)
      (fun t _ => swapIx_invol i j t)
      (fun t ht => ground.countOf_range_pos
        (swapIx_lt him hjm t (ground.ltOfMem ht)))
      (fun t ht => ground.countOf_range_pos
        (swapIx_lt him hjm t (ground.ltOfMem ht)))
      (fun t ht => ?_)
    show R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] m t)
        (ground.getAt 0 (places.swapPair i j p) t))
      (ground.getAt ops.unit
        (ground.getAt [] m (swapIx i j t))
        (ground.getAt 0 p (swapIx i j t)))
    by_cases hti : t = i
    · rw [show swapIx i j t = j from by
          show (if t = i then j else _) = j
          rw [if_pos hti],
        hti,
        places.getAt_swapPair_fst p hne
          (by rw [hplen]; exact him)
          (by rw [hplen]; exact hjm),
        heq]
      exact L.ovRefl _
    · by_cases htj : t = j
      · rw [show swapIx i j t = i from by
            show (if t = i then j else if t = j then i else t)
              = i
            rw [if_neg hti, if_pos htj],
          htj,
          places.getAt_swapPair_snd p hne
            (by rw [hplen]; exact him)
            (by rw [hplen]; exact hjm),
          heq]
        exact L.ovRefl _
      · rw [show swapIx i j t = t from by
            show (if t = i then j else if t = j then i else t)
              = t
            rw [if_neg hti, if_neg htj],
          places.getAt_swapPair_ne p
            (by rw [hplen]; exact him)
            (by rw [hplen]; exact hjm) hti htj]
        exact L.ovRefl _
  have hself : R.rel (detO ops m) (ops.swap (detO ops m)) := by
    show R.rel (ground.famFold ops.add ops.unit
        (fun p => sgnO ops p (termO ops m p))
        (places.monomialsAt (List.replicate m.length 1)))
      (ops.swap (detO ops m))
    refine L.ovTrans (ground.famFold_bij_ov (commLawsOf L.toDCore) ops.unit _
      (fun p => ops.swap (sgnO ops p (termO ops m p)))
      (places.monomialsAt_distinct (List.replicate m.length 1))
      (g := places.swapPair i j) (h := places.swapPair i j)
      (fun p _ => places.swapPair_swapPair i j p)
      (fun p _ => places.swapPair_swapPair i j p)
      (fun p hp => places.perm_member_of_counts hp
        (places.length_swapPair i j p)
        (fun x => places.countOf_swapPair x i j p))
      (fun p hp => places.perm_member_of_counts hp
        (places.length_swapPair i j p)
        (fun x => places.countOf_swapPair x i j p))
      (fun p hp => ?_))
      (foldO_swap L.toDCore
        (fun p => sgnO ops p (termO ops m p)) (places.perms m.length))
    refine L.ovTrans
      (sgnO_congr L.toDCore p (L.ovSymm (hterm p hp))) ?_
    show R.rel (if places.parity p then
        ops.swap (termO ops m (places.swapPair i j p))
        else termO ops m (places.swapPair i j p))
      (ops.swap (if places.parity (places.swapPair i j p) then
        ops.swap (termO ops m (places.swapPair i j p))
        else termO ops m (places.swapPair i j p)))
    rw [places.parity_swapPair p hne
      (by rw [(places.perm_member_reads hp).1]; exact him)
      (by rw [(places.perm_member_reads hp).1]; exact hjm)
      ((places.perm_member_reads hp).2.1)]
    cases places.parity p with
    | true => exact L.ovRefl _
    | false => exact L.ovSymm (L.swapSwap _)
  exact L.swapFix _ hself

name: detL_rows_equal
statement:
theorem detL_rows_equal {m : Mat} {i j : Nat} (hij : i < j)
    (hjm : j < m.length)
    (heq : ground.getAt [] m i = ground.getAt [] m j) :
    (detL m).oneValue BPair.unit
proof:
:=
  detO_rows_equal (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairLaws hij hjm heq

name: sgnPO_unit
proof:
:= by
  have h' : R.rel (if places.parityOf s then ops.swap x else x)
      ops.unit := h
  by_cases hp : places.parityOf s = true
  · rw [if_pos hp] at h'
    exact C.ovTrans (C.ovSymm (C.swapSwap x))
      (C.ovTrans (C.swapCongr h') C.swapUnit)
  · rw [if_neg hp] at h'
    exact h'

name: sgnPO_congr
proof:
:= by
  show R.rel (if places.parityOf k then ops.swap x else x)
    (if places.parityOf k then ops.swap y else y)
  cases places.parityOf k with
  | true => exact C.swapCongr h
  | false => exact h

name: fold_sgnPO
proof:
:= by
  show R.rel (ground.famFold ops.add ops.unit
      (fun x => if places.parityOf k then ops.swap (h x) else h x) l)
    (if places.parityOf k
      then ops.swap (ground.famFold ops.add ops.unit h l)
      else ground.famFold ops.add ops.unit h l)
  cases places.parityOf k with
  | true => exact foldO_swap C h l
  | false => exact C.ovRefl _

name: sub_member_counts
statement:
private theorem sub_member_counts {e j : Nat} {t : List Nat}
    (ht : 0 < ground.countOf t
      (places.monomialsAt (subContent j e))) :
    ∀ x, x < j → ground.countOf x t = 1
proof:
:= by
  intro x hxj
  rw [places.countOf_monomialsAt] at ht
  by_cases hc : t.length = ground.sumNat (subContent j e)
      ∧ places.content (subContent j e).length t = subContent j e
  · have hd : x < (subContent j e).length := by
      show x < (List.replicate j 1
        ++ 0 :: List.replicate (e - j) 1).length
      rw [ground.length_append, ground.length_replicate 1 j]
      exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hxj (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
    have hread : ground.getAt 0
        (places.content (subContent j e).length t) x
        = ground.countOf x t := by
      show ground.getAt 0
          ((List.range (subContent j e).length).map
            (fun i => ground.countOf i t)) x = _
      rw [ground.getAt_map 0 0 _
          (List.range (subContent j e).length) x
          (by rw [ground.length_range]; exact hd),
        ground.getAt_range _ x hd]
    rw [← hread, hc.2]
    show ground.getAt 0
        (List.replicate j 1 ++ 0 :: List.replicate (e - j) 1) x = 1
    rw [ground.getAt_append 0 _ _ x,
      if_pos (by rw [ground.length_replicate 1 j]; exact hxj)]
    exact ground.getAt_replicate 0 1 j x hxj
  · rw [if_neg hc] at ht
    exact absurd ht (Nat.lt_irrefl 0)

name: parity_cons_sub
statement:
private theorem parity_cons_sub {e j : Nat} {t : List Nat}
    (ht : 0 < ground.countOf t
      (places.monomialsAt (subContent j e))) :
    places.parity (j :: t)
      = xor (places.parityOf j) (places.parity t)
proof:
:= by
  show places.parityOf (places.inversions (j :: t)) = _
  rw [places.inversions_cons_of_counts j t
      (fun x hx => by
        rw [sub_member_counts ht x hx]
        exact Nat.succ_pos 0)
      (fun x hx => by
        rw [sub_member_counts ht x hx]
        exact Nat.le_refl 1),
    places.parityOf_add j (places.inversions t)]
  rfl

name: detO_cons
statement:
private theorem detO_cons {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ}
    (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel) (r : List γ) (rest : List (List γ)) :
    R.rel (detO ops (r :: rest))
      (ground.famFold ops.add ops.unit
        (fun j => sgnPO ops j
          (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit r j) (cof0O ops rest j)))
        (List.range (rest.length + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  show R.rel (ground.famFold ops.add ops.unit
      (fun p => sgnO ops p (termO ops (r :: rest) p))
      (places.monomialsAt
        (List.replicate (rest.length + 1) 1))) _
  rw [places.monomialsAt_ones_expand rest.length]
  refine L.ovTrans
    (ground.famFold_flatMap_ov (foldLawsOf L)
      (fun p => sgnO ops p (termO ops (r :: rest) p))
      (fun j => (places.monomialsAt (List.replicate j 1
          ++ 0 :: List.replicate (rest.length - j) 1)).map
        (fun t => j :: t))
      (List.range (rest.length + 1))) ?_
  refine foldO_congr_members L.toDCore _ _
    (List.range (rest.length + 1)) (fun j _ => ?_)
  rw [ground.famFold_map ops.add ops.unit _ (fun t => j :: t)]
  refine L.ovTrans (foldO_congr_members L.toDCore
    (fun t => sgnO ops (j :: t) (termO ops (r :: rest) (j :: t)))
    (fun t => sgnPO ops j (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit r j)
      (sgnO ops t (termO ops rest t))))
    (places.monomialsAt (List.replicate j 1
      ++ 0 :: List.replicate (rest.length - j) 1))
    (fun t htm => by
      have hpar : places.parity (j :: t)
          = xor (places.parityOf j) (places.parity t) :=
        parity_cons_sub (e := rest.length) (j := j) htm
      show R.rel (if places.parity (j :: t) then
          ops.swap (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit r j)
            (termO ops rest t))
        else ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit r j) (termO ops rest t))
        (sgnPO ops j (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit r j)
          (sgnO ops t (termO ops rest t))))
      rw [hpar]
      show R.rel (if xor (places.parityOf j) (places.parity t) then
          ops.swap (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit r j)
            (termO ops rest t))
        else ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit r j) (termO ops rest t))
        (if places.parityOf j then
            ops.swap (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit r j)
              (if places.parity t then ops.swap (termO ops rest t)
                else termO ops rest t))
          else ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit r j)
            (if places.parity t then ops.swap (termO ops rest t)
              else termO ops rest t))
      cases places.parityOf j with
      | true =>
        cases places.parity t with
        | true =>
          show R.rel (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit r j)
              (termO ops rest t))
            (ops.swap (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit r j)
              (ops.swap (termO ops rest t))))
          exact L.ovTrans
            (L.mulCongr (L.ovRefl _)
              (L.ovSymm (L.swapSwap (termO ops rest t))))
            (L.mulSwapRight (ground.getAt ops.unit r j)
              (ops.swap (termO ops rest t)))
        | false => exact L.ovRefl _
      | false =>
        cases places.parity t with
        | true =>
          show R.rel (ops.swap (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit r j)
              (termO ops rest t)))
            (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit r j)
              (ops.swap (termO ops rest t)))
          exact L.ovSymm (L.mulSwapRight
            (ground.getAt ops.unit r j) (termO ops rest t))
        | false => exact L.ovRefl _)) ?_
  refine L.ovTrans (fold_sgnPO L.toDCore j _ _) ?_
  exact sgnPO_congr L.toDCore
    (foldO_mul_left L (ground.getAt ops.unit r j)
      (fun t => sgnO ops t (termO ops rest t))
      (places.monomialsAt (List.replicate j 1
        ++ 0 :: List.replicate (rest.length - j) 1)))

name: frontRec_shape
statement:
private theorem frontRec_shape {α : Type} (d : α) :
    ∀ (k : Nat) (m : List α), k < m.length →
      frontRec k m = ground.getAt d m k :: m.eraseIdx k
  | 0, m, h =>
    match m, h with
    | _ :: _, _ => rfl
  | k + 1, m, h => by
    show frontRec k (ground.adjSwap k m) = _
    rw [frontRec_shape d k (ground.adjSwap k m)
        (by rw [ground.length_adjSwap]; exact Nat.lt_of_succ_lt h),
      ground.getAt_adjSwap_fst d k m h, ground.eraseIdx_adjSwap k m h]

private theorem sgnPO_succ {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ}
    (C : DCore γ ops R.rel) (k : Nat) (x : γ) :
    R.rel (ops.swap (sgnPO ops k x)) (sgnPO ops (k + 1) x)
proof:
:= by
  show R.rel (ops.swap (if places.parityOf k then ops.swap x else x))
    (if !(places.parityOf k) then ops.swap x else x)
  cases places.parityOf k with
  | true => exact C.swapSwap x
  | false => exact C.ovRefl _

name: sgnPO_succ
proof:
:= by
  show R.rel (ops.swap (if places.parityOf k then ops.swap x else x))
    (if !(places.parityOf k) then ops.swap x else x)
  cases places.parityOf k with
  | true => exact C.swapSwap x
  | false => exact C.ovRefl _

name: sgnPO_add
proof:
:= by
  show R.rel (if places.parityOf a then
      ops.swap (if places.parityOf b then ops.swap x else x)
    else (if places.parityOf b then ops.swap x else x))
    (if places.parityOf (a + b) then ops.swap x else x)
  rw [places.parityOf_add a b]
  cases places.parityOf a with
  | true =>
    cases places.parityOf b with
    | true => exact C.swapSwap x
    | false => exact C.ovRefl _
  | false =>
    cases places.parityOf b with
    | true => exact C.ovRefl _
    | false => exact C.ovRefl _

name: sgnPO_mul
proof:
:= by
  show R.rel (if places.parityOf s then ops.swap (ops.mul x y)
      else ops.mul x y)
    (ops.mul x (if places.parityOf s then ops.swap y else y))
  cases places.parityOf s with
  | true => exact C.ovSymm (C.mulSwapRight x y)
  | false => exact C.ovRefl _

name: detO_frontRec
statement:
private theorem detO_frontRec {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ}
    (C : DCore γ ops R.rel) : ∀ (k : Nat) (m : List (List γ)),
    k < m.length →
    R.rel (detO ops m) (sgnPO ops k (detO ops (frontRec k m)))
  | 0, _, _ => C.ovRefl _
  | k + 1, m, h => by
    have h1 : R.rel (detO ops (ground.adjSwap k m)) (ops.swap (detO ops m))
proof:
:=
      detO_swapAdj C k m h
    have h2 : R.rel (detO ops (ground.adjSwap k m))
        (sgnPO ops k (detO ops (frontRec k (ground.adjSwap k m)))) :=
      detO_frontRec C k (ground.adjSwap k m)
        (by rw [ground.length_adjSwap]; exact Nat.lt_of_succ_lt h)
    show R.rel (detO ops m)
      (sgnPO ops (k + 1)
        (detO ops (frontRec k (ground.adjSwap k m))))
    exact C.ovTrans
      (C.ovTrans (C.ovSymm (C.swapSwap (detO ops m)))
        (C.swapCongr (C.ovTrans (C.ovSymm h1) h2)))
      (sgnPO_succ C k (detO ops (frontRec k (ground.adjSwap k m))))

name: detO_replace
statement:
private theorem detO_replace {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ}
    (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel) (m : List (List γ)) (k : Nat)
    (hk : k < m.length) (b : List γ) :
    R.rel (detO ops (List.set m k b))
      (ground.famFold ops.add ops.unit
        (fun j => sgnPO ops (k + j)
          (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit b j)
            (cof0O ops (m.eraseIdx k) j)))
        (List.range ((m.eraseIdx k).length + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  have hks : k < (List.set m k b).length := by
    rw [ground.length_set]
    exact hk
  have hshape : frontRec k (List.set m k b) = b :: m.eraseIdx k := by
    rw [frontRec_shape [] k (List.set m k b) hks,
      ground.getAt_set_self [] b m k hk, ground.eraseIdx_set b m k]
  have hfront : R.rel (detO ops (List.set m k b))
      (sgnPO ops k (detO ops (b :: m.eraseIdx k))) := by
    have hf := detO_frontRec L.toDCore k (List.set m k b) hks
    rw [hshape] at hf
    exact hf
  refine L.ovTrans hfront ?_
  refine L.ovTrans
    (sgnPO_congr L.toDCore (detO_cons L b (m.eraseIdx k))) ?_
  refine L.ovTrans (L.ovSymm (fold_sgnPO L.toDCore k
    (fun j => sgnPO ops j
      (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit b j)
        (cof0O ops (m.eraseIdx k) j)))
    (List.range ((m.eraseIdx k).length + 1)))) ?_
  exact foldO_congr_members L.toDCore
    (fun j => sgnPO ops k (sgnPO ops j
      (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit b j)
        (cof0O ops (m.eraseIdx k) j))))
    (fun j => sgnPO ops (k + j)
      (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit b j)
        (cof0O ops (m.eraseIdx k) j)))
    (List.range ((m.eraseIdx k).length + 1))
    (fun j _ => sgnPO_add L.toDCore k j _)

name: dotO_map_range
statement:
private theorem dotO_map_range {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ)
    (g : Nat → γ) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (x : List γ), x.length = n →
      dotO ops x ((List.range n).map g)
        = ground.famFold ops.add ops.unit
          (fun j => ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit x j) (g j))
          (List.range n)
  | 0, [], _ => rfl
  | 0, _ :: _, h => nomatch h
  | _ + 1, [], h => nomatch h
  | n + 1, a :: s, h => by
    rw [range_cons n]
    show ops.add (ops.mul a (g 0))
        (dotO ops s (((List.range n).map (fun x => x + 1)).map g))
      = ops.add (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit (a :: s) 0) (g 0))
        (ground.famFold ops.add ops.unit
          (fun j => ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit (a :: s) j) (g j))
          ((List.range n).map (fun x => x + 1)))
    rw [ground.map_map (fun x => x + 1) g (List.range n),
      ground.famFold_map ops.add ops.unit _ (fun x => x + 1),
      dotO_map_range ops (fun x => g (x + 1)) n s (Nat.succ.inj h)]
    rfl

private theorem cofVecO_diag {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ}
    (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel) (m : List (List γ)) (k : Nat)
    (hk : k < m.length)
    (hrow : (ground.getAt [] m k).length = m.length) :
    R.rel (dotO ops (ground.getAt [] m k) (cofVecO ops m k))
      (detO ops m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show cofVecO ops m k = (List.range m.length).map (fun j =>
      sgnPO ops (k + j) (cof0O ops (m.eraseIdx k) j)) from rfl,
    dotO_map_range ops _ m.length (ground.getAt [] m k) hrow]
  refine L.ovTrans (foldO_congr_members L.toDCore _
    (fun j => sgnPO ops (k + j)
      (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] m k) j)
        (cof0O ops (m.eraseIdx k) j)))
    (List.range m.length)
    (fun j _ => L.ovSymm (sgnPO_mul L.toDCore (k + j) _ _))) ?_
  have hlen : (m.eraseIdx k).length + 1 = m.length :=
    length_eraseIdx m k hk
  rw [← hlen]
  refine L.ovSymm ?_
  have hrepl := detO_replace L m k hk (ground.getAt [] m k)
  rw [ground.set_self [] m k hk] at hrepl
  exact hrepl

name: cofVecO_diag
statement:
private theorem cofVecO_diag {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ}
    (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel) (m : List (List γ)) (k : Nat)
    (hk : k < m.length)
    (hrow : (ground.getAt [] m k).length = m.length) :
    R.rel (dotO ops (ground.getAt [] m k) (cofVecO ops m k))
      (detO ops m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show cofVecO ops m k = (List.range m.length).map (fun j =>
      sgnPO ops (k + j) (cof0O ops (m.eraseIdx k) j)) from rfl,
    dotO_map_range ops _ m.length (ground.getAt [] m k) hrow]
  refine L.ovTrans (foldO_congr_members L.toDCore _
    (fun j => sgnPO ops (k + j)
      (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] m k) j)
        (cof0O ops (m.eraseIdx k) j)))
    (List.range m.length)
    (fun j _ => L.ovSymm (sgnPO_mul L.toDCore (k + j) _ _))) ?_
  have hlen : (m.eraseIdx k).length + 1 = m.length :=
    length_eraseIdx m k hk
  rw [← hlen]
  refine L.ovSymm ?_
  have hrepl := detO_replace L m k hk (ground.getAt [] m k)
  rw [ground.set_self [] m k hk] at hrepl
  exact hrepl

name: cofVec_diag
statement:
theorem cofVec_diag (m : Mat) (k : Nat) (hk : k < m.length)
    (hrow : (ground.getAt [] m k).length = m.length) :
    (dotP (ground.getAt [] m k) (cofVec m k)).oneValue (detL m)
proof:
:=
  cofVecO_diag (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairLaws m k hk hrow

name: cofVecO_off
statement:
private theorem cofVecO_off {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ}
    (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel) (m : List (List γ)) (i k : Nat)
    (hi : i < m.length) (hk : k < m.length) (hik : i ≠ k)
    (hrow : (ground.getAt [] m i).length = m.length) :
    R.rel (dotO ops (ground.getAt [] m i) (cofVecO ops m k))
      ops.unit
proof:
:= by
  rw [show cofVecO ops m k = (List.range m.length).map (fun j =>
      sgnPO ops (k + j) (cof0O ops (m.eraseIdx k) j)) from rfl,
    dotO_map_range ops _ m.length (ground.getAt [] m i) hrow]
  refine L.ovTrans (foldO_congr_members L.toDCore _
    (fun j => sgnPO ops (k + j)
      (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] m i) j)
        (cof0O ops (m.eraseIdx k) j)))
    (List.range m.length)
    (fun j _ => L.ovSymm (sgnPO_mul L.toDCore (k + j) _ _))) ?_
  have hlen : (m.eraseIdx k).length + 1 = m.length :=
    length_eraseIdx m k hk
  rw [← hlen]
  refine L.ovTrans
    (L.ovSymm (detO_replace L m k hk (ground.getAt [] m i))) ?_
  have hgi : ground.getAt [] (List.set m k (ground.getAt [] m i)) i
      = ground.getAt [] m i := by
    have : ∀ (mm : List (List γ)) (kk ii : Nat)
        (bb : List γ), ii ≠ kk →
        ground.getAt [] (List.set mm kk bb) ii
          = ground.getAt [] mm ii := by
      intro mm
      induction mm with
      | nil => intro kk ii bb _; cases kk <;> rfl
      | cons a t ihm =>
        intro kk ii bb hne
        match kk, ii with
        | 0, 0 => exact absurd rfl hne
        | 0, _ + 1 => rfl
        | _ + 1, 0 => rfl
        | kk + 1, ii + 1 =>
          exact ihm kk ii bb (fun he => hne (congrArg Nat.succ he))
    exact this m k i (ground.getAt [] m i) hik
  have hgk : ground.getAt [] (List.set m k (ground.getAt [] m i)) k
      = ground.getAt [] m i := ground.getAt_set_self [] _ m k hk
  have hlset : (List.set m k (ground.getAt [] m i)).length
      = m.length := ground.length_set _ m k
  match Nat.lt_or_ge i k with
  | .inl hlt =>
    exact detO_rows_equal L hlt (by rw [hlset]; exact hk)
      (hgi.trans hgk.symm)
  | .inr hge =>
    have hklt : k < i := Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne hge
      (fun he => hik he.symm)
    exact detO_rows_equal L hklt (by rw [hlset]; exact hi)
      (hgk.trans hgi.symm)

name: cofVec_off
statement:
theorem cofVec_off (m : Mat) (i k : Nat) (hi : i < m.length)
    (hk : k < m.length) (hik : i ≠ k)
    (hrow : (ground.getAt [] m i).length = m.length) :
    (dotP (ground.getAt [] m i) (cofVec m k)).oneValue
      BPair.unit
proof:
:=
  cofVecO_off (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairLaws m i k hi hk hik hrow

name: vecAdd_eq_polyAdd
statement:
theorem vecAdd_eq_polyAdd : ∀ (u v : List BPair),
    u.length = v.length → elim.vecAdd u v = poly.add u v
  | [], [], _ => rfl
  | [], _ :: _, h => Nat.noConfusion h
  | _ :: _, [], h => Nat.noConfusion h
  | _ :: u, _ :: v, h => by
    show (_ + _) :: elim.vecAdd u v = (_ + _) :: poly.add u v
    rw [vecAdd_eq_polyAdd u v (Nat.succ.inj h)]

/
the rows, seeded at the width's unit family. -/
def combo (n : Nat) : List BPair → Mat → List BPair
proof:
:=
  comboO bpairOps n

name: length_vecScaleO
proof: := ground.length_map _ u

name: getAt_vecScaleO
statement:
private theorem getAt_vecScaleO {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ) (c : γ)
    (u : List γ) (i : Nat) (hi : i < u.length) :
    ground.getAt ops.unit (vecScaleO ops c u) i
      = ops.mul c (ground.getAt ops.unit u i)
proof:
:=
  ground.getAt_map ops.unit ops.unit (fun y => ops.mul c y) u i hi

name: length_vecAddO
statement:
private theorem length_vecAddO {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ) :
    ∀ (u w : List γ) (n : Nat), u.length = n → w.length = n →
    (vecAddO ops u w).length = n
  | [], [], _, hu, _ => hu
  | [], _ :: _, _, hu, hw => by rw [← hu] at hw; nomatch hw
  | _ :: _, [], _, hu, hw => by rw [← hu] at hw; nomatch hw
  | _ :: u, _ :: w, n, hu, hw => by
    match n, hu, hw with
    | n + 1, hu, hw =>
      show (vecAddO ops u w).length + 1 = n + 1
      rw [length_vecAddO ops u w n (Nat.succ.inj hu)
        (Nat.succ.inj hw)]

private theorem getAt_vecAddO {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ) :
    ∀ (u w : List γ) (i : Nat), i < u.length → i < w.length →
    ground.getAt ops.unit (vecAddO ops u w) i
      = ops.add (ground.getAt ops.unit u i)
          (ground.getAt ops.unit w i)
  | [], _, i, hu, _ => absurd hu (Nat.not_lt_zero i)
  | _ :: _, [], i, _, hw => absurd hw (Nat.not_lt_zero i)
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, 0, _, _ => rfl
  | _ :: u, _ :: w, i + 1, hu, hw =>
    getAt_vecAddO ops u w i (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hu)
      (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hw)


/
a combination of the rows, the clearing scalar off the sum's unit
— the carrier the decidable read is certified against
(`lem:lowerspan`). -/
private def spanRelE (n : Nat) (L : Mat) (v : List BPair) : Prop
proof:
:=
  ∃ c₀ cs, (¬ c₀.oneValue BPair.unit) ∧ cs.length = L.length
    ∧ poly.oneValue (vecScale c₀ v) (combo n cs L)

name: getAt_vecAddO
statement:
private theorem getAt_vecAddO {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ) :
    ∀ (u w : List γ) (i : Nat), i < u.length → i < w.length →
    ground.getAt ops.unit (vecAddO ops u w) i
      = ops.add (ground.getAt ops.unit u i)
          (ground.getAt ops.unit w i)
  | [], _, i, hu, _ => absurd hu (Nat.not_lt_zero i)
  | _ :: _, [], i, _, hw => absurd hw (Nat.not_lt_zero i)
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, 0, _, _ => rfl
  | _ :: u, _ :: w, i + 1, hu, hw =>
    getAt_vecAddO ops u w i (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hu)
      (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hw)


/
a combination of the rows, the clearing scalar off the sum's unit
— the carrier the decidable read is certified against
(`lem:lowerspan`). -/
private def spanRelE (n : Nat) (L : Mat) (v : List BPair) : Prop
proof:
:=
  ∃ c₀ cs, (¬ c₀.oneValue BPair.unit) ∧ cs.length = L.length
    ∧ poly.oneValue (vecScale c₀ v) (combo n cs L)

name: dotO_repl_unit
statement:
private theorem dotO_repl_unit {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ}
    (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel) : ∀ (r : List γ) (n : Nat),
    R.rel (dotO ops r (List.replicate n ops.unit)) ops.unit
  | [], 0 => L.ovRefl _
  | [], _ + 1 => L.ovRefl _
  | _ :: _, 0 => L.ovRefl _
  | a :: r, n + 1 => by
    show R.rel (ops.add (ops.mul a ops.unit)
        (dotO ops r (List.replicate n ops.unit))) ops.unit
    refine L.ovTrans
      (L.addCongr (L.mulUnit a) (dotO_repl_unit L r n)) ?_
    exact L.unitAdd ops.unit

/

name: dotO_vecAdd_right
statement:
private theorem dotO_vecAdd_right {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ}
    (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel) : ∀ (r u w : List γ),
    u.length = w.length →
    R.rel (dotO ops r (vecAddO ops u w))
      (ops.add (dotO ops r u) (dotO ops r w))
  | [], _, _, _ => L.ovSymm (L.unitAdd ops.unit)
  | _ :: _, [], [], _ => L.ovSymm (L.unitAdd ops.unit)
  | _ :: _, [], _ :: _, h => nomatch h
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, [], h => nomatch h
  | a :: r, b :: u, c :: w, h => by
    show R.rel (ops.add (ops.mul a (ops.add b c))
        (dotO ops r (vecAddO ops u w)))
      (ops.add (ops.add (ops.mul a b) (dotO ops r u))
        (ops.add (ops.mul a c) (dotO ops r w)))
    exact L.ovTrans
      (L.addCongr (L.leftDistrib a b c)
        (dotO_vecAdd_right L r u w (Nat.succ.inj h)))
      (ground.opExchO (commLawsOf L.toDCore) (ops.mul a b) (ops.mul a c)
        (dotO ops r u) (dotO ops r w))

private theorem dotO_vecAdd {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ}
    (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel) (r u w : List γ)
    (hu : u.length = r.length) (hw : w.length = r.length) :
    R.rel (dotO ops r (vecAddO ops u w))
      (ops.add (dotO ops r u) (dotO ops r w))
proof:
:=
  dotO_vecAdd_right L r u w (hu.trans hw.symm)

name: dotO_vecAdd
proof:
:=
  dotO_vecAdd_right L r u w (hu.trans hw.symm)

statement:
theorem dotP_vecAdd : ∀ (r u w : List BPair),

proof:
:=
  fun r u w hu hw => dotO_vecAdd (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairLaws r u w hu hw

name: dotP_vecAdd_right

theorem dotP_vecAdd_right : ∀ (r u w : List BPair),

name: dotO_vecScale_right
statement:
private theorem dotO_vecScale_right {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ}
    (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel) : ∀ (r u : List γ) (c : γ),
    R.rel (dotO ops r (vecScaleO ops c u)) (ops.mul c (dotO ops r u))
  | [], _, c => L.ovSymm (L.mulUnit c)
  | _ :: _, [], c => L.ovSymm (L.mulUnit c)
  | a :: r, b :: u, c => by
    show R.rel (ops.add (ops.mul a (ops.mul c b))
        (dotO ops r (vecScaleO ops c u)))
      (ops.mul c (ops.add (ops.mul a b) (dotO ops r u)))
    exact L.ovTrans
      (L.addCongr (ground.opLeftCommO (commLawsMulOf L.toDCore) a c b)
        (dotO_vecScale_right L r u c))
      (L.ovSymm (L.leftDistrib c (ops.mul a b) (dotO ops r u)))

name: dotO_congr_right
statement:
private theorem dotO_congr_right {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ}
    (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel) : ∀ (p u u' : List γ),
    u.length = u'.length →
    (∀ i, i < u.length →
      R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit u i)
        (ground.getAt ops.unit u' i)) →
    R.rel (dotO ops p u) (dotO ops p u')
  | [], _, _, _, _ => L.ovRefl _
  | _ :: _, [], [], _, _ => L.ovRefl _
  | _ :: _, [], _ :: _, hl, _ => nomatch hl
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, [], hl, _ => nomatch hl
  | a :: p, b :: u, b' :: u', hl, h => by
    show R.rel (ops.add (ops.mul a b) (dotO ops p u))
      (ops.add (ops.mul a b') (dotO ops p u'))
    exact L.addCongr
      (L.mulCongr (L.ovRefl a) (h 0 (Nat.succ_pos _)))
      (dotO_congr_right L p u u' (Nat.succ.inj hl)
        (fun i hi => h (i + 1) (Nat.succ_lt_succ hi)))

private theorem dotP_congr_right : ∀ (p u u' : List BPair),
    u.length = u'.length →
    (∀ i, i < u.length →
      (ground.getAt BPair.unit u i).oneValue
        (ground.getAt BPair.unit u' i)) →
    (dotP p u).oneValue (dotP p u')
proof:
:=
  fun p u u' hl h => dotO_congr_right (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairLaws p u u' hl h

name: dotP_congr_right
statement:
private theorem dotP_congr_right : ∀ (p u u' : List BPair),

    (∀ i, i < u.length →

        (ground.getAt BPair.unit u' i)) →
    (dotP p u).oneValue (dotP p u')
proof:

  fun p u u' hl h => dotO_congr_right (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairLaws p u u' hl h

name: length_comboO
statement:
private theorem length_comboO {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ) (n : Nat) :
    ∀ (cs : List γ) (M : List (List γ)), rowsLen n M →
      (comboO ops n cs M).length = n
  | [], _, _ => ground.length_replicate ops.unit n
  | _ :: _, [], _ => ground.length_replicate ops.unit n
  | c :: cs, r :: M, hM => by
    show (List.zipWith ops.add (r.map (fun x => ops.mul c x))
      (comboO ops n cs M)).length = n
    exact length_zipWith ops.add _ _ n
      (by rw [ground.length_map]; exact hM.1)
      (length_comboO ops n cs M hM.2)

name: comboO_getAt
statement:
theorem comboO_getAt {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel) (n : Nat) :
    ∀ (cs : List γ) (M : List (List γ)) (i : Nat),
    rowsLen n M → i < n →
    R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit (comboO ops n cs M) i)
      (dotO ops cs (M.map (fun r => ground.getAt ops.unit r i)))
  | [], _, i, _, _ => by
    show R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit
      (List.replicate n ops.unit) i) ops.unit
    rw [ground.getAt_replicate_self ops.unit n i]
    exact L.ovRefl _
  | _ :: _, [], i, _, _ => by
    show R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit
      (List.replicate n ops.unit) i) ops.unit
    rw [ground.getAt_replicate_self ops.unit n i]
    exact L.ovRefl _
  | c :: cs, r :: M', i, hM, hi => by
    have h3 : i < r.length
proof:
:= by rw [hM.1]; exact hi
    have h1 : i < (vecScaleO ops c r).length := by
      rw [length_vecScaleO]; exact h3
    have h2 : i < (comboO ops n cs M').length := by
      rw [length_comboO ops n cs M' hM.2]; exact hi
    show R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit
        (vecAddO ops (vecScaleO ops c r) (comboO ops n cs M')) i)
      (ops.add (ops.mul c (ground.getAt ops.unit r i))
        (dotO ops cs
          (M'.map (fun x => ground.getAt ops.unit x i))))
    rw [getAt_vecAddO ops _ _ i h1 h2, getAt_vecScaleO ops c r i h3]
    exact L.addCongr (L.ovRefl _) (comboO_getAt L n cs M' i hM.2 hi)

name: dotO_combo
statement:
private theorem dotO_combo {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ}
    (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel) : ∀ (cs : List γ) (M : List (List γ))
    (r : List γ) (n : Nat), rowsLen n M →
    R.rel (dotO ops r (comboO ops n cs M))
      (dotO ops cs (M.map (fun row => dotO ops r row)))
  | [], _, r, n, _ => dotO_repl_unit L r n
  | _ :: _, [], r, n, _ => dotO_repl_unit L r n
  | c :: cs, r' :: M', r, n, hM => by
    show R.rel (dotO ops r
        (vecAddO ops (vecScaleO ops c r') (comboO ops n cs M')))
      (ops.add (ops.mul c (dotO ops r r'))
        (dotO ops cs (M'.map (fun row => dotO ops r row))))
    refine L.ovTrans
      (dotO_vecAdd_right L r (vecScaleO ops c r')
        (comboO ops n cs M') (by
          show (r'.map (fun x => ops.mul c x)).length = _
          rw [ground.length_map, hM.1,
            length_comboO ops n cs M' hM.2])) ?_
    exact L.addCongr (dotO_vecScale_right L r r' c)
      (dotO_combo L cs M' r n hM.2)

name: adjPO_read
proof:
:= by
  have hrow : (ground.getAt [] G i).length = G.length :=
    hrows i (by rw [hGl]; exact hi)
  refine L.ovTrans
    (dotO_combo L p
      ((List.range G.length).map (fun k => cofVecO ops G k))
      (ground.getAt [] G i) G.length
      (rowsLen_map _ G.length (List.range G.length) (fun x _ => (fun k => length_cofVecO ops G k) x))) ?_
  rw [ground.map_map]
  refine L.ovTrans
    (dotO_congr_right L p _
      ((List.range G.length).map
        (fun k => if k = i then detO ops G else ops.unit))
      (by rw [ground.length_map, ground.length_map]) ?_) ?_
  · intro t ht
    rw [ground.length_mapRange] at ht
    rw [ground.getAt_map 0 ops.unit _
        (List.range G.length) t
        (by rw [ground.length_range]; exact ht),
      ground.getAt_map 0 ops.unit _
        (List.range G.length) t
        (by rw [ground.length_range]; exact ht),
      ground.getAt_range G.length t ht]
    by_cases hti : t = i
    · rw [if_pos hti, hti]
      exact cofVecO_diag L G i (by rw [hGl]; exact hi) hrow
    · rw [if_neg hti]
      exact cofVecO_off L G i t (by rw [hGl]; exact hi) ht
        (fun he => hti he.symm) hrow
  · rw [dotO_map_range ops _ G.length p (hp.trans hGl.symm)]
    refine L.ovTrans
      (foldO_congr_members L.toDCore _
        (fun k => if i = k then
            ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit p k) (detO ops G)
          else ops.unit)
        (List.range G.length) (fun k _ => ?_))
      (foldO_pick L
        (fun k => ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit p k) (detO ops G))
        (List.range G.length) i
        (by rw [ground.countOf_range_one
          (show i < G.length by rw [hGl]; exact hi)]))
    by_cases hki : i = k
    · rw [if_pos hki, if_pos hki.symm]
      exact L.ovRefl _
    · rw [if_neg hki, if_neg (fun he => hki he.symm)]
      exact L.mulUnit _

name: adjP_read
statement:
theorem adjP_read (G : Mat) {n : Nat} (hsq : sqAt G n)
    (p : List BPair) (hp : p.length = n) (i : Nat) (hi : i < n) :
    (dotP (ground.getAt [] G i) (adjP G p)).oneValue
      (ground.getAt BPair.unit p i * detL G)
proof:
:= by
  have hGl : G.length = n := ground.beqEq _ _ ((ground.andSplitB hsq).1)
  exact adjPO_read (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairLaws G hGl
    (fun t ht => by
      rw [sqAt_row_len hsq t ht, hGl])
    p hp i hi

name: side_add
statement:
theorem side_add {x y : BPair} (hx : x.snd ≤ x.fst)
    (hy : y.snd ≤ y.fst) : (x + y).snd ≤ (x + y).fst
proof:
:= by
  match hx, hy with
  | Or.inl ex, Or.inl ey =>
    exact Or.inl (by show x.snd + y.snd = x.fst + y.fst
                     rw [ex, ey])
  | Or.inl ex, Or.inr ⟨g, hg⟩ =>
    refine Or.inr ⟨g, ?_⟩
    show (x.snd + y.snd) + g = x.fst + y.fst
    rw [ground.add_assoc, hg, ex]
  | Or.inr ⟨g, hg⟩, Or.inl ey =>
    refine Or.inr ⟨g, ?_⟩
    show (x.snd + y.snd) + g = x.fst + y.fst
    rw [ground.add_right_comm, hg, ey]
  | Or.inr ⟨g, hg⟩, Or.inr ⟨g', hg'⟩ =>
    refine Or.inr ⟨g + g', ?_⟩
    show (x.snd + y.snd) + (g + g') = x.fst + y.fst
    rw [ground.add_add_comm x.snd y.snd g g', hg, hg']

name: side_split
statement:
theorem side_split {x y : BPair} (hx : x.snd ≤ x.fst)
    (hy : y.snd ≤ y.fst)
    (h : (x + y).oneValue BPair.unit) :
    x.oneValue BPair.unit ∧ y.oneValue BPair.unit
proof:
:= by
  have h' : x.fst + y.fst = x.snd + y.snd := add_cancel_ones h
  have hxe : x.snd = x.fst := by
    match hx with
    | Or.inl ex => exact ex
    | Or.inr ⟨g, hg⟩ =>
      exfalso
      match hy with
      | Or.inl ey =>
        have h2 : (x.snd + y.fst) + g = x.snd + y.fst := by
          rw [ground.add_right_comm x.snd y.fst g, hg, h', ey]
        exact ground.add_ne_left _ g h2
      | Or.inr ⟨g', hg'⟩ =>
        have h2 : (x.snd + y.snd) + (g + g') = x.snd + y.snd := by
          rw [ground.add_add_comm x.snd y.snd g g', hg, hg']
          exact h'
        exact ground.add_ne_left _ (g + g') h2
  have hye : y.snd = y.fst := by
    have h2 : x.snd + y.fst = x.snd + y.snd := by
      rw [← hxe] at h'
      exact h'
    exact (ground.add_left_cancel h2).symm
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · show x.fst + Pos.one = Pos.one + x.snd
    rw [hxe, ground.add_comm]
  · show y.fst + Pos.one = Pos.one + y.snd
    rw [hye, ground.add_comm]

name: dotP_self_side
statement:
theorem dotP_self_side : ∀ v : List BPair,
    (dotP v v).snd ≤ (dotP v v).fst
  | [] => Or.inl rfl
  | a :: t => side_add (sq_side a) (dotP_self_side t)

/
pairing's definiteness. -/

name: dotP_self_null
statement:
theorem dotP_self_null : ∀ v : List BPair,
    (dotP v v).oneValue BPair.unit → poly.unitTail v
  | [], _ => trivial
  | a :: t, h => by
    have hsplit
proof:
:= side_split (sq_side a) (dotP_self_side t) h
    exact ⟨entry_of_sq_null hsplit.1, dotP_self_null t hsplit.2⟩

name: dotP_swapMap
statement:
theorem dotP_swapMap : ∀ r u : List BPair,
    dotP r (u.map BPair.swap) = (dotP r u).swap
  | [], _ => rfl
  | _ :: _, [] => rfl
  | a :: r, b :: u => by
    show a * b.swap + dotP r (u.map BPair.swap)
      = (a * b + dotP r u).swap
    rw [BPair.mul_swap, dotP_swapMap r u, BPair.swap_add]

/

name: mapAdd
statement:
theorem mapAdd {α : Type} (A B : α → BPair) : ∀ l : List α,
    vecAdd (l.map A) (l.map B) = l.map (fun j => A j + B j)
  | [] => rfl
  | a :: l => by
    show (A a + B a) :: vecAdd (l.map A) (l.map B) = _
    rw [mapAdd A B l]
    rfl

/
the fold's own swap, `dotN_swap`'s twin at the other side. -/

name: dotN_swapLeft
statement:
theorem dotN_swapLeft : ∀ r c : List BPair,
    dotN (r.map BPair.swap) c = (dotN r c).swap
  | [], _ => rfl
  | _ :: _, [] => rfl
  | a :: s, b :: t => by
    show (if a.swap.isUnitRep || b.isUnitRep then
        dotN (s.map BPair.swap) t
      else (a.swap * b + dotN (s.map BPair.swap) t).norm)
      = (if a.isUnitRep || b.isUnitRep then dotN s t
        else (a * b + dotN s t).norm).swap
    rw [BPair.isUnitRep_swap]
    cases a.isUnitRep || b.isUnitRep with
    | true => exact dotN_swapLeft s t
    | false =>
      show (a.swap * b + dotN (s.map BPair.swap) t).norm
        = ((a * b + dotN s t).norm).swap
      rw [dotN_swapLeft s t, BPair.swap_mul, BPair.swap_add, BPair.norm_swap]

/

name: matVec_swapM
statement:
theorem matVec_swapM : ∀ (M : Mat) (v : List BPair),
    matVec (matSwap M) v = (matVec M v).map BPair.swap
  | [], _ => rfl
  | r :: t, v => by
    show dotN (r.map BPair.swap) v :: matVec (matSwap t) v
      = (dotN r v).swap :: (matVec t v).map BPair.swap
    rw [dotN_swapLeft r v, matVec_swapM t v]

/
private theorem dotN_swapBoth (a b : List BPair) :
    dotN (a.map BPair.swap) (b.map BPair.swap) = dotN a b
proof:
:= by
  rw [dotN_swap, dotN_swapLeft]
  rfl

name: dotN_swapBoth
statement:
private theorem dotN_swapBoth (a b : List BPair) :
    dotN (a.map BPair.swap) (b.map BPair.swap) = dotN a b
proof:
:= by
  rw [dotN_swap, dotN_swapLeft]
  rfl

name: matVec_swapArg
statement:
theorem matVec_swapArg (u : List BPair) : ∀ S : Mat,
    matVec S (u.map BPair.swap) = (matVec S u).map BPair.swap
  | [] => rfl
  | r :: t => by
    show dotN r (u.map BPair.swap) :: matVec t (u.map BPair.swap)
      = (dotN r u).swap :: (matVec t u).map BPair.swap
    rw [dotN_swap, matVec_swapArg u t]

/
partner: `matVec_swapArg` at the negation's name. -/

name: matVec_neg
statement:
theorem matVec_neg (M : Mat) (u : List BPair) :
    matVec M (poly.neg u) = poly.neg (matVec M u)

name: dotN_matVec_swapMap

theorem dotN_matVec_swapMap (S : Mat) (u : List BPair) :
    dotN (u.map BPair.swap) (matVec S (u.map BPair.swap))
      = dotN u (matVec S u)
proof:
:= by
  rw [matVec_swapArg u S, dotN_swapBoth]

name: dotO_comm
statement:
private theorem dotO_comm {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (C : DCore γ ops R.rel) :
    ∀ u v : List γ, R.rel (dotO ops u v) (dotO ops v u)
  | [], [] => C.ovRefl _
  | [], _ :: _ => C.ovRefl _
  | _ :: _, [] => C.ovRefl _
  | a :: u, b :: v => C.addCongr (C.mulComm a b) (dotO_comm C u v)

/
unit. -/
private theorem dotO_null_left {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel) :
    ∀ (v w : List γ),
      (∀ b, R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit v b) ops.unit) →
      R.rel (dotO ops v w) ops.unit
  | [], _, _ => L.ovRefl _
  | _ :: _, [], _ => L.ovRefl _
  | a :: v, b :: w, h => by
    show R.rel (ops.add (ops.mul a b) (dotO ops v w)) ops.unit
    exact L.ovTrans
      (L.addCongr
        (L.ovTrans (L.mulCongr (h 0) (L.ovRefl b)) (mulUnitLeftO L b))
        (dotO_null_left L v w (fun t => h (t + 1))))
      (L.unitAdd ops.unit)

/
width pairs at that unit. -/
private theorem dotO_null_right {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel) (p u : List γ)
    (h : ∀ i, i < u.length →
      R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit u i) ops.unit) :
    R.rel (dotO ops p u) ops.unit
proof:
:=
  L.ovTrans (dotO_comm L.toDCore p u)
    (dotO_null_left L u p (fun b =>
      match Nat.lt_or_ge b u.length with
      | .inl hb => h b hb
      | .inr hb => by
        show R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit u b) ops.unit
        rw [ground.getAt_over ops.unit u b hb]
        exact L.ovRefl _))

name: dotO_null_left
statement:
private theorem dotO_null_left {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel) :
    ∀ (v w : List γ),
      (∀ b, R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit v b) ops.unit) →
      R.rel (dotO ops v w) ops.unit
  | [], _, _ => L.ovRefl _
  | _ :: _, [], _ => L.ovRefl _
  | a :: v, b :: w, h => by
    show R.rel (ops.add (ops.mul a b) (dotO ops v w)) ops.unit
    exact L.ovTrans
      (L.addCongr
        (L.ovTrans (L.mulCongr (h 0) (L.ovRefl b)) (mulUnitLeftO L b))
        (dotO_null_left L v w (fun t => h (t + 1))))
      (L.unitAdd ops.unit)

/
width pairs at that unit. -/
private theorem dotO_null_right {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel) (p u : List γ)
    (h : ∀ i, i < u.length →
      R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit u i) ops.unit) :
    R.rel (dotO ops p u) ops.unit
proof:
:=
  L.ovTrans (dotO_comm L.toDCore p u)
    (dotO_null_left L u p (fun b =>
      match Nat.lt_or_ge b u.length with
      | .inl hb => h b hb
      | .inr hb => by
        show R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit u b) ops.unit
        rw [ground.getAt_over ops.unit u b hb]
        exact L.ovRefl _))

name: dotO_null_right
statement:
private theorem dotO_null_right {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel) (p u : List γ)
    (h : ∀ i, i < u.length →
      R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit u i) ops.unit) :
    R.rel (dotO ops p u) ops.unit
proof:

      | .inl hb => h b hb

proof:
:=

name: dotP_nil_right
statement:
theorem dotP_nil_right : ∀ u : List BPair,
    dotP u ([] : List BPair) = BPair.unit
  | [] => rfl
  | _ :: _ => rfl

/
right argument's order alone, the summands read within it. -/

name: dotP_vecAdd_left
statement:
theorem dotP_vecAdd_left : ∀ (u w x : List BPair),
    x.length ≤ u.length → x.length ≤ w.length →
    (dotP (vecAdd u w) x).oneValue (dotP u x + dotP w x)
  | u, w, [], _, _ => by
    rw [dotP_nil_right (vecAdd u w), dotP_nil_right u,
      dotP_nil_right w]
    exact BPair.oneValue_symm (BPair.add_unit BPair.unit)
  | [], _, _ :: _, hu, _ => absurd hu (Nat.not_succ_le_zero _)
  | _ :: _, [], _ :: _, _, hw => absurd hw (Nat.not_succ_le_zero _)
  | a :: u, b :: w, c :: x, hu, hw => by
    show ((a + b) * c + dotP (vecAdd u w) x).oneValue
      (a * c + dotP u x + (b * c + dotP w x))
    rw [BPair.right_distrib,
      ← BPair.add_add_comm (a * c) (b * c) (dotP u x) (dotP w x)]
    exact BPair.add_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl _)
      (dotP_vecAdd_left u w x (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hu)
        (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hw))

/
one value at every place below the right operand's order pair
against it at one value, the fold truncating at that order. -/

name: dotP_congr_left
statement:
theorem dotP_congr_left : ∀ (u u' x : List BPair),
    (∀ j, j < x.length →
      (ground.getAt BPair.unit u j).oneValue
        (ground.getAt BPair.unit u' j)) →
    (dotP u x).oneValue (dotP u' x)
  | u, u', [], _ => by
    rw [dotP_nil_right u, dotP_nil_right u']
    exact BPair.oneValue_refl _
  | [], [], _ :: _, _ => BPair.oneValue_refl _
  | [], a' :: u', c :: x, h => by
    show BPair.unit.oneValue (a' * c + dotP u' x)
    refine BPair.oneValue_symm (BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.add_congr ?_ ?_) (BPair.add_unit BPair.unit))
    · exact BPair.oneValue_trans
        (BPair.mul_congr_left
          (BPair.oneValue_symm (h 0 (Nat.succ_pos _))))
        (BPair.unit_mul c)
    · exact BPair.oneValue_symm
        (dotP_congr_left [] u' x
          (fun j hj => h (j + 1) (Nat.succ_lt_succ hj)))
  | a :: u, [], c :: x, h => by
    show (a * c + dotP u x).oneValue BPair.unit
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans (BPair.add_congr ?_ ?_)
      (BPair.add_unit BPair.unit)
    · exact BPair.oneValue_trans
        (BPair.mul_congr_left (h 0 (Nat.succ_pos _)))
        (BPair.unit_mul c)
    · exact dotP_congr_left u [] x
        (fun j hj => h (j + 1) (Nat.succ_lt_succ hj))
  | a :: u, a' :: u', c :: x, h => by
    show (a * c + dotP u x).oneValue (a' * c + dotP u' x)
    exact BPair.add_congr
      (BPair.mul_congr_left (h 0 (Nat.succ_pos _)))
      (dotP_congr_left u u' x (fun j hj => h (j + 1) (Nat.succ_lt_succ hj)))

/
reads one operand's entry at the sum's unit, the fold reads that
unit whole (`lem:lowerspan`'s pairing reads at the split
supports). -/

name: dotP_null_or
statement:
theorem dotP_null_or : ∀ (x y : List BPair),
    x.length = y.length →
    (∀ i, i < x.length →
      (ground.getAt BPair.unit x i).oneValue BPair.unit
        ∨ (ground.getAt BPair.unit y i).oneValue BPair.unit) →
    (dotP x y).oneValue BPair.unit
  | [], [], _, _ => BPair.oneValue_refl _
  | [], _ :: _, hl, _ => nomatch hl
  | _ :: _, [], hl, _ => nomatch hl
  | a :: x, b :: y, hl, h => by
    show (a * b + dotP x y).oneValue BPair.unit
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans (BPair.add_congr ?_
      (dotP_null_or x y (Nat.succ.inj hl)
        (fun i hi => h (i + 1) (Nat.succ_lt_succ hi))))
      (BPair.unit_add BPair.unit)
    match h 0 (Nat.succ_pos _) with
    | Or.inl ha => exact oneValue_unit_mul ha
    | Or.inr hb => exact oneValue_mul_unit a b hb

private theorem dotP_null_right (p u : List BPair)
    (h : ∀ i, i < u.length →
      (ground.getAt BPair.unit u i).oneValue BPair.unit) :
    (dotP p u).oneValue BPair.unit
proof:
:=
  dotO_null_right (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairLaws p u h

name: dotP_null_right
statement:
private theorem dotP_null_right (p u : List BPair)
    (h : ∀ i, i < u.length →
      (ground.getAt BPair.unit u i).oneValue BPair.unit) :
    (dotP p u).oneValue BPair.unit
proof:
:=
  dotO_null_right (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairLaws p u h

name: dotP_null_tail_right
statement:
theorem dotP_null_tail_right (p u : List BPair)
    (hu : poly.unitTail u) : (dotP p u).oneValue BPair.unit
proof:
:=
  dotP_null_right p u (fun i _ => poly.getAt_unitTail hu i)

name: dotP_null_tail_left
statement:
theorem dotP_null_tail_left (r x : List BPair)
    (hr : poly.unitTail r) : (dotP r x).oneValue BPair.unit
proof:
:= by
  rw [dotP_comm r x]
  exact dotP_null_tail_right x r hr

name: vecScale_vecAdd
statement:
theorem vecScale_vecAdd (c : BPair) : ∀ u w : List BPair,
    vecScale c (vecAdd u w) = vecAdd (vecScale c u) (vecScale c w)
  | [], _ => rfl
  | _ :: _, [] => rfl
  | a :: u, b :: w => by
    show (c * (a + b)) :: vecScale c (vecAdd u w)
      = (c * a + c * b) :: vecAdd (vecScale c u) (vecScale c w)
    rw [BPair.left_distrib, vecScale_vecAdd c u w]

/

name: vecScale_vecScale
statement:
theorem vecScale_vecScale (c d : BPair) (u : List BPair) :
    vecScale c (vecScale d u) = vecScale (c * d) u
proof:
:= by
  show (u.map (fun x => d * x)).map (fun x => c * x)
    = u.map (fun x => (c * d) * x)
  rw [ground.map_map]
  exact ground.map_congr_all _ _
    (fun x => (BPair.mul_assoc c d x).symm) u

name: vecScale_swapMap
statement:
theorem vecScale_swapMap (c : BPair) (u : List BPair) :
    vecScale c (u.map BPair.swap) = (vecScale c u).map BPair.swap
proof:
:= by
  show (u.map BPair.swap).map (fun x => c * x)
    = (u.map (fun x => c * x)).map BPair.swap
  rw [ground.map_map, ground.map_map]
  exact ground.map_congr_all _ _ (fun x => BPair.mul_swap c x) u

name: combo_swapMap
statement:
theorem combo_swapMap (n : Nat) : ∀ (cs : List BPair)
    (L : Mat), combo n (cs.map BPair.swap) L
      = (combo n cs L).map BPair.swap
  | [], _ => by
    show List.replicate n BPair.unit
      = (List.replicate n BPair.unit).map BPair.swap
    exact (ground.map_replicate BPair.swap BPair.unit n).symm
  | _ :: _, [] => by
    show List.replicate n BPair.unit
      = (List.replicate n BPair.unit).map BPair.swap
    exact (ground.map_replicate BPair.swap BPair.unit n).symm
  | c :: cs, r :: L => by
    show vecAdd (vecScale c.swap r) (combo n (cs.map BPair.swap) L)
      = (vecAdd (vecScale c r) (combo n cs L)).map BPair.swap
    rw [combo_swapMap n cs L]
    show List.zipWith BPair.add (r.map (fun x => c.swap * x))
        ((combo n cs L).map BPair.swap)
      = (List.zipWith BPair.add (r.map (fun x => c * x))
        (combo n cs L)).map BPair.swap
    rw [ground.map_congr_all (fun x => c.swap * x)
      (fun x => BPair.swap (c * x)) (fun x => BPair.swap_mul c x) r,
      ← ground.map_map (fun x => c * x) BPair.swap r]
    exact zipWith_swap _ _
  where
    zipWith_swap : ∀ u w : List BPair,
        List.zipWith BPair.add (u.map BPair.swap)
          (w.map BPair.swap)
        = (List.zipWith BPair.add u w).map BPair.swap
      | [], _ => rfl
      | _ :: _, [] => rfl
      | a :: u, b :: w => by
        show (a.swap + b.swap)
            :: List.zipWith BPair.add (u.map BPair.swap)
              (w.map BPair.swap)
          = (a + b).swap :: (List.zipWith BPair.add u w).map
            BPair.swap
        rw [BPair.swap_add, zipWith_swap u w]

/
row count as both its row and its column count. -/

name: gram_sqAt
statement: theorem gram_sqAt (L : Mat) : sqAt (gramM L) L.length
proof:
:= by
  refine ground.andIntroB ?_ ?_
  · rw [show (gramM L).length = L.length from ground.length_map _ L]
    exact beqRefl L.length
  · show ((L.map (fun r => L.map (fun c => dotP r c))).all
      (fun r => Nat.beq r.length L.length)) = true
    rw [ground.all_map]
    refine ground.all_of_pointwise _ L (fun r => ?_)
    rw [show (L.map (fun c => dotP r c)).length = L.length from
      ground.length_map _ L]
    exact beqRefl L.length

name: headD_width
statement:
theorem headD_width {γ : Type} (n : Nat) : ∀ b : List (List γ),
    0 < b.length → rowsLen n b → (b.headD ([] : List γ)).length = n
  | [], h, _ => absurd h (Nat.lt_irrefl 0)

name: rowsLen_getAt
statement:
theorem rowsLen_getAt {γ : Type} {n : Nat} :
    ∀ (L : List (List γ)) (i : Nat),
    rowsLen n L → i < L.length →
    (ground.getAt [] L i).length = n
  | [], _, _, hi => absurd hi (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | _ :: _, 0, h, _ => h.1
  | _ :: t, i + 1, h, hi =>
    rowsLen_getAt t i h.2 (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hi)

name: polyOne_vecAdd
statement:
theorem polyOne_vecAdd : ∀ (u u' w w' : List BPair),
    poly.oneValue u u' → poly.oneValue w w' →
    u.length = u'.length → w.length = w'.length →
    poly.oneValue (vecAdd u w) (vecAdd u' w')
  | [], [], _, _, _, _, _, _ => trivial
  | [], _ :: _, _, _, _, _, hu, _ => nomatch hu
  | _ :: _, [], _, _, _, _, hu, _ => nomatch hu
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, [], [], _, _, _, _ => trivial
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, [], _ :: _, _, _, _, hw => nomatch hw
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, _ :: _, [], _, _, _, hw => nomatch hw
  | _ :: u, _ :: u', _ :: w, _ :: w', hu, hw, hul, hwl =>
    ⟨BPair.add_congr hu.1 hw.1,
     polyOne_vecAdd u u' w w' hu.2 hw.2 (Nat.succ.inj hul)
       (Nat.succ.inj hwl)⟩

private theorem polyOne_refl : ∀ u : List BPair, poly.oneValue u u
  | [] => trivial
  | _ :: u => ⟨BPair.oneValue_refl _, polyOne_refl u⟩

name: polyOne_refl

name: length_combo_congr
statement:
theorem length_combo_congr (n : Nat) :
    ∀ (cs ds : List BPair) (L : Mat), cs.length = ds.length →
      (combo n cs L).length = (combo n ds L).length
  | [], [], _, _ => rfl
  | [], _ :: _, _, h => nomatch h
  | _ :: _, [], _, h => nomatch h
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, [], _ => rfl
  | c :: cs, d :: ds, r :: L, h =>
    ground.length_zipWith_congr BPair.add _ _ _ _
      ((length_vecScaleO bpairOps c r).trans
        (length_vecScaleO bpairOps d r).symm)
      (length_combo_congr n cs ds L (Nat.succ.inj h))

combination's own scale, the clearing crossing every term. -/

name: vecScale_combo
statement:
theorem vecScale_combo (c : BPair) (n : Nat) :
    ∀ (cs : List BPair) (L : Mat),
      poly.oneValue (vecScale c (combo n cs L))
        (combo n (vecScale c cs) L)
  | [], _ => by
    show poly.oneValue
      (vecScale c (List.replicate n BPair.unit))
      (List.replicate n BPair.unit)
    exact repl_scale_null c n
  | _ :: _, [] => repl_scale_null c n
  | k :: cs, r :: L => by
    show poly.oneValue
      (vecScale c (vecAdd (vecScale k r) (combo n cs L)))
      (vecAdd (vecScale (c * k) r) (combo n (vecScale c cs) L))
    rw [vecScale_vecAdd c (vecScale k r) (combo n cs L),
      vecScale_vecScale c k r]
    refine polyOne_vecAdd _ _ _ _ (polyOne_refl _)
      (vecScale_combo c n cs L) ?_ ?_
    · rfl
    · show (vecScale c (combo n cs L)).length
        = (combo n (vecScale c cs) L).length
      rw [show (vecScale c (combo n cs L)).length
          = (combo n cs L).length from ground.length_map _ _]
      exact length_combo_congr n cs (vecScale c cs) L
        (length_vecScaleO bpairOps c cs).symm
  where
    repl_scale_null (c : BPair) (n : Nat) : poly.oneValue
        (vecScale c (List.replicate n BPair.unit))
        (List.replicate n BPair.unit)
proof:
:= by
      rw [show vecScale c (List.replicate n BPair.unit)
          = List.replicate n (c * BPair.unit) from
        ground.map_replicate _ BPair.unit n]
      exact repl_go c n
    repl_go (c : BPair) : ∀ n : Nat, poly.oneValue
        (List.replicate n (c * BPair.unit))
        (List.replicate n BPair.unit)
      | 0 => trivial
      | n + 1 => ⟨BPair.mul_unit c, repl_go c n⟩

name: length_vecScale
statement:
theorem length_vecScale (c : BPair) (u : List BPair) :
    (vecScale c u).length = u.length
proof: := length_vecScaleO bpairOps c u

name: vecScale_swap
statement:
theorem vecScale_swap (c : BPair) : ∀ u : List BPair,
    vecScale (BPair.swap c) u = (vecScale c u).map BPair.swap
  | [] => rfl
  | a :: u => by
    show BPair.swap c * a :: vecScale (BPair.swap c) u
      = (c * a).swap :: (vecScale c u).map BPair.swap
    rw [vecScale_swap c u, BPair.mul_comm (BPair.swap c) a,
      BPair.mul_swap a c, BPair.mul_comm a c]

/

name: unitTail_vecScale
statement:
theorem unitTail_vecScale (c : BPair) : ∀ b : List BPair,
    poly.unitTail b → poly.unitTail (vecScale c b)
  | [], _ => trivial
  | _ :: t, h =>
    ⟨BPair.oneValue_trans
       (BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl c) h.1) (BPair.mul_unit c),
     unitTail_vecScale c t h.2⟩

/

name: vecScale_oneValue
statement:
theorem vecScale_oneValue (c : BPair) : ∀ a b : List BPair,
    poly.oneValue a b → poly.oneValue (vecScale c a) (vecScale c b)
  | [], b, h => unitTail_vecScale c b h
  | _ :: t, [], h =>
    ⟨BPair.oneValue_trans
       (BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl c) h.1) (BPair.mul_unit c),
     unitTail_vecScale c t h.2⟩
  | _ :: a, _ :: b, h =>
    ⟨BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl c) h.1, vecScale_oneValue c a b h.2⟩

/
cancellation entry by entry. -/

name: unitTail_unscale
statement:
theorem unitTail_unscale (c : BPair)
    (hc : ¬ c.oneValue BPair.unit) : ∀ u : List BPair,
    poly.unitTail (vecScale c u) → poly.unitTail u
  | [], _ => trivial
  | _ :: t, h =>
    ⟨ground.mul_cancel_unit hc h.1, unitTail_unscale c hc t h.2⟩

/
members' cancellation entry by entry with the tails' units
descending. -/

name: oneValue_unscale
statement:
theorem oneValue_unscale (c : BPair)
    (hc : ¬ c.oneValue BPair.unit) : ∀ x y : List BPair,
    poly.oneValue (vecScale c x) (vecScale c y) → poly.oneValue x y
  | [], y, h => unitTail_unscale c hc y h
  | _ :: x, [], h =>
    ⟨ground.mul_cancel_unit hc h.1, unitTail_unscale c hc x h.2⟩
  | _ :: x, _ :: y, h =>
    ⟨ground.mulCancel hc h.1, oneValue_unscale c hc x y h.2⟩

/

name: vecScale_one
statement:
theorem vecScale_one : ∀ a : List BPair,
    poly.oneValue (vecScale (BPair.ofNat 1) a) a
  | [] => trivial
  | x :: a => ⟨BPair.ofNat_one_mul x, vecScale_one a⟩

/

name: dotP_scaleRow
statement:
theorem dotP_scaleRow (w : BPair) : ∀ r u : List BPair,
    (dotP (poly.scaleP w r) u).oneValue (w * dotP r u)
  | [], _ => BPair.oneValue_symm (BPair.mul_unit w)
  | _ :: _, [] => BPair.oneValue_symm (BPair.mul_unit w)
  | a :: r, b :: u => by
    show ((w * a).norm * b
        + dotP (poly.scaleP w r) u).oneValue
      (w * (a * b + dotP r u))
    rw [BPair.left_distrib]
    refine BPair.add_congr ?_ (dotP_scaleRow w r u)
    exact BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.mul_congr (BPair.norm_oneValue _) (BPair.oneValue_refl b))
      (BPair.oneValue_of_eq (BPair.mul_assoc w a b))

private theorem length_gramM (L : Mat) :
    (gramM L).length = L.length
proof: := length_gramBy dotP L

name: length_gramM
statement:
private theorem length_gramM (L : Mat) :
    (gramM L).length = L.length
proof: := length_gramBy dotP L

name: length_adjP
statement:
theorem length_adjP (G : Mat) (p : List BPair) :
    (adjP G p).length = G.length
proof:
:= by
  show (combo G.length p
      ((List.range G.length).map (fun k => cofVec G k))).length
    = G.length
  exact length_combo G.length p _ (cofRows_rowsLen G)

name: length_residV
statement:
theorem length_residV (n : Nat) (L : Mat) (v : List BPair)
    (hLn : rowsLen n L) (hv : v.length = n) :
    (residV n L v).length = n
proof:
:= by
  refine length_zipWith BPair.add _ _ n ?_ ?_
  · rw [show (vecScale (detL (gramM L)) v).length = v.length from
      ground.length_map _ v, hv]
  · rw [ground.length_map, length_combo n _ L hLn]

name: resid_perp
statement:
theorem resid_perp (n : Nat) (L : Mat) (v : List BPair)
    (hLn : rowsLen n L) (hv : v.length = n) (i : Nat)
    (hi : i < L.length) :
    (dotP (ground.getAt [] L i) (residV n L v)).oneValue
      BPair.unit
proof:
:= by
  have hrl : (ground.getAt [] L i).length = n :=
    rowsLen_getAt L i hLn hi
  have hp : (L.map (fun r => dotP r v)).length = L.length :=
    ground.length_map _ L
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans
    (dotP_vecAdd (ground.getAt [] L i) _ _
      (by rw [show (vecScale (detL (gramM L)) v).length = v.length
            from ground.length_map _ v, hv, hrl])
      (by rw [ground.length_map,
            length_combo n _ L hLn, hrl])) ?_
  rw [dotP_swapMap]
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans
    (BPair.add_congr
      (dotP_vecScale (detL (gramM L)) (ground.getAt [] L i) v
        (by rw [hv, hrl]))
      (swap_congr
        (BPair.oneValue_trans
          (dotP_combo (adjP (gramM L) (L.map (fun r => dotP r v)))
            L (ground.getAt [] L i) n hLn)
          (by
            rw [show L.map (fun row =>
                dotP (ground.getAt [] L i) row)
              = ground.getAt [] (gramM L) i from
              (gramM_row L i hi).symm,
              dotP_comm]
            exact adjP_read (gramM L) (gram_sqAt L)
              (L.map (fun r => dotP r v)) hp i hi)))) ?_
  rw [show ground.getAt BPair.unit (L.map (fun r => dotP r v)) i
      = dotP (ground.getAt [] L i) v from
    ground.getAt_map [] BPair.unit _ L i hi,
    BPair.mul_comm (dotP (ground.getAt [] L i) v) (detL (gramM L))]
  exact ground.unitOfOne (BPair.oneValue_refl _)

name: oneValue_of_null_swap
statement:
theorem oneValue_of_null_swap : ∀ (a b : List BPair),
    a.length = b.length →
    poly.unitTail (vecAdd a (b.map BPair.swap)) →
    poly.oneValue a b
  | [], [], _, _ => trivial
  | [], _ :: _, hl, _ => nomatch hl
  | _ :: _, [], hl, _ => nomatch hl
  | _ :: a, _ :: b, hl, h =>
    ⟨ground.oneOfUnit h.1,
     oneValue_of_null_swap a b (Nat.succ.inj hl) h.2⟩

/
residual at an off-unit determinant is a span witness, the
determinant the clearing scalar. -/
private theorem resid_soundE (n : Nat) (L : Mat) (v : List BPair)
    (hLn : rowsLen n L) (hv : v.length = n)
    (hdet : ¬ (detL (gramM L)).oneValue BPair.unit)
    (h : poly.unitTail (residV n L v)) : spanRelE n L v
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨detL (gramM L),
    adjP (gramM L) (L.map (fun r => dotP r v)),
    hdet, (length_adjP (gramM L) _).trans (length_gramM L), ?_⟩
  refine oneValue_of_null_swap _ _ ?_ h
  rw [show (vecScale (detL (gramM L)) v).length = v.length from
      ground.length_map _ v, hv,
    length_combo n _ L hLn]

name: resid_soundE
statement:
private theorem resid_soundE (n : Nat) (L : Mat) (v : List BPair)
    (hLn : rowsLen n L) (hv : v.length = n)
    (hdet : ¬ (detL (gramM L)).oneValue BPair.unit)
    (h : poly.unitTail (residV n L v)) : spanRelE n L v
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨detL (gramM L),
    adjP (gramM L) (L.map (fun r => dotP r v)),
    hdet, (length_adjP (gramM L) _).trans (length_gramM L), ?_⟩
  refine oneValue_of_null_swap _ _ ?_ h
  rw [show (vecScale (detL (gramM L)) v).length = v.length from
      ground.length_map _ v, hv,
    length_combo n _ L hLn]

name: resid_completeE
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c₀, cs, hc₀, hcsl, hone⟩ := hsp
  have hw : ∀ k, k < L.length →
      (dotP (residV n L v) (ground.getAt [] L k)).oneValue
        BPair.unit := by
    intro k hk
    rw [dotP_comm]
    exact resid_perp n L v hLn hv k hk
  have hcombo_null : ∀ ds : List BPair,
      (dotP (residV n L v) (combo n ds L)).oneValue BPair.unit := by
    intro ds
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans
      (dotP_combo ds L (residV n L v) n hLn) ?_
    refine dotP_null_right ds _ (fun i hi => ?_)
    rw [ground.length_map] at hi
    rw [ground.getAt_map [] BPair.unit _ L i hi]
    exact hw i hi
  
  have hscale : poly.oneValue
      (vecScale c₀ (residV n L v))
      (vecAdd
        (vecScale (detL (gramM L)) (combo n cs L))
        ((combo n (vecScale c₀
          (adjP (gramM L) (L.map (fun r => dotP r v)))) L).map
          BPair.swap)) := by
    rw [show vecScale c₀ (residV n L v)
        = vecAdd
          (vecScale c₀ (vecScale (detL (gramM L)) v))
          (vecScale c₀ ((combo n (adjP (gramM L)
            (L.map (fun r => dotP r v))) L).map BPair.swap)) from
      vecScale_vecAdd c₀ _ _,
      vecScale_swapMap c₀ _,
      vecScale_vecScale c₀ (detL (gramM L)) v,
      show c₀ * detL (gramM L) = detL (gramM L) * c₀ from
        BPair.mul_comm _ _,
      ← vecScale_vecScale (detL (gramM L)) c₀ v]
    refine polyOne_vecAdd _ _ _ _ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · exact vecScale_oneValue (detL (gramM L)) _ _ hone
    · exact poly.swapMap_oneValue (vecScale_combo c₀ n _ L)
    · rw [length_vecScale, length_vecScale, length_vecScale,
        length_combo n cs L hLn, hv]
    · rw [ground.length_map, ground.length_map, length_vecScale,
        length_combo n _ L hLn, length_combo n _ L hLn]
  
  have hWlen : (vecScale c₀ (residV n L v)).length
      = (vecAdd (vecScale (detL (gramM L)) (combo n cs L))
        ((combo n (vecScale c₀ (adjP (gramM L)
          (L.map (fun r => dotP r v)))) L).map
          BPair.swap)).length := by
    rw [length_vecScale, length_residV n L v hLn hv]
    refine (length_zipWith BPair.add _ _ n ?_ ?_).symm
    · rw [length_vecScale, length_combo n cs L hLn]
    · rw [ground.length_map, length_combo n _ L hLn]
  have hself : (c₀ * dotP (residV n L v) (residV n L v)).oneValue
      BPair.unit := by
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.oneValue_symm
        (dotP_vecScale c₀ (residV n L v) (residV n L v)
          (by rfl))) ?_
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans
      (dotP_congr_right (residV n L v)
        (vecScale c₀ (residV n L v))
        (vecAdd (vecScale (detL (gramM L)) (combo n cs L))
          ((combo n (vecScale c₀ (adjP (gramM L)
            (L.map (fun r => dotP r v)))) L).map BPair.swap))
        hWlen
        (fun i _ =>
          poly.oneValue_getAt i hscale)) ?_
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans
      (dotP_vecAdd (residV n L v)
        (vecScale (detL (gramM L)) (combo n cs L))
        ((combo n (vecScale c₀ (adjP (gramM L)
          (L.map (fun r => dotP r v)))) L).map BPair.swap)
        (by rw [length_vecScale, length_combo n cs L hLn,
              length_residV n L v hLn hv])
        (by rw [ground.length_map, length_combo n _ L hLn,
              length_residV n L v hLn hv])) ?_
    rw [dotP_swapMap]
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.add_congr
        (BPair.oneValue_trans
          (dotP_vecScale (detL (gramM L)) (residV n L v)
            (combo n cs L)
            (by rw [length_combo n cs L hLn,
                  length_residV n L v hLn hv]))
          (BPair.oneValue_trans
            (BPair.mul_congr
              (BPair.oneValue_refl (detL (gramM L)))
              (hcombo_null cs))
            (BPair.mul_unit _)))
        (swap_congr (hcombo_null _))) ?_
    exact BPair.unit_add BPair.unit
  exact dotP_self_null (residV n L v)
    (mul_cancel_unit hc₀ hself)

name: unitTail_vecScale_unit
statement:
theorem unitTail_vecScale_unit {c : BPair}
    (hc : c.oneValue BPair.unit) : ∀ v : List BPair,
    poly.unitTail (vecScale c v)
  | [] => trivial
  | _ :: v => ⟨oneValue_unit_mul hc, unitTail_vecScale_unit hc v⟩

private theorem unitTail_split_left : ∀ {u w : List BPair},
    u.length = w.length → poly.unitTail (vecAdd u w) →
    poly.unitTail w → poly.unitTail u
  | [], [], _, _, _ => trivial
  | [], _ :: _, hl, _, _ => nomatch hl
  | _ :: _, [], hl, _, _ => nomatch hl
  | a :: u, b :: w, hl, h, hw => by
    refine ⟨?_, unitTail_split_left (Nat.succ.inj hl) h.2 hw.2⟩
    
    have h1 : (a + b).oneValue BPair.unit
proof:
:= h.1
    have h2 : (a + b).oneValue a := by
      show (a.fst + b.fst) + a.snd = a.fst + (a.snd + b.snd)
      have h3 : b.fst = b.snd := add_cancel_ones hw.1
      rw [h3, ground.add_right_comm a.fst b.snd a.snd,
        ground.add_assoc]
    exact BPair.oneValue_trans (BPair.oneValue_symm h2) h1

name: unitTail_split_left
statement:
private theorem unitTail_split_left : ∀ {u w : List BPair},
    u.length = w.length → poly.unitTail (vecAdd u w) →
    poly.unitTail w → poly.unitTail u
  | [], [], _, _, _ => trivial
  | [], _ :: _, hl, _, _ => nomatch hl
  | _ :: _, [], hl, _, _ => nomatch hl
  | a :: u, b :: w, hl, h, hw => by
    refine ⟨?_, unitTail_split_left (Nat.succ.inj hl) h.2 hw.2⟩
    
    have h1 : (a + b).oneValue BPair.unit
proof:
:= h.1
    have h2 : (a + b).oneValue a := by
      show (a.fst + b.fst) + a.snd = a.fst + (a.snd + b.snd)
      have h3 : b.fst = b.snd := add_cancel_ones hw.1
      rw [h3, ground.add_right_comm a.fst b.snd a.snd,
        ground.add_assoc]
    exact BPair.oneValue_trans (BPair.oneValue_symm h2) h1

name: splitLast
statement:
private theorem splitLast {α : Type} : ∀ (l : List α), l = [] ∨
    ∃ (t : List α) (a : α), l = t ++ [a]
  | [] => Or.inl rfl
  | a :: l =>
    match splitLast l with
    | Or.inl he => Or.inr ⟨[], a, by rw [he]; rfl⟩
    | Or.inr ⟨t, b, he⟩ => Or.inr ⟨a :: t, b, by rw [he]; rfl⟩

/

name: unitTail_append
statement:
theorem unitTail_append : ∀ {a b : List BPair},
    poly.unitTail a → poly.unitTail b → poly.unitTail (a ++ b)
  | [], _, _, hb => hb
  | _ :: t, _, ha, hb => ⟨ha.1, unitTail_append (a := t) ha.2 hb⟩

/
first's memberwise swap, at matched counts. -/

name: swap_of_null_add
statement:
theorem swap_of_null_add : ∀ (a b : List BPair),
    a.length = b.length → poly.unitTail (vecAdd a b) →
    poly.oneValue b (a.map BPair.swap)
  | [], [], _, _ => trivial
  | [], _ :: _, hl, _ => nomatch hl
  | _ :: _, [], hl, _ => nomatch hl
  | x :: a, y :: b, hl, h => by
    refine ⟨?_, swap_of_null_add a b (Nat.succ.inj hl) h.2⟩
    have h1 : x.fst + y.fst = x.snd + y.snd
proof:
:= add_cancel_ones h.1
    show y.fst + x.fst = x.snd + y.snd
    rw [ground.add_comm y.fst x.fst]
    exact h1

name: matOne_of_entries
statement:
theorem matOne_of_entries (A B : Mat) (n : Nat)
    (hAl : A.length = n) (hAr : rowsLen n A)
    (hBl : B.length = n) (hBr : rowsLen n B)
    (h : ∀ i j, i < n → j < n →
      (ground.getAt BPair.unit
          (ground.getAt ([] : List BPair) A i) j).oneValue
        (ground.getAt BPair.unit
          (ground.getAt ([] : List BPair) B i) j)) :
    matOneValue A B
proof:
:= by
  refine matOne_getAt A B (by rw [hAl, hBl]) ?_
  intro i hi
  rw [hAl] at hi
  refine poly.oneValue_of_entries _ _ ?_ ?_
  · rw [rowsLen_getAt A i hAr (by rw [hAl]; exact hi),
      rowsLen_getAt B i hBr (by rw [hBl]; exact hi)]
  · intro j hj
    rw [rowsLen_getAt A i hAr (by rw [hAl]; exact hi)] at hj
    exact h i j hi hj

name: length_vecAdd
statement:
theorem length_vecAdd (u w : List BPair) (n : Nat)
    (hu : u.length = n) (hw : w.length = n) :
    (vecAdd u w).length = n
proof: := length_vecAddO bpairOps u w n hu hw

name: getAt_vecAdd
statement:
theorem getAt_vecAdd (u w : List BPair) (i : Nat)
    (hu : i < u.length) (hw : i < w.length) :
    ground.getAt BPair.unit (vecAdd u w) i
      = ground.getAt BPair.unit u i + ground.getAt BPair.unit w i
proof:
:=
  getAt_vecAddO bpairOps u w i hu hw

name: pnorm_vecAdd_left
statement:
theorem pnorm_vecAdd_left (u v : List BPair)
    (h : u.length = v.length) :
    poly.pnorm (vecAdd (poly.pnorm u) v)
      = poly.pnorm (vecAdd u v)
proof:
:= by
  refine poly.pnorm_congr _ _ ?_ ?_
  · rw [length_vecAdd (poly.pnorm u) v (poly.pnorm u).length rfl
      (((poly.pnorm_length u).trans h).symm),
      length_vecAdd u v u.length rfl h.symm]
    exact poly.pnorm_length u
  · exact polyOne_vecAdd _ _ _ _ (poly.pnorm_oneValue u)
      (poly.oneValue_refl v) (poly.pnorm_length u) rfl

name: getAt_vecScale
statement:
theorem getAt_vecScale (c : BPair) (u : List BPair) (i : Nat)
    (hi : i < u.length) :
    ground.getAt BPair.unit (vecScale c u) i
      = c * ground.getAt BPair.unit u i
proof:
:=
  getAt_vecScaleO bpairOps c u i hi

name: vecAdd_replicate
statement:
private theorem vecAdd_replicate : ∀ (v : List BPair) (n : Nat), v.length = n →
    poly.oneValue (vecAdd v (List.replicate n BPair.unit)) v
  | [], 0, _ => trivial
  | [], _ + 1, h => Nat.noConfusion h
  | _ :: _, 0, h => Nat.noConfusion h
  | a :: t, n + 1, h =>
    ⟨BPair.add_unit a, vecAdd_replicate t n (Nat.succ.inj h)⟩

/

name: combo_one
statement:
theorem combo_one (n : Nat) (c : BPair) (u : List BPair)
    (hu : u.length = n) :
    poly.oneValue (combo n [c] [u]) (vecScale c u)
proof:
:=
  vecAdd_replicate (vecScale c u) n ((length_vecScale c u).trans hu)

name: combo_append_one
statement:
private theorem combo_append_one (n : Nat) :
    ∀ (cs : List BPair) (c : BPair) (L : Mat) (v : List BPair),
    cs.length = L.length → rowsLen n L → v.length = n →
    poly.oneValue (combo n (cs ++ [c]) (L ++ [v]))
      (vecAdd (combo n cs L) (vecScale c v))
  | [], c, [], v, _, _, hv => by
    show poly.oneValue
      (vecAdd (vecScale c v) (List.replicate n BPair.unit))
      (vecAdd (List.replicate n BPair.unit) (vecScale c v))
    refine poly.oneValue_of_entries _ _ ?_ ?_
    · rw [length_vecAdd _ _ n (by rw [length_vecScale, hv])
          (ground.length_replicate BPair.unit n),
        length_vecAdd _ _ n (ground.length_replicate BPair.unit n)
          (by rw [length_vecScale, hv])]
    · intro i hi
      rw [length_vecAdd _ _ n (by rw [length_vecScale, hv])
          (ground.length_replicate BPair.unit n)] at hi
      rw [getAt_vecAdd _ _ i
          (by rw [length_vecScale, hv]; exact hi)
          (by rw [ground.length_replicate BPair.unit n]; exact hi),
        getAt_vecAdd _ _ i
          (by rw [ground.length_replicate BPair.unit n]; exact hi)
          (by rw [length_vecScale, hv]; exact hi)]
      show (ground.getAt BPair.unit (vecScale c v) i
          + ground.getAt BPair.unit
            (List.replicate n BPair.unit) i).oneValue
        (ground.getAt BPair.unit (List.replicate n BPair.unit) i
          + ground.getAt BPair.unit (vecScale c v) i)
      rw [BPair.add_comm]
      exact BPair.oneValue_refl _
  | [], _, _ :: _, _, hcl, _, _ => nomatch hcl
  | _ :: _, _, [], _, hcl, _, _ => nomatch hcl
  | c' :: cs, c, r :: L, v, hcl, hL, hv => by
    show poly.oneValue
      (vecAdd (vecScale c' r) (combo n (cs ++ [c]) (L ++ [v])))
      (vecAdd (vecAdd (vecScale c' r) (combo n cs L))
        (vecScale c v))
    refine poly.oneValue_trans (q := vecAdd (vecScale c' r)
        (vecAdd (combo n cs L) (vecScale c v))) ?_ ?_
    · refine polyOne_vecAdd _ _ _ _ (polyOne_refl _)
        (combo_append_one n cs c L v (Nat.succ.inj hcl) hL.2 hv)
        rfl
        (by rw [length_combo_app n cs c L v (Nat.succ.inj hcl)
              hL.2 hv,
            length_vecAdd _ _ n (length_combo n cs L hL.2)
              (by rw [length_vecScale, hv])])
    · refine poly.oneValue_of_entries _ _ ?_ ?_
      · rw [length_vecAdd _ _ n
            (by rw [length_vecScale]; exact hL.1)
            (length_vecAdd _ _ n (length_combo n cs L hL.2)
              (by rw [length_vecScale, hv])),
          length_vecAdd _ _ n
            (length_vecAdd _ _ n
              (by rw [length_vecScale]; exact hL.1)
              (length_combo n cs L hL.2))
            (by rw [length_vecScale, hv])]
      · intro i hi
        rw [length_vecAdd _ _ n
            (by rw [length_vecScale]; exact hL.1)
            (length_vecAdd _ _ n (length_combo n cs L hL.2)
              (by rw [length_vecScale, hv]))] at hi
        have h1 : i < (vecScale c' r).length
proof:
:= by
          rw [length_vecScale]
          rw [hL.1]
          exact hi
        have h2 : i < (combo n cs L).length := by
          rw [length_combo n cs L hL.2]
          exact hi
        have h3 : i < (vecScale c v).length := by
          rw [length_vecScale, hv]
          exact hi
        rw [getAt_vecAdd _ _ i h1
            (by
              rw [length_vecAdd _ _ n (length_combo n cs L hL.2)
                (by rw [length_vecScale, hv])]
              exact hi),
          getAt_vecAdd _ _ i h2 h3,
          getAt_vecAdd _ _ i
            (by
              rw [length_vecAdd _ _ n
                (by rw [length_vecScale]; exact hL.1)
                (length_combo n cs L hL.2)]
              exact hi)
            h3,
          getAt_vecAdd _ _ i h1 h2,
          ← BPair.add_assoc]
        exact BPair.oneValue_refl _
  where
    length_combo_app (n : Nat) (cs : List BPair) (c : BPair)
        (L : Mat) (v : List BPair) (hcl : cs.length = L.length)
        (hL : rowsLen n L) (hv : v.length = n) :
        (combo n (cs ++ [c]) (L ++ [v])).length = n :=
      length_combo n (cs ++ [c]) (L ++ [v])
        (rowsLen_append n hL ⟨hv, trivial⟩)

name: termO_congr_letters
statement:
private theorem termO_congr_letters {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (C : DCore γ ops R.rel) (m : Nat) :
    ∀ (M N : List (List γ)) (t : List Nat), M.length = N.length →
    (∀ a, a < M.length → ∀ b, b < m →
      R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] M a) b)
        (ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] N a) b)) →
    (∀ x, 0 < ground.countOf x t → x < m) →
    R.rel (termO ops M t) (termO ops N t)
  | [], [], _, _, _, _ => C.ovRefl _
  | [], _ :: _, _, hl, _, _ => nomatch hl
  | _ :: _, [], _, hl, _, _ => nomatch hl
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, [], _, _, _ => C.ovRefl _
  | r :: M, s :: N, j :: t, hl, h, ht =>
    C.mulCongr
      (h 0 (Nat.succ_pos _) j
        (ht j (by rw [ground.countOf_head]; exact Nat.succ_pos _)))
      (termO_congr_letters C m M N t (Nat.succ.inj hl)
        (fun a ha b hb => h (a + 1) (Nat.succ_lt_succ ha) b hb)
        (fun x hx => ht x
          (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hx (Nat.le_add_left _ _))))

/

private theorem rowsLen_split (n : Nat) : ∀ (L : Mat)

    rowsLen n L ∧ v.length = n

private theorem indep_dropLast (n : Nat) (L : Mat)

    (hind : ∀ cs, cs.length = (L ++ [v]).length →
      poly.unitTail (combo n cs (L ++ [v])) → poly.unitTail cs) :
    ∀ cs, cs.length = L.length → poly.unitTail (combo n cs L) →
      poly.unitTail cs
proof:
:= by
  intro cs hcl hnull
  have h1 : poly.unitTail
      (combo n (cs ++ [BPair.unit]) (L ++ [v])) := by
    refine poly.oneValue_unitTail
      (combo_append_one n cs BPair.unit L v hcl hLn hv) ?_
    exact unitTail_vecAdd_of hnull
      (unitTail_vecScale_unit (BPair.oneValue_refl BPair.unit) v)
  have h2 := hind (cs ++ [BPair.unit])
    (by rw [ground.length_append, ground.length_append, hcl]; rfl) h1
  exact (unitTail_append_split _ _ h2).1

private theorem eraseIdx_map {α β : Type} (f : α → β) :
    ∀ (l : List α) (k : Nat),
      (l.map f).eraseIdx k = (l.eraseIdx k).map f
  | [], 0 => rfl
  | [], _ + 1 => rfl
  | _ :: _, 0 => rfl
  | a :: l, k + 1 => by
    show f a :: (l.map f).eraseIdx k = f a :: (l.eraseIdx k).map f
    rw [eraseIdx_map f l k]

private theorem eraseIdx_append_last {α : Type} :
    ∀ (l : List α) (a : α), (l ++ [a]).eraseIdx l.length = l
  | [], _ => rfl
  | x :: l, a => by
    show x :: (l ++ [a]).eraseIdx l.length = x :: l
    rw [eraseIdx_append_last l a]

name: cof_last_bridge
proof:
:= by
  have herase : (gramM (L ++ [v])).eraseIdx L.length
      = L.map (fun r => (L ++ [v]).map (fun c => dotP r c)) := by
    show ((L ++ [v]).map (fun r => (L ++ [v]).map
        (fun c => dotP r c))).eraseIdx L.length = _
    rw [eraseIdx_map _ (L ++ [v]) L.length,
      eraseIdx_append_last L v]
  rw [herase]
  show ground.famFold BPair.add BPair.unit
      (fun t => sgnAt t (termAt (L.map (fun r =>
        (L ++ [v]).map (fun c => dotP r c))) t))
      (places.monomialsAt (subContent L.length
        (L.map (fun r => (L ++ [v]).map
          (fun c => dotP r c))).length))
    = _
  rw [show (L.map (fun r => (L ++ [v]).map
      (fun c => dotP r c))).length = L.length from
    ground.length_map _ L]
  rw [show subContent L.length L.length
      = List.replicate L.length 1 ++ [0] from by
    show List.replicate L.length 1
        ++ 0 :: List.replicate (L.length - L.length) 1
      = List.replicate L.length 1 ++ [0]
    rw [Nat.sub_self]
    rfl,
    places.monomialsAt_zero_tail (List.replicate L.length 1)]
  show _ = ground.famFold BPair.add BPair.unit
    (fun t => sgnAt t (termAt (gramM L) t))
    (places.monomialsAt (List.replicate (gramM L).length 1))
  rw [length_gramM L]
  refine ground.famFold_congr_members BPair.add BPair.unit _ _
    (places.monomialsAt (List.replicate L.length 1))
    (fun t ht => ?_)
  rw [termAt_congr_letters L.length
    (L.map (fun r => (L ++ [v]).map (fun c => dotP r c)))
    (gramM L) t
    (by rw [ground.length_map, length_gramM])
    (fun i hi j hj => by
      rw [ground.length_map] at hi
      rw [ground.getAt_map ([] : List BPair) ([] : List BPair)
          (fun r => (L ++ [v]).map (fun c => dotP r c)) L i hi,
        gramM_row L i hi,
        ground.map_append (fun c => dotP (ground.getAt [] L i) c)
          L [v],
        ground.getAt_append BPair.unit _ _ j,
        if_pos (by rw [ground.length_map]; exact hj)])
    (fun x hx => (places.perm_member_reads ht).2.2.1 x hx)]

statement:
private theorem combo_self_null (n : Nat) (L : Mat)

        BPair.unit) : poly.unitTail (combo n e L)
proof:
:= by

  refine BPair.oneValue_trans
    (dotP_combo e L (combo n e L) n hLn) ?_
  refine dotP_null_right e _ (fun i hi => ?_)

  exact hperp i hi

statement:
