proof: := by decide +kernel

name: indep_det_go
statement:
private theorem indep_det_go : ∀ (fuel n : Nat) (L : Mat),
    L.length ≤ fuel → rowsLen n L →
    (∀ cs, cs.length = L.length → poly.unitTail (combo n cs L) →
      poly.unitTail cs) →
    ¬ (detL (gramM L)).oneValue BPair.unit
  | _, _, [], _, _, _ => det_nil
  | 0, _, _ :: _, hf, _, _ => nomatch hf
  | fuel + 1, n, r :: L, hf, hLn, hind => by
    match splitLast (r :: L) with
    | Or.inl he => exact nomatch he
    | Or.inr ⟨L', v, he⟩ =>
      rw [he] at hLn hind ⊢
      obtain ⟨hLn', hv⟩
proof:
:= rowsLen_split n L' v hLn
      have hf' : L'.length ≤ fuel := by
        have h1 : (L' ++ [v]).length ≤ fuel + 1 := by
          rw [← he]
          exact hf
        rw [ground.length_append] at h1
        exact Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ h1
      have ihdet := indep_det_go fuel n L' hf' hLn'
        (indep_dropLast n L' v hLn' hv hind)
      intro hdet
      have hGl : (gramM (L' ++ [v])).length = L'.length + 1 := by
        rw [length_gramM, ground.length_append]
        rfl
      have hm : L'.length < (gramM (L' ++ [v])).length := by
        rw [hGl]
        exact Nat.lt_succ_self _
      have hperp : ∀ i, i < (L' ++ [v]).length →
          (dotP (ground.getAt [] (L' ++ [v]) i)
            (combo n (cofVec (gramM (L' ++ [v])) L'.length)
              (L' ++ [v]))).oneValue BPair.unit := by
        intro i hi
        have hiG : i < (gramM (L' ++ [v])).length := by
          rw [length_gramM]
          exact hi
        have hrow : (ground.getAt []
            (gramM (L' ++ [v])) i).length
            = (gramM (L' ++ [v])).length := by
          rw [sqAt_row_len (gram_sqAt (L' ++ [v])) i hiG,
            length_gramM]
        refine BPair.oneValue_trans
          (dotP_combo (cofVec (gramM (L' ++ [v])) L'.length)
            (L' ++ [v]) (ground.getAt [] (L' ++ [v]) i) n
            hLn) ?_
        rw [show (L' ++ [v]).map (fun row =>
            dotP (ground.getAt [] (L' ++ [v]) i) row)
          = ground.getAt [] (gramM (L' ++ [v])) i from
          (gramM_row (L' ++ [v]) i hi).symm,
          dotP_comm]
        by_cases him : i = L'.length
        · rw [him]
          refine BPair.oneValue_trans
            (cofVec_diag (gramM (L' ++ [v])) L'.length hm
              (by rw [← him]; exact hrow)) ?_
          exact hdet
        · exact cofVec_off (gramM (L' ++ [v])) i L'.length hiG
            hm him hrow
      have hnul := combo_self_null n (L' ++ [v]) hLn
        (cofVec (gramM (L' ++ [v])) L'.length) hperp
      have hcof := hind (cofVec (gramM (L' ++ [v])) L'.length)
        (by rw [length_cofVec, length_gramM]) hnul
      have hentry := poly.getAt_unitTail hcof L'.length
      rw [show ground.getAt BPair.unit
          (cofVec (gramM (L' ++ [v])) L'.length) L'.length
        = sgnP (L'.length + L'.length)
          (cof0 ((gramM (L' ++ [v])).eraseIdx L'.length)
            L'.length) from by
        show ground.getAt BPair.unit
            ((List.range (gramM (L' ++ [v])).length).map (fun j =>
              sgnP (L'.length + j)
                (cof0 ((gramM (L' ++ [v])).eraseIdx L'.length)
                  j))) L'.length = _
        rw [ground.getAt_map 0 BPair.unit _
            (List.range (gramM (L' ++ [v])).length) L'.length
            (by rw [ground.length_range]; exact hm),
          ground.getAt_range _ L'.length hm]] at hentry
      exact ihdet (by
        rw [← cof_last_bridge L' v]
        exact sgnP_unit hentry)

statement:
theorem indep_intro (n : Nat) (L : Mat) (hLn : rowsLen n L)

        (BPair.add_congr hu.1 (BPair.oneValue_refl c))

name: combo_append
statement:
theorem combo_append (n : Nat) : ∀ (cs : List BPair) (L : Mat)
    (ds : List BPair) (M : Mat), cs.length = L.length →
    rowsLen n L → rowsLen n M →
    poly.oneValue (combo n (cs ++ ds) (L ++ M))
      (vecAdd (combo n cs L) (combo n ds M))
  | [], [], ds, M, _, _, hM => by
    show poly.oneValue (combo n ds M)
      (vecAdd (List.replicate n BPair.unit) (combo n ds M))
    exact poly.oneValue_symm
      (vecAdd_null_left _ _
        (by rw [ground.length_replicate, length_combo n ds M hM])
        (poly.unitTail_replicate n))
  | [], _ :: _, _, _, hl, _, _ => nomatch hl
  | _ :: _, [], _, _, hl, _, _ => nomatch hl
  | c :: cs, r :: L, ds, M, hl, hL, hM => by
    have hA : (vecScale c r).length = n
proof:
:= by
      rw [length_vecScale]; exact hL.1
    have hB : (combo n cs L).length = n := length_combo n cs L hL.2
    have hC : (combo n ds M).length = n := length_combo n ds M hM
    have hBC : (vecAdd (combo n cs L) (combo n ds M)).length = n :=
      length_vecAdd _ _ n hB hC
    have hAB : (vecAdd (vecScale c r) (combo n cs L)).length = n :=
      length_vecAdd _ _ n hA hB
    show poly.oneValue
      (vecAdd (vecScale c r) (combo n (cs ++ ds) (L ++ M)))
      (vecAdd (vecAdd (vecScale c r) (combo n cs L)) (combo n ds M))
    refine poly.oneValue_trans
      (q := vecAdd (vecScale c r)
        (vecAdd (combo n cs L) (combo n ds M))) ?_ ?_
    · exact polyOne_vecAdd _ _ _ _ (polyOne_refl _)
        (combo_append n cs L ds M (Nat.succ.inj hl) hL.2 hM) rfl
        (by rw [length_combo n (cs ++ ds) (L ++ M)
              (rowsLen_append n hL.2 hM), hBC])
    · refine poly.oneValue_of_entries _ _
        (by rw [length_vecAdd _ _ n hA hBC,
          length_vecAdd _ _ n hAB hC]) ?_
      intro i hi
      rw [length_vecAdd _ _ n hA hBC] at hi
      rw [getAt_vecAdd _ _ i (by rw [hA]; exact hi)
          (by rw [hBC]; exact hi),
        getAt_vecAdd _ _ i (by rw [hB]; exact hi)
          (by rw [hC]; exact hi),
        getAt_vecAdd _ _ i (by rw [hAB]; exact hi)
          (by rw [hC]; exact hi),
        getAt_vecAdd _ _ i (by rw [hA]; exact hi)
          (by rw [hB]; exact hi),
        ← BPair.add_assoc]
      exact BPair.oneValue_refl _

name: combo_append_units
statement:
private theorem combo_append_units (n : Nat) :
    ∀ (L : Mat) (cs : List BPair), cs.length = L.length →
      rowsLen n L → ∀ M : Mat, rowsLen n M →
      poly.oneValue
        (combo n (cs ++ List.replicate M.length BPair.unit)
          (L ++ M))
        (combo n cs L)
proof:
:=
  fun L cs hcl hL M hM =>
    poly.oneValue_trans
      (combo_append n cs L (List.replicate M.length BPair.unit) M
        hcl hL hM)
      (vecAdd_null_right _ _
        (by rw [length_combo n cs L hL, length_combo n _ M hM])
        (combo_unitsT n M M.length))

name: spanE_mono
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c₀, cs, hc₀, hcl, hone⟩ := h
  refine ⟨c₀, cs ++ List.replicate M.length BPair.unit, hc₀, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [ground.length_append, ground.length_append, hcl,
      ground.length_replicate]
  · exact poly.oneValue_trans hone
      (poly.oneValue_symm
        (combo_append_units n L cs hcl hL M hM))

name: spanE_getAt
statement:
private theorem spanE_getAt (n : Nat) :
    ∀ (L : Mat) (k : Nat), k < L.length → rowsLen n L →
      spanRelE n L (ground.getAt [] L k)
  | [], k, hk, _ => absurd hk (Nat.not_lt_zero k)
  | r :: L, 0, _, hL => by
    refine ⟨BPair.ofNat 1,
      BPair.ofNat 1 :: List.replicate L.length BPair.unit,
      BPair.ofNat_one_off, ?_, ?_⟩
    · show (List.replicate L.length BPair.unit).length + 1
        = L.length + 1
      rw [ground.length_replicate]
    · show poly.oneValue (vecScale (BPair.ofNat 1) r)
        (vecAdd (vecScale (BPair.ofNat 1) r)
          (combo n (List.replicate L.length BPair.unit) L))
      exact poly.oneValue_symm
        (vecAdd_null_right _ _
          (by
            rw [show (vecScale (BPair.ofNat 1) r).length
                = r.length from ground.length_map _ r, hL.1,
              length_combo n _ L hL.2])
          (combo_unitsT n L L.length))
  | r :: L, k + 1, hk, hL => by
    match spanE_getAt n L k (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hk) hL.2 with
    | ⟨c₀, cs, hc₀, hcl, hone⟩ =>
      refine ⟨c₀, BPair.unit :: cs, hc₀,
        congrArg Nat.succ hcl, ?_⟩
      show poly.oneValue (vecScale c₀ (ground.getAt [] L k))
        (vecAdd (vecScale BPair.unit r) (combo n cs L))
      exact poly.oneValue_trans hone
        (poly.oneValue_symm (vecAdd_null_left _ _
          (by rw [show (vecScale BPair.unit r).length = r.length from
              ground.length_map _ r, hL.1,
            length_combo n cs L hL.2])
          (unitTail_vecScale_unit
            (BPair.oneValue_refl BPair.unit) r)))

/-! The span's linearity reads: a vector at the unit tail sits in
every span, and two members' join sits in the span at the
clearings multiplied — the combination read through the
coefficients' own scaling and sum. -/

/
combination's read. -/
private theorem spanE_null (n : Nat) (L : Mat) (v : List BPair)
    (hu : poly.unitTail v) : spanRelE n L v
proof:
:=
  ⟨BPair.ofNat 1, List.replicate L.length BPair.unit,
    BPair.ofNat_one_off,
    ground.length_replicate BPair.unit L.length,
    poly.unitTail_oneValue
      (unitTail_vecScale (BPair.ofNat 1) v hu)
      (combo_unitsT n L L.length)⟩

name: spanE_null
statement:
private theorem spanE_null (n : Nat) (L : Mat) (v : List BPair)
    (hu : poly.unitTail v) : spanRelE n L v
proof:
:=
  ⟨BPair.ofNat 1, List.replicate L.length BPair.unit,
    BPair.ofNat_one_off,
    ground.length_replicate BPair.unit L.length,
    poly.unitTail_oneValue
      (unitTail_vecScale (BPair.ofNat 1) v hu)
      (combo_unitsT n L L.length)⟩

name: vecAdd_nil_right
statement:
private theorem vecAdd_nil_right : ∀ u : List BPair,
    vecAdd u [] = []
  | [] => rfl
  | _ :: _ => rfl

/
scalings. -/

name: vecScale_add
statement:
theorem vecScale_add (c d : BPair) :
    ∀ r : List BPair,
      vecScale (c + d) r = vecAdd (vecScale c r) (vecScale d r)
  | [] => rfl
  | x :: r => by
    show (c + d) * x :: vecScale (c + d) r
      = (c * x + d * x) :: vecAdd (vecScale c r) (vecScale d r)
    rw [BPair.right_distrib, vecScale_add c d r]

/

name: vecAdd_add_comm
statement:
theorem vecAdd_add_comm : ∀ a b x y : List BPair,
    vecAdd (vecAdd a b) (vecAdd x y)
      = vecAdd (vecAdd a x) (vecAdd b y)
  | [], _, _, _ => rfl
  | a1 :: a, [], x, _ => by
    show ([] : List BPair) = vecAdd (vecAdd (a1 :: a) x) []
    exact (vecAdd_nil_right _).symm
  | a1 :: a, b1 :: b, [], _ => by
    show vecAdd (vecAdd (a1 :: a) (b1 :: b)) [] = []
    exact vecAdd_nil_right _
  | a1 :: a, b1 :: b, x1 :: x, [] => by
    show vecAdd (vecAdd (a1 :: a) (b1 :: b)) []
      = vecAdd (vecAdd (a1 :: a) (x1 :: x)) []
    rw [vecAdd_nil_right (vecAdd (a1 :: a) (b1 :: b)),
      vecAdd_nil_right (vecAdd (a1 :: a) (x1 :: x))]
  | a1 :: a, b1 :: b, x1 :: x, y1 :: y => by
    show (a1 + b1 + (x1 + y1)) :: vecAdd (vecAdd a b) (vecAdd x y)
      = (a1 + x1 + (b1 + y1)) :: vecAdd (vecAdd a x) (vecAdd b y)
    rw [BPair.add_add_comm a1 b1 x1 y1, vecAdd_add_comm a b x y]

/
weights' combination is the two combinations' memberwise sum, at
one coefficient count. -/

name: combo_vecAdd
statement:
theorem combo_vecAdd (n : Nat) :
    ∀ (cs ds : List BPair) (L : Mat), cs.length = ds.length →
      poly.oneValue (combo n (vecAdd cs ds) L)
        (vecAdd (combo n cs L) (combo n ds L))
  | [], [], _, _ =>
    poly.unitTail_oneValue (poly.unitTail_replicate n)
      (unitTail_vecAdd_of (poly.unitTail_replicate n)
        (poly.unitTail_replicate n))
  | [], _ :: _, _, h => nomatch h
  | _ :: _, [], _, h => nomatch h
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, [], _ =>
    poly.unitTail_oneValue (poly.unitTail_replicate n)
      (unitTail_vecAdd_of (poly.unitTail_replicate n)
        (poly.unitTail_replicate n))
  | c :: cs, d :: ds, r :: L, h => by
    show poly.oneValue
      (vecAdd (vecScale (c + d) r) (combo n (vecAdd cs ds) L))
      (vecAdd (vecAdd (vecScale c r) (combo n cs L))
        (vecAdd (vecScale d r) (combo n ds L)))
    rw [vecScale_add c d r,
      ← vecAdd_add_comm (vecScale c r) (vecScale d r)
        (combo n cs L) (combo n ds L)]
    refine polyOne_vecAdd _ _ _ _ (polyOne_refl _)
      (combo_vecAdd n cs ds L (Nat.succ.inj h)) rfl ?_
    rw [length_combo_congr n (vecAdd cs ds) cs L
      (ground.length_zipWith BPair.add cs ds cs.length rfl
        (Nat.succ.inj h).symm)]
    exact (ground.length_zipWith BPair.add (combo n cs L)
      (combo n ds L) (combo n cs L).length rfl
      (length_combo_congr n ds cs L (Nat.succ.inj h).symm)).symm

/
span, the clearings multiplied. -/
private theorem spanE_add (n : Nat) (L : Mat) (u w : List BPair)
    (hLn : rowsLen n L) (hu : u.length = n) (hw : w.length = n)
    (h1 : spanRelE n L u) (h2 : spanRelE n L w) :
    spanRelE n L (vecAdd u w)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c₀, cs, hc₀, hcl, hone⟩ := h1
  obtain ⟨c₁, ds, hc₁, hdl, htwo⟩ := h2
  have hcn : (combo n cs L).length = n := length_combo n cs L hLn
  have hdn : (combo n ds L).length = n := length_combo n ds L hLn
  have f1 : (vecScale c₀ u).length = n :=
    (length_vecScale c₀ u).trans hu
  have f2 : (vecScale c₁ w).length = n :=
    (length_vecScale c₁ w).trans hw
  have e1 : (vecScale c₁ (vecScale c₀ u)).length = n :=
    (length_vecScale c₁ _).trans f1
  have e2 : (vecScale c₁ (combo n cs L)).length = n :=
    (length_vecScale c₁ _).trans hcn
  have e3 : (vecScale c₀ (vecScale c₁ w)).length = n :=
    (length_vecScale c₀ _).trans f2
  have e4 : (vecScale c₀ (combo n ds L)).length = n :=
    (length_vecScale c₀ _).trans hdn
  refine ⟨c₀ * c₁, vecAdd (vecScale c₁ cs) (vecScale c₀ ds),
    fun hh => hc₁ (mul_cancel_unit hc₀ hh), ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact length_vecAdd _ _ L.length
      ((length_vecScale c₁ cs).trans hcl)
      ((length_vecScale c₀ ds).trans hdl)
  · have hA : poly.oneValue (vecScale (c₀ * c₁) (vecAdd u w))
        (vecAdd (vecScale c₁ (combo n cs L))
          (vecScale c₀ (combo n ds L))) := by
      rw [vecScale_vecAdd (c₀ * c₁) u w,
        show vecScale (c₀ * c₁) u = vecScale c₁ (vecScale c₀ u)
          from by rw [vecScale_vecScale c₁ c₀ u,
            BPair.mul_comm c₁ c₀],
        show vecScale (c₀ * c₁) w = vecScale c₀ (vecScale c₁ w)
          from by rw [vecScale_vecScale c₀ c₁ w]]
      exact polyOne_vecAdd _ _ _ _
        (vecScale_oneValue c₁ (vecScale c₀ u) (combo n cs L)
          hone)
        (vecScale_oneValue c₀ (vecScale c₁ w) (combo n ds L)
          htwo)
        (e1.trans e2.symm) (e3.trans e4.symm)
    have hB : poly.oneValue
        (vecAdd (vecScale c₁ (combo n cs L))
          (vecScale c₀ (combo n ds L)))
        (vecAdd (combo n (vecScale c₁ cs) L)
          (combo n (vecScale c₀ ds) L)) :=
      polyOne_vecAdd _ _ _ _
        (vecScale_combo c₁ n cs L)
        (vecScale_combo c₀ n ds L)
        (e2.trans
          (length_combo n (vecScale c₁ cs) L hLn).symm)
        (e4.trans
          (length_combo n (vecScale c₀ ds) L hLn).symm)
    exact poly.oneValue_trans hA (poly.oneValue_trans hB
      (poly.oneValue_symm
        (combo_vecAdd n (vecScale c₁ cs) (vecScale c₀ ds) L
          (((length_vecScale c₁ cs).trans hcl).trans
            ((length_vecScale c₀ ds).trans hdl).symm))))

name: spanE_add
statement:
private theorem spanE_add (n : Nat) (L : Mat) (u w : List BPair)
    (hLn : rowsLen n L) (hu : u.length = n) (hw : w.length = n)
    (h1 : spanRelE n L u) (h2 : spanRelE n L w) :
    spanRelE n L (vecAdd u w)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c₀, cs, hc₀, hcl, hone⟩ := h1
  obtain ⟨c₁, ds, hc₁, hdl, htwo⟩ := h2
  have hcn : (combo n cs L).length = n := length_combo n cs L hLn
  have hdn : (combo n ds L).length = n := length_combo n ds L hLn
  have f1 : (vecScale c₀ u).length = n :=
    (length_vecScale c₀ u).trans hu
  have f2 : (vecScale c₁ w).length = n :=
    (length_vecScale c₁ w).trans hw
  have e1 : (vecScale c₁ (vecScale c₀ u)).length = n :=
    (length_vecScale c₁ _).trans f1
  have e2 : (vecScale c₁ (combo n cs L)).length = n :=
    (length_vecScale c₁ _).trans hcn
  have e3 : (vecScale c₀ (vecScale c₁ w)).length = n :=
    (length_vecScale c₀ _).trans f2
  have e4 : (vecScale c₀ (combo n ds L)).length = n :=
    (length_vecScale c₀ _).trans hdn
  refine ⟨c₀ * c₁, vecAdd (vecScale c₁ cs) (vecScale c₀ ds),
    fun hh => hc₁ (mul_cancel_unit hc₀ hh), ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact length_vecAdd _ _ L.length
      ((length_vecScale c₁ cs).trans hcl)
      ((length_vecScale c₀ ds).trans hdl)
  · have hA : poly.oneValue (vecScale (c₀ * c₁) (vecAdd u w))
        (vecAdd (vecScale c₁ (combo n cs L))
          (vecScale c₀ (combo n ds L))) := by
      rw [vecScale_vecAdd (c₀ * c₁) u w,
        show vecScale (c₀ * c₁) u = vecScale c₁ (vecScale c₀ u)
          from by rw [vecScale_vecScale c₁ c₀ u,
            BPair.mul_comm c₁ c₀],
        show vecScale (c₀ * c₁) w = vecScale c₀ (vecScale c₁ w)
          from by rw [vecScale_vecScale c₀ c₁ w]]
      exact polyOne_vecAdd _ _ _ _
        (vecScale_oneValue c₁ (vecScale c₀ u) (combo n cs L)
          hone)
        (vecScale_oneValue c₀ (vecScale c₁ w) (combo n ds L)
          htwo)
        (e1.trans e2.symm) (e3.trans e4.symm)
    have hB : poly.oneValue
        (vecAdd (vecScale c₁ (combo n cs L))
          (vecScale c₀ (combo n ds L)))
        (vecAdd (combo n (vecScale c₁ cs) L)
          (combo n (vecScale c₀ ds) L)) :=
      polyOne_vecAdd _ _ _ _
        (vecScale_combo c₁ n cs L)
        (vecScale_combo c₀ n ds L)
        (e2.trans
          (length_combo n (vecScale c₁ cs) L hLn).symm)
        (e4.trans
          (length_combo n (vecScale c₀ ds) L hLn).symm)
    exact poly.oneValue_trans hA (poly.oneValue_trans hB
      (poly.oneValue_symm
        (combo_vecAdd n (vecScale c₁ cs) (vecScale c₀ ds) L
          (((length_vecScale c₁ cs).trans hcl).trans
            ((length_vecScale c₀ ds).trans hdl).symm))))

name: spanE_scale
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c₀, cs, hc₀, hcl, hone⟩ := h
  refine ⟨c₀, vecScale c cs, hc₀, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [length_vecScale, hcl]
  · refine poly.oneValue_trans ?_ (vecScale_combo c n cs L)
    rw [show vecScale c₀ (vecScale c v)
        = vecScale c (vecScale c₀ v) from by
      rw [vecScale_vecScale c₀ c v, BPair.mul_comm c₀ c,
        ← vecScale_vecScale c c₀ v]]
    exact vecScale_oneValue c _ _ hone

name: spanE_congr
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c₀, cs, hc₀, hcl, hone⟩ := hs
  exact ⟨c₀, cs, hc₀, hcl,
    poly.oneValue_trans
      (vecScale_oneValue c₀ u' u (poly.oneValue_symm h)) hone⟩

name: spanE_combo
statement:
private theorem spanE_combo (n : Nat) (M : Mat) (hM : rowsLen n M) :
    ∀ (K : Mat) (cs : List BPair), rowsLen n K →
      (∀ k, k < K.length → spanRelE n M (ground.getAt [] K k)) →
      spanRelE n M (combo n cs K)
  | [], [], _, _ =>
    spanE_null n M (List.replicate n BPair.unit)
      (poly.unitTail_replicate n)
  | [], _ :: _, _, _ =>
    spanE_null n M (List.replicate n BPair.unit)
      (poly.unitTail_replicate n)
  | _ :: _, [], _, _ =>
    spanE_null n M (List.replicate n BPair.unit)
      (poly.unitTail_replicate n)
  | r :: K', c :: cs, hK, h => by
    show spanRelE n M (vecAdd (vecScale c r) (combo n cs K'))
    exact spanE_add n M _ _ hM
      ((length_vecScale c r).trans hK.1)
      (length_combo n cs K' hK.2)
      (spanE_scale n M r c
        (show spanRelE n M r from h 0 (Nat.succ_pos _)))
      (spanE_combo n M hM K' cs hK.2
        (fun k hk => h (k + 1) (Nat.succ_lt_succ hk)))

/
clearings multiplied. -/
private theorem spanE_unscale (n : Nat) (M : Mat) (c : BPair)
    (v : List BPair) (hc : ¬ c.oneValue BPair.unit)
    (h : spanRelE n M (vecScale c v)) : spanRelE n M v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c₀, ds, hc₀, hdl, hone⟩ := h
  refine ⟨c₀ * c, ds, ?_, hdl, ?_⟩
  · intro hh
    exact hc₀ (mul_cancel_unit hc
      (show (c * c₀).oneValue BPair.unit from by
        rw [BPair.mul_comm c c₀]; exact hh))
  · rw [← vecScale_vecScale c₀ c v]
    exact hone

name: spanE_unscale
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c₀, ds, hc₀, hdl, hone⟩ := h
  refine ⟨c₀ * c, ds, ?_, hdl, ?_⟩
  · intro hh
    exact hc₀ (mul_cancel_unit hc
      (show (c * c₀).oneValue BPair.unit from by
        rw [BPair.mul_comm c c₀]; exact hh))
  · rw [← vecScale_vecScale c₀ c v]
    exact hone

name: spanE_trans
statement:
private theorem spanE_trans (n : Nat) (G M : Mat)
    (x : List BPair) (hG : rowsLen n G) (hM : rowsLen n M)
    (hrows : ∀ k, k < G.length →
      spanRelE n M (ground.getAt [] G k))
    (h : spanRelE n G x) : spanRelE n M x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c0, cs, hc0, _, hone⟩ := h
  refine spanE_unscale n M c0 x hc0 ?_
  exact spanE_congr n M _ _ (poly.oneValue_symm hone)
    (spanE_combo n M hM G cs hG hrows)

name: dotN_read
statement:
theorem dotN_read : ∀ r c : List BPair,
    (dotN r c).oneValue (dotP r c)
  | [], _ => BPair.oneValue_refl _
  | _ :: _, [] => BPair.oneValue_refl _
  | a :: s, b :: t => by
    show (if a.isUnitRep || b.isUnitRep then dotN s t
        else (a * b + dotN s t).norm).oneValue (a * b + dotP s t)
    cases hab : a.isUnitRep || b.isUnitRep with
    | true =>
      rw [if_pos rfl]
      have habU : (a * b).oneValue BPair.unit
proof:
:= by
        match ground.orSplitB hab with
        | Or.inl ha =>
          rw [BPair.unit_of_isUnitRep ha]
          exact BPair.unit_mul b
        | Or.inr hb =>
          rw [BPair.unit_of_isUnitRep hb]
          exact BPair.mul_unit a
      exact BPair.oneValue_trans (dotN_read s t)
        (BPair.oneValue_symm (BPair.oneValue_trans
          (BPair.add_congr habU (BPair.oneValue_refl (dotP s t)))
          (BPair.unit_add (dotP s t))))
    | false =>
      rw [if_neg (fun hc : (false : Bool) = true =>
        Bool.noConfusion hc)]
      exact BPair.oneValue_trans (BPair.norm_oneValue _)
        (BPair.add_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl (a * b))
          (dotN_read s t))

name: dotP_addRow
proof:
:= by
  rw [dotP_comm (vecAdd ra rb) u, dotP_comm ra u, dotP_comm rb u]
  exact dotP_vecAdd u ra rb ha hb

name: matAdd_dotPmap
statement:
theorem matAdd_dotPmap : ∀ (A B : Mat) (u : List BPair),
    rowsLen u.length A → rowsLen u.length B →
    poly.oneValue ((matAdd A B).map (fun r => dotP r u))
      (vecAdd (A.map (fun r => dotP r u)) (B.map (fun r => dotP r u)))
  | [], _, _, _, _ => trivial
  | _ :: _, [], _, _, _ => trivial
  | ra :: ta, rb :: tb, u, hA, hB =>
    ⟨dotP_addRow ra rb u hA.1 hB.1, matAdd_dotPmap ta tb u hA.2 hB.2⟩

/

name: dotN_addRow_free
statement:
theorem dotN_addRow_free (ra rb u : List BPair)
    (h : ra.length = rb.length) :
    (dotN (vecAdd ra rb) u).oneValue (dotN ra u + dotN rb u)
proof:
:= by
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans (dotN_read (vecAdd ra rb) u) ?_
  rw [dotP_comm (vecAdd ra rb) u]
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans (dotP_vecAdd_right u ra rb h) ?_
  rw [dotP_comm u ra, dotP_comm u rb]
  exact BPair.add_congr (BPair.oneValue_symm (dotN_read ra u))
    (BPair.oneValue_symm (dotN_read rb u))

name: dotN_addRow
statement:
theorem dotN_addRow (ra rb u : List BPair)
    (ha : ra.length = u.length) (hb : rb.length = u.length) :
    (dotN (vecAdd ra rb) u).oneValue (dotN ra u + dotN rb u)
proof:
:=
  dotN_addRow_free ra rb u (ha.trans hb.symm)

name: matVec_add_free
statement:
theorem matVec_add_free (w : Nat) : ∀ (A B : Mat) (u : List BPair),
    rowsLen w A → rowsLen w B →
    poly.oneValue (matVec (matAdd A B) u)
      (vecAdd (matVec A u) (matVec B u))
  | [], _, _, _, _ => trivial
  | _ :: _, [], _, _, _ => trivial
  | ra :: ta, rb :: tb, u, hA, hB =>
    ⟨dotN_addRow_free ra rb u (hA.1.trans hB.1.symm),
     matVec_add_free w ta tb u hA.2 hB.2⟩

/
shape wrapper. -/

name: matVec_add
statement:
theorem matVec_add (A B : Mat) (u : List BPair)
    (hA : rowsLen u.length A) (hB : rowsLen u.length B) :
    poly.oneValue (matVec (matAdd A B) u)
      (vecAdd (matVec A u) (matVec B u))
proof:
:=
  matVec_add_free u.length A B u hA hB

name: dotN_scaleRow_free
statement:
theorem dotN_scaleRow_free (c : BPair) (a x : List BPair) :
    (dotN (vecScale c a) x).oneValue (c * dotN a x)
proof:
:= by
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans (dotN_read (vecScale c a) x) ?_
  rw [dotP_comm (vecScale c a) x]
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans (dotP_vecScale_right x a c) ?_
  rw [dotP_comm x a]
  exact BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl c)
    (BPair.oneValue_symm (dotN_read a x))

name: dotN_scaleV
statement:
theorem dotN_scaleV (c : BPair) (r u : List BPair) :
    (dotN r (vecScale c u)).oneValue (c * dotN r u)
proof:
:=
  BPair.oneValue_trans (dotN_read r (vecScale c u))
    (BPair.oneValue_trans (dotP_vecScale_right r u c)
      (BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl c)
        (BPair.oneValue_symm (dotN_read r u))))

name: dotN_vecScale_self
statement:
theorem dotN_vecScale_self (k : BPair) (v : List BPair) :
    (dotN (vecScale k v) (vecScale k v)).oneValue (k * k * dotN v v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [BPair.mul_assoc k k (dotN v v)]
  exact BPair.oneValue_trans (dotN_scaleRow_free k v (vecScale k v))
    (BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl k) (dotN_scaleV k v v))

name: length_transposeGoO
statement:
private theorem length_transposeGoO {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (m : List (List γ)),
      (transposeGoO ops n m).length = n
  | 0, _ => rfl
  | n + 1, m =>
    congrArg Nat.succ (length_transposeGoO ops n (dropCol m))

matrix, at every entry bundle. -/

name: length_transposeO
statement:
theorem length_transposeO {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ)
    {n : Nat} : ∀ m : List (List γ), rowsLen n m →
      0 < m.length → (transposeO ops m).length = n
  | [], _, h => absurd h (Nat.lt_irrefl 0)
  | r :: t, hrows, _ => by
    show (transposeGoO ops r.length (r :: t)).length = n
    rw [length_transposeGoO ops r.length (r :: t), hrows.1]

private theorem getAt_transposeGoO {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ)
    (u : γ) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (m : List (List γ)) (p q : Nat), p < n →
      q < m.length →
      (∀ i, i < m.length → n ≤ (ground.getAt [] m i).length) →
      ground.getAt u
          (ground.getAt [] (transposeGoO ops n m) p) q
        = ground.getAt u (ground.getAt [] m q) p
  | n + 1, m, 0, q, _, hq, hlen => by
    show ground.getAt u (colHead ops.unit m) q = _
    rw [show colHead ops.unit m
        = m.map (fun r => ground.getAt ops.unit r 0) from rfl,
      ground.getAt_map [] u _ m q hq]
    match hrow : ground.getAt [] m q with
    | [] =>
      have
proof:
:= hlen q hq
      rw [hrow] at this
      exact absurd this (Nat.not_succ_le_zero n)
    | a :: t => rfl
  | n + 1, m, p + 1, q, hp, hq, hlen => by
    show ground.getAt u
        (ground.getAt [] (transposeGoO ops n (dropCol m)) p) q = _
    have hqt : q < (dropCol m).length := by
      rw [length_dropCol m]
      exact hq
    have hlent : ∀ i, i < (dropCol m).length →
        n ≤ (ground.getAt [] (dropCol m) i).length := by
      intro i hi
      rw [length_dropCol m] at hi
      rw [getAt_dropCol m i hi]
      match hrow : ground.getAt [] m i with
      | [] =>
        have := hlen i hi
        rw [hrow] at this
        exact absurd this (Nat.not_succ_le_zero n)
      | a :: t =>
        have := hlen i hi
        rw [hrow] at this
        exact Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ this
    rw [getAt_transposeGoO ops u n (dropCol m) p q
        (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hp) hqt hlent,
      getAt_dropCol m q hq]
    match hrow : ground.getAt [] m q with
    | [] =>
      have := hlen q hq
      rw [hrow] at this
      exact absurd this (Nat.not_succ_le_zero n)
    | a :: t => rfl

    | [] =>

proof:

    rw [getAt_transposeGoO ops u n (dropCol m) p q

name: getAt_transposeO
statement:
theorem getAt_transposeO {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ)
    (u : γ) {n : Nat} :
    ∀ (m : List (List γ)), rowsLen n m → ∀ p q, p < n →
      q < m.length →
      ground.getAt u (ground.getAt [] (transposeO ops m) p) q
        = ground.getAt u (ground.getAt [] m q) p
  | [], _, _, q, _, hq => absurd hq (Nat.not_lt_zero q)
  | r :: t, hrows, p, q, hp, hq => by
    show ground.getAt u
        (ground.getAt [] (transposeGoO ops r.length (r :: t)) p) q
      = _
    rw [hrows.1]
    exact getAt_transposeGoO ops u n (r :: t) p q hp hq
      (fun i hi => by
        rw [rowsLen_getAt (r :: t) i hrows hi]
        exact Nat.le_refl n)

/
private theorem rowsLen_transposeGoO {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ) :
    ∀ (k : Nat) (m : List (List γ)),
    rowsLen m.length (transposeGoO ops k m)
  | 0, _ => trivial
  | k + 1, m => by
    show (colHead ops.unit m).length = m.length
      ∧ rowsLen m.length (transposeGoO ops k (dropCol m))
    refine ⟨length_colHead ops.unit m, ?_⟩
    have hgo
proof:
:= rowsLen_transposeGoO ops k (dropCol m)
    rw [length_dropCol m] at hgo
    exact hgo

name: rowsLen_transposeO

  | r :: t => by

    exact rowsLen_transposeGoO ops r.length (r :: t)

theorem length_transposeM {n : Nat} (m : Mat) (hrows : rowsLen n m)

name: getAt_transposeM
statement:
theorem getAt_transposeM (u : BPair) {n : Nat} (m : Mat)
    (hrows : rowsLen n m) (p q : Nat) (hp : p < n)
    (hq : q < m.length) :
    ground.getAt u (ground.getAt [] (transposeM m) p) q
      = ground.getAt u (ground.getAt [] m q) p
proof:
:=

name: symmRead_entry
statement:
theorem symmRead_entry {o : Nat} (S : Mat) (hS : sqAt S o)
    (hsym : symmRead S) (i j : Nat) (hi : i < o) (hj : j < o) :
    (ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt ([] : List BPair) S i) j).oneValue
      (ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt ([] : List BPair) S j) i)
proof:
:= by
  have e := poly.oneValue_getAt j
    (matOne_entries S (transposeM S) hsym i (by rw [sqAt_len hS]; exact hi))
  rw [getAt_transposeM BPair.unit S (rowsLen_of_sqAt hS) i j hi
    (by rw [sqAt_len hS]; exact hj)] at e
  exact e

name: detO_transpose
proof:
:= by
  cases m with
  | nil => exact C.ovRefl _
  | cons r t =>
    have htl : (transposeO ops (r :: t)).length = (r :: t).length :=
      length_transposeO ops (r :: t) hsq (Nat.succ_pos _)
    have hterm : ∀ p : List Nat,
        0 < ground.countOf p (places.monomialsAt
          (List.replicate (r :: t).length 1)) →
        R.rel (termO ops (transposeO ops (r :: t)) p)
          (termO ops (r :: t)
            (places.invPerm (r :: t).length p)) := by
      intro p hp
      obtain ⟨hplen, hpdist, hpval, hpocc⟩ :=
        places.perm_member_reads hp
      rw [termO_fold ops (transposeO ops (r :: t)) p
          (by rw [htl, hplen]),
        termO_fold ops (r :: t) (places.invPerm (r :: t).length p)
          (by rw [places.length_invPerm]),
        htl]
      refine ground.famFold_bij_ov (commLawsMulOf C) ops.one _
        (fun s => ground.getAt ops.unit
          (ground.getAt [] (r :: t) s)
          (ground.getAt 0 (places.invPerm (r :: t).length p) s))
        (ground.distinctList_range (r :: t).length)
        (g := ground.getAt 0 p) (h := fun x => places.posOf x p)
        (fun x hx => places.posOf_getAt hpdist x
          (by rw [hplen]; exact ground.ltOfMem hx))
        (fun x hx => places.getAt_posOf x p
          (hpocc x (ground.ltOfMem hx)))
        (fun x hx => ground.countOf_range_pos (hpval _
          (ground.countOf_getAt_pos 0 p x
            (by rw [hplen]; exact ground.ltOfMem hx))))
        (fun x hx => ground.countOf_range_pos (by
          have hlt := places.posOf_lt x p
            (hpocc x (ground.ltOfMem hx))
          rw [hplen] at hlt
          exact hlt))
        (fun s hs => ?_)
      have hsn : s < (r :: t).length := ground.ltOfMem hs
      have hps : ground.getAt 0 p s < (r :: t).length :=
        hpval _ (ground.countOf_getAt_pos 0 p s
          (by rw [hplen]; exact hsn))
      rw [show ground.getAt 0
            (places.invPerm (r :: t).length p)
            (ground.getAt 0 p s) = s from by
          rw [places.getAt_invPerm (r :: t).length p hps,
            places.posOf_getAt hpdist s
              (by rw [hplen]; exact hsn)],
        getAt_transposeO ops ops.unit (r :: t) hsq s
          (ground.getAt 0 p s) hsn hps]
      exact C.ovRefl _
    show R.rel (ground.famFold ops.add ops.unit
        (fun p => sgnO ops p
          (termO ops (transposeO ops (r :: t)) p))
        (places.monomialsAt (List.replicate
          (transposeO ops (r :: t)).length 1)))
      (ground.famFold ops.add ops.unit
        (fun p => sgnO ops p (termO ops (r :: t) p))
        (places.monomialsAt (List.replicate (r :: t).length 1)))
    rw [htl]
    refine ground.famFold_bij_ov (commLawsOf C) ops.unit _
      (fun p => sgnO ops p (termO ops (r :: t) p))
      (places.monomialsAt_distinct
        (List.replicate (r :: t).length 1))
      (g := places.invPerm (r :: t).length)
      (h := places.invPerm (r :: t).length)
      (fun p hp => places.invPerm_invPerm (r :: t).length hp)
      (fun p hp => places.invPerm_invPerm (r :: t).length hp)
      (fun p hp => places.invPerm_member (r :: t).length hp)
      (fun p hp => places.invPerm_member (r :: t).length hp)
      (fun p hp => ?_)
    refine C.ovTrans (sgnO_congr C p (hterm p hp)) ?_
    show R.rel (if places.parity p
        then ops.swap (termO ops (r :: t)
          (places.invPerm (r :: t).length p))
        else termO ops (r :: t)
          (places.invPerm (r :: t).length p))
      (sgnO ops (places.invPerm (r :: t).length p)
        (termO ops (r :: t) (places.invPerm (r :: t).length p)))
    rw [← places.parity_invPerm (r :: t).length hp]
    exact C.ovRefl _

name: lovRefl
statement:
private theorem lovRefl {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (C : DCore γ ops R.rel) :
    ∀ p : List γ, poly.listOV ops R p p
  | [] => trivial
  | c :: p => ⟨C.ovRefl c, lovRefl C p⟩

private theorem lovSymm {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (C : DCore γ ops R.rel) :
    ∀ {p q : List γ}, poly.listOV ops R p q → poly.listOV ops R q p
  | [], [], h => h
  | [], _ :: _, h => h
  | _ :: _, [], h => h
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, h => ⟨C.ovSymm h.1, lovSymm C h.2⟩

private theorem utOv {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (C : DCore γ ops R.rel) :
    ∀ {p q : List γ}, poly.unitTailO ops R p → poly.unitTailO ops R q →
      poly.listOV ops R p q
  | [], _, _, hq => hq
  | _ :: _, [], hp, _ => hp
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, hp, hq =>
    ⟨C.ovTrans hp.1 (C.ovSymm hq.1), utOv C hp.2 hq.2⟩

private theorem ovUt {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (C : DCore γ ops R.rel) :
    ∀ {p q : List γ}, poly.listOV ops R p q → poly.unitTailO ops R q →
      poly.unitTailO ops R p
  | [], _, _, _ => trivial
  | _ :: _, [], h, _ => h
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, h, hq =>
    ⟨C.ovTrans h.1 hq.1, ovUt C h.2 hq.2⟩

private theorem utOvR {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (C : DCore γ ops R.rel) :
    ∀ {q r : List γ}, poly.unitTailO ops R q → poly.listOV ops R q r →
      poly.unitTailO ops R r
  | [], _, _, h => h
  | _ :: _, [], _, _ => trivial
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, hq, h =>
    ⟨C.ovTrans (C.ovSymm h.1) hq.1, utOvR C hq.2 h.2⟩

private theorem lovTrans {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (C : DCore γ ops R.rel) :
    ∀ {p q r : List γ}, poly.listOV ops R p q → poly.listOV ops R q r →
      poly.listOV ops R p r
  | [], _, _, h1, h2 => utOvR C h1 h2
  | _ :: _, [], _, h1, h2 => utOv C h1 h2
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, [], h1, h2 => ovUt C h1 h2
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, _ :: _, h1, h2 =>
    ⟨C.ovTrans h1.1 h2.1, lovTrans C h1.2 h2.2⟩

/-! The key reads at the lifted carrier: the entries at their
keys, the sum and the scale reading through them. -/

private theorem utGetAt {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (C : DCore γ ops R.rel) :
    ∀ {p : List γ}, poly.unitTailO ops R p → ∀ k : Nat,
      R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit p k) ops.unit
  | [], _, _ => C.ovRefl ops.unit
  | _ :: _, h, 0 => h.1
  | _ :: p, h, k + 1 => utGetAt C (p := p) h.2 k

private theorem utOfGetAt {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} :
    ∀ {p : List γ},
      (∀ k : Nat, R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit p k) ops.unit) →
      poly.unitTailO ops R p
  | [], _ => trivial
  | _ :: _, h => ⟨h 0, utOfGetAt (fun k => h (k + 1))⟩

private theorem lovGetAt {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (C : DCore γ ops R.rel) :
    ∀ {p q : List γ}, poly.listOV ops R p q → ∀ k : Nat,
      R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit p k) (ground.getAt ops.unit q k)
  | [], _, h, k => C.ovSymm (utGetAt C h k)
  | c :: p, [], h, k => utGetAt C (p := c :: p) ⟨h.1, h.2⟩ k
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, h, 0 => h.1
  | _ :: p, _ :: q, h, k + 1 => lovGetAt C (p := p) (q := q) h.2 k

private theorem lovOfGetAt {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (C : DCore γ ops R.rel) :
    ∀ {p q : List γ},
      (∀ k : Nat,
        R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit p k) (ground.getAt ops.unit q k)) →
      poly.listOV ops R p q
  | [], _, h => utOfGetAt (fun k => C.ovSymm (h k))
  | _ :: _, [], h => utOfGetAt h
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, h => ⟨h 0, lovOfGetAt C (fun k => h (k + 1))⟩

private theorem getAtAddO {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel) :
    ∀ (p q : List γ) (k : Nat),
      R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit (poly.addLO ops p q) k)
        (ops.add (ground.getAt ops.unit p k)
          (ground.getAt ops.unit q k))
proof:
:=
  poly.getAt_addLO ops R L.toDCore.ovRefl L.toDCore.ovSymm L.unitAdd L.addUnit

name: lovSymm
statement:
private theorem lovSymm {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (C : DCore γ ops R.rel) :
    ∀ {p q : List γ}, poly.listOV ops R p q → poly.listOV ops R q p
  | [], [], h => h
  | [], _ :: _, h => h
  | _ :: _, [], h => h
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, h => ⟨C.ovSymm h.1, lovSymm C h.2⟩

private theorem utOv {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (C : DCore γ ops R.rel) :
    ∀ {p q : List γ}, poly.unitTailO ops R p → poly.unitTailO ops R q →
      poly.listOV ops R p q
  | [], _, _, hq => hq
  | _ :: _, [], hp, _ => hp
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, hp, hq =>
    ⟨C.ovTrans hp.1 (C.ovSymm hq.1), utOv C hp.2 hq.2⟩

private theorem ovUt {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (C : DCore γ ops R.rel) :
    ∀ {p q : List γ}, poly.listOV ops R p q → poly.unitTailO ops R q →
      poly.unitTailO ops R p
  | [], _, _, _ => trivial
  | _ :: _, [], h, _ => h
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, h, hq =>
    ⟨C.ovTrans h.1 hq.1, ovUt C h.2 hq.2⟩

private theorem utOvR {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (C : DCore γ ops R.rel) :
    ∀ {q r : List γ}, poly.unitTailO ops R q → poly.listOV ops R q r →
      poly.unitTailO ops R r
  | [], _, _, h => h
  | _ :: _, [], _, _ => trivial
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, hq, h =>
    ⟨C.ovTrans (C.ovSymm h.1) hq.1, utOvR C hq.2 h.2⟩

private theorem lovTrans {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (C : DCore γ ops R.rel) :
    ∀ {p q r : List γ}, poly.listOV ops R p q → poly.listOV ops R q r →
      poly.listOV ops R p r
  | [], _, _, h1, h2 => utOvR C h1 h2
  | _ :: _, [], _, h1, h2 => utOv C h1 h2
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, [], h1, h2 => ovUt C h1 h2
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, _ :: _, h1, h2 =>
    ⟨C.ovTrans h1.1 h2.1, lovTrans C h1.2 h2.2⟩

/-! The key reads at the lifted carrier: the entries at their
keys, the sum and the scale reading through them. -/

  | [], _ => lovRefl L.toDCore _

    lovTrans L.toDCore

  | c :: p, [], r => by
    show poly.listOV ops R (poly.mulLO ops (c :: p) r)
      (poly.addLO ops (poly.mulLO ops (c :: p) r) [])
    rw [poly.addNilO ops (poly.mulLO ops (c :: p) r)]
    exact lovRefl L.toDCore _
  | c :: p, d :: q, r =>
    lovTrans L.toDCore
      (addCongrO L (scaleAddO L c d r)
        (lovTrans L.toDCore
          (consOvO (L.toDCore.ovRefl ops.unit) (sumMulO L p q r))
          (consAddO L (poly.mulLO ops p r) (poly.mulLO ops q r))))

          exact ovMapO _ _ r (fun x => L.toDCore.mulAssoc c a x))

    addCongr := addCongrO L
    mulCongr := fun h1 h2 =>

name: addLenLeO
statement:
private theorem addLenLeO {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ) :
    ∀ (p q : List γ) (n : Nat), p.length ≤ n → q.length ≤ n →
      (poly.addLO ops p q).length ≤ n
  | [], q, _, _, hq => hq
  | _ :: _, [], _, hp, _ => hp
  | _ :: p, _ :: q, n, hp, hq => by
    match n, hp, hq with
    | n + 1, hp, hq =>
      show (poly.addLO ops p q).length + 1 ≤ n + 1
      exact Nat.succ_le_succ (addLenLeO ops p q n
        (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hp) (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hq))

private theorem mulLenO {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ) :
    ∀ (p q : List γ), 1 ≤ q.length → ∀ n : Nat,
      p.length + q.length ≤ n + 1 → (poly.mulLO ops p q).length ≤ n
  | [], _, _, _, _ => Nat.zero_le _
  | c :: p, q, hq, n, h => by
    show (poly.addLO ops (q.map (ops.mul c))
      (ops.unit :: poly.mulLO ops p q)).length ≤ n
    have h1 : q.length + 1 ≤ p.length + 1 + q.length
proof:
:= by
      rw [Nat.add_comm (p.length + 1) q.length]
      exact Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le _))
        q.length
    have hqn : q.length ≤ n :=
      Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ (Nat.le_trans h1 h)
    refine addLenLeO ops _ _ n
      (by rw [ground.length_map]; exact hqn) ?_
    show (poly.mulLO ops p q).length + 1 ≤ n
    cases n with
    | zero =>
      exact absurd (Nat.le_trans hq hqn) (Nat.not_succ_le_zero 0)
    | succ n' =>
      refine Nat.succ_le_succ (mulLenO ops p q hq n' ?_)
      have h' : p.length + 1 + q.length ≤ n' + 1 + 1 := h
      rw [Nat.add_right_comm p.length 1 q.length] at h'
      exact Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ h'

private theorem lenShiftO {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (p : List γ),
      (shiftUpO ops n p).length = n + p.length
  | 0, _ => (Nat.zero_add _).symm
  | n + 1, p => by
    show (shiftUpO ops n p).length + 1 = n + 1 + p.length
    rw [lenShiftO ops n p, Nat.add_right_comm]

private theorem shiftAppendO {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (p q : List γ),
      shiftUpO ops n (p ++ q) = shiftUpO ops n p ++ q
  | 0, _, _ => rfl
  | n + 1, p, q => by
    show ops.unit :: shiftUpO ops n (p ++ q)
      = ops.unit :: (shiftUpO ops n p ++ q)
    rw [shiftAppendO ops n p q]

private theorem getAtShiftLtO {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (p : List γ) (k : Nat), k < n →
      ground.getAt ops.unit (shiftUpO ops n p) k = ops.unit
  | 0, _, _, h => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | _ + 1, _, 0, _ => rfl
  | n + 1, p, k + 1, h =>
    getAtShiftLtO ops n p k (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ h)

private theorem getAtShiftAddO {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (p : List γ) (k : Nat),
      ground.getAt ops.unit (shiftUpO ops n p) (n + k)
        = ground.getAt ops.unit p k
  | 0, _, k => by rw [Nat.zero_add k]; rfl
  | n + 1, p, k => by
    rw [Nat.add_right_comm n 1 k]
    show ground.getAt ops.unit (shiftUpO ops n p) (n + k)
      = ground.getAt ops.unit p k
    exact getAtShiftAddO ops n p k

      poly.unitTailO ops R (shiftUpO ops n p)
  | 0, _, h => h
  | n + 1, _, h => ⟨C.ovRefl _, utShiftO C n h⟩

private theorem shiftOvO {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (C : DCore γ ops R.rel) :

      poly.listOV ops R (shiftUpO ops n x) (shiftUpO ops n y)

  | n + 1, _, _, h => ⟨C.ovRefl _, shiftOvO C n h⟩

  | 0, _, _ => lovRefl L.toDCore _

name: mulTopO
statement:
private theorem mulTopO {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (C : DCore γ ops R.rel) :
    ∀ (p q : List γ) (n : Nat),
      p.length + q.length ≤ n + 1 → ∀ k : Nat, n ≤ k →
      R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit (poly.mulLO ops p q) k) ops.unit
  | p, [], _, _, k, _ => utGetAt C (mulNilO C p) k
  | p, b :: q, n, h, k, hk => by
    rw [ground.getAt_over ops.unit (poly.mulLO ops p (b :: q)) k
      (Nat.le_trans (mulLenO ops p (b :: q)
        (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le _)) n h) hk)]
    exact C.ovRefl _

private theorem shiftTopO {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {Rd : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops Rd.rel)
        (N : Nat) (X Z R : List γ)
    (hX : ∀ k : Nat, N ≤ k →
      Rd.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit X k) ops.unit)
    (hR : ∀ k : Nat, N ≤ k →
      Rd.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit R k) ops.unit)
    (h : poly.listOV ops Rd (poly.addLO ops X (shiftUpO ops N Z)) R) :
    poly.unitTailO ops Rd Z ∧ poly.listOV ops Rd X R
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · refine utOfGetAt (fun j => ?_)
    have e1 := getAtAddO L X (shiftUpO ops N Z) (N + j)
    rw [getAtShiftAddO ops N Z j] at e1
    have e3 : Rd.rel (ops.add (ground.getAt ops.unit X (N + j))
        (ground.getAt ops.unit Z j)) ops.unit :=
      L.toDCore.ovTrans (L.toDCore.ovSymm e1)
        (L.toDCore.ovTrans (lovGetAt L.toDCore h (N + j))
          (hR (N + j) (Nat.le_add_right N j)))
    exact L.addCancel
      (L.toDCore.ovTrans e3
        (L.toDCore.ovSymm (L.addUnit ops.unit)))
      (hX (N + j) (Nat.le_add_right N j))
  · refine lovOfGetAt L.toDCore (fun k => ?_)
    cases Nat.lt_or_ge k N with
    | inl hlt =>
      have e1 := getAtAddO L X (shiftUpO ops N Z) k
      rw [getAtShiftLtO ops N Z k hlt] at e1
      exact L.toDCore.ovTrans
        (L.toDCore.ovSymm (L.addUnit (ground.getAt ops.unit X k)))
        (L.toDCore.ovTrans (L.toDCore.ovSymm e1)
          (lovGetAt L.toDCore h k))
    | inr hge =>
      exact L.toDCore.ovTrans (hX k hge)
        (L.toDCore.ovSymm (hR k hge))

statement:

name: nilOfLenO
statement:
private theorem nilOfLenO {γ : Type} :
    ∀ p : List γ, p.length ≤ 0 → p = []
proof:
:=
  fun _ h => List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp (Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero h)

name: snocCasesO
statement:
private theorem snocCasesO {γ : Type} :
    ∀ p : List γ, p = [] ∨
      ∃ (q : List γ) (a : γ), p = q ++ [a] ∧ q.length + 1 = p.length
  | [] => Or.inl rfl
  | a :: t => by
    cases snocCasesO t with
    | inl h => exact Or.inr ⟨[], a, by rw [h]; rfl, by rw [h]; rfl⟩
    | inr h =>
      obtain ⟨q, b, hq, hl⟩
proof:
:= h
      exact Or.inr ⟨a :: q, b, by rw [hq]; rfl, by
        show q.length + 1 + 1 = t.length + 1
        rw [hl]⟩

name: monicLenO
statement:
private theorem monicLenO {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ) :
    ∀ s : List γ, (monicLO ops s).length = s.length + 1
  | [] => rfl
  | _ :: s => by
    show (monicLO ops s).length + 1 = s.length + 1 + 1
    rw [monicLenO ops s]

private theorem monicCancelO {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {Rd : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops Rd.rel) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (s Q R : List γ), Q.length ≤ n →
      R.length ≤ s.length →
      poly.listOV ops Rd (poly.mulLO ops (monicLO ops s) Q) R →
      poly.unitTailO ops Rd Q
  | 0, _, Q, _, hn, _, _ => by rw [nilOfLenO Q hn]; exact trivial
  | n + 1, s, Q, R, hn, hR, h => by
    obtain hnil | ⟨Q', a, hQa, hQl⟩
proof:
:= snocCasesO Q
    · rw [hnil]; exact trivial
    · subst hQa
      have hfuel : Q'.length ≤ n := by
        have hn' : (Q' ++ [a]).length ≤ n + 1 := hn
        rw [← hQl] at hn'
        exact Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hn'
      have hYlen : (shiftUpO ops Q'.length
          (s.map (fun d => ops.mul a d))).length
          = Q'.length + s.length := by
        rw [lenShiftO, ground.length_map]
      have h1 : poly.listOV ops Rd (poly.mulLO ops (monicLO ops s) (Q' ++ [a]))
          (poly.addLO ops (poly.addLO ops (poly.mulLO ops (monicLO ops s) Q')
            (shiftUpO ops Q'.length (s.map (fun d => ops.mul a d))))
            (shiftUpO ops (Q'.length + s.length)
              [ops.mul a ops.one])) := by
        refine lovTrans L.toDCore
          (mulSnocO L (monicLO ops s) Q' a) ?_
        show poly.listOV ops Rd (poly.addLO ops (poly.mulLO ops (monicLO ops s) Q')
          (shiftUpO ops Q'.length ((s ++ [ops.one]).map
            (fun d => ops.mul a d)))) _
        have hm : (([ops.one] : List γ)).map (fun d => ops.mul a d)
            = [ops.mul a ops.one] := rfl
        rw [ground.map_append (fun d => ops.mul a d) s [ops.one], hm,
          shiftAppendO ops Q'.length (s.map (fun d => ops.mul a d))
            [ops.mul a ops.one]]
        refine lovTrans L.toDCore (addCongrO L (lovRefl L.toDCore _)
          (appendAddO L (shiftUpO ops Q'.length
              (s.map (fun d => ops.mul a d)))
            [ops.mul a ops.one])) ?_
        rw [hYlen]
        exact lovSymm L.toDCore (addAssocO L _ _ _)
      obtain ⟨hz, hXR⟩ := shiftTopO L
        (Q'.length + s.length)
        (poly.addLO ops (poly.mulLO ops (monicLO ops s) Q')
          (shiftUpO ops Q'.length (s.map (fun d => ops.mul a d))))
        [ops.mul a ops.one] R
        (fun k hk => L.toDCore.ovTrans (getAtAddO L _ _ k)
          (L.toDCore.ovTrans
            (L.toDCore.addCongr
              (mulTopO L.toDCore (monicLO ops s) Q'
                (Q'.length + s.length)
                (by
                  rw [monicLenO ops s, Nat.add_right_comm s.length 1
                    Q'.length, Nat.add_comm s.length Q'.length]
                  exact Nat.le_refl _) k hk)
              (ovOfEq L.toDCore
                (ground.getAt_over ops.unit _ k
                  (by rw [hYlen]; exact hk))))
            (L.addUnit ops.unit)))
        (fun k hk => ovOfEq L.toDCore
          (ground.getAt_over ops.unit R k
            (Nat.le_trans hR (Nat.le_trans
              (Nat.le_add_left s.length Q'.length) hk))))
        (lovTrans L.toDCore (lovSymm L.toDCore h1) h)
      have t1 : Rd.rel (ops.mul a ops.one) a :=
        L.toDCore.ovTrans (L.toDCore.mulComm a ops.one) (L.oneMul a)
      have ha : Rd.rel a ops.unit :=
        L.toDCore.ovTrans (L.toDCore.ovSymm t1) hz.1
      exact utJoinO
        (monicCancelO L n s Q' R hfuel hR
          (lovTrans L.toDCore (lovSymm L.toDCore
            (addUtLovO' L (poly.mulLO ops (monicLO ops s) Q')
              (utShiftO L.toDCore Q'.length (utScaleO L ha s)))) hXR))
        ⟨ha, trivial⟩

name: monicCancelO
statement:
private theorem monicCancelO {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {Rd : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops Rd.rel) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (s Q R : List γ), Q.length ≤ n →
      R.length ≤ s.length →
      poly.listOV ops Rd (poly.mulLO ops (monicLO ops s) Q) R →
      poly.unitTailO ops Rd Q
  | 0, _, Q, _, hn, _, _ => by rw [nilOfLenO Q hn]; exact trivial
  | n + 1, s, Q, R, hn, hR, h => by
    obtain hnil | ⟨Q', a, hQa, hQl⟩
proof:
:= snocCasesO Q
    · rw [hnil]; exact trivial
    · subst hQa
      have hfuel : Q'.length ≤ n := by
        have hn' : (Q' ++ [a]).length ≤ n + 1 := hn
        rw [← hQl] at hn'
        exact Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hn'
      have hYlen : (shiftUpO ops Q'.length
          (s.map (fun d => ops.mul a d))).length
          = Q'.length + s.length := by
        rw [lenShiftO, ground.length_map]
      have h1 : poly.listOV ops Rd (poly.mulLO ops (monicLO ops s) (Q' ++ [a]))
          (poly.addLO ops (poly.addLO ops (poly.mulLO ops (monicLO ops s) Q')
            (shiftUpO ops Q'.length (s.map (fun d => ops.mul a d))))
            (shiftUpO ops (Q'.length + s.length)
              [ops.mul a ops.one])) := by
        refine lovTrans L.toDCore
          (mulSnocO L (monicLO ops s) Q' a) ?_
        show poly.listOV ops Rd (poly.addLO ops (poly.mulLO ops (monicLO ops s) Q')
          (shiftUpO ops Q'.length ((s ++ [ops.one]).map
            (fun d => ops.mul a d)))) _
        have hm : (([ops.one] : List γ)).map (fun d => ops.mul a d)
            = [ops.mul a ops.one] := rfl
        rw [ground.map_append (fun d => ops.mul a d) s [ops.one], hm,
          shiftAppendO ops Q'.length (s.map (fun d => ops.mul a d))
            [ops.mul a ops.one]]
        refine lovTrans L.toDCore (addCongrO L (lovRefl L.toDCore _)
          (appendAddO L (shiftUpO ops Q'.length
              (s.map (fun d => ops.mul a d)))
            [ops.mul a ops.one])) ?_
        rw [hYlen]
        exact lovSymm L.toDCore (addAssocO L _ _ _)
      obtain ⟨hz, hXR⟩ := shiftTopO L
        (Q'.length + s.length)
        (poly.addLO ops (poly.mulLO ops (monicLO ops s) Q')
          (shiftUpO ops Q'.length (s.map (fun d => ops.mul a d))))
        [ops.mul a ops.one] R
        (fun k hk => L.toDCore.ovTrans (getAtAddO L _ _ k)
          (L.toDCore.ovTrans
            (L.toDCore.addCongr
              (mulTopO L.toDCore (monicLO ops s) Q'
                (Q'.length + s.length)
                (by
                  rw [monicLenO ops s, Nat.add_right_comm s.length 1
                    Q'.length, Nat.add_comm s.length Q'.length]
                  exact Nat.le_refl _) k hk)
              (ovOfEq L.toDCore
                (ground.getAt_over ops.unit _ k
                  (by rw [hYlen]; exact hk))))
            (L.addUnit ops.unit)))
        (fun k hk => ovOfEq L.toDCore
          (ground.getAt_over ops.unit R k
            (Nat.le_trans hR (Nat.le_trans
              (Nat.le_add_left s.length Q'.length) hk))))
        (lovTrans L.toDCore (lovSymm L.toDCore h1) h)
      have t1 : Rd.rel (ops.mul a ops.one) a :=
        L.toDCore.ovTrans (L.toDCore.mulComm a ops.one) (L.oneMul a)
      have ha : Rd.rel a ops.unit :=
        L.toDCore.ovTrans (L.toDCore.ovSymm t1) hz.1
      exact utJoinO
        (monicCancelO L n s Q' R hfuel hR
          (lovTrans L.toDCore (lovSymm L.toDCore
            (addUtLovO' L (poly.mulLO ops (monicLO ops s) Q')
              (utShiftO L.toDCore Q'.length (utScaleO L ha s)))) hXR))
        ⟨ha, trivial⟩

name: getAtNegO
statement:
private theorem getAtNegO {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (C : DCore γ ops R.rel) :
    ∀ (q : List γ) (k : Nat),
      R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit (q.map ops.swap) k)
        (ops.swap (ground.getAt ops.unit q k))
proof:
:=
  poly.getAt_mapSwap ops R C.ovRefl C.ovSymm C.swapUnit

name: diffUtO
statement:
private theorem diffUtO {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
    {p q : List γ} (h : poly.listOV ops R p q) :
    poly.unitTailO ops R (poly.addLO ops p (q.map ops.swap))
proof:
:=
  utOfGetAt (fun k =>
    L.toDCore.ovTrans (getAtAddO L p (q.map ops.swap) k)
      (L.toDCore.ovTrans
        (L.toDCore.addCongr (lovGetAt L.toDCore h k)
          (getAtNegO L.toDCore q k))
        (annihDerived L _)))

name: ovOfDiffO
proof:
:=
  lovOfGetAt L.toDCore (fun k => by
    have e1 : R.rel (ops.add (ground.getAt ops.unit p k)
        (ops.swap (ground.getAt ops.unit q k))) ops.unit :=
      L.toDCore.ovTrans
        (L.toDCore.addCongr (L.toDCore.ovRefl _)
          (L.toDCore.ovSymm (getAtNegO L.toDCore q k)))
        (L.toDCore.ovTrans
          (L.toDCore.ovSymm (getAtAddO L p (q.map ops.swap) k))
          (utGetAt L.toDCore h k))
    have e2 : R.rel (ops.add (ops.swap (ground.getAt ops.unit q k))
        (ground.getAt ops.unit p k))
        (ops.add (ops.swap (ground.getAt ops.unit q k))
          (ground.getAt ops.unit q k)) :=
      L.toDCore.ovTrans (L.toDCore.addComm _ _)
        (L.toDCore.ovTrans e1
          (L.toDCore.ovSymm (L.toDCore.ovTrans
            (L.toDCore.addComm _ _) (annihDerived L _))))
    exact L.addCancel e2 (L.toDCore.ovRefl _))

name: cancelMonicOV
statement:
private theorem cancelMonicOV {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
            (D X Y : List γ)
    (hmon : poly.listOV ops R (monicLO ops D.dropLast) D)
    (h : poly.listOV ops R (poly.mulLO ops D X) (poly.mulLO ops D Y)) :
    poly.listOV ops R X Y
proof:
:= by
  have hu : poly.unitTailO ops R
      (poly.addLO ops (poly.mulLO ops D X) ((poly.mulLO ops D Y).map ops.swap)) :=
    diffUtO L h
  have hB : poly.listOV ops R
      (poly.mulLO ops (monicLO ops D.dropLast)
        (poly.addLO ops X (Y.map ops.swap)))
      (poly.addLO ops (poly.mulLO ops D X) ((poly.mulLO ops D Y).map ops.swap)) :=
    lovTrans L.toDCore
      (mulCongrLeftO L hmon (poly.addLO ops X (Y.map ops.swap)))
      (lovTrans L.toDCore (mulSumO L D X (Y.map ops.swap))
        (addCongrO L (lovRefl L.toDCore _)
          (mulSwapRightO L D Y)))
  have huZ : poly.unitTailO ops R (poly.addLO ops X (Y.map ops.swap)) :=
    monicCancelO L
      (poly.addLO ops X (Y.map ops.swap)).length D.dropLast
      (poly.addLO ops X (Y.map ops.swap)) [] (Nat.le_refl _)
      (Nat.zero_le _)
      (poly.lovNilO _ _ (ovUt L.toDCore hB hu))
  exact ovOfDiffO L huZ

name: addLenLO
statement:
private theorem addLenLO {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ) :
    ∀ p q : List γ, q.length ≤ p.length →
      (poly.addLO ops p q).length = p.length
  | [], [], _ => rfl
  | [], _ :: _, h => absurd h (Nat.not_succ_le_zero _)
  | _ :: _, [], _ => rfl
  | _ :: p, _ :: q, h => by
    show (poly.addLO ops p q).length + 1 = p.length + 1
    rw [addLenLO ops p q (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ h)]

private theorem addLenRO {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ) :
    ∀ p q : List γ, p.length ≤ q.length →
      (poly.addLO ops p q).length = q.length
  | [], _, _ => rfl
  | _ :: _, [], h => absurd h (Nat.not_succ_le_zero _)
  | _ :: p, _ :: q, h => by
    show (poly.addLO ops p q).length + 1 = q.length + 1
    rw [addLenRO ops p q (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ h)]

private theorem getAtAddLO {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ) :
    ∀ (p q : List γ) (k : Nat), q.length ≤ k →
      ground.getAt ops.unit (poly.addLO ops p q) k
        = ground.getAt ops.unit p k
  | [], q, k, h => by
    show ground.getAt ops.unit q k = ground.getAt ops.unit [] k
    rw [ground.getAt_over ops.unit q k h,
      ground.getAt_over ops.unit [] k (Nat.zero_le k)]
  | _ :: _, [], _, _ => rfl
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, 0, h => absurd h (Nat.not_succ_le_zero _)
  | _ :: p, _ :: q, k + 1, h =>
    getAtAddLO ops p q k (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ h)

private theorem getAtAddRO {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ) :
    ∀ (p q : List γ) (k : Nat), p.length ≤ k →
      ground.getAt ops.unit (poly.addLO ops p q) k
        = ground.getAt ops.unit q k
  | [], _, _, _ => rfl
  | _ :: _, [], k, h => by
    show ground.getAt ops.unit (_ :: _) k = ground.getAt ops.unit [] k
    rw [ground.getAt_over ops.unit _ k h,
      ground.getAt_over ops.unit [] k (Nat.zero_le k)]
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, 0, h => absurd h (Nat.not_succ_le_zero _)
  | _ :: p, _ :: q, k + 1, h =>
    getAtAddRO ops p q k (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ h)

private theorem mulLenTopO {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel) :
    ∀ (p q : List γ) (a b : Nat),
      p.length = a + 1 → q.length = b + 1 →
      (poly.mulLO ops p q).length = a + b + 1
        ∧ R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit (poly.mulLO ops p q) (a + b))
          (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit p a)
            (ground.getAt ops.unit q b))
  | [], _, _, _, hp, _ => Nat.noConfusion hp
  | c :: p, q, 0, b, hp, hq => by
    have hp0 : p = []
proof:
:= by
      cases p with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons x s => exact Nat.noConfusion (Nat.succ.inj hp)
    rw [hp0]
    have hmap : (q.map (ops.mul c)).length = b + 1 := by
      rw [ground.length_map]
      exact hq
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · show (poly.addLO ops (q.map (ops.mul c))
        (ops.unit :: poly.mulLO ops [] q)).length = 0 + b + 1
      rw [Nat.zero_add,
        addLenLO ops _ _ (by
          rw [hmap]
          exact Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le b))]
      exact hmap
    · show R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit (poly.addLO ops (q.map (ops.mul c))
          (ops.unit :: poly.mulLO ops [] q)) (0 + b))
        (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit [c] 0)
          (ground.getAt ops.unit q b))
      rw [Nat.zero_add]
      cases b with
      | zero =>
        cases q with
        | nil => exact Nat.noConfusion hq
        | cons d s =>
          have hs : s = [] := by
            cases s with
            | nil => rfl
            | cons y u => exact Nat.noConfusion (Nat.succ.inj hq)
          rw [hs]
          show R.rel (ops.add (ops.mul c d) ops.unit) (ops.mul c d)
          exact L.addUnit _
      | succ b' =>
        rw [getAtAddLO ops (q.map (ops.mul c))
            (ops.unit :: poly.mulLO ops [] q) (b' + 1)
            (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le _)),
          ground.getAt_map ops.unit ops.unit (ops.mul c) q (b' + 1)
            (by rw [hq]; exact Nat.lt_succ_self _)]
        exact L.toDCore.ovRefl _
  | c :: p, q, a + 1, b, hp, hq => by
    have hIH := mulLenTopO L p q a b (Nat.succ.inj hp) hq
    have hmap : (q.map (ops.mul c)).length = b + 1 := by
      rw [ground.length_map]
      exact hq
    have hcons : (ops.unit :: poly.mulLO ops p q).length = a + b + 1 + 1 := by
      show (poly.mulLO ops p q).length + 1 = a + b + 1 + 1
      rw [hIH.1]
    have hswap : a + 1 + b = a + b + 1 := Nat.add_right_comm a 1 b
    have hle : (q.map (ops.mul c)).length
        ≤ (ops.unit :: poly.mulLO ops p q).length := by
      rw [hmap, hcons]
      exact Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_succ b)
        (Nat.le_add_left (b + 1) a))
    have hle2 : (q.map (ops.mul c)).length ≤ a + 1 + b := by
      rw [hmap, hswap]
      exact Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.le_add_left b a)
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · show (poly.addLO ops (q.map (ops.mul c))
        (ops.unit :: poly.mulLO ops p q)).length = a + 1 + b + 1
      rw [addLenRO ops _ _ hle, hcons, hswap]
    · show R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit (poly.addLO ops (q.map (ops.mul c))
          (ops.unit :: poly.mulLO ops p q)) (a + 1 + b))
        (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit (c :: p) (a + 1))
          (ground.getAt ops.unit q b))
      rw [getAtAddRO ops (q.map (ops.mul c))
          (ops.unit :: poly.mulLO ops p q) (a + 1 + b) hle2, hswap]
      show R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit (poly.mulLO ops p q) (a + b))
        (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit p a)
          (ground.getAt ops.unit q b))
      exact hIH.2

          ground.getAt_map ops.unit ops.unit (ops.mul c) q (b' + 1)
            (by rw [hq]; exact Nat.lt_succ_self _)]
        exact L.toDCore.ovRefl _
  | c :: p, q, a + 1, b, hp, hq => by
    have hIH := mulLenTopO L p q a b (Nat.succ.inj hp) hq
    have hmap : (q.map (ops.mul c)).length = b + 1 := by
      rw [ground.length_map]
      exact hq
    have hcons : (ops.unit :: poly.mulLO ops p q).length = a + b + 1 + 1 := by
      show (poly.mulLO ops p q).length + 1 = a + b + 1 + 1
      rw [hIH.1]
    have hswap : a + 1 + b = a + b + 1 := Nat.add_right_comm a 1 b
    have hle : (q.map (ops.mul c)).length
        ≤ (ops.unit :: poly.mulLO ops p q).length := by
      rw [hmap, hcons]
      exact Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_succ b)
        (Nat.le_add_left (b + 1) a))
    have hle2 : (q.map (ops.mul c)).length ≤ a + 1 + b := by
      rw [hmap, hswap]
      exact Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.le_add_left b a)
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · show (poly.addLO ops (q.map (ops.mul c))
        (ops.unit :: poly.mulLO ops p q)).length = a + 1 + b + 1
      rw [addLenRO ops _ _ hle, hcons, hswap]
    · show R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit (poly.addLO ops (q.map (ops.mul c))
          (ops.unit :: poly.mulLO ops p q)) (a + 1 + b))
        (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit (c :: p) (a + 1))
          (ground.getAt ops.unit q b))
      rw [getAtAddRO ops (q.map (ops.mul c))
          (ops.unit :: poly.mulLO ops p q) (a + 1 + b) hle2, hswap]
      show R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit (poly.mulLO ops p q) (a + b))
        (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit p a)
          (ground.getAt ops.unit q b))
      exact hIH.2

name: getAtAddRO
statement:
private theorem getAtAddRO {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ) :
    ∀ (p q : List γ) (k : Nat), p.length ≤ k →
      ground.getAt ops.unit (poly.addLO ops p q) k
        = ground.getAt ops.unit q k
  | [], _, _, _ => rfl
  | _ :: _, [], k, h => by
    show ground.getAt ops.unit (_ :: _) k = ground.getAt ops.unit [] k
    rw [ground.getAt_over ops.unit _ k h,
      ground.getAt_over ops.unit [] k (Nat.zero_le k)]
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, 0, h => absurd h (Nat.not_succ_le_zero _)
  | _ :: p, _ :: q, k + 1, h =>
    getAtAddRO ops p q k (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ h)

private theorem mulLenTopO {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel) :
    ∀ (p q : List γ) (a b : Nat),
      p.length = a + 1 → q.length = b + 1 →
      (poly.mulLO ops p q).length = a + b + 1
        ∧ R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit (poly.mulLO ops p q) (a + b))
          (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit p a)
            (ground.getAt ops.unit q b))
  | [], _, _, _, hp, _ => Nat.noConfusion hp
  | c :: p, q, 0, b, hp, hq => by
    have hp0 : p = []
proof:
:= by
      cases p with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons x s => exact Nat.noConfusion (Nat.succ.inj hp)
    rw [hp0]
    have hmap : (q.map (ops.mul c)).length = b + 1 := by
      rw [ground.length_map]
      exact hq
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · show (poly.addLO ops (q.map (ops.mul c))
        (ops.unit :: poly.mulLO ops [] q)).length = 0 + b + 1
      rw [Nat.zero_add,
        addLenLO ops _ _ (by
          rw [hmap]
          exact Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le b))]
      exact hmap
    · show R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit (poly.addLO ops (q.map (ops.mul c))
          (ops.unit :: poly.mulLO ops [] q)) (0 + b))
        (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit [c] 0)
          (ground.getAt ops.unit q b))
      rw [Nat.zero_add]
      cases b with
      | zero =>
        cases q with
        | nil => exact Nat.noConfusion hq
        | cons d s =>
          have hs : s = [] := by
            cases s with
            | nil => rfl
            | cons y u => exact Nat.noConfusion (Nat.succ.inj hq)
          rw [hs]
          show R.rel (ops.add (ops.mul c d) ops.unit) (ops.mul c d)
          exact L.addUnit _
      | succ b' =>
        rw [getAtAddLO ops (q.map (ops.mul c))
            (ops.unit :: poly.mulLO ops [] q) (b' + 1)
            (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le _)),
          ground.getAt_map ops.unit ops.unit (ops.mul c) q (b' + 1)
            (by rw [hq]; exact Nat.lt_succ_self _)]
        exact L.toDCore.ovRefl _
  | c :: p, q, a + 1, b, hp, hq => by
    have hIH := mulLenTopO L p q a b (Nat.succ.inj hp) hq
    have hmap : (q.map (ops.mul c)).length = b + 1 := by
      rw [ground.length_map]
      exact hq
    have hcons : (ops.unit :: poly.mulLO ops p q).length = a + b + 1 + 1 := by
      show (poly.mulLO ops p q).length + 1 = a + b + 1 + 1
      rw [hIH.1]
    have hswap : a + 1 + b = a + b + 1 := Nat.add_right_comm a 1 b
    have hle : (q.map (ops.mul c)).length
        ≤ (ops.unit :: poly.mulLO ops p q).length := by
      rw [hmap, hcons]
      exact Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_succ b)
        (Nat.le_add_left (b + 1) a))
    have hle2 : (q.map (ops.mul c)).length ≤ a + 1 + b := by
      rw [hmap, hswap]
      exact Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.le_add_left b a)
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · show (poly.addLO ops (q.map (ops.mul c))
        (ops.unit :: poly.mulLO ops p q)).length = a + 1 + b + 1
      rw [addLenRO ops _ _ hle, hcons, hswap]
    · show R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit (poly.addLO ops (q.map (ops.mul c))
          (ops.unit :: poly.mulLO ops p q)) (a + 1 + b))
        (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit (c :: p) (a + 1))
          (ground.getAt ops.unit q b))
      rw [getAtAddRO ops (q.map (ops.mul c))
          (ops.unit :: poly.mulLO ops p q) (a + 1 + b) hle2, hswap]
      show R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit (poly.mulLO ops p q) (a + b))
        (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit p a)
          (ground.getAt ops.unit q b))
      exact hIH.2

name: mulLenTopO
statement:
private theorem mulLenTopO {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel) :
    ∀ (p q : List γ) (a b : Nat),
      p.length = a + 1 → q.length = b + 1 →
      (poly.mulLO ops p q).length = a + b + 1
        ∧ R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit (poly.mulLO ops p q) (a + b))
          (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit p a)
            (ground.getAt ops.unit q b))
  | [], _, _, _, hp, _ => Nat.noConfusion hp
  | c :: p, q, 0, b, hp, hq => by
    have hp0 : p = []
proof:
:= by
      cases p with

    rw [hp0]
    have hmap : (q.map (ops.mul c)).length = b + 1 := by

    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · show (poly.addLO ops (q.map (ops.mul c))
        (ops.unit :: poly.mulLO ops [] q)).length = 0 + b + 1
      rw [Nat.zero_add,
        addLenLO ops _ _ (by
          rw [hmap]
          exact Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le b))]
      exact hmap
    · show R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit (poly.addLO ops (q.map (ops.mul c))
          (ops.unit :: poly.mulLO ops [] q)) (0 + b))
        (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit [c] 0)
          (ground.getAt ops.unit q b))
      rw [Nat.zero_add]
      cases b with
      | zero =>
        cases q with
        | nil => exact Nat.noConfusion hq
        | cons d s =>
          have hs : s = [] := by
            cases s with
            | nil => rfl
            | cons y u => exact Nat.noConfusion (Nat.succ.inj hq)
          rw [hs]
          show R.rel (ops.add (ops.mul c d) ops.unit) (ops.mul c d)
          exact L.addUnit _
      | succ b' =>
        rw [getAtAddLO ops (q.map (ops.mul c))
            (ops.unit :: poly.mulLO ops [] q) (b' + 1)
            (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le _)),
          ground.getAt_map ops.unit ops.unit (ops.mul c) q (b' + 1)
            (by rw [hq]; exact Nat.lt_succ_self _)]
        exact L.toDCore.ovRefl _
  | c :: p, q, a + 1, b, hp, hq => by
    have hIH := mulLenTopO L p q a b (Nat.succ.inj hp) hq
    have hmap : (q.map (ops.mul c)).length = b + 1 := by
      rw [ground.length_map]
      exact hq
    have hcons : (ops.unit :: poly.mulLO ops p q).length = a + b + 1 + 1 := by
      show (poly.mulLO ops p q).length + 1 = a + b + 1 + 1
      rw [hIH.1]
    have hswap : a + 1 + b = a + b + 1 := Nat.add_right_comm a 1 b
    have hle : (q.map (ops.mul c)).length
        ≤ (ops.unit :: poly.mulLO ops p q).length := by
      rw [hmap, hcons]
      exact Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_succ b)

    have hle2 : (q.map (ops.mul c)).length ≤ a + 1 + b := by
      rw [hmap, hswap]
      exact Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.le_add_left b a)
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · show (poly.addLO ops (q.map (ops.mul c))
        (ops.unit :: poly.mulLO ops p q)).length = a + 1 + b + 1
      rw [addLenRO ops _ _ hle, hcons, hswap]
    · show R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit (poly.addLO ops (q.map (ops.mul c))
          (ops.unit :: poly.mulLO ops p q)) (a + 1 + b))
        (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit (c :: p) (a + 1))
          (ground.getAt ops.unit q b))
      rw [getAtAddRO ops (q.map (ops.mul c))
          (ops.unit :: poly.mulLO ops p q) (a + 1 + b) hle2, hswap]
      show R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit (poly.mulLO ops p q) (a + b))
        (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit p a)
          (ground.getAt ops.unit q b))

name: mulLenLeO
statement:
private theorem mulLenLeO {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ) :
    ∀ (p q : List γ) (a b : Nat),
      p.length ≤ a + 1 → q.length ≤ b + 1 →
      (poly.mulLO ops p q).length ≤ a + b + 1
  | [], _, _, _, _, _ => Nat.zero_le _
  | c :: p, q, a, b, hp, hq => by
    show (poly.addLO ops (q.map (ops.mul c))
      (ops.unit :: poly.mulLO ops p q)).length ≤ a + b + 1
    refine addLenLeO ops _ _ _ ?_ ?_
    · rw [ground.length_map]
      exact Nat.le_trans hq (Nat.le_add_left (b + 1) a)
    · show (poly.mulLO ops p q).length + 1 ≤ a + b + 1
      cases a with
      | zero =>
        cases p with
        | nil =>
          show 0 + 1 ≤ 0 + b + 1
          exact Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le _)
        | cons x s =>
          exact absurd (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hp)
            (Nat.not_succ_le_zero s.length)
      | succ a' =>
        have hIH
proof:
:= mulLenLeO ops p q a' b
          (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hp) hq
        have he : a' + 1 + b + 1 = a' + b + 1 + 1 := by
          rw [Nat.add_right_comm a' 1 b]
        rw [he]
        exact Nat.succ_le_succ hIH

name: topUnitTailO
statement:
private theorem topUnitTailO {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (C : DCore γ ops R.rel) :
    ∀ {p : List γ}, poly.unitTailO ops R p → R.rel (poly.topO ops p) ops.unit
  | [], _ => C.ovRefl _
  | [_], h => h.1
  | _ :: c :: t, h => topUnitTailO C (p := c :: t) h.2

/
carrier, `def:poly`'s displayed read at the summed key, the vacant
factors at the unit's own product. -/
private theorem topMulLO {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel) :
    ∀ p q : List γ,
      R.rel (poly.topO ops (poly.mulLO ops p q))
        (ops.mul (poly.topO ops p) (poly.topO ops q))
  | [], q =>
    L.toDCore.ovSymm (L.toDCore.ovTrans (L.toDCore.mulComm _ _)
      (L.mulUnit (poly.topO ops q)))
  | _ :: p, [] =>
    L.toDCore.ovTrans (topUnitTailO L.toDCore (mulNilO L.toDCore _))
      (L.toDCore.ovSymm (L.mulUnit _))
  | c :: p, d :: q => by
    have h
proof:
:= mulLenTopO L (c :: p) (d :: q) p.length q.length rfl rfl
    rw [poly.topO_getAt ops _ (p.length + q.length) h.1,
      poly.topO_getAt ops (c :: p) p.length rfl,
      poly.topO_getAt ops (d :: q) q.length rfl]
    exact h.2

name: topMulLO
statement:
private theorem topMulLO {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel) :
    ∀ p q : List γ,
      R.rel (poly.topO ops (poly.mulLO ops p q))
        (ops.mul (poly.topO ops p) (poly.topO ops q))
  | [], q =>
    L.toDCore.ovSymm (L.toDCore.ovTrans (L.toDCore.mulComm _ _)
      (L.mulUnit (poly.topO ops q)))
  | _ :: p, [] =>
    L.toDCore.ovTrans (topUnitTailO L.toDCore (mulNilO L.toDCore _))
      (L.toDCore.ovSymm (L.mulUnit _))
  | c :: p, d :: q => by
    have h
proof:
:= mulLenTopO L (c :: p) (d :: q) p.length q.length rfl rfl
    rw [poly.topO_getAt ops _ (p.length + q.length) h.1,
      poly.topO_getAt ops (c :: p) p.length rfl,
      poly.topO_getAt ops (d :: q) q.length rfl]
    exact h.2

name: ptop_pmul
statement:
theorem ptop_pmul (P Q : poly.PPoly) :
    poly.oneValue (poly.ptop (poly.pmul P Q))
      (poly.mul (poly.ptop P) (poly.ptop Q))
proof:
:=
  topMulLO (R := poly.polyRead) (polyLawsO (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairLaws)
    P Q

name: foldMulLeO
statement:
private theorem foldMulLeO {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ)
    (E : Nat → List γ) (hE : ∀ t, (E t).length ≤ 2) :
    ∀ l : List Nat,
      (ground.famFold (poly.mulLO ops) [ops.one] E l).length ≤ l.length + 1
  | [] => Nat.le_refl 1
  | a :: t => by
    show (poly.mulLO ops (E a)
      (ground.famFold (poly.mulLO ops) [ops.one] E t)).length
        ≤ t.length + 1 + 1
    have h
proof:
:= mulLenLeO ops (E a)
      (ground.famFold (poly.mulLO ops) [ops.one] E t)
      1 t.length (hE a) (foldMulLeO ops E hE t)
    rw [Nat.add_comm 1 t.length] at h
    exact h

name: foldMulDropO
statement:
private theorem foldMulDropO {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ)
    (E : Nat → List γ) (hE : ∀ t, (E t).length ≤ 2) (t₀ : Nat)
    (h0 : (E t₀).length ≤ 1) : ∀ l : List Nat,
    0 < ground.countOf t₀ l →
    (ground.famFold (poly.mulLO ops) [ops.one] E l).length ≤ l.length
  | [], h => absurd h (Nat.lt_irrefl 0)
  | a :: t, h => by
    by_cases hat : t₀ = a
    · show (poly.mulLO ops (E a)
        (ground.famFold (poly.mulLO ops) [ops.one] E t)).length ≤ t.length + 1
      have hEa : (E a).length ≤ 0 + 1
proof:
:= by
        rw [← hat]
        exact h0
      have hb := mulLenLeO ops (E a)
        (ground.famFold (poly.mulLO ops) [ops.one] E t)
        0 t.length hEa (foldMulLeO ops E hE t)
      rw [Nat.zero_add] at hb
      exact hb
    · have ht : 0 < ground.countOf t₀ t := by
        rw [ground.countOf_head_ne hat] at h
        exact h
      have hIH := foldMulDropO ops E hE t₀ h0 t ht
      cases t with
      | nil => exact absurd ht (Nat.lt_irrefl 0)
      | cons x s =>
        show (poly.mulLO ops (E a)
          (ground.famFold (poly.mulLO ops) [ops.one] E (x :: s))).length
          ≤ (x :: s).length + 1
        have hb := mulLenLeO ops (E a)
          (ground.famFold (poly.mulLO ops) [ops.one] E (x :: s)) 1 s.length
          (hE a) hIH
        rw [Nat.add_comm 1 s.length] at hb
        exact hb

name: foldMulMonicO
statement:
private theorem foldMulMonicO {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
        (E : Nat → List γ) : ∀ l : List Nat,
    (∀ t, 0 < ground.countOf t l →
      (E t).length = 2
        ∧ R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit (E t) 1) ops.one) →
    (ground.famFold (poly.mulLO ops) [ops.one] E l).length = l.length + 1
      ∧ R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit
          (ground.famFold (poly.mulLO ops) [ops.one] E l) l.length)
        ops.one
  | [], _ => ⟨rfl, L.toDCore.ovRefl _⟩
  | a :: t, h => by
    have hIH
proof:
:= foldMulMonicO L E t
      (fun x hx => h x (ground.countOf_cons_pos hx))
    have ha := h a (by rw [ground.countOf_head]; exact Nat.succ_pos _)
    have hm := mulLenTopO L (E a)
      (ground.famFold (poly.mulLO ops) [ops.one] E t)
      1 t.length ha.1 hIH.1
    have hswap : 1 + t.length = t.length + 1 := Nat.add_comm 1 t.length
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · show (poly.mulLO ops (E a)
        (ground.famFold (poly.mulLO ops) [ops.one] E t)).length
        = t.length + 1 + 1
      rw [hm.1, hswap]
    · show R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit (poly.mulLO ops (E a)
          (ground.famFold (poly.mulLO ops) [ops.one] E t))
        (t.length + 1)) ops.one
      rw [← hswap]
      refine L.toDCore.ovTrans hm.2 ?_
      exact L.toDCore.ovTrans
        (L.toDCore.mulCongr ha.2 hIH.2)
        (L.oneMul ops.one)

name: foldAddLeO
statement:
private theorem foldAddLeO {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ)
    (g : List Nat → List γ) (n : Nat) :
    ∀ l : List (List Nat),
    (∀ q, 0 < ground.countOf q l → (g q).length ≤ n) →
    (ground.famFold (poly.addLO ops) [] g l).length ≤ n
  | [], _ => Nat.zero_le n
  | a :: t, h => by
    show (poly.addLO ops (g a) (ground.famFold (poly.addLO ops) [] g t)).length ≤ n
    exact addLenLeO ops _ _ n
      (h a (by rw [ground.countOf_head]; exact Nat.succ_pos _))
      (foldAddLeO ops g n t (fun q hq => h q (ground.countOf_cons_pos hq)))

private theorem foldAddPickO {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
    (g : List Nat → List γ)
    (key : List Nat) (n : Nat) (hkey : (g key).length = n + 1)
    (htop : R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit (g key) n) ops.one) :
    ∀ l : List (List Nat), ground.countOf key l = 1 →
    (∀ q, 0 < ground.countOf q l → ¬ q = key → (g q).length ≤ n) →
    (ground.famFold (poly.addLO ops) [] g l).length = n + 1
      ∧ R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit
          (ground.famFold (poly.addLO ops) [] g l) n) ops.one
  | [], hc, _ => Nat.noConfusion hc
  | a :: t, hc, h => by
    have hh : (if key = a then 1 else 0) + ground.countOf key t = 1
proof:
:=
      (ground.countOf_cons key a t).symm.trans hc
    by_cases hak : key = a
    · rw [if_pos hak] at hh
      have hc0 : ground.countOf key t = 0 :=
        ground.addCancelL 1 (by rw [Nat.add_zero]; exact hh)
      have hrest : (ground.famFold (poly.addLO ops) [] g t).length ≤ n :=
        foldAddLeO ops g n t (fun q hq => h q (ground.countOf_cons_pos hq)
          (fun he => absurd (show 0 < ground.countOf key t by
              rw [← he]; exact hq)
            (by rw [hc0]; exact Nat.lt_irrefl 0)))
      show (poly.addLO ops (g a) (ground.famFold (poly.addLO ops) [] g t)).length
          = n + 1
        ∧ R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit
            (poly.addLO ops (g a) (ground.famFold (poly.addLO ops) [] g t)) n)
          ops.one
      rw [← hak]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [addLenLO ops (g key) (ground.famFold (poly.addLO ops) [] g t)
          (by rw [hkey]; exact Nat.le_trans hrest (Nat.le_succ n))]
        exact hkey
      · rw [getAtAddLO ops (g key) (ground.famFold (poly.addLO ops) [] g t)
          n hrest]
        exact htop
    · rw [if_neg hak, Nat.zero_add] at hh
      have hIH := foldAddPickO L g key n hkey htop t hh
        (fun q hq hqk => h q (ground.countOf_cons_pos hq) hqk)
      have hga : (g a).length ≤ n :=
        h a (by rw [ground.countOf_head]; exact Nat.succ_pos _)
          (fun he => hak he.symm)
      show (poly.addLO ops (g a) (ground.famFold (poly.addLO ops) [] g t)).length
          = n + 1
        ∧ R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit
            (poly.addLO ops (g a) (ground.famFold (poly.addLO ops) [] g t)) n)
          ops.one
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [addLenRO ops (g a) (ground.famFold (poly.addLO ops) [] g t)
          (by rw [hIH.1]; exact Nat.le_trans hga (Nat.le_succ n))]
        exact hIH.1
      · rw [getAtAddRO ops (g a) (ground.famFold (poly.addLO ops) [] g t)
          n hga]
        exact hIH.2

name: foldAddPickO
statement:
private theorem foldAddPickO {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
    (g : List Nat → List γ)
    (key : List Nat) (n : Nat) (hkey : (g key).length = n + 1)
    (htop : R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit (g key) n) ops.one) :
    ∀ l : List (List Nat), ground.countOf key l = 1 →
    (∀ q, 0 < ground.countOf q l → ¬ q = key → (g q).length ≤ n) →
    (ground.famFold (poly.addLO ops) [] g l).length = n + 1
      ∧ R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit
          (ground.famFold (poly.addLO ops) [] g l) n) ops.one
  | [], hc, _ => Nat.noConfusion hc
  | a :: t, hc, h => by
    have hh : (if key = a then 1 else 0) + ground.countOf key t = 1
proof:
:=
      (ground.countOf_cons key a t).symm.trans hc
    by_cases hak : key = a
    · rw [if_pos hak] at hh
      have hc0 : ground.countOf key t = 0 :=
        ground.addCancelL 1 (by rw [Nat.add_zero]; exact hh)
      have hrest : (ground.famFold (poly.addLO ops) [] g t).length ≤ n :=
        foldAddLeO ops g n t (fun q hq => h q (ground.countOf_cons_pos hq)
          (fun he => absurd (show 0 < ground.countOf key t by
              rw [← he]; exact hq)
            (by rw [hc0]; exact Nat.lt_irrefl 0)))
      show (poly.addLO ops (g a) (ground.famFold (poly.addLO ops) [] g t)).length
          = n + 1
