        ∧ R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit
            (poly.addLO ops (g a) (ground.famFold (poly.addLO ops) [] g t)) n)
          ops.one
      rw [← hak]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [addLenLO ops (g key) (ground.famFold (poly.addLO ops) [] g t)
          (by rw [hkey]; exact Nat.le_trans hrest (Nat.le_succ n))]
        exact hkey
      · rw [getAtAddLO ops (g key) (ground.famFold (poly.addLO ops) [] g t)
          n hrest]
        exact htop
    · rw [if_neg hak, Nat.zero_add] at hh
      have hIH := foldAddPickO L g key n hkey htop t hh
        (fun q hq hqk => h q (ground.countOf_cons_pos hq) hqk)
      have hga : (g a).length ≤ n :=
        h a (by rw [ground.countOf_head]; exact Nat.succ_pos _)
          (fun he => hak he.symm)
      show (poly.addLO ops (g a) (ground.famFold (poly.addLO ops) [] g t)).length
          = n + 1
        ∧ R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit
            (poly.addLO ops (g a) (ground.famFold (poly.addLO ops) [] g t)) n)
          ops.one
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [addLenRO ops (g a) (ground.famFold (poly.addLO ops) [] g t)
          (by rw [hIH.1]; exact Nat.le_trans hga (Nat.le_succ n))]
        exact hIH.1
      · rw [getAtAddRO ops (g a) (ground.famFold (poly.addLO ops) [] g t)
          n hga]
        exact hIH.2

name: foldMulDrop2O
statement:
private theorem foldMulDrop2O {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ)
    (E : Nat → List γ) (hE : ∀ t, (E t).length ≤ 2) (t₀ t₁ : Nat)
    (hne : ¬ t₀ = t₁)
    (h0 : (E t₀).length ≤ 1) (h1 : (E t₁).length ≤ 1) :
    ∀ l : List Nat, 0 < ground.countOf t₀ l →
      0 < ground.countOf t₁ l →
      (ground.famFold (poly.mulLO ops) [ops.one] E l).length + 1 ≤ l.length
  | [], h, _ => absurd h (Nat.lt_irrefl 0)
  | a :: t, h₀, h₁ => by
    show (poly.mulLO ops (E a)
      (ground.famFold (poly.mulLO ops) [ops.one] E t)).length + 1
        ≤ t.length + 1
    by_cases ha0 : t₀ = a
    · have ht1 : 0 < ground.countOf t₁ t
proof:
:= by
        rw [ground.countOf_head_ne
          (fun he : t₁ = a => hne (ha0.trans he.symm))] at h₁
        exact h₁
      match t, ht1 with
      | b :: t', ht1 =>
        have htail := foldMulDropO ops E hE t₁ h1 (b :: t') ht1
        refine Nat.succ_le_succ ?_
        refine Nat.le_trans (mulLenLeO ops (E a)
          (ground.famFold (poly.mulLO ops) [ops.one] E (b :: t')) 0
          t'.length (by rw [← ha0]; exact h0) htail) ?_
        rw [Nat.zero_add]
        exact Nat.le_refl _
    · by_cases ha1 : t₁ = a
      · have ht0 : 0 < ground.countOf t₀ t := by
          rw [ground.countOf_head_ne ha0] at h₀
          exact h₀
        match t, ht0 with
        | b :: t', ht0 =>
          have htail := foldMulDropO ops E hE t₀ h0 (b :: t') ht0
          refine Nat.succ_le_succ ?_
          refine Nat.le_trans (mulLenLeO ops (E a)
            (ground.famFold (poly.mulLO ops) [ops.one] E (b :: t')) 0
            t'.length (by rw [← ha1]; exact h1) htail) ?_
          rw [Nat.zero_add]
          exact Nat.le_refl _
      · have ht0 : 0 < ground.countOf t₀ t := by
          rw [ground.countOf_head_ne ha0] at h₀
          exact h₀
        have ht1 : 0 < ground.countOf t₁ t := by
          rw [ground.countOf_head_ne ha1] at h₁
          exact h₁
        have htail := foldMulDrop2O ops E hE t₀ t₁ hne h0 h1 t ht0 ht1
        refine Nat.succ_le_succ ?_
        match hfl : (ground.famFold (poly.mulLO ops) [ops.one] E t).length,
            htail with
        | 0, htail =>
          refine Nat.le_trans (mulLenLeO ops (E a)
            (ground.famFold (poly.mulLO ops) [ops.one] E t) 1 0
            (hE a) (by rw [hfl]; exact Nat.zero_le 1)) ?_
          match t, ht0, ht1 with
          | [c], ht0, ht1 =>
            have he0 : t₀ = c := by
              by_cases h : t₀ = c
              · exact h
              · rw [ground.countOf_cons t₀ c ([] : List Nat),
                  if_neg h] at ht0
                exact absurd ht0 (Nat.lt_irrefl 0)
            have he1 : t₁ = c := by
              by_cases h : t₁ = c
              · exact h
              · rw [ground.countOf_cons t₁ c ([] : List Nat),
                  if_neg h] at ht1
                exact absurd ht1 (Nat.lt_irrefl 0)
            exact absurd (he0.trans he1.symm) hne
          | c :: d :: t'', _, _ =>
            exact Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le _))
        | e + 1, htail =>
          refine Nat.le_trans (mulLenLeO ops (E a)
            (ground.famFold (poly.mulLO ops) [ops.one] E t) 1 e
            (hE a) (by rw [hfl]; exact Nat.le_refl _)) ?_
          rw [show 1 + e + 1 = e + 1 + 1 from by
            rw [Nat.add_comm 1 e]]
          exact htail

name: getAt_ne_witness
statement:
private theorem getAt_ne_witness : ∀ (u v : List Nat),
    u.length = v.length → ¬ u = v →
    ∃ k, k < u.length ∧ ¬ ground.getAt 0 u k = ground.getAt 0 v k
  | [], [], _, h => absurd rfl h
  | [], _ :: _, hl, _ => Nat.noConfusion hl
  | _ :: _, [], hl, _ => Nat.noConfusion hl
  | a :: u, b :: v, hl, h => by
    by_cases hab : a = b
    · have huv : ¬ u = v
proof:
:= by
        intro he
        exact h (by rw [hab, he])
      match getAt_ne_witness u v (Nat.succ.inj hl) huv with
      | ⟨k, hk, hne⟩ => exact ⟨k + 1, Nat.succ_lt_succ hk, hne⟩
    · exact ⟨0, Nat.succ_pos _, hab⟩

name: countOf_range_mon
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (List.range d).length
      = ground.sumNat (List.replicate d 1) := by
    rw [ground.length_range, ground.sumNat_replicate_one d]
  have h2 : places.content (List.replicate d 1).length (List.range d)
      = List.replicate d 1 := by
    rw [ground.length_replicate]
    refine ground.getAt_ext 0 _ _ ?_ ?_
    · rw [places.content_length, ground.length_replicate]
    · intro i hi
      have hid : i < d := by
        rw [places.content_length] at hi
        exact hi
      rw [places.getAt_contentAt d (List.range d) i hid,
        ground.countOf_range_one hid,
        ground.getAt_replicate 0 1 d i hid]
  rw [places.countOf_monomialsAt, if_pos ⟨h1, h2⟩]

name: offDiag_pair
statement:
private theorem offDiag_pair (n : Nat) (p : List Nat)
    (hp : 0 < ground.countOf p
      (places.monomialsAt (List.replicate n 1)))
    (k1 : Nat) (hk1 : k1 < n)
    (hkv : ¬ ground.getAt 0 p k1 = k1) :
    ∃ k2, k2 < n ∧ ¬ k2 = k1 ∧ ¬ ground.getAt 0 p k2 = k2
proof:
:= by
  have hreads := places.perm_member_reads hp
  refine ⟨ground.getAt 0 p k1, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact hreads.2.2.1 (ground.getAt 0 p k1)
      (ground.countOf_getAt_pos 0 p k1 (by
        rw [hreads.1]; exact hk1))
  · exact fun he => hkv he
  · intro hfix
    have h1 := places.posOf_getAt hreads.2.1 k1 (by
      rw [hreads.1]; exact hk1)
    have h2 := places.posOf_getAt hreads.2.1 (ground.getAt 0 p k1)
      (by
        rw [hreads.1]
        exact hreads.2.2.1 (ground.getAt 0 p k1)
          (ground.countOf_getAt_pos 0 p k1 (by
            rw [hreads.1]; exact hk1)))
    rw [hfix] at h2
    exact hkv (h1.symm.trans h2).symm

name: shiftedRowO_len
proof:
:=
  ground.length_mapRange _ r.length

name: shiftedRowO_entry
statement:
private theorem shiftedRowO_entry {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ)
    (r : List γ) (i j : Nat) (hj : j < r.length) :
    ground.getAt [] (shiftedRowO ops r i) j
      = match Nat.beq i j with
        | true => [ground.getAt ops.unit r j, ops.one]
        | false => [ground.getAt ops.unit r j]
proof:
:= by
  show ground.getAt [] ((List.range r.length).map (fun j =>
      match Nat.beq i j with
      | true => [ground.getAt ops.unit r j, ops.one]
      | false => [ground.getAt ops.unit r j])) j = _
  rw [ground.getAt_map 0 [] _ (List.range r.length) j
      (by rw [ground.length_range]; exact hj),
    ground.getAt_range r.length j hj]

name: shiftedRowO_diag
statement:
private theorem shiftedRowO_diag {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ)
    (r : List γ) (i : Nat) (hi : i < r.length) :
    ground.getAt [] (shiftedRowO ops r i) i
      = [ground.getAt ops.unit r i, ops.one]
proof:
:= by
  rw [shiftedRowO_entry ops r i i hi, ground.beqRefl i]

name: shiftedRowO_off
statement:
private theorem shiftedRowO_off {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ)
    (r : List γ) (i j : Nat) (hj : j < r.length) (hne : ¬ i = j) :
    ground.getAt [] (shiftedRowO ops r i) j
      = [ground.getAt ops.unit r j]
proof:
:= by
  have hb : Nat.beq i j = false := by
    cases hbe : Nat.beq i j with
    | true => exact absurd (Nat.eq_of_beq_eq_true hbe) hne
    | false => rfl
  rw [shiftedRowO_entry ops r i j hj, hb]

name: shiftedRowO_entry_len
proof:
:= by
  match Nat.lt_or_ge j r.length with
  | .inl hj =>
    rw [shiftedRowO_entry ops r i j hj]
    cases Nat.beq i j with
    | true => exact Nat.le_refl 2
    | false => exact Nat.le_succ 1
  | .inr hj =>
    rw [ground.getAt_over [] (shiftedRowO ops r i) j
      (by rw [shiftedRowO_len]; exact hj)]
    exact Nat.zero_le 2

name: shiftedMO_len
proof:
:=
  ground.length_mapRange _ B.length

name: shiftedMO_row
statement:
private theorem shiftedMO_row {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ)
    (B : List (List γ)) (i : Nat) (hi : i < B.length) :
    ground.getAt [] (shiftedMO ops B) i
      = shiftedRowO ops (ground.getAt [] B i) i
proof:
:= by
  show ground.getAt [] ((List.range B.length).map
    (fun i => shiftedRowO ops (ground.getAt [] B i) i)) i = _
  rw [ground.getAt_map 0 [] _ (List.range B.length) i
      (by rw [ground.length_range]; exact hi),
    ground.getAt_range B.length i hi]

name: shiftedMO_entry_len
statement:
private theorem shiftedMO_entry_len {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ)
    (B : List (List γ)) (i j : Nat) :
    (ground.getAt [] (ground.getAt [] (shiftedMO ops B) i) j).length
      ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  match Nat.lt_or_ge i B.length with
  | .inl hi =>
    rw [shiftedMO_row ops B i hi]
    exact shiftedRowO_entry_len ops _ i j
  | .inr hi =>
    rw [ground.getAt_over [] (shiftedMO ops B) i
      (by rw [shiftedMO_len]; exact hi)]
    show (ground.getAt ([] : List γ) [] j).length ≤ 2
    rw [ground.getAt_over [] ([] : List (List γ))]
    · exact Nat.zero_le 2
    · exact Nat.zero_le j

name: shiftTermIdO
statement:
private theorem shiftTermIdO {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
        (B : List (List γ)) (hsq : rowsLen B.length B) :
    (termO (poly.polyO ops) (shiftedMO ops B) (List.range B.length)).length
        = B.length + 1
      ∧ R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit
          (termO (poly.polyO ops) (shiftedMO ops B) (List.range B.length))
          B.length) ops.one
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : (shiftedMO ops B).length
      = (List.range B.length).length := by
    rw [shiftedMO_len, ground.length_range]
  have key := foldMulMonicO L
    (fun t => ground.getAt [] (ground.getAt [] (shiftedMO ops B) t)
      (ground.getAt 0 (List.range B.length) t))
    (List.range B.length)
    (fun t ht => by
      have htB : t < B.length := by
        rw [ground.countOf_range t B.length] at ht
        by_cases hb : t < B.length
        · exact hb
        · rw [if_neg hb] at ht
          exact absurd ht (Nat.lt_irrefl 0)
      have hrl : (ground.getAt [] B t).length = B.length :=
        rowsLen_getAt B t hsq htB
      show (ground.getAt [] (ground.getAt [] (shiftedMO ops B) t)
            (ground.getAt 0 (List.range B.length) t)).length = 2
          ∧ R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit
            (ground.getAt [] (ground.getAt [] (shiftedMO ops B) t)
              (ground.getAt 0 (List.range B.length) t)) 1) ops.one
      rw [ground.getAt_range B.length t htB, shiftedMO_row ops B t htB,
        shiftedRowO_diag ops (ground.getAt [] B t) t
          (by rw [hrl]; exact htB)]
      exact ⟨rfl, L.toDCore.ovRefl _⟩)
  rw [ground.length_range] at key
  rw [termO_fold (poly.polyO ops) (shiftedMO ops B) (List.range B.length)
    hlen, shiftedMO_len]
  exact key

name: shiftTermOffO
statement:
private theorem shiftTermOffO {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ)
    (B : List (List γ)) (hsq : rowsLen B.length B)
    (p : List Nat)
    (hp : 0 < ground.countOf p
      (places.monomialsAt (List.replicate B.length 1)))
    (hne : ¬ p = List.range B.length) :
    (termO (poly.polyO ops) (shiftedMO ops B) p).length + 1 ≤ B.length
proof:
:= by
  have hreads := places.perm_member_reads hp
  have hlen : (shiftedMO ops B).length = p.length := by
    rw [shiftedMO_len, hreads.1]
  have hlen2 : p.length = (List.range B.length).length := by
    rw [hreads.1, ground.length_range]
  match getAt_ne_witness p (List.range B.length) hlen2 hne with
  | ⟨k, hk, hkne⟩ =>
    have hkB : k < B.length := by
      rw [← hreads.1]
      exact hk
    have hkval : ¬ k = ground.getAt 0 p k := by
      rw [ground.getAt_range B.length k hkB] at hkne
      exact fun he => hkne he.symm
    have hpk : ground.getAt 0 p k < B.length :=
      hreads.2.2.1 (ground.getAt 0 p k)
        (ground.countOf_getAt_pos 0 p k hk)
    have hrl : (ground.getAt [] B k).length = B.length :=
      rowsLen_getAt B k hsq hkB
    have h0 : (ground.getAt [] (ground.getAt [] (shiftedMO ops B) k)
        (ground.getAt 0 p k)).length ≤ 1 := by
      rw [shiftedMO_row ops B k hkB]
      rw [shiftedRowO_off ops (ground.getAt [] B k) k
        (ground.getAt 0 p k) (by rw [hrl]; exact hpk) hkval]
      exact Nat.le_refl 1
    match offDiag_pair B.length p hp k hkB
        (fun he => hkval he.symm) with
    | ⟨k2, hk2B, hk2ne, hk2v⟩ =>
      have hpk2 : ground.getAt 0 p k2 < B.length :=
        hreads.2.2.1 (ground.getAt 0 p k2)
          (ground.countOf_getAt_pos 0 p k2 (by
            rw [hreads.1]; exact hk2B))
      have hrl2 : (ground.getAt [] B k2).length = B.length :=
        rowsLen_getAt B k2 hsq hk2B
      have h02 : (ground.getAt []
          (ground.getAt [] (shiftedMO ops B) k2)
          (ground.getAt 0 p k2)).length ≤ 1 := by
        rw [shiftedMO_row ops B k2 hk2B]
        rw [shiftedRowO_off ops (ground.getAt [] B k2) k2
          (ground.getAt 0 p k2) (by rw [hrl2]; exact hpk2)
          (fun he => hk2v he.symm)]
        exact Nat.le_refl 1
      have hcount : 0 < ground.countOf k (List.range B.length) := by
        rw [ground.countOf_range_one hkB]
        exact Nat.succ_pos 0
      have hcount2 : 0 < ground.countOf k2 (List.range B.length) := by
        rw [ground.countOf_range_one hk2B]
        exact Nat.succ_pos 0
      have hbound := foldMulDrop2O ops
        (fun t => ground.getAt [] (ground.getAt [] (shiftedMO ops B) t)
          (ground.getAt 0 p t))
        (fun t => shiftedMO_entry_len ops B t (ground.getAt 0 p t))
        k k2 (fun he => hk2ne he.symm) h0 h02
        (List.range B.length) hcount hcount2
      rw [ground.length_range] at hbound
      rw [termO_fold (poly.polyO ops) (shiftedMO ops B) p hlen,
        shiftedMO_len]
      exact hbound

name: shiftDetShapeO
statement:
private theorem shiftDetShapeO {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
        (B : List (List γ)) (hsq : rowsLen B.length B) :
    (detO (poly.polyO ops) (shiftedMO ops B)).length = B.length + 1
    ∧ R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit (detO (poly.polyO ops) (shiftedMO ops B))
        B.length) ops.one
proof:
:= by
  have hid := shiftTermIdO L B hsq
  have hsgn : ∀ X : List γ,
      sgnO (poly.polyO ops) (List.range B.length) X = X := fun X => by
    show (if places.parity (List.range B.length)
      then (poly.polyO ops).swap X else X) = X
    exact if_neg (fun hp => Bool.noConfusion
      ((places.parity_range B.length).symm.trans hp))
  have h1 : (sgnO (poly.polyO ops) (List.range B.length)
      (termO (poly.polyO ops) (shiftedMO ops B)
        (List.range B.length))).length = B.length + 1 := by
    rw [hsgn]
    exact hid.1
  have h2 : R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit
      (sgnO (poly.polyO ops) (List.range B.length)
        (termO (poly.polyO ops) (shiftedMO ops B) (List.range B.length)))
      B.length) ops.one := by
    rw [hsgn]
    exact hid.2
  have h4 : ∀ q, 0 < ground.countOf q
        (places.monomialsAt (List.replicate B.length 1)) →
      ¬ q = List.range B.length →
      (sgnO (poly.polyO ops) q
        (termO (poly.polyO ops) (shiftedMO ops B) q)).length
        ≤ B.length := by
    intro q hq hne
    have hoff := shiftTermOffO ops B hsq q hq hne
    show (if places.parity q then (poly.polyO ops).swap
        (termO (poly.polyO ops) (shiftedMO ops B) q)
      else termO (poly.polyO ops) (shiftedMO ops B) q).length ≤ B.length
    cases places.parity q with
    | false => exact Nat.le_of_succ_le hoff
    | true =>
      show ((termO (poly.polyO ops) (shiftedMO ops B) q).map
        ops.swap).length ≤ B.length
      rw [show ((termO (poly.polyO ops) (shiftedMO ops B) q).map
          ops.swap).length
          = (termO (poly.polyO ops) (shiftedMO ops B) q).length from
        ground.length_map ops.swap _]
      exact Nat.le_of_succ_le hoff
  show (ground.famFold (poly.polyO ops).add []
        (fun p => sgnO (poly.polyO ops) p
          (termO (poly.polyO ops) (shiftedMO ops B) p))
        (places.monomialsAt
          (List.replicate (shiftedMO ops B).length 1))).length
      = B.length + 1
    ∧ R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.famFold (poly.polyO ops).add []
        (fun p => sgnO (poly.polyO ops) p
          (termO (poly.polyO ops) (shiftedMO ops B) p))
        (places.monomialsAt
          (List.replicate (shiftedMO ops B).length 1)))
      B.length) ops.one
  rw [shiftedMO_len]
  exact foldAddPickO L
    (fun p => sgnO (poly.polyO ops) p
      (termO (poly.polyO ops) (shiftedMO ops B) p))
    (List.range B.length) B.length h1 h2
    (places.monomialsAt (List.replicate B.length 1))
    (countOf_range_mon B.length) h4

name: monicDropLastOvO
statement:
private theorem monicDropLastOvO {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (C : DCore γ ops R.rel) :
    ∀ (p : List γ) (n : Nat), p.length = n + 1 →
      R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit p n) ops.one →
      poly.listOV ops R (monicLO ops p.dropLast) p
  | [], _, hl, _ => Nat.noConfusion hl
  | [_], 0, _, ht => ⟨C.ovSymm ht, trivial⟩
  | [_], _ + 1, hl, _ => Nat.noConfusion (Nat.succ.inj hl)
  | _ :: _ :: _, 0, hl, _ => Nat.noConfusion (Nat.succ.inj hl)
  | c :: d :: t, n + 1, hl, ht =>
    ⟨C.ovRefl c,
      monicDropLastOvO C (d :: t) n (Nat.succ.inj hl) ht⟩

private theorem shiftDetMonicO {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
        (B : List (List γ)) (hsq : rowsLen B.length B) :
    poly.listOV ops R
      (monicLO ops ((detO (poly.polyO ops) (shiftedMO ops B)).dropLast))
      (detO (poly.polyO ops) (shiftedMO ops B))
proof:
:=
  monicDropLastOvO L.toDCore (detO (poly.polyO ops) (shiftedMO ops B))
    B.length (shiftDetShapeO L B hsq).1
    (shiftDetShapeO L B hsq).2

name: shiftDetMonicO
statement:
private theorem shiftDetMonicO {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
        (B : List (List γ)) (hsq : rowsLen B.length B) :
    poly.listOV ops R
      (monicLO ops ((detO (poly.polyO ops) (shiftedMO ops B)).dropLast))
      (detO (poly.polyO ops) (shiftedMO ops B))
proof:
:=
  monicDropLastOvO L.toDCore (detO (poly.polyO ops) (shiftedMO ops B))
    B.length (shiftDetShapeO L B hsq).1
    (shiftDetShapeO L B hsq).2

name: gapClash
statement:
private theorem gapClash {z : BPair} {g h : Pos}
    (hg : z.snd + g = z.fst) (hh : z.fst + h = z.snd) : False
proof:
:=
  ground.add_ne_left z.snd (g + h)
    (by rw [← ground.add_assoc, hg, hh])

name: gapEqClash
statement:
private theorem gapEqClash {z : BPair} {g : Pos}
    (hg : z.snd + g = z.fst) (he : z.fst = z.snd) : False
proof:
:=
  ground.add_ne_left z.snd g (by rw [hg, he])

name: gapEqClashL
statement:
private theorem gapEqClashL {z : BPair} {g : Pos}
    (hg : z.fst + g = z.snd) (he : z.fst = z.snd) : False
proof:
:=
  ground.add_ne_left z.fst g (by rw [hg, he])

name: ovOfGap
proof:
:= by
  show u.fst + v.snd = v.fst + u.snd
  rw [← hu, ← hv, ground.add_right_comm u.snd g v.snd,
    ground.add_right_comm v.snd g u.snd,
    ground.add_comm u.snd v.snd]

name: ovOfGapL
proof:
:=
  ground.swap_congr (ovOfGap (u := u.swap) (v := v.swap) hu hv)

name: ofPos_gap
statement:
private theorem ofPos_gap (a : Pos) :
    (BPair.ofPos a).snd + a = (BPair.ofPos a).fst
proof:
:=
  ground.add_comm Pos.one a

name: ofPos_swap_gap
statement:
private theorem ofPos_swap_gap (a : Pos) :
    (BPair.ofPos a).swap.fst + a = (BPair.ofPos a).swap.snd
proof:
:=
  ground.add_comm Pos.one a

name: gapMulGG
proof:
:= by
  show P.fst * X.snd + P.snd * X.fst + p * x
    = P.fst * X.fst + P.snd * X.snd
  exact ground.crossGap hp hx

name: gapMulGL
proof:
:= by
  show P.fst * X.fst + P.snd * X.snd + p * x
    = P.fst * X.snd + P.snd * X.fst
  exact ground.crossGap hp hx

name: gapMulLG
proof:
:= by
  show P.fst * X.fst + P.snd * X.snd + p * x
    = P.fst * X.snd + P.snd * X.fst
  rw [ground.add_comm (P.fst * X.fst) (P.snd * X.snd),
    ground.add_comm (P.fst * X.snd) (P.snd * X.fst)]
  exact ground.crossGap hp hx

name: gapMulLL
proof:
:= by
  show P.fst * X.snd + P.snd * X.fst + p * x
    = P.fst * X.fst + P.snd * X.snd
  rw [ground.add_comm (P.fst * X.snd) (P.snd * X.fst),
    ground.add_comm (P.fst * X.fst) (P.snd * X.snd)]
  exact ground.crossGap hp hx

name: side_gt
statement:
private theorem side_gt {z : BPair} {g : Pos}
    (hg : z.snd + g = z.fst) : z.side = Trich.gt g hg
proof:
:= by
  cases z.side with
  | eq he => exact (gapEqClash hg he).elim
  | lt g' hg' => exact (gapClash hg hg').elim
  | gt g' hg' =>
    have hgg : g' = g := ground.gap_unique hg' hg
    subst hgg
    rfl

name: side_lt
statement:
private theorem side_lt {z : BPair} {g : Pos}
    (hg : z.fst + g = z.snd) : z.side = Trich.lt g hg
proof:
:= by
  cases z.side with
  | eq he => exact (gapEqClashL hg he).elim
  | lt g' hg' =>
    have hgg : g' = g := ground.gap_unique hg' hg
    subst hgg
    rfl
  | gt g' hg' => exact (gapClash hg' hg).elim

name: cofactorMag_exact
statement:
private theorem cofactorMag_exact {e p x : Pos} (h : p * x = e) :
    cofactorMag e p = some x
proof:
:=
  ground.divQuot_eq e p x (Or.inl h)
    ⟨p, by
      show e + p = p * ground.succ x
      have hs : p * ground.succ x = p * x + p := by
        show p * (x + Pos.one) = p * x + p
        rw [ground.left_distrib, ground.mul_one]
      rw [hs, h]⟩

name: cofactorAt_gg
proof:
:= by
  have hm : cofactorMag e p = some x := cofactorMag_exact hpx
  unfold cofactorAt
  rw [side_gt hEg, side_gt hPg]
  show (match cofactorMag e p with
      | some c => BPair.ofPos c
      | none => BPair.unit) = BPair.ofPos x
  rw [hm]

name: cofactorAt_gl
statement:
private theorem cofactorAt_gl {E P : BPair} {e p x : Pos}
    (hEg : E.snd + e = E.fst) (hPg : P.fst + p = P.snd)
    (hpx : p * x = e) :
    cofactorAt E P = (BPair.ofPos x).swap
proof:
:= by
  have hm : cofactorMag e p = some x := cofactorMag_exact hpx
  unfold cofactorAt
  rw [side_gt hEg, side_lt hPg]
  show (match cofactorMag e p with
      | some c => (BPair.ofPos c).swap
      | none => BPair.unit) = (BPair.ofPos x).swap
  rw [hm]

name: cofactorAt_lg
statement:
private theorem cofactorAt_lg {E P : BPair} {e p x : Pos}
    (hEg : E.fst + e = E.snd) (hPg : P.snd + p = P.fst)
    (hpx : p * x = e) :
    cofactorAt E P = (BPair.ofPos x).swap
proof:
:= by
  have hm : cofactorMag e p = some x := cofactorMag_exact hpx
  unfold cofactorAt
  rw [side_lt hEg, side_gt hPg]
  show (match cofactorMag e p with
      | some c => (BPair.ofPos c).swap
      | none => BPair.unit) = (BPair.ofPos x).swap
  rw [hm]

name: cofactorAt_ll
proof:
:= by
  have hm : cofactorMag e p = some x := cofactorMag_exact hpx
  unfold cofactorAt
  rw [side_lt hEg, side_lt hPg]
  show (match cofactorMag e p with
      | some c => BPair.ofPos c
      | none => BPair.unit) = BPair.ofPos x
  rw [hm]

name: eqMem_of_mul
statement:
private theorem eqMem_of_mul {P X E : BPair} (hxe : X.fst = X.snd)
    (hE : (BPair.mul P X).oneValue E) : E.fst = E.snd
proof:
:=
  BPair.eqMem_of_oneValue
    (BPair.oneValue_trans (BPair.oneValue_symm hE)
      (BPair.oneValue_trans
        (BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl P)
          (BPair.oneValue_of_eqMem hxe))
        (BPair.mul_unit P)))

name: cofactorAt_sound
statement:
private theorem cofactorAt_sound {P X E : BPair}
    (hP : ¬ P.oneValue BPair.unit)
    (hE : (BPair.mul P X).oneValue E) :
    (BPair.mul P (cofactorAt E P)).oneValue E
proof:
:= by
  cases P.side with
  | eq hpe => exact absurd (BPair.oneValue_of_eqMem hpe) hP
  | gt p hp =>
    cases E.side with
    | eq hee =>
      rw [cofactorAt_eqMem E P hee]
      exact BPair.oneValue_trans (BPair.mul_unit P)
        (BPair.oneValue_symm (BPair.oneValue_of_eqMem hee))
    | gt e he =>
      cases X.side with
      | eq hxe => exact (gapEqClash he (eqMem_of_mul hxe hE)).elim
      | gt x hx =>
        have hpx : p * x = e :=
          ground.gap_unique (ground.gapCongr hE (gapMulGG hp hx)) he
        rw [cofactorAt_gg he hp hpx]
        exact BPair.oneValue_trans
          (BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl P)
            (ovOfGap (ofPos_gap x) hx)) hE
      | lt x hx =>
        exact (gapClash he (ground.gapCongrL hE (gapMulGL hp hx))).elim
    | lt e he =>
      cases X.side with
      | eq hxe => exact (gapEqClashL he (eqMem_of_mul hxe hE)).elim
      | gt x hx =>
        exact (gapClash (ground.gapCongr hE (gapMulGG hp hx)) he).elim
      | lt x hx =>
        have hpx : p * x = e :=
          ground.gap_unique (ground.gapCongrL hE (gapMulGL hp hx)) he
        rw [cofactorAt_lg he hp hpx]
        exact BPair.oneValue_trans
          (BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl P)
            (ovOfGapL (ofPos_swap_gap x) hx)) hE
  | lt p hp =>
    cases E.side with
    | eq hee =>
      rw [cofactorAt_eqMem E P hee]
      exact BPair.oneValue_trans (BPair.mul_unit P)
        (BPair.oneValue_symm (BPair.oneValue_of_eqMem hee))
    | gt e he =>
      cases X.side with
      | eq hxe => exact (gapEqClash he (eqMem_of_mul hxe hE)).elim
      | lt x hx =>
        have hpx : p * x = e :=
          ground.gap_unique (ground.gapCongr hE (gapMulLL hp hx)) he
        rw [cofactorAt_gl he hp hpx]
        exact BPair.oneValue_trans
          (BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl P)
            (ovOfGapL (ofPos_swap_gap x) hx)) hE
      | gt x hx =>
        exact (gapClash he (ground.gapCongrL hE (gapMulLG hp hx))).elim
    | lt e he =>
      cases X.side with
      | eq hxe => exact (gapEqClashL he (eqMem_of_mul hxe hE)).elim
      | lt x hx =>
        exact (gapClash (ground.gapCongr hE (gapMulLL hp hx)) he).elim
      | gt x hx =>
        have hpx : p * x = e :=
          ground.gap_unique (ground.gapCongrL hE (gapMulLG hp hx)) he
        rw [cofactorAt_ll he hp hpx]
        exact BPair.oneValue_trans
          (BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl P)
            (ovOfGap (ofPos_gap x) hx)) hE

name: borderKeys
proof:
:= by
  rw [ground.getAt_append 0 (List.range K) [x] a, ground.length_range]
  by_cases h : a < K
  · rw [if_pos h, if_pos h, ground.getAt_range K a h]
  · rw [if_neg h, if_neg h,
      show a - K = 0 from by
        rw [show a = K from
          Nat.le_antisymm (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ ha)
            (Nat.le_of_not_lt h),
          Nat.sub_self]]
    rfl

name: borderKeys_len
statement:
private theorem borderKeys_len (K x : Nat) :
    (List.range K ++ [x]).length = K + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [ground.length_append, ground.length_range]
  rfl

name: keepColsO_len
proof:
:= by
  show ((ks.map (fun j => ground.getAt ops.unit r j))).length
    = ks.length
  rw [ground.length_map]

name: keepColsO_entry
statement:
private theorem keepColsO_entry {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ)
    (ks : List Nat) (r : List γ) (b : Nat) (hb : b < ks.length) :
    ground.getAt ops.unit (keepColsO ops ks r) b
      = ground.getAt ops.unit r (ground.getAt 0 ks b)
proof:
:= by
  show ground.getAt ops.unit
    (ks.map (fun j => ground.getAt ops.unit r j)) b = _
  rw [ground.getAt_map 0 ops.unit _ ks b hb]

name: borderAtO_len
proof:
:= by
  show (((List.range k) ++ [i]).map (fun a =>
    keepColsO ops ((List.range k) ++ [j])
      (ground.getAt [] m a))).length = k + 1
  rw [ground.length_map, borderKeys_len]

name: borderAtO_rows
proof:
:=
  rowsLen_map _ (k + 1) (List.range k ++ [i])
    (fun x _ => (fun _ => by
      rw [keepColsO_len, borderKeys_len]) x)

name: borderAtO_row
statement:
private theorem borderAtO_row {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ)
    (k i j : Nat) (m : List (List γ)) (a : Nat) (ha : a < k + 1) :
    ground.getAt [] (borderAtO ops k i j m) a
      = keepColsO ops ((List.range k) ++ [j])
        (ground.getAt [] m (if a < k then a else i))
proof:
:= by
  show ground.getAt [] (((List.range k) ++ [i]).map (fun a =>
    keepColsO ops ((List.range k) ++ [j])
      (ground.getAt [] m a))) a = _
  rw [ground.getAt_map 0 [] _ (List.range k ++ [i]) a
      (by rw [borderKeys_len]; exact ha),
    borderKeys k i a ha]

name: borderAtO_entry
statement:
private theorem borderAtO_entry {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ)
    (k i j : Nat) (m : List (List γ)) (a b : Nat)
    (ha : a < k + 1) (hb : b < k + 1) :
    ground.getAt ops.unit
        (ground.getAt [] (borderAtO ops k i j m) a) b
      = ground.getAt ops.unit
        (ground.getAt [] m (if a < k then a else i))
        (if b < k then b else j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [borderAtO_row ops k i j m a ha,
    keepColsO_entry ops _ _ b (by rw [borderKeys_len]; exact hb),
    borderKeys k j b hb]

name: leadAtO_len
statement:
private theorem leadAtO_len {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ) (k : Nat)
    (m : List (List γ)) : (leadAtO ops k m).length = k
proof:
:=
  ground.matOf_length k k _

name: leadAtO_entry
statement:
private theorem leadAtO_entry {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ) (k : Nat)
    (m : List (List γ)) (a b : Nat) (ha : a < k) (hb : b < k) :
    ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] (leadAtO ops k m) a) b
      = ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] m a) b
proof:
:=
  ground.matOf_entry [] ops.unit k k _ a b ha hb

name: keepCols_len
statement:
private theorem keepCols_len (ks : List Nat) (r : List BPair) :
    (keepCols ks r).length = ks.length
proof:
:=
  keepColsO_len bpairOps ks r

name: keepCols_entry
statement:
private theorem keepCols_entry (ks : List Nat) (r : List BPair)
    (b : Nat) (hb : b < ks.length) :
    ground.getAt BPair.unit (keepCols ks r) b
      = ground.getAt BPair.unit r (ground.getAt 0 ks b)
proof:
:=
  keepColsO_entry bpairOps ks r b hb

name: borderAt_len
statement:
private theorem borderAt_len (k i j : Nat) (m : Mat) :
    (borderAt k i j m).length = k + 1
proof:
:=
  borderAtO_len bpairOps k i j m

name: borderAt_rows
statement:
private theorem borderAt_rows (k i j : Nat) (m : Mat) :
    rowsLen (k + 1) (borderAt k i j m)
proof:
:=
  borderAtO_rows bpairOps k i j m

name: borderAt_row
statement:
private theorem borderAt_row (k i j : Nat) (m : Mat) (a : Nat)
    (ha : a < k + 1) :
    ground.getAt [] (borderAt k i j m) a
      = keepCols ((List.range k) ++ [j])
        (ground.getAt [] m (if a < k then a else i))
proof:
:=
  borderAtO_row bpairOps k i j m a ha

name: borderAt_entry
statement:
private theorem borderAt_entry (k i j : Nat) (m : Mat) (a b : Nat)
    (ha : a < k + 1) (hb : b < k + 1) :
    ground.getAt BPair.unit
        (ground.getAt [] (borderAt k i j m) a) b
      = ground.getAt BPair.unit
        (ground.getAt [] m (if a < k then a else i))
        (if b < k then b else j)
proof:
:=
  borderAtO_entry bpairOps k i j m a b ha hb

name: leadAt_len
statement:
private theorem leadAt_len (k : Nat) (m : Mat) :
    (leadAt k m).length = k
proof:
:=
  leadAtO_len bpairOps k m

name: getAt_eraseIdx
statement:
private theorem getAt_eraseIdx {α : Type} (d : α) :
    ∀ (l : List α) (j c : Nat),
      ground.getAt d (l.eraseIdx j) c
        = if c < j then ground.getAt d l c
          else ground.getAt d l (c + 1)
  | [], j, c => by
    show ground.getAt d ([] : List α) c
      = if c < j then ground.getAt d ([] : List α) c
        else ground.getAt d ([] : List α) (c + 1)
    by_cases h : c < j
    · rw [if_pos h]
    · rw [if_neg h]
      rfl
  | a :: t, 0, c => by
    show ground.getAt d t c
      = if c < 0 then ground.getAt d (a :: t) c
        else ground.getAt d (a :: t) (c + 1)
    rw [if_neg (Nat.not_lt_zero c)]
    rfl
  | a :: t, j + 1, 0 => by
    show a = if 0 < j + 1 then a else ground.getAt d t 0
    rw [if_pos (Nat.succ_pos j)]
  | a :: t, j + 1, c + 1 => by
    show ground.getAt d (t.eraseIdx j) c
      = if c + 1 < j + 1 then ground.getAt d t c
        else ground.getAt d t (c + 1)
    rw [getAt_eraseIdx d t j c]
    by_cases h : c < j
    · rw [if_pos h, if_pos (Nat.succ_lt_succ h)]
    · rw [if_neg h, if_neg (fun hs => h (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hs))]

/
product's unit and the further keys at the sum's, the pairing the
further factor's own entry there. -/
private theorem dotO_unitRead {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel) :
    ∀ (v w : List γ) (c : Nat), v.length = w.length →
      R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit v c) ops.one →
      (∀ b, ¬ b = c → R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit v b) ops.unit) →
      R.rel (dotO ops v w) (ground.getAt ops.unit w c)
  | [], [], _, _, _, _ => L.ovRefl _
  | [], _ :: _, _, hl, _, _ => nomatch hl
  | _ :: _, [], _, hl, _, _ => nomatch hl
  | a :: v, b :: w, 0, _, hc, hr => by
    show R.rel (ops.add (ops.mul a b) (dotO ops v w)) b
    refine L.ovTrans (L.addCongr
      (L.ovTrans (L.mulCongr hc (L.ovRefl b)) (L.oneMul b))
      (dotO_null_left L v w
        (fun t => hr (t + 1) (fun he => Nat.noConfusion he)))) ?_
    exact L.addUnit b
  | a :: v, b :: w, c + 1, hl, hc, hr => by
    show R.rel (ops.add (ops.mul a b) (dotO ops v w))
      (ground.getAt ops.unit w c)
    refine L.ovTrans (L.addCongr
      (L.ovTrans (L.mulCongr (hr 0 (fun he => Nat.noConfusion he))
        (L.ovRefl b)) (mulUnitLeftO L b))
      (dotO_unitRead L v w c (Nat.succ.inj hl) hc
        (fun t ht => hr (t + 1)
          (fun he => ht (Nat.succ.inj he))))) ?_
    exact L.unitAdd _

/
private theorem sgnPO_even {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ) (e : Nat)
    (x : γ) : sgnPO ops (e + e) x = x
proof:
:= by
  show (if places.parityOf (e + e) then ops.swap x else x) = x
  rw [show places.parityOf (e + e) = false from by
    rw [places.parityOf_add e e]
    cases places.parityOf e with
    | true => rfl
    | false => rfl]
  exact if_neg (fun hb => Bool.noConfusion hb)

name: dotO_unitRead
statement:
private theorem dotO_unitRead {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel) :
    ∀ (v w : List γ) (c : Nat), v.length = w.length →
      R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit v c) ops.one →
      (∀ b, ¬ b = c → R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit v b) ops.unit) →
      R.rel (dotO ops v w) (ground.getAt ops.unit w c)
  | [], [], _, _, _, _ => L.ovRefl _
  | [], _ :: _, _, hl, _, _ => nomatch hl
  | _ :: _, [], _, hl, _, _ => nomatch hl
  | a :: v, b :: w, 0, _, hc, hr => by
    show R.rel (ops.add (ops.mul a b) (dotO ops v w)) b
    refine L.ovTrans (L.addCongr
      (L.ovTrans (L.mulCongr hc (L.ovRefl b)) (L.oneMul b))
      (dotO_null_left L v w
        (fun t => hr (t + 1) (fun he => Nat.noConfusion he)))) ?_
    exact L.addUnit b
  | a :: v, b :: w, c + 1, hl, hc, hr => by
    show R.rel (ops.add (ops.mul a b) (dotO ops v w))
      (ground.getAt ops.unit w c)
    refine L.ovTrans (L.addCongr
      (L.ovTrans (L.mulCongr (hr 0 (fun he => Nat.noConfusion he))
        (L.ovRefl b)) (mulUnitLeftO L b))
      (dotO_unitRead L v w c (Nat.succ.inj hl) hc
        (fun t ht => hr (t + 1)
          (fun he => ht (Nat.succ.inj he))))) ?_
    exact L.unitAdd _

/
private theorem sgnPO_even {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ) (e : Nat)
    (x : γ) : sgnPO ops (e + e) x = x
proof:
:= by
  show (if places.parityOf (e + e) then ops.swap x else x) = x
  rw [show places.parityOf (e + e) = false from by
    rw [places.parityOf_add e e]
    cases places.parityOf e with
    | true => rfl
    | false => rfl]
  exact if_neg (fun hb => Bool.noConfusion hb)

name: sgnPO_even
statement:
private theorem sgnPO_even {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ) (e : Nat)
    (x : γ) : sgnPO ops (e + e) x = x
proof:
:= by
  show (if places.parityOf (e + e) then ops.swap x else x) = x
  rw [show places.parityOf (e + e) = false from by
    rw [places.parityOf_add e e]
    cases places.parityOf e with
    | true => rfl
    | false => rfl]
  exact if_neg (fun hb => Bool.noConfusion hb)

name: detO_congr_letters
statement:
private theorem detO_congr_letters {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (C : DCore γ ops R.rel)
    (M N : List (List γ)) (hl : M.length = N.length)
    (h : ∀ a, a < M.length → ∀ b, b < M.length →
      R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] M a) b)
        (ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] N a) b)) :
    R.rel (detO ops M) (detO ops N)
proof:
:= by
  show R.rel (ground.famFold ops.add ops.unit
      (fun p => sgnO ops p (termO ops M p))
      (places.monomialsAt (List.replicate M.length 1)))
    (ground.famFold ops.add ops.unit
      (fun p => sgnO ops p (termO ops N p))
      (places.monomialsAt (List.replicate N.length 1)))
  rw [← hl]
  refine foldO_congr_members C _ _ _ (fun p hp => ?_)
  exact sgnO_congr C p
    (termO_congr_letters C M.length M N p hl h
      (fun x hx => (places.perm_member_reads hp).2.2.1 x hx))

name: detO_List.set_dot
statement:
private theorem detO_List.set_dot {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
    (m : List (List γ)) (k : Nat) (hk : k < m.length) (b : List γ)
    (hb : b.length = m.length) :
    R.rel (detO ops (List.set m k b)) (dotO ops b (cofVecO ops m k))
proof:
:= by
  refine L.ovTrans (detO_replace L m k hk b) ?_
  rw [show ((m.eraseIdx k).length + 1) = m.length from
    length_eraseIdx m k hk]
  refine L.ovTrans (foldO_congr_members L.toDCore _
    (fun j => ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit b j)
      (sgnPO ops (k + j) (cof0O ops (m.eraseIdx k) j)))
    (List.range m.length)
    (fun j _ => sgnPO_mul L.toDCore (k + j) _ _)) ?_
  show R.rel _ (dotO ops b ((List.range m.length).map
    (fun j => sgnPO ops (k + j) (cof0O ops (m.eraseIdx k) j))))
  rw [dotO_map_range ops
    (fun j => sgnPO ops (k + j) (cof0O ops (m.eraseIdx k) j))
    m.length b hb]
  exact L.ovRefl _

name: cof0O_last
statement:
private theorem cof0O_last {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (C : DCore γ ops R.rel)
    (rest : List (List γ)) :
    R.rel (cof0O ops rest rest.length)
      (detO ops (rest.map (fun r => r.eraseIdx rest.length)))
proof:
:= by
  show R.rel (ground.famFold ops.add ops.unit
      (fun t => sgnO ops t (termO ops rest t))
      (places.monomialsAt (subContent rest.length rest.length)))
    (ground.famFold ops.add ops.unit
      (fun t => sgnO ops t (termO ops
        (rest.map (fun r => r.eraseIdx rest.length)) t))
      (places.monomialsAt (List.replicate
        (rest.map (fun r => r.eraseIdx rest.length)).length 1)))
  rw [ground.length_map,
    show subContent rest.length rest.length
        = List.replicate rest.length 1 ++ [0] from by
      show List.replicate rest.length 1
          ++ 0 :: List.replicate (rest.length - rest.length) 1
        = List.replicate rest.length 1 ++ [0]
      rw [Nat.sub_self]
      rfl,
    places.monomialsAt_zero_tail (List.replicate rest.length 1)]
  refine foldO_congr_members C _ _ _ (fun t ht => ?_)
  refine sgnO_congr C t ?_
  refine termO_congr_letters C rest.length rest _ t
    (by rw [ground.length_map]) (fun a ha b hb => ?_)
    (fun x hx => (places.perm_member_reads ht).2.2.1 x hx)
  rw [ground.getAt_map ([] : List γ) ([] : List γ)
      (fun r => r.eraseIdx rest.length) rest a ha,
    getAt_eraseIdx ops.unit (ground.getAt [] rest a) rest.length b,
    if_pos hb]
  exact C.ovRefl _

name: liftIx_ne
statement: private theorem liftIx_ne (j y : Nat) : ¬ liftIx j y = j
proof:
:= by
  show ¬ (if y < j then y else y + 1) = j
  by_cases hy : y < j
  · rw [if_pos hy]
    exact fun he => Nat.lt_irrefl j (he ▸ hy)
  · rw [if_neg hy]
    exact fun he => hy (he ▸ Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.le_refl y))

name: liftIx_gt
statement:
private theorem liftIx_gt (j y : Nat) (hy : ¬ y < j) :
    liftIx j y = y + 1
proof:
:= by
  show (if y < j then y else y + 1) = y + 1
  rw [if_neg hy]

name: dropIx_liftIx
statement:
private theorem dropIx_liftIx (j y : Nat) :
    dropIx j (liftIx j y) = y
proof:
:= by
  show dropIx j (if y < j then y else y + 1) = y
  by_cases hy : y < j
  · rw [if_pos hy]
    show (if y < j then y else y - 1) = y
    rw [if_pos hy]
  · rw [if_neg hy]
    show (if y + 1 < j then y + 1 else y + 1 - 1) = y
    rw [if_neg (fun h => hy
      (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_succ y) h))]
    rfl

name: gt_of_ne_nlt
statement:
private theorem gt_of_ne_nlt {x j : Nat} (hx : ¬ x = j)
    (hlt : ¬ x < j) : j < x
proof:
:=
  match Nat.lt_or_ge j x with
  | .inl h => h
  | .inr h => absurd (Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne h (fun he => hx he)) hlt

name: dropIx_gt
statement:
private theorem dropIx_gt {j x : Nat} (hj : j < x) {g : Nat}
    (hg : j + 1 + g = x) : dropIx j x = j + g
proof:
:= by
  show (if x < j then x else x - 1) = j + g
  rw [if_neg (fun h => Nat.lt_irrefl j (Nat.lt_trans hj h)),
    ← hg, Nat.succ_add j g]
  rfl

name: liftIx_dropIx
statement:
private theorem liftIx_dropIx (j x : Nat) (hx : ¬ x = j) :
    liftIx j (dropIx j x) = x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hlt : x < j
  · show liftIx j (if x < j then x else x - 1) = x
    rw [if_pos hlt]
    show (if x < j then x else x + 1) = x
    rw [if_pos hlt]
  · have hj : j < x := gt_of_ne_nlt hx hlt
    match Nat.le.dest hj with
    | ⟨g, hg⟩ =>
      rw [dropIx_gt hj hg]
      show (if j + g < j then j + g else j + g + 1) = x
      rw [if_neg (fun h => Nat.lt_irrefl j
          (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_add_right j g) h)),
        ← hg, Nat.succ_add j g]

name: dropIx_lt_up
statement:
private theorem dropIx_lt_up (j a b : Nat) (ha : ¬ a = j)
    (hb : ¬ b = j) (hab : a < b) : dropIx j a < dropIx j b
proof:
:= by
  by_cases haj : a < j
  · show (if a < j then a else a - 1) < dropIx j b
    rw [if_pos haj]
    by_cases hbj : b < j
    · show a < (if b < j then b else b - 1)
      rw [if_pos hbj]
      exact hab
    · have hjb : j < b := gt_of_ne_nlt hb hbj
      match Nat.le.dest hjb with
      | ⟨g, hg⟩ =>
        rw [dropIx_gt hjb hg]
        exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le haj (Nat.le_add_right j g)
  · have hja : j < a := gt_of_ne_nlt ha haj
    have hjb : j < b := Nat.lt_trans hja hab
    match Nat.le.dest hja, Nat.le.dest hjb with
    | ⟨g, hg⟩, ⟨g2, hg2⟩ =>
      rw [dropIx_gt hja hg, dropIx_gt hjb hg2]
      have hlt : j + 1 + g < j + 1 + g2 := by
        rw [hg, hg2]
        exact hab
      have h2 : g < g2 := Nat.lt_of_add_lt_add_left hlt
      exact Nat.add_lt_add_left h2 j

name: dropIx_lt_down
statement:
private theorem dropIx_lt_down (j a b : Nat) (ha : ¬ a = j)
    (hb : ¬ b = j) (hf : dropIx j a < dropIx j b) : a < b
proof:
:=
  match Nat.lt_or_ge a b with
  | .inl h => h
  | .inr h =>
    match Nat.lt_or_ge b a with
    | .inl h2 => absurd (dropIx_lt_up j b a hb ha h2)
        (fun hc => Nat.lt_irrefl _ (Nat.lt_trans hc hf))
    | .inr h2 =>
      absurd (Nat.le_antisymm h2 h ▸ hf) (Nat.lt_irrefl _)

name: subContent_at_j
statement:
private theorem subContent_at_j (j g : Nat) :
    ground.getAt 0 (subContent j (j + g)) j = 0
proof:
:= by
  show ground.getAt 0 (List.replicate j 1
    ++ 0 :: List.replicate (j + g - j) 1) j = 0
  rw [ground.getAt_append 0 _ _ j,
    if_neg (by
      rw [ground.length_replicate]
      exact Nat.lt_irrefl j),
    ground.length_replicate, Nat.sub_self]
  rfl

name: subContent_at_ne
proof:
:= by
  show ground.getAt 0 (List.replicate j 1
    ++ 0 :: List.replicate (j + g - j) 1) z = 1
  rw [ground.getAt_append 0 _ _ z, ground.length_replicate,
    ground.addSubSelfL j g]
  by_cases hlt : z < j
  · rw [if_pos hlt]
    exact ground.getAt_replicate 0 1 j z hlt
  · rw [if_neg hlt]
    have hjz : j < z := gt_of_ne_nlt hz hlt
    match Nat.le.dest hjz with
    | ⟨c, hc⟩ =>
      have hzj : z - j = c + 1 := by
        rw [← hc, Nat.succ_add j c, ← Nat.add_succ j c,
          ground.addSubSelfL j (c + 1)]
      rw [hzj]
      show ground.getAt 0 (List.replicate g 1) c = 1
      refine ground.getAt_replicate 0 1 g c ?_
      have h1 : j + 1 + c < j + 1 + g := by
        rw [hc, Nat.add_right_comm j 1 g]
        exact hzn
      exact Nat.lt_of_add_lt_add_left h1

name: liftIx_succ
statement:
private theorem liftIx_succ (i c : Nat) :
    liftIx (i + 1) (c + 1) = liftIx i c + 1
proof:
:= by
  show (if c + 1 < i + 1 then c + 1 else c + 1 + 1)
    = (if c < i then c else c + 1) + 1
  by_cases h : c < i
  · rw [if_pos h, if_pos (Nat.succ_lt_succ h)]
  · rw [if_neg h, if_neg (fun hc => h (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hc))]

name: getAt_eraseIdx_lift
statement:
private theorem getAt_eraseIdx_lift {α : Type} (d : α)
    (l : List α) (j c : Nat) :
    ground.getAt d (l.eraseIdx j) c
      = ground.getAt d l (liftIx j c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [getAt_eraseIdx d l j c]
  show _ = ground.getAt d l (if c < j then c else c + 1)
  by_cases hc : c < j
  · rw [if_pos hc, if_pos hc]
  · rw [if_neg hc, if_neg hc]

name: liftIx_lt
statement:
private theorem liftIx_lt {j c n : Nat} (h : c < n) :
    liftIx j c < n + 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hc : c < j
  · rw [show liftIx j c = c from if_pos hc]
    exact Nat.lt_trans h (Nat.lt_succ_self n)
  · rw [liftIx_gt j c hc]
    exact Nat.succ_lt_succ h

name: mapDropLift
statement:
private theorem mapDropLift (j : Nat) :
    ∀ x : List Nat, (x.map (liftIx j)).map (dropIx j) = x
  | [] => rfl
  | a :: x => by
    show dropIx j (liftIx j a) :: (x.map (liftIx j)).map (dropIx j)
      = a :: x
    rw [dropIx_liftIx, mapDropLift j x]

/
back. -/
private theorem mapLiftDrop (j : Nat) :
    ∀ x : List Nat, (∀ a, 0 < ground.countOf a x → ¬ a = j) →
      (x.map (dropIx j)).map (liftIx j) = x
  | [], _ => rfl
  | a :: x, h => by
    show liftIx j (dropIx j a) :: (x.map (dropIx j)).map (liftIx j)
      = a :: x
    rw [liftIx_dropIx j a (h a (by
        rw [ground.countOf_head]; exact Nat.succ_pos _)),
      mapLiftDrop j x (fun c hc => h c
        (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hc (Nat.le_add_left _ _)))]

/
private theorem sumNat_subContent (j g : Nat) :
    ground.sumNat (subContent j (j + g)) = j + g
proof:
:= by
  show ground.sumNat (List.replicate j 1
    ++ 0 :: List.replicate (j + g - j) 1) = j + g
  exact ground.sumNat_replicate_strike j (j + g) (Nat.le_add_right j g)

name: mapLiftDrop
statement:
private theorem mapLiftDrop (j : Nat) :
    ∀ x : List Nat, (∀ a, 0 < ground.countOf a x → ¬ a = j) →
      (x.map (dropIx j)).map (liftIx j) = x
  | [], _ => rfl
  | a :: x, h => by
    show liftIx j (dropIx j a) :: (x.map (dropIx j)).map (liftIx j)
      = a :: x
    rw [liftIx_dropIx j a (h a (by
        rw [ground.countOf_head]; exact Nat.succ_pos _)),
      mapLiftDrop j x (fun c hc => h c
        (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hc (Nat.le_add_left _ _)))]

/
private theorem sumNat_subContent (j g : Nat) :
    ground.sumNat (subContent j (j + g)) = j + g
proof:
:= by
  show ground.sumNat (List.replicate j 1
    ++ 0 :: List.replicate (j + g - j) 1) = j + g
  exact ground.sumNat_replicate_strike j (j + g) (Nat.le_add_right j g)

name: sumNat_subContent
statement:
private theorem sumNat_subContent (j g : Nat) :
    ground.sumNat (subContent j (j + g)) = j + g
proof:
:= by
  show ground.sumNat (List.replicate j 1
    ++ 0 :: List.replicate (j + g - j) 1) = j + g
  exact ground.sumNat_replicate_strike j (j + g) (Nat.le_add_right j g)

name: parity_mapDrop
proof:
:= by
  show places.parityOf (places.inversions (t.map (dropIx j))) = _
  rw [places.inversions_map (dropIx j) t (fun a ha b hb =>
    ⟨fun hab => dropIx_lt_up j a b (h a ha) (h b hb) hab,
     fun hf => dropIx_lt_down j a b (h a ha) (h b hb) hf⟩)]
  rfl

name: termO_strike
statement:
private theorem termO_strike {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (C : DCore γ ops R.rel) (j : Nat) :
    ∀ (M : List (List γ)) (t : List Nat),
      (∀ x, 0 < ground.countOf x t → ¬ x = j) →
      R.rel (termO ops (M.map (fun r => r.eraseIdx j))
          (t.map (dropIx j)))
        (termO ops M t)
  | [], [], _ => C.ovRefl _
  | [], _ :: _, _ => C.ovRefl _
  | _ :: _, [], _ => C.ovRefl _
  | r :: M, x :: t, h => by
    show R.rel (ops.mul
        (ground.getAt ops.unit (r.eraseIdx j) (dropIx j x))
        (termO ops (M.map (fun r => r.eraseIdx j))
          (t.map (dropIx j))))
      (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit r x) (termO ops M t))
    have hx : ¬ x = j
proof:
:= h x (by
      rw [ground.countOf_head]; exact Nat.succ_pos _)
    have hentry : ground.getAt ops.unit (r.eraseIdx j) (dropIx j x)
        = ground.getAt ops.unit r x := by
      rw [getAt_eraseIdx ops.unit r j (dropIx j x)]
      by_cases hlt : x < j
      · rw [show dropIx j x = x from if_pos hlt, if_pos hlt]
      · have hj : j < x := gt_of_ne_nlt hx hlt
        match Nat.le.dest hj with
        | ⟨g, hg⟩ =>
          rw [dropIx_gt hj hg,
            if_neg (fun hc => Nat.lt_irrefl j
              (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_add_right j g) hc)),
            ← hg, Nat.succ_add j g]
    rw [hentry]
    exact C.mulCongr (C.ovRefl _)
      (termO_strike C j M t (fun c hc => h c
        (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hc (Nat.le_add_left _ _))))

name: strikeMem_ne
statement:
private theorem strikeMem_ne (j g : Nat) {t : List Nat}
    (ht : 0 < ground.countOf t
      (places.monomialsAt (subContent j (j + g)))) :
    ∀ a, 0 < ground.countOf a t → ¬ a = j
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha he
  have h0 := places.letter_zero (subContent j (j + g)) j
    (subContent_at_j j g) t ht
  rw [he] at ha
  rw [h0] at ha
  exact absurd ha (Nat.lt_irrefl 0)

name: liftMem
statement:
private theorem liftMem (j g : Nat) {x : List Nat}
    (hx : x.length = ground.sumNat (List.replicate (j + g) 1)
      ∧ places.content (j + g) x = List.replicate (j + g) 1) :
    (x.map (liftIx j)).length
        = ground.sumNat (subContent j (j + g))
      ∧ places.content (subContent j (j + g)).length
          (x.map (liftIx j)) = subContent j (j + g)
proof:
:= by
  have hn : ground.sumNat (List.replicate (j + g) 1) = j + g :=
    ground.sumNat_replicate_one (j + g)
  have hlen : (subContent j (j + g)).length = j + g + 1 := by
    show (List.replicate j 1
      ++ 0 :: List.replicate (j + g - j) 1).length = j + g + 1
    rw [ground.length_append, ground.length_replicate,
      ground.addSubSelfL j g]
    show j + ((List.replicate g 1).length + 1) = j + g + 1
    rw [ground.length_replicate]
    exact (Nat.add_assoc j g 1).symm
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [ground.length_map, hx.1, hn, sumNat_subContent j g]
  · rw [hlen]
    refine ground.getAt_ext 0 _ _ ?_ ?_
    · rw [places.content_length]
      show j + g + 1 = (List.replicate j 1
        ++ 0 :: List.replicate (j + g - j) 1).length
      rw [ground.length_append, ground.length_replicate,
        ground.addSubSelfL j g]
      show j + g + 1 = j + ((List.replicate g 1).length + 1)
      rw [ground.length_replicate]
      exact Nat.add_assoc j g 1
    · intro z hz
      rw [places.content_length] at hz
      rw [places.getAt_contentAt (j + g + 1) (x.map (liftIx j)) z hz]
      by_cases hzj : z = j
      · rw [hzj, ground.countOf_map_none (liftIx j) j x
          (fun c _ => liftIx_ne j c), subContent_at_j j g]
      · have hdz : liftIx j (dropIx j z) = z := liftIx_dropIx j z hzj
        rw [← hdz, ground.countOf_map_inj (liftIx j) (dropIx j z) x
            (fun c _ he => by
              rw [← dropIx_liftIx j c, he, dropIx_liftIx]),
          hdz, subContent_at_ne j g z hzj hz]
        have hdlt : dropIx j z < j + g := by
          by_cases hlt : z < j
          · rw [show dropIx j z = z from if_pos hlt]
            exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hlt (Nat.le_add_right j g)
          · have hjz : j < z := gt_of_ne_nlt hzj hlt
            match Nat.le.dest hjz with
            | ⟨c, hc⟩ =>
              rw [dropIx_gt hjz hc]
              have h1 : j + 1 + c < j + g + 1 := by rw [hc]; exact hz
              rw [Nat.add_right_comm j 1 c] at h1
              exact Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ h1
        rw [← places.getAt_contentAt (j + g) x (dropIx j z) hdlt,
          hx.2, ground.getAt_replicate 0 1 (j + g) (dropIx j z)
            hdlt]

name: dropMem
statement:
private theorem dropMem (j g : Nat) {t : List Nat}
    (ht : 0 < ground.countOf t
      (places.monomialsAt (subContent j (j + g)))) :
    (t.map (dropIx j)).length
        = ground.sumNat (List.replicate (j + g) 1)
      ∧ places.content (j + g) (t.map (dropIx j))
          = List.replicate (j + g) 1
proof:
:= by
  have hne := strikeMem_ne j g ht
  match places.member_conditions ht with
  | ⟨hl, hc⟩ =>
    have hlen : (subContent j (j + g)).length = j + g + 1 := by
      show (List.replicate j 1
        ++ 0 :: List.replicate (j + g - j) 1).length = j + g + 1
      rw [ground.length_append, ground.length_replicate,
        ground.addSubSelfL j g]
      show j + ((List.replicate g 1).length + 1) = j + g + 1
      rw [ground.length_replicate]
      exact (Nat.add_assoc j g 1).symm
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [ground.length_map, hl, sumNat_subContent j g,
        ground.sumNat_replicate_one]
    · refine ground.getAt_ext 0 _ _ ?_ ?_
      · rw [places.content_length, ground.length_replicate]
      · intro y hy
        rw [places.content_length] at hy
        rw [places.getAt_contentAt (j + g) (t.map (dropIx j)) y hy,
          ground.getAt_replicate 0 1 (j + g) y hy]
        have hld : dropIx j (liftIx j y) = y := dropIx_liftIx j y
        rw [← hld, ground.countOf_map_inj (dropIx j) (liftIx j y) t
            (fun c hcm he => by
              rw [← liftIx_dropIx j c (hne c hcm), he,
                dropIx_liftIx])]
        have hlift_lt : liftIx j y < j + g + 1 := liftIx_lt hy
        rw [← places.getAt_contentAt (j + g + 1) t (liftIx j y)
            hlift_lt]
        rw [show places.content (j + g + 1) t
            = subContent j (j + g) from by
          rw [← hlen]; exact hc]
        exact subContent_at_ne j g (liftIx j y) (liftIx_ne j y)
          hlift_lt

name: countOf_mapDrop
statement:
private theorem countOf_mapDrop (j g : Nat) (x : List Nat) :
    ground.countOf x
        ((places.monomialsAt (subContent j (j + g))).map
          (List.map (dropIx j)))
      = ground.countOf x
          (places.monomialsAt (List.replicate (j + g) 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [places.countOf_monomialsAt (List.replicate (j + g) 1) x,
    ground.length_replicate]
  by_cases hxB : x.length
      = ground.sumNat (List.replicate (j + g) 1)
    ∧ places.content (j + g) x = List.replicate (j + g) 1
  · rw [if_pos hxB]
    have htA := liftMem j g hxB
    have hx : (x.map (liftIx j)).map (dropIx j) = x :=
      mapDropLift j x
    rw [← hx,
      ground.countOf_map_inj (List.map (dropIx j))
        (x.map (liftIx j))
        (places.monomialsAt (subContent j (j + g)))
        (fun t htm he => by
          have hnet := strikeMem_ne j g htm
          rw [← mapLiftDrop j t hnet, he, mapDropLift j x]),
      places.countOf_monomialsAt, if_pos htA]
  · rw [if_neg hxB]
    refine ground.countOf_map_none (List.map (dropIx j)) x
      (places.monomialsAt (subContent j (j + g)))
      (fun t htm he => hxB ?_)
    rw [← he]
    exact dropMem j g htm

name: cof0O_strike
statement:
private theorem cof0O_strike {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (C : DCore γ ops R.rel)
    (rest : List (List γ)) (j : Nat) (hj : j ≤ rest.length) :
    R.rel (cof0O ops rest j)
      (detO ops (rest.map (fun r => r.eraseIdx j)))
proof:
:= by
  match Nat.le.dest hj with
  | ⟨g, hg⟩ =>
    show R.rel (ground.famFold ops.add ops.unit
        (fun t => sgnO ops t (termO ops rest t))
        (places.monomialsAt (subContent j rest.length)))
      (ground.famFold ops.add ops.unit
        (fun t => sgnO ops t (termO ops
          (rest.map (fun r => r.eraseIdx j)) t))
        (places.monomialsAt (List.replicate
          (rest.map (fun r => r.eraseIdx j)).length 1)))
    rw [ground.length_map, ← hg]
    refine C.ovTrans (foldO_congr_members C _
      (fun t => sgnO ops (t.map (dropIx j)) (termO ops
        (rest.map (fun r => r.eraseIdx j)) (t.map (dropIx j))))
      (places.monomialsAt (subContent j (j + g)))
      (fun t htm => ?_)) ?_
    · have hnet := strikeMem_ne j g htm
      have h1 := termO_strike C j rest t hnet
      show R.rel (if places.parity t then
          ops.swap (termO ops rest t) else termO ops rest t)
        (if places.parity (t.map (dropIx j)) then
          ops.swap (termO ops (rest.map (fun r => r.eraseIdx j))
            (t.map (dropIx j)))
          else termO ops (rest.map (fun r => r.eraseIdx j))
            (t.map (dropIx j)))
      rw [parity_mapDrop j t hnet]
      cases places.parity t with
      | true => exact C.swapCongr (C.ovSymm h1)
      | false => exact C.ovSymm h1
    · rw [← ground.famFold_map ops.add ops.unit
        (fun t => sgnO ops t (termO ops
          (rest.map (fun r => r.eraseIdx j)) t))
        (List.map (dropIx j))
        (places.monomialsAt (subContent j (j + g)))]
      exact ground.famFold_relist_ov (commLawsOf C) ops.unit
        (fun t => sgnO ops t (termO ops
          (rest.map (fun r => r.eraseIdx j)) t))
        _ _ (fun x => countOf_mapDrop j g x)

name: detO_nil
proof:
:=
  L.addUnit ops.one

name: detO_single
proof:
:= by
  show R.rel (ops.add (ops.mul x ops.one) ops.unit) x
  exact L.ovTrans (L.addUnit _)
    (L.ovTrans (L.toDCore.mulComm x ops.one) (L.oneMul x))

name: minorRowO_read
statement:
private theorem minorRowO_read {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
    (nrm snrm : γ → γ) (hnrm : ∀ x, R.rel (nrm x) x)
    (hsnrm : ∀ x, R.rel (snrm x) x)
    (f : List (List γ) → γ) (rest : List (List γ))
    (hf : ∀ i, i ≤ rest.length →
      R.rel (f (rest.map (fun l => l.eraseIdx i)))
        (detO ops (rest.map (fun row => row.eraseIdx i)))) :
    ∀ (r' : List γ) (j : Nat),
      j + r'.length ≤ rest.length + 1 →
      R.rel (minorRowO ops nrm snrm f (places.parityOf j) j r' rest)
        (ground.famFold ops.add ops.unit
          (fun k => sgnPO ops (j + k)
            (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit r' k)
              (cof0O ops rest (j + k))))
          (List.range r'.length))
  | [], _, _ => L.ovRefl _
  | a :: r', j, hjb => by
    show R.rel (snrm (ops.add
        (if places.parityOf j
          then ops.swap (nrm (ops.mul a
            (f (rest.map (fun l => l.eraseIdx j)))))
          else nrm (ops.mul a
            (f (rest.map (fun l => l.eraseIdx j)))))
        (minorRowO ops nrm snrm f
          (!places.parityOf j) (j + 1) r' rest))) _
    have hLc : (a :: r').length = r'.length + 1
proof:
:= rfl
    rw [hLc, range_cons r'.length]
    show R.rel (snrm (ops.add
        (if places.parityOf j
          then ops.swap (nrm (ops.mul a
            (f (rest.map (fun l => l.eraseIdx j)))))
          else nrm (ops.mul a
            (f (rest.map (fun l => l.eraseIdx j)))))
        (minorRowO ops nrm snrm f
          (!places.parityOf j) (j + 1) r' rest)))
      (ops.add
        (sgnPO ops (j + 0)
          (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit (a :: r') 0)
            (cof0O ops rest (j + 0))))
        (ground.famFold ops.add ops.unit
          (fun k => sgnPO ops (j + k)
            (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit (a :: r') k)
              (cof0O ops rest (j + k))))
          (List.map (fun x => x + 1) (List.range r'.length))))
    rw [ground.famFold_map ops.add ops.unit _ (fun x => x + 1)
        (List.range r'.length)]
    have hjr : j ≤ rest.length := by
      refine Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ ?_
      refine Nat.le_trans ?_ hjb
      show j + 1 ≤ j + (r'.length + 1)
      refine Nat.add_le_add_left ?_ j
      exact Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le _)
    have hhead : R.rel (if places.parityOf j
        then ops.swap (nrm (ops.mul a
          (f (rest.map (fun l => l.eraseIdx j)))))
        else nrm (ops.mul a
          (f (rest.map (fun l => l.eraseIdx j)))))
        (sgnPO ops (j + 0)
          (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit (a :: r') 0)
            (cof0O ops rest (j + 0)))) := by
      show R.rel _ (sgnPO ops j (ops.mul a (cof0O ops rest j)))
      have hcore : R.rel (nrm (ops.mul a
          (f (rest.map (fun l => l.eraseIdx j)))))
          (ops.mul a (cof0O ops rest j)) := by
        refine L.ovTrans (hnrm _) ?_
        refine L.mulCongr (L.ovRefl a) ?_
        exact L.ovTrans (hf j hjr)
          (L.ovSymm (cof0O_strike L.toDCore rest j hjr))
      show R.rel (if places.parityOf j
          then ops.swap (nrm (ops.mul a
            (f (rest.map (fun l => l.eraseIdx j)))))
          else nrm (ops.mul a
            (f (rest.map (fun l => l.eraseIdx j)))))
        (if places.parityOf j
          then ops.swap (ops.mul a (cof0O ops rest j))
          else ops.mul a (cof0O ops rest j))
      cases places.parityOf j with
      | true => exact L.toDCore.swapCongr hcore
      | false => exact hcore
    have htail := minorRowO_read L nrm snrm hnrm hsnrm f rest hf r'
      (j + 1) (by
        rw [Nat.add_right_comm j 1 r'.length]
        exact hjb)
    refine L.ovTrans (hsnrm _) ?_
    refine L.addCongr hhead ?_
    refine L.ovTrans htail ?_
    refine ovOfEq L.toDCore
      (ground.famFold_congr_members ops.add ops.unit _ _
        (List.range r'.length) (fun k hk => by
          rw [Nat.add_right_comm j 1 k, Nat.add_assoc]
          rfl))

name: minorFO_detO
statement:
private theorem minorFO_detO {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
    (nrm snrm : γ → γ) (hnrm : ∀ x, R.rel (nrm x) x)
    (hsnrm : ∀ x, R.rel (snrm x) x) :
    ∀ (fuel : Nat) (l : List (List γ)), l.length = fuel →
      rowsLen fuel l →
      R.rel (minorFO ops nrm snrm fuel l) (detO ops l)
  | 0, [], _, _ => by
    show R.rel ops.one (ops.add ops.one ops.unit)
    exact L.ovSymm (L.addUnit ops.one)
  | 0, _ :: _, h, _ => Nat.noConfusion h
  | _ + 1, [], h, _ => Nat.noConfusion h
  | f + 1, [r], hl, hw => by
    have hf0 : f = 0
proof:
:= (Nat.succ.inj hl).symm
    have hr1 : r.length = 1 := by
      rw [hw.1, hf0]
    match r with
    | [] => exact absurd hr1 (fun h => Nat.noConfusion h)
    | [x] =>
      show R.rel x (detO ops [[x]])
      exact L.ovSymm (detO_single L x)
    | _ :: _ :: t =>
      have h2 : t.length + 1 + 1 = 1 := hr1
      nomatch (Nat.succ.inj h2)
  | f + 1, r :: r2 :: rest, hl, hw => by
    show R.rel (minorRowO ops nrm snrm
        (minorFO ops nrm snrm f) false 0 r (r2 :: rest))
      (detO ops (r :: r2 :: rest))
    have hlen : (r2 :: rest).length = f := Nat.succ.inj hl
    have hwr : r.length = (r2 :: rest).length + 1 := by
      rw [hlen]
      exact hw.1
    have hstr : ∀ (i : Nat), i < f + 1 → ∀ M : List (List γ),
        rowsLen (f + 1) M →
        rowsLen f (M.map (fun l => l.eraseIdx i)) := by
      intro i hif
      intro M
      induction M with
      | nil => intro _; exact trivial
      | cons row M ih =>
        intro h
        refine ⟨?_, ih h.2⟩
        have hl2 := ground.length_eraseIdx row i
          (by rw [h.1]; exact hif)
        rw [h.1] at hl2
        exact Nat.succ.inj hl2
    have hf : ∀ i, i ≤ (r2 :: rest).length →
        R.rel ((minorFO ops nrm snrm f)
            ((r2 :: rest).map (fun l => l.eraseIdx i)))
          (detO ops ((r2 :: rest).map
            (fun row => row.eraseIdx i))) :=
      fun i hi => minorFO_detO L nrm snrm hnrm hsnrm f
        ((r2 :: rest).map (fun l => l.eraseIdx i))
        (by rw [ground.length_map]; exact hlen)
        (hstr i (by
            rw [hlen] at hi
            exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le hi)
          (r2 :: rest) hw.2)
    have h1 := minorRowO_read L nrm snrm hnrm hsnrm
      (minorFO ops nrm snrm f) (r2 :: rest) hf r 0
      (by rw [Nat.zero_add, hwr]; exact Nat.le_refl _)
    rw [show places.parityOf 0 = false from rfl] at h1
    refine L.ovTrans h1 ?_
    refine L.ovTrans (ovOfEq L.toDCore
      (ground.famFold_congr_members ops.add ops.unit _
        (fun j => sgnPO ops j
          (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit r j)
            (cof0O ops (r2 :: rest) j)))
        (List.range r.length) (fun k hk => by
          rw [Nat.zero_add]))) ?_
    rw [hwr]
    exact L.ovSymm (detO_cons L r (r2 :: rest))

name: minorO_detO
statement:
private theorem minorO_detO {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
    (nrm snrm : γ → γ) (hnrm : ∀ x, R.rel (nrm x) x)
    (hsnrm : ∀ x, R.rel (snrm x) x)
    (m : List (List γ)) (hsq : rowsLen m.length m) :
    R.rel (minorO ops nrm snrm m) (detO ops m)
proof:
:=
  minorFO_detO L nrm snrm hnrm hsnrm m.length m rfl hsq

name: take_as_range
statement:
private theorem take_as_range {α : Type} (d : α) :
    ∀ (k : Nat) (l : List α), k ≤ l.length →
      l.take k = (List.range k).map (fun a => ground.getAt d l a)
  | 0, _, _ => rfl
  | k + 1, [], h => absurd h (Nat.not_succ_le_zero _)
  | k + 1, a :: l, h => by
    show a :: l.take k
      = (List.range (k + 1)).map (fun t => ground.getAt d (a :: l) t)
    rw [range_cons k, take_as_range d k l (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ h)]
    show a :: (List.range k).map (fun t => ground.getAt d l t)
      = a :: ((List.range k).map (fun x => x + 1)).map
          (fun t => ground.getAt d (a :: l) t)
    rw [ground.map_map]
    rfl

/
of the two reads. -/
private theorem borderKey_mem {k i a : Nat}
    (ha : 0 < ground.countOf a ((List.range k) ++ [i])) :
    a < k ∨ a = i
proof:
:= by
  rw [ground.countOf_append, ground.countOf_range] at ha
  by_cases hak : a < k
  · exact Or.inl hak
  · rw [if_neg hak, Nat.zero_add] at ha
    refine Or.inr ?_
    show a = i
    by_cases hai : a = i
    · exact hai
    · exact absurd ha (by
        show ¬ 0 < ground.countOf a [i]
        rw [ground.countOf_cons a i ([] : List Nat), if_neg hai]
        exact Nat.lt_irrefl 0)

name: borderKey_mem
proof:
:= by
  rw [ground.countOf_append, ground.countOf_range] at ha
  by_cases hak : a < k
  · exact Or.inl hak
  · rw [if_neg hak, Nat.zero_add] at ha
    refine Or.inr ?_
    show a = i
    by_cases hai : a = i
    · exact hai
    · exact absurd ha (by
        show ¬ 0 < ground.countOf a [i]
        rw [ground.countOf_cons a i ([] : List Nat), if_neg hai]
        exact Nat.lt_irrefl 0)

name: keepCols_take
statement:
private theorem keepCols_take (k j : Nat) (r : List BPair)
    (hk : k ≤ r.length) :
    r.take k ++ [ground.getAt BPair.unit r j]
      = keepCols ((List.range k) ++ [j]) r
proof:
:= by
  show r.take k ++ [ground.getAt BPair.unit r j]
    = ((List.range k) ++ [j]).map
        (fun c => ground.getAt BPair.unit r c)
  rw [ground.map_append, take_as_range BPair.unit k r hk]
  rfl

name: bordered_borderAt
statement:
private theorem bordered_borderAt (m : Mat) (k i j : Nat)
    (hk : k ≤ m.length) (hi : i < m.length)
    (hw : ∀ a, a < m.length →
      (ground.getAt [] m a).length = m.length) :
    bordered m k i j = minor (borderAt k i j m)
proof:
:= by
  refine congrArg minor ?_
  show (m.take k ++ [ground.getAt [] m i]).map
      (fun r => r.take k ++ [ground.getAt BPair.unit r j])
    = ((List.range k) ++ [i]).map (fun a =>
        keepCols ((List.range k) ++ [j]) (ground.getAt [] m a))
  rw [take_as_range ([] : List BPair) k m hk,
    show ((List.range k).map (fun a => ground.getAt [] m a)
        ++ [ground.getAt [] m i])
      = ((List.range k) ++ [i]).map (fun a => ground.getAt [] m a)
      from by rw [ground.map_append]; rfl,
    ground.map_map]
  refine ground.map_congr_members _ _ ((List.range k) ++ [i])
    (fun a ha => ?_)
  have haM : a < m.length := match borderKey_mem ha with
    | .inl h => Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le h hk
    | .inr h => h ▸ hi
  exact keepCols_take k j (ground.getAt [] m a)
    (by rw [hw a haM]; exact hk)

name: leading_leadAt
statement:
private theorem leading_leadAt (m : Mat) (k : Nat)
    (hk : k ≤ m.length)
    (hw : ∀ a, a < m.length →
      (ground.getAt [] m a).length = m.length) :
    leading m k = minor (leadAt k m)
proof:
:= by
  refine congrArg minor ?_
  show (m.take k).map (fun r => r.take k)
    = (List.range k).map (fun a =>
        keepCols (List.range k) (ground.getAt [] m a))
  rw [take_as_range ([] : List BPair) k m hk, ground.map_map]
  refine ground.map_congr_members _ _ (List.range k)
    (fun a ha => ?_)
  have haM : a < m.length := Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (ground.ltOfCountRange ha) hk
  show (ground.getAt [] m a).take k
    = (List.range k).map
        (fun c => ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] m a) c)
  exact take_as_range BPair.unit k (ground.getAt [] m a)
    (by rw [hw a haM]; exact hk)

name: leadAt_rowsW
statement:
private theorem leadAt_rowsW (k : Nat) (m : Mat) :
    rowsLen k (leadAt k m)
proof:
:=
  rowsLen_matOf k k _

name: minor_detL
statement:
theorem minor_detL (M : Mat) (hsq : rowsLen M.length M) :
    (minor M).oneValue (detL M)
proof:
:=
  minorO_detO (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairLaws BPair.norm BPair.norm
    (fun x => BPair.norm_oneValue x) (fun x => BPair.norm_oneValue x)
    M hsq

name: length_conjP
statement:
private theorem length_conjP (n : Nat) (q p : List Nat) :
    (conjP n q p).length = n
proof:
:= by
  show ((places.invPerm n q).map _).length = n
  rw [ground.length_map]
  exact ground.length_mapRange _ n

name: getAt_conjP
statement:
private theorem getAt_conjP (n : Nat) {q : List Nat} (p : List Nat)
    (hq : 0 < ground.countOf q (places.perms n)) (hplen : p.length = n)
    (i : Nat) (hi : i < n) :
    ground.getAt 0 (conjP n q p) i
      = ground.getAt 0 q (ground.getAt 0 p (places.posOf i q))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hqlen, _, _, hqocc⟩ := places.perm_member_reads hq
  have hpos : places.posOf i q < n := by
    have hlt := places.posOf_lt i q (hqocc i hi)
    rw [hqlen] at hlt
    exact hlt
  show ground.getAt 0
      (places.expo (places.expo q p) (places.invPerm n q)) i = _
  rw [places.getAt_expo (places.expo q p) (places.invPerm n q) i
      (by rw [places.length_invPerm n q]; exact hi),
    places.getAt_invPerm n q hi,
    places.getAt_expo q p (places.posOf i q)
      (by rw [hplen]; exact hpos)]

name: conjP_member
statement:
private theorem conjP_member (n : Nat) {q p : List Nat}
    (hq : 0 < ground.countOf q (places.perms n))
    (hp : 0 < ground.countOf p (places.perms n)) :
    0 < ground.countOf (conjP n q p) (places.perms n)
proof:
:=
  places.expo_member n (places.expo_member n hq hp)
    (places.invPerm_member n hq)

name: conjP_conjP
statement:
private theorem conjP_conjP (n : Nat) {q p : List Nat}
    (hq : 0 < ground.countOf q (places.perms n))
    (hp : 0 < ground.countOf p (places.perms n)) :
    conjP n (places.invPerm n q) (conjP n q p) = p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hqlen, hqdist, hqval, _⟩ := places.perm_member_reads hq
  obtain ⟨hplen, _, hpval, _⟩ := places.perm_member_reads hp
  have hq' := places.invPerm_member n hq
  obtain ⟨hq'len, _, _, hq'occ⟩ := places.perm_member_reads hq'
  refine ground.getAt_ext 0 _ _ (by rw [length_conjP, hplen]) ?_
  intro i hi
  rw [length_conjP] at hi
  have hk : places.posOf i (places.invPerm n q) < n := by
    have hlt := places.posOf_lt i (places.invPerm n q) (hq'occ i hi)
    rw [hq'len] at hlt
    exact hlt
  have hkey : places.posOf (places.posOf i (places.invPerm n q)) q
      = i := by
    have h1 : ground.getAt 0 (places.invPerm n q)
        (places.posOf i (places.invPerm n q)) = i :=
      places.getAt_posOf i (places.invPerm n q) (hq'occ i hi)
    rw [places.getAt_invPerm n q hk] at h1
    exact h1
  have hpi : ground.getAt 0 p i < n :=
    hpval _ (ground.countOf_getAt_pos 0 p i (by rw [hplen]; exact hi))
  have hqpi : ground.getAt 0 q (ground.getAt 0 p i) < n :=
    hqval _ (ground.countOf_getAt_pos 0 q _
      (by rw [hqlen]; exact hpi))
  rw [getAt_conjP n (conjP n q p) hq' (length_conjP n q p) i hi,
    getAt_conjP n p hq hplen _ hk,
    hkey, places.getAt_invPerm n q hqpi,
    places.posOf_getAt hqdist (ground.getAt 0 p i)
      (by rw [hqlen]; exact hpi)]

name: parity_conjP
statement:
private theorem parity_conjP (n : Nat) {q p : List Nat}
    (hq : 0 < ground.countOf q (places.perms n))
    (hp : 0 < ground.countOf p (places.perms n)) :
    places.parity (conjP n q p) = places.parity p
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : places.parity (places.expo q p)
      = xor (places.parity p) (places.parity q) :=
    places.parity_comp n p q hp hq
  have h2 : places.parity (conjP n q p)
      = xor (places.parity (places.invPerm n q))
          (places.parity (places.expo q p)) :=
    places.parity_comp n (places.invPerm n q)
      (places.expo q p) (places.invPerm_member n hq)
      (places.expo_member n hq hp)
  rw [h2, h1, places.parity_invPerm n hq]
  cases places.parity p <;> cases places.parity q <;> rfl

name: sgnO_conjP
statement:
private theorem sgnO_conjP {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ) (n : Nat)
    {q p : List Nat} (hq : 0 < ground.countOf q (places.perms n))
    (hp : 0 < ground.countOf p (places.perms n)) (x : γ) :
    sgnO ops (conjP n q p) x = sgnO ops p x
proof:
:= by
  show (if places.parity (conjP n q p) then ops.swap x else x)
    = (if places.parity p then ops.swap x else x)
  rw [parity_conjP n hq hp]

name: detO_reindex
statement:
private theorem detO_reindex {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (C : DCore γ ops R.rel) (n : Nat)
    (M M' : List (List γ)) (q : List Nat)
    (hq : 0 < ground.countOf q
      (places.monomialsAt (List.replicate n 1)))
    (hM : M.length = n) (hM' : M'.length = n)
    (hent : ∀ i j, i < n → j < n →
      R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] M' i) j)
        (ground.getAt ops.unit
          (ground.getAt [] M (ground.getAt 0 q i))
          (ground.getAt 0 q j))) :
    R.rel (detO ops M') (detO ops M)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hqlen, hqdist, hqval, hqocc⟩ := places.perm_member_reads hq
  have hterm : ∀ p : List Nat,
      0 < ground.countOf p (places.perms n) →
      R.rel (termO ops M' p) (termO ops M (conjP n q p)) := by
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨hplen, _, hpval, _⟩ := places.perm_member_reads hp
    rw [termO_fold ops M' p (by rw [hM', hplen]),
      termO_fold ops M (conjP n q p) (by rw [hM, length_conjP]),
      hM, hM']
    refine ground.famFold_bij_ov (commLawsMulOf C) ops.one _
      (fun s => ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] M s)
        (ground.getAt 0 (conjP n q p) s))
      (ground.distinctList_range n)
      (g := ground.getAt 0 q) (h := fun x => places.posOf x q)
      (fun x hx => places.posOf_getAt hqdist x
        (by rw [hqlen]; exact ground.ltOfMem hx))
      (fun x hx => places.getAt_posOf x q
        (hqocc x (ground.ltOfMem hx)))
      (fun x hx => ground.countOf_range_pos (hqval _
        (ground.countOf_getAt_pos 0 q x
          (by rw [hqlen]; exact ground.ltOfMem hx))))
      (fun x hx => ground.countOf_range_pos (by
        have hlt := places.posOf_lt x q (hqocc x (ground.ltOfMem hx))
        rw [hqlen] at hlt
        exact hlt))
      (fun t ht => ?_)
    have htn : t < n := ground.ltOfMem ht
    have hqt : ground.getAt 0 q t < n :=
      hqval _ (ground.countOf_getAt_pos 0 q t
        (by rw [hqlen]; exact htn))
    have hpt : ground.getAt 0 p t < n :=
      hpval _ (ground.countOf_getAt_pos 0 p t
        (by rw [hplen]; exact htn))
    rw [getAt_conjP n p hq hplen _ hqt,
      places.posOf_getAt hqdist t (by rw [hqlen]; exact htn)]
    exact hent t (ground.getAt 0 p t) htn hpt
  show R.rel (ground.famFold ops.add ops.unit
      (fun p => sgnO ops p (termO ops M' p))
      (places.monomialsAt (List.replicate M'.length 1)))
    (ground.famFold ops.add ops.unit
      (fun p => sgnO ops p (termO ops M p))
      (places.monomialsAt (List.replicate M.length 1)))
  rw [hM, hM']
  exact ground.famFold_bij_ov (commLawsOf C) ops.unit _
    (fun r => sgnO ops r (termO ops M r))
    (places.monomialsAt_distinct (List.replicate n 1))
    (g := conjP n q) (h := conjP n (places.invPerm n q))
    (fun p hp => conjP_conjP n hq hp)
    (fun p hp => by
      have hback := conjP_conjP n (places.invPerm_member n hq) hp
      rw [places.invPerm_invPerm n hq] at hback
      exact hback)
    (fun p hp => conjP_member n hq hp)
    (fun p hp => conjP_member n (places.invPerm_member n hq) hp)
    (fun p hp => C.ovTrans (sgnO_congr C p (hterm p hp))
      (ovOfEq C (sgnO_conjP ops n hq hp
        (termO ops M (conjP n q p))).symm))

name: detL_reindex
statement:
theorem detL_reindex (n : Nat) (M M' : Mat) (q : List Nat)
    (hq : 0 < ground.countOf q
      (places.monomialsAt (List.replicate n 1)))
    (hM : M.length = n) (hM' : M'.length = n)
    (hent : ∀ i j, i < n → j < n →
      (ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] M' i) j).oneValue
        (ground.getAt BPair.unit
          (ground.getAt [] M (ground.getAt 0 q i))
          (ground.getAt 0 q j))) :
    (detL M').oneValue (detL M)
proof:
:=
  detO_reindex (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairCore n M M' q hq hM hM'
    hent

name: minorP_reindex
statement:
theorem minorP_reindex (n : Nat) (M M' : List (List poly.Poly))
    (q : List Nat)
    (hq : 0 < ground.countOf q
      (places.monomialsAt (List.replicate n 1)))
    (hM : M.length = n) (hM' : M'.length = n)
    (hrows : rowsLen n M) (hrows' : rowsLen n M')
    (hent : ∀ i j, i < n → j < n →
      poly.oneValue (ground.getAt [] (ground.getAt [] M' i) j)
        (ground.getAt []
          (ground.getAt [] M (ground.getAt 0 q i))
          (ground.getAt 0 q j))) :
    poly.oneValue (minorO poly.polyOps poly.pnorm id M')
      (minorO poly.polyOps poly.pnorm id M)
proof:
:= by
  have hsq : rowsLen M.length M := by rw [hM]; exact hrows
  have hsq' : rowsLen M'.length M' := by rw [hM']; exact hrows'
  have hbridge : ∀ (X : List (List poly.Poly)), rowsLen X.length X →
      poly.oneValue (minorO poly.polyOps poly.pnorm id X)
        (detO poly.polyOps X) := fun X hX =>
    minorO_detO (R := poly.polyRead)
      (polyLawsO (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairLaws) poly.pnorm id
      (fun x => poly.pnorm_oneValue x)
      (fun x => lovRefl (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairCore x) X hX
  have C : DCore poly.Poly poly.polyOps poly.polyRead.rel :=
    polyCoreO (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairLaws
  exact C.ovTrans (hbridge M' hsq')
    (C.ovTrans (detO_reindex C n M M' q hq hM hM' hent)
      (C.ovSymm (hbridge M hsq)))

name: detO_List.set_last
statement:
private theorem detO_List.set_last {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
        (m : List (List γ)) (e : Nat) (hlen : m.length = e + 1)
    (v : List γ) (hv : v.length = e + 1)
    (hve : R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit v e) ops.one)
    (hvo : ∀ b, ¬ b = e → R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit v b) ops.unit) :
    R.rel (detO ops (List.set m e v))
      (detO ops ((m.eraseIdx e).map (fun r => r.eraseIdx e)))
proof:
:= by
  have hem : e < m.length := by
    rw [hlen]
    exact Nat.lt_succ_self e
  have hrest : (m.eraseIdx e).length = e := by
    have h := length_eraseIdx m e hem
    rw [hlen] at h
    exact Nat.succ.inj h
  refine L.ovTrans (detO_List.set_dot L m e hem v (by rw [hv, hlen])) ?_
  refine L.ovTrans (dotO_unitRead L v (cofVecO ops m e) e
    (by rw [hv, length_cofVecO, hlen]) hve hvo) ?_
  rw [show ground.getAt ops.unit (cofVecO ops m e) e
      = sgnPO ops (e + e) (cof0O ops (m.eraseIdx e) e) from by
    show ground.getAt ops.unit ((List.range m.length).map
      (fun j => sgnPO ops (e + j)
        (cof0O ops (m.eraseIdx e) j))) e = _
    rw [ground.getAt_map 0 ops.unit _ (List.range m.length) e
        (by rw [ground.length_range]; exact hem),
      ground.getAt_range m.length e hem],
    sgnPO_even ops e]
  have hb := cof0O_last L.toDCore (m.eraseIdx e)
  rw [hrest] at hb
  exact hb

name: map_as_range
statement:
private theorem map_as_range {α β : Type} (d : α) (f : α → β)
    (l : List α) :
    l.map f = (List.range l.length).map
      (fun t => f (ground.getAt d l t))
proof:
:= by
  refine ground.getAt_ext (f d) _ _ ?_ ?_
  · rw [ground.length_map, ground.length_mapRange]
  · intro i hi
    rw [ground.length_map] at hi
    rw [ground.getAt_map d (f d) f l i hi,
      ground.getAt_map 0 (f d) _ (List.range l.length) i
        (by rw [ground.length_range]; exact hi),
      ground.getAt_range l.length i hi]

name: dotO_map_index
statement:
private theorem dotO_map_index {γ α : Type} (ops : DOps γ) (d : α)
    (f : α → γ) (y : List γ) (l : List α) (hy : y.length = l.length) :
    dotO ops y (l.map f)
      = ground.famFold ops.add ops.unit
        (fun t => ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit y t)
          (f (ground.getAt d l t))) (List.range l.length)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_as_range d f l]
  exact dotO_map_range ops (fun t => f (ground.getAt d l t))
    l.length y hy

name: List.set_comm
statement:
private theorem List.set_comm {α : Type} :
