    ∀ (l : List α) (p q : Nat) (u v : α), ¬ p = q →
      List.set (List.set l p u) q v = List.set (List.set l q v) p u
  | [], _, _, _, _, _ => rfl
  | _ :: _, 0, 0, _, _, h => absurd rfl h
  | _ :: _, 0, _ + 1, _, _, _ => rfl
  | _ :: _, _ + 1, 0, _, _, _ => rfl
  | a :: t, p + 1, q + 1, u, v, h => by
    show a :: List.set (List.set t p u) q v
      = a :: List.set (List.set t q v) p u
    rw [List.set_comm t p q u v (fun he => h (congrArg Nat.succ he))]

/
the sum's unit reads those two keys' join. -/
private theorem foldO_pick2 {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel) (g : Nat → γ)
    (l : List Nat) (a b : Nat) (hab : ¬ a = b)
    (hca : ground.countOf a l = 1) (hcb : ground.countOf b l = 1)
    (hrest : ∀ x, 0 < ground.countOf x l → ¬ x = a → ¬ x = b →
      R.rel (g x) ops.unit) :
    R.rel (ground.famFold ops.add ops.unit g l)
      (ops.add (g a) (g b))
proof:
:= by
  have hpa : 0 < ground.countOf a l := by
    rw [hca]
    exact Nat.succ_pos 0
  have hea : ground.countOf a (ground.eraseFirst a l) = 0 := by
    have h := ground.countOf_eraseFirst_self l a hpa
    rw [hca] at h
    exact (Nat.succ.inj h).symm
  have hpb1 : 0 < ground.countOf b (ground.eraseFirst a l) := by
    rw [ground.countOf_eraseFirst_ne l a b (fun he => hab he.symm),
      hcb]
    exact Nat.succ_pos 0
  have hstep1 : R.rel (ground.famFold ops.add ops.unit g l)
      (ops.add (g a) (ground.famFold ops.add ops.unit g
        (ground.eraseFirst a l))) :=
    L.ovSymm (ground.famFold_eraseFirst_ov (commLawsOf L.toDCore) ops.unit g l a hpa)
  have hstep2 : R.rel (ground.famFold ops.add ops.unit g
        (ground.eraseFirst a l))
      (ops.add (g b) (ground.famFold ops.add ops.unit g
        (ground.eraseFirst b (ground.eraseFirst a l)))) :=
    L.ovSymm (ground.famFold_eraseFirst_ov (commLawsOf L.toDCore) ops.unit g
      (ground.eraseFirst a l) b hpb1)
  have hnull : R.rel (ground.famFold ops.add ops.unit g
      (ground.eraseFirst b (ground.eraseFirst a l))) ops.unit := by
    refine ground.famFold_null_ov (foldLawsOf L) g _ (fun x hx => ?_)
    have hxb : ¬ x = b := by
      intro he
      have h0 : ground.countOf b (ground.eraseFirst b
          (ground.eraseFirst a l)) = 0 := by
        have h := ground.countOf_eraseFirst_self
          (ground.eraseFirst a l) b hpb1
        rw [ground.countOf_eraseFirst_ne l a b
          (fun hz => hab hz.symm), hcb] at h
        exact (Nat.succ.inj h).symm
      rw [he, h0] at hx
      exact absurd hx (Nat.lt_irrefl 0)
    have hxa : ¬ x = a := by
      intro he
      have h0 : ground.countOf a (ground.eraseFirst b
          (ground.eraseFirst a l)) = 0 := by
        rw [ground.countOf_eraseFirst_ne (ground.eraseFirst a l) b a
          (fun hz => hab hz), hea]
      rw [he, h0] at hx
      exact absurd hx (Nat.lt_irrefl 0)
    have hxl : 0 < ground.countOf x l := by
      rw [ground.countOf_eraseFirst_ne (ground.eraseFirst a l) b x hxb,
        ground.countOf_eraseFirst_ne l a x hxa] at hx
      exact hx
    exact hrest x hxl hxa hxb
  exact L.ovTrans hstep1 (L.addCongr (L.ovRefl (g a))
    (L.ovTrans hstep2 (L.ovTrans
      (L.addCongr (L.ovRefl (g b)) hnull) (L.addUnit (g b)))))

name: foldO_pick2
statement:
private theorem foldO_pick2 {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel) (g : Nat → γ)
    (l : List Nat) (a b : Nat) (hab : ¬ a = b)
    (hca : ground.countOf a l = 1) (hcb : ground.countOf b l = 1)
    (hrest : ∀ x, 0 < ground.countOf x l → ¬ x = a → ¬ x = b →
      R.rel (g x) ops.unit) :
    R.rel (ground.famFold ops.add ops.unit g l)
      (ops.add (g a) (g b))
proof:
:= by
  have hpa : 0 < ground.countOf a l := by
    rw [hca]
    exact Nat.succ_pos 0
  have hea : ground.countOf a (ground.eraseFirst a l) = 0 := by
    have h := ground.countOf_eraseFirst_self l a hpa
    rw [hca] at h
    exact (Nat.succ.inj h).symm
  have hpb1 : 0 < ground.countOf b (ground.eraseFirst a l) := by
    rw [ground.countOf_eraseFirst_ne l a b (fun he => hab he.symm),
      hcb]
    exact Nat.succ_pos 0
  have hstep1 : R.rel (ground.famFold ops.add ops.unit g l)
      (ops.add (g a) (ground.famFold ops.add ops.unit g
        (ground.eraseFirst a l))) :=
    L.ovSymm (ground.famFold_eraseFirst_ov (commLawsOf L.toDCore) ops.unit g l a hpa)
  have hstep2 : R.rel (ground.famFold ops.add ops.unit g
        (ground.eraseFirst a l))
      (ops.add (g b) (ground.famFold ops.add ops.unit g
        (ground.eraseFirst b (ground.eraseFirst a l)))) :=
    L.ovSymm (ground.famFold_eraseFirst_ov (commLawsOf L.toDCore) ops.unit g
      (ground.eraseFirst a l) b hpb1)
  have hnull : R.rel (ground.famFold ops.add ops.unit g
      (ground.eraseFirst b (ground.eraseFirst a l))) ops.unit := by
    refine ground.famFold_null_ov (foldLawsOf L) g _ (fun x hx => ?_)
    have hxb : ¬ x = b := by
      intro he
      have h0 : ground.countOf b (ground.eraseFirst b
          (ground.eraseFirst a l)) = 0 := by
        have h := ground.countOf_eraseFirst_self
          (ground.eraseFirst a l) b hpb1
        rw [ground.countOf_eraseFirst_ne l a b
          (fun hz => hab hz.symm), hcb] at h
        exact (Nat.succ.inj h).symm
      rw [he, h0] at hx
      exact absurd hx (Nat.lt_irrefl 0)
    have hxa : ¬ x = a := by
      intro he
      have h0 : ground.countOf a (ground.eraseFirst b
          (ground.eraseFirst a l)) = 0 := by
        rw [ground.countOf_eraseFirst_ne (ground.eraseFirst a l) b a
          (fun hz => hab hz), hea]
      rw [he, h0] at hx
      exact absurd hx (Nat.lt_irrefl 0)
    have hxl : 0 < ground.countOf x l := by
      rw [ground.countOf_eraseFirst_ne (ground.eraseFirst a l) b x hxb,
        ground.countOf_eraseFirst_ne l a x hxa] at hx
      exact hx
    exact hrest x hxl hxa hxb
  exact L.ovTrans hstep1 (L.addCongr (L.ovRefl (g a))
    (L.ovTrans hstep2 (L.ovTrans
      (L.addCongr (L.ovRefl (g b)) hnull) (L.addUnit (g b)))))

name: detO_List.set_combo
statement:
private theorem detO_List.set_combo {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
    (m : List (List γ)) (k : Nat) (hk : k < m.length)
    (y : List γ) (M' : List (List γ)) (hM : rowsLen m.length M') :
    R.rel (detO ops (List.set m k (comboO ops m.length y M')))
      (dotO ops y
        (M'.map (fun row => detO ops (List.set m k row))))
proof:
:= by
  have hcl : (comboO ops m.length y M').length = m.length :=
    length_comboO ops m.length y M' hM
  have hcof : (cofVecO ops m k).length = m.length :=
    length_cofVecO ops m k
  refine L.ovTrans (detO_List.set_dot L m k hk _ hcl) ?_
  refine L.ovTrans (dotO_comm L.toDCore _ _) ?_
  refine L.ovTrans
    (dotO_combo L y M' (cofVecO ops m k) m.length hM) ?_
  refine dotO_congr_right L y _ _
    (by rw [ground.length_map, ground.length_map]) ?_
  intro i hi
  rw [ground.length_map] at hi
  rw [ground.getAt_map ([] : List γ) ops.unit
      (fun row => dotO ops (cofVecO ops m k) row) M' i hi,
    ground.getAt_map ([] : List γ) ops.unit
      (fun row => detO ops (List.set m k row)) M' i hi]
  refine L.ovTrans (dotO_comm L.toDCore _ _) ?_
  exact L.ovSymm (detO_List.set_dot L m k hk (ground.getAt [] M' i)
    (rowsLen_getAt M' i hM hi))

name: rowsLen_adjSwap
statement:
theorem rowsLen_adjSwap {γ : Type} {n : Nat} :
    ∀ (k : Nat) (m : List (List γ)), rowsLen n m →
      rowsLen n (ground.adjSwap k m)
  | 0, [], h => h
  | _ + 1, [], h => h
  | 0, [_], h => h
  | 0, _ :: _ :: _, h => ⟨h.2.1, h.1, h.2.2⟩
  | k + 1, _ :: t, h => ⟨h.1, rowsLen_adjSwap k t h.2⟩

/
map — the explicit spelling the bordered tier reads at. -/
private def transM {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ) (n : Nat)
    (S : List (List γ)) : List (List γ)
proof:
:=
  ground.matOf n n (fun a b =>
    ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] S b) a)

name: transM_len
statement:
private theorem transM_len {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ) (n : Nat)
    (S : List (List γ)) : (transM ops n S).length = n
proof:
:=
  ground.matOf_length n n _

name: transM_rows
statement:
private theorem transM_rows {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ) (n : Nat)
    (S : List (List γ)) : rowsLen n (transM ops n S)
proof:
:=
  rowsLen_matOf n n _

name: transM_entry
statement:
private theorem transM_entry {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ) (n : Nat)
    (S : List (List γ)) (a b : Nat) (ha : a < n) (hb : b < n) :
    ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] (transM ops n S) a) b
      = ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] S b) a
proof:
:=
  ground.matOf_entry [] ops.unit n n _ a b ha hb

name: transM_det
statement:
private theorem transM_det {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (C : DCore γ ops R.rel) (n : Nat)
    (S : List (List γ)) (hl : S.length = n) (hrows : rowsLen n S) :
    R.rel (detO ops (transM ops n S)) (detO ops S)
proof:
:= by
  match n, hl, hrows with
  | 0, hl, _ =>
    match S, hl with
    | [], _ => exact C.ovRefl _
  | n' + 1, hl, hrows =>
  have h0 : 0 < n' + 1 := Nat.succ_pos n'
  have hlt : (transposeO ops S).length = n' + 1 :=
    length_transposeO ops S hrows (by rw [hl]; exact h0)
  refine C.ovTrans (detO_congr_letters C (transM ops (n' + 1) S)
    (transposeO ops S) (by rw [transM_len, hlt]) (fun a ha b hb => ?_))
    ?_
  · rw [transM_len] at ha hb
    rw [transM_entry ops (n' + 1) S a b ha hb,
      getAt_transposeO ops ops.unit S hrows a b ha (by rw [hl]; exact hb)]
    exact C.ovRefl _
  · have h := detO_transpose C S (by rw [hl]; exact hrows)
    exact h

name: colSwapM_len
statement:
private theorem colSwapM_len {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ) (n k : Nat)
    (X : List (List γ)) : (colSwapM ops n k X).length = n
proof:
:=
  ground.matOf_length n n _

name: colSwapM_entry
statement:
private theorem colSwapM_entry {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ) (n k : Nat)
    (X : List (List γ)) (a b : Nat) (ha : a < n) (hb : b < n) :
    ground.getAt ops.unit
        (ground.getAt [] (colSwapM ops n k X) a) b
      = ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] X a)
        (swapIx k (k + 1) b)
proof:
:=
  ground.matOf_entry [] ops.unit n n _ a b ha hb

name: colSwapM_det
statement:
private theorem colSwapM_det {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (C : DCore γ ops R.rel) (n k : Nat)
    (X : List (List γ)) (hl : X.length = n) (hrows : rowsLen n X)
    (hk : k + 1 < n) :
    R.rel (detO ops (colSwapM ops n k X)) (ops.swap (detO ops X))
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : 0 < n := Nat.lt_trans (Nat.succ_pos k) hk
  have hXt : (transM ops n X).length = n := transM_len ops n X
  have hYl : (ground.adjSwap k (transM ops n X)).length = n := by
    rw [ground.length_adjSwap, hXt]
  have hYr : rowsLen n (ground.adjSwap k (transM ops n X)) :=
    rowsLen_adjSwap k (transM ops n X) (transM_rows ops n X)
  refine C.ovTrans (detO_congr_letters C (colSwapM ops n k X)
    (transM ops n (ground.adjSwap k (transM ops n X)))
    (by rw [colSwapM_len, transM_len]) (fun a ha b hb => ?_)) ?_
  · rw [colSwapM_len] at ha hb
    rw [colSwapM_entry ops n k X a b ha hb,
      transM_entry ops n (ground.adjSwap k (transM ops n X)) a b ha hb,
      getAt_adjSwap ([] : List γ) k (transM ops n X)
        (by rw [hXt]; exact hk) b,
      transM_entry ops n X (swapIx k (k + 1) b) a
        (swapIx_lt (Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self k) hk) hk b hb) ha]
    exact C.ovRefl _
  · refine C.ovTrans (transM_det C n
      (ground.adjSwap k (transM ops n X)) hYl hYr) ?_
    refine C.ovTrans (detO_swapAdj C k (transM ops n X)
      (by rw [hXt]; exact hk)) ?_
    exact C.swapCongr (transM_det C n X hl hrows)

name: unitFam_len
statement:
private theorem unitFam_len {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ) (n c : Nat) :
    (unitFam ops n c).length = n
proof:
:=
  ground.length_mapRange _ n

name: unitFam_hit
proof:
:= by
  show ground.getAt ops.unit ((List.range n).map
    (fun b => if b = c then ops.one else ops.unit)) c = _
  rw [ground.getAt_map 0 ops.unit _ (List.range n) c
      (by rw [ground.length_range]; exact hc),
    ground.getAt_range n c hc, if_pos rfl]

name: unitFam_miss
proof:
:= by
  match Nat.lt_or_ge b n with
  | .inl hbn =>
    show ground.getAt ops.unit ((List.range n).map
      (fun b => if b = c then ops.one else ops.unit)) b = _
    rw [ground.getAt_map 0 ops.unit _ (List.range n) b
        (by rw [ground.length_range]; exact hbn),
      ground.getAt_range n b hbn, if_neg hb]
  | .inr hbn =>
    exact ground.getAt_over ops.unit (unitFam ops n c) b
      (by rw [unitFam_len]; exact hbn)

name: bumpIx_lt
statement:
private theorem bumpIx_lt {k x n : Nat} (hx : x < k + 1)
    (hk : k + 1 < n) : bumpIx k x < n
proof:
:= by
  show (if x = k then k + 1 else x) < n
  by_cases h : x = k
  · rw [if_pos h]
    exact hk
  · rw [if_neg h]
    exact Nat.lt_trans hx hk

name: bumpIx_swapIx
statement:
private theorem bumpIx_swapIx (k x : Nat) (hx : x < k + 1) :
    bumpIx k x = swapIx k (k + 1) x
proof:
:= by
  show (if x = k then k + 1 else x)
    = if x = k then k + 1 else if x = k + 1 then k else x
  by_cases h : x = k
  · rw [if_pos h, if_pos h]
  · rw [if_neg h, if_neg h,
      if_neg (fun he => Nat.lt_irrefl (k + 1)
        (by rw [he] at hx; exact hx))]

name: subM_len
proof:
:=
  ground.matOf_length p p _

name: subM_rows
proof:
:=
  rowsLen_matOf p p _

name: subM_entry
statement:
private theorem subM_entry {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ) (p : Nat)
    (f g : Nat → Nat) (S : List (List γ)) (a b : Nat)
    (ha : a < p) (hb : b < p) :
    ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] (subM ops p f g S) a) b
      = ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] S (f a)) (g b)
proof:
:=
  ground.matOf_entry [] ops.unit p p _ a b ha hb

name: List.set_swapAdj
statement:
private theorem List.set_swapAdj {α : Type} (d : α) :
    ∀ (k : Nat) (m : List α), k + 1 < m.length →
      List.set (List.set m (k + 1) (ground.getAt d m k)) k
        (ground.getAt d m (k + 1)) = ground.adjSwap k m
  | 0, [], h => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | 0, [_], h => absurd h (Nat.lt_irrefl 1)
  | _ + 1, [], h => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | 0, _ :: _ :: _, _ => rfl
  | k + 1, a :: t, h => by
    show a :: List.set (List.set t (k + 1) (ground.getAt d t k)) k
      (ground.getAt d t (k + 1)) = a :: ground.adjSwap k t
    rw [List.set_swapAdj d k t (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ h)]

/
exchange at the second. -/
private theorem adjSwap_List.set {α : Type} :
    ∀ (k : Nat) (m : List α) (b : α), k + 1 < m.length →
      ground.adjSwap k (List.set m k b)
        = List.set (ground.adjSwap k m) (k + 1) b
  | 0, [], _, h => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | 0, [_], _, h => absurd h (Nat.lt_irrefl 1)
  | _ + 1, [], _, h => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | 0, _ :: _ :: _, _, _ => rfl
  | k + 1, a :: t, b, h => by
    show a :: ground.adjSwap k (List.set t k b)
      = a :: List.set (ground.adjSwap k t) (k + 1) b
    rw [adjSwap_List.set k t b (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ h)]

/
pairing. -/
private theorem dotO_vecScale_left {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel) (c : γ)
    (u w : List γ) :
    R.rel (dotO ops (vecScaleO ops c u) w) (ops.mul c (dotO ops u w))
proof:
:=
  L.ovTrans (dotO_comm L.toDCore _ _)
    (L.ovTrans (dotO_vecScale_right L w u c)
      (L.mulCongr (L.ovRefl c) (dotO_comm L.toDCore w u)))

name: adjSwap_List.set
statement:
private theorem adjSwap_List.set {α : Type} :
    ∀ (k : Nat) (m : List α) (b : α), k + 1 < m.length →
      ground.adjSwap k (List.set m k b)
        = List.set (ground.adjSwap k m) (k + 1) b
  | 0, [], _, h => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | 0, [_], _, h => absurd h (Nat.lt_irrefl 1)
  | _ + 1, [], _, h => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | 0, _ :: _ :: _, _, _ => rfl
  | k + 1, a :: t, b, h => by
    show a :: ground.adjSwap k (List.set t k b)
      = a :: List.set (ground.adjSwap k t) (k + 1) b
    rw [adjSwap_List.set k t b (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ h)]

pairing. -/
private theorem dotO_vecScale_left {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}

statement:

name: rowsLen_set
statement:
theorem rowsLen_set {γ : Type} {n : Nat} :
    ∀ (M : List (List γ)) (k : Nat) (v : List γ),
      rowsLen n M → v.length = n → rowsLen n (List.set M k v)
  | [], _, _, h, _ => h
  | _ :: _, 0, _, h, hv => ⟨hv, h.2⟩
  | _ :: t, k + 1, v, h, hv => ⟨h.1, rowsLen_set t k v h.2 hv⟩

/
submatrix's determinant, in the explicit key-map spelling. -/
private theorem detO_lastUnit_subM {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
    (e : Nat)
    (X : List (List γ)) (hl : X.length = e + 1) :
    R.rel (detO ops (List.set X e (unitFam ops (e + 1) e)))
      (detO ops (subM ops e (fun a => a) (fun b => b) X))
proof:
:= by
  have hk1 : e < X.length := by
    rw [hl]
    exact Nat.lt_succ_self e
  have hrest : (X.eraseIdx e).length = e := by
    have h := length_eraseIdx X e hk1
    rw [hl] at h
    exact Nat.succ.inj h
  refine L.ovTrans (detO_List.set_last L X e hl
    (unitFam ops (e + 1) e) (unitFam_len ops (e + 1) e)
    (ovOfEq L.toDCore
      (unitFam_hit ops (e + 1) e (Nat.lt_succ_self e)))
    (fun b hb => ovOfEq L.toDCore
      (unitFam_miss ops (e + 1) e b hb))) ?_
  refine detO_congr_letters L.toDCore _ _ ?_ (fun a ha b hb => ?_)
  · rw [ground.length_map, hrest, subM_len]
  · rw [ground.length_map, hrest] at ha hb
    rw [ground.getAt_map ([] : List γ) ([] : List γ)
        (fun r => r.eraseIdx e) (X.eraseIdx e) a
        (by rw [hrest]; exact ha),
      getAt_eraseIdx ([] : List γ) X e a, if_pos ha,
      getAt_eraseIdx ops.unit (ground.getAt [] X a) e b,
      if_pos hb, subM_entry ops e _ _ X a b ha hb]
    exact L.ovRefl _

name: detO_lastUnit_subM
statement:
private theorem detO_lastUnit_subM {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
    (e : Nat)
    (X : List (List γ)) (hl : X.length = e + 1) :
    R.rel (detO ops (List.set X e (unitFam ops (e + 1) e)))
      (detO ops (subM ops e (fun a => a) (fun b => b) X))
proof:
:= by
  have hk1 : e < X.length := by
    rw [hl]
    exact Nat.lt_succ_self e
  have hrest : (X.eraseIdx e).length = e := by
    have h := length_eraseIdx X e hk1
    rw [hl] at h
    exact Nat.succ.inj h
  refine L.ovTrans (detO_List.set_last L X e hl
    (unitFam ops (e + 1) e) (unitFam_len ops (e + 1) e)
    (ovOfEq L.toDCore
      (unitFam_hit ops (e + 1) e (Nat.lt_succ_self e)))
    (fun b hb => ovOfEq L.toDCore
      (unitFam_miss ops (e + 1) e b hb))) ?_
  refine detO_congr_letters L.toDCore _ _ ?_ (fun a ha b hb => ?_)
  · rw [ground.length_map, hrest, subM_len]
  · rw [ground.length_map, hrest] at ha hb
    rw [ground.getAt_map ([] : List γ) ([] : List γ)
        (fun r => r.eraseIdx e) (X.eraseIdx e) a
        (by rw [hrest]; exact ha),
      getAt_eraseIdx ([] : List γ) X e a, if_pos ha,
      getAt_eraseIdx ops.unit (ground.getAt [] X a) e b,
      if_pos hb, subM_entry ops e _ _ X a b ha hb]
    exact L.ovRefl _

name: subM_trans_det
statement:
private theorem subM_trans_det {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (C : DCore γ ops R.rel) (n p : Nat)
    (f g : Nat → Nat) (S : List (List γ))
    (hf : ∀ a, a < p → f a < n) (hg : ∀ b, b < p → g b < n) :
    R.rel (detO ops (subM ops p f g (transM ops n S)))
      (detO ops (subM ops p g f S))
proof:
:= by
  refine C.ovTrans (detO_congr_letters C _
    (transM ops p (subM ops p g f S))
    (by rw [subM_len, transM_len]) (fun a ha b hb => ?_)) ?_
  · rw [subM_len] at ha hb
    rw [subM_entry ops p f g (transM ops n S) a b ha hb,
      transM_entry ops n S (f a) (g b) (hf a ha) (hg b hb),
      transM_entry ops p (subM ops p g f S) a b ha hb,
      subM_entry ops p g f S b a hb ha]
    exact C.ovRefl _
  · exact transM_det C p (subM ops p g f S) (subM_len ops p g f S)
      (subM_rows ops p g f S)

name: swapIx_hit
statement:
private theorem swapIx_hit {k b : Nat} (hb : ¬ b = k + 1) :
    ¬ swapIx k (k + 1) b = k
proof:
:= by
  show ¬ (if b = k then k + 1 else if b = k + 1 then k else b) = k
  by_cases h1 : b = k
  · rw [if_pos h1]
    exact Nat.succ_ne_self k
  · rw [if_neg h1, if_neg hb]
    exact h1

name: colSwap_List.set_unit
statement:
private theorem colSwap_List.set_unit {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (C : DCore γ ops R.rel) (n k : Nat)
    (X : List (List γ)) (hl : X.length = n) (hk : k + 1 < n) :
    R.rel (detO ops
        (colSwapM ops n k (List.set X (k + 1) (unitFam ops n k))))
      (detO ops (List.set (colSwapM ops n k X) (k + 1)
        (unitFam ops n (k + 1))))
proof:
:= by
  have hk0 : k < n := Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self k) hk
  refine detO_congr_letters C _ _ ?_ (fun a ha b hb => ?_)
  · rw [colSwapM_len, ground.length_set, colSwapM_len]
  · rw [colSwapM_len] at ha hb
    rw [colSwapM_entry ops n k _ a b ha hb]
    by_cases hak : a = k + 1
    · rw [hak, ground.getAt_set_self ([] : List γ) _ X (k + 1) (by rw [hl]; exact hk),
        ground.getAt_set_self ([] : List γ) _ (colSwapM ops n k X) (k + 1)
          (by rw [colSwapM_len]; exact hk)]
      by_cases hbk : b = k + 1
      · rw [hbk,
          show swapIx k (k + 1) (k + 1) = k from by
            show (if k + 1 = k then k + 1
              else if k + 1 = k + 1 then k else k + 1) = k
            rw [if_neg (Nat.succ_ne_self k), if_pos rfl],
          unitFam_hit ops n k hk0,
          unitFam_hit ops n (k + 1) hk]
        exact C.ovRefl _
      · rw [unitFam_miss ops n k _ (swapIx_hit hbk),
          unitFam_miss ops n (k + 1) b hbk]
        exact C.ovRefl _
    · rw [ground.getAt_set_ne ([] : List γ) X (k + 1) a _ hak,
        ground.getAt_set_ne ([] : List γ) (colSwapM ops n k X) (k + 1) a
          _ hak,
        colSwapM_entry ops n k X a b ha hb]
      exact C.ovRefl _

name: cofRead
statement:
private theorem cofRead {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
    (n : Nat)
    (G : List (List γ)) (hl : G.length = n) (c t : Nat)
    (hc : c < n) (ht : t < n) :
    R.rel (detO ops (List.set G c (unitFam ops n t)))
      (ground.getAt ops.unit (cofVecO ops G c) t)
proof:
:= by
  refine L.ovTrans (detO_List.set_dot L G c (by rw [hl]; exact hc)
    (unitFam ops n t) (by rw [unitFam_len, hl])) ?_
  exact dotO_unitRead L (unitFam ops n t) (cofVecO ops G c) t
    (by rw [unitFam_len, length_cofVecO, hl])
    (ovOfEq L.toDCore (unitFam_hit ops n t ht))
    (fun b hb => ovOfEq L.toDCore (unitFam_miss ops n t b hb))

name: cofBorder11
statement:
private theorem cofBorder11 {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
    (k : Nat)
    (S : List (List γ)) :
    R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit
        (cofVecO ops (transM ops (k + 2) S) (k + 1)) (k + 1))
      (detO ops (subM ops (k + 1)
        (fun a => a) (fun b => b) S))
proof:
:= by
  have hk : k + 1 < k + 2 := Nat.lt_succ_self (k + 1)
  have hG : (transM ops (k + 2) S).length = k + 2 :=
    transM_len ops (k + 2) S
  refine L.ovTrans (L.ovSymm (cofRead L (k + 2)
    (transM ops (k + 2) S) hG (k + 1) (k + 1) hk hk)) ?_
  refine L.ovTrans (detO_lastUnit_subM L (k + 1)
    (transM ops (k + 2) S) hG) ?_
  exact subM_trans_det L.toDCore (k + 2) (k + 1)
    (fun a => a) (fun b => b) S
    (fun a ha => Nat.lt_trans ha hk) (fun b hb => Nat.lt_trans hb hk)

name: cofBorder10
statement:
private theorem cofBorder10 {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
    (k : Nat)
    (S : List (List γ)) :
    R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit
        (cofVecO ops (transM ops (k + 2) S) (k + 1)) k)
      (ops.swap (detO ops (subM ops (k + 1)
        (bumpIx k) (fun b => b) S)))
proof:
:= by
  have hk : k + 1 < k + 2 := Nat.lt_succ_self (k + 1)
  have hk0 : k < k + 2 := Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self k) hk
  have hG : (transM ops (k + 2) S).length = k + 2 :=
    transM_len ops (k + 2) S
  have hGr : rowsLen (k + 2) (transM ops (k + 2) S) :=
    transM_rows ops (k + 2) S
  have hcs : (colSwapM ops (k + 2) k (transM ops (k + 2) S)).length
      = k + 2 := colSwapM_len ops (k + 2) k _
  have h1 := colSwapM_det L.toDCore (k + 2) k
    (List.set (transM ops (k + 2) S) (k + 1) (unitFam ops (k + 2) k))
    (by rw [ground.length_set, hG])
    (rowsLen_set _ (k + 1) _ hGr (unitFam_len ops (k + 2) k)) hk
  have h2 := colSwap_List.set_unit L.toDCore (k + 2) k
    (transM ops (k + 2) S) hG hk
  have h3 := detO_lastUnit_subM L (k + 1)
    (colSwapM ops (k + 2) k (transM ops (k + 2) S)) hcs
  have h4 : R.rel (detO ops (subM ops (k + 1) (fun a => a) (fun b => b)
      (colSwapM ops (k + 2) k (transM ops (k + 2) S))))
      (detO ops (subM ops (k + 1) (fun a => a) (bumpIx k)
        (transM ops (k + 2) S))) := by
    refine detO_congr_letters L.toDCore _ _
      (by rw [subM_len, subM_len]) (fun a ha b hb => ?_)
    rw [subM_len] at ha hb
    rw [subM_entry ops (k + 1) _ _ _ a b ha hb,
      colSwapM_entry ops (k + 2) k (transM ops (k + 2) S) a b
        (Nat.lt_trans ha hk) (Nat.lt_trans hb hk),
      subM_entry ops (k + 1) _ _ (transM ops (k + 2) S) a b ha hb,
      bumpIx_swapIx k b hb]
    exact L.ovRefl _
  have h5 := subM_trans_det L.toDCore (k + 2) (k + 1)
    (fun a => a) (bumpIx k) S
    (fun a ha => Nat.lt_trans ha hk)
    (fun b hb => bumpIx_lt hb hk)
  have hmain : R.rel (ops.swap (detO ops (List.set (transM ops (k + 2) S)
      (k + 1) (unitFam ops (k + 2) k))))
      (detO ops (subM ops (k + 1) (bumpIx k) (fun b => b) S)) :=
    L.ovTrans (L.ovSymm h1)
      (L.ovTrans h2 (L.ovTrans h3 (L.ovTrans h4 h5)))
  refine L.ovTrans (L.ovSymm (cofRead L (k + 2)
    (transM ops (k + 2) S) hG (k + 1) k hk hk0)) ?_
  exact L.ovTrans (L.ovSymm (L.swapSwap _)) (L.swapCongr hmain)

name: cofBorder01
statement:
private theorem cofBorder01 {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
    (k : Nat)
    (S : List (List γ)) :
    R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit
        (cofVecO ops (transM ops (k + 2) S) k) (k + 1))
      (ops.swap (detO ops (subM ops (k + 1)
        (fun a => a) (bumpIx k) S)))
proof:
:= by
  have hk : k + 1 < k + 2 := Nat.lt_succ_self (k + 1)
  have hk0 : k < k + 2 := Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self k) hk
  have hG : (transM ops (k + 2) S).length = k + 2 :=
    transM_len ops (k + 2) S
  have hZ : (ground.adjSwap k (transM ops (k + 2) S)).length = k + 2 := by
    rw [ground.length_adjSwap, hG]
  have h1 : ground.adjSwap k (List.set (transM ops (k + 2) S) k
      (unitFam ops (k + 2) (k + 1)))
      = List.set (ground.adjSwap k (transM ops (k + 2) S)) (k + 1)
        (unitFam ops (k + 2) (k + 1)) :=
    adjSwap_List.set k (transM ops (k + 2) S) _
      (by rw [hG]; exact hk)
  have h2 := detO_swapAdj L.toDCore k
    (List.set (transM ops (k + 2) S) k (unitFam ops (k + 2) (k + 1)))
    (by rw [ground.length_set, hG]; exact hk)
  rw [h1] at h2
  have h3 := detO_lastUnit_subM L (k + 1)
    (ground.adjSwap k (transM ops (k + 2) S)) hZ
  have h4 : R.rel (detO ops (subM ops (k + 1) (fun a => a) (fun b => b)
      (ground.adjSwap k (transM ops (k + 2) S))))
      (detO ops (subM ops (k + 1) (bumpIx k) (fun b => b)
        (transM ops (k + 2) S))) := by
    refine detO_congr_letters L.toDCore _ _
      (by rw [subM_len, subM_len]) (fun a ha b hb => ?_)
    rw [subM_len] at ha hb
    rw [subM_entry ops (k + 1) _ _ _ a b ha hb,
      getAt_adjSwap ([] : List γ) k (transM ops (k + 2) S)
        (by rw [hG]; exact hk) a,
      subM_entry ops (k + 1) _ _ (transM ops (k + 2) S) a b ha hb,
      bumpIx_swapIx k a ha]
    exact L.ovRefl _
  have h5 := subM_trans_det L.toDCore (k + 2) (k + 1)
    (bumpIx k) (fun b => b) S
    (fun a ha => bumpIx_lt ha hk)
    (fun b hb => Nat.lt_trans hb hk)
  have hmain : R.rel (ops.swap (detO ops (List.set (transM ops (k + 2) S)
      k (unitFam ops (k + 2) (k + 1)))))
      (detO ops (subM ops (k + 1) (fun a => a) (bumpIx k) S)) :=
    L.ovTrans (L.ovSymm h2) (L.ovTrans h3 (L.ovTrans h4 h5))
  refine L.ovTrans (L.ovSymm (cofRead L (k + 2)
    (transM ops (k + 2) S) hG k (k + 1) hk0 hk)) ?_
  exact L.ovTrans (L.ovSymm (L.swapSwap _)) (L.swapCongr hmain)

name: cofBorder00
statement:
private theorem cofBorder00 {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
    (k : Nat)
    (S : List (List γ)) :
    R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit
        (cofVecO ops (transM ops (k + 2) S) k) k)
      (detO ops (subM ops (k + 1)
        (bumpIx k) (bumpIx k) S))
proof:
:= by
  have hk : k + 1 < k + 2 := Nat.lt_succ_self (k + 1)
  have hk0 : k < k + 2 := Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self k) hk
  have hG : (transM ops (k + 2) S).length = k + 2 :=
    transM_len ops (k + 2) S
  have hGr : rowsLen (k + 2) (transM ops (k + 2) S) :=
    transM_rows ops (k + 2) S
  have hZ : (ground.adjSwap k (transM ops (k + 2) S)).length = k + 2 := by
    rw [ground.length_adjSwap, hG]
  have hZr : rowsLen (k + 2) (ground.adjSwap k (transM ops (k + 2) S)) :=
    rowsLen_adjSwap k (transM ops (k + 2) S) hGr
  have h1 : ground.adjSwap k (List.set (transM ops (k + 2) S) k
      (unitFam ops (k + 2) k))
      = List.set (ground.adjSwap k (transM ops (k + 2) S)) (k + 1)
        (unitFam ops (k + 2) k) :=
    adjSwap_List.set k (transM ops (k + 2) S) _
      (by rw [hG]; exact hk)
  have h2 := detO_swapAdj L.toDCore k
    (List.set (transM ops (k + 2) S) k (unitFam ops (k + 2) k))
    (by rw [ground.length_set, hG]; exact hk)
  rw [h1] at h2
  have h3 := colSwapM_det L.toDCore (k + 2) k
    (List.set (ground.adjSwap k (transM ops (k + 2) S)) (k + 1)
      (unitFam ops (k + 2) k))
    (by rw [ground.length_set, hZ])
    (rowsLen_set _ (k + 1) _ hZr (unitFam_len ops (k + 2) k)) hk
  have h4 := colSwap_List.set_unit L.toDCore (k + 2) k
    (ground.adjSwap k (transM ops (k + 2) S)) hZ hk
  have h5 := detO_lastUnit_subM L (k + 1)
    (colSwapM ops (k + 2) k (ground.adjSwap k (transM ops (k + 2) S)))
    (colSwapM_len ops (k + 2) k _)
  have h6 : R.rel (detO ops (subM ops (k + 1) (fun a => a) (fun b => b)
      (colSwapM ops (k + 2) k
        (ground.adjSwap k (transM ops (k + 2) S)))))
      (detO ops (subM ops (k + 1) (bumpIx k) (bumpIx k)
        (transM ops (k + 2) S))) := by
    refine detO_congr_letters L.toDCore _ _
      (by rw [subM_len, subM_len]) (fun a ha b hb => ?_)
    rw [subM_len] at ha hb
    rw [subM_entry ops (k + 1) _ _ _ a b ha hb,
      colSwapM_entry ops (k + 2) k
        (ground.adjSwap k (transM ops (k + 2) S)) a b
        (Nat.lt_trans ha hk) (Nat.lt_trans hb hk),
      getAt_adjSwap ([] : List γ) k (transM ops (k + 2) S)
        (by rw [hG]; exact hk) a,
      subM_entry ops (k + 1) _ _ (transM ops (k + 2) S) a b ha hb,
      bumpIx_swapIx k a ha, bumpIx_swapIx k b hb]
    exact L.ovRefl _
  have h7 := subM_trans_det L.toDCore (k + 2) (k + 1)
    (bumpIx k) (bumpIx k) S
    (fun a ha => bumpIx_lt ha hk)
    (fun b hb => bumpIx_lt hb hk)
  refine L.ovTrans (L.ovSymm (cofRead L (k + 2)
    (transM ops (k + 2) S) hG k k hk0 hk0)) ?_
  refine L.ovTrans (L.ovSymm (L.swapSwap _)) ?_
  refine L.ovTrans (L.swapCongr (L.ovSymm h2)) ?_
  refine L.ovTrans (L.ovSymm h3) ?_
  exact L.ovTrans h4 (L.ovTrans h5 (L.ovTrans h6 h7))

name: comboCof_entry
statement:
private theorem comboCof_entry {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
    (n : Nat)
    (S : List (List γ)) (hl : S.length = n) (hrows : rowsLen n S)
    (c q : Nat) (hc : c < n) (hq : q < n) :
    R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit
        (comboO ops n (cofVecO ops (transM ops n S) c) S) q)
      (ground.getAt ops.unit
        (vecScaleO ops (detO ops S) (unitFam ops n c)) q)
proof:
:= by
  have hG : (transM ops n S).length = n := transM_len ops n S
  have hGr : rowsLen n (transM ops n S) := transM_rows ops n S
  have hrow : ∀ t, t < n →
      (ground.getAt [] (transM ops n S) t).length = n :=
    fun t ht => rowsLen_getAt _ t hGr (by rw [hG]; exact ht)
  have hcl : (comboO ops n (cofVecO ops (transM ops n S) c) S).length
      = n := length_comboO ops n _ S hrows
  refine L.ovTrans (L.ovSymm (dotO_unitRead L
    (unitFam ops n q) _ q (by rw [unitFam_len, hcl])
    (ovOfEq L.toDCore (unitFam_hit ops n q hq))
    (fun b hb => ovOfEq L.toDCore (unitFam_miss ops n q b hb)))) ?_
  refine L.ovTrans (dotO_combo L (cofVecO ops (transM ops n S) c) S
    (unitFam ops n q) n hrows) ?_
  refine L.ovTrans (dotO_congr_right L _ _
    (ground.getAt [] (transM ops n S) q)
    (by rw [ground.length_map, hl, hrow q hq]) (fun t ht => ?_)) ?_
  · rw [ground.length_map, hl] at ht
    rw [ground.getAt_map ([] : List γ) ops.unit
        (fun row => dotO ops (unitFam ops n q) row) S t
        (by rw [hl]; exact ht),
      transM_entry ops n S q t hq ht]
    exact dotO_unitRead L (unitFam ops n q)
      (ground.getAt [] S t) q
      (by rw [unitFam_len, rowsLen_getAt S t hrows (by rw [hl]; exact ht)])
      (ovOfEq L.toDCore (unitFam_hit ops n q hq))
      (fun b hb => ovOfEq L.toDCore (unitFam_miss ops n q b hb))
  · refine L.ovTrans (dotO_comm L.toDCore _ _) ?_
    rw [show vecScaleO ops (detO ops S) (unitFam ops n c)
        = (unitFam ops n c).map
          (fun x => ops.mul (detO ops S) x) from rfl,
      ground.getAt_map ops.unit ops.unit
        (fun x => ops.mul (detO ops S) x) (unitFam ops n c) q
        (by rw [unitFam_len]; exact hq)]
    by_cases hqc : q = c
    · rw [hqc, unitFam_hit ops n c hc]
      refine L.ovTrans (cofVecO_diag L (transM ops n S) c
        (by rw [hG]; exact hc) (by rw [hG]; exact hrow c hc)) ?_
      refine L.ovTrans (transM_det L.toDCore n S hl hrows) ?_
      exact L.ovSymm (L.ovTrans (L.mulComm (detO ops S) ops.one)
        (L.oneMul (detO ops S)))
    · rw [unitFam_miss ops n c q hqc]
      refine L.ovTrans (cofVecO_off L (transM ops n S) q c
        (by rw [hG]; exact hq) (by rw [hG]; exact hc) hqc
        (by rw [hG]; exact hrow q hq)) ?_
      exact L.ovSymm (L.mulUnit (detO ops S))

name: detO_comboRow_pick
statement:
private theorem detO_comboRow_pick {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
    (n : Nat) (M S : List (List γ)) (hM : M.length = n)
    (hS : S.length = n) (hrows : rowsLen n S)
    (p : Nat) (hp : p < n) (y : List γ) (hy : y.length = n)
    (s0 : Nat) (hs0 : s0 < n) (V : γ)
    (hhit : R.rel (detO ops (List.set M p (ground.getAt [] S s0))) V)
    (hmiss : ∀ s, s < n → ¬ s = s0 →
      R.rel (detO ops (List.set M p (ground.getAt [] S s))) ops.unit) :
    R.rel (detO ops (List.set M p (comboO ops n y S)))
      (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit y s0) V)
proof:
:= by
  have h := detO_List.set_combo L M p (by rw [hM]; exact hp) y S
    (by rw [hM]; exact hrows)
  rw [hM] at h
  refine L.ovTrans h ?_
  rw [dotO_map_index ops ([] : List γ)
    (fun row => detO ops (List.set M p row)) y S (by rw [hy, hS]), hS]
  refine L.ovTrans (foldO_congr_members L.toDCore _
    (fun s => if s0 = s then
        ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit y s0) V else ops.unit)
    (List.range n) (fun s hs => ?_))
    (foldO_pick L (fun _ => ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit y s0) V)
      (List.range n) s0
      (by rw [ground.countOf_range_one hs0]))
  have hsn : s < n := by
    rw [ground.countOf_range s n] at hs
    by_cases hc : s < n
    · exact hc
    · rw [if_neg hc] at hs
      exact absurd hs (Nat.lt_irrefl 0)
  by_cases hss : s0 = s
  · rw [if_pos hss, ← hss]
    exact L.mulCongr (L.ovRefl _) hhit
  · rw [if_neg hss]
    exact L.ovTrans
      (L.mulCongr (L.ovRefl _) (hmiss s hsn (fun he => hss he.symm)))
      (L.mulUnit _)

name: detN_direct
statement:
private theorem detN_direct {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
    (k : Nat)
    (S : List (List γ)) (hl : S.length = k + 2) :
    R.rel (detO ops (List.set (List.set S k
          (vecScaleO ops (detO ops S) (unitFam ops (k + 2) k)))
        (k + 1)
        (vecScaleO ops (detO ops S) (unitFam ops (k + 2) (k + 1)))))
      (ops.mul (detO ops S) (ops.mul (detO ops S)
        (detO ops (subM ops k (fun a => a) (fun b => b) S))))
proof:
:= by
  have hk : k + 1 < k + 2 := Nat.lt_succ_self (k + 1)
  have hk0 : k < k + 2 := Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self k) hk
  have hne : ¬ k = k + 1 := fun he => Nat.succ_ne_self k he.symm
  have hm1 : (List.set S k
      (vecScaleO ops (detO ops S) (unitFam ops (k + 2) k))).length
      = k + 2 := by rw [ground.length_set, hl]
  have hm2 : (List.set S (k + 1) (unitFam ops (k + 2) (k + 1))).length
      = k + 2 := by rw [ground.length_set, hl]
  have hvs : ∀ c, (vecScaleO ops (detO ops S)
      (unitFam ops (k + 2) c)).length = k + 2 := fun c => by
    show ((unitFam ops (k + 2) c).map _).length = k + 2
    rw [ground.length_map, unitFam_len]
  refine L.ovTrans (detO_List.set_dot L _ (k + 1)
    (by rw [hm1]; exact hk) _ (by rw [hvs, hm1])) ?_
  refine L.ovTrans (dotO_vecScale_left L (detO ops S) _ _) ?_
  refine L.mulCongr (L.ovRefl _) ?_
  refine L.ovTrans (L.ovSymm (detO_List.set_dot L _ (k + 1)
    (by rw [hm1]; exact hk) _ (by rw [unitFam_len, hm1]))) ?_
  rw [List.set_comm S k (k + 1)
    (vecScaleO ops (detO ops S) (unitFam ops (k + 2) k))
    (unitFam ops (k + 2) (k + 1)) hne]
  refine L.ovTrans (detO_List.set_dot L _ k
    (by rw [hm2]; exact hk0) _ (by rw [hvs, hm2])) ?_
  refine L.ovTrans (dotO_vecScale_left L (detO ops S) _ _) ?_
  refine L.mulCongr (L.ovRefl _) ?_
  refine L.ovTrans (L.ovSymm (detO_List.set_dot L _ k
    (by rw [hm2]; exact hk0) _ (by rw [unitFam_len, hm2]))) ?_
  rw [← List.set_comm S k (k + 1) (unitFam ops (k + 2) k)
    (unitFam ops (k + 2) (k + 1)) hne]
  refine L.ovTrans (detO_lastUnit_subM L (k + 1)
    (List.set S k (unitFam ops (k + 2) k))
    (by rw [ground.length_set, hl])) ?_
  refine L.ovTrans (detO_congr_letters L.toDCore _
    (List.set (subM ops (k + 1) (fun a => a) (fun b => b) S) k
      (unitFam ops (k + 1) k))
    (by rw [subM_len, ground.length_set, subM_len]) (fun a ha b hb => ?_))
    ?_
  · rw [subM_len] at ha hb
    rw [subM_entry ops (k + 1) _ _ _ a b ha hb]
    by_cases hak : a = k
    · rw [hak,
        ground.getAt_set_self ([] : List γ) _ S k (by rw [hl]; exact hk0),
        ground.getAt_set_self ([] : List γ) _
          (subM ops (k + 1) (fun a => a) (fun b => b) S) k
          (by rw [subM_len]; exact Nat.lt_succ_self k)]
      by_cases hbk : b = k
      · rw [hbk, unitFam_hit ops (k + 2) k hk0,
          unitFam_hit ops (k + 1) k (Nat.lt_succ_self k)]
        exact L.ovRefl _
      · rw [unitFam_miss ops (k + 2) k b hbk,
          unitFam_miss ops (k + 1) k b hbk]
        exact L.ovRefl _
    · rw [ground.getAt_set_ne ([] : List γ) S k a _ hak,
        ground.getAt_set_ne ([] : List γ)
          (subM ops (k + 1) (fun a => a) (fun b => b) S) k a _ hak,
        subM_entry ops (k + 1) _ _ S a b ha hb]
      exact L.ovRefl _
  · refine L.ovTrans (detO_lastUnit_subM L k
      (subM ops (k + 1) (fun a => a) (fun b => b) S)
      (subM_len ops (k + 1) _ _ S)) ?_
    refine detO_congr_letters L.toDCore _ _
      (by rw [subM_len, subM_len]) (fun a ha b hb => ?_)
    rw [subM_len] at ha hb
    rw [subM_entry ops k _ _ _ a b ha hb,
      subM_entry ops (k + 1) _ _ S a b
        (Nat.lt_trans ha (Nat.lt_succ_self k))
        (Nat.lt_trans hb (Nat.lt_succ_self k)),
      subM_entry ops k _ _ S a b ha hb]
    exact L.ovRefl _

name: detN_expand
statement:
private theorem detN_expand {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel) (k : Nat)
    (S : List (List γ)) (hl : S.length = k + 2)
    (hrows : rowsLen (k + 2) S) :
    R.rel (detO ops (List.set (List.set S k
          (comboO ops (k + 2)
            (cofVecO ops (transM ops (k + 2) S) k) S))
        (k + 1)
        (comboO ops (k + 2)
          (cofVecO ops (transM ops (k + 2) S) (k + 1)) S)))
      (ops.add
        (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit
            (cofVecO ops (transM ops (k + 2) S) (k + 1)) k)
          (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit
              (cofVecO ops (transM ops (k + 2) S) k) (k + 1))
            (ops.swap (detO ops S))))
        (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit
            (cofVecO ops (transM ops (k + 2) S) (k + 1)) (k + 1))
          (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit
              (cofVecO ops (transM ops (k + 2) S) k) k)
            (detO ops S))))
proof:
:= by
  have hk : k + 1 < k + 2 := Nat.lt_succ_self (k + 1)
  have hk0 : k < k + 2 := Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self k) hk
  have hne : ¬ k = k + 1 := fun he => Nat.succ_ne_self k he.symm
  have hy : ∀ c, (cofVecO ops (transM ops (k + 2) S) c).length
      = k + 2 := fun c => by
    rw [length_cofVecO, transM_len]
  have hm1 : (List.set S k (comboO ops (k + 2)
      (cofVecO ops (transM ops (k + 2) S) k) S)).length = k + 2 := by
    rw [ground.length_set, hl]
  have hstep : ∀ (M : List (List γ)) (p s : Nat), M.length = k + 2 →
      p < k + 2 → s < k + 2 →
      ground.getAt [] (List.set M p (ground.getAt [] S s)) p
        = ground.getAt [] S s := fun M p s hM hp _ =>
    ground.getAt_set_self ([] : List γ) _ M p (by rw [hM]; exact hp)
  have houter := detO_List.set_combo L
    (List.set S k (comboO ops (k + 2)
      (cofVecO ops (transM ops (k + 2) S) k) S)) (k + 1)
    (by rw [hm1]; exact hk)
    (cofVecO ops (transM ops (k + 2) S) (k + 1)) S
    (by rw [hm1]; exact hrows)
  rw [hm1] at houter
  refine L.ovTrans houter ?_
  rw [dotO_map_index ops ([] : List γ)
    (fun row => detO ops (List.set (List.set S k (comboO ops (k + 2)
      (cofVecO ops (transM ops (k + 2) S) k) S)) (k + 1) row))
    (cofVecO ops (transM ops (k + 2) S) (k + 1)) S
    (by rw [hy, hl]), hl]
  refine L.ovTrans (foldO_pick2 L _ (List.range (k + 2)) k (k + 1)
    hne (by rw [ground.countOf_range_one hk0])
    (by rw [ground.countOf_range_one hk])
    (fun x hx hxk hxk1 => ?_)) ?_
  · have hxn : x < k + 2 := by
      rw [ground.countOf_range x (k + 2)] at hx
      by_cases hc : x < k + 2
      · exact hc
      · rw [if_neg hc] at hx
        exact absurd hx (Nat.lt_irrefl 0)
    refine L.ovTrans (L.mulCongr (L.ovRefl _) ?_) (L.mulUnit _)
    refine detO_rows_equal L
      (show x < k + 1 from Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne
        (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hxn) hxk1)
      (show k + 1 < (List.set (List.set S k (comboO ops (k + 2)
          (cofVecO ops (transM ops (k + 2) S) k) S)) (k + 1)
          (ground.getAt [] S x)).length from by
        rw [ground.length_set, hm1]
        exact hk)
      ?_
    rw [ground.getAt_set_ne ([] : List γ) _ (k + 1) x _ hxk1,
      ground.getAt_set_ne ([] : List γ) S k x _ hxk,
      hstep _ (k + 1) x hm1 hk hxn]
  · refine L.addCongr ?_ ?_
    · refine L.mulCongr (L.ovRefl _) ?_
      rw [List.set_comm S k (k + 1) _ (ground.getAt [] S k) hne]
      refine detO_comboRow_pick L (k + 2)
        (List.set S (k + 1) (ground.getAt [] S k)) S
        (by rw [ground.length_set, hl]) hl hrows k hk0 _ (hy k)
        (k + 1) hk (ops.swap (detO ops S)) ?_ (fun s hs hsk => ?_)
      · rw [List.set_swapAdj ([] : List γ) k S (by rw [hl]; exact hk)]
        exact detO_swapAdj L.toDCore k S (by rw [hl]; exact hk)
      · have hml : (List.set S (k + 1) (ground.getAt [] S k)).length
            = k + 2 := by rw [ground.length_set, hl]
        have hXl : (List.set (List.set S (k + 1) (ground.getAt [] S k)) k
            (ground.getAt [] S s)).length = k + 2 := by
          rw [ground.length_set, hml]
        by_cases hsk0 : s = k
        · refine detO_rows_equal L (Nat.lt_succ_self k)
            (by rw [hXl]; exact hk) ?_
          rw [hsk0,
            ground.getAt_set_self ([] : List γ) _
              (List.set S (k + 1) (ground.getAt [] S k)) k
              (by rw [hml]; exact hk0),
            ground.getAt_set_ne ([] : List γ) _ k (k + 1) _
              (fun he => Nat.succ_ne_self k he),
            ground.getAt_set_self ([] : List γ) _ S (k + 1)
              (by rw [hl]; exact hk)]
        · refine detO_rows_equal L
            (show s < k from Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne
              (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ (Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne
                (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hs) hsk)) hsk0)
            (by rw [hXl]; exact hk0) ?_
          rw [ground.getAt_set_ne ([] : List γ) _ k s _ hsk0,
            ground.getAt_set_ne ([] : List γ) S (k + 1) s _ hsk,
            ground.getAt_set_self ([] : List γ) _
              (List.set S (k + 1) (ground.getAt [] S k)) k
              (by rw [hml]; exact hk0)]
    · refine L.mulCongr (L.ovRefl _) ?_
      rw [← ground.getAt_set_ne ([] : List γ) S k (k + 1)
          (comboO ops (k + 2)
            (cofVecO ops (transM ops (k + 2) S) k) S)
          (fun he => Nat.succ_ne_self k he),
        ground.set_self ([] : List γ) _ (k + 1) (by rw [hm1]; exact hk)]
      refine detO_comboRow_pick L (k + 2) S S hl hl hrows k hk0 _
        (hy k) k hk0 (detO ops S) ?_ (fun s hs hsk => ?_)
      · rw [ground.set_self ([] : List γ) S k (by rw [hl]; exact hk0)]
        exact L.ovRefl _
      · have hXl : (List.set S k (ground.getAt [] S s)).length = k + 2 := by
          rw [ground.length_set, hl]
        match Nat.lt_or_ge s k with
        | .inl hsk1 =>
          refine detO_rows_equal L hsk1 (by rw [hXl]; exact hk0) ?_
          rw [ground.getAt_set_ne ([] : List γ) S k s _ hsk,
            ground.getAt_set_self ([] : List γ) _ S k (by rw [hl]; exact hk0)]
        | .inr hsk1 =>
          refine detO_rows_equal L
            (show k < s from Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne hsk1
              (fun he => hsk he.symm))
            (by rw [hXl]; exact hs) ?_
          rw [ground.getAt_set_self ([] : List γ) _ S k (by rw [hl]; exact hk0),
            ground.getAt_set_ne ([] : List γ) S k s _ hsk]

name: mulSwapLeft
proof:
:=
  C.ovTrans (C.mulComm (ops.swap x) y)
    (C.ovTrans (C.mulSwapRight y x) (C.swapCongr (C.mulComm y x)))

name: rightDistribO
statement:
private theorem rightDistribO {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (C : DCore γ ops R.rel) (x y z : γ) :
    R.rel (ops.mul (ops.add x y) z)
      (ops.add (ops.mul x z) (ops.mul y z))
proof:
:=
  C.ovTrans (C.mulComm (ops.add x y) z)
    (C.ovTrans (C.leftDistrib z x y)
      (C.addCongr (C.mulComm z x) (C.mulComm z y)))

name: jacobiCorner
statement:
private theorem jacobiCorner {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
    (k : Nat)
    (S : List (List γ)) (hl : S.length = k + 2)
    (hrows : rowsLen (k + 2) S) :
    R.rel (ops.mul
        (ops.add
          (ops.mul
            (detO ops (subM ops (k + 1) (bumpIx k) (bumpIx k) S))
            (detO ops (subM ops (k + 1)
              (fun a => a) (fun b => b) S)))
          (ops.swap (ops.mul
            (detO ops (subM ops (k + 1) (fun a => a) (bumpIx k) S))
            (detO ops (subM ops (k + 1) (bumpIx k) (fun b => b) S)))))
        (detO ops S))
      (ops.mul (detO ops S) (ops.mul (detO ops S)
        (detO ops (subM ops k (fun a => a) (fun b => b) S))))
proof:
:= by
  have hk : k + 1 < k + 2 := Nat.lt_succ_self (k + 1)
  have hk0 : k < k + 2 := Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self k) hk
  have hne : ¬ k = k + 1 := fun he => Nat.succ_ne_self k he.symm
  have h00 := cofBorder00 L k S
  have h11 := cofBorder11 L k S
  have h01 := cofBorder01 L k S
  have h10 := cofBorder10 L k S
  have hA := detN_expand L k S hl hrows
  have hcong : R.rel (detO ops (List.set (List.set S k
        (comboO ops (k + 2)
          (cofVecO ops (transM ops (k + 2) S) k) S))
        (k + 1)
        (comboO ops (k + 2)
          (cofVecO ops (transM ops (k + 2) S) (k + 1)) S)))
      (detO ops (List.set (List.set S k
          (vecScaleO ops (detO ops S) (unitFam ops (k + 2) k)))
        (k + 1)
        (vecScaleO ops (detO ops S)
          (unitFam ops (k + 2) (k + 1))))) := by
    refine detO_congr_letters L.toDCore _ _
      (by rw [ground.length_set, ground.length_set, ground.length_set,
        ground.length_set]) (fun a ha b hb => ?_)
    rw [ground.length_set, ground.length_set, hl] at ha hb
    by_cases ha1 : a = k + 1
    · rw [ha1,
        ground.getAt_set_self ([] : List γ) _ _ (k + 1)
          (by rw [ground.length_set, hl]; exact hk),
        ground.getAt_set_self ([] : List γ) _ _ (k + 1)
          (by rw [ground.length_set, hl]; exact hk)]
      exact comboCof_entry L (k + 2) S hl hrows
        (k + 1) b hk hb
    · rw [ground.getAt_set_ne ([] : List γ) _ (k + 1) a _ ha1,
        ground.getAt_set_ne ([] : List γ) _ (k + 1) a _ ha1]
      by_cases ha0 : a = k
      · rw [ha0,
          ground.getAt_set_self ([] : List γ) _ S k (by rw [hl]; exact hk0),
          ground.getAt_set_self ([] : List γ) _ S k (by rw [hl]; exact hk0)]
        exact comboCof_entry L (k + 2) S hl hrows
          k b hk0 hb
      · rw [ground.getAt_set_ne ([] : List γ) S k a _ ha0,
          ground.getAt_set_ne ([] : List γ) S k a _ ha0]
        exact L.ovRefl _
  have hB := detN_direct L k S hl
  refine L.ovTrans ?_ (L.ovTrans (L.ovSymm hA)
    (L.ovTrans hcong hB))
  refine L.ovTrans (rightDistribO L.toDCore _ _ (detO ops S)) ?_
  refine L.ovTrans (L.addComm _ _) ?_
  refine L.addCongr ?_ ?_
  · refine L.ovTrans (mulSwapLeft L.toDCore _ (detO ops S)) ?_
    refine L.ovTrans (L.swapCongr (L.mulAssoc _ _ _)) ?_
    refine L.ovTrans (L.swapCongr (ground.opLeftCommO (commLawsMulOf L.toDCore) _ _ _)) ?_
    refine L.ovTrans (L.ovSymm (mulSwapLeft L.toDCore _ _)) ?_
    refine L.mulCongr (L.ovSymm h10) ?_
    refine L.ovTrans (L.ovSymm (L.swapSwap _)) ?_
    refine L.ovTrans (L.swapCongr (L.ovSymm (L.mulSwapRight _ _))) ?_
    refine L.ovTrans (L.ovSymm (mulSwapLeft L.toDCore _ _)) ?_
    exact L.mulCongr (L.ovSymm h01) (L.ovRefl _)
  · refine L.ovTrans (L.mulCongr
      (L.mulCongr (L.ovSymm h00) (L.ovSymm h11)) (L.ovRefl _)) ?_
    refine L.ovTrans (L.mulCongr (L.mulComm _ _) (L.ovRefl _)) ?_
    exact L.mulAssoc _ _ _

name: borderKey_bump
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : x < k
  · rw [if_pos h,
      show bumpIx k x = x from by
        show (if x = k then k + 1 else x) = x
        rw [if_neg (fun he => Nat.lt_irrefl k
          (by rw [he] at h; exact h))],
      if_pos (Nat.lt_trans h (Nat.lt_succ_self k))]
  · rw [if_neg h,
      show bumpIx k x = k + 1 from by
        show (if x = k then k + 1 else x) = k + 1
        rw [if_pos (Nat.le_antisymm (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hx)

  by_cases h : x < k

  · rw [if_neg h]

statement:
private theorem evalAddLO {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel) :
    ∀ (p q : List γ) (r : γ),
      R.rel (evalLO ops (poly.addLO ops p q) r)
        (ops.add (evalLO ops p r) (evalLO ops q r))
  | [], q, r => L.toDCore.ovSymm (L.unitAdd (evalLO ops q r))
  | c :: p, [], r =>
    L.toDCore.ovSymm (L.addUnit (evalLO ops (c :: p) r))
  | c :: p, d :: q, r => by
    show R.rel (ops.add (ops.add c d)
        (ops.mul r (evalLO ops (poly.addLO ops p q) r)))
      (ops.add (ops.add c (ops.mul r (evalLO ops p r)))
        (ops.add d (ops.mul r (evalLO ops q r))))
    refine L.toDCore.ovTrans
      (L.toDCore.addCongr (L.toDCore.ovRefl _)
        (L.toDCore.ovTrans
          (L.toDCore.mulCongr (L.toDCore.ovRefl r)
            (evalAddLO L p q r))
          (L.toDCore.leftDistrib r _ _))) ?_
    exact ground.opExchO (commLawsOf L.toDCore) c d (ops.mul r (evalLO ops p r))
      (ops.mul r (evalLO ops q r))

private theorem evalScaleLO {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel) :
    ∀ (q : List γ) (c r : γ),
      R.rel (evalLO ops (q.map (ops.mul c)) r)
        (ops.mul c (evalLO ops q r))
  | [], c, _ => L.toDCore.ovSymm (L.mulUnit c)
  | d :: q, c, r => by
    show R.rel (ops.add (ops.mul c d)
        (ops.mul r (evalLO ops (q.map (ops.mul c)) r)))
      (ops.mul c (ops.add d (ops.mul r (evalLO ops q r))))
    refine L.toDCore.ovTrans
      (L.toDCore.addCongr (L.toDCore.ovRefl _)
        (L.toDCore.ovTrans
          (L.toDCore.mulCongr (L.toDCore.ovRefl r)
            (evalScaleLO L q c r))
          (ground.opLeftCommO (commLawsMulOf L.toDCore) r c (evalLO ops q r)))) ?_
    exact L.toDCore.ovSymm (L.toDCore.leftDistrib c d
      (ops.mul r (evalLO ops q r)))

private theorem evalMulLO {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel) :
    ∀ (p q : List γ) (r : γ),
      R.rel (evalLO ops (poly.mulLO ops p q) r)
        (ops.mul (evalLO ops p r) (evalLO ops q r))
  | [], q, r =>
    L.toDCore.ovSymm (L.toDCore.ovTrans
      (L.toDCore.mulComm ops.unit (evalLO ops q r))
      (L.mulUnit (evalLO ops q r)))
  | c :: p, q, r => by
    show R.rel (evalLO ops (poly.addLO ops (q.map (ops.mul c))
        (ops.unit :: poly.mulLO ops p q)) r)
      (ops.mul (ops.add c (ops.mul r (evalLO ops p r)))
        (evalLO ops q r))
    refine L.toDCore.ovTrans (evalAddLO L (q.map (ops.mul c))
      (ops.unit :: poly.mulLO ops p q) r) ?_
    refine L.toDCore.ovTrans
      (L.toDCore.addCongr (evalScaleLO L q c r)
        (show R.rel (evalLO ops (ops.unit :: poly.mulLO ops p q) r)
            (ops.mul r (ops.mul (evalLO ops p r) (evalLO ops q r)))
          from L.toDCore.ovTrans (L.unitAdd _)
            (L.toDCore.mulCongr (L.toDCore.ovRefl r)
              (evalMulLO L p q r)))) ?_
    refine L.toDCore.ovTrans
      (L.toDCore.addCongr (L.toDCore.ovRefl _)
        (L.toDCore.ovSymm (L.toDCore.mulAssoc r (evalLO ops p r)
          (evalLO ops q r)))) ?_
    refine L.toDCore.ovSymm ?_
    refine L.toDCore.ovTrans
      (L.toDCore.ovTrans
        (L.toDCore.mulComm _ (evalLO ops q r))
        (L.toDCore.leftDistrib (evalLO ops q r) c
          (ops.mul r (evalLO ops p r)))) ?_
    exact L.toDCore.addCongr
      (L.toDCore.mulComm (evalLO ops q r) c)
      (L.toDCore.mulComm (evalLO ops q r) _)

private theorem evalUtO {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel) :
    ∀ {p : List γ}, poly.unitTailO ops R p → ∀ r : γ,

  | [], _, _ => L.toDCore.ovRefl _
  | _ :: p, h, r =>
    L.toDCore.ovTrans
      (L.toDCore.addCongr h.1
        (L.toDCore.ovTrans
          (L.toDCore.mulCongr (L.toDCore.ovRefl r)

          (L.mulUnit r)))
      (L.unitAdd ops.unit)

private theorem evalCongrO {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel) :
    ∀ {p q : List γ}, poly.listOV ops R p q → ∀ r : γ,
      R.rel (evalLO ops p r) (evalLO ops q r)
  | [], q, h, r => L.toDCore.ovSymm (evalUtO L (p := q) h r)
  | _ :: p, [], h, r =>
    evalUtO L (p := _ :: p) ⟨h.1, h.2⟩ r
  | _ :: p, _ :: q, h, r =>
    L.toDCore.addCongr h.1
      (L.toDCore.mulCongr (L.toDCore.ovRefl r)
