  detO_hom (poly.polyO ops) ops L.toDCore (fun f => evalLO ops f r)
    (fun x y => evalAddLO L x y r)
    (fun x y => evalMulLO L x y r)
    (fun x => evalNegO L.toDCore x r)
    (L.toDCore.ovRefl ops.unit)
    (L.toDCore.ovTrans
      (L.toDCore.addCongr (L.toDCore.ovRefl ops.one) (L.mulUnit r))
      (L.addUnit ops.one))
    M

name: shiftedRowEvalO
statement:
private theorem shiftedRowEvalO {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel) (r : List γ) (i : Nat) :
    poly.listOV ops R ((shiftedRowO ops r i).map
      (fun p => evalLO ops p ops.unit)) r
proof:
:= by
  refine lovOfGetAt L.toDCore (fun k => ?_)
  match Nat.lt_or_ge k r.length with
  | .inl hk =>
    rw [show ground.getAt ops.unit ((shiftedRowO ops r i).map
        (fun p => evalLO ops p ops.unit)) k
        = evalLO ops (ground.getAt [] (shiftedRowO ops r i) k)
          ops.unit from
      (evalRowGetAtO ops ops.unit (shiftedRowO ops r i) k).symm,
      shiftedRowO_entry ops r i k hk]
    cases Nat.beq i k with
    | true =>
      show R.rel (ops.add (ground.getAt ops.unit r k)
          (ops.mul ops.unit (ops.add ops.one
            (ops.mul ops.unit ops.unit)))) (ground.getAt ops.unit r k)
      refine L.toDCore.ovTrans
        (L.toDCore.addCongr (L.toDCore.ovRefl _)
          (L.toDCore.ovTrans
            (L.toDCore.mulComm ops.unit _) (L.mulUnit _))) ?_
      exact L.addUnit _
    | false =>
      show R.rel (ops.add (ground.getAt ops.unit r k)
          (ops.mul ops.unit ops.unit)) (ground.getAt ops.unit r k)
      refine L.toDCore.ovTrans
        (L.toDCore.addCongr (L.toDCore.ovRefl _) (L.mulUnit _)) ?_
      exact L.addUnit _
  | .inr hk =>
    rw [ground.getAt_over ops.unit _ k
        (by rw [ground.length_map, shiftedRowO_len]; exact hk),
      ground.getAt_over ops.unit r k hk]
    exact L.toDCore.ovRefl _

name: evalSubMDetO
statement:
private theorem evalSubMDetO {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
        (A : List (List γ)) (p : Nat) (f g : Nat → Nat)
    (N : List (List γ)) (hN : N.length = p)
    (hf : ∀ a, a < p → f a < A.length)
    (hent : ∀ a, a < p → ∀ b, b < p →
      R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] A (f a)) (g b))
        (ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] N a) b)) :
    R.rel (evalLO ops (detO (poly.polyO ops)
        (subM (poly.polyO ops) p f g (shiftedMO ops A))) ops.unit)
      (detO ops N)
proof:
:= by
  refine L.toDCore.ovTrans
    (evalDetLO L (subM (poly.polyO ops) p f g (shiftedMO ops A))
      ops.unit) ?_
  refine detO_congr_letters L.toDCore _ N
    (by rw [evalMatLO_len, subM_len, hN]) (fun a ha b hb => ?_)
  rw [evalMatLO_len, subM_len] at ha hb
  have hfa : f a < (shiftedMO ops A).length := by
    rw [shiftedMO_len]
    exact hf a ha
  show R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt []
    ((subM (poly.polyO ops) p f g (shiftedMO ops A)).map (fun row =>
      row.map (fun q => evalLO ops q ops.unit))) a) b) _
  rw [ground.getAt_map ([] : List (List γ)) ([] : List γ)
      (fun row => row.map (fun q => evalLO ops q ops.unit))
      (subM (poly.polyO ops) p f g (shiftedMO ops A)) a
      (by rw [subM_len]; exact ha),
    ← evalRowGetAtO ops ops.unit
      (ground.getAt [] (subM (poly.polyO ops) p f g (shiftedMO ops A)) a) b]
  show R.rel (evalLO ops (ground.getAt (poly.polyO ops).unit
    (ground.getAt [] (subM (poly.polyO ops) p f g (shiftedMO ops A)) a) b)
    ops.unit) _
  rw [subM_entry (poly.polyO ops) p f g (shiftedMO ops A) a b ha hb]
  show R.rel (evalLO ops (ground.getAt ([] : List γ)
    (ground.getAt [] (shiftedMO ops A) (f a)) (g b)) ops.unit) _
  rw [shiftedMO_row ops A (f a) (by
      rw [shiftedMO_len] at hfa; exact hfa),
    evalRowGetAtO ops ops.unit
      (shiftedRowO ops (ground.getAt [] A (f a)) (f a)) (g b)]
  refine L.toDCore.ovTrans
    (lovGetAt L.toDCore
      (shiftedRowEvalO L (ground.getAt [] A (f a)) (f a)) (g b)) ?_
  exact hent a ha b hb

name: evalShiftedMDetO
statement:
private theorem evalShiftedMDetO {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
        (A : List (List γ)) :
    R.rel (evalLO ops (detO (poly.polyO ops) (shiftedMO ops A)) ops.unit)
      (detO ops A)
proof:
:= by
  refine L.toDCore.ovTrans
    (evalDetLO L (shiftedMO ops A) ops.unit) ?_
  refine detO_congr_letters L.toDCore _ A
    (by rw [evalMatLO_len, shiftedMO_len]) (fun a ha b _ => ?_)
  rw [evalMatLO_len, shiftedMO_len] at ha
  show R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt []
    ((shiftedMO ops A).map (fun row =>
      row.map (fun q => evalLO ops q ops.unit))) a) b) _
  rw [ground.getAt_map ([] : List (List γ)) ([] : List γ)
      (fun row => row.map (fun q => evalLO ops q ops.unit))
      (shiftedMO ops A) a (by rw [shiftedMO_len]; exact ha),
    shiftedMO_row ops A a ha]
  exact lovGetAt L.toDCore
    (shiftedRowEvalO L (ground.getAt [] A a) a) b

name: shiftedMO_rows
proof:
:=
  rowsLen_intro _ (fun i hi => by
    rw [shiftedMO_len] at hi
    rw [shiftedMO_row ops B i hi, shiftedRowO_len]
    exact rowsLen_getAt B i hrows hi)

name: swapMoveO
statement:
private theorem swapMoveO {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
    {X Y Z : γ} (h : R.rel (ops.add X (ops.swap Y)) Z) :
    R.rel (ops.add Z Y) X
proof:
:= by
  refine L.toDCore.ovTrans
    (L.toDCore.addCongr (L.toDCore.ovSymm h) (L.toDCore.ovRefl Y)) ?_
  refine L.toDCore.ovTrans
    (L.toDCore.addAssoc X (ops.swap Y) Y) ?_
  refine L.toDCore.ovTrans
    (L.toDCore.addCongr (L.toDCore.ovRefl X)
      (L.toDCore.ovTrans
        (L.toDCore.addComm (ops.swap Y) Y) (annihDerived L Y))) ?_
  exact L.addUnit X

name: sylvesterO
statement:
private theorem sylvesterO {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
            (m : List (List γ)) (k i j : Nat) :
    R.rel (ops.add
        (ops.mul (detO ops (leadAtO ops k m))
          (detO ops (borderAtO ops (k + 1) i j m)))
        (ops.mul (detO ops (borderAtO ops k i k m))
          (detO ops (borderAtO ops k k j m))))
      (ops.mul (detO ops (borderAtO ops k k k m))
        (detO ops (borderAtO ops k i j m)))
proof:
:= by
  have hk : k + 1 < k + 2 := Nat.lt_succ_self (k + 1)
  have hAl : (borderAtO ops (k + 1) i j m).length = k + 2 :=
    borderAtO_len ops (k + 1) i j m
  have hAr : rowsLen (k + 2) (borderAtO ops (k + 1) i j m) :=
    borderAtO_rows ops (k + 1) i j m
  have hSl : (shiftedMO ops (borderAtO ops (k + 1) i j m)).length
      = k + 2 := by
    rw [shiftedMO_len, hAl]
  have hSr : rowsLen (k + 2)
      (shiftedMO ops (borderAtO ops (k + 1) i j m)) :=
    shiftedMO_rows ops _ hAr
  have hmon := shiftDetMonicO L (borderAtO ops (k + 1) i j m)
    (by rw [hAl]; exact hAr)
  have hJ := jacobiCorner (R := poly.listRead ops R) (polyLawsO L) k
    (shiftedMO ops (borderAtO ops (k + 1) i j m)) hSl hSr
  have hcanc := cancelMonicOV L
    (detO (poly.polyO ops) (shiftedMO ops (borderAtO ops (k + 1) i j m))) _ _
    hmon ((polyCoreO L).ovTrans ((polyCoreO L).mulComm _ _) hJ)
  have hE := evalCongrO L hcanc ops.unit
  have e00 := evalSubMDetO L (borderAtO ops (k + 1) i j m) (k + 1)
    (bumpIx k) (bumpIx k) (borderAtO ops k i j m)
    (borderAtO_len ops k i j m)
    (fun a ha => by rw [hAl]; exact bumpIx_lt ha hk)
    (fun a ha b hb => by
      rw [borderAtO_entry ops (k + 1) i j m (bumpIx k a) (bumpIx k b)
          (bumpIx_lt ha hk) (bumpIx_lt hb hk),
        borderAtO_entry ops k i j m a b ha hb,
        borderKey_bump k a i ha, borderKey_bump k b j hb]
      exact L.toDCore.ovRefl _)
  have e11 := evalSubMDetO L (borderAtO ops (k + 1) i j m) (k + 1)
    (fun a => a) (fun b => b) (borderAtO ops k k k m)
    (borderAtO_len ops k k k m)
    (fun a ha => by rw [hAl]; exact Nat.lt_trans ha hk)
    (fun a ha b hb => by
      rw [borderAtO_entry ops (k + 1) i j m a b
          (Nat.lt_trans ha hk) (Nat.lt_trans hb hk),
        borderAtO_entry ops k k k m a b ha hb,
        borderKey_id k a i ha, borderKey_id k b j hb]
      exact L.toDCore.ovRefl _)
  have e10 := evalSubMDetO L (borderAtO ops (k + 1) i j m) (k + 1)
    (fun a => a) (bumpIx k) (borderAtO ops k k j m)
    (borderAtO_len ops k k j m)
    (fun a ha => by rw [hAl]; exact Nat.lt_trans ha hk)
    (fun a ha b hb => by
      rw [borderAtO_entry ops (k + 1) i j m a (bumpIx k b)
          (Nat.lt_trans ha hk) (bumpIx_lt hb hk),
        borderAtO_entry ops k k j m a b ha hb,
        borderKey_id k a i ha, borderKey_bump k b j hb]
      exact L.toDCore.ovRefl _)
  have e01 := evalSubMDetO L (borderAtO ops (k + 1) i j m) (k + 1)
    (bumpIx k) (fun b => b) (borderAtO ops k i k m)
    (borderAtO_len ops k i k m)
    (fun a ha => by rw [hAl]; exact bumpIx_lt ha hk)
    (fun a ha b hb => by
      rw [borderAtO_entry ops (k + 1) i j m (bumpIx k a) b
          (bumpIx_lt ha hk) (Nat.lt_trans hb hk),
        borderAtO_entry ops k i k m a b ha hb,
        borderKey_bump k a i ha, borderKey_id k b j hb]
      exact L.toDCore.ovRefl _)
  have eP := evalSubMDetO L (borderAtO ops (k + 1) i j m) k
    (fun a => a) (fun b => b) (leadAtO ops k m) (leadAtO_len ops k m)
    (fun a ha => by
      rw [hAl]
      exact Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_trans ha (Nat.lt_succ_self k)) hk)
    (fun a ha b hb => by
      rw [borderAtO_entry ops (k + 1) i j m a b
          (Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_trans ha (Nat.lt_succ_self k)) hk)
          (Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_trans hb (Nat.lt_succ_self k)) hk),
        if_pos (Nat.lt_trans ha (Nat.lt_succ_self k)),
        if_pos (Nat.lt_trans hb (Nat.lt_succ_self k)),
        leadAtO_entry ops k m a b ha hb]
      exact L.toDCore.ovRefl _)
  have eD := evalShiftedMDetO L (borderAtO ops (k + 1) i j m)
  have hL : R.rel (evalLO ops ((poly.polyO ops).add
        ((poly.polyO ops).mul
          (detO (poly.polyO ops) (subM (poly.polyO ops) (k + 1) (bumpIx k)
            (bumpIx k) (shiftedMO ops (borderAtO ops (k + 1) i j m))))
          (detO (poly.polyO ops) (subM (poly.polyO ops) (k + 1) (fun a => a)
            (fun b => b) (shiftedMO ops (borderAtO ops (k + 1) i j m)))))
        ((poly.polyO ops).swap ((poly.polyO ops).mul
          (detO (poly.polyO ops) (subM (poly.polyO ops) (k + 1) (fun a => a)
            (bumpIx k) (shiftedMO ops (borderAtO ops (k + 1) i j m))))
          (detO (poly.polyO ops) (subM (poly.polyO ops) (k + 1) (bumpIx k)
            (fun b => b)
            (shiftedMO ops (borderAtO ops (k + 1) i j m)))))))
      ops.unit)
      (ops.add
        (ops.mul (detO ops (borderAtO ops k i j m))
          (detO ops (borderAtO ops k k k m)))
        (ops.swap (ops.mul (detO ops (borderAtO ops k k j m))
          (detO ops (borderAtO ops k i k m))))) := by
    refine L.toDCore.ovTrans (evalAddLO L _ _ ops.unit) ?_
    refine L.toDCore.addCongr ?_ ?_
    · exact L.toDCore.ovTrans (evalMulLO L _ _ ops.unit)
        (L.toDCore.mulCongr e00 e11)
    · exact L.toDCore.ovTrans (evalNegO L.toDCore _ ops.unit)
        (L.toDCore.swapCongr (L.toDCore.ovTrans
          (evalMulLO L _ _ ops.unit)
          (L.toDCore.mulCongr e10 e01)))
  have hR : R.rel (evalLO ops ((poly.polyO ops).mul
        (detO (poly.polyO ops) (shiftedMO ops (borderAtO ops (k + 1) i j m)))
        (detO (poly.polyO ops) (subM (poly.polyO ops) k (fun a => a)
          (fun b => b)
          (shiftedMO ops (borderAtO ops (k + 1) i j m))))) ops.unit)
      (ops.mul (detO ops (borderAtO ops (k + 1) i j m))
        (detO ops (leadAtO ops k m))) :=
    L.toDCore.ovTrans (evalMulLO L _ _ ops.unit)
      (L.toDCore.mulCongr eD eP)
  have hfinal := swapMoveO L (L.toDCore.ovTrans
    (L.toDCore.ovSymm hL) (L.toDCore.ovTrans hE hR))
  refine L.toDCore.ovTrans ?_
    (L.toDCore.ovTrans hfinal (L.toDCore.mulComm _ _))
  exact L.toDCore.addCongr (L.toDCore.mulComm _ _)
    (L.toDCore.mulComm _ _)

name: sylvester
statement:
theorem sylvester (m : Mat) (hsq : rowsLen m.length m) (k i j : Nat)
    (hki : k < i) (him : i < m.length) (hkj : k < j)
    (hjm : j < m.length) :
    (BPair.add
        (BPair.mul (detL (leadAt k m))
          (detL (borderAt (k + 1) i j m)))
        (BPair.mul (detL (borderAt k i k m))
          (detL (borderAt k k j m)))).oneValue
      (BPair.mul (detL (borderAt k k k m))
        (detL (borderAt k i j m)))
proof:
:=
  sylvesterO (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairLaws m k i j

name: divExact
statement:
theorem divExact (m : Mat) (hsq : rowsLen m.length m) (k i j : Nat)
    (hki : k < i) (him : i < m.length) (hkj : k < j)
    (hjm : j < m.length) :
    (BPair.mul (detL (leadAt k m))
      (cofactorAt
        (BPair.add
          (BPair.mul (detL (borderAt k k k m)) (detL (borderAt k i j m)))
          (BPair.swap (BPair.mul (detL (borderAt k i k m))
            (detL (borderAt k k j m)))))
        (detL (leadAt k m)))).oneValue
      (BPair.add
        (BPair.mul (detL (borderAt k k k m)) (detL (borderAt k i j m)))
        (BPair.swap (BPair.mul (detL (borderAt k i k m))
          (detL (borderAt k k j m)))))
proof:
:= by
  have hprod := BPair.oneValue_symm
    (swapMove
      (Y := (BPair.mul (detL (borderAt k i k m))
        (detL (borderAt k k j m))).swap)
      (sylvester m hsq k i j hki him hkj hjm))
  by_cases hP : (detL (leadAt k m)).oneValue BPair.unit
  · have hEu := BPair.oneValue_trans (BPair.oneValue_symm hprod)
      (BPair.oneValue_trans
        (BPair.mul_congr hP (BPair.oneValue_refl _))
        (BPair.unit_mul _))
    rw [cofactorAt_eqMem
      (BPair.add
        (BPair.mul (detL (borderAt k k k m)) (detL (borderAt k i j m)))
        (BPair.swap (BPair.mul (detL (borderAt k i k m))
          (detL (borderAt k k j m)))))
      (detL (leadAt k m)) (BPair.eqMem_of_oneValue hEu)]
    exact BPair.oneValue_trans (BPair.mul_unit _)
      (BPair.oneValue_symm hEu)
  · exact cofactorAt_sound hP hprod

name: unitTail_of_getAt
statement:
theorem unitTail_of_getAt : ∀ u : List BPair,
    (∀ p, p < u.length →
      (ground.getAt BPair.unit u p).oneValue BPair.unit) →
    poly.unitTail u
  | [], _ => trivial
  | _ :: u, h =>
    ⟨h 0 (Nat.succ_pos _),
     unitTail_of_getAt u
       (fun p hp => h (p + 1) (Nat.succ_lt_succ hp))⟩

/
sits at the sum's unit the pairing is the stated place's own
product. -/

name: dotP_oneIndex
statement:
theorem dotP_oneIndex : ∀ (cs M : List BPair) (p : Nat),
    cs.length = M.length → p < M.length →
    (∀ q, q < M.length → ¬ q = p →
      (ground.getAt BPair.unit M q).oneValue BPair.unit) →
    (dotP cs M).oneValue
      (ground.getAt BPair.unit cs p
        * ground.getAt BPair.unit M p)
  | [], [], p, _, hp, _ => absurd hp (Nat.not_lt_zero p)
  | [], _ :: _, _, hl, _, _ => Nat.noConfusion hl
  | _ :: _, [], _, hl, _, _ => Nat.noConfusion hl
  | c :: cs, m :: M, 0, _, _, h => by
    show (c * m + dotP cs M).oneValue (c * m)
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.add_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl (c * m))
        (dotP_null_right cs M (fun i hi =>
          h (i + 1) (Nat.succ_lt_succ hi)
            (fun hb => Nat.noConfusion hb)))) ?_
    exact BPair.add_unit (c * m)
  | c :: cs, m :: M, p + 1, hl, hp, h => by
    show (c * m + dotP cs M).oneValue
      (ground.getAt BPair.unit cs p
        * ground.getAt BPair.unit M p)
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.add_congr
        (BPair.oneValue_trans
          (BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl c)
            (h 0 (Nat.succ_pos _) (fun hb => Nat.noConfusion hb)))
          (BPair.mul_unit c))
        (dotP_oneIndex cs M p (Nat.succ.inj hl)
          (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hp)
          (fun q hq hne => h (q + 1) (Nat.succ_lt_succ hq)
            (fun hb => hne (Nat.succ.inj hb))))) ?_
    exact BPair.unit_add _

/
key, the sum's unit elsewhere. -/
def idRow (n k : Nat) : List BPair
proof:
:=
  (List.range n).map (fun i => if i = k then BPair.ofNat 1 else BPair.unit)

name: length_idRow
statement: theorem length_idRow (n k : Nat) : (idRow n k).length = n
proof:
:=
  ground.length_mapRange _ n

name: getAt_idRow
statement:
theorem getAt_idRow (n k j : Nat) (hj : j < n) :
    ground.getAt BPair.unit (idRow n k) j
      = if j = k then BPair.ofNat 1 else BPair.unit
proof:
:= by
  show ground.getAt BPair.unit ((List.range n).map
    (fun i => if i = k then BPair.ofNat 1 else BPair.unit)) j = _
  rw [ground.getAt_map 0 BPair.unit _ (List.range n) j
      (by rw [ground.length_range]; exact hj),
    ground.getAt_range n j hj]

name: idRow_set
statement:
theorem idRow_set (n k : Nat) :
    idRow n k
      = List.set (List.replicate n BPair.unit) k (BPair.ofPos .one)
proof:
:= by
  refine ground.getAt_ext BPair.unit _ _
    (by rw [length_idRow, ground.length_set, ground.length_replicate])
    (fun i hi => ?_)
  rw [length_idRow] at hi
  rw [getAt_idRow n k i hi]
  by_cases hik : i = k
  · have hk : k < n := by
      rw [← hik]
      exact hi
    rw [if_pos hik, hik,
      ground.getAt_set_self BPair.unit (BPair.ofPos .one)
        (List.replicate n BPair.unit) k
        (by rw [ground.length_replicate]; exact hk)]
    rfl
  · rw [if_neg hik,
      ground.getAt_set_ne BPair.unit (List.replicate n BPair.unit) k i
        (BPair.ofPos .one) hik,
      ground.getAt_replicate_self BPair.unit n i]

name: length_idMat
statement: theorem length_idMat (n : Nat) : (idMat n).length = n
proof:
:=
  ground.length_mapRange _ n

name: rowsLen_idMat
statement: theorem rowsLen_idMat (n : Nat) : rowsLen n (idMat n)
proof:
:=
  rowsLen_map _ n (List.range n) (fun x _ => length_idRow n x)

name: idMat_row
statement:
theorem idMat_row (n i : Nat) (hi : i < n) :
    ground.getAt ([] : List BPair) (idMat n) i = idRow n i
proof:
:=
  ground.matOf_row [] n n _ i hi

name: getAt_idMat
statement:
theorem getAt_idMat (n i j : Nat) (hi : i < n) (hj : j < n) :
    ground.getAt BPair.unit
        (ground.getAt ([] : List BPair) (idMat n) i) j
      = if j = i then BPair.ofNat 1 else BPair.unit
proof:
:=
  ground.matOf_entry [] BPair.unit n n _ i j hi hj

name: dotP_idRow
statement:
theorem dotP_idRow (u : List BPair) (n i : Nat)
    (hu : u.length = n) (hi : i < n) :
    (dotP u (idRow n i)).oneValue (ground.getAt BPair.unit u i)
proof:
:= by
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans
    (dotP_oneIndex u (idRow n i) i (by rw [hu, length_idRow])
      (by rw [length_idRow]; exact hi) ?_) ?_
  · intro q hq hne
    rw [length_idRow] at hq
    rw [getAt_idRow n i q hq, if_neg hne]
    exact BPair.oneValue_refl _
  · rw [getAt_idRow n i i hi, if_pos rfl]
    exact BPair.mul_ofNat_one _

name: indep_elim
statement:
theorem indep_elim {n : Nat} {L : Mat} (h : indepRows n L) :
    ∀ cs, cs.length = L.length → poly.unitTail (combo n cs L) →
      poly.unitTail cs
proof:
:= by
  intro cs hcl hnull
  obtain ⟨hLn, hdet⟩ := h
  refine unitTail_of_getAt cs (fun k hk => ?_)
  rw [hcl] at hk
  have hGl : (gramM L).length = L.length := length_gramM L
  have hkG : k < (gramM L).length := by rw [hGl]; exact hk
  have hMl : (L.map (fun row =>
      dotP (combo n (cofVec (gramM L) k) L) row)).length
      = L.length := ground.length_map _ L
  have hrowG : ∀ i, i < L.length →
      (ground.getAt [] (gramM L) i).length = (gramM L).length := by
    intro i hi
    rw [sqAt_row_len (gram_sqAt L) i (by rw [hGl]; exact hi), hGl]
  have hentry : ∀ i, i < L.length →
      (ground.getAt BPair.unit (L.map (fun row =>
        dotP (combo n (cofVec (gramM L) k) L) row)) i).oneValue
        (dotP (ground.getAt [] (gramM L) i)
          (cofVec (gramM L) k)) := by
    intro i hi
    rw [ground.getAt_map ([] : List BPair) BPair.unit
      (fun row => dotP (combo n (cofVec (gramM L) k) L) row)
      L i hi]
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.oneValue_of_eq (dotP_comm _ _)) ?_
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans
      (dotP_combo (cofVec (gramM L) k) L (ground.getAt [] L i) n
        hLn) ?_
    rw [show L.map (fun row => dotP (ground.getAt [] L i) row)
        = ground.getAt [] (gramM L) i from
      (gramM_row L i hi).symm]
    exact BPair.oneValue_of_eq (dotP_comm (cofVec (gramM L) k)
      (ground.getAt [] (gramM L) i))
  have hpick := dotP_oneIndex cs
    (L.map (fun row =>
      dotP (combo n (cofVec (gramM L) k) L) row)) k
    (by rw [hMl, hcl]) (by rw [hMl]; exact hk)
    (fun q hq hqk => by
      rw [hMl] at hq
      exact BPair.oneValue_trans (hentry q hq)
        (cofVec_off (gramM L) q k (by rw [hGl]; exact hq) hkG hqk
          (hrowG q hq)))
  have hnullS : (dotP cs (L.map (fun row =>
      dotP (combo n (cofVec (gramM L) k) L) row))).oneValue
      BPair.unit :=
    BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.oneValue_symm
        (dotP_combo cs L (combo n (cofVec (gramM L) k) L) n
          hLn))
      (dotP_null_right (combo n (cofVec (gramM L) k) L)
        (combo n cs L)
        (fun i _ => poly.getAt_unitTail hnull i))
  refine mul_cancel_unit hdet ?_
  rw [BPair.mul_comm (detL (gramM L))
    (ground.getAt BPair.unit cs k)]
  exact BPair.oneValue_trans
    (BPair.oneValue_symm
      (BPair.oneValue_trans hpick
        (BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl _)
          (BPair.oneValue_trans (hentry k hk)
            (cofVec_diag (gramM L) k hkG (hrowG k hk))))))
    hnullS

name: indep_perp_null
statement:
theorem indep_perp_null (n : Nat) (L : Mat) (hind : indepRows n L)
    (f : List BPair) (hf : f.length = L.length)
    (hperp : ∀ l, l < L.length →
      (dotP (combo n f L) (ground.getAt [] L l)).oneValue
        BPair.unit) :
    poly.unitTail f
proof:
:=
  indep_elim hind f hf
    (combo_self_null n L hind.1 f (fun i hi => by
      rw [dotP_comm]
      exact hperp i hi))

name: indep_extendE
statement:
private theorem indep_extendE (n : Nat) (L : Mat) (v : List BPair)
    (hLn : rowsLen n L) (hv : v.length = n)
    (hind : indepRows n L) (hns : ¬ spanRelE n L v) :
    indepRows n (L ++ [v])
proof:
:= by
  refine indep_intro n (L ++ [v])
    (rowsLen_append n hLn ⟨hv, trivial⟩) ?_
  intro cs' hlen hnull
  match splitLast cs' with
  | Or.inl he =>
    rw [he, ground.length_append] at hlen
    exact nomatch hlen
  | Or.inr ⟨cs, c, he⟩ =>
    rw [he] at hlen hnull ⊢
    have hcl : cs.length = L.length := by
      rw [ground.length_append, ground.length_append] at hlen
      exact Nat.succ.inj hlen
    have hco := combo_append_one n cs c L v hcl hLn hv
    have h1 : poly.unitTail (vecAdd (combo n cs L)
        (vecScale c v)) :=
      poly.unitTail_oneValue_right hnull hco
    by_cases hcu : c.oneValue BPair.unit
    · have h2 : poly.unitTail (combo n cs L) :=
        unitTail_split_left
          (by rw [length_combo n cs L hLn, length_vecScale, hv])
          h1 (unitTail_vecScale_unit hcu v)
      exact unitTail_append (indep_elim hind cs hcl h2)
        ⟨hcu, trivial⟩
    · refine absurd ⟨c, cs.map BPair.swap, hcu,
        (by rw [ground.length_map]; exact hcl), ?_⟩ hns
      rw [combo_swapMap n cs L]
      exact swap_of_null_add (combo n cs L) (vecScale c v)
        (by rw [length_combo n cs L hLn, length_vecScale, hv]) h1

name: indep_nil
statement: theorem indep_nil (n : Nat) : indepRows n ([] : Mat)
proof:
:=
  ⟨trivial, det_nil⟩

name: indep_single
statement:
theorem indep_single (n : Nat) (r : List BPair)
    (hrn : r.length = n) (hr : ¬ poly.unitTail r) :
    indepRows n [r]
proof:
:= by
  refine indep_intro n [r] ⟨hrn, trivial⟩ ?_
  intro cs hlen hnull
  match cs, hlen with
  | [], hl => exact nomatch hl
  | _ :: _ :: _, hl => exact nomatch (Nat.succ.inj hl)
  | [c], _ =>
    have hnull' : poly.unitTail (vecAdd (vecScale c r)
        (List.replicate n BPair.unit)) := hnull
    match poly.offUnit_witness r hr with
    | ⟨k, hk, hrk⟩ =>
      have hkn : k < n := by
        rw [← hrn]
        exact hk
      have hkv : k < (vecAdd (vecScale c r)
          (List.replicate n BPair.unit)).length := by
        rw [length_vecAdd _ _ n
          (by
            rw [length_vecScale c r]
            exact hrn)
          (ground.length_replicate BPair.unit n)]
        exact hkn
      have hget := poly.getAt_unitTail hnull' k
      rw [getAt_vecAdd _ _ k
          (by
            rw [length_vecScale c r]
            exact hk)
          (by
            rw [ground.length_replicate]
            exact hkn),
        getAt_vecScale c r k hk] at hget
      have hrep := poly.getAt_unitTail (poly.unitTail_replicate n) k
      have h2 : (c * ground.getAt BPair.unit r k).oneValue
          BPair.unit :=
        BPair.oneValue_trans
          (BPair.oneValue_symm (BPair.oneValue_trans
            (BPair.add_congr
              (BPair.oneValue_refl (c * ground.getAt BPair.unit r k))
              hrep)
            (BPair.add_unit (c * ground.getAt BPair.unit r k))))
          hget
      have h3 : (ground.getAt BPair.unit r k * c).oneValue
          BPair.unit := by
        rw [BPair.mul_comm]
        exact h2
      exact ⟨mul_cancel_unit hrk h3, trivial⟩

name: indep_tail
statement:
theorem indep_tail (n : Nat) (r : List BPair) (t : Mat)
    (h : indepRows n (r :: t)) : indepRows n t
proof:
:= by
  refine indep_intro n t h.1.2 ?_
  intro cs hcl hnull
  have h1 : poly.unitTail (combo n (BPair.unit :: cs) (r :: t)) :=
    unitTail_vecAdd_of
      (unitTail_vecScale_unit (BPair.oneValue_refl BPair.unit) r)
      hnull
  exact (indep_elim h (BPair.unit :: cs)
    (congrArg Nat.succ hcl) h1).2

name: vecAdd_comm
statement:
theorem vecAdd_comm : ∀ u v : List BPair,
    vecAdd u v = vecAdd v u
  | [], [] => rfl
  | [], _ :: _ => rfl
  | _ :: _, [] => rfl
  | a :: u, b :: v => by
    show (a + b) :: vecAdd u v = (b + a) :: vecAdd v u
    rw [BPair.add_comm a b, vecAdd_comm u v]

/

name: vecAdd_assoc
statement:
theorem vecAdd_assoc : ∀ a b x : List BPair,
    vecAdd (vecAdd a b) x = vecAdd a (vecAdd b x)
  | [], _, _ => rfl
  | _ :: _, [], _ => rfl
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, [] => rfl
  | a1 :: a, b1 :: b, x1 :: x => by
    show (a1 + b1 + x1) :: vecAdd (vecAdd a b) x
      = (a1 + (b1 + x1)) :: vecAdd a (vecAdd b x)
    rw [BPair.add_assoc a1 b1 x1, vecAdd_assoc a b x]

private theorem vecAdd_left_comm (a b x : List BPair) :
    vecAdd a (vecAdd b x) = vecAdd b (vecAdd a x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← vecAdd_assoc a b x, ← vecAdd_assoc b a x, vecAdd_comm a b]

name: vecAdd_left_comm
statement:
private theorem vecAdd_left_comm (a b x : List BPair) :
    vecAdd a (vecAdd b x) = vecAdd b (vecAdd a x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← vecAdd_assoc a b x, ← vecAdd_assoc b a x, vecAdd_comm a b]

name: combo_swapAdj
statement:
private theorem combo_swapAdj (n : Nat) : ∀ (k : Nat)
    (cs : List BPair) (L : Mat), cs.length = L.length →
      combo n (ground.adjSwap k cs) (ground.adjSwap k L) = combo n cs L
  | 0, [], [], _ => rfl
  | 0, [], _ :: _, hl => nomatch hl
  | 0, _ :: _, [], hl => nomatch hl
  | 0, [_], [_], _ => rfl
  | 0, [_], _ :: _ :: _, hl => nomatch (Nat.succ.inj hl)
  | 0, _ :: _ :: _, [_], hl => nomatch (Nat.succ.inj hl)
  | 0, c :: c2 :: cs, r :: r2 :: L, _ => by
    show vecAdd (vecScale c2 r2)
        (vecAdd (vecScale c r) (combo n cs L))
      = vecAdd (vecScale c r)
        (vecAdd (vecScale c2 r2) (combo n cs L))
    exact vecAdd_left_comm _ _ _
  | _ + 1, [], [], _ => rfl
  | _ + 1, [], _ :: _, hl => nomatch hl
  | _ + 1, _ :: _, [], hl => nomatch hl
  | k + 1, c :: cs, r :: L, hl =>
    congrArg (fun z => vecAdd (vecScale c r) z)
      (combo_swapAdj n k cs L (Nat.succ.inj hl))

private theorem unitTail_adjSwap : ∀ (k : Nat) (l : List BPair),
    poly.unitTail l → poly.unitTail (ground.adjSwap k l)
  | 0, [], h => h
  | _ + 1, [], h => h
  | 0, [_], h => h
  | 0, _ :: _ :: _, h => ⟨h.2.1, h.1, h.2.2⟩
  | k + 1, _ :: t, h => ⟨h.1, unitTail_adjSwap k t h.2⟩

rows. -/

name: unitTail_adjSwap
statement:
private theorem unitTail_adjSwap : ∀ (k : Nat) (l : List BPair),
    poly.unitTail l → poly.unitTail (ground.adjSwap k l)
  | 0, [], h => h
  | _ + 1, [], h => h
  | 0, [_], h => h
  | 0, _ :: _ :: _, h => ⟨h.2.1, h.1, h.2.2⟩
  | k + 1, _ :: t, h => ⟨h.1, unitTail_adjSwap k t h.2⟩

rows. -/

name: indep_swapAdj
statement:
theorem indep_swapAdj (n k : Nat) (L : Mat)
    (h : indepRows n L) : indepRows n (ground.adjSwap k L)
proof:
:= by
  refine indep_intro n (ground.adjSwap k L)
    (rowsLen_adjSwap k L h.1) ?_
  intro cs hcl hnull
  have hsw : (ground.adjSwap k cs).length = L.length := by
    rw [ground.length_adjSwap, hcl, ground.length_adjSwap]
  have hkey : combo n (ground.adjSwap k (ground.adjSwap k cs))
      (ground.adjSwap k L) = combo n (ground.adjSwap k cs) L :=
    combo_swapAdj n k (ground.adjSwap k cs) L hsw
  rw [ground.adjSwap_adjSwap k cs] at hkey
  have h2 : poly.unitTail (combo n (ground.adjSwap k cs) L) := by
    rw [← hkey]
    exact hnull
  have h4 := unitTail_adjSwap k (ground.adjSwap k cs)
    (indep_elim h (ground.adjSwap k cs) hsw h2)
  rw [ground.adjSwap_adjSwap k cs] at h4
  exact h4

name: indep_frontRec
statement:
private theorem indep_frontRec (n : Nat) : ∀ (k : Nat) (L : Mat),
    indepRows n L → indepRows n (frontRec k L)
  | 0, _, h => h
  | k + 1, L, h =>
    indep_frontRec n k (ground.adjSwap k L) (indep_swapAdj n k L h)

the further members' order kept. -/

name: indep_focus
statement:
theorem indep_focus (n k : Nat) (L : Mat) (hk : k < L.length)
    (h : indepRows n L) :
    indepRows n (ground.getAt [] L k :: L.eraseIdx k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← frontRec_shape ([] : List BPair) k L hk]
  exact indep_frontRec n k L h

name: indep_row_off
statement:
theorem indep_row_off {n : Nat} {L : Mat} (h : indepRows n L) :
    ∀ k, k < L.length → ¬ poly.unitTail (ground.getAt [] L k)
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk ht
  have hf : indepRows n (ground.getAt [] L k :: L.eraseIdx k) :=
    indep_focus n k L hk h
  have hnull : poly.unitTail
      (combo n (BPair.ofNat 1
          :: List.replicate (L.eraseIdx k).length BPair.unit)
        (ground.getAt [] L k :: L.eraseIdx k)) := by
    show poly.unitTail (vecAdd
      (vecScale (BPair.ofNat 1) (ground.getAt [] L k))
      (combo n (List.replicate (L.eraseIdx k).length BPair.unit)
        (L.eraseIdx k)))
    exact unitTail_vecAdd_of
      (unitTail_vecScale (BPair.ofNat 1) _ ht)
      (combo_unitsT n (L.eraseIdx k) (L.eraseIdx k).length)
  have hcs := indep_elim hf
    (BPair.ofNat 1
      :: List.replicate (L.eraseIdx k).length BPair.unit)
    (by
      show (List.replicate (L.eraseIdx k).length BPair.unit).length
          + 1 = (L.eraseIdx k).length + 1
      rw [ground.length_replicate])
    hnull
  exact BPair.ofNat_one_off hcs.1

name: combo_headSplit
statement:
private theorem combo_headSplit (n : Nat) : ∀ (cs : List BPair)
    (L : Mat), cs.length = L.length → rowsLen (n + 1) L →
      combo (n + 1) cs L
        = dotP cs (colHead BPair.unit L) :: combo n cs (dropCol L)
  | [], [], _, _ => rfl
  | [], _ :: _, hl, _ => nomatch hl
  | _ :: _, [], hl, _ => nomatch hl
  | _ :: _, [] :: _, _, hL => nomatch hL.1
  | c :: cs, (a :: r) :: L, hl, hL =>
    congrArg (fun z => vecAdd (c * a :: vecScale c r) z)
      (combo_headSplit n cs L (Nat.succ.inj hl) hL.2)

private theorem indep_tails (n : Nat) (L : Mat)
    (hL : rowsLen (n + 1) L)
    (hU : poly.unitTail (colHead BPair.unit L))
    (h : indepRows (n + 1) L) : indepRows n (dropCol L)
proof:
:= by
  refine indep_intro n (dropCol L) (rowsLen_dropCol n L hL) ?_
  intro cs hcl hnull
  have hcl' : cs.length = L.length := by
    rw [hcl, length_dropCol]
  refine indep_elim h cs hcl' ?_
  rw [combo_headSplit n cs L hcl' hL]
  exact ⟨dotP_null_tail_right cs (colHead BPair.unit L) hU, hnull⟩

name: indep_tails
statement:
private theorem indep_tails (n : Nat) (L : Mat)
    (hL : rowsLen (n + 1) L)
    (hU : poly.unitTail (colHead BPair.unit L))
    (h : indepRows (n + 1) L) : indepRows n (dropCol L)
proof:
:= by
  refine indep_intro n (dropCol L) (rowsLen_dropCol n L hL) ?_
  intro cs hcl hnull
  have hcl' : cs.length = L.length := by
    rw [hcl, length_dropCol]
  refine indep_elim h cs hcl' ?_
  rw [combo_headSplit n cs L hcl' hL]
  exact ⟨dotP_null_tail_right cs (colHead BPair.unit L) hU, hnull⟩

name: length_elimRows
statement:
private theorem length_elimRows (P : List BPair) (P0 : BPair)
    (R : Mat) : (elimRows P P0 R).length = R.length
proof:
:=
  ground.length_map _ R

name: rowsLen_elim
statement:
private theorem rowsLen_elim (n : Nat) (P : List BPair) (P0 : BPair)
    (hP : P.length = n + 1) : ∀ R : Mat, rowsLen (n + 1) R →
      rowsLen (n + 1) (elimRows P P0 R)
  | [], _ => trivial
  | s :: R, hR =>
    ⟨length_vecAdd _ _ (n + 1)
      ((length_vecScale P0 s).trans hR.1)
      ((length_vecScale _ P).trans hP),
     rowsLen_elim n P P0 hP R hR.2⟩

private theorem colHead_elim_unit (P0 : BPair) (Pt : List BPair) :
    ∀ R : Mat,
      poly.unitTail (colHead BPair.unit (elimRows (P0 :: Pt) P0 R))
  | [] => trivial
  | [] :: R =>
    ⟨BPair.oneValue_refl BPair.unit, colHead_elim_unit P0 Pt R⟩
  | (a :: _) :: R => by
    refine ⟨?_, colHead_elim_unit P0 Pt R⟩
    show (P0 * a + BPair.swap a * P0).oneValue BPair.unit
    have h1 : (a + BPair.swap a).oneValue BPair.unit
proof:
:= by
      rw [BPair.add_comm]
      exact BPair.swap_add_null (BPair.oneValue_refl a)
    have h2 : P0 * a + BPair.swap a * P0 = P0 * (a + BPair.swap a) := by
      rw [BPair.mul_comm (BPair.swap a) P0, BPair.left_distrib]
    rw [h2]
    exact BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl P0) h1)
      (BPair.mul_unit P0)

name: colHead_elim_unit
statement:
private theorem colHead_elim_unit (P0 : BPair) (Pt : List BPair) :
    ∀ R : Mat,
      poly.unitTail (colHead BPair.unit (elimRows (P0 :: Pt) P0 R))
  | [] => trivial
  | [] :: R =>
    ⟨BPair.oneValue_refl BPair.unit, colHead_elim_unit P0 Pt R⟩
  | (a :: _) :: R => by
    refine ⟨?_, colHead_elim_unit P0 Pt R⟩
    show (P0 * a + BPair.swap a * P0).oneValue BPair.unit
    have h1 : (a + BPair.swap a).oneValue BPair.unit
proof:
:= by
      rw [BPair.add_comm]
      exact BPair.swap_add_null (BPair.oneValue_refl a)
    have h2 : P0 * a + BPair.swap a * P0 = P0 * (a + BPair.swap a) := by
      rw [BPair.mul_comm (BPair.swap a) P0, BPair.left_distrib]
    rw [h2]
    exact BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl P0) h1)
      (BPair.mul_unit P0)

name: combo_elim
statement:
private theorem combo_elim (n : Nat) (P : List BPair) (P0 : BPair)
    (hP : P.length = n + 1) : ∀ (cs : List BPair) (R : Mat),
      cs.length = R.length → rowsLen (n + 1) R →
      poly.oneValue (combo (n + 1) cs (elimRows P P0 R))
        (vecAdd (vecScale (swapFold cs R) P)
          (combo (n + 1) (vecScale P0 cs) R))
  | [], [], _, _ =>
    poly.unitTail_oneValue (poly.unitTail_replicate (n + 1))
      (unitTail_vecAdd_of
        (unitTail_vecScale_unit (BPair.oneValue_refl BPair.unit) P)
        (poly.unitTail_replicate (n + 1)))
  | [], _ :: _, hl, _ => nomatch hl
  | _ :: _, [], hl, _ => nomatch hl
  | c :: cs, s :: R, hl, hR => by
    have hYlen : (combo (n + 1) cs (elimRows P P0 R)).length = n + 1
proof:
:=
      length_combo (n + 1) cs (elimRows P P0 R)
        (rowsLen_elim n P P0 hP R hR.2)
    have hZlen : (vecAdd (vecScale (swapFold cs R) P)
        (combo (n + 1) (vecScale P0 cs) R)).length = n + 1 :=
      length_vecAdd _ _ (n + 1)
        ((length_vecScale (swapFold cs R) P).trans hP)
        (length_combo (n + 1) (vecScale P0 cs) R hR.2)
    show poly.oneValue
      (vecAdd (vecScale c (vecAdd (vecScale P0 s)
          (vecScale (BPair.swap (ground.getAt BPair.unit s 0)) P)))
        (combo (n + 1) cs (elimRows P P0 R)))
      (vecAdd (vecScale (c * BPair.swap
            (ground.getAt BPair.unit s 0) + swapFold cs R) P)
        (vecAdd (vecScale (P0 * c) s)
          (combo (n + 1) (vecScale P0 cs) R)))
    rw [vecScale_vecAdd c (vecScale P0 s)
        (vecScale (BPair.swap (ground.getAt BPair.unit s 0)) P),
      vecScale_vecScale c P0 s,
      vecScale_vecScale c (BPair.swap (ground.getAt BPair.unit s 0)) P,
      vecScale_add (c * BPair.swap (ground.getAt BPair.unit s 0))
        (swapFold cs R) P,
      BPair.mul_comm P0 c,
      vecAdd_add_comm
        (vecScale (c * BPair.swap (ground.getAt BPair.unit s 0)) P)
        (vecScale (swapFold cs R) P)
        (vecScale (c * P0) s)
        (combo (n + 1) (vecScale P0 cs) R),
      vecAdd_comm
        (vecScale (c * BPair.swap (ground.getAt BPair.unit s 0)) P)
        (vecScale (c * P0) s)]
    exact polyOne_vecAdd _ _ _ _ (polyOne_refl _)
      (combo_elim n P P0 hP cs R (Nat.succ.inj hl) hR.2) rfl
      (hYlen.trans hZlen.symm)

name: bound_step
statement:
private theorem bound_step (n : Nat) (P0 : BPair) (Pt : List BPair)
    (R : Mat) (hPt : Pt.length = n) (hR : rowsLen (n + 1) R)
    (hP0 : ¬ P0.oneValue BPair.unit)
    (hfoc : indepRows (n + 1) ((P0 :: Pt) :: R))
    (ih : ∀ M : Mat, rowsLen n M → indepRows n M → M.length ≤ n) :
    R.length ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  have hP : (P0 :: Pt).length = n + 1 := congrArg Nat.succ hPt
  have hR' : rowsLen (n + 1) (elimRows (P0 :: Pt) P0 R) :=
    rowsLen_elim n (P0 :: Pt) P0 hP R hR
  have hind : indepRows (n + 1) (elimRows (P0 :: Pt) P0 R) := by
    refine indep_intro (n + 1) (elimRows (P0 :: Pt) P0 R) hR' ?_
    intro cs hcl hnull
    have hcl2 : cs.length = R.length :=
      hcl.trans (length_elimRows (P0 :: Pt) P0 R)
    have h1 : poly.unitTail
        (combo (n + 1) (swapFold cs R :: vecScale P0 cs)
          ((P0 :: Pt) :: R)) :=
      poly.unitTail_oneValue_right hnull
        (combo_elim n (P0 :: Pt) P0 hP cs R hcl2 hR)
    have h2 := indep_elim hfoc (swapFold cs R :: vecScale P0 cs)
      (congrArg Nat.succ ((length_vecScale P0 cs).trans hcl2)) h1
    exact unitTail_unscale P0 hP0 cs h2.2
  have h3 := ih (dropCol (elimRows (P0 :: Pt) P0 R))
    (rowsLen_dropCol n _ hR')
    (indep_tails n _ hR' (colHead_elim_unit P0 Pt R) hind)
  rw [length_dropCol, length_elimRows] at h3
  exact h3

name: unitTail_of_len_zero
statement:
private theorem unitTail_of_len_zero : ∀ u : List BPair,
    u.length = 0 → poly.unitTail u
  | [], _ => trivial
  | _ :: _, hl => nomatch hl

private theorem bound_zero : ∀ L : Mat, rowsLen 0 L →
    indepRows 0 L → L.length ≤ 0
  | [], _, _ => Nat.le_refl 0
  | r :: t, hL, h =>
    absurd
      (indep_elim h
        (BPair.ofNat 1 :: List.replicate t.length BPair.unit)
        (congrArg Nat.succ
          (ground.length_replicate BPair.unit t.length))
        (unitTail_of_len_zero _
          (length_combo 0 _ (r :: t) hL))).1
      BPair.ofNat_one_off

private theorem bound_succ (n : Nat)
    (ih : ∀ M : Mat, rowsLen n M → indepRows n M → M.length ≤ n) :
    ∀ L : Mat, rowsLen (n + 1) L → indepRows (n + 1) L →
      L.length ≤ n + 1
proof:
:= by
  intro L hL h
  by_cases hU : poly.unitTail (colHead BPair.unit L)
  · have h3 := ih (dropCol L) (rowsLen_dropCol n L hL)
      (indep_tails n L hL hU h)
    rw [length_dropCol] at h3
    exact Nat.le_trans h3 (Nat.le_succ n)
  · match poly.offUnit_witness (colHead BPair.unit L) hU with
    | ⟨k, hk, hks⟩ =>
      have hk' : k < L.length := by
        rw [← length_colHead BPair.unit L]
        exact hk
      have hfin : ∀ P : List BPair, P.length = n + 1 →
          ¬ (ground.getAt BPair.unit P 0).oneValue BPair.unit →
          indepRows (n + 1) (P :: L.eraseIdx k) →
          (L.eraseIdx k).length ≤ n := by
        intro P hPl
        match P, hPl with
        | [], hp => exact nomatch hp
        | P0 :: Pt, hp =>
          intro hh hf
          exact bound_step n P0 Pt (L.eraseIdx k) (Nat.succ.inj hp)
            (rowsLen_eraseIdx (n + 1) L k hL) hh hf ih
      have hle := hfin (ground.getAt [] L k)
        (rowsLen_getAt L k hL hk')
        (by
          rw [show ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] L k) 0
              = ground.getAt BPair.unit (colHead BPair.unit L) k from
            (getAt_colHead BPair.unit L k hk').symm]
          exact hks)
        (indep_focus (n + 1) k L hk' h)
      rw [← length_eraseIdx L k hk']
      exact Nat.succ_le_succ hle

name: indep_bound
statement:
theorem indep_bound (n : Nat) : ∀ L : Mat, rowsLen n L →
    indepRows n L → L.length ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact bound_zero
  | succ n ih => exact bound_succ n ih

name: rows_append_gen
statement:
private theorem rows_append_gen {P : List BPair → Prop} (A : Mat)
    (v : List BPair)
    (hA : ∀ p, p < A.length → P (ground.getAt [] A p))
    (hv : P v) :
    ∀ p, p < (A ++ [v]).length →
      P (ground.getAt [] (A ++ [v]) p)
proof:
:=
  ground.getAt_append_all ([] : List BPair) P A [v] hA
    (fun k hk =>
      match k, hk with
      | 0, _ => hv
      | q' + 1, h2 =>
        absurd (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ h2)
          (Nat.not_succ_le_zero q'))

name: joinStep_pass
statement:
private theorem joinStep_pass (n : Nat) (B : Mat) (r : List BPair)
    (h : poly.unitTail (residV n B r)) : joinStep n B r = B
proof:
:= by
  show (if poly.unitTail (residV n B r) then B else B ++ [r]) = B
  rw [if_pos h]

name: joinStep_join
proof:
:= by
  show (if poly.unitTail (residV n B r) then B else B ++ [r])
    = B ++ [r]
  rw [if_neg h]

name: joinStep_rows
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ht : poly.unitTail (residV n B r)
  · rw [joinStep_pass n B r ht]; exact hB
  · rw [joinStep_join n B r ht]
    exact rowsLen_append n hB ⟨hr, trivial⟩

name: joinStep_indep
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ht : poly.unitTail (residV n B r)
  · rw [joinStep_pass n B r ht]; exact hB
  · rw [joinStep_join n B r ht]
    exact indep_extendE n B r hB.1 hr hB
      (fun hE => ht (resid_completeE n B r hB.1 hr hE))

name: collect_rowsLen_go
statement:
private theorem collect_rowsLen_go (n : Nat) :
    ∀ (R B : Mat), rowsLen n R → rowsLen n B →
      rowsLen n (R.foldl (joinStep n) B)
  | [], _, _, hB => hB
  | r :: R, B, hR, hB =>
    collect_rowsLen_go n R (joinStep n B r) hR.2
      (joinStep_rows n B r hB hR.1)

/
span stays a member of the collected list's. -/
private theorem collect_grow_go (n : Nat) :
    ∀ (R B : Mat) (x : List BPair), rowsLen n R → rowsLen n B →
      spanRelE n B x → spanRelE n (R.foldl (joinStep n) B) x
  | [], _, _, _, _, h => h
  | r :: R, B, x, hR, hB, h => by
    refine collect_grow_go n R (joinStep n B r) x hR.2
      (joinStep_rows n B r hB hR.1) ?_
    by_cases ht : poly.unitTail (residV n B r)
    · rw [joinStep_pass n B r ht]; exact h
    · rw [joinStep_join n B r ht]
      exact spanE_mono n B [r] x hB ⟨hR.1, trivial⟩ h

private theorem collect_indep_go (n : Nat) :
    ∀ (R B : Mat), rowsLen n R → indepRows n B →
      indepRows n (R.foldl (joinStep n) B)
  | [], _, _, hB => hB
  | r :: R, B, hR, hB =>
    collect_indep_go n R (joinStep n B r) hR.2
      (joinStep_indep n B r hB hR.1)

/
memberwise swap, the swap the subtraction's read. -/

name: collect_grow_go
statement:
private theorem collect_grow_go (n : Nat) :
    ∀ (R B : Mat) (x : List BPair), rowsLen n R → rowsLen n B →

  | r :: R, B, x, hR, hB, h => by

      (joinStep_rows n B r hB hR.1) ?_

    · rw [joinStep_pass n B r ht]; exact h

name: null_swap_add
statement:
theorem null_swap_add : ∀ a b : List BPair,
    poly.oneValue a b →
    poly.unitTail (vecAdd (a.map BPair.swap) b)
  | [], _, _ => trivial
  | _ :: _, [], _ => trivial
  | _ :: a, _ :: b, h =>
    ⟨ground.BPair.swap_add_null h.1, null_swap_add a b h.2⟩

/
witness's clearing joins the family's coefficients at the member's
row to a dependency of the extended list, which its independence
reads at the unit family, against the clearing off the sum's unit
(`lem:lowerspan`'s own-collection read). -/

name: indep_refuseE
statement:
theorem indep_refuseE (n : Nat) (L : Mat) (v : List BPair)
    (hind : indepRows n (L ++ [v]))
    (h : ∃ c₀ cs, (¬ c₀.oneValue BPair.unit) ∧ cs.length = L.length
      ∧ poly.oneValue (vecScale c₀ v) (combo n cs L)) : False
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hLn, hv⟩ := rowsLen_split n L v hind.1
  obtain ⟨c₀, cs, hc₀, hcsl, hone⟩ := h
  have hnull : poly.unitTail
      (combo n (cs.map BPair.swap ++ [c₀]) (L ++ [v])) := by
    refine poly.oneValue_unitTail
      (combo_append_one n (cs.map BPair.swap) c₀ L v
        (by rw [ground.length_map]; exact hcsl) hLn hv) ?_
    rw [combo_swapMap n cs L]
    exact null_swap_add (combo n cs L) (vecScale c₀ v)
      (poly.oneValue_symm hone)
  have hcs := indep_elim hind (cs.map BPair.swap ++ [c₀])
    (by rw [ground.length_append, ground.length_append, ground.length_map,
      hcsl]; rfl) hnull
  exact hc₀ ((unitTail_append_split _ _ hcs).2).1

name: indep_ofPrefix
statement:
private theorem indep_ofPrefix (n : Nat) : ∀ (R B : Mat),
    rowsLen n B → rowsLen n R → indepRows n (B ++ R) → indepRows n B
  | [], B, _, _, h => by
    rw [ground.append_nil B] at h
    exact h
  | r :: R, B, hB, hR, h => by
    have hBr : indepRows n (B ++ [r])
proof:
:= by
      refine indep_ofPrefix n R (B ++ [r])
        (rowsLen_append n hB ⟨hR.1, trivial⟩) hR.2 ?_
      rw [ground.append_assoc B [r] R]
      exact h
    exact indep_intro n B hB
      (indep_dropLast n B r hB hR.1 (indep_elim hBr))

name: collect_keep_go
statement:
private theorem collect_keep_go (n : Nat) : ∀ (R B : Mat),
    rowsLen n B → rowsLen n R → indepRows n (B ++ R) →
      R.foldl (joinStep n) B = B ++ R
  | [], B, _, _, _ => (ground.append_nil B).symm
  | r :: R, B, hB, hR, h => by
    have hBrR : indepRows n ((B ++ [r]) ++ R)
proof:
:= by
      rw [ground.append_assoc B [r] R]
      exact h
    have hBrows : rowsLen n (B ++ [r]) :=
      rowsLen_append n hB ⟨hR.1, trivial⟩
    have hBr : indepRows n (B ++ [r]) :=
      indep_ofPrefix n R (B ++ [r]) hBrows hR.2 hBrR
    have hBind : indepRows n B :=
      indep_ofPrefix n [r] B hB ⟨hR.1, trivial⟩ hBr
    have hstep : ¬ poly.unitTail (residV n B r) := fun ht =>
      indep_refuseE n B r hBr
        (resid_soundE n B r hB hR.1 (indep_det n B hBind) ht)
    show R.foldl (joinStep n) (joinStep n B r) = B ++ r :: R
    rw [joinStep_join n B r hstep,
      collect_keep_go n R (B ++ [r]) hBrows hR.2 hBrR,
      ground.append_assoc B [r] R]
    rfl

name: collect_keep
statement:
theorem collect_keep (n : Nat) (L : Mat) (hind : indepRows n L) :
    collectOf n L = L
proof:
:=
  collect_keep_go n L [] trivial hind.1 hind

name: collect_spans_go
statement:
private theorem collect_spans_go (n : Nat) :
    ∀ (R B : Mat), rowsLen n R → indepRows n B →
      ∀ k, k < R.length →
        spanRelE n (R.foldl (joinStep n) B) (ground.getAt [] R k)
  | [], _, _, _, k, hk => absurd hk (Nat.not_lt_zero k)
  | r :: R, B, hR, hB, 0, _ => by
    show spanRelE n (R.foldl (joinStep n) (joinStep n B r)) r
    by_cases ht : poly.unitTail (residV n B r)
    · rw [joinStep_pass n B r ht]
      exact collect_grow_go n R B r hR.2 hB.1
        (resid_soundE n B r hB.1 hR.1 (indep_det n B hB) ht)
    · rw [joinStep_join n B r ht]
      have hBr : rowsLen n (B ++ [r])
proof:
:=
        rowsLen_append n hB.1 ⟨hR.1, trivial⟩
      refine collect_grow_go n R (B ++ [r]) r hR.2 hBr ?_
      have hlt : B.length < (B ++ [r]).length := by
        rw [ground.length_append]
        exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.le_refl B.length)
      have hmem := spanE_getAt n (B ++ [r]) B.length hlt hBr
      rw [show ground.getAt ([] : List BPair) (B ++ [r]) B.length = r
        from ground.getAt_append_add ([] : List BPair) B [r] 0]
        at hmem
      exact hmem
  | r :: R, B, hR, hB, k + 1, hk =>
    collect_spans_go n R (joinStep n B r) hR.2
      (joinStep_indep n B r hB hR.1) k (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hk)

name: collect_sub_go
statement:
private theorem collect_sub_go (n : Nat) (L : Mat) :
    ∀ (R B : Mat),
      (∀ k, k < B.length → spanRelE n L (ground.getAt [] B k)) →
      (∀ j, j < R.length → spanRelE n L (ground.getAt [] R j)) →
      ∀ k, k < (R.foldl (joinStep n) B).length →
        spanRelE n L (ground.getAt [] (R.foldl (joinStep n) B) k)
  | [], _, hB, _ => hB
  | r :: R, B, hB, hR => by
    have hstep : ∀ k, k < (joinStep n B r).length →
        spanRelE n L (ground.getAt [] (joinStep n B r) k)
proof:
:= by
      by_cases ht : poly.unitTail (residV n B r)
      · rw [joinStep_pass n B r ht]; exact hB
      · rw [joinStep_join n B r ht]
        exact rows_append_gen B r hB (hR 0 (Nat.succ_pos _))
    exact collect_sub_go n L R (joinStep n B r) hstep
      (fun j hj => hR (j + 1) (Nat.succ_lt_succ hj))

name: collect_rowsLen
statement:
theorem collect_rowsLen (n : Nat) (L : Mat)
    (hL : rowsLen n L) : rowsLen n (collectOf n L)
proof:
:=
  collect_rowsLen_go n L [] hL trivial

name: collect_indep
statement:
theorem collect_indep (n : Nat) (L : Mat)
    (hL : rowsLen n L) : indepRows n (collectOf n L)
proof:
:=
  collect_indep_go n L [] hL (indep_nil n)

name: collect_spans
statement:
private theorem collect_spans (n : Nat) (L : Mat)
    (hL : rowsLen n L) :
    ∀ k, k < L.length →
      spanRelE n (collectOf n L) (ground.getAt [] L k)
proof:
:=
  collect_spans_go n L [] hL (indep_nil n)

name: collect_sub
statement:
private theorem collect_sub (n : Nat) (L : Mat)
    (hL : rowsLen n L) :
    ∀ k, k < (collectOf n L).length →
      spanRelE n L (ground.getAt [] (collectOf n L) k)
proof:
:=
  collect_sub_go n L L [] (fun k hk => absurd hk (Nat.not_lt_zero k))
    (fun j hj => spanE_getAt n L j hj hL)

name: span_intro
statement:
theorem span_intro (n : Nat) (L : Mat) (v : List BPair)
    (hLn : rowsLen n L) (hv : v.length = n)
    (h : ∃ c₀ cs, (¬ c₀.oneValue BPair.unit) ∧ cs.length = L.length
      ∧ poly.oneValue (vecScale c₀ v) (combo n cs L)) :
    spanRel n L v
proof:
:=
  ⟨hLn, hv,
    resid_completeE n (collectOf n L) v (collect_rowsLen n L hLn) hv
      (spanE_trans n L (collectOf n L) v hLn
        (collect_rowsLen n L hLn) (collect_spans n L hLn) h)⟩

name: collect_span_row
statement:
theorem collect_span_row (n : Nat) (L : Mat)
    (hL : rowsLen n L) :
    ∀ k, k < L.length →
      spanRel n (collectOf n L) (ground.getAt [] L k)
proof:
:=
  fun k hk =>
    span_intro n (collectOf n L) _ (collect_rowsLen n L hL)
      (rowsLen_getAt L k hL hk) (collect_spans n L hL k hk)

name: collect_row_span
statement:
theorem collect_row_span (n : Nat) (L : Mat)
    (hL : rowsLen n L) :
    ∀ k, k < (collectOf n L).length →
      spanRel n L (ground.getAt [] (collectOf n L) k)
proof:
:=
  fun k hk =>
    span_intro n L _ hL
      (rowsLen_getAt (collectOf n L) k (collect_rowsLen n L hL) hk)
      (collect_sub n L hL k hk)

name: span_elim
statement:
theorem span_elim {n : Nat} {L : Mat} {v : List BPair}
    (h : spanRel n L v) :
    ∃ c₀ cs, (¬ c₀.oneValue BPair.unit) ∧ cs.length = L.length
      ∧ poly.oneValue (vecScale c₀ v) (combo n cs L)
proof:
:=
  spanE_trans n (collectOf n L) L v (collect_rowsLen n L h.1) h.1
    (collect_sub n L h.1)
    (resid_soundE n (collectOf n L) v (collect_rowsLen n L h.1)
      h.2.1
      (indep_det n (collectOf n L) (collect_indep n L h.1))
      h.2.2)

name: resid_sound
statement:
theorem resid_sound (n : Nat) (L : Mat) (v : List BPair)
    (hLn : rowsLen n L) (hv : v.length = n)
    (hdet : ¬ (detL (gramM L)).oneValue BPair.unit)
    (h : poly.unitTail (residV n L v)) : spanRel n L v
proof:
:=
  span_intro n L v hLn hv (resid_soundE n L v hLn hv hdet h)

name: resid_complete
statement:
theorem resid_complete (n : Nat) (L : Mat) (v : List BPair)
    (hLn : rowsLen n L) (hv : v.length = n)
    (hsp : spanRel n L v) : poly.unitTail (residV n L v)
proof:
:=
  resid_completeE n L v hLn hv (span_elim hsp)

name: spanRel_mono
statement:
theorem spanRel_mono (n : Nat) (L M : Mat) (v : List BPair)
    (hL : rowsLen n L) (hM : rowsLen n M)
    (h : spanRel n L v) : spanRel n (L ++ M) v
proof:
:=
  span_intro n (L ++ M) v (rowsLen_append n hL hM) h.2.1
    (spanE_mono n L M v hL hM (span_elim h))

name: spanRel_getAt
statement:
theorem spanRel_getAt (n : Nat) :
    ∀ (L : Mat) (k : Nat), k < L.length → rowsLen n L →

name: spanRel_null

name: spanRel_add

name: spanRel_combo

      spanRel n M (combo n cs K)
proof:

name: spanRel_unscale

name: indep_extend
statement:

name: coord_exists
statement:
private theorem coord_exists (n : Nat) (B : Mat) : ∀ A : Mat,
    (∀ k, k < A.length → spanRel n B (ground.getAt [] A k)) →
    ∃ cs C, coordRel n B A cs C
  | [], _ => ⟨[], [], trivial⟩
  | _ :: A, h => by
    match span_elim (h 0 (Nat.succ_pos _)) with
    | ⟨c₀, r, hc₀, hrl, hone⟩ =>
      match coord_exists n B A
          (fun k hk => h (k + 1) (Nat.succ_lt_succ hk)) with
      | ⟨cs, C, hco⟩ =>
        refine ⟨c₀ :: cs, r :: C, ?_⟩
        exact ⟨hc₀, hrl, hone, hco⟩

private theorem coordRel_lenC (n : Nat) (B : Mat) :
    ∀ (A : Mat) (cs : List BPair) (C : Mat),
      coordRel n B A cs C → C.length = A.length

  | [], [], _ :: _, h => False.elim h
  | [], _ :: _, _, h => False.elim h
  | _ :: _, [], _, h => False.elim h
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, [], h => False.elim h
  | _ :: A, _ :: cs, _ :: C, h =>

  | _ :: _, _ :: _, [], h => False.elim h

theorem unitTail_combo_of (n : Nat) :

  | [], _, _ => poly.unitTail_replicate n
  | _ :: _, [], _ => poly.unitTail_replicate n
  | _ :: cs, r :: L, h =>
    unitTail_vecAdd_of (unitTail_vecScale_unit h.1 r)
      (unitTail_combo_of n cs L h.2)

statement:
theorem unitTail_combo_rows (n : Nat) :

      poly.unitTail (combo n cs L)
  | [], _, _ => poly.unitTail_replicate n
  | _ :: _, [], _ => poly.unitTail_replicate n
  | c :: cs, r :: L, h =>
    unitTail_vecAdd_of
      (unitTail_vecScale c r (h 0 (Nat.succ_pos L.length)))
      (unitTail_combo_rows n cs L
        (fun k hk => h (k + 1) (Nat.succ_lt_succ hk)))

name: collect_nil_of_units
statement:
theorem collect_nil_of_units (n : Nat) :
    ∀ L : Mat, (∀ k, k < L.length →
        poly.unitTail (ground.getAt [] L k)) →
      collectOf n L = []
  | [], _ => rfl
  | r :: t, h => by
    have hres : poly.unitTail (residV n [] r)
proof:
:=
      unitTail_vecAdd_of
        (unitTail_vecScale (detL (gramM ([] : Mat))) r
          (h 0 (Nat.succ_pos t.length)))
        (poly.unitTail_swapMap _ (poly.unitTail_replicate n))
    show (r :: t).foldl
        (fun B s =>
          if poly.unitTail (residV n B s) then B else B ++ [s]) [] = []
    rw [show (r :: t).foldl
          (fun B s =>
            if poly.unitTail (residV n B s) then B else B ++ [s]) []
        = t.foldl
            (fun B s =>
              if poly.unitTail (residV n B s) then B else B ++ [s])
            (if poly.unitTail (residV n [] r) then [] else [] ++ [r])
        from rfl,
      if_pos hres]
    exact collect_nil_of_units n t
      (fun k hk => h (k + 1) (Nat.succ_lt_succ hk))

name: spanRel_unit_of_units
statement:
theorem spanRel_unit_of_units (n : Nat) (L : Mat) (v : List BPair)
    (hrows : ∀ k, k < L.length →
        poly.unitTail (ground.getAt [] L k))
    (h : spanRel n L v) : poly.unitTail v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c₀, cs, hc₀, _, hone⟩ := span_elim h
  exact unitTail_unscale c₀ hc₀ v
    (poly.oneValue_unitTail hone (unitTail_combo_rows n cs L hrows))

name: combo_coord
statement:
private theorem combo_coord (n : Nat) (B : Mat) (hB : rowsLen n B) :
    ∀ (A : Mat) (cs : List BPair) (C : Mat) (ds : List BPair),
      rowsLen n A → coordRel n B A cs C → ds.length = A.length →
      poly.oneValue (combo n (combo B.length ds C) B)
        (combo n (List.zipWith (fun c d => c * d) cs ds) A)
  | [], [], [], [], _, _, _ =>
    poly.unitTail_oneValue (combo_unitsT n B B.length)
      (poly.unitTail_replicate n)
  | [], [], [], _ :: _, _, _, hdl => nomatch hdl
  | [], [], _ :: _, _, _, hco, _ => False.elim hco
  | [], _ :: _, _, _, _, hco, _ => False.elim hco
  | _ :: _, [], _, _, _, hco, _ => False.elim hco
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, [], _, _, hco, _ => False.elim hco
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, _ :: _, [], _, _, hdl => nomatch hdl
  | a :: A, c :: cs, r :: C, d :: ds, hA, hco, hdl => by
    have hr : r.length = B.length
proof:
:= hco.2.1
    have hone : poly.oneValue (vecScale c a) (combo n r B) := hco.2.2.1
    have hrest : coordRel n B A cs C := hco.2.2.2
    have hAn : a.length = n := hA.1
    have hK : (combo B.length ds C).length = B.length :=
      length_combo B.length ds C (coordRel_rows n B A cs C hrest)
    have hSr : (vecScale d r).length = B.length :=
      (length_vecScale d r).trans hr
    have hcrB : (combo n r B).length = n := length_combo n r B hB
    have hleft1 : poly.oneValue (combo n (vecScale d r) B)
        (vecScale d (combo n r B)) :=
      poly.oneValue_symm (vecScale_combo d n r B)
    have hleft2 : poly.oneValue (vecScale d (combo n r B))
        (vecScale d (vecScale c a)) :=
      vecScale_oneValue d (combo n r B) (vecScale c a)
        (poly.oneValue_symm hone)
    have hsc : vecScale d (vecScale c a) = vecScale (c * d) a := by
      rw [vecScale_vecScale d c a, BPair.mul_comm d c]
    have hleft : poly.oneValue (combo n (vecScale d r) B)
        (vecScale (c * d) a) := by
      rw [← hsc]
      exact poly.oneValue_trans hleft1 hleft2
    have hright : poly.oneValue (combo n (combo B.length ds C) B)
        (combo n (List.zipWith (fun c d => c * d) cs ds) A) :=
      combo_coord n B hB A cs C ds hA.2 hrest (Nat.succ.inj hdl)
    show poly.oneValue
      (combo n (vecAdd (vecScale d r) (combo B.length ds C)) B)
      (vecAdd (vecScale (c * d) a)
        (combo n (List.zipWith (fun c d => c * d) cs ds) A))
    refine poly.oneValue_trans
      (combo_vecAdd n (vecScale d r) (combo B.length ds C) B
        (hSr.trans hK.symm)) ?_
    exact polyOne_vecAdd _ _ _ _ hleft hright
      ((length_combo n (vecScale d r) B hB).trans
        ((length_vecScale (c * d) a).trans hAn).symm)
      ((length_combo n (combo B.length ds C) B hB).trans
        (length_combo n (List.zipWith (fun c d => c * d) cs ds)
          A hA.2).symm)

name: coordRel_zip_cancel
statement:
private theorem coordRel_zip_cancel (n : Nat) (B : Mat) :
    ∀ (A : Mat) (cs : List BPair) (C : Mat) (ds : List BPair),
      coordRel n B A cs C → ds.length = A.length →
      poly.unitTail (List.zipWith (fun c d => c * d) cs ds) →
      poly.unitTail ds
  | [], [], [], [], _, _, _ => trivial
  | [], [], [], _ :: _, _, hdl, _ => nomatch hdl
  | [], [], _ :: _, _, hco, _, _ => False.elim hco
  | [], _ :: _, _, _, hco, _, _ => False.elim hco
  | _ :: _, [], _, _, hco, _, _ => False.elim hco
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, [], _, hco, _, _ => False.elim hco
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, _ :: _, [], _, hdl, _ => nomatch hdl
  | _ :: A, _ :: cs, _ :: C, _ :: ds, hco, hdl, h =>
    ⟨mul_cancel_unit hco.1 h.1,
      coordRel_zip_cancel n B A cs C ds hco.2.2.2
        (Nat.succ.inj hdl) h.2⟩

/
counts at or below the second's: the members' span witnesses read
coefficient rows over the second list, independent at its count
(`lem:lowerspan`'s exchange clause), and the width bound closes
the comparison. -/

name: span_count_le
statement:
theorem span_count_le (n : Nat) (A B : Mat) (hA : rowsLen n A)
    (hB : rowsLen n B) (hiA : indepRows n A)
    (hmem : ∀ k, k < A.length → spanRel n B (ground.getAt [] A k)) :
    A.length ≤ B.length
proof:
:= by
  match coord_exists n B A hmem with
  | ⟨cs, C, hco⟩ =>
    have hCA : C.length = A.length := coordRel_lenC n B A cs C hco
    have hcsA : cs.length = A.length := coordRel_lencs n B A cs C hco
    have hCrows : rowsLen B.length C := coordRel_rows n B A cs C hco
    have hCind : indepRows B.length C := by
      refine indep_intro B.length C hCrows ?_
      intro ds hdl hnull
      have hdA : ds.length = A.length := hdl.trans hCA
      have h1 : poly.unitTail (combo n (combo B.length ds C) B) :=
        unitTail_combo_of n (combo B.length ds C) B hnull
      have h2 : poly.unitTail
          (combo n (List.zipWith (fun c d => c * d) cs ds) A) :=
        poly.unitTail_oneValue_right h1
          (combo_coord n B hB A cs C ds hA hco hdA)
      have h3 := indep_elim hiA (List.zipWith (fun c d => c * d) cs ds)
        (length_zipWith (fun c d => c * d) cs ds A.length hcsA hdA)
        h2
      exact coordRel_zip_cancel n B A cs C ds hco hdA h3
    have h4 := indep_bound B.length C hCrows hCind
    rw [← hCA]
    exact h4

name: span_count_eq
statement:
theorem span_count_eq (n : Nat) (A B : Mat) (hA : rowsLen n A)
    (hB : rowsLen n B) (hiA : indepRows n A) (hiB : indepRows n B)
    (hAB : ∀ k, k < A.length → spanRel n B (ground.getAt [] A k))
    (hBA : ∀ k, k < B.length → spanRel n A (ground.getAt [] B k)) :
    A.length = B.length
proof:
:=
  Nat.le_antisymm (span_count_le n A B hA hB hiA hAB)
    (span_count_le n B A hB hA hiB hBA)

name: matVec_null
statement:
theorem matVec_null : ∀ (T : Mat) (v : List BPair),
    poly.unitTail v → poly.unitTail (matVec T v)
  | [], _, _ => trivial
  | r :: t, v, hv => by
    show (dotN r v).oneValue BPair.unit ∧ poly.unitTail (matVec t v)
    exact ⟨BPair.oneValue_trans (dotN_read r v)
        (dotP_null_right r v
          (fun i _ => poly.getAt_unitTail hv i)),

private theorem matVec_congr_go : ∀ (T : Mat) (u u' : List BPair),
    u.length = u'.length → poly.oneValue u u' →
    poly.oneValue (matVec T u) (matVec T u')
  | [], _, _, _, _ => trivial
  | r :: t, u, u', hl, h => by
    show (dotN r u).oneValue (dotN r u')
      ∧ poly.oneValue (matVec t u) (matVec t u')
    exact ⟨BPair.oneValue_trans (dotN_read r u)
        (BPair.oneValue_trans
          (dotP_congr_right r u u' hl
            (fun i _ => poly.oneValue_getAt i h))
          (BPair.oneValue_symm (dotN_read r u'))),
      matVec_congr_go t u u' hl h⟩

name: matVec_congr_go
statement:
private theorem matVec_congr_go : ∀ (T : Mat) (u u' : List BPair),

  | [], _, _, _, _ => trivial
  | r :: t, u, u', hl, h => by

      ∧ poly.oneValue (matVec t u) (matVec t u')
    exact ⟨BPair.oneValue_trans (dotN_read r u)
        (BPair.oneValue_trans
          (dotP_congr_right r u u' hl
            (fun i _ => poly.oneValue_getAt i h))
          (BPair.oneValue_symm (dotN_read r u'))),

name: matVec_vecAdd_free
statement:
theorem matVec_vecAdd_free : ∀ (M : Mat) (u w : List BPair),
    u.length = w.length →
    poly.oneValue (matVec M (vecAdd u w))
      (vecAdd (matVec M u) (matVec M w))
  | [], _, _, _ => trivial
  | r :: t, u, w, h => by
    refine ⟨?_, matVec_vecAdd_free t u w h⟩
    exact BPair.oneValue_trans (dotN_read r (vecAdd u w))
      (BPair.oneValue_trans (dotP_vecAdd_right r u w h)
        (BPair.add_congr (BPair.oneValue_symm (dotN_read r u))
          (BPair.oneValue_symm (dotN_read r w))))
