general's one read. -/

name: matVec_vecAdd
statement:
theorem matVec_vecAdd (T : Mat) (n : Nat) (_ : rowsLen n T)
    (u w : List BPair) (hu : u.length = n) (hw : w.length = n) :
    poly.oneValue (matVec T (vecAdd u w))
      (vecAdd (matVec T u) (matVec T w))
proof:
:=
  matVec_vecAdd_free T u w (hu.trans hw.symm)

name: matVec_vecScale_free
statement:
theorem matVec_vecScale_free : ∀ (M : Mat) (c : BPair)
    (u : List BPair),
    poly.oneValue (matVec M (vecScale c u))
      (vecScale c (matVec M u))
  | [], _, _ => trivial
  | r :: t, c, u => by
    refine ⟨?_, matVec_vecScale_free t c u⟩
    exact BPair.oneValue_trans (dotN_read r (vecScale c u))
      (BPair.oneValue_trans (dotP_vecScale_right r u c)
        (BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl c)
          (BPair.oneValue_symm (dotN_read r u))))

private theorem unitReplRead (n : Nat) (v : List BPair) :
    BPair.unit.oneValue (dotP (List.replicate n BPair.unit) v)
proof:
:=
  BPair.oneValue_symm (BPair.oneValue_trans
    (BPair.oneValue_of_eq
      (dotP_comm (List.replicate n BPair.unit) v))
    (dotP_repl_unit v n))

name: unitReplRead
statement:
private theorem unitReplRead (n : Nat) (v : List BPair) :
    BPair.unit.oneValue (dotP (List.replicate n BPair.unit) v)
proof:
:=
  BPair.oneValue_symm (BPair.oneValue_trans
    (BPair.oneValue_of_eq
      (dotP_comm (List.replicate n BPair.unit) v))
    (dotP_repl_unit v n))

name: dotP_matVec_gen
statement:
private theorem dotP_matVec_gen (n : Nat) (v : List BPair)
    (hv : v.length = n) : ∀ (s : List BPair) (T : Mat),
    rowsLen n T →
      (dotP s (matVec T v)).oneValue (dotP (combo n s T) v)
  | [], _, _ => unitReplRead n v
  | _ :: _, [], _ => unitReplRead n v
  | a :: s, r :: T', hT => by
    have hr : r.length = v.length
proof:
:= hT.1.trans hv.symm
    have hX : (vecScale a r).length = v.length :=
      (length_vecScale a r).trans hr
    have hY : (combo n s T').length = v.length :=
      (length_combo n s T' hT.2).trans hv.symm
    show (a * dotN r v + dotP s (matVec T' v)).oneValue
      (dotP (vecAdd (vecScale a r) (combo n s T')) v)
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans ?_
      (BPair.oneValue_of_eq
        (dotP_comm v (vecAdd (vecScale a r) (combo n s T'))))
    refine BPair.oneValue_symm (BPair.oneValue_trans
      (dotP_vecAdd v (vecScale a r) (combo n s T') hX hY) ?_)
    refine BPair.add_congr ?_ ?_
    · exact BPair.oneValue_trans (dotP_vecScale a v r hr)
        (BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl a)
          (BPair.oneValue_trans (BPair.oneValue_of_eq (dotP_comm v r))
            (BPair.oneValue_symm (dotN_read r v))))
    · exact BPair.oneValue_trans
        (BPair.oneValue_of_eq (dotP_comm v (combo n s T')))
        (BPair.oneValue_symm
          (dotP_matVec_gen n v hv s T' hT.2))

name: dotP_matVec
statement:
theorem dotP_matVec (n : Nat) (s : List BPair) (T : Mat)
    (v : List BPair) (hT : rowsLen n T) (hv : v.length = n)
    (_hs : s.length = T.length) :
    (dotP s (matVec T v)).oneValue (dotP (combo n s T) v)
proof:
:=
  dotP_matVec_gen n v hv s T hT

name: combo_getAt
statement:
theorem combo_getAt (n : Nat) (cs : List BPair)
    (L : Mat) (i : Nat) (hL : rowsLen n L) (hi : i < n) :
    (ground.getAt BPair.unit (combo n cs L) i).oneValue
      (dotP cs (L.map (fun r => ground.getAt BPair.unit r i)))
proof:
:=
  comboO_getAt (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairLaws n cs L i hL hi

name: rowsLen_transposeM
statement:
theorem rowsLen_transposeM (m : Mat) :
    rowsLen m.length (transposeM m)
proof: := rowsLen_transposeO bpairOps m

name: dotP_map_pair
statement:
theorem dotP_map_pair {α : Type} (f g : α → BPair) :
    ∀ l : List α, dotP (l.map f) (l.map g)
      = ground.famFold BPair.add BPair.unit (fun x => f x * g x) l
  | [] => rfl
  | x :: t => by
    show f x * g x + dotP (t.map f) (t.map g)
      = f x * g x + ground.famFold BPair.add BPair.unit
        (fun y => f y * g y) t
    rw [dotP_map_pair f g t]

/
source rows' pairing at its two orders, one value entry by
entry. -/

name: gramM_symm
statement:
theorem gramM_symm (L : Mat) (i j : Nat) (hi : i < L.length)
    (hj : j < L.length) :
    ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] (gramM L) i) j
      = ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] (gramM L) j) i
proof:
:= by
  rw [gramM_entry L i j hi hj, gramM_entry L j i hj hi, dotP_comm]

name: cofVec_col_fold
statement:
theorem cofVec_col_fold (G : Mat) {n : Nat} (hsq : sqAt G n)
    (a' k : Nat) (ha' : a' < n) (hk : k < n) (A : Nat → BPair)
    (hA : ∀ i, i < n →
      A i = ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] G a') i) :
    (ground.famFold BPair.add BPair.unit
      (fun i => A i * ground.getAt BPair.unit (cofVec G k) i)
      (List.range n)).oneValue
      (if k = a' then detL G else BPair.unit)
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : G.length = n := sqAt_len hsq
  have hrows : rowsLen n G := rowsLen_of_sqAt hsq
  have haG : a' < G.length := by rw [hlen]; exact ha'
  have hkG : k < G.length := by rw [hlen]; exact hk
  have hrow : (ground.getAt [] G a').length = G.length := by
    rw [rowsLen_getAt G a' hrows haG, hlen]
  have hfold : dotP (ground.getAt [] G a') (cofVec G k)
      = ground.famFold BPair.add BPair.unit
        (fun i => ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] G a') i
          * sgnP (k + i) (cof0 (G.eraseIdx k) i))
        (List.range G.length) :=
    dotO_map_range bpairOps
      (fun i => sgnP (k + i) (cof0 (G.eraseIdx k) i))
      G.length (ground.getAt [] G a') hrow
  rw [hlen] at hfold
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans
    (ground.foldB_congr_members
      (fun i => A i * ground.getAt BPair.unit (cofVec G k) i)
      (fun i => ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] G a') i
        * sgnP (k + i) (cof0 (G.eraseIdx k) i))
      (List.range n) ?_)
    (BPair.oneValue_trans (BPair.oneValue_of_eq hfold.symm) ?_)
  · intro t ht
    have htn : t < n := ground.ltOfMem ht
    have htG : t < G.length := by rw [hlen]; exact htn
    have hentry : ground.getAt BPair.unit (cofVec G k) t
        = sgnP (k + t) (cof0 (G.eraseIdx k) t) := by
      show ground.getAt BPair.unit
          ((List.range G.length).map
            (fun i => sgnP (k + i) (cof0 (G.eraseIdx k) i))) t
        = sgnP (k + t) (cof0 (G.eraseIdx k) t)
      rw [ground.getAt_map 0 BPair.unit _ (List.range G.length) t
          (by rw [ground.length_range]; exact htG),
        ground.getAt_range G.length t htG]
    show (A t * ground.getAt BPair.unit (cofVec G k) t).oneValue
      (ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] G a') t
        * sgnP (k + t) (cof0 (G.eraseIdx k) t))
    rw [hA t htn, hentry]
    exact BPair.oneValue_refl _
  · by_cases hka : k = a'
    · rw [if_pos hka, hka]
      exact cofVec_diag G a' haG hrow
    · rw [if_neg hka]
      exact cofVec_off G a' k haG hkG (fun he => hka he.symm) hrow

name: detL_cols_equal
statement:
private theorem detL_cols_equal (m : Mat) (hsq : rowsLen m.length m)
    {i j : Nat} (hij : i < j) (hjm : j < m.length)
    (heq : ∀ a, a < m.length →
      ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] m a) i
        = ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] m a) j) :
    (detL m).oneValue BPair.unit
proof:
:= by
  match m, hsq, hjm with
  | [], _, hjm0 => exact absurd hjm0 (Nat.not_lt_zero j)
  | r :: t, hsq, hjm =>
    rw [← detL_transpose (r :: t) hsq]
    refine detL_rows_equal hij
      (by
        rw [length_transposeM (r :: t) hsq (Nat.succ_pos _)]
        exact hjm) ?_
    refine ground.getAt_ext BPair.unit _ _ ?_ ?_
    · rw [rowsLen_getAt (transposeM (r :: t)) i
          (rowsLen_transposeM (r :: t))
          (by
            rw [length_transposeM (r :: t) hsq (Nat.succ_pos _)]
            exact Nat.lt_trans hij hjm),
        rowsLen_getAt (transposeM (r :: t)) j
          (rowsLen_transposeM (r :: t))
          (by
            rw [length_transposeM (r :: t) hsq (Nat.succ_pos _)]
            exact hjm)]
    · intro a ha
      rw [rowsLen_getAt (transposeM (r :: t)) i
          (rowsLen_transposeM (r :: t))
          (by
            rw [length_transposeM (r :: t) hsq (Nat.succ_pos _)]
            exact Nat.lt_trans hij hjm)] at ha
      rw [getAt_transposeM BPair.unit (r :: t) hsq i a
          (Nat.lt_trans hij hjm) ha,
        getAt_transposeM BPair.unit (r :: t) hsq j a hjm ha]
      exact heq a ha

name: borderAt_row_repeat
proof:
:= by
  refine detL_rows_equal (i := i') (j := k') hik
    (by rw [borderAt_len]; exact Nat.lt_succ_self k') ?_
  rw [borderAt_row k' i' j' m i' (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hik),
    borderAt_row k' i' j' m k' (Nat.lt_succ_self k'),
    if_pos hik, if_neg (Nat.lt_irrefl k')]

name: borderAt_col_repeat
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : (borderAt k' i' j' m).length = k' + 1 :=
    borderAt_len k' i' j' m
  refine detL_cols_equal (borderAt k' i' j' m)
    (by rw [hlen]; exact borderAt_rows k' i' j' m)
    (i := j') (j := k') hjk
    (by rw [hlen]; exact Nat.lt_succ_self k') ?_
  intro a ha
  rw [hlen] at ha
  rw [borderAt_entry k' i' j' m a j' ha
      (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hjk),
    borderAt_entry k' i' j' m a k' ha (Nat.lt_succ_self k'),
    if_pos hjk, if_neg (Nat.lt_irrefl k')]

name: sylvesterRead_holds
statement:
theorem sylvesterRead_holds (m : Mat) (hsq : rowsLen m.length m)
    (k i j : Nat) (hk1 : k + 1 ≤ m.length) (him : i < m.length)
    (hjm : j < m.length) : sylvesterRead m k i j
proof:
:= by
  have hw : ∀ a, a < m.length →
      (ground.getAt [] m a).length = m.length :=
    fun a ha => rowsLen_getAt m a hsq ha
  have hkm : k ≤ m.length := Nat.le_of_lt hk1
  have hkml : k < m.length := hk1
  show BPair.oneValue
    (leading m k * bordered m (k + 1) i j
      + bordered m k i k * bordered m k k j)
    (bordered m k k k * bordered m k i j)
  rw [leading_leadAt m k hkm hw,
    bordered_borderAt m (k + 1) i j hk1 him hw,
    bordered_borderAt m k i k hkm him hw,
    bordered_borderAt m k k j hkm hkml hw,
    bordered_borderAt m k k k hkm hkml hw,
    bordered_borderAt m k i j hkm him hw]
  have hb : ∀ (k' i' j' : Nat),
      (minor (borderAt k' i' j' m)).oneValue
        (detL (borderAt k' i' j' m)) := fun k' i' j' => by
    refine minor_detL (borderAt k' i' j' m) ?_
    rw [borderAt_len]
    exact borderAt_rows k' i' j' m
  have hL : (minor (leadAt k m)).oneValue (detL (leadAt k m)) := by
    refine minor_detL (leadAt k m) ?_
    rw [leadAt_len]
    exact leadAt_rowsW k m
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans
    (BPair.add_congr (BPair.mul_congr hL (hb (k + 1) i j))
      (BPair.mul_congr (hb k i k) (hb k k j))) ?_
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans ?_ (BPair.oneValue_symm
    (BPair.mul_congr (hb k k k) (hb k i j)))
  cases Nat.lt_or_ge k i with
  | inl hki =>
    cases Nat.lt_or_ge k j with
    | inl hkj => exact sylvester m hsq k i j hki him hkj hjm
    | inr hjk =>
      cases Nat.lt_or_ge j k with
      | inl hjlt =>
        refine BPair.oneValue_trans
          (BPair.add_units
            (oneValue_mul_unit _ _
              (borderAt_col_repeat (k + 1) i j m
                (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hjlt)))
            (oneValue_mul_unit _ _
              (borderAt_col_repeat k k j m hjlt))) ?_
        exact BPair.oneValue_symm (oneValue_mul_unit _ _
          (borderAt_col_repeat k i j m hjlt))
      | inr hkj2 =>
        have hejk : j = k := Nat.le_antisymm hjk hkj2
        subst hejk
        refine BPair.oneValue_trans
          (BPair.add_congr
            (oneValue_mul_unit _ _
              (borderAt_col_repeat (j + 1) i j m
                (Nat.lt_succ_self j)))
            (BPair.oneValue_refl _)) ?_
        refine BPair.oneValue_trans (BPair.unit_add _) ?_
        exact BPair.oneValue_of_eq
          (BPair.mul_comm (detL (borderAt j i j m))
            (detL (borderAt j j j m)))
  | inr hik =>
    cases Nat.lt_or_ge i k with
    | inl hilt =>
      refine BPair.oneValue_trans
        (BPair.add_units
          (oneValue_mul_unit _ _
            (borderAt_row_repeat (k + 1) i j m
              (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hilt)))
          (oneValue_unit_mul
            (borderAt_row_repeat k i k m hilt))) ?_
      exact BPair.oneValue_symm (oneValue_mul_unit _ _
        (borderAt_row_repeat k i j m hilt))
    | inr hki2 =>
      have heik : i = k := Nat.le_antisymm hik hki2
      subst heik
      refine BPair.oneValue_trans
        (BPair.add_congr
          (oneValue_mul_unit _ _
            (borderAt_row_repeat (i + 1) i j m
              (Nat.lt_succ_self i)))
          (BPair.oneValue_refl _)) ?_
      exact BPair.unit_add _

name: rowsLen_replicateO
statement:
private theorem rowsLen_replicateO {γ : Type} (a : γ) (n : Nat) :
    ∀ m : Nat, rowsLen n (List.replicate m (List.replicate n a))
  | 0 => trivial
  | m + 1 => ⟨ground.length_replicate a n, rowsLen_replicateO a n m⟩

/
one row per stated key. -/

name: rowsLen_replicate
statement:
theorem rowsLen_replicate (n : Nat) : ∀ m : Nat,
    rowsLen n (List.replicate m (List.replicate n BPair.unit))
proof:
:=
  rowsLen_replicateO BPair.unit n

name: matVec_transpose_entry
statement:
private theorem matVec_transpose_entry (n : Nat) (T : Mat)
    (s : List BPair) (hT : rowsLen n T) (hne : 0 < T.length)
    (i : Nat) (hi : i < n) :
    (ground.getAt BPair.unit (matVec (transposeM T) s) i).oneValue
      (ground.getAt BPair.unit (combo n s T) i)
proof:
:= by
  have hlenT : (transposeM T).length = n := length_transposeM T hT hne
  have hiT : i < (transposeM T).length := by rw [hlenT]; exact hi
  have hcol : (ground.getAt [] (transposeM T) i).length = T.length :=
    rowsLen_getAt (transposeM T) i (rowsLen_transposeM T) hiT
  have hread : ground.getAt BPair.unit (matVec (transposeM T) s) i
      = dotN (ground.getAt [] (transposeM T) i) s :=
    ground.getAt_map [] BPair.unit (fun r => dotN r s)
      (transposeM T) i hiT
  have hlen : (ground.getAt [] (transposeM T) i).length
      = (T.map (fun r => ground.getAt BPair.unit r i)).length := by
    rw [hcol, ground.length_map]
  have hpt : ∀ q, q < (ground.getAt [] (transposeM T) i).length →
      (ground.getAt BPair.unit
        (ground.getAt [] (transposeM T) i) q).oneValue
      (ground.getAt BPair.unit
        (T.map (fun r => ground.getAt BPair.unit r i)) q) := by
    intro q hq
    rw [hcol] at hq
    have e1 : ground.getAt BPair.unit
        (ground.getAt [] (transposeM T) i) q
        = ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] T q) i :=
      getAt_transposeM BPair.unit T hT i q hi hq
    have e2 : ground.getAt BPair.unit
        (T.map (fun r => ground.getAt BPair.unit r i)) q
        = ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] T q) i :=
      ground.getAt_map [] BPair.unit
        (fun r => ground.getAt BPair.unit r i) T q hq
    exact BPair.oneValue_of_eq (e1.trans e2.symm)
  exact BPair.oneValue_trans (BPair.oneValue_of_eq hread)
    (BPair.oneValue_trans
      (dotN_read (ground.getAt [] (transposeM T) i) s)
      (BPair.oneValue_trans
        (BPair.oneValue_of_eq
          (dotP_comm (ground.getAt [] (transposeM T) i) s))
        (BPair.oneValue_trans
          (dotP_congr_right s (ground.getAt [] (transposeM T) i)
            (T.map (fun r => ground.getAt BPair.unit r i)) hlen hpt)
          (BPair.oneValue_symm (combo_getAt n s T i hT hi)))))

name: matVec_transpose_go
proof:
:= by
  have hL : (matVec (transposeM T) s).length = n := by
    rw [matVec_length, length_transposeM T hT hne]
  refine poly.oneValue_of_entries _ _ ?_ ?_
  · rw [hL, length_combo n s T hT]
  · intro i hi
    rw [hL] at hi
    exact matVec_transpose_entry n T s hT hne i hi

name: matVec_transpose_combo
statement:
theorem matVec_transpose_combo (n : Nat) (T : Mat)
    (s : List BPair) (hT : rowsLen n T) (hs : s.length = T.length) :
    poly.oneValue (matVec (transposeM T) s) (combo n s T)
proof:
:= by
  match T, hT, hs with
  | [], _, hs0 =>
    match s, hs0 with
    | [], _ =>
      show poly.unitTail (List.replicate n BPair.unit)
      exact poly.unitTail_replicate n
    | _ :: _, hbad => nomatch hbad
  | r :: t, hT0, _ =>
    exact matVec_transpose_go n (r :: t) s hT0 (Nat.succ_pos _)

name: dotN_map_comm
statement:
private theorem dotN_map_comm : ∀ (M : Mat) (u : List BPair),
    poly.oneValue (M.map (fun c => dotN u c)) (matVec M u)
  | [], _ => trivial
  | r :: t, u => by
    show (dotN u r).oneValue (dotN r u)
      ∧ poly.oneValue (t.map (fun c => dotN u c)) (matVec t u)
    exact ⟨BPair.oneValue_trans (dotN_read u r)
        (BPair.oneValue_trans (BPair.oneValue_of_eq (dotP_comm u r))
          (BPair.oneValue_symm (dotN_read r u))),
      dotN_map_comm t u⟩

/-! The composition's row read at every row length: the row against
the second factor's column folds reads that row against the second
factor's own action, the exchange through the transpose with no
shape read on the row — a row shorter or longer than the factor's
row count truncates on both sides alike. -/

private theorem matVec_row_gen (n : Nat) : ∀ (T : Mat)
    (v s : List BPair), rowsLen n T → v.length = n →
      (dotN s (matVec T v)).oneValue
        (dotN ((transposeM T).map (fun c => dotN s c)) v)
  | [], v, s, _, _ => by
    show (dotN s ([] : List BPair)).oneValue
      (dotN ([] : List BPair) v)
    match s with
    | [] => exact BPair.oneValue_refl _
    | _ :: _ => exact BPair.oneValue_refl _
  | r :: t, v, s, hT, hv => by
    have hMt : (transposeM (r :: t)).length = n
proof:
:=
      length_transposeM (r :: t) hT (Nat.succ_pos _)
    have hrow : ((transposeM (r :: t)).map
        (fun c => dotN s c)).length = n := by
      rw [ground.length_map, hMt]
    have hcb : (combo n s (r :: t)).length = n :=
      length_combo n s (r :: t) hT
    have hpo : poly.oneValue (combo n s (r :: t))
        ((transposeM (r :: t)).map (fun c => dotN s c)) :=
      poly.oneValue_symm
        (poly.oneValue_trans
          (dotN_map_comm (transposeM (r :: t)) s)
          (matVec_transpose_go n (r :: t) s hT (Nat.succ_pos _)))
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans (dotN_read s (matVec (r :: t) v)) ?_
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans
      (dotP_matVec_gen n v hv s (r :: t) hT) ?_
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.oneValue_of_eq (dotP_comm (combo n s (r :: t)) v)) ?_
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans
      (dotP_congr_right v (combo n s (r :: t))
        ((transposeM (r :: t)).map (fun c => dotN s c))
        (hcb.trans hrow.symm)
        (fun i _ => poly.oneValue_getAt i hpo)) ?_
    exact BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.oneValue_of_eq
        (dotP_comm v ((transposeM (r :: t)).map (fun c => dotN s c))))
      (BPair.oneValue_symm
        (dotN_read
          ((transposeM (r :: t)).map (fun c => dotN s c)) v))

name: matVec_row_gen
statement:
private theorem matVec_row_gen (n : Nat) : ∀ (T : Mat)
    (v s : List BPair), rowsLen n T → v.length = n →
      (dotN s (matVec T v)).oneValue
        (dotN ((transposeM T).map (fun c => dotN s c)) v)
  | [], v, s, _, _ => by
    show (dotN s ([] : List BPair)).oneValue
      (dotN ([] : List BPair) v)
    match s with
    | [] => exact BPair.oneValue_refl _
    | _ :: _ => exact BPair.oneValue_refl _
  | r :: t, v, s, hT, hv => by
    have hMt : (transposeM (r :: t)).length = n
proof:
:=
      length_transposeM (r :: t) hT (Nat.succ_pos _)
    have hrow : ((transposeM (r :: t)).map
        (fun c => dotN s c)).length = n := by
      rw [ground.length_map, hMt]
    have hcb : (combo n s (r :: t)).length = n :=
      length_combo n s (r :: t) hT
    have hpo : poly.oneValue (combo n s (r :: t))
        ((transposeM (r :: t)).map (fun c => dotN s c)) :=
      poly.oneValue_symm
        (poly.oneValue_trans
          (dotN_map_comm (transposeM (r :: t)) s)
          (matVec_transpose_go n (r :: t) s hT (Nat.succ_pos _)))
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans (dotN_read s (matVec (r :: t) v)) ?_
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans
      (dotP_matVec_gen n v hv s (r :: t) hT) ?_
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.oneValue_of_eq (dotP_comm (combo n s (r :: t)) v)) ?_
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans
      (dotP_congr_right v (combo n s (r :: t))
        ((transposeM (r :: t)).map (fun c => dotN s c))
        (hcb.trans hrow.symm)
        (fun i _ => poly.oneValue_getAt i hpo)) ?_
    exact BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.oneValue_of_eq
        (dotP_comm v ((transposeM (r :: t)).map (fun c => dotN s c))))
      (BPair.oneValue_symm
        (dotN_read
          ((transposeM (r :: t)).map (fun c => dotN s c)) v))

name: matVec_comp_go
statement:
private theorem matVec_comp_go (n : Nat) (T : Mat) (v : List BPair)
    (hT : rowsLen n T) (hv : v.length = n) :
    ∀ S : Mat, rowsLen T.length S →
      poly.oneValue (matVec S (matVec T v)) (matVec (matMul S T) v)
  | [], _ => trivial
  | s :: S', hS => by
    show (dotN s (matVec T v)).oneValue
        (dotN ((transposeM T).map (fun c => dotN s c)) v)
      ∧ poly.oneValue (matVec S' (matVec T v))
        (matVec (matMul S' T) v)
    exact ⟨matVec_row_gen n T v s hT hv,
      matVec_comp_go n T v hT hv S' hS.2⟩

/

name: matVec_comp
statement:
theorem matVec_comp (S T : Mat) (v : List BPair) (n : Nat)
    (hT : rowsLen n T) (hv : v.length = n)
    (hS : rowsLen T.length S) :
    poly.oneValue (matVec S (matVec T v)) (matVec (matMul S T) v)
proof:
:=
  matVec_comp_go n T v hT hv S hS

name: matVec_matMul
statement:
theorem matVec_matMul : ∀ (a b : Mat) (n : Nat), rowsLen n b →
    ∀ (v : List BPair), v.length = n →
      poly.oneValue (matVec (matMul a b) v) (matVec a (matVec b v))
  | [], _, _, _, _, _ => trivial
  | r :: t, b, n, hb, v, hv => by
    show (dotN ((transposeM b).map (fun c => dotN r c)) v).oneValue
        (dotN r (matVec b v))
      ∧ poly.oneValue (matVec (matMul t b) v)
        (matVec t (matVec b v))
    exact ⟨BPair.oneValue_symm (matVec_row_gen n b v r hb hv),
      matVec_matMul t b n hb v hv⟩

/
one entry per column key of the right factor. -/

name: rowsLen_matMul
statement:
theorem rowsLen_matMul : ∀ (a b : Mat),
    rowsLen (transposeM b).length (matMul a b)
  | [], _ => trivial
  | _ :: t, b =>
    ⟨ground.length_map _ (transposeM b), rowsLen_matMul t b⟩

/

name: rowsLen_cast
statement:
theorem rowsLen_cast {a b : Nat} (h : a = b) {M : Mat}
    (hm : rowsLen a M) : rowsLen b M
proof: := by rw [← h]; exact hm

name: rectAt_of
statement:
theorem rectAt_of {M : Mat} {r c : Nat} (hl : M.length = r)
    (hr : rowsLen c M) : rectAt M r c
proof:
:= by
  show (Nat.beq M.length r
    && M.all (fun row => Nat.beq row.length c)) = true
  rw [hl, ground.beqRefl r,
    ground.all_of_getAt ([] : List BPair)
      (fun row => Nat.beq row.length c) M
      (fun j hj => by
        rw [rowsLen_getAt M j hr hj]; exact ground.beqRefl c)]
  rfl

name: rowsLen_matMul_of
statement:
theorem rowsLen_matMul_of {o : Nat} : ∀ (A B : Mat),
    (0 < A.length → 0 < B.length) → rowsLen o B →
    rowsLen o (matMul A B)
  | [], _, _, _ => trivial
  | r :: t, B, hpos, hBr =>
    rowsLen_cast (length_transposeM B hBr (hpos (Nat.succ_pos t.length)))
      (rowsLen_matMul (r :: t) B)

/

name: transposeLen
statement:
theorem transposeLen {n : Nat} : ∀ (T : Mat), rowsLen n T →
    T.length = n → (transposeM T).length = n
  | [], _, hz => hz
  | r :: t, hr, _ => length_transposeM (r :: t) hr (Nat.succ_pos _)

private theorem allBeq : ∀ (M : Mat) (n : Nat), rowsLen n M →
    M.all (fun r => Nat.beq r.length n) = true
  | [], _, _ => rfl
  | r :: t, n, h => by
    show (Nat.beq r.length n
      && t.all (fun s => Nat.beq s.length n)) = true
    rw [h.1, ground.beqRefl n, allBeq t n h.2]
    rfl

/
converse constructor. -/

name: allBeq
statement:
private theorem allBeq : ∀ (M : Mat) (n : Nat), rowsLen n M →
    M.all (fun r => Nat.beq r.length n) = true
  | [], _, _ => rfl
  | r :: t, n, h => by
    show (Nat.beq r.length n
      && t.all (fun s => Nat.beq s.length n)) = true
    rw [h.1, ground.beqRefl n, allBeq t n h.2]
    rfl

/
converse constructor. -/

name: sqAt_of
statement:
theorem sqAt_of {M : Mat} {n : Nat} (hl : M.length = n)
    (hr : rowsLen n M) : sqAt M n
proof:
:= by
  show (Nat.beq M.length n
    && M.all (fun r => Nat.beq r.length n)) = true
  rw [hl, ground.beqRefl n, allBeq M n hr]
  rfl

name: sqSquare
statement:
theorem sqSquare {A : Mat} {n : Nat} (h : sqAt A n) :
    sqAt (matMul A A) n
proof:
:= by
  have hl : A.length = n := ground.beqEq _ _ ((ground.andSplitB h).1)
  have hr : rowsLen n A := rowsLen_of_sqAt h
  refine sqAt_of ?_ (rowsLen_cast (transposeLen A hr hl)
    (rowsLen_matMul A A))
  show (A.map (fun r => (transposeM A).map (fun c => dotN r c))).length
    = n
  rw [ground.length_map]; exact hl

name: matVec_combo
statement:
theorem matVec_combo (T : Mat) (n : Nat) :
    ∀ (cs : List BPair) (L : Mat), rowsLen n L →
      poly.oneValue (matVec T (combo n cs L))
        (combo T.length cs (L.map (matVec T)))
  | [], _, _ =>
    poly.unitTail_oneValue
      (matVec_null T _ (poly.unitTail_replicate n))
      (poly.unitTail_replicate T.length)
  | _ :: _, [], _ =>
    poly.unitTail_oneValue
      (matVec_null T _ (poly.unitTail_replicate n))
      (poly.unitTail_replicate T.length)
  | c :: cs, r :: L, hL => by
    have hK : rowsLen T.length (L.map (matVec T))
proof:
:=
      rowsLen_map (matVec T) T.length L (fun x _ => (fun y => matVec_length T y) x)
    show poly.oneValue
      (matVec T (vecAdd (vecScale c r) (combo n cs L)))
      (vecAdd (vecScale c (matVec T r))
        (combo T.length cs (L.map (matVec T))))
    refine poly.oneValue_trans
      (matVec_vecAdd_free T _ _
        (((length_vecScale c r).trans hL.1).trans
          (length_combo n cs L hL.2).symm)) ?_
    refine polyOne_vecAdd _ _ _ _
      (matVec_vecScale_free T c r)
      (matVec_combo T n cs L hL.2)
      ((matVec_length T _).trans
        ((length_vecScale c (matVec T r)).trans
          (matVec_length T r)).symm)
      ((matVec_length T _).trans
        (length_combo T.length cs _ hK).symm)

name: span_map
statement:
theorem span_map (T : Mat) (n : Nat)
    (L M : Mat) (hL : rowsLen n L) (hM : rowsLen T.length M)
    (himg : ∀ k, k < L.length →
      spanRel T.length M (matVec T (ground.getAt [] L k)))
    (x : List BPair) (hx : x.length = n) (h : spanRel n L x) :
    spanRel T.length M (matVec T x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c₀, cs, hc₀, hcl, hone⟩ := span_elim h
  have hK : rowsLen T.length (L.map (matVec T)) :=
    rowsLen_map (matVec T) T.length L (fun x _ => (fun y => matVec_length T y) x)
  have hsp : spanRel T.length M
      (combo T.length cs (L.map (matVec T))) := by
    refine spanRel_combo T.length M hM _ cs hK ?_
    intro k hk
    rw [ground.length_map] at hk
    rw [ground.getAt_map ([] : List BPair) ([] : List BPair)
      (matVec T) L k hk]
    exact himg k hk
  have hchain : poly.oneValue (vecScale c₀ (matVec T x))
      (combo T.length cs (L.map (matVec T))) :=
    poly.oneValue_trans
      (poly.oneValue_symm (matVec_vecScale_free T c₀ x))
      (poly.oneValue_trans
        (matVec_congr_go T (vecScale c₀ x) (combo n cs L)
          (((length_vecScale c₀ x).trans hx).trans
            (length_combo n cs L hL).symm) hone)
        (matVec_combo T n cs L hL))
  exact spanRel_unscale T.length M c₀ (matVec T x) hc₀
    (spanRel_congr T.length M _ _ (poly.oneValue_symm hchain) hsp
      ((length_vecScale c₀ (matVec T x)).trans
        (matVec_length T x)))

name: spanRel_mapBy
statement:
theorem spanRel_mapBy (n m : Nat) (f : List BPair → List BPair)
    (hflen : ∀ x : List BPair, (f x).length = m)
    (hfcongr : ∀ a b : List BPair, a.length = n → b.length = n →
      poly.oneValue a b → poly.oneValue (f a) (f b))
    (hfscale : ∀ (c : BPair) (x : List BPair), x.length = n →
      poly.oneValue (f (vecScale c x)) (vecScale c (f x)))
    (hfcombo : ∀ (cs : List BPair) (M : Mat), rowsLen n M →
      poly.oneValue (f (combo n cs M)) (combo m cs (M.map f)))
    (M : Mat) (hM : rowsLen n M) (v : List BPair)
    (hv : v.length = n) (h : spanRel n M v) :
    spanRel m (M.map f) (f v)
proof:
:= by
  match span_elim h with
  | ⟨c₀, cs, hc₀, hcsl, hone⟩ =>
    refine span_intro m (M.map f) (f v)
      (rowsLen_map f m M (fun x _ => hflen x)) (hflen v)
      ⟨c₀, cs, hc₀, hcsl.trans (ground.length_map f M).symm, ?_⟩
    refine poly.oneValue_trans
      (poly.oneValue_symm (hfscale c₀ v hv)) ?_
    refine poly.oneValue_trans
      (hfcongr (vecScale c₀ v) (combo n cs M)
        ((length_vecScale c₀ v).trans hv)
        (length_combo n cs M hM) hone) ?_
    exact hfcombo cs M hM

name: indep_mapBy
statement:
theorem indep_mapBy (n m : Nat) (f : List BPair → List BPair)
    (hflen : ∀ x : List BPair, (f x).length = m)
    (hfunit : ∀ x : List BPair, x.length = n →
      poly.unitTail (f x) → poly.unitTail x)
    (hfcombo : ∀ (cs : List BPair) (M : Mat), rowsLen n M →
      poly.oneValue (f (combo n cs M)) (combo m cs (M.map f)))
    (M : Mat) (hM : rowsLen n M) (hi : indepRows n M) :
    indepRows m (M.map f)
proof:
:= by
  refine indep_intro m (M.map f)
    (rowsLen_map f m M (fun x _ => hflen x)) ?_
  intro cs hcs hnull
  refine indep_elim hi cs (hcs.trans (ground.length_map f M)) ?_
  refine hfunit (combo n cs M) (length_combo n cs M hM) ?_
  exact poly.unitTail_oneValue_right hnull
    (poly.oneValue_symm (hfcombo cs M hM))

name: spanRel_matVec
statement:
theorem spanRel_matVec (n : Nat) (G : Mat) (x : List BPair)
    (T : Mat) (m : Nat) (hTl : T.length = m)
    (hG : rowsLen n G) (hx : x.length = n) (h : spanRel n G x) :
    spanRel m (G.map (matVec T)) (matVec T x)
proof:
:= by
  have hres := spanRel_mapBy n T.length (matVec T)
    (fun y => matVec_length T y)
    (fun a b ha hb hone =>
      matVec_congr_go T a b (ha.trans hb.symm) hone)
    (fun c y hy => matVec_vecScale_free T c y)
    (fun cs L hL => matVec_combo T n cs L hL)
    G hG x hx h
  rw [hTl] at hres
  exact hres

name: mulPairNat
statement:
theorem mulPairNat (c e : Nat) (x y : BPair) :
    ((BPair.ofNat c * x) * (BPair.ofNat e * y)).oneValue
      (BPair.ofNat (c * e) * (x * y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [BPair.mul_assoc, BPair.mul_left_comm x (BPair.ofNat e) y,
    ← BPair.mul_assoc]
  exact BPair.mul_congr_left
    (BPair.oneValue_symm (BPair.ofNat_mul c e))

name: dotP_fold
statement:
theorem dotP_fold : ∀ (n : Nat) (u v : List BPair),
    u.length = n → v.length = n →
    dotP u v = bsum (fun i => ground.getAt BPair.unit u i
      * ground.getAt BPair.unit v i) (List.range n)
  | 0, [], [], _, _ => rfl
  | 0, [], _ :: _, _, hv => nomatch hv
  | 0, _ :: _, _, hu, _ => nomatch hu
  | _ + 1, [], _, hu, _ => nomatch hu
  | _ + 1, _ :: _, [], _, hv => nomatch hv
  | n + 1, a :: s, b :: t, hu, hv => by
    rw [ground.range_cons n]
    show a * b + dotP s t
      = ground.getAt BPair.unit (a :: s) 0
          * ground.getAt BPair.unit (b :: t) 0
        + bsum (fun i => ground.getAt BPair.unit (a :: s) i
          * ground.getAt BPair.unit (b :: t) i)
          ((List.range n).map (fun x => x + 1))
    rw [bsum_map, dotP_fold n s t (Nat.succ.inj hu)
      (Nat.succ.inj hv)]
    rfl

/

name: selfFold
statement:
theorem selfFold (u : List BPair) (n : Nat)
    (hu : u.length = n) :
    (dotN u u).oneValue
      (bsum (fun i => ground.getAt BPair.unit u i
        * ground.getAt BPair.unit u i) (List.range n))
proof:
:= by
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans (dotN_read u u) ?_
  rw [dotP_fold n u u hu hu]
  exact BPair.oneValue_refl _

name: dotN_self_side
statement:
theorem dotN_self_side : ∀ v : List ground.BPair,
    ¬ (elim.dotN v v < ground.BPair.unit)
proof:
:= by
  intro v hlt
  have h : (dotP v v).fst + Pos.one < Pos.one + (dotP v v).snd :=
    BPair.lt_congr (dotN_read v v) (BPair.oneValue_refl _) hlt
  match dotP_self_side v with
  | Or.inl he => exact ground.lt_ne h (by rw [he, ground.add_comm])
  | Or.inr ⟨g, hg⟩ =>
    exact ground.lt_asymm h
      ⟨g, by rw [ground.add_assoc, hg, ground.add_comm]⟩

name: dotP_polar_expand
statement:
private theorem dotP_polar_expand (P Q : List BPair)
    (hPQ : P.length = Q.length) :
    (dotP (vecAdd P Q) (vecAdd P Q)).oneValue
      (dotP P P + dotP Q Q + (dotP P Q + dotP P Q))
proof:
:= by
  have hW : (vecAdd P Q).length = P.length :=
    length_vecAdd P Q P.length rfl hPQ.symm
  have h1 : (dotP (vecAdd P Q) (vecAdd P Q)).oneValue
      (dotP P (vecAdd P Q) + dotP Q (vecAdd P Q)) :=
    dotP_vecAdd_left P Q (vecAdd P Q) (Nat.le_of_eq hW)
      (Nat.le_of_eq (hW.trans hPQ))
  have h2 : (dotP P (vecAdd P Q)).oneValue (dotP P P + dotP P Q) :=
    dotP_vecAdd_right P P Q hPQ
  have h3 : (dotP Q (vecAdd P Q)).oneValue (dotP Q P + dotP Q Q) :=
    dotP_vecAdd_right Q P Q hPQ
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans h1 ?_
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans (BPair.add_congr h2 h3) ?_
  rw [dotP_comm Q P, BPair.add_comm (dotP P Q) (dotP Q Q),
    BPair.add_add_comm]
  exact BPair.oneValue_refl _

name: dotP_scale_self
statement:
private theorem dotP_scale_self (c : BPair) (l : List BPair) :
    (dotP (vecScale c l) (vecScale c l)).oneValue ((c * c) * dotP l l)
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : (dotP (vecScale c l) l).oneValue (c * dotP l l) := by
    rw [dotP_comm (vecScale c l) l]
    exact dotP_vecScale_right l l c
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans (dotP_vecScale_right (vecScale c l) l c) ?_
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans
    (BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl c) h2) ?_
  exact BPair.oneValue_of_eq (BPair.mul_assoc c c (dotP l l)).symm

name: dotN_polar
statement:
theorem dotN_polar (u v : List BPair) (h : u.length = v.length)
    (a b : BPair) :
    ((a * b) * dotN u v).scale 2
      ≤ (a * a) * dotN u u + (b * b) * dotN v v
proof:
:= by
  have hPQ : (vecScale a u).length
      = ((vecScale b v).map BPair.swap).length := by
    rw [length_vecScale, ground.length_map, length_vecScale]
    exact h
  have hQQe : dotP ((vecScale b v).map BPair.swap)
        ((vecScale b v).map BPair.swap)
      = dotP (vecScale b v) (vecScale b v) := by
    rw [dotP_swapMap, dotP_comm, dotP_swapMap, BPair.swap_swap]
  have hQQ : (dotP ((vecScale b v).map BPair.swap)
        ((vecScale b v).map BPair.swap)).oneValue ((b * b) * dotP v v) := by
    rw [hQQe]
    exact dotP_scale_self b v
  have hPv : (dotP (vecScale a u) v).oneValue (a * dotP u v) := by
    rw [dotP_comm (vecScale a u) v, dotP_comm u v]
    exact dotP_vecScale_right v u a
  have hcross : (dotP (vecScale a u) (vecScale b v)).oneValue
      ((a * b) * dotP u v) := by
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans
      (dotP_vecScale_right (vecScale a u) v b) ?_
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl b) hPv) ?_
    refine BPair.oneValue_of_eq ?_
    rw [← BPair.mul_assoc, BPair.mul_comm b a]
  have hPQv : (dotP (vecScale a u) ((vecScale b v).map BPair.swap)).oneValue
      (((a * b) * dotP u v).swap) :=
    BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.oneValue_of_eq (dotP_swapMap (vecScale a u) (vecScale b v)))
      (ground.swap_congr hcross)
  have hV : (((a * b) * dotN u v).scale 2).swap
      = ((a * b) * dotN u v).swap + ((a * b) * dotN u v).swap := by
    rw [BPair.scale_two, BPair.swap_add]
  have hTarget : ((a * a) * dotN u u + (b * b) * dotN v v
        + (((a * b) * dotN u v).scale 2).swap).oneValue
      ((a * a) * dotP u u + (b * b) * dotP v v
        + (((a * b) * dotP u v).swap + ((a * b) * dotP u v).swap)) := by
    rw [hV]
    exact BPair.add_congr
      (BPair.add_congr
        (BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl _) (dotN_read u u))
        (BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl _) (dotN_read v v)))
      (BPair.add_congr
        (ground.swap_congr
          (BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl _) (dotN_read u v)))
        (ground.swap_congr
          (BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl _) (dotN_read u v))))
  have hunit : BPair.unit
      ≤ dotN (vecAdd (vecScale a u) ((vecScale b v).map BPair.swap))
          (vecAdd (vecScale a u) ((vecScale b v).map BPair.swap)) :=
    ground.leB_of_not_lt (dotN_self_side _)
  have hchain : (dotN (vecAdd (vecScale a u)
          ((vecScale b v).map BPair.swap))
        (vecAdd (vecScale a u) ((vecScale b v).map BPair.swap))).oneValue
      ((a * a) * dotN u u + (b * b) * dotN v v
        + (((a * b) * dotN u v).scale 2).swap) :=
    BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.oneValue_trans (dotN_read _ _)
        (BPair.oneValue_trans
          (dotP_polar_expand (vecScale a u)
            ((vecScale b v).map BPair.swap) hPQ)
          (BPair.add_congr
            (BPair.add_congr (dotP_scale_self a u) hQQ)
            (BPair.add_congr hPQv hPQv))))
      (BPair.oneValue_symm hTarget)
  exact ground.leB_of_unit_add (ground.leB_congr_right hchain hunit)

name: indep_of_orth
statement:
theorem indep_of_orth (n : Nat) (L : Mat) (hLn : rowsLen n L)
    (horth : ∀ p q, p < L.length → q < L.length → ¬ p = q →
      (dotP (ground.getAt [] L p)
        (ground.getAt [] L q)).oneValue BPair.unit)
    (hoff : ∀ p, p < L.length →
      ¬ poly.unitTail (ground.getAt [] L p)) :
    indepRows n L
proof:
:= by
  refine indep_intro n L hLn ?_
  intro cs hcl hnull
  refine unitTail_of_getAt cs (fun p hp => ?_)
  rw [hcl] at hp
  have hrp : (ground.getAt [] L p).length = n :=
    rowsLen_getAt L p hLn hp
  have hM : (L.map (fun row =>
      dotP (ground.getAt [] L p) row)).length = L.length :=
    ground.length_map _ L
  have hpair : (dotP cs (L.map (fun row =>
      dotP (ground.getAt [] L p) row))).oneValue BPair.unit :=
    BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.oneValue_symm
        (dotP_combo cs L (ground.getAt [] L p) n hLn))
      (dotP_null_right (ground.getAt [] L p) (combo n cs L)
        (fun i _ => poly.getAt_unitTail hnull i))
  have hentry : ∀ q, q < L.length →
      ground.getAt BPair.unit (L.map (fun row =>
        dotP (ground.getAt [] L p) row)) q
        = dotP (ground.getAt [] L p) (ground.getAt [] L q) :=
    fun q hq => ground.getAt_map ([] : List BPair) BPair.unit
      (fun row => dotP (ground.getAt [] L p) row) L q hq
  have hdel := dotP_oneIndex cs
    (L.map (fun row => dotP (ground.getAt [] L p) row)) p
    (by rw [hM, hcl]) (by rw [hM]; exact hp)
    (fun q hq hne => by
      rw [hM] at hq
      rw [hentry q hq]
      exact horth p q hp hq (fun hb => hne hb.symm))
  have hprod := BPair.oneValue_trans
    (BPair.oneValue_symm hdel) hpair
  rw [hentry p hp] at hprod
  have hself : ¬ (dotP (ground.getAt [] L p)
      (ground.getAt [] L p)).oneValue BPair.unit :=
    fun hbad => hoff p hp (dotP_self_null _ hbad)
  refine mul_cancel_unit hself ?_
  rw [BPair.mul_comm (dotP (ground.getAt [] L p)
    (ground.getAt [] L p)) (ground.getAt BPair.unit cs p)]
  exact hprod

name: spanRel_nil_unit
statement:
theorem spanRel_nil_unit (n : Nat) (v : List BPair)
    (h : spanRel n ([] : Mat) v) : poly.unitTail v
proof:
:=
  spanRel_unit_of_units n ([] : Mat) v
    (fun k hk => absurd hk (Nat.not_lt_zero k)) h

name: dotP_matVec_transpose
statement:
theorem dotP_matVec_transpose (n : Nat) (T : Mat) (x y : List BPair)
    (hT : rowsLen n T) (hx : x.length = n) (hy : y.length = T.length) :
    (dotP (matVec T x) y).oneValue
      (dotP x (matVec (transposeM T) y))
proof:
:= by
  match T, hT, hy with
  | [], _, hy0 =>
    match y, hy0 with
    | [], _ =>
      show (dotP ([] : List BPair) ([] : List BPair)).oneValue
        (dotP x (matVec (transposeM ([] : Mat)) []))
      rw [show matVec (transposeM ([] : Mat)) [] = [] from rfl,
        dotP_nil_right x]
      exact BPair.oneValue_refl _
    | _ :: _, hbad => nomatch hbad
  | r :: t, hT0, hy0 =>
    have hTt : (transposeM (r :: t)).length = n :=
      length_transposeM (r :: t) hT0 (Nat.succ_pos _)
    have hlen : (combo n y (r :: t)).length
        = (matVec (transposeM (r :: t)) y).length := by
      rw [length_combo n y (r :: t) hT0, matVec_length, hTt]
    have hpoly : poly.oneValue (combo n y (r :: t))
        (matVec (transposeM (r :: t)) y) :=
      poly.oneValue_symm
        (matVec_transpose_combo n (r :: t) y hT0 hy0)
    exact BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.oneValue_of_eq (dotP_comm (matVec (r :: t) x) y))
      (BPair.oneValue_trans
        (dotP_matVec n y (r :: t) x hT0 hx hy0)
        (BPair.oneValue_trans
          (BPair.oneValue_of_eq
            (dotP_comm (combo n y (r :: t)) x))
          (dotP_congr_right x _ _ hlen
            (fun i _ => poly.oneValue_getAt i hpoly))))

name: dotP_oneValue_right
statement:
theorem dotP_oneValue_right : ∀ (p u u' : List BPair),
    poly.oneValue u u' → (dotP p u).oneValue (dotP p u')
  | [], _, _, _ => BPair.oneValue_refl _
  | _ :: _, [], [], _ => BPair.oneValue_refl _
  | a :: s, [], d :: q, h =>
    BPair.oneValue_symm
      (BPair.add_units (oneValue_mul_unit a d h.1)
        (dotP_null_tail_right s q h.2))
  | a :: s, c :: p, [], h =>
    BPair.add_units (oneValue_mul_unit a c h.1)
      (dotP_null_tail_right s p h.2)
  | a :: s, _ :: p, _ :: q, h =>
    BPair.add_congr (BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl a) h.1)
      (dotP_oneValue_right s p q h.2)


/
the bilinear read's two-slot scaling at the balance weights. -/

name: dotN_vecScale_pair
statement:
theorem dotN_vecScale_pair (A : Mat) (c d : BPair)
    (u w : List BPair) :
    (dotN (vecScale c u) (matVec A (vecScale d w))).oneValue
      (d * (c * dotN u (matVec A w)))
proof:
:= by
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans (dotN_read _ _) ?_
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans
    (dotP_oneValue_right _ _ _ (matVec_vecScale_free A d w)) ?_
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans (dotP_vecScale_right _ _ d) ?_
  refine BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl d) ?_
  rw [dotP_comm (vecScale c u) (matVec A w)]
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans (dotP_vecScale_right _ _ c) ?_
  refine BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl c) ?_
  rw [dotP_comm (matVec A w) u]
  exact BPair.oneValue_symm (dotN_read u (matVec A w))

name: dotP_oneValue_left
statement:
theorem dotP_oneValue_left : ∀ (r s x : List BPair),
    poly.oneValue r s → (dotP r x).oneValue (dotP s x)
  | [], [], _, _ => BPair.oneValue_refl _
  | [], _ :: _, [], _ => BPair.oneValue_refl _
  | [], _ :: q, _ :: t, h =>
    BPair.oneValue_symm
      (BPair.add_units (oneValue_unit_mul h.1)
        (dotP_null_tail_left q t h.2))
  | _ :: _, [], [], _ => BPair.oneValue_refl _
  | _ :: p, [], _ :: t, h =>
    BPair.add_units (oneValue_unit_mul h.1)
      (dotP_null_tail_left p t h.2)
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, [], _ => BPair.oneValue_refl _
  | _ :: p, _ :: q, e :: t, h =>
    BPair.add_congr (BPair.mul_congr h.1 (BPair.oneValue_refl e))
      (dotP_oneValue_left p q t h.2)

/-! The pairing's fold against its termwise reads at two clearings:
a termwise at-or-below read carries to the fold, an equal-membered
fold reads every term equal-membered inside both lists' order, and
a fold strictly above the sum's unit at termwise at-or-above
products carries such a product (`def:elim`'s pairing tier). -/

/
at-or-below read: every term inside the left orders compares at the
stated clearings, each side's fold at its own right carrier. -/

name: dotP_le_of_leTerm
statement:
theorem dotP_le_of_leTerm (gn gd : Pos) : ∀ (a w b v : List BPair),
    a.length = b.length →
    (∀ j, j < a.length →
      ((ground.getAt BPair.unit a j * ground.getAt BPair.unit w j).scale gn)
        ≤ ((ground.getAt BPair.unit b j
            * ground.getAt BPair.unit v j).scale gd)) →
    ((dotP a w).scale gn) ≤ ((dotP b v).scale gd)
  | [], _, [], _, _, _ =>
    ground.leB_congr (ground.unitScale gn) (ground.unitScale gd)
      (ground.leB_refl BPair.unit)
  | [], _, _ :: _, _, hl, _ => Nat.noConfusion hl
  | _ :: _, _, [], _, hl, _ => Nat.noConfusion hl
  | _ :: _, [], _ :: _, [], _, _ =>
    ground.leB_congr (ground.unitScale gn) (ground.unitScale gd)
      (ground.leB_refl BPair.unit)
  | d :: a, [], e :: b, x :: v, hl, h => by
    show ((dotP (d :: a) []).scale gn) ≤ ((e * x + dotP b v).scale gd)
    rw [dotP_nil_right, BPair.scale_add]
    have h0 : (BPair.unit.scale gn) ≤ ((e * x).scale gd)
proof:
:=
      ground.leB_congr_left
        (BPair.scale_congr gn (BPair.mul_unit d)) (h 0 (Nat.succ_pos _))
    have hrec := dotP_le_of_leTerm gn gd a [] b v (Nat.succ.inj hl)
      (fun j hj => h (j + 1) (Nat.succ_lt_succ hj))
    rw [dotP_nil_right] at hrec
    refine ground.leB_congr_left ?_ (ground.leB_add h0 hrec)
    exact BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.oneValue_of_eq (BPair.scale_add BPair.unit BPair.unit gn).symm)
      (BPair.scale_congr gn (BPair.add_unit BPair.unit))
  | d :: a, y :: w, e :: b, [], hl, h => by
    show ((d * y + dotP a w).scale gn) ≤ ((dotP (e :: b) []).scale gd)
    rw [dotP_nil_right, BPair.scale_add]
    have h0 : ((d * y).scale gn) ≤ (BPair.unit.scale gd) :=
      ground.leB_congr_right
        (BPair.scale_congr gd (BPair.mul_unit e)) (h 0 (Nat.succ_pos _))
    have hrec := dotP_le_of_leTerm gn gd a w b [] (Nat.succ.inj hl)
      (fun j hj => h (j + 1) (Nat.succ_lt_succ hj))
    rw [dotP_nil_right] at hrec
    refine ground.leB_congr_right ?_ (ground.leB_add h0 hrec)
    exact BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.oneValue_of_eq (BPair.scale_add BPair.unit BPair.unit gd).symm)
      (BPair.scale_congr gd (BPair.add_unit BPair.unit))
  | d :: a, y :: w, e :: b, x :: v, hl, h => by
    show ((d * y + dotP a w).scale gn) ≤ ((e * x + dotP b v).scale gd)
    rw [BPair.scale_add, BPair.scale_add]
    exact ground.leB_add (h 0 (Nat.succ_pos _))
      (dotP_le_of_leTerm gn gd a w b v (Nat.succ.inj hl)
        (fun j hj => h (j + 1) (Nat.succ_lt_succ hj)))

name: dotP_eq_of_leTerm
statement:
theorem dotP_eq_of_leTerm (gn gd : Pos) : ∀ (a b w : List BPair),
    a.length = b.length →
    (∀ j, j < a.length →
      ((ground.getAt BPair.unit a j * ground.getAt BPair.unit w j).scale gn)
        ≤ ((ground.getAt BPair.unit b j
            * ground.getAt BPair.unit w j).scale gd)) →
    ((dotP a w).scale gn).oneValue ((dotP b w).scale gd) →
    ∀ j, j < a.length → j < w.length →
      ((ground.getAt BPair.unit a j
          * ground.getAt BPair.unit w j).scale gn).oneValue
        ((ground.getAt BPair.unit b j
            * ground.getAt BPair.unit w j).scale gd)
  | [], [], _, _, _, _, j, hj, _ => absurd hj (Nat.not_lt_zero j)
  | [], _ :: _, _, hl, _, _, _, _, _ => Nat.noConfusion hl
  | _ :: _, [], _, hl, _, _, _, _, _ => Nat.noConfusion hl
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, [], _, _, _, j, _, hjw => absurd hjw (Nat.not_lt_zero j)
  | d :: a, e :: b, x :: w, hl, hle, he, j, hj, hjw => by
    have hs : ((d * x).scale gn + (dotP a w).scale gn).oneValue
        ((e * x).scale gd + (dotP b w).scale gd)
proof:
:= by
      rw [← BPair.scale_add, ← BPair.scale_add]
      exact he
    have h0 : ((d * x).scale gn) ≤ ((e * x).scale gd) :=
      hle 0 (Nat.succ_pos _)
    have htl : ((dotP a w).scale gn) ≤ ((dotP b w).scale gd) :=
      dotP_le_of_leTerm gn gd a w b w (Nat.succ.inj hl)
        (fun k hk => hle (k + 1) (Nat.succ_lt_succ hk))
    have hsplit := ground.addOneValue_of_le h0 htl hs
    match j, hj, hjw with
    | 0, _, _ => exact hsplit.1
    | i + 1, hji, hjwi =>
      exact dotP_eq_of_leTerm gn gd a b w (Nat.succ.inj hl)
        (fun k hk => hle (k + 1) (Nat.succ_lt_succ hk)) hsplit.2 i
        (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hji) (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hjwi)

name: dotP_unitLe
statement:
theorem dotP_unitLe : ∀ (a w : List BPair),
    (∀ j, j < a.length →
      BPair.unit ≤ ground.getAt BPair.unit a j * ground.getAt BPair.unit w j) →
    BPair.unit ≤ dotP a w
  | [], _, _ => ground.leB_refl BPair.unit
  | _ :: _, [], _ => ground.leB_refl BPair.unit
  | d :: a, x :: w, h => by
    show BPair.unit ≤ d * x + dotP a w
    exact ground.unitLeAdd (h 0 (Nat.succ_pos _))
      (dotP_unitLe a w (fun j hj => h (j + 1) (Nat.succ_lt_succ hj)))

/
products carries a product strictly above it inside both lists'
order. -/

name: dotP_pos_mem
statement:
theorem dotP_pos_mem : ∀ (a w : List BPair),
    (∀ j, j < a.length →
      BPair.unit ≤ ground.getAt BPair.unit a j * ground.getAt BPair.unit w j) →
    BPair.unit < dotP a w →
    ∃ j, j < a.length ∧ j < w.length
      ∧ BPair.unit < ground.getAt BPair.unit a j * ground.getAt BPair.unit w j
  | [], _, _, hp =>
    absurd hp (ground.leB_not_lt (ground.leB_refl BPair.unit))
  | _ :: _, [], _, hp =>
    absurd hp (ground.leB_not_lt (ground.leB_refl BPair.unit))
  | d :: a, x :: w, h, hp => by
    have hsplit
proof:
:= ground.posOfAddPos (h 0 (Nat.succ_pos _))
      (dotP_unitLe a w (fun j hj => h (j + 1) (Nat.succ_lt_succ hj)))
      (show BPair.unit < d * x + dotP a w from hp)
    match hsplit with
    | Or.inl h0 => exact ⟨0, Nat.succ_pos _, Nat.succ_pos _, h0⟩
    | Or.inr ht =>
      obtain ⟨j, hj, hjw, hpos⟩ := dotP_pos_mem a w
        (fun k hk => h (k + 1) (Nat.succ_lt_succ hk)) ht
      exact ⟨j + 1, Nat.succ_lt_succ hj, Nat.succ_lt_succ hjw, hpos⟩

name: matVec_dotPmap
statement:
theorem matVec_dotPmap : ∀ (M : Mat) (v : List BPair),
    poly.oneValue (matVec M v) (M.map (fun r => dotP r v))
  | [], _ => trivial
  | r :: t, v => ⟨dotN_read r v, matVec_dotPmap t v⟩

/

name: quadP_read
statement:
theorem quadP_read (M : Mat) (c : List BPair) :
    (dotN c (matVec M c)).oneValue (dotP c (M.map (fun r => dotP r c)))
proof:
:=
  BPair.oneValue_trans (dotN_read c (matVec M c))
    (dotP_oneValue_right c _ _ (matVec_dotPmap M c))

name: matVec_unitRows
statement:
theorem matVec_unitRows :
    ∀ (M : Mat) (x : List BPair),
      (∀ p, p < M.length →
        poly.unitTail (ground.getAt ([] : List BPair) M p)) →
      poly.unitTail (matVec M x)
  | [], _, _ => trivial
  | r :: t, x, hM =>
    ⟨BPair.oneValue_trans (dotN_read r x)
        (dotP_null_tail_left r x (hM 0 (Nat.succ_pos _))),
     matVec_unitRows t x
       (fun p hp => hM (p + 1) (Nat.succ_lt_succ hp))⟩

/
family, so every fold sits at the sum's unit. -/

name: matVec_replicate_null
statement:
theorem matVec_replicate_null (n m : Nat) (x : List BPair) :
    poly.unitTail
      (matVec (List.replicate m (List.replicate n BPair.unit)) x)
proof:
:=
  matVec_unitRows _ x (fun p hp => by
    rw [ground.length_replicate] at hp
    rw [ground.getAt_replicate ([] : List BPair) _ m p hp]
    exact poly.unitTail_replicate n)

name: matVec_matOne
statement:
theorem matVec_matOne :
    ∀ (A B : Mat) (x : List BPair),
      matOneValue A B →
      poly.oneValue (matVec A x) (matVec B x)
  | [], [], _, _ => trivial
  | [], _ :: _, _, h => h.elim
  | _ :: _, [], _, h => h.elim
  | r :: a, s :: b, x, h =>
    ⟨BPair.oneValue_trans (dotN_read r x)
       (BPair.oneValue_trans (dotP_oneValue_left r s x h.1)
         (BPair.oneValue_symm (dotN_read s x))),
     matVec_matOne a b x h.2⟩

/

name: dotP_matVec_sym
statement:
theorem dotP_matVec_sym {n : Nat} (M : Mat) (hM : sqAt M n)
    (hsym : matOneValue (transposeM M) M)
    (x y : List BPair) (hx : x.length = n) (hy : y.length = n) :
    (dotP (matVec M x) y).oneValue (dotP x (matVec M y))
proof:
:= by
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans
    (dotP_matVec_transpose n M x y (rowsLen_of_sqAt hM) hx
      (by rw [sqAt_len hM]; exact hy)) ?_
  exact dotP_oneValue_right x _ _ (matVec_matOne _ _ y hsym)

name: dotP_comboNull
statement:
theorem dotP_comboNull (n : Nat) (y : List BPair)
    (hy : y.length = n) :
    ∀ (cs : List BPair) (M : Mat), rowsLen n M →
      (∀ k, k < M.length →
        (dotP y (ground.getAt [] M k)).oneValue BPair.unit) →
      (dotP y (combo n cs M)).oneValue BPair.unit
  | [], _, _, _ => dotP_repl_unit y n
  | _ :: _, [], _, _ => dotP_repl_unit y n
  | c :: cs, r :: M, hM, hp => by
    show (dotP y (vecAdd (vecScale c r) (combo n cs M))).oneValue
      BPair.unit
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans
      (dotP_vecAdd y (vecScale c r) (combo n cs M)
        (by rw [length_vecScale, hM.1, hy])
        (by rw [length_combo n cs M hM.2, hy])) ?_
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans (BPair.add_congr ?_
      (dotP_comboNull n y hy cs M hM.2
        (fun k hk => hp (k + 1) (Nat.succ_lt_succ hk))))
      (BPair.unit_add BPair.unit)
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans (dotP_vecScale_right y r c) ?_
    exact oneValue_mul_unit c (dotP y r) (hp 0 (Nat.succ_pos _))

/
join splits the pairing (`dotP_vecAdd`), the scaled vector
reads the stated pairing multiplied and the swapped combination
reads the collected rows' own pairings, each at the sum's unit
(`dotP_comboNull`), so the join sits there. -/

name: resid_perp_ext
statement:
theorem resid_perp_ext (n : Nat) (C : Mat)
    (v r : List BPair) (hC : rowsLen n C)
    (hv : v.length = n) (hr : r.length = n)
    (hvr : (dotP v r).oneValue BPair.unit)
    (hCr : ∀ k, k < C.length →
      (dotP (ground.getAt [] C k) r).oneValue BPair.unit) :
    (dotP (residV n C v) r).oneValue BPair.unit
proof:
:= by
  have hrv : (dotP r v).oneValue BPair.unit := by
    rw [dotP_comm]
    exact hvr
  have hrC : ∀ k, k < C.length →
      (dotP r (ground.getAt [] C k)).oneValue BPair.unit := by
    intro k hk
    rw [dotP_comm]
    exact hCr k hk
  rw [dotP_comm]
  show (dotP r (vecAdd
      (vecScale (detL (gramM C)) v)
      ((combo n (adjP (gramM C)
        (C.map (fun s => dotP s v))) C).map
        BPair.swap))).oneValue BPair.unit
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans (dotP_vecAdd r _ _ ?_ ?_) ?_
  · rw [length_vecScale, hv, hr]
  · rw [ground.length_map, length_combo _ _ _ hC, hr]
  · refine BPair.oneValue_trans (BPair.add_congr ?_ ?_)
      (BPair.unit_add BPair.unit)
    · exact BPair.oneValue_trans
        (dotP_vecScale_right r v (detL (gramM C)))
        (oneValue_mul_unit _ _ hrv)
    · rw [dotP_swapMap]
      exact ground.swap_congr
        (dotP_comboNull n r hr _ C hC hrC)

name: perp_span
statement:
theorem perp_span (n : Nat) (M : Mat) (y x : List BPair)
    (hM : rowsLen n M) (hy : y.length = n)
    (hperp : ∀ k, k < M.length →
      (dotP y (ground.getAt [] M k)).oneValue BPair.unit)
    (hsp : spanRel n M x) :
    (dotP y x).oneValue BPair.unit
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c0, cs, hc0, _, hone⟩ := span_elim hsp
  refine mul_cancel_unit hc0 ?_
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans
    (BPair.oneValue_symm (dotP_vecScale_right y x c0)) ?_
  exact BPair.oneValue_trans
    (dotP_oneValue_right y (vecScale c0 x) (combo n cs M) hone)
    (dotP_comboNull n y hy cs M hM hperp)

name: swap_scale_read
statement:
private theorem swap_scale_read (x : BPair) :
    (x.swap).oneValue (swapCoef * x)
proof:
:= by
  show x.snd + (Pos.one * x.snd + (Pos.one + Pos.one) * x.fst)
    = (Pos.one * x.fst + (Pos.one + Pos.one) * x.snd) + x.fst
  rw [ground.one_mul, ground.one_mul, ground.right_distrib,
    ground.right_distrib, ground.one_mul, ground.one_mul,
    ← ground.add_assoc x.snd x.snd (x.fst + x.fst),
    ground.add_comm x.fst (x.snd + x.snd),
    ground.add_assoc (x.snd + x.snd) x.fst x.fst]

name: swapMap_scale
statement:
theorem swapMap_scale : ∀ u : List BPair,
    poly.oneValue (u.map BPair.swap) (vecScale swapCoef u)
  | [] => trivial
  | a :: t => ⟨swap_scale_read a, swapMap_scale t⟩

/
in that span. -/

name: spanRel_residV
statement:
theorem spanRel_residV (n : Nat) (L M : Mat)
    (v : List BPair) (hLn : rowsLen n L) (hv : v.length = n)
    (hMn : rowsLen n M)
    (hLsp : ∀ k, k < L.length →
      spanRel n M (ground.getAt [] L k))
    (hvsp : spanRel n M v) :
    spanRel n M (residV n L v)
proof:
:= by
  have hco : spanRel n M
      (combo n (adjP (gramM L)
        (L.map (fun r => dotP r v))) L) :=
    spanRel_combo n M hMn L _ hLn hLsp
  refine spanRel_add n M _ _ hMn ?_ ?_
    (spanRel_scale n M v _ hMn hv hvsp) ?_
  · rw [length_vecScale]
    exact hv
  · rw [ground.length_map, length_combo n _ L hLn]
  · refine spanRel_congr n M _ _
      (poly.oneValue_symm (swapMap_scale _)) ?_
      (by rw [ground.length_map, length_combo n _ L hLn])
    exact spanRel_scale n M _ swapCoef hMn
      (length_combo n _ L hLn) hco

name: spanRel_trans
statement:
theorem spanRel_trans (n : Nat) (G M : Mat)
    (x : List BPair) (hG : rowsLen n G) (hM : rowsLen n M)
    (hrows : ∀ k, k < G.length →
      spanRel n M (ground.getAt [] G k))
    (h : spanRel n G x) : spanRel n M x
proof:
:=
  span_intro n M x hM h.2.1
    (spanE_trans n G M x hG hM
      (fun k hk => span_elim (hrows k hk)) (span_elim h))

name: vecAdd_cancel_right
statement:
theorem vecAdd_cancel_right : ∀ (A B S : List BPair),
    A.length = B.length → A.length = S.length →
    poly.oneValue (vecAdd A S) (vecAdd B S) →
    poly.oneValue A B
  | [], [], _, _, _, _ => trivial
  | [], _ :: _, _, hl, _, _ => Nat.noConfusion hl
  | _ :: _, [], _, hl, _, _ => Nat.noConfusion hl
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, [], _, hs, _ => Nat.noConfusion hs
  | _ :: A, _ :: B, _ :: S, hl, hs, h =>
    ⟨ground.BPair.add_cancel h.1,
     vecAdd_cancel_right A B S (Nat.succ.inj hl)
       (Nat.succ.inj hs) h.2⟩

/

name: vecAdd_congr
statement:
theorem vecAdd_congr : ∀ (A B S : List BPair),
    A.length = B.length → poly.oneValue A B →
    poly.oneValue (vecAdd A S) (vecAdd B S)
  | [], [], _, _, _ => trivial
  | [], _ :: _, _, hl, _ => Nat.noConfusion hl
  | _ :: _, [], _, hl, _ => Nat.noConfusion hl
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, [], _, _ => trivial
  | _ :: A, _ :: B, s :: S, hl, hh =>
    ⟨BPair.add_congr hh.1 (BPair.oneValue_refl s),
     vecAdd_congr A B S (Nat.succ.inj hl) hh.2⟩

/

name: vecAdd_congr2
statement:
theorem vecAdd_congr2 (A A' B B' : List BPair)
    (hA : A.length = A'.length) (hB : B.length = B'.length)
    (h1 : poly.oneValue A A') (h2 : poly.oneValue B B') :
    poly.oneValue (vecAdd A B) (vecAdd A' B')
proof:
:= by
  refine poly.oneValue_trans (vecAdd_congr A A' B hA h1) ?_
  rw [vecAdd_comm A' B, vecAdd_comm A' B']
  exact vecAdd_congr B B' A' hB h2

name: residV_expand
statement:
theorem residV_expand (n : Nat) (L : Mat) (v : List BPair)
    (hLn : rowsLen n L) (hv : v.length = n) :
    poly.oneValue (vecScale (detL (gramM L)) v)
      (vecAdd (residV n L v)
        (combo n (adjP (gramM L)
          (L.map (fun r => dotP r v))) L))
proof:
:= by
  have hS : (vecScale (detL (gramM L)) v).length = n := by
    rw [length_vecScale, hv]
  have hC : (combo n (adjP (gramM L)
      (L.map (fun r => dotP r v))) L).length = n :=
    length_combo n (adjP (gramM L) (L.map (fun r => dotP r v))) L hLn
  have hCs : ((combo n (adjP (gramM L)
      (L.map (fun r => dotP r v))) L).map BPair.swap).length = n := by
    rw [ground.length_map]
    exact hC
  have hR : (residV n L v).length = n := length_residV n L v hLn hv
  refine poly.oneValue_of_entries _ _
    (by rw [hS, length_vecAdd _ _ n hR hC]) ?_
  intro i hi
  rw [hS] at hi
  rw [getAt_vecAdd (residV n L v)
      (combo n (adjP (gramM L) (L.map (fun r => dotP r v))) L) i
      (by rw [hR]; exact hi) (by rw [hC]; exact hi),
    show residV n L v
        = vecAdd (vecScale (detL (gramM L)) v)
          ((combo n (adjP (gramM L)
            (L.map (fun r => dotP r v))) L).map BPair.swap) from rfl,
    getAt_vecAdd (vecScale (detL (gramM L)) v)
      ((combo n (adjP (gramM L)
        (L.map (fun r => dotP r v))) L).map BPair.swap) i
      (by rw [hS]; exact hi) (by rw [hCs]; exact hi),
    ground.getAt_map BPair.unit BPair.unit BPair.swap
      (combo n (adjP (gramM L) (L.map (fun r => dotP r v))) L) i
      (by rw [hC]; exact hi),
    BPair.add_assoc]
  exact BPair.oneValue_symm
    (BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.add_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl _)
        (BPair.swap_add_null (BPair.oneValue_refl _)))
      (BPair.add_unit _))

name: spanRel_mono_left
statement:
theorem spanRel_mono_left (n : Nat) (L M : Mat) (v : List BPair)
    (hL : rowsLen n L) (hM : rowsLen n M)
    (h : spanRel n M v) : spanRel n (L ++ M) v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c₀, cs, hc₀, hcl, hone⟩ := span_elim h
  refine span_intro n (L ++ M) v (rowsLen_append n hL hM) h.2.1
    ⟨c₀, List.replicate L.length BPair.unit ++ cs, hc₀, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [ground.length_append, ground.length_append,
      ground.length_replicate, hcl]
  · refine poly.oneValue_trans hone (poly.oneValue_symm ?_)
    refine poly.oneValue_trans
      (combo_append n (List.replicate L.length BPair.unit) L cs M
        (ground.length_replicate BPair.unit L.length) hL hM) ?_
    exact vecAdd_null_left _ _
      (by rw [length_combo n (List.replicate L.length BPair.unit) L hL,
        length_combo n cs M hM])
      (combo_unitsT n L L.length)

name: length_insertAt
statement:
private theorem length_insertAt {α : Type} (x : α) :
    ∀ (l : List α) (n : Nat), (insertAt x l n).length = l.length + 1
  | [], 0 => rfl
  | _ :: _, 0 => rfl
  | [], _ + 1 => rfl
  | _ :: t, n + 1 => congrArg Nat.succ (length_insertAt x t n)

/
seed is the empty family and every round's map keeps it. -/
private theorem kernelGo_w0 : ∀ (fuel : Nat) (prev : BPair)
    (rows : List SRow), kernelGo fuel 0 prev rows = []
  | 0, _, _ => rfl
  | fuel + 1, prev, rows => by
    show (match sFind rows with
      | none => idMat 0
      | some (i, j) =>
        let p := sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)
        let t := denseRow (0 - 1) p.2
        (kernelGo fuel (0 - 1) p.1
            (stepRows prev p j (rows.eraseIdx i))).map
          (fun v => insertAt ((dotN t v).swap) (vecScale p.1 v) j))
      = []
    cases hf : sFind rows with
    | none => rfl
    | some ij =>
      show ((kernelGo fuel 0
          (sPeel ij.2 (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows ij.1)).1
          (stepRows prev
            (sPeel ij.2 (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows ij.1))
            ij.2 (rows.eraseIdx ij.1))).map _) = []
      rw [kernelGo_w0 fuel _ _]
      rfl

/
one place, the scaling leaving the member's own width. -/
private theorem rowsLen_extend (w j : Nat) (c : BPair)
    (t : List BPair) : ∀ K : List (List BPair), rowsLen w K →
    rowsLen (w + 1) (K.map
      (fun v => insertAt ((dotN t v).swap) (vecScale c v) j))
  | [], _ => trivial
  | _ :: K, h =>
    ⟨by rw [length_insertAt, length_vecScale, h.1],
      rowsLen_extend w j c t K h.2⟩

/
the terminal seed reads it off the replaced unit family, and a
round's extension grows the round below's width by one place. -/
private theorem kernelGo_rowsLen : ∀ (fuel w : Nat) (prev : BPair)
    (rows : List SRow), rowsLen w (kernelGo fuel w prev rows)
  | 0, w, _, _ => rowsLen_idMat w
  | fuel + 1, 0, prev, rows => by
    rw [kernelGo_w0 (fuel + 1) prev rows]
    exact trivial
  | fuel + 1, w + 1, prev, rows => by
    show rowsLen (w + 1) (match sFind rows with
      | none => idMat (w + 1)
      | some (i, j) =>
        let p := sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)
        let t := denseRow (w + 1 - 1) p.2
        (kernelGo fuel (w + 1 - 1) p.1
            (stepRows prev p j (rows.eraseIdx i))).map
          (fun v => insertAt ((dotN t v).swap) (vecScale p.1 v) j))
    cases hf : sFind rows with
    | none => exact rowsLen_idMat (w + 1)
    | some ij =>
      exact rowsLen_extend w ij.2
        (sPeel ij.2 (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows ij.1)).1
        (denseRow w
          (sPeel ij.2 (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows ij.1)).2)
        _ (kernelGo_rowsLen fuel w _ _)

name: natSubOneJoin
statement:
private theorem natSubOneJoin : ∀ (n k : Nat),
    n - (1 + k) = n - 1 - k
  | _, 0 => rfl
  | n, k + 1 => congrArg (· - 1) (natSubOneJoin n k)

/
descent's own pivot count: the terminal seed reads one member per
column key against a pivot count of nought, and a round trades one
stated column for one pivot, the two truncations joining. -/
private theorem kernelGo_length : ∀ (fuel w : Nat) (prev : BPair)
    (rows : List SRow),
    (kernelGo fuel w prev rows).length = w - sdescend fuel prev rows
  | 0, w, _, _ => by
    show (idMat w).length = w - 0
    rw [length_idMat, Nat.sub_zero]
  | fuel + 1, w, prev, rows => by
    show (match sFind rows with
        | none => idMat w
        | some (i, j) =>
          let p := sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)
          let t := denseRow (w - 1) p.2
          (kernelGo fuel (w - 1) p.1
              (stepRows prev p j (rows.eraseIdx i))).map
            (fun v =>
              insertAt ((dotN t v).swap) (vecScale p.1 v) j)).length
      = w - (match sFind rows with
        | none => 0
        | some (i, j) =>
          let p := sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)
          1 + sdescend fuel p.1
            (stepRows prev p j (rows.eraseIdx i)))
    cases hf : sFind rows with
    | none =>
      show (idMat w).length = w - 0
      rw [length_idMat, Nat.sub_zero]
    | some ij =>
      show ((kernelGo fuel (w - 1)
            (sPeel ij.2 (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows ij.1)).1
            (stepRows prev
              (sPeel ij.2 (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows ij.1))
              ij.2 (rows.eraseIdx ij.1))).map _).length
        = w - (1 + sdescend fuel
            (sPeel ij.2 (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows ij.1)).1
            (stepRows prev
              (sPeel ij.2 (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows ij.1))
              ij.2 (rows.eraseIdx ij.1)))
      rw [ground.length_map, kernelGo_length fuel (w - 1)
        (sPeel ij.2 (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows ij.1)).1
        (stepRows prev
          (sPeel ij.2 (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows ij.1))
          ij.2 (rows.eraseIdx ij.1)), natSubOneJoin]

name: sFind_lt
statement:
private theorem sFind_lt : ∀ (rows : List SRow) (i j : Nat),
    sFind rows = some (i, j) → i < rows.length
  | [], _, _, h => nomatch h
  | (_, []) :: rest, i, j, h => by
    revert h
    show (match sFind rest with
        | none => none
        | some (a, b) => some (a + 1, b)) = some (i, j) →
      i < rest.length + 1
    cases hf : sFind rest with
    | none =>
      intro h
      exact nomatch h
    | some ij =>
      intro h
      have hi : ij.1 + 1 = i
proof:
:=
        congrArg Prod.fst (Option.some.inj h)
      rw [← hi]
      exact Nat.succ_lt_succ (sFind_lt rest ij.1 ij.2 hf)
  | (_, (k, _) :: _) :: rest, i, j, h => by
    have h' : ((0, k) : Nat × Nat) = (i, j) := Option.some.inj h
    have hi : (0 : Nat) = i := congrArg Prod.fst h'
    rw [← hi]
    exact Nat.zero_lt_succ rest.length

name: sFind_key
statement:
private theorem sFind_key : ∀ (w : Nat) (rows : List SRow)
    (i j : Nat), SInv w rows → sFind rows = some (i, j) → j < w
  | _, [], _, _, _, h => nomatch h
  | w, (c, []) :: rest, i, j, hinv, h => by
    have hh : (c = w ∧ ground.keysBelow w ([] : List (Nat × BPair)))
        ∧ SInv w rest
proof:
:= hinv
    revert h
    show (match sFind rest with
        | none => none
        | some (a, b) => some (a + 1, b)) = some (i, j) → j < w
    cases hf : sFind rest with
    | none =>
      intro h
      exact nomatch h
    | some ij =>
      intro h
      have hj : ij.2 = j := congrArg Prod.snd (Option.some.inj h)
      rw [← hj]
      exact sFind_key w rest ij.1 ij.2 hh.2 hf
  | w, (c, (k, v) :: es) :: rest, i, j, hinv, h => by
    have hh : (c = w ∧ ground.keysBelow w ((k, v) :: es))
        ∧ SInv w rest := hinv
    have hk : k < w ∧ ground.keysBelow w es := hh.1.2
    have h' : ((0, k) : Nat × Nat) = (i, j) := Option.some.inj h
    have hj : k = j := congrArg Prod.snd h'
    rw [← hj]
    exact hk.1

name: keysBelow_ofRowFrom
statement:
private theorem keysBelow_ofRowFrom : ∀ (r : List BPair) (k : Nat),
    ground.keysBelow (k + r.length) (ofRowFrom k r)
  | [], _ => trivial
  | e :: es, k => by
    have hib : ground.keysBelow (k + (es.length + 1))
        (ofRowFrom (k + 1) es)
proof:
:= by
      have h := keysBelow_ofRowFrom es (k + 1)
      rw [Nat.succ_add k es.length] at h
      exact h
    show ground.keysBelow (k + (es.length + 1))
      (match (e.norm).isUnitRep with
        | true => ofRowFrom (k + 1) es
        | false => (k, e.norm) :: ofRowFrom (k + 1) es)
    cases hu : (e.norm).isUnitRep with
    | true => exact hib
    | false =>
      exact ⟨Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.le_add_right k es.length), hib⟩

name: keysBelow_le
statement:
private theorem keysBelow_le {v w : Nat} (h : v ≤ w) :
    ∀ es : List (Nat × BPair), ground.keysBelow v es → ground.keysBelow w es
  | [], _ => trivial
  | (k, _) :: es, he => by
    have hh : k < v ∧ ground.keysBelow v es
proof:
:= he
    exact ⟨Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hh.1 h, keysBelow_le h es hh.2⟩

name: sInv_ofRow
statement:
private theorem sInv_ofRow (cols : Nat) : ∀ (m : Mat),
    rowsLen cols m → SInv cols (m.map ofRow)
  | [], _ => trivial
  | r :: t, h => by
    have hr : r.length = cols ∧ rowsLen cols t
proof:
:= h
    refine ⟨⟨hr.1, ?_⟩, sInv_ofRow cols t hr.2⟩
    refine keysBelow_le ?_ (ofRowFrom 0 r) (keysBelow_ofRowFrom r 0)
    show 0 + r.length ≤ cols
    rw [Nat.zero_add]
    exact Nat.le_of_eq hr.1

name: sInv_eraseIdx
statement:
private theorem sInv_eraseIdx (w : Nat) : ∀ (rows : List SRow)
    (i : Nat), SInv w rows → SInv w (rows.eraseIdx i)
  | [], _, _ => trivial
  | r :: t, 0, h => by
    have hh : (r.1 = w ∧ ground.keysBelow w r.2) ∧ SInv w t
proof:
:= h
    exact hh.2
  | r :: t, i + 1, h => by
    have hh : (r.1 = w ∧ ground.keysBelow w r.2) ∧ SInv w t := h
    exact ⟨hh.1, sInv_eraseIdx w t i hh.2⟩

name: keysBelow_keepTail
statement:
private theorem keysBelow_keepTail (f : BPair → BPair) (lim : Nat) :
    ∀ es : List (Nat × BPair), ground.keysBelow lim (keepTail f lim es)
  | [] => trivial
  | (k, e) :: es => by
    show ground.keysBelow lim
      (match !(f e).isUnitRep && Nat.blt k lim with
        | true => (k, f e) :: keepTail f lim es
        | false => keepTail f lim es)
    cases hg : !(f e).isUnitRep && Nat.blt k lim with
    | true =>
      exact ⟨bltLt (ground.andSplitB hg).2,
        keysBelow_keepTail f lim es⟩
    | false => exact keysBelow_keepTail f lim es

/
entry it keeps passed the same bound guard the kept-entry walk
reads, the split's own second component carrying no bound. -/
private theorem keysBelow_fillBelow (prev r0 : BPair) (lim k : Nat) :
    ∀ ps : List (Nat × BPair),
      ground.keysBelow lim (fillBelow prev r0 lim k ps).1
  | [] => trivial
  | (kt, t) :: ps => by
    show ground.keysBelow lim
      (match Nat.blt kt k with
        | false => ([], (kt, t) :: ps)
        | true =>
          match !(fillEntry prev r0 t).isUnitRep

  | ps, (ke, e) :: es => by
    show ground.keysBelow lim

                ++ mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim ((kt, t) :: pr) es)
    cases hb : (fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps).2 with
    | nil =>
      exact ground.keysBelow_append lim _ _
        (keysBelow_fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps)

          ((ke, e) :: es))
    | cons hd pr =>

        (match Nat.beq hd.1 ke with

                && Nat.blt ke lim with

            | false => (fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps).1
                ++ mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim pr es
          | false =>
            match !(scaleEntry prev pivot e).isUnitRep
                && Nat.blt ke lim with
            | true => (fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps).1
                ++ (ke, scaleEntry prev pivot e)
                  :: mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim (hd :: pr) es
            | false => (fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps).1
                ++ mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim (hd :: pr) es)
      cases hbe : Nat.beq hd.1 ke with
      | true =>
        cases hg : !(jointEntry prev pivot hd.2 r0 e).isUnitRep
            && Nat.blt ke lim with
        | true =>
          exact ground.keysBelow_append lim _ _
            (keysBelow_fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps)
            ⟨bltLt (ground.andSplitB hg).2,
              keysBelow_mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim pr es⟩
        | false =>
          exact ground.keysBelow_append lim _ _
            (keysBelow_fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps)
            (keysBelow_mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim pr es)
      | false =>
        cases hg : !(scaleEntry prev pivot e).isUnitRep
            && Nat.blt ke lim with
        | true =>
          exact ground.keysBelow_append lim _ _
            (keysBelow_fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps)
            ⟨bltLt (ground.andSplitB hg).2,
              keysBelow_mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim (hd :: pr) es⟩
        | false =>
          exact ground.keysBelow_append lim _ _
            (keysBelow_fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps)
            (keysBelow_mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim (hd :: pr) es)

scaling walk and the merge both keep an entry only past the bound
guard. -/
private theorem keysBelow_stepSRow (prev pivot r0 : BPair)
    (lim : Nat) (ps es : List (Nat × BPair)) :
      ground.keysBelow lim (stepSRow prev pivot r0 lim ps es)
proof:
:= by
  show ground.keysBelow lim
    (match r0.isUnitRep with
      | true => scaleTail prev pivot lim es
      | false => mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim ps es)
  cases hu : r0.isUnitRep with
