name: sPeel_count
statement:
private theorem sPeel_count {w j : Nat} (r : SRow) (hj : j < w)
    (hr : r.1 = w) : ((sPeel j r).2).1 = w - 1
proof:
:= by
  show (match Nat.blt j r.1 with
      | true => r.1 - 1
      | false => r.1) = w - 1
  rw [hr, ltBlt hj]

name: sInv_step
statement:
private theorem sInv_step (w : Nat) (prev : BPair)
    (p : BPair × SRow) (j : Nat) (hp : p.2.1 = w - 1)
    (rows : List SRow) (hrows : SInv w rows) (hj : j < w) :
    SInv (w - 1) (stepRows prev p j rows)
proof:
:= by
  revert hrows
  induction rows with
  | nil => exact fun _ => trivial
  | cons r t ih =>
    intro hrows
    have hh : (r.1 = w ∧ ground.keysBelow w r.2) ∧ SInv w t := hrows
    have hq : ((sPeel j r).2).1 = w - 1 :=
      sPeel_count r hj hh.1.1
    have hlim : ground.natMin p.2.1 ((sPeel j r).2).1 = w - 1 := by
      rw [hp, hq]
      exact natMin_self (w - 1)
    show ((ground.natMin p.2.1 ((sPeel j r).2).1 = w - 1)
        ∧ ground.keysBelow (w - 1)
          (stepSRow prev p.1 (sPeel j r).1
            (ground.natMin p.2.1 ((sPeel j r).2).1) p.2.2
            ((sPeel j r).2).2))
      ∧ SInv (w - 1) (t.map (fun s =>
        let q := sPeel j s
        let lim := ground.natMin p.2.1 q.2.1
        (lim, stepSRow prev p.1 q.1 lim p.2.2 q.2.2)))
    rw [hlim]
    exact ⟨⟨rfl, keysBelow_stepSRow prev p.1 (sPeel j r).1 (w - 1)
      p.2.2 ((sPeel j r).2).2⟩, ih hh.2⟩

name: sInv_getAt
statement:
private theorem sInv_getAt (w : Nat) : ∀ (rows : List SRow)
    (i : Nat), SInv w rows → i < rows.length →
      (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i).1 = w
      ∧ ground.keysBelow w (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i).2
  | [], _, _, hi => absurd hi (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | r :: t, 0, h, _ => by
    have hh : (r.1 = w ∧ ground.keysBelow w r.2) ∧ SInv w t
proof:
:= h
    exact hh.1
  | r :: t, i + 1, h, hi => by
    have hh : (r.1 = w ∧ ground.keysBelow w r.2) ∧ SInv w t := h
    exact sInv_getAt w t i hh.2 (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hi)

name: sdescend_le
statement:
private theorem sdescend_le : ∀ (fuel w : Nat) (prev : BPair)
    (rows : List SRow), SInv w rows →
      sdescend fuel prev rows ≤ w
  | 0, w, _, _, _ => Nat.zero_le w
  | fuel + 1, w, prev, rows, hinv => by
    show (match sFind rows with
        | none => 0
        | some (i, j) =>
          let p := sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)
          1 + sdescend fuel p.1
            (stepRows prev p j (rows.eraseIdx i))) ≤ w
    cases hf : sFind rows with
    | none => exact Nat.zero_le w
    | some ij =>
      show 1 + sdescend fuel
          (sPeel ij.2 (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows ij.1)).1
          (stepRows prev
            (sPeel ij.2 (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows ij.1))
            ij.2 (rows.eraseIdx ij.1)) ≤ w
      have hj : ij.2 < w
proof:
:= sFind_key w rows ij.1 ij.2 hinv hf
      have hi : ij.1 < rows.length := sFind_lt rows ij.1 ij.2 hf
      have hrow := sInv_getAt w rows ij.1 hinv hi
      have hp : ((sPeel ij.2
          (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows ij.1)).2).1 = w - 1 :=
        sPeel_count _ hj hrow.1
      have hstep := sInv_step w prev
        (sPeel ij.2 (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows ij.1)) ij.2
        hp (rows.eraseIdx ij.1) (sInv_eraseIdx w rows ij.1 hinv) hj
      have hrec := sdescend_le fuel (w - 1)
        (sPeel ij.2 (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows ij.1)).1
        (stepRows prev
          (sPeel ij.2 (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows ij.1))
          ij.2 (rows.eraseIdx ij.1)) hstep
      cases w with
      | zero => exact absurd hj (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
      | succ w' =>
        rw [Nat.add_comm 1]
        exact Nat.succ_le_succ hrec

name: kernelList_length
statement:
theorem kernelList_length (cols : Nat) (m : Mat)
    (hm : rowsLen cols m) :
    (kernelList cols m).length + rank m = cols
proof:
:= by
  rw [kernelList_dim]
  show cols - rank m + rank m = cols
  rw [Nat.add_comm]
  exact ground.natAddSubCancel
    (sdescend_le m.length cols (BPair.ofPos .one) (m.map ofRow)
      (sInv_ofRow cols m hm))

name: repOfGuardFalse
statement:
private theorem repOfGuardFalse {b t : Bool} (ht : t = true)
    (h : (!b && t) = false) : b = true
proof:
:= by
  rw [ht] at h
  cases b with
  | true => rfl
  | false => exact Bool.noConfusion h

name: keysAsc_le
statement:
private theorem keysAsc_le {lo lo' : Nat} (h : lo' ≤ lo) :
    ∀ es : List (Nat × BPair), keysAsc lo es → keysAsc lo' es
  | [], _ => trivial
  | (k, _) :: es, he => by
    have hh : lo ≤ k ∧ keysAsc (k + 1) es
proof:
:= he
    exact ⟨Nat.le_trans h hh.1, hh.2⟩

name: keyAt_lo
statement:
private theorem keyAt_lo {lo : Nat} : ∀ es : List (Nat × BPair),
    keysAsc lo es → ∀ a, a < lo → ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a es = BPair.unit
  | [], _, _, _ => rfl
  | (k, v) :: es, he, a, ha => by
    have hh : lo ≤ k ∧ keysAsc (k + 1) es
proof:
:= he
    have hak : a < k := Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le ha hh.1
    show (cond (Nat.beq k a) (v) (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a es)) = BPair.unit
    rw [ground.beqFalse (Nat.ne_of_gt hak)]
    exact keyAt_lo es hh.2 a (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hak)

name: keyAt_append_unit
statement:
private theorem keyAt_append_unit (a : Nat) (v : List (Nat × BPair))
    (hv : ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a v = BPair.unit) :
    ∀ u : List (Nat × BPair), ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a (u ++ v) = ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a u
  | [] => hv
  | (k, x) :: u => by
    show (cond (Nat.beq k a) (x) (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a (u ++ v)))
      = (cond (Nat.beq k a) (x) (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a u))
    cases Nat.beq k a with
    | true => rfl
    | false => exact keyAt_append_unit a v hv u

/
private theorem keyAt_append_below (w : Nat) :
    ∀ u : List (Nat × BPair), ground.keysBelow w u →
      ∀ (v : List (Nat × BPair)) (a : Nat), ¬ a < w →
        ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a (u ++ v) = ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a v
  | [], _, _, _, _ => rfl
  | (k, x) :: u, hu, v, a, ha => by
    have hh : k < w ∧ ground.keysBelow w u
proof:
:= hu
    show (cond (Nat.beq k a) (x) (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a (u ++ v))) = ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a v
    rw [beqFalse (fun he => ha (by rw [← he]; exact hh.1))]
    exact keyAt_append_below w u hh.2 v a ha

name: keyAt_append_below
statement:
private theorem keyAt_append_below (w : Nat) :
    ∀ u : List (Nat × BPair), ground.keysBelow w u →
      ∀ (v : List (Nat × BPair)) (a : Nat), ¬ a < w →
        ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a (u ++ v) = ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a v
  | [], _, _, _, _ => rfl
  | (k, x) :: u, hu, v, a, ha => by
    have hh : k < w ∧ ground.keysBelow w u
proof:
:= hu
    show (cond (Nat.beq k a) (x) (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a (u ++ v))) = ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a v
    rw [beqFalse (fun he => ha (by rw [← he]; exact hh.1))]
    exact keyAt_append_below w u hh.2 v a ha

name: eqUnit_of_snd_one
statement:
private theorem eqUnit_of_snd_one {x : BPair} (hs : x.snd = Pos.one)
    (he : x.fst = x.snd) : x = BPair.unit
proof:
:= by
  show (⟨x.fst, x.snd⟩ : BPair) = BPair.unit
  rw [he, hs]
  rfl

name: eqUnit_of_fst_one
statement:
private theorem eqUnit_of_fst_one {x : BPair} (hs : x.fst = Pos.one)
    (he : x.fst = x.snd) : x = BPair.unit
proof:
:= by
  show (⟨x.fst, x.snd⟩ : BPair) = BPair.unit
  rw [← he, hs]
  rfl

name: offRepSnd
statement:
private theorem offRepSnd {x : BPair} (h : x.isUnitRep = false)
    (hs : x.snd = Pos.one) : ¬ x.oneValue BPair.unit
proof:
:= by
  intro hov
  rw [eqUnit_of_snd_one hs (BPair.eqMem_of_oneValue hov)] at h
  exact Bool.noConfusion h

name: offRepFst
statement:
private theorem offRepFst {x : BPair} (h : x.isUnitRep = false)
    (hs : x.fst = Pos.one) : ¬ x.oneValue BPair.unit
proof:
:= by
  intro hov
  rw [eqUnit_of_fst_one hs (BPair.eqMem_of_oneValue hov)] at h
  exact Bool.noConfusion h

name: norm_one_mem
statement:
private theorem norm_one_mem (x : BPair) :
    (x.norm).snd = Pos.one ∨ (x.norm).fst = Pos.one
proof:
:= by
  unfold BPair.norm
  cases x.side with
  | lt _ _ => exact Or.inr rfl
  | eq _ => exact Or.inl rfl
  | gt _ _ => exact Or.inl rfl

name: offRep_norm
proof:
:= by
  cases norm_one_mem x with
  | inl hs => exact offRepSnd h hs
  | inr hs => exact offRepFst h hs

name: cofMag_one_snd
statement:
private theorem cofMag_one_snd : ∀ m : Option Pos,
    (match m with
      | some c => BPair.ofPos c
      | none => BPair.unit).snd = Pos.one
  | none => rfl
  | some _ => rfl

/
private theorem cofMag_one_fst : ∀ m : Option Pos,
    (match m with
      | some c => (BPair.ofPos c).swap
      | none => BPair.unit).fst = Pos.one
  | none => rfl
  | some _ => rfl

/
branch answers at the unit, a ground datum's balance read or its
swap. -/
private theorem cofactorAt_one_mem (E P : BPair) :
    (cofactorAt E P).snd = Pos.one
      ∨ (cofactorAt E P).fst = Pos.one
proof:
:= by
  unfold cofactorAt
  cases E.side with
  | eq _ => cases P.side <;> exact Or.inl rfl
  | lt e _ =>
    cases P.side with
    | eq _ => exact Or.inl rfl
    | lt p _ => exact Or.inl (cofMag_one_snd (cofactorMag e p))
    | gt p _ => exact Or.inr (cofMag_one_fst (cofactorMag e p))
  | gt e _ =>
    cases P.side with
    | eq _ => exact Or.inl rfl
    | lt p _ => exact Or.inr (cofMag_one_fst (cofactorMag e p))
    | gt p _ => exact Or.inl (cofMag_one_snd (cofactorMag e p))

statement:

    (match m with

/

proof:

name: cofactorAt_congr
statement:
private theorem cofactorAt_congr {E E' : BPair} (P : BPair)
    (h : E.oneValue E') : cofactorAt E P = cofactorAt E' P
proof:
:= by
  unfold cofactorAt
  cases hE : E.side with
  | eq he =>
    cases hE' : E'.side with
    | eq _ => cases P.side <;> rfl
    | lt g' hg' =>
      exact (gapEqClashL
        (ground.gapCongrL (BPair.oneValue_symm h) hg') he).elim
    | gt g' hg' =>
      exact (gapEqClash
        (ground.gapCongr (BPair.oneValue_symm h) hg') he).elim
  | lt g hg =>
    cases hE' : E'.side with
    | eq he' => exact (gapEqClashL (ground.gapCongrL h hg) he').elim
    | gt g' hg' => exact (gapClash hg' (ground.gapCongrL h hg)).elim
    | lt g' hg' =>
      have hgg : g = g' :=
        ground.gap_unique (ground.gapCongrL h hg) hg'
      cases P.side with
      | eq _ => rfl
      | lt p _ =>
        show (match cofactorMag g p with
            | some c => BPair.ofPos c
            | none => BPair.unit)
          = (match cofactorMag g' p with
            | some c => BPair.ofPos c
            | none => BPair.unit)
        rw [hgg]
      | gt p _ =>
        show (match cofactorMag g p with
            | some c => (BPair.ofPos c).swap
            | none => BPair.unit)
          = (match cofactorMag g' p with
            | some c => (BPair.ofPos c).swap
            | none => BPair.unit)
        rw [hgg]
  | gt g hg =>
    cases hE' : E'.side with
    | eq he' => exact (gapEqClash (ground.gapCongr h hg) he').elim
    | lt g' hg' => exact (gapClash (ground.gapCongr h hg) hg').elim
    | gt g' hg' =>
      have hgg : g = g' :=
        ground.gap_unique (ground.gapCongr h hg) hg'
      cases P.side with
      | eq _ => rfl
      | lt p _ =>
        show (match cofactorMag g p with
            | some c => (BPair.ofPos c).swap
            | none => BPair.unit)
          = (match cofactorMag g' p with
            | some c => (BPair.ofPos c).swap
            | none => BPair.unit)
        rw [hgg]
      | gt p _ =>
        show (match cofactorMag g p with
            | some c => BPair.ofPos c
            | none => BPair.unit)
          = (match cofactorMag g' p with
            | some c => BPair.ofPos c
            | none => BPair.unit)
        rw [hgg]

name: cofactorAt_addEq
statement:
private theorem cofactorAt_addEq (X P : BPair) {c : BPair}
    (hc : c.fst = c.snd) : cofactorAt (X + c) P = cofactorAt X P
proof:
:= by
  refine cofactorAt_congr P ?_
  show X.fst + c.fst + X.snd = X.fst + (X.snd + c.snd)
  rw [hc, ground.add_assoc, ground.add_comm c.snd X.snd]

name: cofactorAt_addEqL
statement:
private theorem cofactorAt_addEqL (X P : BPair) {c : BPair}
    (hc : c.fst = c.snd) : cofactorAt (c + X) P = cofactorAt X P
proof:
:= by
  rw [BPair.add_comm]
  exact cofactorAt_addEq X P hc

name: eqMemMulUnit
statement:
private theorem eqMemMulUnit (a : BPair) :
    (a * BPair.unit).fst = (a * BPair.unit).snd
proof:
:=
  BPair.eqMem_of_oneValue
    (oneValue_mul_unit a BPair.unit (BPair.oneValue_refl BPair.unit))

name: eqMemUnitMul
statement:
private theorem eqMemUnitMul (a : BPair) :
    (BPair.unit * a).fst = (BPair.unit * a).snd
proof:
:=
  BPair.eqMem_of_oneValue
    (oneValue_unit_mul (BPair.oneValue_refl BPair.unit))

name: scaleEntry_unit
statement:
private theorem scaleEntry_unit (prev pivot : BPair) :
    scaleEntry prev pivot BPair.unit = BPair.unit
proof:
:=
  cofactorAt_eqMem (pivot * BPair.unit) prev (eqMemMulUnit pivot)

name: fillEntry_unit
statement:
private theorem fillEntry_unit (prev r0 : BPair) :
    fillEntry prev r0 BPair.unit = BPair.unit
proof:
:=
  cofactorAt_eqMem ((r0 * BPair.unit).swap) prev
    (eqMemMulUnit r0).symm

name: stepRead_noFill
proof:
:=
  cofactorAt_addEq (pivot * x) prev (eqMemMulUnit r0).symm

name: stepRead_noScale
proof:

name: stepRead_null
proof:

  step_unit prev pivot BPair.unit r0 BPair.unit rfl (Or.inr rfl)

name: stepRead_unitCol
proof:
:=
  cofactorAt_addEq (pivot * x) prev (eqMemUnitMul y).symm

name: keyAt_hit
proof:
:= by
  show (cond (Nat.beq k a) (v) (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a es)) = v
  rw [hb]
  exact rfl

name: keyAt_miss
proof:
:= by
  show (cond (Nat.beq k a) (v) (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a es)) = ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a es
  rw [hb]
  exact rfl

name: keysAsc_shiftKeys
statement:
private theorem keysAsc_shiftKeys : ∀ (es : List (Nat × BPair))
    (lo : Nat), keysAsc (lo + 1) es → keysAsc lo (shiftKeys es)
  | [], _, _ => trivial
  | (0, _) :: es, lo, h => by
    have hh : lo + 1 ≤ 0 ∧ keysAsc (0 + 1) es
proof:
:= h
    exact absurd hh.1 (Nat.not_succ_le_zero lo)
  | (k + 1, _) :: es, lo, h => by
    have hh : lo + 1 ≤ k + 1 ∧ keysAsc (k + 1 + 1) es := h
    exact ⟨Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hh.1,
      keysAsc_shiftKeys es (k + 1) hh.2⟩

name: keyAt_shiftKeys
statement:
private theorem keyAt_shiftKeys : ∀ es : List (Nat × BPair),
    keysAsc 1 es → ∀ c, ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit c (shiftKeys es) = ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit (c + 1) es
  | [], _, _ => rfl
  | (0, _) :: es, h, _ => by
    have hh : 1 ≤ 0 ∧ keysAsc (0 + 1) es
proof:
:= h
    exact absurd hh.1 (Nat.not_succ_le_zero 0)
  | (k + 1, v) :: es, h, c => by
    have hh : 1 ≤ k + 1 ∧ keysAsc (k + 1 + 1) es := h
    show (cond (Nat.beq k c) (v) (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit c (shiftKeys es)))
      = (cond (Nat.beq k c) (v) (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit (c + 1) es))
    cases Nat.beq k c with
    | true => rfl
    | false =>
      exact keyAt_shiftKeys es
        (keysAsc_le (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le (k + 1))) es hh.2)
        c

name: keyAt_peel_head
statement:
private theorem keyAt_peel_head (j : Nat) :
    ∀ es : List (Nat × BPair), keysAsc 0 es →
      (peel j es).1 = ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit j es
  | [], _ => rfl
  | (k, v) :: es, he => by
    have hh : 0 ≤ k ∧ keysAsc (k + 1) es
proof:
:= he
    show (match Nat.beq k j with
        | true => (v, shiftKeys es)
        | false =>
          match Nat.blt k j with
          | true => ((peel j es).1, (k, v) :: (peel j es).2)
          | false => (BPair.unit, shiftKeys ((k, v) :: es))).1
      = ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit j ((k, v) :: es)
    cases hbe : Nat.beq k j with
    | true =>
      show v = ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit j ((k, v) :: es)
      rw [keyAt_hit hbe v es]
    | false =>
      rw [keyAt_miss hbe v es]
      cases hb : Nat.blt k j with
      | true =>
        show (peel j es).1 = ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit j es
        exact keyAt_peel_head j es
          (keysAsc_le (Nat.zero_le (k + 1)) es hh.2)
      | false =>
        show BPair.unit = ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit j es
        exact (keyAt_lo es hh.2 j
          (Nat.lt_succ_of_le
            (Nat.le_of_not_lt (bltFalse hb)))).symm

name: keysAsc_peel
statement:
private theorem keysAsc_peel (j : Nat) :
    ∀ (es : List (Nat × BPair)) (lo : Nat), keysAsc lo es →
      lo ≤ j → keysAsc lo (peel j es).2
  | [], _, _, _ => trivial
  | (k, v) :: es, lo, he, hlo => by
    have hh : lo ≤ k ∧ keysAsc (k + 1) es
proof:
:= he
    show keysAsc lo (match Nat.beq k j with
        | true => (v, shiftKeys es)
        | false =>
          match Nat.blt k j with
          | true => ((peel j es).1, (k, v) :: (peel j es).2)
          | false => (BPair.unit, shiftKeys ((k, v) :: es))).2
    cases hbe : Nat.beq k j with
    | true =>
      show keysAsc lo (shiftKeys es)
      exact keysAsc_shiftKeys es lo
        (keysAsc_le (Nat.succ_le_succ hh.1) es hh.2)
    | false =>
      cases hb : Nat.blt k j with
      | true =>
        show keysAsc lo ((k, v) :: (peel j es).2)
        exact ⟨hh.1, keysAsc_peel j es (k + 1) hh.2 (bltLt hb)⟩
      | false =>
        show keysAsc lo (shiftKeys ((k, v) :: es))
        refine keysAsc_shiftKeys ((k, v) :: es) lo ?_
        exact ⟨Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt hlo
          (Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne (Nat.le_of_not_lt (bltFalse hb))
            (fun hjk => beqNe hbe hjk.symm)), hh.2⟩

name: keyAt_peel
statement:
private theorem keyAt_peel (j : Nat) :
    ∀ es : List (Nat × BPair), keysAsc 0 es →
      ∀ c, ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit c (peel j es).2 = ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit (liftIx j c) es
  | [], _, _ => rfl
  | (k, v) :: es, he, c => by
    have hh : 0 ≤ k ∧ keysAsc (k + 1) es
proof:
:= he
    have hes : keysAsc 0 es := keysAsc_le (Nat.zero_le (k + 1)) es hh.2
    show ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit c (match Nat.beq k j with
        | true => (v, shiftKeys es)
        | false =>
          match Nat.blt k j with
          | true => ((peel j es).1, (k, v) :: (peel j es).2)
          | false => (BPair.unit, shiftKeys ((k, v) :: es))).2
      = ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit (liftIx j c) ((k, v) :: es)
    cases hbe : Nat.beq k j with
    | true =>
      have hkj : k = j := ground.beqEq k j hbe
      have hjes : keysAsc (j + 1) es := by
        rw [← hkj]; exact hh.2
      show ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit c (shiftKeys es) = ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit (liftIx j c) ((k, v) :: es)
      rw [keyAt_miss
          (beqFalse (fun hf => liftIx_ne j c (hf.symm.trans hkj)))
          v es,
        keyAt_shiftKeys es
          (keysAsc_le (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le j)) es hjes) c]
      by_cases hc : c < j
      · have hl : liftIx j c = c := by
          show (if c < j then c else c + 1) = c
          rw [if_pos hc]
        rw [hl, keyAt_lo es hjes (c + 1) (Nat.succ_lt_succ hc),
          keyAt_lo es hjes c (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hc)]
      · rw [liftIx_gt j c hc]
    | false =>
      cases hb : Nat.blt k j with
      | true =>
        show ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit c ((k, v) :: (peel j es).2)
          = ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit (liftIx j c) ((k, v) :: es)
        have hih := keyAt_peel j es hes c
        by_cases hc : c < j
        · have hl : liftIx j c = c := by
            show (if c < j then c else c + 1) = c
            rw [if_pos hc]
          rw [hl] at hih ⊢
          cases hbc : Nat.beq k c with
          | true =>
            rw [keyAt_hit hbc v (peel j es).2, keyAt_hit hbc v es]
          | false =>
            rw [keyAt_miss hbc v (peel j es).2, keyAt_miss hbc v es]
            exact hih
        · have hkc : k < c :=
            Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (bltLt hb) (Nat.le_of_not_lt hc)
          rw [liftIx_gt j c hc] at hih ⊢
          rw [keyAt_miss (beqFalse (Nat.ne_of_lt hkc)) v (peel j es).2,
            keyAt_miss (beqFalse (Nat.ne_of_lt (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hkc)))
              v es]
          exact hih
      | false =>
        have hjk : j < k :=
          Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne (Nat.le_of_not_lt (bltFalse hb))
            (fun hjk => beqNe hbe hjk.symm)
        have hka : keysAsc k ((k, v) :: es) := ⟨Nat.le_refl k, hh.2⟩
        show ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit c (shiftKeys ((k, v) :: es))
          = ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit (liftIx j c) ((k, v) :: es)
        rw [keyAt_shiftKeys ((k, v) :: es)
          (keysAsc_le (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le j) hjk)
            ((k, v) :: es) hka) c]
        by_cases hc : c < j
        · have hl : liftIx j c = c := by
            show (if c < j then c else c + 1) = c
            rw [if_pos hc]
          rw [hl, keyAt_lo ((k, v) :: es) hka (c + 1)
              (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt hc hjk),
            keyAt_lo ((k, v) :: es) hka c
              (Nat.lt_trans hc hjk)]
        · rw [liftIx_gt j c hc]

name: repFalseOfGuard
statement:
private theorem repFalseOfGuard {b t : Bool} (h : (!b && t) = true) :
    b = false
proof: := ground.boolFalseOfNot (ground.andSplitB h).1

name: offRep_scaleEntry
proof:
:=
  offRep_cofactorAt (E := pivot * e) (P := prev) h

name: offRep_fillEntry
proof:
:=
  offRep_cofactorAt (E := (r0 * t).swap) (P := prev) h

name: offRep_jointEntry
proof:
:=
  offRep_cofactorAt (E := pivot * e + (r0 * t).swap) (P := prev) h

name: keysAsc_keepTail
statement:
private theorem keysAsc_keepTail (f : BPair → BPair) (lim : Nat) :
    ∀ (es : List (Nat × BPair)) (lo : Nat), keysAsc lo es →
      keysAsc lo (keepTail f lim es)
  | [], _, _ => trivial
  | (k, e) :: es, lo, he => by
    have hh : lo ≤ k ∧ keysAsc (k + 1) es
proof:
:= he
    show keysAsc lo (match !(f e).isUnitRep && Nat.blt k lim with
        | true => (k, f e) :: keepTail f lim es
        | false => keepTail f lim es)
    cases hg : !(f e).isUnitRep && Nat.blt k lim with
    | true =>
      exact ⟨hh.1, keysAsc_keepTail f lim es (k + 1) hh.2⟩
    | false =>
      exact keysAsc_le (Nat.le_trans hh.1 (Nat.le_succ k))
        (keepTail f lim es) (keysAsc_keepTail f lim es (k + 1) hh.2)

name: entsOk_keepTail
statement:
private theorem entsOk_keepTail (f : BPair → BPair)
    (hf : ∀ x : BPair, (f x).isUnitRep = false →
      ¬ (f x).oneValue BPair.unit) (lim : Nat) :
    ∀ es : List (Nat × BPair), entsOk (keepTail f lim es)
  | [] => trivial
  | (k, e) :: es => by
    show entsOk (match !(f e).isUnitRep && Nat.blt k lim with
        | true => (k, f e) :: keepTail f lim es
        | false => keepTail f lim es)
    cases hg : !(f e).isUnitRep && Nat.blt k lim with
    | true =>
      exact ⟨hf e (repFalseOfGuard hg), entsOk_keepTail f hf lim es⟩
    | false => exact entsOk_keepTail f hf lim es

/
read of the list's own: a kept key answers at the head, a key
dropped at the read key carries the sum's unit both sides, and every
other drop falls through the walk. -/
private theorem keyAt_keepTail (f : BPair → BPair) (lim : Nat)
    (hf : f BPair.unit = BPair.unit) :
    ∀ (es : List (Nat × BPair)) (lo : Nat), keysAsc lo es →
      ∀ a, a < lim → ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a (keepTail f lim es) = f (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a es)
  | [], _, _, _, _ => hf.symm
  | (k, e) :: es, lo, he, a, ha => by
    have hh : lo ≤ k ∧ keysAsc (k + 1) es
proof:
:= he
    show ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a (match !(f e).isUnitRep && Nat.blt k lim with
        | true => (k, f e) :: keepTail f lim es
        | false => keepTail f lim es)
      = f (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a ((k, e) :: es))
    cases hbe : Nat.beq k a with
    | false =>
      rw [keyAt_miss hbe e es]
      cases hg : !(f e).isUnitRep && Nat.blt k lim with
      | true =>
        show ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a ((k, f e) :: keepTail f lim es)
          = f (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a es)
        rw [keyAt_miss hbe (f e) (keepTail f lim es)]
        exact keyAt_keepTail f lim hf es (k + 1) hh.2 a ha
      | false =>
        show ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a (keepTail f lim es) = f (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a es)
        exact keyAt_keepTail f lim hf es (k + 1) hh.2 a ha
    | true =>
      have hka : k = a := ground.beqEq k a hbe
      rw [keyAt_hit hbe e es]
      cases hg : !(f e).isUnitRep && Nat.blt k lim with
      | true =>
        show ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a ((k, f e) :: keepTail f lim es) = f e
        exact keyAt_hit hbe (f e) (keepTail f lim es)
      | false =>
        show ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a (keepTail f lim es) = f e
        have hkl : Nat.blt k lim = true := by
          rw [hka]; exact ltBlt ha
        have hfe : f e = BPair.unit :=
          BPair.unit_of_isUnitRep (repOfGuardFalse hkl hg)
        rw [hfe, keyAt_keepTail f lim hf es (k + 1) hh.2 a ha,
          keyAt_lo es hh.2 a
            (by rw [← hka]; exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.le_refl k)),
          hf]

name: keyAt_keepTail
statement:
private theorem keyAt_keepTail (f : BPair → BPair) (lim : Nat)
    (hf : f BPair.unit = BPair.unit) :
    ∀ (es : List (Nat × BPair)) (lo : Nat), keysAsc lo es →
      ∀ a, a < lim → ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a (keepTail f lim es) = f (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a es)
  | [], _, _, _, _ => hf.symm
  | (k, e) :: es, lo, he, a, ha => by
    have hh : lo ≤ k ∧ keysAsc (k + 1) es
proof:
:= he
    show ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a (match !(f e).isUnitRep && Nat.blt k lim with
        | true => (k, f e) :: keepTail f lim es
        | false => keepTail f lim es)
      = f (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a ((k, e) :: es))
    cases hbe : Nat.beq k a with
    | false =>
      rw [keyAt_miss hbe e es]
      cases hg : !(f e).isUnitRep && Nat.blt k lim with
      | true =>
        show ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a ((k, f e) :: keepTail f lim es)
          = f (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a es)
        rw [keyAt_miss hbe (f e) (keepTail f lim es)]
        exact keyAt_keepTail f lim hf es (k + 1) hh.2 a ha
      | false =>
        show ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a (keepTail f lim es) = f (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a es)
        exact keyAt_keepTail f lim hf es (k + 1) hh.2 a ha
    | true =>
      have hka : k = a := ground.beqEq k a hbe
      rw [keyAt_hit hbe e es]
      cases hg : !(f e).isUnitRep && Nat.blt k lim with
      | true =>
        show ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a ((k, f e) :: keepTail f lim es) = f e
        exact keyAt_hit hbe (f e) (keepTail f lim es)
      | false =>
        show ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a (keepTail f lim es) = f e
        have hkl : Nat.blt k lim = true := by
          rw [hka]; exact ltBlt ha
        have hfe : f e = BPair.unit :=
          BPair.unit_of_isUnitRep (repOfGuardFalse hkl hg)
        rw [hfe, keyAt_keepTail f lim hf es (k + 1) hh.2 a ha,
          keyAt_lo es hh.2 a
            (by rw [← hka]; exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.le_refl k)),
          hf]

name: keysBelow_fillBelow_lt
statement:
private theorem keysBelow_fillBelow_lt (prev r0 : BPair)
    (lim k : Nat) : ∀ ps : List (Nat × BPair),
      ground.keysBelow k (fillBelow prev r0 lim k ps).1
  | [] => trivial
  | (kt, t) :: ps => by
    show ground.keysBelow k (match Nat.blt kt k with
        | false => ([], (kt, t) :: ps)
        | true =>
          match !(fillEntry prev r0 t).isUnitRep
              && Nat.blt kt lim with
          | true => ((kt, fillEntry prev r0 t)
              :: (fillBelow prev r0 lim k ps).1,
            (fillBelow prev r0 lim k ps).2)
          | false => fillBelow prev r0 lim k ps).1
    cases hb : Nat.blt kt k with
    | false => exact trivial
    | true =>
      cases hg : !(fillEntry prev r0 t).isUnitRep
          && Nat.blt kt lim with
      | true =>
        exact ⟨bltLt hb, keysBelow_fillBelow_lt prev r0 lim k ps⟩
      | false => exact keysBelow_fillBelow_lt prev r0 lim k ps

/
walk stops exactly at the first key the strict guard refuses. -/
private theorem keysAsc_fillBelow_snd (prev r0 : BPair)
    (lim k : Nat) : ∀ (ps : List (Nat × BPair)) (lo : Nat),
      keysAsc lo ps → keysAsc k (fillBelow prev r0 lim k ps).2
  | [], _, _ => trivial
  | (kt, t) :: ps, lo, he => by
    have hh : lo ≤ kt ∧ keysAsc (kt + 1) ps
proof:
:= he
    show keysAsc k (match Nat.blt kt k with
        | false => ([], (kt, t) :: ps)
        | true =>
          match !(fillEntry prev r0 t).isUnitRep
              && Nat.blt kt lim with
          | true => ((kt, fillEntry prev r0 t)
              :: (fillBelow prev r0 lim k ps).1,
            (fillBelow prev r0 lim k ps).2)
          | false => fillBelow prev r0 lim k ps).2
    cases hb : Nat.blt kt k with
    | false =>
      exact ⟨Nat.le_of_not_lt (bltFalse hb), hh.2⟩
    | true =>
      cases hg : !(fillEntry prev r0 t).isUnitRep
          && Nat.blt kt lim with
      | true =>
        exact keysAsc_fillBelow_snd prev r0 lim k ps (kt + 1) hh.2
      | false =>
        exact keysAsc_fillBelow_snd prev r0 lim k ps (kt + 1) hh.2

name: keysAsc_fillBelow
statement:
private theorem keysAsc_fillBelow (prev r0 : BPair) (lim k : Nat) :
    ∀ (ps : List (Nat × BPair)) (lo : Nat), keysAsc lo ps → lo ≤ k →
      ∀ tl : List (Nat × BPair), keysAsc k tl →
        keysAsc lo ((fillBelow prev r0 lim k ps).1 ++ tl)
  | [], lo, _, hlo, tl, htl => keysAsc_le hlo tl htl
  | (kt, t) :: ps, lo, he, hlo, tl, htl => by
    have hh : lo ≤ kt ∧ keysAsc (kt + 1) ps
proof:
:= he
    show keysAsc lo ((match Nat.blt kt k with
        | false => ([], (kt, t) :: ps)
        | true =>
          match !(fillEntry prev r0 t).isUnitRep
              && Nat.blt kt lim with
          | true => ((kt, fillEntry prev r0 t)
              :: (fillBelow prev r0 lim k ps).1,
            (fillBelow prev r0 lim k ps).2)
          | false => fillBelow prev r0 lim k ps).1 ++ tl)
    cases hb : Nat.blt kt k with
    | false => exact keysAsc_le hlo tl htl
    | true =>
      cases hg : !(fillEntry prev r0 t).isUnitRep
          && Nat.blt kt lim with
      | true =>
        exact ⟨hh.1, keysAsc_fillBelow prev r0 lim k ps (kt + 1)
          hh.2 (bltLt hb) tl htl⟩
      | false =>

          (keysAsc_fillBelow prev r0 lim k ps (kt + 1) hh.2
            (bltLt hb) tl htl)

/
the kept keys answer at their own entries, a key dropped at the read
key carries the sum's unit both sides, and the walk covers every
stored key below the split. -/
private theorem keyAt_fillBelow (prev r0 : BPair) (lim k : Nat) :
    ∀ (ps : List (Nat × BPair)) (lo : Nat), keysAsc lo ps →
      ∀ a, a < k → a < lim →
        ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a (fillBelow prev r0 lim k ps).1
          = fillEntry prev r0 (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a ps)
  | [], _, _, _, _, _ => (fillEntry_unit prev r0).symm
  | (kt, t) :: ps, lo, he, a, hak, hal => by
    have hh : lo ≤ kt ∧ keysAsc (kt + 1) ps
proof:
:= he
    show ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a (match Nat.blt kt k with
        | false => ([], (kt, t) :: ps)
        | true =>
          match !(fillEntry prev r0 t).isUnitRep
              && Nat.blt kt lim with
          | true => ((kt, fillEntry prev r0 t)
              :: (fillBelow prev r0 lim k ps).1,
            (fillBelow prev r0 lim k ps).2)
          | false => fillBelow prev r0 lim k ps).1
      = fillEntry prev r0 (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a ((kt, t) :: ps))
    cases hb : Nat.blt kt k with
    | false =>
      have hakt : a < kt :=
        Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hak (Nat.le_of_not_lt (bltFalse hb))
      show BPair.unit = fillEntry prev r0 (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a ((kt, t) :: ps))
      rw [keyAt_miss (ground.beqFalse (Nat.ne_of_gt hakt)) t ps,
        keyAt_lo ps hh.2 a (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hakt), fillEntry_unit]
    | true =>
      cases hbe : Nat.beq kt a with
      | true =>
        have hka : kt = a := ground.beqEq kt a hbe
        rw [keyAt_hit hbe t ps]
        cases hg : !(fillEntry prev r0 t).isUnitRep
            && Nat.blt kt lim with
        | true =>
          show ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a ((kt, fillEntry prev r0 t)
              :: (fillBelow prev r0 lim k ps).1)
            = fillEntry prev r0 t
          exact keyAt_hit hbe (fillEntry prev r0 t)
            (fillBelow prev r0 lim k ps).1
        | false =>
          show ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a (fillBelow prev r0 lim k ps).1
            = fillEntry prev r0 t
          have hkl : Nat.blt kt lim = true := by
            rw [hka]; exact ltBlt hal
          have hfe : fillEntry prev r0 t = BPair.unit :=
            BPair.unit_of_isUnitRep (repOfGuardFalse hkl hg)
          rw [hfe,
            keyAt_fillBelow prev r0 lim k ps (kt + 1) hh.2 a hak hal,
            keyAt_lo ps hh.2 a
              (by rw [← hka]; exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.le_refl kt)),
            fillEntry_unit]
      | false =>
        rw [keyAt_miss hbe t ps]
        cases hg : !(fillEntry prev r0 t).isUnitRep
            && Nat.blt kt lim with
        | true =>
          show ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a ((kt, fillEntry prev r0 t)
              :: (fillBelow prev r0 lim k ps).1)
            = fillEntry prev r0 (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a ps)
          rw [keyAt_miss hbe (fillEntry prev r0 t)
            (fillBelow prev r0 lim k ps).1]
          exact keyAt_fillBelow prev r0 lim k ps (kt + 1) hh.2 a hak hal
        | false =>
          show ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a (fillBelow prev r0 lim k ps).1
            = fillEntry prev r0 (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a ps)
          exact keyAt_fillBelow prev r0 lim k ps (kt + 1) hh.2 a hak hal

private theorem keyAt_fillBelow_snd (prev r0 : BPair) (lim k : Nat) :
    ∀ (ps : List (Nat × BPair)) (a : Nat), ¬ a < k →
      ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a (fillBelow prev r0 lim k ps).2 = ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a ps
  | [], _, _ => rfl
  | (kt, t) :: ps, a, ha => by
    show ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a (match Nat.blt kt k with
        | false => ([], (kt, t) :: ps)
        | true =>
          match !(fillEntry prev r0 t).isUnitRep
              && Nat.blt kt lim with
          | true => ((kt, fillEntry prev r0 t)
              :: (fillBelow prev r0 lim k ps).1,
            (fillBelow prev r0 lim k ps).2)
          | false => fillBelow prev r0 lim k ps).2
      = ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a ((kt, t) :: ps)
    cases hb : Nat.blt kt k with
    | false => rfl
    | true =>
      have hkta : kt < a
proof:
:=
        Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (bltLt hb) (Nat.le_of_not_lt ha)
      rw [keyAt_miss (beqFalse (Nat.ne_of_lt hkta)) t ps]
      cases hg : !(fillEntry prev r0 t).isUnitRep
          && Nat.blt kt lim with
      | true =>

        exact keyAt_fillBelow_snd prev r0 lim k ps a ha

  | [], _, _, hb => hb
  | (_, v) :: a, b, ha, hb => by
    have hh : (¬ v.oneValue BPair.unit) ∧ entsOk a
proof:
:= ha
    exact ⟨hh.1, entsOk_append a b hh.2 hb⟩

name: keysAsc_mergeRow
statement:
private theorem keysAsc_mergeRow (prev pivot r0 : BPair) (lim : Nat) :
    ∀ (es ps : List (Nat × BPair)) (lo : Nat), keysAsc lo ps →
      keysAsc lo es → keysAsc lo (mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim ps es)
  | [], ps, lo, hps, _ =>
    keysAsc_keepTail (fillEntry prev r0) lim ps lo hps
  | (ke, e) :: es, ps, lo, hps, hes => by
    have hh : lo ≤ ke ∧ keysAsc (ke + 1) es
proof:
:= hes
    have hsnd : keysAsc ke (fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps).2 :=
      keysAsc_fillBelow_snd prev r0 lim ke ps lo hps
    show keysAsc lo (match (fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps).2 with
        | [] => (fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps).1
            ++ scaleTail prev pivot lim ((ke, e) :: es)
        | (kt, t) :: pr =>
          match Nat.beq kt ke with
          | true =>
            match !(jointEntry prev pivot t r0 e).isUnitRep
                && Nat.blt ke lim with
            | true => (fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps).1
                ++ (ke, jointEntry prev pivot t r0 e)
                  :: mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim pr es
            | false => (fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps).1
                ++ mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim pr es
          | false =>
            match !(scaleEntry prev pivot e).isUnitRep
                && Nat.blt ke lim with
            | true => (fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps).1
                ++ (ke, scaleEntry prev pivot e)
                  :: mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim ((kt, t) :: pr) es
            | false => (fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps).1
                ++ mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim ((kt, t) :: pr) es)
    cases hb : (fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps).2 with
    | nil =>
      refine keysAsc_fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps lo hps hh.1 _ ?_
      exact keysAsc_keepTail (scaleEntry prev pivot) lim
        ((ke, e) :: es) ke ⟨Nat.le_refl ke, hh.2⟩
    | cons hd pr =>
      cases hd with
      | mk kt t =>
        rw [hb] at hsnd
        have hhd : ke ≤ kt ∧ keysAsc (kt + 1) pr := hsnd
        show keysAsc lo (match Nat.beq kt ke with
            | true =>
              match !(jointEntry prev pivot t r0 e).isUnitRep
                  && Nat.blt ke lim with
              | true => (fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps).1
                  ++ (ke, jointEntry prev pivot t r0 e)
                    :: mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim pr es
              | false => (fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps).1
                  ++ mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim pr es
            | false =>
              match !(scaleEntry prev pivot e).isUnitRep
                  && Nat.blt ke lim with
              | true => (fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps).1
                  ++ (ke, scaleEntry prev pivot e)
                    :: mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim ((kt, t) :: pr) es
              | false => (fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps).1
                  ++ mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim ((kt, t) :: pr) es)
        cases hbe : Nat.beq kt ke with
        | true =>
          have hkt : kt = ke := ground.beqEq kt ke hbe
          have hpr : keysAsc (ke + 1) pr := by
            rw [← hkt]; exact hhd.2
          have hrec : keysAsc (ke + 1)
              (mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim pr es) :=
            keysAsc_mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim es pr (ke + 1) hpr hh.2
          cases hg : !(jointEntry prev pivot t r0 e).isUnitRep
              && Nat.blt ke lim with
          | true =>
            refine keysAsc_fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps lo hps hh.1
              _ ?_
            exact ⟨Nat.le_refl ke, hrec⟩
          | false =>
            refine keysAsc_fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps lo hps hh.1
              _ ?_
            exact keysAsc_le (Nat.le_succ ke) _ hrec
        | false =>
          have hkt : ke < kt :=
            Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne hhd.1 (fun he => beqNe hbe he.symm)
          have hrec : keysAsc (ke + 1)
              (mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim ((kt, t) :: pr) es) :=
            keysAsc_mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim es ((kt, t) :: pr)
              (ke + 1) ⟨hkt, hhd.2⟩ hh.2
          cases hg : !(scaleEntry prev pivot e).isUnitRep
              && Nat.blt ke lim with
          | true =>
            refine keysAsc_fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps lo hps hh.1
              _ ?_
            exact ⟨Nat.le_refl ke, hrec⟩
          | false =>
            refine keysAsc_fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps lo hps hh.1
              _ ?_
            exact keysAsc_le (Nat.le_succ ke) _ hrec

statement:
private theorem entsOk_mergeRow (prev pivot r0 : BPair) (lim : Nat) :

                  ++ (ke, scaleEntry prev pivot e)
                    :: mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim ((kt, t) :: pr) es
              | false => (fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps).1
                  ++ mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim ((kt, t) :: pr) es)
        cases hbe : Nat.beq kt ke with
        | true =>
          cases hg : !(jointEntry prev pivot t r0 e).isUnitRep
              && Nat.blt ke lim with
          | true =>
            exact entsOk_append _ _
              (entsOk_fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps)
              ⟨offRep_jointEntry (repFalseOfGuard hg),
                entsOk_mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim es pr⟩
          | false =>
            exact entsOk_append _ _
              (entsOk_fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps)
              (entsOk_mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim es pr)
        | false =>
          cases hg : !(scaleEntry prev pivot e).isUnitRep
              && Nat.blt ke lim with
          | true =>
            exact entsOk_append _ _
              (entsOk_fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps)
              ⟨offRep_scaleEntry (repFalseOfGuard hg),
                entsOk_mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim es ((kt, t) :: pr)⟩
          | false =>
            exact entsOk_append _ _
              (entsOk_fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps)
              (entsOk_mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim es ((kt, t) :: pr))

/
the appended block begins at the split key, so the read falls inside
the split's own fill-in. -/
private theorem keyAt_merge_low (prev r0 : BPair) (lim ke : Nat)
    (ps : List (Nat × BPair)) (lo : Nat) (hps : keysAsc lo ps)
    (Z : List (Nat × BPair)) (hZ : keysAsc ke Z) (a : Nat)
    (hak : a < ke) (hal : a < lim) :
    ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a ((fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps).1 ++ Z)
      = fillEntry prev r0 (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a ps)
proof:
:= by
  rw [keyAt_append_unit a Z (keyAt_lo Z hZ a hak)
      (fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps).1,
    keyAt_fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps lo hps a hak hal]

name: keyAt_merge_low
statement:
private theorem keyAt_merge_low (prev r0 : BPair) (lim ke : Nat)
    (ps : List (Nat × BPair)) (lo : Nat) (hps : keysAsc lo ps)
    (Z : List (Nat × BPair)) (hZ : keysAsc ke Z) (a : Nat)
    (hak : a < ke) (hal : a < lim) :
    ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a ((fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps).1 ++ Z)
      = fillEntry prev r0 (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a ps)
proof:
:= by
  rw [keyAt_append_unit a Z (keyAt_lo Z hZ a hak)
      (fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps).1,
    keyAt_fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps lo hps a hak hal]

name: keyAt_merge_high
proof:
:=
  keyAt_append_below ke (fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps).1
    (keysBelow_fillBelow_lt prev r0 lim ke ps) Z a hak

name: keyAt_mergeRow
statement:
private theorem keyAt_mergeRow (prev pivot r0 : BPair) (lim : Nat) :
    ∀ (es ps : List (Nat × BPair)) (lo : Nat), keysAsc lo ps →
      keysAsc lo es → ∀ a, a < lim →
        ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a (mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim ps es)
          = cofactorAt (pivot * ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a es
              + (r0 * ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a ps).swap) prev
  | [], ps, lo, hps, _, a, ha => by
    show ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a (keepTail (fillEntry prev r0) lim ps)
      = cofactorAt (pivot * BPair.unit
          + (r0 * ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a ps).swap) prev
    rw [keyAt_keepTail (fillEntry prev r0) lim
        (fillEntry_unit prev r0) ps lo hps a ha,
      stepRead_noScale prev pivot r0 (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a ps)]
  | (ke, e) :: es, ps, lo, hps, hes, a, ha => by
    have hh : lo ≤ ke ∧ keysAsc (ke + 1) es
proof:
:= hes
    have hsnd : keysAsc ke (fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps).2 :=
      keysAsc_fillBelow_snd prev r0 lim ke ps lo hps
    by_cases hak : a < ke
    · have hesa : ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a ((ke, e) :: es) = BPair.unit := by
        rw [keyAt_miss (ground.beqFalse (Nat.ne_of_gt hak)) e es]
        exact keyAt_lo es hh.2 a (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hak)
      rw [hesa, stepRead_noScale prev pivot r0 (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a ps)]
      show ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a (match (fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps).2 with
          | [] => (fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps).1
              ++ scaleTail prev pivot lim ((ke, e) :: es)
          | (kt, t) :: pr =>
            match Nat.beq kt ke with
            | true =>
              match !(jointEntry prev pivot t r0 e).isUnitRep
                  && Nat.blt ke lim with
              | true => (fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps).1
                  ++ (ke, jointEntry prev pivot t r0 e)
                    :: mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim pr es
              | false => (fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps).1
                  ++ mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim pr es
            | false =>
              match !(scaleEntry prev pivot e).isUnitRep
                  && Nat.blt ke lim with
              | true => (fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps).1
                  ++ (ke, scaleEntry prev pivot e)
                    :: mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim ((kt, t) :: pr) es
              | false => (fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps).1
                  ++ mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim ((kt, t) :: pr) es)
        = fillEntry prev r0 (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a ps)
      cases hb : (fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps).2 with
      | nil =>
        exact keyAt_merge_low prev r0 lim ke ps lo hps _
          (keysAsc_keepTail (scaleEntry prev pivot) lim
            ((ke, e) :: es) ke ⟨Nat.le_refl ke, hh.2⟩) a hak ha
      | cons hd pr =>
        cases hd with
        | mk kt t =>
          rw [hb] at hsnd
          have hhd : ke ≤ kt ∧ keysAsc (kt + 1) pr := hsnd
          show ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a (match Nat.beq kt ke with
              | true =>
                match !(jointEntry prev pivot t r0 e).isUnitRep
                    && Nat.blt ke lim with
                | true => (fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps).1
                    ++ (ke, jointEntry prev pivot t r0 e)
                      :: mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim pr es
                | false => (fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps).1
                    ++ mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim pr es
              | false =>
                match !(scaleEntry prev pivot e).isUnitRep
                    && Nat.blt ke lim with
                | true => (fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps).1
                    ++ (ke, scaleEntry prev pivot e)
                      :: mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim ((kt, t) :: pr) es
                | false => (fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps).1
                    ++ mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim ((kt, t) :: pr) es)
            = fillEntry prev r0 (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a ps)
          cases hbe : Nat.beq kt ke with
          | true =>
            have hkt : kt = ke := ground.beqEq kt ke hbe
            have hpr : keysAsc (ke + 1) pr := by
              rw [← hkt]; exact hhd.2
            have hrec : keysAsc (ke + 1)
                (mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim pr es) :=
              keysAsc_mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim es pr (ke + 1)
                hpr hh.2
            cases hg : !(jointEntry prev pivot t r0 e).isUnitRep
                && Nat.blt ke lim with
            | true =>
              exact keyAt_merge_low prev r0 lim ke ps lo hps
                ((ke, jointEntry prev pivot t r0 e)
                  :: mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim pr es)
                ⟨Nat.le_refl ke, hrec⟩ a hak ha
            | false =>
              exact keyAt_merge_low prev r0 lim ke ps lo hps _
                (keysAsc_le (Nat.le_succ ke) _ hrec) a hak ha
          | false =>
            have hkt : ke < kt :=
              Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne hhd.1 (fun he => beqNe hbe he.symm)
            have hrec : keysAsc (ke + 1)
                (mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim ((kt, t) :: pr) es) :=
              keysAsc_mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim es ((kt, t) :: pr)
                (ke + 1) ⟨hkt, hhd.2⟩ hh.2
            cases hg : !(scaleEntry prev pivot e).isUnitRep
                && Nat.blt ke lim with
            | true =>
              exact keyAt_merge_low prev r0 lim ke ps lo hps
                ((ke, scaleEntry prev pivot e)
                  :: mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim ((kt, t) :: pr) es)
                ⟨Nat.le_refl ke, hrec⟩ a hak ha
            | false =>
              exact keyAt_merge_low prev r0 lim ke ps lo hps _
                (keysAsc_le (Nat.le_succ ke) _ hrec) a hak ha
    · rw [(keyAt_fillBelow_snd prev r0 lim ke ps a hak).symm]
      show ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a (match (fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps).2 with
          | [] => (fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps).1
              ++ scaleTail prev pivot lim ((ke, e) :: es)
          | (kt, t) :: pr =>
            match Nat.beq kt ke with
            | true =>
              match !(jointEntry prev pivot t r0 e).isUnitRep
                  && Nat.blt ke lim with
              | true => (fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps).1
                  ++ (ke, jointEntry prev pivot t r0 e)
                    :: mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim pr es
              | false => (fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps).1
                  ++ mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim pr es
            | false =>
              match !(scaleEntry prev pivot e).isUnitRep
                  && Nat.blt ke lim with
              | true => (fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps).1
                  ++ (ke, scaleEntry prev pivot e)
                    :: mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim ((kt, t) :: pr) es
              | false => (fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps).1
                  ++ mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim ((kt, t) :: pr) es)
        = cofactorAt (pivot * ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a ((ke, e) :: es)
            + (r0 * ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a (fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps).2).swap)
          prev
      cases hb : (fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps).2 with
      | nil =>
        rw [keyAt_merge_high prev r0 lim ke ps _ a hak,
          show ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a ([] : List (Nat × BPair)) = BPair.unit from rfl,
          stepRead_noFill prev pivot r0 (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a ((ke, e) :: es))]
        exact keyAt_keepTail (scaleEntry prev pivot) lim
          (scaleEntry_unit prev pivot) ((ke, e) :: es) lo hes a ha
      | cons hd pr =>
        cases hd with
        | mk kt t =>
          rw [hb] at hsnd
          have hhd : ke ≤ kt ∧ keysAsc (kt + 1) pr := hsnd
          show ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a (match Nat.beq kt ke with
              | true =>
                match !(jointEntry prev pivot t r0 e).isUnitRep
                    && Nat.blt ke lim with
                | true => (fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps).1
                    ++ (ke, jointEntry prev pivot t r0 e)
                      :: mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim pr es
                | false => (fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps).1
                    ++ mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim pr es
              | false =>
                match !(scaleEntry prev pivot e).isUnitRep
                    && Nat.blt ke lim with
                | true => (fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps).1
                    ++ (ke, scaleEntry prev pivot e)
                      :: mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim ((kt, t) :: pr) es
                | false => (fillBelow prev r0 lim ke ps).1
                    ++ mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim ((kt, t) :: pr) es)
            = cofactorAt (pivot * ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a ((ke, e) :: es)
                + (r0 * ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a ((kt, t) :: pr)).swap) prev
          cases hbe : Nat.beq kt ke with
          | true =>
            have hkt : kt = ke := ground.beqEq kt ke hbe
            have hpr : keysAsc (ke + 1) pr := by
              rw [← hkt]; exact hhd.2
            cases hbke : Nat.beq ke a with
            | true =>
              have hka : ke = a := ground.beqEq ke a hbke
              have hbta : Nat.beq kt a = true := by
                rw [hkt]; exact hbke
              rw [keyAt_hit hbke e es, keyAt_hit hbta t pr]
              cases hg : !(jointEntry prev pivot t r0 e).isUnitRep
                  && Nat.blt ke lim with
              | true =>
                rw [keyAt_merge_high prev r0 lim ke ps _ a hak]
                exact keyAt_hit hbke (jointEntry prev pivot t r0 e)
                  (mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim pr es)
              | false =>
                rw [keyAt_merge_high prev r0 lim ke ps _ a hak]
                have hkl : Nat.blt ke lim = true := by
                  rw [hka]; exact ltBlt ha
                have hje : jointEntry prev pivot t r0 e = BPair.unit :=
                  BPair.unit_of_isUnitRep (repOfGuardFalse hkl hg)
                rw [keyAt_mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim es pr (ke + 1)
                    hpr hh.2 a ha,
                  keyAt_lo es hh.2 a
                    (Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.le_of_eq hka.symm)),
                  keyAt_lo pr hpr a
                    (Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.le_of_eq hka.symm)),
                  stepRead_null prev pivot r0]
                exact hje.symm
            | false =>
              rw [keyAt_miss hbke e es,
                keyAt_miss
                  (beqFalse (fun he => beqNe hbke (hkt.symm.trans he)))
                  t pr]
              cases hg : !(jointEntry prev pivot t r0 e).isUnitRep
                  && Nat.blt ke lim with
              | true =>
                rw [keyAt_merge_high prev r0 lim ke ps _ a hak,
                  keyAt_miss hbke (jointEntry prev pivot t r0 e)
                    (mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim pr es)]
                exact keyAt_mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim es pr (ke + 1)
                  hpr hh.2 a ha
              | false =>
                rw [keyAt_merge_high prev r0 lim ke ps _ a hak]
                exact keyAt_mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim es pr (ke + 1)
                  hpr hh.2 a ha
          | false =>
            have hkt : ke < kt :=
              Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne hhd.1 (fun he => beqNe hbe he.symm)
            have hprA : keysAsc (ke + 1) ((kt, t) :: pr) :=
              ⟨hkt, hhd.2⟩
            cases hbke : Nat.beq ke a with
            | true =>
              have hka : ke = a := ground.beqEq ke a hbke
              have hpra : ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a ((kt, t) :: pr) = BPair.unit :=
                keyAt_lo ((kt, t) :: pr) hprA a
                  (Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.le_of_eq hka.symm))
              rw [keyAt_hit hbke e es, hpra,
                stepRead_noFill prev pivot r0 e]
              cases hg : !(scaleEntry prev pivot e).isUnitRep
                  && Nat.blt ke lim with
              | true =>
                rw [keyAt_merge_high prev r0 lim ke ps _ a hak]
                exact keyAt_hit hbke (scaleEntry prev pivot e)
                  (mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim ((kt, t) :: pr) es)
              | false =>
                rw [keyAt_merge_high prev r0 lim ke ps _ a hak]
                have hkl : Nat.blt ke lim = true := by
                  rw [hka]; exact ltBlt ha
                have hse : scaleEntry prev pivot e = BPair.unit :=
                  BPair.unit_of_isUnitRep (repOfGuardFalse hkl hg)
                rw [keyAt_mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim es
                    ((kt, t) :: pr) (ke + 1) hprA hh.2 a ha,
                  keyAt_lo es hh.2 a
                    (Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.le_of_eq hka.symm)),
                  hpra, stepRead_null prev pivot r0]
                exact hse.symm
            | false =>
              rw [keyAt_miss hbke e es]
              cases hg : !(scaleEntry prev pivot e).isUnitRep
                  && Nat.blt ke lim with
              | true =>
                rw [keyAt_merge_high prev r0 lim ke ps _ a hak,
                  keyAt_miss hbke (scaleEntry prev pivot e)
                    (mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim ((kt, t) :: pr) es)]
                exact keyAt_mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim es
                  ((kt, t) :: pr) (ke + 1) hprA hh.2 a ha
              | false =>
                rw [keyAt_merge_high prev r0 lim ke ps _ a hak]
                exact keyAt_mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim es
                  ((kt, t) :: pr) (ke + 1) hprA hh.2 a ha

name: keysAsc_stepSRow
statement:
private theorem keysAsc_stepSRow (prev pivot r0 : BPair)
    (lim : Nat) (ps es : List (Nat × BPair)) (hps : keysAsc 0 ps)
    (hes : keysAsc 0 es) :
    keysAsc 0 (stepSRow prev pivot r0 lim ps es)
proof:
:= by
  show keysAsc 0 (match r0.isUnitRep with
      | true => scaleTail prev pivot lim es
      | false => mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim ps es)
  cases r0.isUnitRep with
  | true =>
    exact keysAsc_keepTail (scaleEntry prev pivot) lim es 0 hes
  | false =>
    exact keysAsc_mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim es ps 0 hps hes

name: entsOk_stepSRow
proof:
:= by
  show entsOk (match r0.isUnitRep with
      | true => scaleTail prev pivot lim es
      | false => mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim ps es)
  cases r0.isUnitRep with
  | true =>
    exact entsOk_keepTail (scaleEntry prev pivot)
      (fun _ h => offRep_scaleEntry h) lim es
  | false => exact entsOk_mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim es ps

name: keyAt_stepSRow
statement:
private theorem keyAt_stepSRow (prev pivot r0 : BPair) (lim : Nat)
    (ps es : List (Nat × BPair)) (hps : keysAsc 0 ps)
    (hes : keysAsc 0 es) : ∀ a, a < lim →
      ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a (stepSRow prev pivot r0 lim ps es)
        = cofactorAt (pivot * ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a es
            + (r0 * ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a ps).swap) prev
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha
  show ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a (match r0.isUnitRep with
      | true => scaleTail prev pivot lim es
      | false => mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim ps es)
    = cofactorAt (pivot * ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a es + (r0 * ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a ps).swap) prev
  cases hr : r0.isUnitRep with
  | true =>
    show ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a (keepTail (scaleEntry prev pivot) lim es)
      = cofactorAt (pivot * ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a es
          + (r0 * ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a ps).swap) prev
    rw [BPair.unit_of_isUnitRep hr,
      stepRead_unitCol prev pivot (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a es) (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit a ps)]
    exact keyAt_keepTail (scaleEntry prev pivot) lim
      (scaleEntry_unit prev pivot) es 0 hes a ha
  | false =>
    exact keyAt_mergeRow prev pivot r0 lim es ps 0 hps hes a ha

name: keysAsc_ofRowFrom
statement:
private theorem keysAsc_ofRowFrom : ∀ (r : List BPair) (k : Nat),
    keysAsc k (ofRowFrom k r)
  | [], _ => trivial
  | e :: es, k => by
    show keysAsc k (match (e.norm).isUnitRep with
        | true => ofRowFrom (k + 1) es
        | false => (k, e.norm) :: ofRowFrom (k + 1) es)
    cases (e.norm).isUnitRep with
    | true =>
      exact keysAsc_le (Nat.le_succ k) (ofRowFrom (k + 1) es)
        (keysAsc_ofRowFrom es (k + 1))
    | false => exact ⟨Nat.le_refl k, keysAsc_ofRowFrom es (k + 1)⟩

/
every kept value is a canonical representative past the guard. -/
private theorem entsOk_ofRowFrom : ∀ (r : List BPair) (k : Nat),
    entsOk (ofRowFrom k r)
  | [], _ => trivial
  | e :: es, k => by
    show entsOk (match (e.norm).isUnitRep with
        | true => ofRowFrom (k + 1) es
        | false => (k, e.norm) :: ofRowFrom (k + 1) es)
    cases hu : (e.norm).isUnitRep with
    | true => exact entsOk_ofRowFrom es (k + 1)
    | false => exact ⟨offRep_norm hu, entsOk_ofRowFrom es (k + 1)⟩

private theorem length_denseRow (w : Nat) (r : SRow) :

proof:
