name: getAt_denseRow
proof:
:= by
  show ground.getAt BPair.unit
      ((List.range w).map (fun x => ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit x r.2)) c = ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit c r.2
  rw [ground.getAt_map 0 BPair.unit (fun x => ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit x r.2)
      (List.range w) c (by rw [ground.length_range]; exact hc),
    ground.getAt_range w c hc]

name: denseRow_sPeel
proof:
:= by
  cases w with
  | zero => exact absurd hj (Nat.not_lt_zero j)
  | succ w' =>
    have hjlen : j < (denseRow (w' + 1) r).length := by
      rw [length_denseRow]; exact hj
    show denseRow w' ((sPeel j r).2) = strike j (denseRow (w' + 1) r)
    refine ground.getAt_ext BPair.unit _ _ ?_ ?_
    · rw [length_denseRow]
      exact (Nat.succ.inj
        ((ground.length_eraseIdx (denseRow (w' + 1) r) j hjlen).trans
          (length_denseRow (w' + 1) r))).symm
    · intro i hi
      rw [length_denseRow] at hi
      rw [getAt_denseRow w' ((sPeel j r).2) i hi]
      show ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit i (peel j r.2).2
        = ground.getAt BPair.unit
          ((denseRow (w' + 1) r).eraseIdx j) i
      rw [keyAt_peel j r.2 hr i,
        getAt_eraseIdx BPair.unit (denseRow (w' + 1) r) j i]
      by_cases hij : i < j
      · rw [if_pos hij,
          getAt_denseRow (w' + 1) r i (Nat.lt_trans hij hj),
          show liftIx j i = i from by
            show (if i < j then i else i + 1) = i
            rw [if_pos hij]]
      · rw [if_neg hij,
          getAt_denseRow (w' + 1) r (i + 1) (Nat.succ_lt_succ hi),
          liftIx_gt j i hij]

name: keyAt_ofRowFrom
statement:
private theorem keyAt_ofRowFrom : ∀ (r : List BPair) (k c : Nat),
    (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit (k + c) (ofRowFrom k r)).oneValue
      (ground.getAt BPair.unit r c)
  | [], _, _ => BPair.oneValue_refl BPair.unit
  | e :: es, k, 0 => by
    show (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit k (match (e.norm).isUnitRep with
        | true => ofRowFrom (k + 1) es
        | false => (k, e.norm) :: ofRowFrom (k + 1) es)).oneValue e
    cases hu : (e.norm).isUnitRep with
    | true =>
      show (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit k (ofRowFrom (k + 1) es)).oneValue e
      rw [keyAt_lo (ofRowFrom (k + 1) es)
          (keysAsc_ofRowFrom es (k + 1)) k
          (Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.le_refl k)),
        ← BPair.unit_of_isUnitRep hu]
      exact BPair.norm_oneValue e
    | false =>
      show (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit k ((k, e.norm) :: ofRowFrom (k + 1) es)).oneValue e
      rw [keyAt_hit (ground.beqRefl k) (e.norm)
        (ofRowFrom (k + 1) es)]
      exact BPair.norm_oneValue e
  | e :: es, k, c + 1 => by
    have hih
proof:
:= keyAt_ofRowFrom es (k + 1) c
    rw [Nat.succ_add k c] at hih
    show (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit (k + c + 1) (match (e.norm).isUnitRep with
        | true => ofRowFrom (k + 1) es
        | false => (k, e.norm) :: ofRowFrom (k + 1) es)).oneValue
      (ground.getAt BPair.unit es c)
    cases hu : (e.norm).isUnitRep with
    | true =>
      show (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit (k + c + 1) (ofRowFrom (k + 1) es)).oneValue
        (ground.getAt BPair.unit es c)
      exact hih
    | false =>
      show (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit (k + c + 1)
          ((k, e.norm) :: ofRowFrom (k + 1) es)).oneValue
        (ground.getAt BPair.unit es c)
      rw [keyAt_miss (beqFalse (Nat.ne_of_lt
          (Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.le_add_right k c)))) (e.norm)
        (ofRowFrom (k + 1) es)]
      exact hih

name: denseRow_ofRow
statement:
private theorem denseRow_ofRow : ∀ r : List BPair,
    poly.oneValue (denseRow r.length (ofRow r)) r
proof:
:= by
  intro r
  have hmem : ∀ c : Nat,
      (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit c (ofRowFrom 0 r)).oneValue
        (ground.getAt BPair.unit r c) := by
    intro c
    have h := keyAt_ofRowFrom r 0 c
    rw [Nat.zero_add] at h
    exact h
  have h := poly.oneValue_map (fun c => ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit c (ofRowFrom 0 r)) (ground.getAt BPair.unit r) (List.range r.length) (fun x _ => hmem x)
  rw [ground.range_map_getAt BPair.unit r.length r rfl] at h
  exact h

name: appendPair
statement:
private theorem appendPair {α : Type} (a b : α)
    (xs : List α) : (xs ++ [a]) ++ [b] = xs ++ [a, b]
proof:
:=
  ground.append_assoc xs [a] [b]

name: sel_len
statement:
private theorem sel_len (m : Mat) (rs cs : List Nat) :
    (sel m rs cs).length = rs.length
proof:
:= by
  show (rs.map (fun i => keepCols cs (ground.getAt [] m i))).length
    = rs.length
  rw [ground.length_map]

name: getAt_sel
statement:
private theorem getAt_sel (m : Mat) (rs cs : List Nat) (a : Nat)
    (ha : a < rs.length) :
    ground.getAt [] (sel m rs cs) a
      = keepCols cs (ground.getAt [] m (ground.getAt 0 rs a))
proof:
:= by
  show ground.getAt []
      (rs.map (fun i => keepCols cs (ground.getAt [] m i))) a = _
  rw [ground.getAt_map 0 [] _ rs a ha]

name: getAt_append_lt
proof:
:=
  (ground.getAt_append d xs ys a).trans (if_pos ha)

name: getAt_append_at
statement:
private theorem getAt_append_at {α : Type} (d : α) (xs ys : List α) :
    ground.getAt d (xs ++ ys) xs.length = ground.getAt d ys 0
proof:
:=
  (congrArg (ground.getAt d (xs ++ ys))
    (Nat.add_zero xs.length)).symm.trans
    (ground.getAt_append_add d xs ys 0)

name: keepCols_lead
statement:
private theorem keepCols_lead (cs ys : List Nat) (r : List BPair)
    (K : Nat) (hcs : cs.length = K) :
    keepCols (List.range K) (keepCols (cs ++ ys) r)
      = keepCols cs r
proof:
:= by
  refine ground.getAt_ext BPair.unit _ _ ?_ ?_
  · rw [keepCols_len, keepCols_len, ground.length_range, hcs]
  · intro b hb
    rw [keepCols_len, ground.length_range] at hb
    have hbr : b < (List.range K).length := by
      rw [ground.length_range]
      exact hb
    have hbc : b < (cs ++ ys).length := by
      rw [ground.length_append, hcs]
      exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hb (Nat.le_add_right K ys.length)
    have hbs : b < cs.length := by
      rw [hcs]
      exact hb
    rw [keepCols_entry (List.range K) _ b hbr,
      ground.getAt_range K b hb,
      keepCols_entry (cs ++ ys) r b hbc,
      getAt_append_lt 0 cs ys hbs,
      keepCols_entry cs r b hbs]

name: keepCols_border
statement:
private theorem keepCols_border (cs ys : List Nat) (r : List BPair)
    (K j : Nat) (hcs : cs.length = K)
    (hj : j < cs.length + ys.length) :
    keepCols (List.range K ++ [j]) (keepCols (cs ++ ys) r)
      = keepCols (cs ++ [ground.getAt 0 (cs ++ ys) j]) r
proof:
:= by
  have hjc : j < (cs ++ ys).length := by
    rw [ground.length_append]
    exact hj
  refine ground.getAt_ext BPair.unit _ _ ?_ ?_
  · rw [keepCols_len, keepCols_len, borderKeys_len,
      ground.length_append, hcs]
    rfl
  · intro b hb
    rw [keepCols_len, borderKeys_len] at hb
    have hbk : b < (List.range K ++ [j]).length := by
      rw [borderKeys_len]
      exact hb
    have hbn : b < (cs ++ [ground.getAt 0 (cs ++ ys) j]).length := by
      rw [ground.length_append, hcs]
      exact hb
    rw [keepCols_entry (List.range K ++ [j]) _ b hbk,
      borderKeys K j b hb,
      keepCols_entry (cs ++ [ground.getAt 0 (cs ++ ys) j]) r b hbn]
    by_cases hbK : b < K
    · have hbs : b < cs.length := by
        rw [hcs]
        exact hbK
      have hbj : b < (cs ++ ys).length := by
        rw [ground.length_append, hcs]
        exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hbK
          (Nat.le_add_right K ys.length)
      rw [if_pos hbK, keepCols_entry (cs ++ ys) r b hbj,
        getAt_append_lt 0 cs ys hbs,
        getAt_append_lt 0 cs
          [ground.getAt 0 (cs ++ ys) j] hbs]
    · have hbe : b = cs.length := by
        rw [hcs]
        exact Nat.le_antisymm (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hb)
          (Nat.le_of_not_lt hbK)
      rw [if_neg hbK, keepCols_entry (cs ++ ys) r j hjc, hbe,
        getAt_append_at 0 cs
          [ground.getAt 0 (cs ++ ys) j]]
      rfl

name: leadAt_sel
proof:
:= by
  refine ground.getAt_ext ([] : List BPair) _ _ ?_ ?_
  · rw [leadAt_len, sel_len]
  · intro a ha
    rw [leadAt_len] at ha
    have hax : a < (rs ++ xs).length := by
      rw [ground.length_append]
      exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le ha (Nat.le_add_right rs.length xs.length)
    show ground.getAt []
        ((List.range rs.length).map (fun b =>
          keepCols (List.range rs.length)
            (ground.getAt [] (sel m (rs ++ xs) (cs ++ ys)) b))) a
      = ground.getAt [] (sel m rs cs) a
    rw [ground.getAt_map 0 [] _ (List.range rs.length) a
        (by rw [ground.length_range]; exact ha),
      ground.getAt_range rs.length a ha,
      getAt_sel m (rs ++ xs) (cs ++ ys) a hax,
      getAt_append_lt 0 rs xs ha,
      keepCols_lead cs ys _ rs.length hcs,
      getAt_sel m rs cs a ha]

name: borderAt_sel
statement:
private theorem borderAt_sel (m : Mat) (rs cs xs ys : List Nat)
    (i j : Nat) (hcs : cs.length = rs.length)
    (hi : i < rs.length + xs.length)
    (hj : j < cs.length + ys.length) :
    borderAt rs.length i j (sel m (rs ++ xs) (cs ++ ys))
      = sel m (rs ++ [ground.getAt 0 (rs ++ xs) i])
          (cs ++ [ground.getAt 0 (cs ++ ys) j])
proof:
:= by
  refine ground.getAt_ext ([] : List BPair) _ _ ?_ ?_
  · rw [borderAt_len, sel_len, ground.length_append]
    rfl
  · intro a ha
    rw [borderAt_len] at ha
    have han : a < (rs ++ [ground.getAt 0 (rs ++ xs) i]).length := by
      rw [ground.length_append]
      exact ha
    have hax : (if a < rs.length then a else i)
        < (rs ++ xs).length := by
      rw [ground.length_append]
      by_cases hak : a < rs.length
      · rw [if_pos hak]
        exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hak
          (Nat.le_add_right rs.length xs.length)
      · rw [if_neg hak]
        exact hi
    have hkey : ground.getAt 0 (rs ++ xs)
          (if a < rs.length then a else i)
        = ground.getAt 0 (rs ++ [ground.getAt 0 (rs ++ xs) i])
          a := by
      by_cases hak : a < rs.length
      · rw [if_pos hak,
          getAt_append_lt 0 rs xs hak,
          getAt_append_lt 0 rs
            [ground.getAt 0 (rs ++ xs) i] hak]
      · have hae : a = rs.length :=
          Nat.le_antisymm (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ ha)
            (Nat.le_of_not_lt hak)
        rw [if_neg hak, hae,
          getAt_append_at 0 rs
            [ground.getAt 0 (rs ++ xs) i]]
        rfl
    rw [borderAt_row rs.length i j (sel m (rs ++ xs) (cs ++ ys)) a ha,
      getAt_sel m (rs ++ xs) (cs ++ ys) _ hax,
      keepCols_border cs ys _ rs.length j hcs hj, hkey,
      getAt_sel m (rs ++ [ground.getAt 0 (rs ++ xs) i])
        (cs ++ [ground.getAt 0 (cs ++ ys) j]) a han]

name: borderAt_full
statement:
private theorem borderAt_full (m : Mat) (rs cs : List Nat)
    (x y : Nat) (hcs : cs.length = rs.length) :
    borderAt rs.length rs.length rs.length
        (sel m (rs ++ [x]) (cs ++ [y]))
      = sel m (rs ++ [x]) (cs ++ [y])
proof:
:= by
  have hrow : ground.getAt 0 (rs ++ [x]) rs.length = x :=
    ground.getAt_append_add 0 rs [x] 0
  have hcol : ground.getAt 0 (cs ++ [y]) rs.length = y := by
    rw [← hcs]
    exact ground.getAt_append_add 0 cs [y] 0
  rw [borderAt_sel m rs cs [x] [y] rs.length rs.length hcs
      (Nat.lt_succ_self rs.length)
      (by rw [hcs]; exact Nat.lt_succ_self rs.length),
    hrow, hcol]

name: sel_sq
proof:
:= by
  rw [sel_len]
  exact rowsLen_map (fun i => keepCols cs (ground.getAt [] m i)) rs.length rs (fun x _ => (fun _ => by rw [keepCols_len, hcs]) x)

name: sFind_at
statement:
private theorem sFind_at : ∀ (rows : List SRow) (i j : Nat),
    sFind rows = some (i, j) →
    ∃ v es, (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i).2 = (j, v) :: es
  | [], _, _, h => nomatch h
  | (c, []) :: rest, i, j, h => by
    revert h
    show (match sFind rest with
        | none => none
        | some (a, b) => some (a + 1, b)) = some (i, j) →
      ∃ v es, (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow)
        ((c, []) :: rest) i).2 = (j, v) :: es
    cases hfr : sFind rest with
    | none =>
      intro h
      exact nomatch h
    | some ij =>
      intro h
      have hi : ij.1 + 1 = i
proof:
:= congrArg Prod.fst (Option.some.inj h)
      have hj : ij.2 = j := congrArg Prod.snd (Option.some.inj h)
      rw [← hi, ← hj]
      exact sFind_at rest ij.1 ij.2 hfr
  | (_, (k, v) :: es) :: _, i, j, h => by
    have h' : ((0, k) : Nat × Nat) = (i, j) := Option.some.inj h
    have hi : (0 : Nat) = i := congrArg Prod.fst h'
    have hj : k = j := congrArg Prod.snd h'
    rw [← hi, ← hj]
    exact ⟨v, es, rfl⟩

name: detL_nil
statement:
private theorem detL_nil : (detL ([] : Mat)).oneValue
    (BPair.ofPos .one)
proof:
:=
  detO_nil (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairLaws

name: detL_single
statement:
private theorem detL_single (x : BPair) :
    (detL [[x]]).oneValue x
proof: := detO_single (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairLaws x

name: rowsOk_ofRow
statement:
private theorem rowsOk_ofRow : ∀ m : Mat, rowsOk (m.map ofRow)
  | [] => trivial
  | r :: t =>
    ⟨⟨keysAsc_ofRowFrom r 0, entsOk_ofRowFrom r 0⟩,
      rowsOk_ofRow t⟩

/
private theorem rowsOk_getAt : ∀ (rows : List SRow) (a : Nat),
    rowsOk rows → a < rows.length →
      keysAsc 0 (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows a).2
      ∧ entsOk (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows a).2
  | [], _, _, ha => absurd ha (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | r :: t, 0, h, _ => by
    have hh : (keysAsc 0 r.2 ∧ entsOk r.2) ∧ rowsOk t
proof:
:= h
    exact hh.1
  | r :: t, a + 1, h, ha => by
    have hh : (keysAsc 0 r.2 ∧ entsOk r.2) ∧ rowsOk t := h
    exact rowsOk_getAt t a hh.2 (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ ha)

name: rowsOk_getAt
statement:
private theorem rowsOk_getAt : ∀ (rows : List SRow) (a : Nat),
    rowsOk rows → a < rows.length →
      keysAsc 0 (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows a).2
      ∧ entsOk (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows a).2
  | [], _, _, ha => absurd ha (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | r :: t, 0, h, _ => by
    have hh : (keysAsc 0 r.2 ∧ entsOk r.2) ∧ rowsOk t
proof:
:= h
    exact hh.1
  | r :: t, a + 1, h, ha => by
    have hh : (keysAsc 0 r.2 ∧ entsOk r.2) ∧ rowsOk t := h
    exact rowsOk_getAt t a hh.2 (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ ha)

name: rowsOk_eraseIdx
statement:
private theorem rowsOk_eraseIdx : ∀ (rows : List SRow) (i : Nat),
    rowsOk rows → rowsOk (rows.eraseIdx i)
  | [], _, _ => trivial
  | r :: t, 0, h => by
    have hh : (keysAsc 0 r.2 ∧ entsOk r.2) ∧ rowsOk t
proof:
:= h
    exact hh.2
  | r :: t, i + 1, h => by
    have hh : (keysAsc 0 r.2 ∧ entsOk r.2) ∧ rowsOk t := h
    exact ⟨hh.1, rowsOk_eraseIdx t i hh.2⟩

name: rowsOk_stepRows
statement:
private theorem rowsOk_stepRows (prev : BPair) (p : BPair × SRow)
    (j : Nat) (hp : keysAsc 0 p.2.2) : ∀ rows : List SRow,
    rowsOk rows → rowsOk (stepRows prev p j rows)
  | [], _ => trivial
  | r :: t, h => by
    have hh : (keysAsc 0 r.2 ∧ entsOk r.2) ∧ rowsOk t
proof:
:= h
    show ((keysAsc 0 (stepSRow prev p.1 (sPeel j r).1
          (ground.natMin p.2.1 (sPeel j r).2.1) p.2.2 (sPeel j r).2.2)
        ∧ entsOk (stepSRow prev p.1 (sPeel j r).1
          (ground.natMin p.2.1 (sPeel j r).2.1) p.2.2 (sPeel j r).2.2))
      ∧ rowsOk (stepRows prev p j t))
    exact ⟨⟨keysAsc_stepSRow prev p.1 (sPeel j r).1
        (ground.natMin p.2.1 (sPeel j r).2.1) p.2.2 (sPeel j r).2.2 hp
        (keysAsc_peel j r.2 0 hh.1.1 (Nat.zero_le j)),
      entsOk_stepSRow prev p.1 (sPeel j r).1
        (ground.natMin p.2.1 (sPeel j r).2.1) p.2.2 (sPeel j r).2.2⟩,
      rowsOk_stepRows prev p j hp t hh.2⟩

name: length_stepRows
proof:
:=
  ground.length_map _ rows

name: kinv_init
statement:
private theorem kinv_init (cols : Nat) (m : Mat)
    (hm : rowsLen cols m) :
    KInv m [] [] (List.range m.length) (List.range cols)
      (BPair.ofPos .one) (m.map ofRow)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨BPair.oneValue_symm detL_nil, BPair.ofNat_one_off, rfl,
    ?_, ?_, rowsOk_ofRow m, ?_⟩
  · rw [ground.length_map, ground.length_range]
  · rw [ground.length_range]
    exact sInv_ofRow cols m hm
  · intro a ha c hc
    rw [ground.length_map] at ha
    rw [ground.length_range] at hc
    rw [ground.getAt_map ([] : List BPair) ((0, []) : SRow) ofRow
        m a ha,
      ground.getAt_range m.length a ha,
      ground.getAt_range cols c hc]
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans ?_
      (BPair.oneValue_symm
        (detL_single (ground.getAt BPair.unit
          (ground.getAt [] m a) c)))
    have h := keyAt_ofRowFrom (ground.getAt [] m a) 0 c
    rw [Nat.zero_add] at h
    exact h

name: keyAt_stepRows
statement:
private theorem keyAt_stepRows (prev : BPair) (pr0 : SRow) (j : Nat)
    (rows : List SRow) (hpr : keysAsc 0 pr0.2) (hrows : rowsOk rows)
    (a : Nat) (ha : a < rows.length) (c : Nat)
    (hc : c < ground.natMin (sPeel j pr0).2.1
      (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows a)).2.1) :
    ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit c (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow)
        (stepRows prev (sPeel j pr0) j rows) a).2
      = cofactorAt ((sPeel j pr0).1
          * ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit (liftIx j c)
            (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows a).2
          + (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows a).2
              * ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit (liftIx j c) pr0.2).swap) prev
proof:
:= by
  have hasc := (rowsOk_getAt rows a hrows ha).1
  have hstep : (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow)
        (stepRows prev (sPeel j pr0) j rows) a).2
      = stepSRow prev (peel j pr0.2).1
          (peel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows a).2).1
          (ground.natMin (sPeel j pr0).2.1
            (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows a)).2.1)
          (peel j pr0.2).2
          (peel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows a).2).2 :=
    congrArg Prod.snd
      (ground.getAt_map ((0, []) : SRow) ((0, []) : SRow)
        (fun r =>
          let q := sPeel j r
          let lim := ground.natMin (sPeel j pr0).2.1 q.2.1
          (lim, stepSRow prev (sPeel j pr0).1 q.1 lim
            (sPeel j pr0).2.2 q.2.2))
        rows a ha)
  rw [hstep,
    keyAt_stepSRow prev (peel j pr0.2).1
      (peel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows a).2).1
      (ground.natMin (sPeel j pr0).2.1
        (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows a)).2.1)
      (peel j pr0.2).2
      (peel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows a).2).2
      (keysAsc_peel j pr0.2 0 hpr (Nat.zero_le j))
      (keysAsc_peel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows a).2 0
        hasc (Nat.zero_le j))
      c hc,
    keyAt_peel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows a).2 hasc c,
    keyAt_peel j pr0.2 hpr c,
    keyAt_peel_head j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows a).2 hasc]
  rfl

name: kinv_read
statement:
private theorem kinv_read (m : Mat) (rs cs ri cj : List Nat)
    (prev : BPair) (rows : List SRow)
    (inv : KInv m rs cs ri cj prev rows) (i j : Nat)
    (hf : sFind rows = some (i, j))
    (a : Nat) (ha : a < (rows.eraseIdx i).length)
    (c : Nat) (hc : c + 1 < cj.length) :
    ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit c (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow)
        (stepRows prev
          (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)) j
          (rows.eraseIdx i)) a).2
      = cofactorAt
          ((sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
              * ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit (liftIx j c)
                (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow)
                  (rows.eraseIdx i) a).2
            + (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow)
                  (rows.eraseIdx i) a).2
                * ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit (liftIx j c)
                  (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i).2).swap)
          prev
    ∧ (prev * detL (sel m
          ((rs ++ [ground.getAt 0 ri i])
            ++ [ground.getAt 0 (ri.eraseIdx i) a])
          ((cs ++ [ground.getAt 0 cj j])
            ++ [ground.getAt 0 (cj.eraseIdx j) c]))).oneValue
        ((sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
            * ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit (liftIx j c)
              (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow)
                (rows.eraseIdx i) a).2
          + (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow)
                (rows.eraseIdx i) a).2
              * ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit (liftIx j c)
                (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i).2).swap)
proof:
:= by
  have hi : i < rows.length := sFind_lt rows i j hf
  have hj : j < cj.length :=
    sFind_key cj.length rows i j inv.widths hf
  have hwi := sInv_getAt cj.length rows i inv.widths hi
  have hsi := rowsOk_getAt rows i inv.sorted hi
  have hser : rowsOk (rows.eraseIdx i) :=
    rowsOk_eraseIdx rows i inv.sorted
  have hwer : SInv cj.length (rows.eraseIdx i) :=
    sInv_eraseIdx cj.length rows i inv.widths
  have hwa := sInv_getAt cj.length (rows.eraseIdx i) a hwer ha
  have herow : (rows.eraseIdx i).length + 1 = rows.length :=
    ground.length_eraseIdx rows i hi
  have hecj : (cj.eraseIdx j).length + 1 = cj.length :=
    ground.length_eraseIdx cj j hj
  have hcn : c < (cj.eraseIdx j).length := by
    have hsucc : c + 1 < (cj.eraseIdx j).length + 1 := by
      rw [hecj]
      exact hc
    exact Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hsucc
  have hclim : c < cj.length - 1 := by
    rw [← hecj]
    exact hcn
  have hlim : ground.natMin
      (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).2.1
      (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow)
        (rows.eraseIdx i) a)).2.1 = cj.length - 1 := by
    rw [sPeel_count _ hj hwi.1, sPeel_count _ hj hwa.1]
    exact natMin_self (cj.length - 1)
  have hread := keyAt_stepRows prev
    (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i) j (rows.eraseIdx i)
    hsi.1 hser a ha c (by rw [hlim]; exact hclim)
  refine ⟨hread, ?_⟩
  have hii : i < ri.length := by
    rw [← inv.lenRows]
    exact hi
  have hlia : liftIx i a < rows.length := by
    by_cases hai : a < i
    · have hl : liftIx i a = a := by
        show (if a < i then a else a + 1) = a
        rw [if_pos hai]
      rw [hl, ← herow]
      exact Nat.lt_succ_of_lt ha
    · rw [liftIx_gt i a hai, ← herow]
      exact Nat.succ_lt_succ ha
  have hljc : liftIx j c < cj.length := by
    by_cases hcj : c < j
    · have hl : liftIx j c = c := by
        show (if c < j then c else c + 1) = c
        rw [if_pos hcj]
      rw [hl]
      exact Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self c) hc
    · rw [liftIx_gt j c hcj]
      exact hc
  have hrowa : ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) (rows.eraseIdx i) a
      = ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows (liftIx i a) := by
    rw [getAt_eraseIdx ((0, []) : SRow) rows i a]
    by_cases hai : a < i
    · have hl : liftIx i a = a := by
        show (if a < i then a else a + 1) = a
        rw [if_pos hai]
      rw [if_pos hai, hl]
    · rw [if_neg hai, liftIx_gt i a hai]
  have hra : ground.getAt 0 (ri.eraseIdx i) a
      = ground.getAt 0 ri (liftIx i a) := by
    rw [getAt_eraseIdx 0 ri i a]
    by_cases hai : a < i
    · have hl : liftIx i a = a := by
        show (if a < i then a else a + 1) = a
        rw [if_pos hai]
      rw [if_pos hai, hl]
    · rw [if_neg hai, liftIx_gt i a hai]
  have hcc : ground.getAt 0 (cj.eraseIdx j) c
      = ground.getAt 0 cj (liftIx j c) := by
    rw [getAt_eraseIdx 0 cj j c]
    by_cases hcj : c < j
    · have hl : liftIx j c = c := by
        show (if c < j then c else c + 1) = c
        rw [if_pos hcj]
      rw [if_pos hcj, hl]
    · rw [if_neg hcj, liftIx_gt j c hcj]
  have hp1eq : (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
      = ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i).2 :=
    keyAt_peel_head j
      (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i).2 hsi.1
  have hD := inv.entries i hi j hj
  have hA := inv.entries (liftIx i a) hlia (liftIx j c) hljc
  have hB := inv.entries i hi (liftIx j c) hljc
  have hC := inv.entries (liftIx i a) hlia j hj
  rw [← hp1eq] at hD
  rw [← hrowa, ← hra, ← hcc] at hA
  rw [← hcc] at hB
  rw [← hrowa, ← hra] at hC
  have hcs2 : (cs ++ [ground.getAt 0 cj j,
        ground.getAt 0 (cj.eraseIdx j) c]).length
      = (rs ++ [ground.getAt 0 ri i,
        ground.getAt 0 (ri.eraseIdx i) a]).length := by
    rw [ground.length_append, ground.length_append, inv.lenCs]
    rfl
  have hMMlen : (sel m
        (rs ++ [ground.getAt 0 ri i,
          ground.getAt 0 (ri.eraseIdx i) a])
        (cs ++ [ground.getAt 0 cj j,
          ground.getAt 0 (cj.eraseIdx j) c])).length
      = rs.length + 2 := by
    rw [sel_len, ground.length_append]
    rfl
  have hlt0 : rs.length < rs.length + 2 :=
    Nat.lt_succ_of_lt (Nat.lt_succ_self rs.length)
  have hlt1 : rs.length + 1 < rs.length + 2 :=
    Nat.lt_succ_self (rs.length + 1)
  have hlt0c : rs.length < cs.length + 2 := by
    rw [inv.lenCs]
    exact hlt0
  have hlt1c : rs.length + 1 < cs.length + 2 := by
    rw [inv.lenCs]
    exact hlt1
  have hrowP : ground.getAt 0
      (rs ++ [ground.getAt 0 ri i,
        ground.getAt 0 (ri.eraseIdx i) a]) rs.length
      = ground.getAt 0 ri i :=
    ground.getAt_append_add 0 rs _ 0
  have hrowR : ground.getAt 0
      (rs ++ [ground.getAt 0 ri i,
        ground.getAt 0 (ri.eraseIdx i) a]) (rs.length + 1)
      = ground.getAt 0 (ri.eraseIdx i) a :=
    ground.getAt_append_add 0 rs _ 1
  have hcolP : ground.getAt 0
      (cs ++ [ground.getAt 0 cj j,
        ground.getAt 0 (cj.eraseIdx j) c]) rs.length
      = ground.getAt 0 cj j := by
    rw [← inv.lenCs]
    exact ground.getAt_append_add 0 cs _ 0
  have hcolC : ground.getAt 0
      (cs ++ [ground.getAt 0 cj j,
        ground.getAt 0 (cj.eraseIdx j) c]) (rs.length + 1)
      = ground.getAt 0 (cj.eraseIdx j) c := by
    rw [← inv.lenCs]
    exact ground.getAt_append_add 0 cs _ 1
  have hcsP : (cs ++ [ground.getAt 0 cj j]).length
      = (rs ++ [ground.getAt 0 ri i]).length := by
    rw [ground.length_append, ground.length_append, inv.lenCs]
    rfl
  have hlenP : (rs ++ [ground.getAt 0 ri i]).length
      = rs.length + 1 := ground.length_append rs _
  have hfull := borderAt_full m (rs ++ [ground.getAt 0 ri i])
    (cs ++ [ground.getAt 0 cj j])
    (ground.getAt 0 (ri.eraseIdx i) a)
    (ground.getAt 0 (cj.eraseIdx j) c) hcsP
  rw [hlenP, appendPair, appendPair] at hfull
  have hsyl := sylvester
    (sel m
      (rs ++ [ground.getAt 0 ri i,
        ground.getAt 0 (ri.eraseIdx i) a])
      (cs ++ [ground.getAt 0 cj j,
        ground.getAt 0 (cj.eraseIdx j) c]))
    (sel_sq m _ _ hcs2) rs.length (rs.length + 1) (rs.length + 1)
    (Nat.lt_succ_self rs.length)
    (by rw [hMMlen]; exact hlt1)
    (Nat.lt_succ_self rs.length)
    (by rw [hMMlen]; exact hlt1)
  rw [hfull,
    leadAt_sel m rs cs
      [ground.getAt 0 ri i, ground.getAt 0 (ri.eraseIdx i) a]
      [ground.getAt 0 cj j, ground.getAt 0 (cj.eraseIdx j) c]
      inv.lenCs,
    borderAt_sel m rs cs
      [ground.getAt 0 ri i, ground.getAt 0 (ri.eraseIdx i) a]
      [ground.getAt 0 cj j, ground.getAt 0 (cj.eraseIdx j) c]
      rs.length rs.length inv.lenCs hlt0 hlt0c,
    borderAt_sel m rs cs
      [ground.getAt 0 ri i, ground.getAt 0 (ri.eraseIdx i) a]
      [ground.getAt 0 cj j, ground.getAt 0 (cj.eraseIdx j) c]
      (rs.length + 1) rs.length inv.lenCs hlt1 hlt0c,
    borderAt_sel m rs cs
      [ground.getAt 0 ri i, ground.getAt 0 (ri.eraseIdx i) a]
      [ground.getAt 0 cj j, ground.getAt 0 (cj.eraseIdx j) c]
      rs.length (rs.length + 1) inv.lenCs hlt0 hlt1c,
    borderAt_sel m rs cs
      [ground.getAt 0 ri i, ground.getAt 0 (ri.eraseIdx i) a]
      [ground.getAt 0 cj j, ground.getAt 0 (cj.eraseIdx j) c]
      (rs.length + 1) (rs.length + 1) inv.lenCs hlt1 hlt1c,
    hrowP, hrowR, hcolP, hcolC] at hsyl
  rw [appendPair, appendPair]
  exact BPair.oneValue_trans
    (BPair.mul_congr inv.prevRead (BPair.oneValue_refl _))
    (BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.oneValue_symm
        (swapMove
          (Y := (BPair.mul
            (detL (sel m (rs ++ [ground.getAt 0 (ri.eraseIdx i) a])
              (cs ++ [ground.getAt 0 cj j])))
            (detL (sel m (rs ++ [ground.getAt 0 ri i])
              (cs ++ [ground.getAt 0 (cj.eraseIdx j) c])))).swap)
          hsyl))
      (BPair.add_congr
        (BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_symm hD)
          (BPair.oneValue_symm hA))
        (ground.swap_congr
          (BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_symm hC)
            (BPair.oneValue_symm hB)))))

name: kinv_step
statement:
private theorem kinv_step (m : Mat) (rs cs ri cj : List Nat)
    (prev : BPair) (rows : List SRow)
    (inv : KInv m rs cs ri cj prev rows) (i j : Nat)
    (hf : sFind rows = some (i, j)) :
    KInv m (rs ++ [ground.getAt 0 ri i])
      (cs ++ [ground.getAt 0 cj j])
      (ri.eraseIdx i) (cj.eraseIdx j)
      (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
      (stepRows prev
        (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)) j
        (rows.eraseIdx i))
proof:
:= by
  have hi : i < rows.length := sFind_lt rows i j hf
  have hj : j < cj.length :=
    sFind_key cj.length rows i j inv.widths hf
  have hwi := sInv_getAt cj.length rows i inv.widths hi
  have hsi := rowsOk_getAt rows i inv.sorted hi
  have hp1eq : (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
      = ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i).2 :=
    keyAt_peel_head j
      (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i).2 hsi.1
  have hecj : (cj.eraseIdx j).length + 1 = cj.length :=
    ground.length_eraseIdx cj j hj
  have herow : (rows.eraseIdx i).length + 1 = rows.length :=
    ground.length_eraseIdx rows i hi
  have hii : i < ri.length := by
    rw [← inv.lenRows]
    exact hi
  have heri : (ri.eraseIdx i).length + 1 = ri.length :=
    ground.length_eraseIdx ri i hii
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hp1eq]
    exact inv.entries i hi j hj
  · obtain ⟨v, es, hrow⟩ := sFind_at rows i j hf
    rw [hp1eq, hrow, keyAt_hit (ground.beqRefl j) v es]
    have hent : entsOk ((j, v) :: es) := by
      rw [← hrow]
      exact hsi.2
    exact (show (¬ v.oneValue BPair.unit) ∧ entsOk es from hent).1
  · rw [ground.length_append, ground.length_append, inv.lenCs]
    rfl
  · rw [length_stepRows]
    exact Nat.succ.inj (herow.trans (inv.lenRows.trans heri.symm))
  · rw [show (cj.eraseIdx j).length = cj.length - 1 from by
      rw [← hecj]
      rfl]
    exact sInv_step cj.length prev
      (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)) j
      (sPeel_count _ hj hwi.1) (rows.eraseIdx i)
      (sInv_eraseIdx cj.length rows i inv.widths) hj
  · exact rowsOk_stepRows prev
      (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)) j
      (keysAsc_peel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i).2 0
        hsi.1 (Nat.zero_le j))
      (rows.eraseIdx i) (rowsOk_eraseIdx rows i inv.sorted)
  · intro a ha c hc
    rw [length_stepRows] at ha
    have hc' : c + 1 < cj.length := by
      rw [← hecj]
      exact Nat.succ_lt_succ hc
    have h := kinv_read m rs cs ri cj prev rows inv i j hf a ha c hc'
    rw [h.1]
    exact ground.mulCancel inv.prevOff
      (BPair.oneValue_trans (cofactorAt_sound inv.prevOff h.2)
        (BPair.oneValue_symm h.2))

name: kinv_exact
statement:
private theorem kinv_exact (m : Mat) (rs cs ri cj : List Nat)
    (prev : BPair) (rows : List SRow)
    (inv : KInv m rs cs ri cj prev rows) (i j : Nat)
    (hf : sFind rows = some (i, j)) :
    ∀ a, a < (rows.eraseIdx i).length → ∀ c, c + 1 < cj.length →
      (prev * ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit c (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow)
          (stepRows prev
            (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)) j
            (rows.eraseIdx i)) a).2).oneValue
        ((sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
            * ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit (liftIx j c)
              (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow)
                (rows.eraseIdx i) a).2
          + (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow)
                (rows.eraseIdx i) a).2
              * ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit (liftIx j c)
                (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i).2).swap)
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha c hc
  have h := kinv_read m rs cs ri cj prev rows inv i j hf a ha c hc
  rw [h.1]
  exact cofactorAt_sound inv.prevOff h.2

name: denseRow_snd
statement:
private theorem denseRow_snd (w : Nat) (r r' : SRow)
    (h : r.2 = r'.2) : denseRow w r = denseRow w r'
proof:
:= by
  show (List.range w).map (fun c => ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit c r.2)
    = (List.range w).map (fun c => ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit c r'.2)
  rw [h]

name: sPeel_snd
statement:
private theorem sPeel_snd (j : Nat) (r : SRow) :
    (sPeel j r).2.2 = (peel j r.2).2
proof: := rfl

name: insertAt_zero
statement:
private theorem insertAt_zero {α : Type} (x : α) :
    ∀ l : List α, insertAt x l 0 = x :: l
  | [] => rfl
  | _ :: _ => rfl

/
at the place the inserted entry, past it the predecessor's. -/
private theorem getAt_insertAt {α : Type} (d : α) (x : α) :
    ∀ (l : List α) (n c : Nat), n ≤ l.length →
      ground.getAt d (insertAt x l n) c
        = if c < n then ground.getAt d l c
          else if c = n then x
          else ground.getAt d l (c - 1)
  | l, 0, 0, _ => by
    rw [insertAt_zero x l, if_neg (Nat.lt_irrefl 0), if_pos rfl]
    rfl
  | l, 0, c + 1, _ => by
    rw [insertAt_zero x l, if_neg (Nat.not_lt_zero (c + 1)),
      if_neg (show ¬ c + 1 = 0 from fun he => Nat.noConfusion he)]
    rfl
  | [], n + 1, _, hn => absurd hn (Nat.not_succ_le_zero n)
  | a :: t, n + 1, 0, _ => by
    show ground.getAt d (a :: insertAt x t n) 0
      = if (0 : Nat) < n + 1 then ground.getAt d (a :: t) 0
        else if (0 : Nat) = n + 1 then x
        else ground.getAt d (a :: t) (0 - 1)
    rw [if_pos (Nat.succ_pos n)]
    rfl
  | a :: t, n + 1, c + 1, hn => by
    show ground.getAt d (insertAt x t n) c
      = if c + 1 < n + 1 then ground.getAt d (a :: t) (c + 1)
        else if c + 1 = n + 1 then x
        else ground.getAt d (a :: t) (c + 1 - 1)
    rw [getAt_insertAt d x t n c (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hn)]
    by_cases h1 : c < n
    · rw [if_pos h1, if_pos (Nat.succ_lt_succ h1)]
      rfl
    · rw [if_neg h1,
        if_neg (fun hs => h1 (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hs))]
      by_cases h2 : c = n
      · rw [if_pos h2, if_pos (congrArg (fun z => z + 1) h2)]
      · rw [if_neg h2, if_neg (fun hs => h2 (Nat.succ.inj hs))]
        cases c with
        | zero =>
          cases n with
          | zero => exact absurd rfl h2
          | succ n' => exact absurd (Nat.succ_pos n') h1
        | succ c' => rfl

/
against the two lists' heads. -/
private theorem dotP_insertAt : ∀ (r s : List BPair) (x : BPair)
    (j : Nat), r.length = s.length + 1 → j ≤ s.length →
    (dotP r (insertAt x s j)).oneValue
      (ground.getAt BPair.unit r j * x + dotP (strike j r) s)
  | [], s, _, _, hr, _ => nomatch (show 0 = s.length + 1 from hr)
  | a :: r, s, x, 0, _, _ => by
    rw [insertAt_zero x s]
    show (a * x + dotP r s).oneValue (a * x + dotP r s)
    exact BPair.oneValue_refl _
  | _ :: _, [], _, j + 1, _, hj => absurd hj (Nat.not_succ_le_zero j)
  | a :: r, b :: s, x, j + 1, hr, hj => by
    have ih
proof:
:= dotP_insertAt r s x j (Nat.succ.inj hr)
      (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hj)
    show (a * b + dotP r (insertAt x s j)).oneValue
      (ground.getAt BPair.unit r j * x
        + (a * b + dotP (strike j r) s))
    exact BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.add_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl (a * b)) ih)
      (BPair.oneValue_of_eq (BPair.add_left_comm (a * b) _ _))

name: dotP_strike
statement:
private theorem dotP_strike : ∀ (r s : List BPair) (j : Nat),
    r.length = s.length → j < s.length →
    (dotP r s).oneValue
      (ground.getAt BPair.unit r j * ground.getAt BPair.unit s j
        + dotP (strike j r) (strike j s))
  | [], [], _, _, hj => absurd hj (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | [], _ :: _, _, hr, _ => nomatch hr
  | _ :: _, [], _, hr, _ => nomatch hr
  | a :: r, b :: s, 0, _, _ => by
    show (a * b + dotP r s).oneValue (a * b + dotP r s)
    exact BPair.oneValue_refl _
  | a :: r, b :: s, j + 1, hr, hj => by
    have ih
proof:
:= dotP_strike r s j (Nat.succ.inj hr)
      (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hj)
    show (a * b + dotP r s).oneValue
      (ground.getAt BPair.unit r j * ground.getAt BPair.unit s j
        + (a * b + dotP (strike j r) (strike j s)))
    exact BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.add_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl (a * b)) ih)
      (BPair.oneValue_of_eq (BPair.add_left_comm (a * b) _ _))

name: sFind_none
statement:
private theorem sFind_none : ∀ (rows : List SRow) (a : Nat),
    sFind rows = none → a < rows.length →
      (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows a).2 = []
  | [], _, _, ha => absurd ha (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | (_, []) :: _, 0, _, _ => rfl
  | (_, []) :: rest, a + 1, h, ha => by
    revert h
    show (match sFind rest with
        | none => none
        | some (i, j) => some (i + 1, j)) = none →
      (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rest a).2 = []
    cases hfr : sFind rest with
    | none =>
      intro _
      exact sFind_none rest a hfr (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ ha)
    | some ij =>
      intro hb
      exact nomatch hb
  | (_, (_, _) :: _) :: _, _, h, _ => nomatch h

/
list: every read off the vacant entries is the sum's unit. -/
private theorem unitTail_denseNil : ∀ l : List Nat,
    poly.unitTail
      (l.map (fun c => ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit c ([] : List (Nat × BPair))))
  | [] => trivial
  | _ :: t => ⟨BPair.oneValue_refl BPair.unit, unitTail_denseNil t⟩

/
unit. -/
private theorem dotP_unitRow (w : Nat) : ∀ u : List BPair,
    (dotP (denseRow w ((w, []) : SRow)) u).oneValue BPair.unit
proof:
:=
  fun u =>
    dotP_null_tail_left (denseRow w ((w, []) : SRow)) u
      (unitTail_denseNil (List.range w))

  | [] => trivial
  | _ :: t => ⟨BPair.oneValue_refl BPair.unit, unitTail_denseNil t⟩

unit. -/
