name: kernelGo_none
proof:
:=
  descGo_none _ _ fuel w prev rows hf

name: kernelGo_some
statement:
private theorem kernelGo_some (fuel w : Nat) (prev : BPair)
    (rows : List SRow) (i j : Nat) (hf : sFind rows = some (i, j)) :
    kernelGo (fuel + 1) w prev rows
      = (kernelGo fuel (w - 1)
          (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
          (stepRows prev
            (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)) j
            (rows.eraseIdx i))).map
        (fun v => insertAt
          ((dotN (denseRow (w - 1)
              (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).2)
            v).swap)
          (vecScale
            (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1 v)
          j)
proof:
:=
  descGo_some _ _ fuel w prev rows i j hf

name: swapOfAddNull
statement:
private theorem swapOfAddNull {A B : BPair}
    (h : (A + B).oneValue BPair.unit) : B.oneValue A.swap
proof:
:= by
  show B.fst + A.fst = A.snd + B.snd
  rw [ground.add_comm B.fst A.fst]
  exact ground.add_cancel_ones h

name: eraseIdx_index
statement:
private theorem eraseIdx_index {α : Type} (d : α) (l : List α)
    (i a : Nat) (hi : i < l.length) (ha : a < l.length)
    (hne : ¬ a = i) :
    ∃ b, b < (l.eraseIdx i).length
      ∧ ground.getAt d (l.eraseIdx i) b = ground.getAt d l a
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : (l.eraseIdx i).length + 1 = l.length :=
    ground.length_eraseIdx l i hi
  have hi' : i < (l.eraseIdx i).length + 1 := by
    rw [hlen]
    exact hi
  match Nat.lt_or_ge a i with
  | Or.inl hai =>
    refine ⟨a, Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hai (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hi'), ?_⟩
    rw [getAt_eraseIdx d l i a, if_pos hai]
  | Or.inr hge =>
    have hlt : i < a :=
      Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne hge (fun he => hne he.symm)
    match a, ha, hlt with
    | b + 1, ha, hlt =>
      have hb : b < (l.eraseIdx i).length := by
        have h1 : b + 1 < (l.eraseIdx i).length + 1 := by
          rw [hlen]
          exact ha
        exact Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ h1
      refine ⟨b, hb, ?_⟩
      rw [getAt_eraseIdx d l i b,
        if_neg (Nat.not_lt_of_ge (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hlt))]

name: display_dense
statement:
private theorem display_dense (m : Mat) (rs cs ri cj : List Nat)
    (prev : BPair) (rows : List SRow)
    (inv : KInv m rs cs ri cj prev rows) (i j : Nat)
    (hf : sFind rows = some (i, j))
    (a : Nat) (ha : a < (rows.eraseIdx i).length) :
    poly.oneValue
      (vecScale prev (denseRow (cj.eraseIdx j).length
        (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow)
          (stepRows prev
            (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)) j
            (rows.eraseIdx i)) a)))
      (vecAdd
        (vecScale (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
          (denseRow (cj.eraseIdx j).length
            (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow)
              (rows.eraseIdx i) a)).2))
        ((vecScale
            (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow)
              (rows.eraseIdx i) a).2)
            (denseRow (cj.eraseIdx j).length
              (sPeel j
                (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).2)).map
          BPair.swap))
proof:
:= by
  have hi : i < rows.length := sFind_lt rows i j hf
  have hj : j < cj.length :=
    sFind_key cj.length rows i j inv.widths hf
  have hecj : (cj.eraseIdx j).length + 1 = cj.length :=
    ground.length_eraseIdx cj j hj
  have hsi := rowsOk_getAt rows i inv.sorted hi
  have hsa := rowsOk_getAt (rows.eraseIdx i) a
    (rowsOk_eraseIdx rows i inv.sorted) ha
  refine poly.oneValue_of_entries _ _ ?_ ?_
  · rw [length_vecScale, length_denseRow,
      length_vecAdd _ _ (cj.eraseIdx j).length
        (by rw [length_vecScale, length_denseRow])
        (by rw [ground.length_map, length_vecScale,
          length_denseRow])]
  · intro c hc
    rw [length_vecScale, length_denseRow] at hc
    have hc1 : c + 1 < cj.length := by
      rw [← hecj]
      exact Nat.succ_lt_succ hc
    have hexact := kinv_exact m rs cs ri cj prev rows inv i j hf
      a ha c hc1
    rw [getAt_vecScale prev _ c
        (by rw [length_denseRow]; exact hc),
      getAt_denseRow (cj.eraseIdx j).length _ c hc,
      getAt_vecAdd _ _ c
        (by rw [length_vecScale, length_denseRow]; exact hc)
        (by rw [ground.length_map, length_vecScale, length_denseRow]
            exact hc),
      getAt_vecScale _ _ c (by rw [length_denseRow]; exact hc),
      ground.getAt_map BPair.unit BPair.unit BPair.swap _ c
        (by rw [length_vecScale, length_denseRow]; exact hc),
      getAt_vecScale _ _ c (by rw [length_denseRow]; exact hc),
      getAt_denseRow (cj.eraseIdx j).length _ c hc,
      getAt_denseRow (cj.eraseIdx j).length _ c hc,
      sPeel_snd j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) (rows.eraseIdx i) a),
      sPeel_snd j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i),
      keyAt_peel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow)
        (rows.eraseIdx i) a).2 hsa.1 c,
      keyAt_peel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i).2 hsi.1 c]
    exact hexact

name: kernelGo_members
statement:
private theorem kernelGo_members (m : Mat) :
    ∀ (fuel : Nat) (rs cs ri cj : List Nat) (prev : BPair)
      (rows : List SRow), KInv m rs cs ri cj prev rows →
      rows.length ≤ fuel →
      ∀ k, k < (kernelGo fuel cj.length prev rows).length →
      ∀ a, a < rows.length →
        (dotP (denseRow cj.length
            (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows a))
          (ground.getAt [] (kernelGo fuel cj.length prev rows)
            k)).oneValue BPair.unit
  | 0, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, hfuel, _, _, a, ha =>
    absurd (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le ha hfuel) (Nat.not_lt_zero a)
  | fuel + 1, rs, cs, ri, cj, prev, rows, inv, hfuel, k, hk, a,
      ha => by
    cases hf : sFind rows with
    | none =>
      rw [kernelGo_none fuel cj.length prev rows hf,
        denseRow_snd cj.length _ ((cj.length, []) : SRow)
          (sFind_none rows a hf ha)]
      exact dotP_unitRow cj.length _
    | some ij =>
      obtain ⟨i, j⟩
proof:
:= ij
      have hi : i < rows.length := sFind_lt rows i j hf
      have hj : j < cj.length :=
        sFind_key cj.length rows i j inv.widths hf
      have hecj : (cj.eraseIdx j).length + 1 = cj.length :=
        ground.length_eraseIdx cj j hj
      have herow : (rows.eraseIdx i).length + 1 = rows.length :=
        ground.length_eraseIdx rows i hi
      have hW : cj.length - 1 = (cj.eraseIdx j).length := by
        rw [← hecj]
        rfl
      have hsi := rowsOk_getAt rows i inv.sorted hi
      have hp1 : (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
          = ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i).2 :=
        keyAt_peel_head j
          (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i).2 hsi.1
      have hjs : j < (cj.eraseIdx j).length + 1 := by
        rw [hecj]
        exact hj
      rw [kernelGo_some fuel cj.length prev rows i j hf, hW] at hk ⊢
      have hkK : k < (kernelGo fuel (cj.eraseIdx j).length
          (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
          (stepRows prev
            (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)) j
            (rows.eraseIdx i))).length := by
        rw [ground.length_map] at hk
        exact hk
      rw [ground.getAt_map ([] : List BPair) ([] : List BPair) _ _ k
        hkK]
      have hvk : (ground.getAt ([] : List BPair)
          (kernelGo fuel (cj.eraseIdx j).length
            (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
            (stepRows prev
              (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)) j
              (rows.eraseIdx i))) k).length
          = (cj.eraseIdx j).length :=
        rowsLen_getAt _ k (kernelGo_rowsLen fuel _ _ _) hkK
      have hrlen : (denseRow cj.length
            (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows a)).length
          = (vecScale
              (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
              (ground.getAt ([] : List BPair)
                (kernelGo fuel (cj.eraseIdx j).length
                  (sPeel j
                    (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
                  (stepRows prev
                    (sPeel j
                      (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)) j
                    (rows.eraseIdx i))) k)).length + 1 := by
        rw [length_denseRow, length_vecScale, hvk, hecj]
      have hjle : j ≤ (vecScale
          (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
          (ground.getAt ([] : List BPair)
            (kernelGo fuel (cj.eraseIdx j).length
              (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
              (stepRows prev
                (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)) j
                (rows.eraseIdx i))) k)).length := by
        rw [length_vecScale, hvk]
        exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ hjs
      refine BPair.oneValue_trans
        (dotP_insertAt _ _ _ j hrlen hjle) ?_
      rw [getAt_denseRow cj.length
          (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows a) j hj,
        ← denseRow_sPeel cj.length j
          (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows a)
          (rowsOk_getAt rows a inv.sorted ha).1 hj,
        hW]
      by_cases hai : a = i
      · rw [hai, ← hp1]
        refine BPair.oneValue_trans
          (BPair.add_congr
            (BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl _)
              (ground.swap_congr (dotN_read _ _)))
            (dotP_vecScale_right _ _ _)) ?_
        rw [← BPair.left_distrib]
        exact oneValue_mul_unit _ _
          (BPair.swap_add_null (BPair.oneValue_refl _))
      · obtain ⟨b, hb, hbeq⟩ := eraseIdx_index ((0, []) : SRow)
          rows i a hi ha hai
        have hstep : (stepRows prev
            (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)) j
            (rows.eraseIdx i)).length
            = (rows.eraseIdx i).length := length_stepRows _ _ _ _
        have hfuel' : (stepRows prev
            (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)) j
            (rows.eraseIdx i)).length ≤ fuel := by
          rw [hstep]
          have h1 : (rows.eraseIdx i).length + 1 ≤ fuel + 1 := by
            rw [herow]
            exact hfuel
          exact Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ h1
        have hbs : b < (stepRows prev
            (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)) j
            (rows.eraseIdx i)).length := by
          rw [hstep]
          exact hb
        have hih := kernelGo_members m fuel
          (rs ++ [ground.getAt 0 ri i])
          (cs ++ [ground.getAt 0 cj j])
          (ri.eraseIdx i) (cj.eraseIdx j)
          (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
          (stepRows prev
            (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)) j
            (rows.eraseIdx i))
          (kinv_step m rs cs ri cj prev rows inv i j hf) hfuel'
          k hkK b hbs
        have hdisp := display_dense m rs cs ri cj prev rows inv i j
          hf b hb
        rw [hbeq] at hdisp
        have hDunit : (dotP
            (vecAdd
              (vecScale
                (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
                (denseRow (cj.eraseIdx j).length
                  (sPeel j
                    (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows a)).2))
              ((vecScale
                  (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows a).2)
                  (denseRow (cj.eraseIdx j).length
                    (sPeel j
                      (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).2)).map
                BPair.swap))
            (ground.getAt ([] : List BPair)
              (kernelGo fuel (cj.eraseIdx j).length
                (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
                (stepRows prev
                  (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)) j
                  (rows.eraseIdx i))) k)).oneValue BPair.unit := by
          refine BPair.oneValue_trans
            (BPair.oneValue_symm (dotP_oneValue_left _ _ _ hdisp)) ?_
          refine BPair.oneValue_trans
            (BPair.oneValue_of_eq (dotP_comm _ _)) ?_
          refine BPair.oneValue_trans
            (dotP_vecScale_right _ _ prev) ?_
          exact oneValue_mul_unit prev _
            (BPair.oneValue_trans
              (BPair.oneValue_of_eq (dotP_comm _ _)) hih)
        have hlen1 : (ground.getAt ([] : List BPair)
            (kernelGo fuel (cj.eraseIdx j).length
              (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
              (stepRows prev
                (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)) j
                (rows.eraseIdx i))) k).length
            ≤ (vecScale
                (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
                (denseRow (cj.eraseIdx j).length
                  (sPeel j
                    (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows a)).2)).length
            := by
          rw [hvk, length_vecScale, length_denseRow]
          exact Nat.le_refl _
        have hlen2 : (ground.getAt ([] : List BPair)
            (kernelGo fuel (cj.eraseIdx j).length
              (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
              (stepRows prev
                (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)) j
                (rows.eraseIdx i))) k).length
            ≤ ((vecScale
                (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows a).2)
                (denseRow (cj.eraseIdx j).length
                  (sPeel j
                    (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).2)).map
              BPair.swap).length := by
          rw [hvk, ground.length_map, length_vecScale,
            length_denseRow]
          exact Nat.le_refl _
        have hA : (dotP
            (vecScale
              (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
              (denseRow (cj.eraseIdx j).length
                (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows a)).2))
            (ground.getAt ([] : List BPair)
              (kernelGo fuel (cj.eraseIdx j).length
                (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
                (stepRows prev
                  (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)) j
                  (rows.eraseIdx i))) k)).oneValue
            ((sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
              * dotP
                (denseRow (cj.eraseIdx j).length
                  (sPeel j
                    (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows a)).2)
                (ground.getAt ([] : List BPair)
                  (kernelGo fuel (cj.eraseIdx j).length
                    (sPeel j
                      (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
                    (stepRows prev
                      (sPeel j
                        (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)) j
                      (rows.eraseIdx i))) k)) :=
          BPair.oneValue_trans
            (BPair.oneValue_of_eq (dotP_comm _ _))
            (BPair.oneValue_trans (dotP_vecScale_right _ _ _)
              (BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl _)
                (BPair.oneValue_of_eq (dotP_comm _ _))))
        have hB : (dotP
            ((vecScale
                (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows a).2)
                (denseRow (cj.eraseIdx j).length
                  (sPeel j
                    (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).2)).map
              BPair.swap)
            (ground.getAt ([] : List BPair)
              (kernelGo fuel (cj.eraseIdx j).length
                (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
                (stepRows prev
                  (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)) j
                  (rows.eraseIdx i))) k)).oneValue
            (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows a).2
              * (dotP
                  (denseRow (cj.eraseIdx j).length
                    (sPeel j
                      (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).2)
                  (ground.getAt ([] : List BPair)
                    (kernelGo fuel (cj.eraseIdx j).length
                      (sPeel j
                        (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
                      (stepRows prev
                        (sPeel j
                          (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)) j
                        (rows.eraseIdx i))) k)).swap) := by
          rw [dotP_comm, dotP_swapMap, BPair.mul_swap]
          exact ground.swap_congr
            (BPair.oneValue_trans (dotP_vecScale_right _ _ _)
              (BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl _)
                (BPair.oneValue_of_eq (dotP_comm _ _))))
        have hSum := BPair.oneValue_trans
          (BPair.oneValue_symm (BPair.add_congr hA hB))
          (BPair.oneValue_trans
            (BPair.oneValue_symm
              (dotP_vecAdd_left _ _ _ hlen1 hlen2))
            hDunit)
        refine BPair.oneValue_trans
          (BPair.add_congr
            (BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl _)
              (ground.swap_congr (dotN_read _ _)))
            (dotP_vecScale_right _ _ _)) ?_
        rw [BPair.add_comm]
        exact hSum

name: dotP_denseRow_row
statement:
private theorem dotP_denseRow_row (cols : Nat) (m : Mat)
    (hm : rowsLen cols m) (v : List BPair) (a : Nat)
    (ha : a < m.length) :
    (dotP (denseRow cols
        (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) (m.map ofRow) a)) v).oneValue
      (dotP (ground.getAt [] m a) v)
proof:
:= by
  have hrow : (ground.getAt [] m a).length = cols :=
    rowsLen_getAt m a hm ha
  rw [ground.getAt_map ([] : List BPair) ((0, []) : SRow) ofRow m a
      ha,
    ← hrow]
  exact dotP_oneValue_left _ _ v
    (denseRow_ofRow (ground.getAt [] m a))

name: unitTail_matVec
statement:
private theorem unitTail_matVec (m : Mat) (v : List BPair)
    (h : ∀ a, a < m.length →
      (dotP (ground.getAt [] m a) v).oneValue BPair.unit) :
    poly.unitTail (matVec m v)
proof:
:= by
  refine unitTail_of_getAt (matVec m v) ?_
  intro p hp
  rw [matVec_length] at hp
  show (ground.getAt BPair.unit
    (m.map (fun r => dotN r v)) p).oneValue BPair.unit
  rw [ground.getAt_map ([] : List BPair) BPair.unit
    (fun r => dotN r v) m p hp]
  exact BPair.oneValue_trans (dotN_read _ v) (h p hp)

name: matVec_row_null
statement:
private theorem matVec_row_null (m : Mat) (v : List BPair)
    (h : poly.unitTail (matVec m v)) :
    ∀ a, a < m.length →
      (dotP (ground.getAt [] m a) v).oneValue BPair.unit
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha
  have hp : a < (matVec m v).length := by
    rw [matVec_length]
    exact ha
  have hg : (ground.getAt BPair.unit
      (m.map (fun r => dotN r v)) a).oneValue BPair.unit :=
    poly.getAt_unitTail h a
  rw [ground.getAt_map ([] : List BPair) BPair.unit
    (fun r => dotN r v) m a ha] at hg
  exact BPair.oneValue_trans
    (BPair.oneValue_symm (dotN_read _ v)) hg

name: kernelList_members
statement:
theorem kernelList_members (cols : Nat) (m : Mat)
    (hm : rowsLen cols m) :
    ∀ k : Nat, k < (kernelList cols m).length →
      poly.unitTail (matVec m
        (ground.getAt [] (kernelList cols m) k))
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  refine unitTail_matVec m _ ?_
  intro a ha
  have hlr : (List.range cols).length = cols :=
    ground.length_range cols
  have hrows : (m.map ofRow).length = m.length :=
    ground.length_map _ m
  have ha' : a < (m.map ofRow).length := by
    rw [hrows]
    exact ha
  have hfuel : (m.map ofRow).length ≤ m.length := by
    rw [hrows]
    exact Nat.le_refl _
  have hk' : k < (kernelGo m.length (List.range cols).length
      (BPair.ofPos .one) (m.map ofRow)).length := by
    rw [hlr]
    exact hk
  have hmem := kernelGo_members m m.length [] []
    (List.range m.length) (List.range cols) (BPair.ofPos .one)
    (m.map ofRow) (kinv_init cols m hm) hfuel k hk' a ha'
  rw [hlr] at hmem
  exact BPair.oneValue_trans
    (BPair.oneValue_symm (dotP_denseRow_row cols m hm _ a ha)) hmem

name: kernelGo_zero
statement:
private theorem kernelGo_zero (w : Nat) (prev : BPair)
    (rows : List SRow) : kernelGo 0 w prev rows = idMat w
proof:
:=
  descGo_zero _ _ w prev rows

name: liftIx_lo
statement:
private theorem liftIx_lo (j q : Nat) (hq : q < j) :
    liftIx j q = q
proof:
:= by
  show (if q < j then q else q + 1) = q
  rw [if_pos hq]

name: getAt_insertAt_lift
statement:
private theorem getAt_insertAt_lift {α : Type} (d : α) (x : α)
    (l : List α) (j q : Nat) (hj : j ≤ l.length) :
    ground.getAt d (insertAt x l j) (liftIx j q)
      = ground.getAt d l q
proof:
:= by
  rw [getAt_insertAt d x l j (liftIx j q) hj,
    if_neg (liftIx_ne j q)]
  match Nat.lt_or_ge q j with
  | Or.inl hq => rw [liftIx_lo j q hq, if_pos hq]
  | Or.inr hq =>
    rw [liftIx_gt j q (Nat.not_lt_of_ge hq),
      if_neg (Nat.not_lt_of_ge (Nat.le_succ_of_le hq)), Nat.succ_sub_one]

name: idMat_coords
statement:
private theorem idMat_coords (w k : Nat) (hk : k < w) :
    ((ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] (idMat w) k)
      (ground.getAt 0 (List.range w) k)).oneValue
        (BPair.ofPos .one))
      ∧ ∀ k', k' < w → ¬ k' = k →
        (ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] (idMat w) k)
          (ground.getAt 0 (List.range w) k')).oneValue
          BPair.unit
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [ground.getAt_range w k hk, getAt_idMat w k k hk hk, if_pos rfl]
    exact BPair.oneValue_refl _
  · intro k' hk' hne
    rw [ground.getAt_range w k' hk', getAt_idMat w k k' hk hk', if_neg hne]
    exact BPair.oneValue_refl _

name: freeGo_zero
statement:
private theorem freeGo_zero (w : Nat) (prev : BPair)
    (rows : List SRow) : freeGo 0 w prev rows = List.range w
proof:
:=
  descGo_zero _ _ w prev rows

name: freeGo_none
proof:
:=
  descGo_none _ _ fuel w prev rows hf

name: freeGo_some
statement:
private theorem freeGo_some (fuel w : Nat) (prev : BPair)
    (rows : List SRow) (i j : Nat) (hf : sFind rows = some (i, j)) :
    freeGo (fuel + 1) w prev rows
      = (freeGo fuel (w - 1)
          (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
          (stepRows prev
            (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)) j
            (rows.eraseIdx i))).map (liftIx j)
proof:
:=
  descGo_some _ _ fuel w prev rows i j hf

name: length_freeGo
statement:
private theorem length_freeGo : ∀ (fuel w : Nat) (prev : BPair)
    (rows : List SRow),
    (freeGo fuel w prev rows).length
      = (kernelGo fuel w prev rows).length
  | 0, w, prev, rows => by
    rw [freeGo_zero w prev rows, kernelGo_zero w prev rows,
      ground.length_range, length_idMat]
  | fuel + 1, w, prev, rows => by
    cases hf : sFind rows with
    | none =>
      rw [freeGo_none fuel w prev rows hf,
        kernelGo_none fuel w prev rows hf, ground.length_range,
        length_idMat]
    | some ij =>
      obtain ⟨i, j⟩
proof:
:= ij
      rw [freeGo_some fuel w prev rows i j hf,
        kernelGo_some fuel w prev rows i j hf, ground.length_map,
        ground.length_map]
      exact length_freeGo fuel (w - 1) _ _

name: pivGo_zero
statement:
private theorem pivGo_zero (prev : BPair) (rows : List SRow) :
    pivGo 0 prev rows = BPair.ofPos .one
proof: := rfl

name: pivGo_none
proof:
:=
  descGo_none _ _ fuel 0 prev rows hf

name: pivGo_some
statement:
private theorem pivGo_some (fuel : Nat) (prev : BPair)
    (rows : List SRow) (i j : Nat)
    (hf : sFind rows = some (i, j)) :
    pivGo (fuel + 1) prev rows
      = (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
        * pivGo fuel
          (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
          (stepRows prev
            (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)) j
            (rows.eraseIdx i))
proof:
:=
  descGo_some _ _ fuel 0 prev rows i j hf

name: freeGo_lt
statement:
private theorem freeGo_lt : ∀ (fuel w : Nat) (prev : BPair)
    (rows : List SRow) (k : Nat),
    k < (freeGo fuel w prev rows).length →
      ground.getAt 0 (freeGo fuel w prev rows) k < w
  | 0, w, prev, rows, k, hk => by
    rw [freeGo_zero w prev rows] at hk ⊢
    rw [ground.length_range] at hk
    rw [ground.getAt_range w k hk]
    exact hk
  | fuel + 1, w, prev, rows, k, hk => by
    cases hf : sFind rows with
    | none =>
      rw [freeGo_none fuel w prev rows hf] at hk ⊢
      rw [ground.length_range] at hk
      rw [ground.getAt_range w k hk]
      exact hk
    | some ij =>
      obtain ⟨i, j⟩
proof:
:= ij
      rw [freeGo_some fuel w prev rows i j hf] at hk ⊢
      rw [ground.length_map] at hk
      rw [ground.getAt_map 0 0 (liftIx j) _ k hk]
      have hih := freeGo_lt fuel (w - 1)
        (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
        (stepRows prev
          (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)) j
          (rows.eraseIdx i)) k hk
      cases w with
      | zero => exact absurd hih (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
      | succ w' => exact liftIx_lt hih

name: pivGo_off
statement:
private theorem pivGo_off : ∀ (fuel : Nat) (prev : BPair)
    (rows : List SRow), rowsOk rows →
      ¬ (pivGo fuel prev rows).oneValue BPair.unit
  | 0, prev, rows, _ => by
    rw [pivGo_zero prev rows]
    exact BPair.ofNat_one_off
  | fuel + 1, prev, rows, hro => by
    cases hf : sFind rows with
    | none =>
      rw [pivGo_none fuel prev rows hf]
      exact BPair.ofNat_one_off
    | some ij =>
      obtain ⟨i, j⟩
proof:
:= ij
      have hi : i < rows.length := sFind_lt rows i j hf
      have hsi := rowsOk_getAt rows i hro hi
      have hp1eq : (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
          = ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit j
            (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i).2 :=
        keyAt_peel_head j
          (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i).2 hsi.1
      have hoff : ¬ (sPeel j
          (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1.oneValue
          BPair.unit := by
        obtain ⟨v, es, hrow⟩ := sFind_at rows i j hf
        rw [hp1eq, hrow, keyAt_hit (ground.beqRefl j) v es]
        have hent : entsOk ((j, v) :: es) := by
          rw [← hrow]
          exact hsi.2
        exact (show (¬ v.oneValue BPair.unit) ∧ entsOk es from hent).1
      rw [pivGo_some fuel prev rows i j hf]
      intro hcon
      exact pivGo_off fuel _ _
        (rowsOk_stepRows prev
          (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)) j
          (keysAsc_peel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i).2 0
            hsi.1 (Nat.zero_le j))
          (rows.eraseIdx i) (rowsOk_eraseIdx rows i hro))
        (mul_cancel_unit hoff hcon)

name: freeGo_coords
statement:
private theorem freeGo_coords (m : Mat) :
    ∀ (fuel : Nat) (rs cs ri cj : List Nat) (prev : BPair)
      (rows : List SRow), KInv m rs cs ri cj prev rows →
      rows.length ≤ fuel →
      ∀ k, k < (kernelGo fuel cj.length prev rows).length →
        ((ground.getAt BPair.unit
            (ground.getAt [] (kernelGo fuel cj.length prev rows) k)
            (ground.getAt 0
              (freeGo fuel cj.length prev rows) k)).oneValue
          (pivGo fuel prev rows))
        ∧ ∀ k', k' < (kernelGo fuel cj.length prev rows).length →
          ¬ k' = k →
          (ground.getAt BPair.unit
            (ground.getAt [] (kernelGo fuel cj.length prev rows) k)
            (ground.getAt 0
              (freeGo fuel cj.length prev rows) k')).oneValue
            BPair.unit
  | 0, _, _, _, cj, prev, rows, _, _, k, hk => by
    rw [kernelGo_zero cj.length prev rows] at hk ⊢
    rw [freeGo_zero cj.length prev rows, length_idMat]
    rw [length_idMat] at hk
    exact idMat_coords cj.length k hk
  | fuel + 1, rs, cs, ri, cj, prev, rows, inv, hfuel, k, hk => by
    cases hf : sFind rows with
    | none =>
      rw [kernelGo_none fuel cj.length prev rows hf] at hk ⊢
      rw [freeGo_none fuel cj.length prev rows hf,
        pivGo_none fuel prev rows hf, length_idMat]
      rw [length_idMat] at hk
      exact idMat_coords cj.length k hk
    | some ij =>
      obtain ⟨i, j⟩
proof:
:= ij
      have hi : i < rows.length := sFind_lt rows i j hf
      have hj : j < cj.length :=
        sFind_key cj.length rows i j inv.widths hf
      have hecj : (cj.eraseIdx j).length + 1 = cj.length :=
        ground.length_eraseIdx cj j hj
      have herow : (rows.eraseIdx i).length + 1 = rows.length :=
        ground.length_eraseIdx rows i hi
      have hW : cj.length - 1 = (cj.eraseIdx j).length := by
        rw [← hecj]
        rfl
      have hjs : j < (cj.eraseIdx j).length + 1 := by
        rw [hecj]
        exact hj
      have inv' := kinv_step m rs cs ri cj prev rows inv i j hf
      have hstep : (stepRows prev
          (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)) j
          (rows.eraseIdx i)).length
          = (rows.eraseIdx i).length := length_stepRows _ _ _ _
      have hfuel' : (stepRows prev
          (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)) j
          (rows.eraseIdx i)).length ≤ fuel := by
        rw [hstep]
        have h1 : (rows.eraseIdx i).length + 1 ≤ fuel + 1 := by
          rw [herow]
          exact hfuel
        exact Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ h1
      rw [kernelGo_some fuel cj.length prev rows i j hf, hW] at hk
      rw [kernelGo_some fuel cj.length prev rows i j hf,
        freeGo_some fuel cj.length prev rows i j hf, hW]
      have hkK : k < (kernelGo fuel (cj.eraseIdx j).length
          (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
          (stepRows prev
            (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)) j
            (rows.eraseIdx i))).length := by
        rw [ground.length_map] at hk
        exact hk
      have hkF : k < (freeGo fuel (cj.eraseIdx j).length
          (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
          (stepRows prev
            (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)) j
            (rows.eraseIdx i))).length := by
        rw [length_freeGo]
        exact hkK
      have hvk : (ground.getAt ([] : List BPair)
          (kernelGo fuel (cj.eraseIdx j).length
            (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
            (stepRows prev
              (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)) j
              (rows.eraseIdx i))) k).length
          = (cj.eraseIdx j).length :=
        rowsLen_getAt _ k (kernelGo_rowsLen fuel _ _ _) hkK
      have hjle : j ≤ (vecScale
          (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
          (ground.getAt ([] : List BPair)
            (kernelGo fuel (cj.eraseIdx j).length
              (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
              (stepRows prev
                (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)) j
                (rows.eraseIdx i))) k)).length := by
        rw [length_vecScale, hvk]
        exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ hjs
      have hih := freeGo_coords m fuel (rs ++ [ground.getAt 0 ri i])
        (cs ++ [ground.getAt 0 cj j]) (ri.eraseIdx i)
        (cj.eraseIdx j)
        (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
        (stepRows prev
          (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)) j
          (rows.eraseIdx i)) inv' hfuel' k hkK
      have hread : ∀ k'', k'' < (freeGo fuel (cj.eraseIdx j).length
          (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
          (stepRows prev
            (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)) j
            (rows.eraseIdx i))).length →
          ground.getAt BPair.unit
            (ground.getAt []
              ((kernelGo fuel (cj.eraseIdx j).length
                (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
                (stepRows prev
                  (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)) j
                  (rows.eraseIdx i))).map
                (fun v => insertAt
                  ((dotN (denseRow (cj.eraseIdx j).length
                    (sPeel j
                      (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).2)
                    v).swap)
                  (vecScale
                    (sPeel j
                      (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1 v)
                  j)) k)
            (ground.getAt 0
              ((freeGo fuel (cj.eraseIdx j).length
                (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
                (stepRows prev
                  (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)) j
                  (rows.eraseIdx i))).map (liftIx j)) k'')
          = (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
            * ground.getAt BPair.unit
              (ground.getAt []
                (kernelGo fuel (cj.eraseIdx j).length
                  (sPeel j
                    (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
                  (stepRows prev
                    (sPeel j
                      (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)) j
                    (rows.eraseIdx i))) k)
              (ground.getAt 0
                (freeGo fuel (cj.eraseIdx j).length
                  (sPeel j
                    (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
                  (stepRows prev
                    (sPeel j
                      (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)) j
                    (rows.eraseIdx i))) k'') := by
        intro k'' hk''
        have hqW := freeGo_lt fuel (cj.eraseIdx j).length
          (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
          (stepRows prev
            (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)) j
            (rows.eraseIdx i)) k'' hk''
        rw [ground.getAt_map ([] : List BPair) ([] : List BPair) _ _
            k hkK,
          ground.getAt_map 0 0 (liftIx j) _ k'' hk'',
          getAt_insertAt_lift BPair.unit _ _ j _ hjle,
          getAt_vecScale _ _ _ (by rw [hvk]; exact hqW)]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hread k hkF, pivGo_some fuel prev rows i j hf]
        exact BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl _) hih.1
      · intro k' hk' hne
        have hk'K : k' < (kernelGo fuel (cj.eraseIdx j).length
            (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
            (stepRows prev
              (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)) j
              (rows.eraseIdx i))).length := by
          rw [ground.length_map] at hk'
          exact hk'
        have hk'F : k' < (freeGo fuel (cj.eraseIdx j).length
            (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
            (stepRows prev
              (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)) j
              (rows.eraseIdx i))).length := by
          rw [length_freeGo]
          exact hk'K
        rw [hread k' hk'F]
        exact oneValue_mul_unit _ _ (hih.2 k' hk'K hne)

name: combo_pick
statement:
private theorem combo_pick (n : Nat) (L : Mat) (hL : rowsLen n L)
    (cs : List BPair) (hcs : cs.length = L.length)
    (hcombo : poly.unitTail (combo n cs L)) (k q : Nat)
    (hk : k < L.length) (hq : q < n)
    (hdiag : ¬ (ground.getAt BPair.unit
      (ground.getAt [] L k) q).oneValue BPair.unit)
    (hoff : ∀ k', k' < L.length → ¬ k' = k →
      (ground.getAt BPair.unit
        (ground.getAt [] L k') q).oneValue BPair.unit) :
    (ground.getAt BPair.unit cs k).oneValue BPair.unit
proof:
:= by
  have hM : (L.map (fun r => ground.getAt BPair.unit r q)).length
      = L.length := ground.length_map _ L
  have hoff' : ∀ k', k' < (L.map
        (fun r => ground.getAt BPair.unit r q)).length →
      ¬ k' = k →
      (ground.getAt BPair.unit
        (L.map (fun r => ground.getAt BPair.unit r q)) k').oneValue
        BPair.unit := by
    intro k' hk' hne
    rw [hM] at hk'
    rw [ground.getAt_map ([] : List BPair) BPair.unit _ L k' hk']
    exact hoff k' hk' hne
  have hpick := dotP_oneIndex cs
    (L.map (fun r => ground.getAt BPair.unit r q)) k
    (hcs.trans hM.symm) (by rw [hM]; exact hk) hoff'
  have hcoord := poly.getAt_unitTail hcombo q
  have hsum : (dotP cs (L.map
      (fun r => ground.getAt BPair.unit r q))).oneValue
      BPair.unit :=
    BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.oneValue_symm (combo_getAt n cs L q hL hq)) hcoord
  have hprod := BPair.oneValue_trans
    (BPair.oneValue_symm hpick) hsum
  rw [ground.getAt_map ([] : List BPair) BPair.unit _ L k hk,
    BPair.mul_comm] at hprod
  exact mul_cancel_unit hdiag hprod

name: pivotProd_off
statement: theorem pivotProd_off (m : Mat) : ¬ (pivotProd m).oneValue BPair.unit
proof:
:=
  pivGo_off m.length (BPair.ofPos .one) (m.map ofRow) (rowsOk_ofRow m)

name: freeCols_length
statement:
theorem freeCols_length (cols : Nat) (m : Mat) :
    (freeCols cols m).length = (kernelList cols m).length
proof:
:=
  length_freeGo m.length cols (BPair.ofPos .one) (m.map ofRow)

name: kernelList_coords
statement:
theorem kernelList_coords (cols : Nat) (m : Mat)
    (hm : rowsLen cols m) :
    ∀ k : Nat, k < (kernelList cols m).length →
      ((ground.getAt BPair.unit
          (ground.getAt [] (kernelList cols m) k)
          (ground.getAt 0 (freeCols cols m) k)).oneValue
        (pivotProd m))
      ∧ ∀ k' : Nat, k' < (kernelList cols m).length → ¬ k' = k →
        (ground.getAt BPair.unit
          (ground.getAt [] (kernelList cols m) k)
          (ground.getAt 0 (freeCols cols m) k')).oneValue
          BPair.unit
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  have hlr : (List.range cols).length = cols :=
    ground.length_range cols
  have hrows : (m.map ofRow).length = m.length :=
    ground.length_map _ m
  have hfuel : (m.map ofRow).length ≤ m.length := by
    rw [hrows]
    exact Nat.le_refl _
  have hk' : k < (kernelGo m.length (List.range cols).length
      (BPair.ofPos .one) (m.map ofRow)).length := by
    rw [hlr]
    exact hk
  have h := freeGo_coords m m.length [] [] (List.range m.length)
    (List.range cols) (BPair.ofPos .one) (m.map ofRow)
    (kinv_init cols m hm) hfuel k hk'
  rw [hlr] at h
  exact h

name: kernelList_indep
statement:
theorem kernelList_indep (cols : Nat) (m : Mat)
    (hm : rowsLen cols m) :
    indepRows cols (kernelList cols m)
proof:
:= by
  have hlr : (List.range cols).length = cols :=
    ground.length_range cols
  have hrows : (m.map ofRow).length = m.length :=
    ground.length_map _ m
  have hfuel : (m.map ofRow).length ≤ m.length := by
    rw [hrows]
    exact Nat.le_refl _
  refine indep_intro cols (kernelList cols m)
    (kernelList_rowsLen cols m) ?_
  have hcoords := kernelList_coords cols m hm
  intro csf hcsf hcombo
  refine unitTail_of_getAt csf ?_
  intro k hk
  rw [hcsf] at hk
  have hkF : k < (freeGo m.length cols (BPair.ofPos .one)
      (m.map ofRow)).length := by
    rw [length_freeGo]
    exact hk
  exact combo_pick cols (kernelList cols m)
    (kernelList_rowsLen cols m) csf hcsf hcombo k
    (ground.getAt 0
      (freeGo m.length cols (BPair.ofPos .one) (m.map ofRow)) k) hk
    (freeGo_lt m.length cols (BPair.ofPos .one) (m.map ofRow) k hkF)
    (fun hcon => pivGo_off m.length (BPair.ofPos .one)
      (m.map ofRow) (rowsOk_ofRow m)
      (BPair.oneValue_trans
        (BPair.oneValue_symm (hcoords k hk).1) hcon))
    (fun k' hk' hne => (hcoords k' hk').2 k hk
      (fun he => hne he.symm))

name: insertIx_lift
proof:
:= by
  match Nat.lt_or_ge c j with
  | Or.inl hlt =>
    exact ⟨c, Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hlt hj, liftIx_lo j c hlt⟩
  | Or.inr hge =>
    have hjc : j < c :=
      Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne hge (fun he => hne he.symm)
    cases c with
    | zero => exact absurd hjc (Nat.not_lt_zero j)
    | succ e =>
      exact ⟨e, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hc,
        liftIx_gt j e (Nat.not_lt_of_ge (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hjc))⟩

name: getAt_strike
proof:
:= by
  show ground.getAt BPair.unit (v.eraseIdx j) d
    = ground.getAt BPair.unit v (liftIx j d)
  rw [getAt_eraseIdx BPair.unit v j d]
  show (if d < j then ground.getAt BPair.unit v d
      else ground.getAt BPair.unit v (d + 1))
    = ground.getAt BPair.unit v (if d < j then d else d + 1)
  by_cases h : d < j
  · rw [if_pos h, if_pos h]
  · rw [if_neg h, if_neg h]

name: oneValue_map_rowsLen
statement:
private theorem oneValue_map_rowsLen (w : Nat)
    (f g : List BPair → BPair)
    (h : ∀ u : List BPair, u.length = w → (f u).oneValue (g u))
    (K : Mat) (hK : rowsLen w K) :
    poly.oneValue (K.map f) (K.map g)
proof:
:=
  poly.oneValue_map f g K (fun u hu =>
    match ground.getAt_of_mem ([] : List BPair) hu with
    | ⟨k, hk, hke⟩ => h u (hke ▸ rowsLen_getAt K k hK hk))

name: combo_idMat
statement:
private theorem combo_idMat (w : Nat) (u : List BPair)
    (hu : u.length = w) :
    poly.oneValue (vecScale (BPair.ofPos .one) u)
      (combo w u (idMat w))
proof:
:= by
  refine poly.oneValue_of_entries _ _ ?_ ?_
  · rw [length_vecScale, hu,
      length_combo w u (idMat w) (rowsLen_idMat w)]
  · intro q hq
    rw [length_vecScale, hu] at hq
    have hM : ((idMat w).map
        (fun r => ground.getAt BPair.unit r q)).length = w := by
      rw [ground.length_map, length_idMat]
    have hoff : ∀ kk, kk < ((idMat w).map
          (fun r => ground.getAt BPair.unit r q)).length →
        ¬ kk = q →
        (ground.getAt BPair.unit ((idMat w).map
          (fun r => ground.getAt BPair.unit r q)) kk).oneValue
          BPair.unit := by
      intro kk hkk hne
      rw [hM] at hkk
      rw [ground.getAt_map ([] : List BPair) BPair.unit _ (idMat w)
          kk (by rw [length_idMat]; exact hkk),
        getAt_idMat w kk q hkk hq, if_neg (fun he => hne he.symm)]
      exact BPair.oneValue_refl _
    have hdiag : ground.getAt BPair.unit ((idMat w).map
        (fun r => ground.getAt BPair.unit r q)) q
        = BPair.ofPos .one := by
      rw [ground.getAt_map ([] : List BPair) BPair.unit _ (idMat w)
          q (by rw [length_idMat]; exact hq),
        getAt_idMat w q q hq hq, if_pos rfl]
      rfl
    have hpick := dotP_oneIndex u ((idMat w).map
        (fun r => ground.getAt BPair.unit r q)) q
      (by rw [hM, hu]) (by rw [hM]; exact hq) hoff
    rw [hdiag] at hpick
    rw [getAt_vecScale _ _ q (by rw [hu]; exact hq)]
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans ?_
      (BPair.oneValue_symm
        (combo_getAt w u (idMat w) q (rowsLen_idMat w) hq))
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.oneValue_of_eq
        (BPair.mul_comm (BPair.ofPos .one)
          (ground.getAt BPair.unit u q))) ?_
    exact BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.mul_one_read (ground.getAt BPair.unit u q))
      (BPair.oneValue_symm
        (BPair.oneValue_trans hpick
          (BPair.mul_one_read (ground.getAt BPair.unit u q))))

name: combo_mapExt_off
statement:
private theorem combo_mapExt_off (w : Nat) (P0 : BPair)
    (f : List BPair → BPair) (d : Nat) (hd : d < w)
    (cs : List BPair) (K : Mat) (hK : rowsLen w K)
    (hf : ∀ u : List BPair, u.length = w →
      (f u).oneValue (P0 * ground.getAt BPair.unit u d)) :
    (dotP cs (K.map f)).oneValue
      (P0 * ground.getAt BPair.unit (combo w cs K) d)
proof:
:= by
  have hmm : vecScale P0
      (K.map (fun u => ground.getAt BPair.unit u d))
      = K.map (fun u => P0 * ground.getAt BPair.unit u d) :=
    ground.map_map (fun u => ground.getAt BPair.unit u d)
      (fun x => P0 * x) K
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans
    (dotP_oneValue_right cs _ _
      (show poly.oneValue (K.map f)
          (vecScale P0
            (K.map (fun u => ground.getAt BPair.unit u d)))
        from by
          rw [hmm]
          exact oneValue_map_rowsLen w f _ hf K hK)) ?_
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans (dotP_vecScale_right cs _ P0) ?_
  exact BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl P0)
    (BPair.oneValue_symm (combo_getAt w cs K d hK hd))

name: combo_mapExt
statement:
private theorem combo_mapExt (w : Nat) (t : List BPair)
    (P0 : BPair) (j : Nat) (hj : j ≤ w)
    (cs : List BPair) (K : Mat) (hK : rowsLen w K) :
    poly.oneValue
      (combo (w + 1) cs (K.map (fun u =>
        insertAt ((dotN t u).swap) (vecScale P0 u) j)))
      (insertAt ((dotP t (combo w cs K)).swap)
        (vecScale P0 (combo w cs K)) j)
proof:
:= by
  have hC : (combo w cs K).length = w := length_combo w cs K hK
  have hext : rowsLen (w + 1) (K.map (fun u =>
      insertAt ((dotN t u).swap) (vecScale P0 u) j)) :=
    rowsLen_extend w j P0 t K hK
  refine poly.oneValue_of_entries _ _ ?_ ?_
  · rw [length_combo (w + 1) cs _ hext, length_insertAt,
      length_vecScale, hC]
  · intro c hc
    rw [length_combo (w + 1) cs _ hext] at hc
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans
      (combo_getAt (w + 1) cs _ c hext hc) ?_
    rw [ground.map_map]
    by_cases hcj : c = j
    · rw [hcj, getAt_insertAt BPair.unit _ _ j j
          (by rw [length_vecScale, hC]; exact hj),
        if_neg (Nat.lt_irrefl j), if_pos rfl]
      refine BPair.oneValue_trans
        (dotP_oneValue_right cs _
          ((K.map (fun u => dotP t u)).map BPair.swap)
          (by
            rw [ground.map_map]
            refine oneValue_map_rowsLen w _ _ ?_ K hK
            intro u hu
            rw [getAt_insertAt BPair.unit _ _ j j
                (by rw [length_vecScale, hu]; exact hj),
              if_neg (Nat.lt_irrefl j), if_pos rfl]
            exact ground.swap_congr (dotN_read t u))) ?_
      rw [dotP_swapMap]
      exact ground.swap_congr
        (BPair.oneValue_symm (dotP_combo cs K t w hK))
    · obtain ⟨d, hd, hlift⟩ := insertIx_lift j w c hj hc hcj
      rw [← hlift,
        getAt_insertAt_lift BPair.unit _ _ j d
          (by rw [length_vecScale, hC]; exact hj),
        getAt_vecScale P0 _ d (by rw [hC]; exact hd)]
      refine combo_mapExt_off w P0 _ d hd cs K hK ?_
      intro u hu
      rw [getAt_insertAt_lift BPair.unit _ _ j d
          (by rw [length_vecScale, hu]; exact hj),
        getAt_vecScale P0 u d (by rw [hu]; exact hd)]
      exact BPair.oneValue_refl _

name: eraseIdx_source
statement:
private theorem eraseIdx_source {α : Type} (d : α) (l : List α)
    (i b : Nat) (hi : i < l.length)
    (hb : b < (l.eraseIdx i).length) :
    ∃ a, a < l.length
      ∧ ground.getAt d l a = ground.getAt d (l.eraseIdx i) b
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : (l.eraseIdx i).length + 1 = l.length :=
    ground.length_eraseIdx l i hi
  match Nat.lt_or_ge b i with
  | Or.inl hbi =>
    refine ⟨b, Nat.lt_trans hbi hi, ?_⟩
    rw [getAt_eraseIdx d l i b, if_pos hbi]
  | Or.inr hge =>
    refine ⟨b + 1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← hlen]
      exact Nat.succ_lt_succ hb
    · rw [getAt_eraseIdx d l i b, if_neg (Nat.not_lt_of_ge hge)]

name: dotP_display
statement:
private theorem dotP_display (w : Nat) (P0 r0 : BPair)
    (E T u : List BPair) (hE : E.length = w) (hT : T.length = w)
    (hu : u.length = w) :
    (dotP (vecAdd (vecScale P0 E) ((vecScale r0 T).map BPair.swap))
      u).oneValue (P0 * dotP E u + (r0 * dotP T u).swap)
proof:
:= by
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans
    (dotP_vecAdd_left _ _ u
      (by rw [hu, length_vecScale, hE]; exact Nat.le_refl _)
      (by rw [hu, ground.length_map, length_vecScale, hT]
          exact Nat.le_refl _)) ?_
  refine BPair.add_congr ?_ ?_
  · exact BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.oneValue_of_eq (dotP_comm (vecScale P0 E) u))
      (BPair.oneValue_trans (dotP_vecScale_right u E P0)
        (BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl P0)
          (BPair.oneValue_of_eq (dotP_comm u E))))
  · rw [dotP_comm, dotP_swapMap]
    exact ground.swap_congr
      (BPair.oneValue_trans (dotP_vecScale_right u T r0)
        (BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl r0)
          (BPair.oneValue_of_eq (dotP_comm u T))))

name: strike_row_read
statement:
private theorem strike_row_read (w : Nat) (r : SRow)
    (hr : keysAsc 0 r.2) (v : List BPair) (hv : v.length = w + 1)
    (j : Nat) (hj : j < w + 1)
    (hnull : (dotP (denseRow (w + 1) r) v).oneValue BPair.unit) :
    (dotP (denseRow w (sPeel j r).2) (strike j v)).oneValue
      ((ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit j r.2 * ground.getAt BPair.unit v j).swap)
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : (denseRow (w + 1) r).length = v.length := by
    rw [length_denseRow, hv]
  have hjv : j < v.length := by
    rw [hv]
    exact hj
  have hsplit := dotP_strike (denseRow (w + 1) r) v j hlen hjv
  rw [getAt_denseRow (w + 1) r j hj,
    ← denseRow_sPeel (w + 1) j r hr hj] at hsplit
  exact swapOfAddNull
    (BPair.oneValue_trans (BPair.oneValue_symm hsplit) hnull)

name: kernelGo_span
statement:
private theorem kernelGo_span (m : Mat) :
    ∀ (fuel : Nat) (rs cs ri cj : List Nat) (prev : BPair)
      (rows : List SRow), KInv m rs cs ri cj prev rows →
      rows.length ≤ fuel →
      ∀ v : List BPair, v.length = cj.length →
      (∀ a, a < rows.length →
        (dotP (denseRow cj.length
            (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows a)) v).oneValue
          BPair.unit) →
      ∃ c₀ cs', (¬ c₀.oneValue BPair.unit)
        ∧ cs'.length = (kernelGo fuel cj.length prev rows).length
        ∧ poly.oneValue (vecScale c₀ v)
            (combo cj.length cs'
              (kernelGo fuel cj.length prev rows))
  | 0, _, _, _, cj, prev, rows, _, _, v, hv, _ => by
    rw [kernelGo_zero cj.length prev rows]
    exact ⟨BPair.ofPos .one, v, BPair.ofNat_one_off,
      by rw [length_idMat]; exact hv,
      combo_idMat cj.length v hv⟩
  | fuel + 1, rs, cs, ri, cj, prev, rows, inv, hfuel, v, hv,
      hnull => by
    cases hf : sFind rows with
    | none =>
      rw [kernelGo_none fuel cj.length prev rows hf]
      exact ⟨BPair.ofPos .one, v, BPair.ofNat_one_off,
        by rw [length_idMat]; exact hv,
        combo_idMat cj.length v hv⟩
    | some ij =>
      obtain ⟨i, j⟩
proof:
:= ij
      have hi : i < rows.length := sFind_lt rows i j hf
      have hj : j < cj.length :=
        sFind_key cj.length rows i j inv.widths hf
      have hecj : (cj.eraseIdx j).length + 1 = cj.length :=
        ground.length_eraseIdx cj j hj
      have herow : (rows.eraseIdx i).length + 1 = rows.length :=
        ground.length_eraseIdx rows i hi
      have hW : cj.length - 1 = (cj.eraseIdx j).length := by
        rw [← hecj]
        rfl
      have hsi := rowsOk_getAt rows i inv.sorted hi
      have hp1 : (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
          = ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i).2 :=
        keyAt_peel_head j
          (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i).2 hsi.1
      have hjs : j < (cj.eraseIdx j).length + 1 := by
        rw [hecj]
        exact hj
      have hvW : v.length = (cj.eraseIdx j).length + 1 := by
        rw [hecj]
        exact hv
      have inv' := kinv_step m rs cs ri cj prev rows inv i j hf
      have hstep : (stepRows prev
          (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)) j
          (rows.eraseIdx i)).length
          = (rows.eraseIdx i).length := length_stepRows _ _ _ _
      have hfuel' : (stepRows prev
          (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)) j
          (rows.eraseIdx i)).length ≤ fuel := by
        rw [hstep]
        have h1 : (rows.eraseIdx i).length + 1 ≤ fuel + 1 := by
          rw [herow]
          exact hfuel
        exact Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ h1
      have hvs : (strike j v).length = (cj.eraseIdx j).length := by
        have h1 : (strike j v).length + 1 = cj.length := by
          show (v.eraseIdx j).length + 1 = cj.length
          rw [ground.length_eraseIdx v j (by rw [hv]; exact hj), hv]
        refine Nat.succ.inj ?_
        show (strike j v).length + 1 = (cj.eraseIdx j).length + 1
        rw [h1, hecj]
      
      have hpiv : (dotP (denseRow (cj.eraseIdx j).length
          (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).2)
          (strike j v)).oneValue
          (((sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
            * ground.getAt BPair.unit v j).swap) := by
        rw [hp1]
        exact strike_row_read (cj.eraseIdx j).length
          (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i) hsi.1 v hvW j hjs
          (by rw [hecj]; exact hnull i hi)
      
      have hnull' : ∀ b, b < (stepRows prev
          (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)) j
          (rows.eraseIdx i)).length →
          (dotP (denseRow (cj.eraseIdx j).length
            (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow)
              (stepRows prev
                (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)) j
                (rows.eraseIdx i)) b)) (strike j v)).oneValue
            BPair.unit := by
        intro b hbs
        rw [hstep] at hbs
        obtain ⟨a, hasrc, haeq⟩ := eraseIdx_source ((0, []) : SRow)
          rows i b hi hbs
        have hsb := rowsOk_getAt (rows.eraseIdx i) b
          (rowsOk_eraseIdx rows i inv.sorted) hbs
        have hrow : (dotP (denseRow (cj.eraseIdx j).length
            (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow)
              (rows.eraseIdx i) b)).2) (strike j v)).oneValue
            ((ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow)
                (rows.eraseIdx i) b).2
              * ground.getAt BPair.unit v j).swap) := by
          refine strike_row_read (cj.eraseIdx j).length
            (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) (rows.eraseIdx i) b)
            hsb.1 v hvW j hjs ?_
          rw [hecj, ← haeq]
          exact hnull a hasrc
        have hdisp := display_dense m rs cs ri cj prev rows inv i j
          hf b hbs
        refine mul_cancel_unit inv.prevOff ?_
        refine BPair.oneValue_trans
          (BPair.oneValue_symm
            (BPair.oneValue_trans
              (BPair.oneValue_of_eq (dotP_comm _ (strike j v)))
              (BPair.oneValue_trans
                (dotP_vecScale_right (strike j v) _ prev)
                (BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl prev)
                  (BPair.oneValue_of_eq
                    (dotP_comm (strike j v) _)))))) ?_
        refine BPair.oneValue_trans
          (dotP_oneValue_left _ _ (strike j v) hdisp) ?_
        refine BPair.oneValue_trans
          (dotP_display (cj.eraseIdx j).length
            (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
            (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow)
              (rows.eraseIdx i) b).2)
            _ _ (strike j v) (length_denseRow _ _)
            (length_denseRow _ _) hvs) ?_
        refine BPair.oneValue_trans
          (BPair.add_congr
            (BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl _) hrow)
            (ground.swap_congr
              (BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl _) hpiv))) ?_
        exact BPair.swap_add_null (BPair.oneValue_of_eq
          (BPair.mul_left_comm
            (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
            (ground.keyAt Nat.beq BPair.unit j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow)
              (rows.eraseIdx i) b).2)
            (ground.getAt BPair.unit v j)))
      obtain ⟨c0, cs0, hc0off, hc0len, hc0poly⟩ :=
        kernelGo_span m fuel (rs ++ [ground.getAt 0 ri i])
          (cs ++ [ground.getAt 0 cj j]) (ri.eraseIdx i)
          (cj.eraseIdx j)
          (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
          (stepRows prev
            (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)) j
            (rows.eraseIdx i)) inv' hfuel' (strike j v) hvs hnull'
      rw [kernelGo_some fuel cj.length prev rows i j hf, hW,
        ← hecj]
      refine ⟨(sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
          * c0, cs0, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro hcon
        exact hc0off (mul_cancel_unit inv'.prevOff hcon)
      · rw [ground.length_map]
        exact hc0len
      · refine poly.oneValue_trans ?_
          (poly.oneValue_symm
            (combo_mapExt (cj.eraseIdx j).length
              (denseRow (cj.eraseIdx j).length
                (sPeel j
                  (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).2)
              (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1 j
              (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hjs) cs0
              (kernelGo fuel (cj.eraseIdx j).length
                (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
                (stepRows prev
                  (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)) j
                  (rows.eraseIdx i)))
              (kernelGo_rowsLen fuel _ _ _)))
        have hCK : (combo (cj.eraseIdx j).length cs0
            (kernelGo fuel (cj.eraseIdx j).length
              (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1
              (stepRows prev
                (sPeel j (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)) j
                (rows.eraseIdx i)))).length
            = (cj.eraseIdx j).length :=
          length_combo _ cs0 _ (kernelGo_rowsLen fuel _ _ _)
        refine poly.oneValue_of_entries _ _ ?_ ?_
        · rw [length_vecScale, hvW, length_insertAt,
            length_vecScale, hCK]
        · intro c hc
          rw [length_vecScale, hvW] at hc
          rw [getAt_vecScale _ _ c (by rw [hvW]; exact hc)]
          by_cases hcj : c = j
          · rw [hcj, getAt_insertAt BPair.unit _ _ j j
                (by rw [length_vecScale, hCK]
                    exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ hjs),
              if_neg (Nat.lt_irrefl j), if_pos rfl]
            refine BPair.oneValue_trans ?_
              (BPair.oneValue_symm (ground.swap_congr
                (BPair.oneValue_trans
                  (dotP_oneValue_right _ _ _
                    (poly.oneValue_symm hc0poly))
                  (BPair.oneValue_trans
                    (dotP_vecScale_right _ (strike j v) c0)
                    (BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl c0)
                      hpiv)))))
            exact BPair.oneValue_of_eq
              ((BPair.mul_assoc
                  (sPeel j
                    (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1 c0
                  (ground.getAt BPair.unit v j)).trans
                (BPair.mul_left_comm
                  (sPeel j
                    (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) rows i)).1 c0
                  (ground.getAt BPair.unit v j)))
          · obtain ⟨d, hd, hlift⟩ := insertIx_lift j
              (cj.eraseIdx j).length c
              (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hjs) hc hcj
            rw [← hlift,
              getAt_insertAt_lift BPair.unit _ _ j d
                (by rw [length_vecScale, hCK]
                    exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ hjs),
              getAt_vecScale _ _ d (by rw [hCK]; exact hd),
              ← getAt_strike v j d]
            refine BPair.oneValue_trans ?_
              (BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl _)
                (BPair.oneValue_symm
                  (BPair.oneValue_trans
                    (poly.oneValue_getAt d
                      (poly.oneValue_symm hc0poly))
                    (BPair.oneValue_of_eq
                      (getAt_vecScale c0 (strike j v) d
                        (by rw [hvs]; exact hd))))))
            exact BPair.oneValue_of_eq
              (BPair.mul_assoc _ _ _)

name: kernelList_span
statement:
theorem kernelList_span (cols : Nat) (m : Mat)
    (hm : rowsLen cols m) (v : List BPair) (hv : v.length = cols)
    (hker : poly.unitTail (matVec m v)) :
    spanRel cols (kernelList cols m) v
proof:
:= by
  have hlr : (List.range cols).length = cols :=
    ground.length_range cols
  have hrows : (m.map ofRow).length = m.length :=
    ground.length_map _ m
  have hfuel : (m.map ofRow).length ≤ m.length := by
    rw [hrows]
    exact Nat.le_refl _
  have hnull : ∀ a, a < (m.map ofRow).length →
      (dotP (denseRow (List.range cols).length
        (ground.getAt ((0, []) : SRow) (m.map ofRow) a)) v).oneValue
        BPair.unit := by
    intro a ha
    rw [hrows] at ha
    rw [hlr]
    exact BPair.oneValue_trans
      (dotP_denseRow_row cols m hm v a ha)
      (matVec_row_null m v hker a ha)
  obtain ⟨c0, cs0, hc0off, hc0len, hc0poly⟩ :=
    kernelGo_span m m.length [] [] (List.range m.length)
      (List.range cols) (BPair.ofPos .one) (m.map ofRow)
      (kinv_init cols m hm) hfuel v (by rw [hlr]; exact hv) hnull
  rw [hlr] at hc0len hc0poly
  exact span_intro cols (kernelList cols m) v
    (kernelList_rowsLen cols m) hv ⟨c0, cs0, hc0off, hc0len,
      hc0poly⟩

name: spanRel_append_comm
statement:
theorem spanRel_append_comm (n : Nat) (L M : Mat) (v : List BPair)
    (hL : rowsLen n L) (hM : rowsLen n M)
    (h : spanRel n (L ++ M) v) : spanRel n (M ++ L) v
proof:
:= by
  refine spanRel_trans n (L ++ M) (M ++ L) v
    (rowsLen_append n hL hM) (rowsLen_append n hM hL) ?_ h
  intro k hk
  rw [ground.getAt_append [] L M k]
  by_cases hkL : k < L.length
  · rw [if_pos hkL]
    exact spanRel_mono_left n M L _ hM hL
      (spanRel_getAt n L k hkL hL)
  · rw [if_neg hkL]
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := Nat.le.dest (Nat.le_of_not_lt hkL)
    have hsub : k - L.length = g := by
      rw [← hg]
      exact ground.addSubSelfL L.length g
    have hgM : g < M.length := by
      have hk' : L.length + g < L.length + M.length := by
        rw [hg]
        have hlen : (L ++ M).length = L.length + M.length :=
          ground.length_append L M
        rw [← hlen]
        exact hk
      exact Nat.lt_of_add_lt_add_left hk'
    rw [hsub]
    exact spanRel_mono n M L _ hM hL
      (spanRel_getAt n M g hgM hM)

name: vecAdd_perp_null
statement:
theorem vecAdd_perp_null (x y : List BPair)
    (hl : y.length = x.length)
    (hs : poly.unitTail (vecAdd x y))
    (hp : (dotP x y).oneValue BPair.unit) :
    poly.unitTail x ∧ poly.unitTail y
proof:
:= by
  have hxs : (dotP x x + dotP x y).oneValue BPair.unit :=
    BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.oneValue_symm (dotP_vecAdd x x y rfl hl))
      (dotP_null_tail_right x (vecAdd x y) hs)
  have hx : (dotP x x).oneValue BPair.unit :=
    BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.oneValue_symm
        (BPair.oneValue_trans
          (BPair.add_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl (dotP x x)) hp)
          (BPair.add_unit _)))
      hxs
  have hyx : (dotP y x).oneValue BPair.unit := by
    rw [dotP_comm y x]
    exact hp
  have hys : (dotP y x + dotP y y).oneValue BPair.unit :=
    BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.oneValue_symm
        (dotP_vecAdd y x y hl.symm rfl))
      (dotP_null_tail_right y (vecAdd x y) hs)
  have hy : (dotP y y).oneValue BPair.unit :=
    BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.oneValue_symm
        (BPair.oneValue_trans
          (BPair.add_congr hyx (BPair.oneValue_refl (dotP y y)))
          (BPair.unit_add _)))
      hys
  exact ⟨dotP_self_null x hx, dotP_self_null y hy⟩

name: span_perp_split
statement:
theorem span_perp_split (n : Nat) (A B : Mat) (v : List BPair)
    (hA : rowsLen n A) (hB : rowsLen n B)
    (hperpv : ∀ k, k < B.length →
      (dotP v (ground.getAt [] B k)).oneValue BPair.unit)
    (hperpA : ∀ j, j < A.length → ∀ k, k < B.length →
      (dotP (ground.getAt [] A j)
        (ground.getAt [] B k)).oneValue BPair.unit)
    (h : spanRel n (A ++ B) v) : spanRel n A v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c₀, cs, hc₀, hcl, hone⟩ := span_elim h
  have hAle : A.length ≤ cs.length := by
    rw [hcl, ground.length_append]
    exact Nat.le_add_right A.length B.length
  obtain ⟨csA, csB, hsplit, hlA⟩ := ground.listSplit cs A.length hAle
  have hcomboA : (combo n csA A).length = n := length_combo n csA A hA
  have hcomboB : (combo n csB B).length = n := length_combo n csB B hB
  have hchain : poly.oneValue (vecScale c₀ v)
      (vecAdd (combo n csA A) (combo n csB B)) := by
    refine poly.oneValue_trans ?_
      (combo_append n csA A csB B hlA hA hB)
    rw [← hsplit]
    exact hone
  have hperpAB : ∀ k, k < B.length → ∀ j, j < A.length →
      (dotP (ground.getAt [] B k)
        (ground.getAt [] A j)).oneValue BPair.unit := by
    intro k hk j hj
    rw [dotP_comm]
    exact hperpA j hj k hk
  have hstep : ∀ k, k < B.length →
      (dotP (ground.getAt [] B k) (combo n csB B)).oneValue
        BPair.unit := by
    intro k hk
    have hy : (ground.getAt ([] : List BPair) B k).length = n :=
      rowsLen_getAt B k hB hk
    have h1 : (dotP (ground.getAt [] B k)
        (vecScale c₀ v)).oneValue BPair.unit := by
      refine BPair.oneValue_trans
        (dotP_vecScale_right (ground.getAt [] B k) v c₀) ?_
      refine oneValue_mul_unit c₀ (dotP (ground.getAt [] B k) v) ?_
      rw [dotP_comm]
      exact hperpv k hk
    have h2 : (dotP (ground.getAt [] B k)
        (vecScale c₀ v)).oneValue
        (dotP (ground.getAt [] B k) (combo n csA A)
          + dotP (ground.getAt [] B k) (combo n csB B)) :=
      BPair.oneValue_trans
        (dotP_oneValue_right (ground.getAt [] B k) (vecScale c₀ v)
          (vecAdd (combo n csA A) (combo n csB B)) hchain)
        (dotP_vecAdd (ground.getAt [] B k) (combo n csA A)
          (combo n csB B) (by rw [hcomboA, hy])
          (by rw [hcomboB, hy]))
    have h3 : (dotP (ground.getAt [] B k)
        (combo n csA A)).oneValue BPair.unit :=
      dotP_comboNull n (ground.getAt [] B k) hy csA A hA
        (fun j hj => hperpAB k hk j hj)
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.oneValue_symm
        (BPair.unit_add (dotP (ground.getAt [] B k)
          (combo n csB B)))) ?_
    exact BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.add_congr (BPair.oneValue_symm h3)
        (BPair.oneValue_refl _))
      (BPair.oneValue_trans (BPair.oneValue_symm h2) h1)
  have hunitB : poly.unitTail (combo n csB B) :=
    dotP_self_null (combo n csB B)
      (dotP_comboNull n (combo n csB B) hcomboB csB B hB
        (fun k hk => by
          rw [dotP_comm]
          exact hstep k hk))
  refine span_intro n A v hA h.2.1 ⟨c₀, csA, hc₀, hlA, ?_⟩
  exact poly.oneValue_trans hchain
    (vecAdd_null_right (combo n csA A) (combo n csB B)
      (by rw [hcomboA, hcomboB]) hunitB)

name: vsumGo_length
statement:
private theorem vsumGo_length (n : Nat) (g : Nat → List BPair) :
    ∀ (l : List Nat) (acc : List BPair), acc.length = n →
      (∀ k, 0 < ground.countOf k l → (g k).length = n) →
      (l.foldl (fun a k => vecAdd a (g k)) acc).length = n
  | [], _, ha, _ => ha
  | k :: t, acc, ha, hg =>
    vsumGo_length n g t (vecAdd acc (g k))
      (length_vecAdd acc (g k) n ha
        (hg k (by rw [ground.countOf_head]; exact Nat.succ_pos _)))
      (fun k' hk' =>
        hg k' (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hk' (Nat.le_add_left _ _)))

/

name: length_vsum
statement:
theorem length_vsum (n : Nat) (g : Nat → List BPair) (l : List Nat)
    (hg : ∀ k, 0 < ground.countOf k l → (g k).length = n) :
    (vsum n g l).length = n
proof:
:=
  vsumGo_length n g l (List.replicate n BPair.unit)
    (ground.length_replicate BPair.unit n) hg

name: lenVsum
proof:
:=
  length_vsum n g l (fun k _ => hg k)

name: foldAcc
statement:
private theorem foldAcc (n : Nat) (g : Nat → List BPair)
    (hg : ∀ k, (g k).length = n) :
    ∀ (l : List Nat) (a b : List BPair), b.length = n →
      (l.foldl (fun c k => vecAdd c (g k)) (vecAdd a b))
        = vecAdd a (l.foldl (fun c k => vecAdd c (g k)) b)
  | [], _, _, _ => rfl
  | k :: t, a, b, hb => by
    show (t.foldl (fun c k' => vecAdd c (g k'))
        (vecAdd (vecAdd a b) (g k)))
      = vecAdd a (t.foldl (fun c k' => vecAdd c (g k'))
        (vecAdd b (g k)))
    rw [vecAdd_assoc a b (g k)]
    exact foldAcc n g hg t a (vecAdd b (g k))
      (length_vecAdd b (g k) n hb (hg k))

/

name: vsum_cons
statement:
theorem vsum_cons (n : Nat) (g : Nat → List BPair)
    (hg : ∀ k, (g k).length = n) (k : Nat) (t : List Nat) :
    poly.oneValue (vsum n g (k :: t)) (vecAdd (g k) (vsum n g t))
proof:
:= by
  show poly.oneValue (t.foldl (fun c k' => vecAdd c (g k'))
      (vecAdd (List.replicate n BPair.unit) (g k)))
    (vecAdd (g k) (vsum n g t))
  rw [vecAdd_comm (List.replicate n BPair.unit) (g k),
    foldAcc n g hg t (g k) (List.replicate n BPair.unit)
      (ground.length_replicate BPair.unit n)]
  exact polyOne_refl _

name: vsum_null
statement:
theorem vsum_null (n : Nat) (g : Nat → List BPair)
    (hg : ∀ k, (g k).length = n) :
    ∀ l : List Nat,
      (∀ k, 0 < ground.countOf k l → poly.unitTail (g k)) →
      poly.unitTail (vsum n g l)
  | [], _ => poly.unitTail_replicate n
  | k :: t, hu =>
    poly.oneValue_unitTail (vsum_cons n g hg k t)
      (unitTail_vecAdd_of
        (hu k (by rw [ground.countOf_head]; exact Nat.succ_pos _))
        (vsum_null n g hg t (fun k' hk' =>
          hu k' (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hk' (Nat.le_add_left _ _)))))

/
at the fold. -/

name: vsum_congr
statement:
theorem vsum_congr (n : Nat) (g g' : Nat → List BPair)
    (hg : ∀ k, (g k).length = n) (hg' : ∀ k, (g' k).length = n)
    (h : ∀ k, poly.oneValue (g k) (g' k)) :
    ∀ l : List Nat, poly.oneValue (vsum n g l) (vsum n g' l)
  | [] => polyOne_refl _
  | k :: t =>
    poly.oneValue_trans (vsum_cons n g hg k t)
      (poly.oneValue_trans
        (polyOne_vecAdd (g k) (g' k) (vsum n g t) (vsum n g' t)
          (h k) (vsum_congr n g g' hg hg' h t)
          ((hg k).trans (hg' k).symm)
          ((lenVsum n g hg t).trans (lenVsum n g' hg' t).symm))
        (poly.oneValue_symm (vsum_cons n g' hg' k t)))

/

name: vsum_vecAdd
statement:
theorem vsum_vecAdd (n : Nat) (g h : Nat → List BPair)
    (hg : ∀ k, (g k).length = n) (hh : ∀ k, (h k).length = n) :
    ∀ l : List Nat,
      poly.oneValue (vsum n (fun k => vecAdd (g k) (h k)) l)
        (vecAdd (vsum n g l) (vsum n h l))
  | [] =>
    poly.unitTail_oneValue (poly.unitTail_replicate n)
      (unitTail_vecAdd_of (poly.unitTail_replicate n)
        (poly.unitTail_replicate n))
  | k :: t => by
    have hgh : ∀ k', (vecAdd (g k') (h k')).length = n
proof:
:=
      fun k' => length_vecAdd (g k') (h k') n (hg k') (hh k')
    refine poly.oneValue_trans
      (vsum_cons n (fun k' => vecAdd (g k') (h k')) hgh k t) ?_
    refine poly.oneValue_trans
      (polyOne_vecAdd _ _ _ _ (polyOne_refl _)
        (vsum_vecAdd n g h hg hh t) rfl
        ((lenVsum n _ hgh t).trans
          (length_vecAdd _ _ n (lenVsum n g hg t)
            (lenVsum n h hh t)).symm)) ?_
    rw [vecAdd_add_comm (g k) (h k) (vsum n g t) (vsum n h t)]
    refine poly.oneValue_symm
      (polyOne_vecAdd _ _ _ _ (vsum_cons n g hg k t)
        (vsum_cons n h hh k t) ?_ ?_)
    · rw [lenVsum n g hg (k :: t),
        length_vecAdd _ _ n (hg k) (lenVsum n g hg t)]
    · rw [lenVsum n h hh (k :: t),
        length_vecAdd _ _ n (hh k) (lenVsum n h hh t)]

name: dotP_foldRow
statement:
theorem dotP_foldRow (n : Nat) (y : List BPair)
    (hy : y.length = n) (g : Nat → List BPair) :
    ∀ (l : List Nat) (a : List BPair), a.length = n →
      (∀ k, 0 < ground.countOf k l → (g k).length = n) →
      (dotP y (l.foldl (fun s k => vecAdd s (g k)) a)).oneValue
        (dotP y a + ground.bsum (fun k => dotP y (g k)) l)
  | [], a, _, _ => BPair.oneValue_symm (BPair.add_unit (dotP y a))
  | k :: t, a, ha, hg => by
    have hgk : (g k).length = n
proof:
:=
      hg k (by rw [ground.countOf_head]; exact Nat.succ_pos _)
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans
      (dotP_foldRow n y hy g t (vecAdd a (g k))
        (length_vecAdd a (g k) n ha hgk)
        (fun k' hk' => hg k'
          (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hk' (Nat.le_add_left _ _)))) ?_
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.add_congr
        (dotP_vecAdd y a (g k) (ha.trans hy.symm) (hgk.trans hy.symm))
        (BPair.oneValue_refl
          (ground.bsum (fun k' => dotP y (g k')) t))) ?_
    show ((dotP y a + dotP y (g k))
        + ground.bsum (fun k' => dotP y (g k')) t).oneValue
      (dotP y a + (dotP y (g k)
        + ground.bsum (fun k' => dotP y (g k')) t))
    rw [BPair.add_assoc]
    exact BPair.oneValue_refl _

name: dotP_vsum
statement:
theorem dotP_vsum (n : Nat) (g : Nat → List BPair)
    (hg : ∀ k, (g k).length = n) (r : List BPair)
    (hr : r.length = n) (l : List Nat) :
    (dotP r (vsum n g l)).oneValue
      (ground.bsum (fun k => dotP r (g k)) l)
proof:
:=
  BPair.oneValue_trans
    (dotP_foldRow n r hr g l (List.replicate n BPair.unit)
      (ground.length_replicate BPair.unit n) (fun k _ => hg k))
    (BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.add_congr (dotP_repl_unit r n)
        (BPair.oneValue_refl
          (ground.bsum (fun k => dotP r (g k)) l)))
      (BPair.unit_add _))

name: matVec_vsum
statement:
theorem matVec_vsum (n : Nat) (T : Mat)
    (g : Nat → List BPair) (hg : ∀ k, (g k).length = n) :
    ∀ l : List Nat,
      poly.oneValue (matVec T (vsum n g l))
        (vsum T.length (fun k => matVec T (g k)) l)
  | [] =>
    poly.unitTail_oneValue
      (matVec_null T _ (poly.unitTail_replicate n))
      (poly.unitTail_replicate T.length)
  | k :: t => by
    have hTg : ∀ k', (matVec T (g k')).length = T.length
proof:
:=
      fun k' => matVec_length T (g k')
    refine poly.oneValue_trans
      (matVec_congr_go T _ _
        ((lenVsum n g hg (k :: t)).trans
          (length_vecAdd _ _ n (hg k) (lenVsum n g hg t)).symm)
        (vsum_cons n g hg k t)) ?_
    refine poly.oneValue_trans
      (matVec_vecAdd_free T (g k) (vsum n g t)
        ((hg k).trans (lenVsum n g hg t).symm)) ?_
    refine poly.oneValue_trans
      (polyOne_vecAdd _ _ _ _ (polyOne_refl _)
        (matVec_vsum n T g hg t) rfl
        ((matVec_length T (vsum n g t)).trans
          (lenVsum T.length _ hTg t).symm)) ?_
    exact poly.oneValue_symm
      (vsum_cons T.length (fun k' => matVec T (g k')) hTg k t)

name: vsum_swap
statement:
theorem vsum_swap (n : Nat) (F : Nat → Nat → List BPair)
    (hF : ∀ a b, (F a b).length = n) (m : List Nat) :
    ∀ l : List Nat,
      poly.oneValue (vsum n (fun a => vsum n (fun b => F a b) m) l)
        (vsum n (fun b => vsum n (fun a => F a b) l) m)
  | [] =>
    poly.unitTail_oneValue (poly.unitTail_replicate n)
      (vsum_null n _ (fun b => lenVsum n (fun a => F a b)
        (fun a => hF a b) []) m
        (fun _ _ => poly.unitTail_replicate n))
  | a :: l => by
    refine poly.oneValue_trans
      (vsum_cons n (fun a' => vsum n (fun b => F a' b) m)
        (fun a' => lenVsum n _ (fun b => hF a' b) m) a l) ?_
    refine poly.oneValue_trans
      (polyOne_vecAdd _ _ _ _ (polyOne_refl _)
        (vsum_swap n F hF m l) rfl
        ((lenVsum n _
            (fun a' => lenVsum n _ (fun b => hF a' b) m) l).trans
          (lenVsum n _
            (fun b => lenVsum n _ (fun a' => hF a' b) l) m).symm)) ?_
    refine poly.oneValue_trans
      (poly.oneValue_symm
        (vsum_vecAdd n (fun b => F a b)
          (fun b => vsum n (fun a' => F a' b) l)
          (fun b => hF a b)
          (fun b => lenVsum n _ (fun a' => hF a' b) l) m)) ?_
    exact vsum_congr n _ _
      (fun b => length_vecAdd _ _ n (hF a b)
        (lenVsum n _ (fun a' => hF a' b) l))
      (fun b => lenVsum n _ (fun a' => hF a' b) (a :: l))
      (fun b => poly.oneValue_symm
        (vsum_cons n (fun a' => F a' b) (fun a' => hF a' b) a l)) m

/

name: vsum_pick
statement:
theorem vsum_pick (n : Nat) (g : Nat → List BPair)
    (hg : ∀ k, (g k).length = n) :
    ∀ (l : List Nat) (i : Nat), ground.countOf i l = 1 →
      poly.oneValue (vsum n (fun k =>
        if i = k then g k else List.replicate n BPair.unit) l)
        (g i)
  | [], _, h => Nat.noConfusion h
  | a :: t, i, h => by
    have hlen : ∀ k, (if i = k then g k
        else List.replicate n BPair.unit).length = n
proof:
:= by
      intro k
      by_cases hik : i = k
      · rw [if_pos hik]
        exact hg k
      · rw [if_neg hik]
        exact ground.length_replicate BPair.unit n
    have hh : (if i = a then 1 else 0) + ground.countOf i t = 1 :=
      (ground.countOf_cons i a t).symm.trans h
    refine poly.oneValue_trans (vsum_cons n _ hlen a t) ?_
    by_cases hia : i = a
    · rw [if_pos hia] at hh
      have h1 : ground.countOf i t = 0 :=
        ground.addCancelL 1 (by rw [Nat.add_zero]; exact hh)
      have htail : poly.unitTail (vsum n (fun k =>
          if i = k then g k else List.replicate n BPair.unit) t) :=
        vsum_null n _ hlen t (fun k hk => by
          rw [if_neg (fun he => by
            rw [he] at h1
            rw [h1] at hk
            exact absurd hk (Nat.lt_irrefl 0))]
          exact poly.unitTail_replicate n)
      rw [if_pos hia, ← hia]
      exact vecAdd_null_right _ _
        ((hg i).trans (lenVsum n _ hlen t).symm) htail
    · rw [if_neg hia] at hh
      rw [Nat.zero_add] at hh
      rw [if_neg hia]
      refine poly.oneValue_trans
        (vecAdd_null_left _ _
          ((ground.length_replicate BPair.unit n).trans
            (lenVsum n _ hlen t).symm)
          (poly.unitTail_replicate n)) ?_
      exact vsum_pick n g hg t i hh

name: vecScale_congr
statement:
theorem vecScale_congr {c d : BPair}
    (hcd : c.oneValue d) : ∀ u : List BPair,
      poly.oneValue (vecScale c u) (vecScale d u)
  | [] => trivial
  | a :: t =>
    ⟨BPair.mul_congr hcd (BPair.oneValue_refl a),
     vecScale_congr hcd t⟩

private theorem subEq {a p q : Nat} (hap : a ≤ p) (haq : a ≤ q)
    (h : p - a = q - a) : p = q
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ground.natAddSubCancel hap, ← ground.natAddSubCancel haq,
    h]

name: subEq
statement:
private theorem subEq {a p q : Nat} (hap : a ≤ p) (haq : a ≤ q)
    (h : p - a = q - a) : p = q
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ground.natAddSubCancel hap, ← ground.natAddSubCancel haq,
    h]

name: perpAll_append
statement:
theorem perpAll_append (A B : Mat) (hA : perpAll A)
    (hB : perpAll B)
    (hAB : ∀ p q, p < A.length → q < B.length →
      (dotP (ground.getAt [] A p)
        (ground.getAt [] B q)).oneValue BPair.unit) :
    perpAll (A ++ B)
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp q hq hpq
  rw [ground.length_append] at hp hq
  rw [ground.getAt_append ([] : List BPair) A B p,
    ground.getAt_append ([] : List BPair) A B q]
  by_cases hpA : p < A.length
  · rw [if_pos hpA]
    by_cases hqA : q < A.length
    · rw [if_pos hqA]
      exact hA p hpA q hqA hpq
    · rw [if_neg hqA]
      exact hAB p (q - A.length) hpA
        (ground.subLt (match Nat.lt_or_ge q A.length with
          | .inl hlt => absurd hlt hqA
          | .inr hge => hge) hq)
  · rw [if_neg hpA]
    have hpge : A.length ≤ p :=
      match Nat.lt_or_ge p A.length with
      | .inl hlt => absurd hlt hpA
      | .inr hge => hge
    by_cases hqA : q < A.length
    · rw [if_pos hqA, dotP_comm]
      exact hAB q (p - A.length) hqA (ground.subLt hpge hp)
    · rw [if_neg hqA]
      have hqge : A.length ≤ q :=
        match Nat.lt_or_ge q A.length with
        | .inl hlt => absurd hlt hqA
        | .inr hge => hge
      exact hB (p - A.length) (ground.subLt hpge hp) (q - A.length)
        (ground.subLt hqge hq)
        (fun he => hpq (subEq hpge hqge he))

name: perpAll_le1
statement: theorem perpAll_le1 (M : Mat) (h : M.length ≤ 1) : perpAll M
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp q hq hpq
  have hp1 : p < 1 := Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hp h
  have hq1 : q < 1 := Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hq h
  match p, hp1 with
  | 0, _ =>
    match q, hq1 with
    | 0, _ => exact absurd rfl hpq
    | q' + 1, hq2 =>
      exact absurd (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hq2)
        (Nat.not_succ_le_zero q')
  | p' + 1, hp2 =>
    exact absurd (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hp2)
      (Nat.not_succ_le_zero p')

name: span_rows_append
statement:
theorem span_rows_append (n : Nat) (A : Mat)
    (v : List BPair) (B : Mat)
    (hA : ∀ p, p < A.length → spanRel n B (ground.getAt [] A p))
    (hv : spanRel n B v) :
    ∀ p, p < (A ++ [v]).length →
      spanRel n B (ground.getAt [] (A ++ [v]) p)
proof:
:=
  rows_append_gen A v hA hv

name: mulRot
statement: private theorem mulRot (a b c : BPair) : a * b * c = c * b * a
proof:
:= by
  rw [BPair.mul_assoc a b c, BPair.mul_comm b c,
    BPair.mul_comm a (c * b)]

name: sgnP_double
statement:
private theorem sgnP_double (k : Nat) (x : BPair) :
    sgnP (k + k) x = x
proof: := sgnPO_even bpairOps k x

name: selfProd_snoc
statement:
private theorem selfProd_snoc : ∀ (L : Mat) (y : List BPair),
    (selfProd (L ++ [y])).oneValue (selfProd L * dotP y y)
  | [], y => by
    show ((dotP y y * BPair.ofPos .one).norm).oneValue
      (BPair.ofPos .one * dotP y y)
    rw [BPair.mul_comm (dotP y y) (BPair.ofPos .one)]
    exact BPair.norm_oneValue _
  | r :: t, y => by
    show ((dotP r r * selfProd (t ++ [y])).norm).oneValue
      ((dotP r r * selfProd t).norm * dotP y y)
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans (BPair.norm_oneValue _) ?_
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl (dotP r r))
        (selfProd_snoc t y)) ?_
    rw [← BPair.mul_assoc (dotP r r) (selfProd t) (dotP y y)]
    exact BPair.mul_congr_left
      (BPair.oneValue_symm (BPair.norm_oneValue _))

/
the recursion is `selfProd`'s own, a row's self-pairing against the
rows below it. -/
private theorem residGo_snd : ∀ (L : Mat) (v : List BPair),
    (residGo L v).2 = selfProd L
  | [], _ => rfl
  | r :: t, v => by
    show (dotP r r * (residGo t v).2).norm
      = (dotP r r * selfProd t).norm
    rw [residGo_snd t v]

/
private theorem length_residGo (n : Nat) (v : List BPair)
    (hv : v.length = n) :
    ∀ L : Mat, rowsLen n L → (residGo L v).1.length = n
  | [], _ => by
    show (vecScale BPair.unit v).length = n
    rw [length_vecScale]
    exact hv
  | r :: t, hLn => by
    show (vecAdd (vecScale ((dotP r v * (residGo t v).2).norm) r)
      (vecScale (dotP r r) (residGo t v).1)).length = n
    refine length_vecAdd _ _ n ?_ ?_
    · rw [length_vecScale]
      exact hLn.1
    · rw [length_vecScale]
      exact length_residGo n v hv t hLn.2

/

name: length_residD
statement:
theorem length_residD (n : Nat) (L : Mat) (v : List BPair)
    (hLn : rowsLen n L) (hv : v.length = n) :
    (residD L v).length = n
proof:
