name: perpAll_tail
statement:
theorem perpAll_tail (r : List BPair) (t : Mat)
    (h : perpAll (r :: t)) : perpAll t
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp q hq hpq
  exact h (p + 1) (Nat.succ_lt_succ hp) (q + 1) (Nat.succ_lt_succ hq)
    (fun he => hpq (Nat.succ.inj he))

name: dotP_residGo_null
statement:
private theorem dotP_residGo_null (n : Nat) (v D : List BPair)
    (hv : v.length = n) (hD : D.length = n) :
    ∀ L : Mat, rowsLen n L →
      (∀ k, k < L.length →
        (dotP D (ground.getAt [] L k)).oneValue BPair.unit) →
      (dotP D (residGo L v).1).oneValue BPair.unit
  | [], _, _ => by
    show (dotP D (vecScale BPair.unit v)).oneValue BPair.unit
    exact dotP_null_tail_right D _
      (unitTail_vecScale_unit (BPair.oneValue_refl BPair.unit) v)
  | r :: t, hLn, hrow => by
    show (dotP D (vecAdd
      (vecScale ((dotP r v * (residGo t v).2).norm) r)
      (vecScale (dotP r r) (residGo t v).1))).oneValue BPair.unit
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans
      (dotP_vecAdd D _ _
        (by rw [length_vecScale, hLn.1, hD])
        (by rw [length_vecScale, length_residGo n v hv t hLn.2,
          hD])) ?_
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans (BPair.add_congr ?_ ?_)
      (BPair.unit_add BPair.unit)
    · refine BPair.oneValue_trans (dotP_vecScale_right D r _) ?_
      exact oneValue_mul_unit _ _ (hrow 0 (Nat.succ_pos _))
    · refine BPair.oneValue_trans (dotP_vecScale_right D _ _) ?_
      exact oneValue_mul_unit _ _
        (dotP_residGo_null n v D hv hD t hLn.2
          (fun k hk => hrow (k + 1) (Nat.succ_lt_succ hk)))

/
product against that row's own pairing with the vector: its own
term carries the product with its factor restored, and the further
rows drop at the perpendicularity. -/
private theorem dotP_residGo_row (n : Nat) (v : List BPair)
    (hv : v.length = n) :
    ∀ L : Mat, rowsLen n L → perpAll L → ∀ i, i < L.length →
      (dotP (ground.getAt [] L i) (residGo L v).1).oneValue
        (selfProd L * dotP (ground.getAt [] L i) v)
  | [], _, _, _, hi => absurd hi (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | r :: t, hLn, hperp, 0, _ => by
    have ht : (dotP r (residGo t v).1).oneValue BPair.unit
proof:
:=
      dotP_residGo_null n v r hv hLn.1 t hLn.2
        (fun k hk => hperp 0 (Nat.succ_pos _) (k + 1)
          (Nat.succ_lt_succ hk) (fun he => nomatch he))
    show (dotP r (vecAdd
      (vecScale ((dotP r v * (residGo t v).2).norm) r)
      (vecScale (dotP r r) (residGo t v).1))).oneValue
      ((dotP r r * selfProd t).norm * dotP r v)
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans
      (dotP_vecAdd r _ _
        (by rw [length_vecScale])
        (by rw [length_vecScale, length_residGo n v hv t hLn.2]
            exact hLn.1.symm)) ?_
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.add_congr (dotP_vecScale_right r r _)
        (BPair.oneValue_trans (dotP_vecScale_right r _ _)
          (oneValue_mul_unit _ _ ht))) ?_
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans (BPair.add_unit _) ?_
    rw [residGo_snd t v]
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.mul_congr_left (BPair.norm_oneValue _)) ?_
    rw [mulRot (dotP r v) (selfProd t) (dotP r r)]
    exact BPair.oneValue_symm
      (BPair.mul_congr_left (BPair.norm_oneValue _))
  | r :: t, hLn, hperp, i + 1, hi => by
    have hit : i < t.length := Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hi
    have hti : (ground.getAt ([] : List BPair) t i).length = n :=
      rowsLen_getAt t i hLn.2 hit
    have hri : (dotP (ground.getAt [] t i) r).oneValue BPair.unit :=
      hperp (i + 1) hi 0 (Nat.succ_pos _) (fun he => nomatch he)
    have hih := dotP_residGo_row n v hv t hLn.2
      (perpAll_tail r t hperp) i hit
    show (dotP (ground.getAt [] t i) (vecAdd
      (vecScale ((dotP r v * (residGo t v).2).norm) r)
      (vecScale (dotP r r) (residGo t v).1))).oneValue
      ((dotP r r * selfProd t).norm * dotP (ground.getAt [] t i) v)
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans
      (dotP_vecAdd (ground.getAt [] t i) _ _
        (by rw [length_vecScale, hLn.1, hti])
        (by rw [length_vecScale, length_residGo n v hv t hLn.2,
          hti])) ?_
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.add_congr
        (BPair.oneValue_trans (dotP_vecScale_right _ r _)
          (oneValue_mul_unit _ _ hri))
        (BPair.oneValue_trans (dotP_vecScale_right _ _ _)
          (BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl (dotP r r)) hih))) ?_
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans (BPair.unit_add _) ?_
    rw [← BPair.mul_assoc (dotP r r) (selfProd t)
      (dotP (ground.getAt [] t i) v)]
    exact BPair.oneValue_symm
      (BPair.mul_congr_left (BPair.norm_oneValue _))

name: dotP_residGo_row
statement:
private theorem dotP_residGo_row (n : Nat) (v : List BPair)
    (hv : v.length = n) :
    ∀ L : Mat, rowsLen n L → perpAll L → ∀ i, i < L.length →
      (dotP (ground.getAt [] L i) (residGo L v).1).oneValue
        (selfProd L * dotP (ground.getAt [] L i) v)
  | [], _, _, _, hi => absurd hi (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | r :: t, hLn, hperp, 0, _ => by
    have ht : (dotP r (residGo t v).1).oneValue BPair.unit
proof:
:=
      dotP_residGo_null n v r hv hLn.1 t hLn.2
        (fun k hk => hperp 0 (Nat.succ_pos _) (k + 1)
          (Nat.succ_lt_succ hk) (fun he => nomatch he))
    show (dotP r (vecAdd
      (vecScale ((dotP r v * (residGo t v).2).norm) r)
      (vecScale (dotP r r) (residGo t v).1))).oneValue
      ((dotP r r * selfProd t).norm * dotP r v)
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans
      (dotP_vecAdd r _ _
        (by rw [length_vecScale])
        (by rw [length_vecScale, length_residGo n v hv t hLn.2]
            exact hLn.1.symm)) ?_
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.add_congr (dotP_vecScale_right r r _)
        (BPair.oneValue_trans (dotP_vecScale_right r _ _)
          (oneValue_mul_unit _ _ ht))) ?_
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans (BPair.add_unit _) ?_
    rw [residGo_snd t v]
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.mul_congr_left (BPair.norm_oneValue _)) ?_
    rw [mulRot (dotP r v) (selfProd t) (dotP r r)]
    exact BPair.oneValue_symm
      (BPair.mul_congr_left (BPair.norm_oneValue _))
  | r :: t, hLn, hperp, i + 1, hi => by
    have hit : i < t.length := Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hi
    have hti : (ground.getAt ([] : List BPair) t i).length = n :=
      rowsLen_getAt t i hLn.2 hit
    have hri : (dotP (ground.getAt [] t i) r).oneValue BPair.unit :=
      hperp (i + 1) hi 0 (Nat.succ_pos _) (fun he => nomatch he)
    have hih := dotP_residGo_row n v hv t hLn.2
      (perpAll_tail r t hperp) i hit
    show (dotP (ground.getAt [] t i) (vecAdd
      (vecScale ((dotP r v * (residGo t v).2).norm) r)
      (vecScale (dotP r r) (residGo t v).1))).oneValue
      ((dotP r r * selfProd t).norm * dotP (ground.getAt [] t i) v)
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans
      (dotP_vecAdd (ground.getAt [] t i) _ _
        (by rw [length_vecScale, hLn.1, hti])
        (by rw [length_vecScale, length_residGo n v hv t hLn.2,
          hti])) ?_
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.add_congr
        (BPair.oneValue_trans (dotP_vecScale_right _ r _)
          (oneValue_mul_unit _ _ hri))
        (BPair.oneValue_trans (dotP_vecScale_right _ _ _)
          (BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl (dotP r r)) hih))) ?_
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans (BPair.unit_add _) ?_
    rw [← BPair.mul_assoc (dotP r r) (selfProd t)
      (dotP (ground.getAt [] t i) v)]
    exact BPair.oneValue_symm
      (BPair.mul_congr_left (BPair.norm_oneValue _))

name: perpAll_dropLast
statement:
private theorem perpAll_dropLast (L : Mat) (v : List BPair)
    (h : perpAll (L ++ [v])) : perpAll L
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp q hq hpq
  have hp' : p < (L ++ [v]).length := by
    rw [ground.length_append]
    exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hp (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
  have hq' : q < (L ++ [v]).length := by
    rw [ground.length_append]
    exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hq (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
  have hpq' := h p hp' q hq' hpq
  rw [ground.getAt_append ([] : List BPair) L [v] p, if_pos hp,
    ground.getAt_append ([] : List BPair) L [v] q, if_pos hq] at hpq'
  exact hpq'

name: dotP_map_range
statement:
theorem dotP_map_range (g : Nat → BPair) (n : Nat)
    (x : List BPair) (h : x.length = n) :
    dotP x ((List.range n).map g)
      = ground.famFold BPair.add BPair.unit
        (fun j => (ground.getAt BPair.unit x j) * g j) (List.range n)
proof:
:=
  dotO_map_range bpairOps g n x h

name: detO_comboRow
statement:
private theorem detO_comboRow {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
    (M N : List (List γ)) (k : Nat) (hk : k < N.length)
    (hM : rowsLen N.length M) (hMl : M.length = N.length)
    (y : List γ) (hy : y.length = N.length)
    (hoff : ∀ t, t < N.length → ¬ t = k →
      R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit y t) ops.unit
        ∨ ground.getAt [] M t = ground.getAt [] N t)
    (hself : ground.getAt [] M k = ground.getAt [] N k) :
    R.rel (detO ops (List.set N k (comboO ops N.length y M)))
      (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit y k) (detO ops N))
proof:
:= by
  refine L.ovTrans (detO_List.set_combo L N k hk y M hM) ?_
  show R.rel (dotO ops y (M.map (fun row => detO ops (List.set N k row)))) _
  have hMr : M = (List.range N.length).map (ground.getAt [] M) :=
    (ground.range_map_getAt [] N.length M hMl).symm
  have hmap : M.map (fun row => detO ops (List.set N k row))
      = (List.range N.length).map
          (fun t => detO ops (List.set N k (ground.getAt [] M t))) := by
    conv => lhs; rw [hMr]
    exact ground.map_map _ _ _
  rw [hmap, dotO_map_range ops _ N.length y hy]
  refine ground.famFold_pick_ov (foldLawsOf L) _ k _ (List.range N.length)
    (ground.countOf_range_one hk) ?_ ?_
  · rw [hself, ground.set_self [] N k hk]
    exact L.ovRefl _
  · intro t ht htk
    have htn : t < N.length := ground.ltOfMem ht
    match hoff t htn htk with
    | .inl hyt =>
      exact L.ovTrans (L.mulCongr hyt (L.ovRefl _)) (mulUnitLeftO L _)
    | .inr hMt =>
      rw [hMt]
      refine L.ovTrans (L.mulCongr (L.ovRefl _) ?_) (L.mulUnit _)
      have hlen : (List.set N k (ground.getAt [] N t)).length = N.length :=
        ground.length_set _ N k
      cases Nat.lt_or_ge t k with
      | inl hlt =>
        exact detO_rows_equal L hlt (by rw [hlen]; exact hk)
          (by rw [ground.getAt_set_ne [] N k t _ htk,
            ground.getAt_set_self [] _ N k hk])
      | inr hge =>
        have hkt : k < t := by
          match Nat.lt_or_ge k t with
          | .inl h => exact h
          | .inr h =>
            exact absurd (Nat.le_antisymm hge h) (fun he => htk he.symm)
        exact detO_rows_equal L hkt (by rw [hlen]; exact htn)
          (by rw [ground.getAt_set_self [] _ N k hk,
            ground.getAt_set_ne [] N k t _ htk])

name: getAt_vecScaleO_ov
statement:
private theorem getAt_vecScaleO_ov {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel) (c : γ)
    (r : List γ) (j : Nat) :
    R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit (vecScaleO ops c r) j)
      (ops.mul c (ground.getAt ops.unit r j))
proof:
:= by
  cases Nat.lt_or_ge j r.length with
  | inl hlt => exact ovOfEq L.toDCore (getAt_vecScaleO ops c r j hlt)
  | inr hge =>
    rw [ground.getAt_over ops.unit (vecScaleO ops c r) j
        (by rw [length_vecScaleO ops c r]; exact hge),
      ground.getAt_over ops.unit r j hge]
    exact L.ovSymm (L.mulUnit c)

name: map_eraseIdx_vecScaleO
statement:
private theorem map_eraseIdx_vecScaleO {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ)
    (c : γ) (j : Nat) :
    ∀ rest : List (List γ),
      (rest.map (vecScaleO ops c)).map (fun r => r.eraseIdx j)
        = (rest.map (fun r => r.eraseIdx j)).map (vecScaleO ops c)
  | [] => rfl
  | r :: rest => by
    show (vecScaleO ops c r).eraseIdx j
        :: (rest.map (vecScaleO ops c)).map (fun r => r.eraseIdx j)
      = vecScaleO ops c (r.eraseIdx j)
        :: (rest.map (fun r => r.eraseIdx j)).map (vecScaleO ops c)
    rw [map_eraseIdx_vecScaleO ops c j rest]
    show (r.map (fun x => ops.mul c x)).eraseIdx j :: _
      = (r.eraseIdx j).map (fun x => ops.mul c x) :: _
    rw [eraseIdx_map (fun x => ops.mul c x) r j]

/
at the row count: the head-row expansion's entries and struck
cofactors each carry the scale. -/
private theorem detO_scaleAll {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel) (c : γ) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (M : List (List γ)), M.length = n →
      R.rel (detO ops (M.map (vecScaleO ops c)))
        (ops.mul (poly.powO ops c n) (detO ops M))
  | 0, [], _ => L.ovSymm (L.oneMul (detO ops []))
  | 0, _ :: _, h => Nat.noConfusion h
  | _ + 1, [], h => Nat.noConfusion h
  | n + 1, r :: rest, h => by
    have hn : rest.length = n
proof:
:= Nat.succ.inj h
    show R.rel (detO ops
      (vecScaleO ops c r :: rest.map (vecScaleO ops c))) _
    refine L.ovTrans (detO_cons L _ _) ?_
    refine L.ovTrans ?_
      (L.mulCongr (L.ovRefl _) (L.ovSymm (detO_cons L r rest)))
    rw [ground.length_map]
    refine L.ovTrans ?_
      (foldO_mul_left L (poly.powO ops c (n + 1))
        (fun j => sgnPO ops j
          (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit r j) (cof0O ops rest j)))
        (List.range (rest.length + 1)))
    refine foldO_congr_members L.toDCore _ _
      (List.range (rest.length + 1)) ?_
    intro j hj
    have hjle : j ≤ rest.length := Nat.le_of_lt_succ (ground.ltOfMem hj)
    have hstrike : R.rel (cof0O ops (rest.map (vecScaleO ops c)) j)
        (ops.mul (poly.powO ops c n) (cof0O ops rest j)) := by
      refine L.ovTrans
        (cof0O_strike L.toDCore _ j
          (by rw [ground.length_map]; exact hjle)) ?_
      rw [map_eraseIdx_vecScaleO ops c j rest]
      refine L.ovTrans
        (detO_scaleAll L c n _ (by rw [ground.length_map]; exact hn)) ?_
      exact L.mulCongr (L.ovRefl _)
        (L.ovSymm (cof0O_strike L.toDCore rest j hjle))
    refine L.ovTrans
      (sgnPO_congr L.toDCore
        (L.mulCongr (getAt_vecScaleO_ov L c r j) hstrike)) ?_
    refine L.ovTrans
      (sgnPO_congr L.toDCore
        (mulShuffleO L.toDCore c (ground.getAt ops.unit r j)
          (poly.powO ops c n) (cof0O ops rest j))) ?_
    exact sgnPO_mul L.toDCore j _ _

name: detO_scaleAll
statement:
private theorem detO_scaleAll {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel) (c : γ) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (M : List (List γ)), M.length = n →
      R.rel (detO ops (M.map (vecScaleO ops c)))
        (ops.mul (poly.powO ops c n) (detO ops M))
  | 0, [], _ => L.ovSymm (L.oneMul (detO ops []))
  | 0, _ :: _, h => Nat.noConfusion h
  | _ + 1, [], h => Nat.noConfusion h
  | n + 1, r :: rest, h => by
    have hn : rest.length = n
proof:
:= Nat.succ.inj h
    show R.rel (detO ops
      (vecScaleO ops c r :: rest.map (vecScaleO ops c))) _
    refine L.ovTrans (detO_cons L _ _) ?_
    refine L.ovTrans ?_
      (L.mulCongr (L.ovRefl _) (L.ovSymm (detO_cons L r rest)))
    rw [ground.length_map]
    refine L.ovTrans ?_
      (foldO_mul_left L (poly.powO ops c (n + 1))
        (fun j => sgnPO ops j
          (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit r j) (cof0O ops rest j)))
        (List.range (rest.length + 1)))
    refine foldO_congr_members L.toDCore _ _
      (List.range (rest.length + 1)) ?_
    intro j hj
    have hjle : j ≤ rest.length := Nat.le_of_lt_succ (ground.ltOfMem hj)
    have hstrike : R.rel (cof0O ops (rest.map (vecScaleO ops c)) j)
        (ops.mul (poly.powO ops c n) (cof0O ops rest j)) := by
      refine L.ovTrans
        (cof0O_strike L.toDCore _ j
          (by rw [ground.length_map]; exact hjle)) ?_
      rw [map_eraseIdx_vecScaleO ops c j rest]
      refine L.ovTrans
        (detO_scaleAll L c n _ (by rw [ground.length_map]; exact hn)) ?_
      exact L.mulCongr (L.ovRefl _)
        (L.ovSymm (cof0O_strike L.toDCore rest j hjle))
    refine L.ovTrans
      (sgnPO_congr L.toDCore
        (L.mulCongr (getAt_vecScaleO_ov L c r j) hstrike)) ?_
    refine L.ovTrans
      (sgnPO_congr L.toDCore
        (mulShuffleO L.toDCore c (ground.getAt ops.unit r j)
          (poly.powO ops c n) (cof0O ops rest j))) ?_
    exact sgnPO_mul L.toDCore j _ _

name: detL_scaleAll
statement:
theorem detL_scaleAll (c : BPair) : ∀ (n : Nat) (M : Mat), M.length = n →

proof:
:=
  fun n M h =>
    BPair.oneValue_trans
      (detO_scaleAll (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairLaws c n M h)
      (BPair.mul_congr (powO_bpow c n) (BPair.oneValue_refl (detL M)))

name: dotP_scaleL

:= by

name: dotP_replL

name: dotP_addE
statement:
theorem dotP_addE : ∀ (u w x : List BPair),
    u.length = w.length →
    (dotP (vecAdd u w) x).oneValue
      (dotP u x + dotP w x)
  | u, w, [], _ => by
    rw [dotP_nil_right (vecAdd u w), dotP_nil_right u,
      dotP_nil_right w]
    exact BPair.oneValue_symm (BPair.add_unit BPair.unit)
  | [], [], _ :: _, _ =>
    BPair.oneValue_symm (BPair.add_unit BPair.unit)
  | [], _ :: _, _ :: _, hl => Nat.noConfusion hl
  | _ :: _, [], _ :: _, hl => Nat.noConfusion hl
  | a :: u, b :: w, c :: x, hl => by
    show ((a + b) * c + dotP (vecAdd u w) x).oneValue
      (a * c + dotP u x + (b * c + dotP w x))
    rw [BPair.right_distrib,
      ← BPair.add_add_comm (a * c) (b * c) (dotP u x)
        (dotP w x)]
    exact BPair.add_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl _)
      (dotP_addE u w x (Nat.succ.inj hl))

name: dotP_rowRange
statement:
theorem dotP_rowRange (g : Nat → BPair) (n : Nat)
    (y : List BPair) (h : y.length = n) :
    (dotP ((List.range n).map g) y).oneValue
      (ground.famFold BPair.add BPair.unit
        (fun k => g k * ground.getAt BPair.unit y k)
        (List.range n))
proof:
:=
  BPair.oneValue_of_eq (by
    rw [dotP_fold n _ y
      (ground.length_mapRange _ n) h]
    refine ground.famFold_congr_members BPair.add BPair.unit _ _ _
      (fun i hi => ?_)
    rw [ground.getAt_map 0 BPair.unit g (List.range n) i
        (by rw [ground.length_range]; exact ground.ltOfMem hi),
      ground.getAt_range n i (ground.ltOfMem hi)])

name: dotP_zipSum
statement:
theorem dotP_zipSum (n : Nat) (x : List BPair)
    (hx : x.length = n) : ∀ (f : List Nat)
      (rows : List (List BPair)),
    (dotP ((List.range n).map (fun j =>
        BPair.sum (List.zipWith (fun c row =>
          BPair.ofNat c * getAt BPair.unit row j)
          f rows))) x).oneValue
      (BPair.sum (List.zipWith (fun c row =>
        BPair.ofNat c * dotP row x) f rows))
  | [], _ => by
    show (dotP ((List.range n).map
        (fun _ => BPair.unit)) x).oneValue BPair.unit
    rw [ground.map_const BPair.unit (List.range n)]
    exact dotP_replL (List.range n).length x
  | _ :: _, [] => by
    show (dotP ((List.range n).map
        (fun _ => BPair.unit)) x).oneValue BPair.unit
    rw [ground.map_const BPair.unit (List.range n)]
    exact dotP_replL (List.range n).length x
  | c :: f, row :: rows => by
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans
      (dotP_congr_left _ ((List.range n).map (fun j =>
          BPair.ofNat c * getAt BPair.unit row j
            + BPair.sum (List.zipWith (fun c' row' =>
                BPair.ofNat c' * getAt BPair.unit row' j)
                f rows)))
        x (fun j hj => ?_)) ?_
    · rw [ground.getAt_map 0 BPair.unit _ (List.range n) j
          (by rw [ground.length_range, ← hx]; exact hj),
        ground.getAt_map 0 BPair.unit _ (List.range n) j
          (by rw [ground.length_range, ← hx]; exact hj)]
      exact BPair.sum_cons _ _
    · rw [← mapAdd]
      refine BPair.oneValue_trans
        (dotP_addE _ _ x (by
          rw [ground.length_map, ground.length_map])) ?_
      refine BPair.oneValue_trans (BPair.add_congr ?_
        (dotP_zipSum n x hx f rows))
        (BPair.oneValue_symm (BPair.sum_cons _ _))
      rw [show (List.range n).map (fun j =>
            BPair.ofNat c * getAt BPair.unit row j)
          = ((List.range n).map (getAt BPair.unit row)).map
              (fun z => BPair.ofNat c * z) from
          (ground.map_map (getAt BPair.unit row)
            (fun z => BPair.ofNat c * z) (List.range n)).symm]
      refine BPair.oneValue_trans
        (dotP_scaleL (BPair.ofNat c)
          ((List.range n).map (getAt BPair.unit row)) x) ?_
      refine BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl _) ?_
      refine dotP_congr_left _ row x (fun j hj => ?_)
      rw [ground.getAt_map 0 BPair.unit (getAt BPair.unit row)
          (List.range n) j
          (by rw [ground.length_range, ← hx]; exact hj)]
      rw [ground.getAt_range n j (by rw [← hx]; exact hj)]
      exact BPair.oneValue_refl _

private theorem detL_perp_go : ∀ (fuel : Nat) (L : Mat),
    L.length ≤ fuel → perpAll L →
    (detL (gramM L)).oneValue (selfProd L)
  | _, [], _, _ => by decide +kernel
  | 0, _ :: _, hf, _ => nomatch hf
  | fuel + 1, r :: L, hf, hperp => by
    match splitLast (r :: L) with
    | Or.inl he => exact nomatch he
    | Or.inr ⟨L', v, he⟩ =>
      rw [he] at hperp ⊢
      have hf' : L'.length ≤ fuel
proof:
:= by
        have h1 : (L' ++ [v]).length ≤ fuel + 1 := by
          rw [← he]
          exact hf
        rw [ground.length_append] at h1
        exact Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ h1
      have ih := detL_perp_go fuel L' hf'
        (perpAll_dropLast L' v hperp)
      have hlen : (L' ++ [v]).length = L'.length + 1 := by
        rw [ground.length_append]
        rfl
      have hGl : (gramM (L' ++ [v])).length = L'.length + 1 := by
        rw [length_gramM]
        exact hlen
      have hk : L'.length < (gramM (L' ++ [v])).length := by
        rw [hGl]
        exact Nat.lt_succ_self _
      have hkA : L'.length < (L' ++ [v]).length := by
        rw [hlen]
        exact Nat.lt_succ_self _
      have hrow : (ground.getAt []
          (gramM (L' ++ [v])) L'.length).length
          = (gramM (L' ++ [v])).length := by
        rw [sqAt_row_len (gram_sqAt (L' ++ [v])) L'.length hk,
          length_gramM]
      have hvrow : ground.getAt ([] : List BPair)
          (L' ++ [v]) L'.length = v := by
        rw [ground.getAt_append ([] : List BPair) L' [v] L'.length,
          if_neg (Nat.lt_irrefl _), Nat.sub_self]
        rfl
      have hentry : ∀ j, j < (gramM (L' ++ [v])).length →
          ground.getAt BPair.unit
            (ground.getAt [] (gramM (L' ++ [v])) L'.length) j
          = dotP v (ground.getAt [] (L' ++ [v]) j) := by
        intro j hj
        rw [length_gramM] at hj
        rw [gramM_entry (L' ++ [v]) L'.length j hkA hj, hvrow]
      refine BPair.oneValue_trans
        (BPair.oneValue_symm
          (cofVec_diag (gramM (L' ++ [v])) L'.length hk hrow)) ?_
      rw [show cofVec (gramM (L' ++ [v])) L'.length
          = (List.range (gramM (L' ++ [v])).length).map (fun j =>
            sgnP (L'.length + j)
              (cof0 ((gramM (L' ++ [v])).eraseIdx L'.length) j))
        from rfl,
        dotP_map_range _ (gramM (L' ++ [v])).length
          (ground.getAt [] (gramM (L' ++ [v])) L'.length) hrow]
      refine BPair.oneValue_trans
        (foldB_congr_members _
          (fun j => if L'.length = j then
              ground.getAt BPair.unit
                (ground.getAt [] (gramM (L' ++ [v])) L'.length) j
                * sgnP (L'.length + j)
                  (cof0 ((gramM (L' ++ [v])).eraseIdx L'.length) j)
            else BPair.unit)
          (List.range (gramM (L' ++ [v])).length) (fun j hj => ?_)) ?_
      · by_cases hij : L'.length = j
        · rw [if_pos hij]
          exact BPair.oneValue_refl _
        · rw [if_neg hij]
          refine oneValue_unit_mul ?_
          have hpq := hperp L'.length hkA j
            (by rw [← length_gramM]; exact ground.ltOfMem hj)
            hij
          rw [hvrow] at hpq
          rw [hentry j (ground.ltOfMem hj)]
          exact hpq
      refine BPair.oneValue_trans
        (bsum_pick (fun j =>
          ground.getAt BPair.unit
            (ground.getAt [] (gramM (L' ++ [v])) L'.length) j
            * sgnP (L'.length + j)
              (cof0 ((gramM (L' ++ [v])).eraseIdx L'.length) j))
          (List.range (gramM (L' ++ [v])).length) L'.length
          (by rw [ground.countOf_range_one hk])) ?_
      rw [hentry L'.length hk, hvrow, sgnP_double L'.length,
        cof_last_bridge L' v]
      refine BPair.oneValue_trans
        (BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl (dotP v v)) ih) ?_
      rw [BPair.mul_comm (dotP v v) (selfProd L')]
      exact BPair.oneValue_symm (selfProd_snoc L' v)
