name: detL_perp
statement:
theorem detL_perp (L : Mat) (hperp : perpAll L) :
    (detL (gramM L)).oneValue (selfProd L)
proof:
:=
  detL_perp_go L.length L (Nat.le_refl _) hperp

name: residD_perp
statement:
theorem residD_perp (n : Nat) (L : Mat) (v : List BPair)
    (hLn : rowsLen n L) (hv : v.length = n) (hperp : perpAll L)
    (i : Nat) (hi : i < L.length) :
    (dotP (ground.getAt [] L i) (residD L v)).oneValue BPair.unit
proof:
:= by
  have hy : (ground.getAt ([] : List BPair) L i).length = n :=
    rowsLen_getAt L i hLn hi
  show (dotP (ground.getAt [] L i)
    (vecAdd (vecScale (residGo L v).2 v)
      ((residGo L v).1.map BPair.swap))).oneValue BPair.unit
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans
    (dotP_vecAdd (ground.getAt [] L i) _ _
      (by rw [length_vecScale, hv, hy])
      (by rw [ground.length_map, length_residGo n v hv L hLn, hy])) ?_
  rw [dotP_swapMap]
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans
    (BPair.add_congr
      (dotP_vecScale_right (ground.getAt [] L i) v (residGo L v).2)
      (swap_congr (dotP_residGo_row n v hv L hLn hperp i hi))) ?_
  rw [residGo_snd L v, BPair.add_comm]
  exact BPair.swap_add_null (BPair.oneValue_refl _)

name: gap_self_null
statement:
private theorem gap_self_null (n : Nat) (L : Mat) (v : List BPair)
    (D : List BPair) (hLn : rowsLen n L) (hv : v.length = n)
    (hDl : D.length = n) (hperp : perpAll L)
    (hrow : ∀ k, k < L.length →
      (dotP D (ground.getAt [] L k)).oneValue BPair.unit) :
    (dotP D (vecAdd (residV n L v)
      ((residD L v).map BPair.swap))).oneValue BPair.unit
proof:
:= by
  have hVl : (residV n L v).length = n := length_residV n L v hLn hv
  have hDDl : (residD L v).length = n := length_residD n L v hLn hv
  have hV : (dotP D (residV n L v)).oneValue
      (detL (gramM L) * dotP D v) := by
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans
      (dotP_vecAdd D (vecScale (detL (gramM L)) v)
        ((combo n (adjP (gramM L) (L.map (fun r => dotP r v))) L).map
          BPair.swap)
        (by rw [length_vecScale, hv, hDl])
        (by rw [ground.length_map, length_combo n _ L hLn, hDl])) ?_
    rw [dotP_swapMap]
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.add_congr (dotP_vecScale_right D v (detL (gramM L)))
        (swap_congr
          (dotP_comboNull n D hDl _ L hLn hrow))) ?_
    exact BPair.add_unit _
  have hD : (dotP D (residD L v)).oneValue
      (detL (gramM L) * dotP D v) := by
    show (dotP D (vecAdd (vecScale (residGo L v).2 v)
      ((residGo L v).1.map BPair.swap))).oneValue
      (detL (gramM L) * dotP D v)
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans
      (dotP_vecAdd D _ _
        (by rw [length_vecScale, hv, hDl])
        (by rw [ground.length_map, length_residGo n v hv L hLn,
          hDl])) ?_
    rw [dotP_swapMap]
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.add_congr (dotP_vecScale_right D v (residGo L v).2)
        (swap_congr
          (dotP_residGo_null n v D hv hDl L hLn hrow))) ?_
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans (BPair.add_unit _) ?_
    rw [residGo_snd L v]
    exact BPair.mul_congr_left
      (BPair.oneValue_symm (detL_perp L hperp))
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans
    (dotP_vecAdd D (residV n L v) ((residD L v).map BPair.swap)
      (by rw [hVl, hDl])
      (by rw [ground.length_map, hDDl, hDl])) ?_
  rw [dotP_swapMap]
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans
    (BPair.add_congr hV (swap_congr hD)) ?_
  rw [BPair.add_comm]
  exact BPair.swap_add_null (BPair.oneValue_refl _)

name: residD_residV
statement:
theorem residD_residV (n : Nat) (L : Mat) (v : List BPair)
    (hLn : rowsLen n L) (hv : v.length = n) (hperp : perpAll L) :
    poly.oneValue (residV n L v) (residD L v)
proof:
:= by
  have hVl : (residV n L v).length = n := length_residV n L v hLn hv
  have hDl : (residD L v).length = n := length_residD n L v hLn hv
  have hgap : (vecAdd (residV n L v)
      ((residD L v).map BPair.swap)).length = n :=
    length_vecAdd _ _ n hVl (by rw [ground.length_map]; exact hDl)
  have hrow : ∀ k, k < L.length →
      (dotP (vecAdd (residV n L v) ((residD L v).map BPair.swap))
        (ground.getAt [] L k)).oneValue BPair.unit := by
    intro k hk
    rw [dotP_comm]
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans
      (dotP_vecAdd (ground.getAt [] L k) (residV n L v)
        ((residD L v).map BPair.swap)
        (by rw [hVl, rowsLen_getAt L k hLn hk])
        (by rw [ground.length_map, hDl, rowsLen_getAt L k hLn hk])) ?_
    rw [dotP_swapMap]
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.add_congr (resid_perp n L v hLn hv k hk)
        (swap_congr (residD_perp n L v hLn hv hperp k hk))) ?_
    exact BPair.unit_add BPair.unit
  refine oneValue_of_null_swap (residV n L v) (residD L v)
    (by rw [hVl, hDl]) ?_
  exact dotP_self_null _
    (gap_self_null n L v _ hLn hv hgap hperp hrow)

name: matAdd_nil_right
statement:
theorem matAdd_nil_right : ∀ A : Mat, matAdd A [] = []
  | [] => rfl
  | _ :: _ => rfl

/

name: matAdd_comm
statement:
theorem matAdd_comm : ∀ A B : Mat, matAdd A B = matAdd B A
  | [], [] => rfl
  | [], _ :: _ => rfl
  | _ :: _, [] => rfl
  | r :: A, s :: B => by
    show vecAdd r s :: matAdd A B = vecAdd s r :: matAdd B A
    rw [vecAdd_comm r s, matAdd_comm A B]

/

name: matAdd_assoc
statement:
theorem matAdd_assoc : ∀ A B C : Mat,
    matAdd (matAdd A B) C = matAdd A (matAdd B C)
  | [], _, _ => rfl
  | _ :: _, [], _ => rfl
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, [] => rfl
  | r :: A, s :: B, t :: C => by
    show vecAdd (vecAdd r s) t :: matAdd (matAdd A B) C
      = vecAdd r (vecAdd s t) :: matAdd A (matAdd B C)
    rw [vecAdd_assoc r s t, matAdd_assoc A B C]

/

name: matAdd_right_comm
statement:
theorem matAdd_right_comm (A B C : Mat) :
    matAdd (matAdd A B) C = matAdd (matAdd A C) B
proof:
:= by
  rw [matAdd_assoc A B C, matAdd_comm B C, matAdd_assoc A C B]

name: matAdd_shuffle
statement:
theorem matAdd_shuffle : ∀ A B C D : Mat,
    matAdd (matAdd A B) (matAdd C D) = matAdd (matAdd A C) (matAdd B D)
  | [], _, _, _ => rfl
  | _ :: _, [], [], _ => rfl
  | _ :: _, [], _ :: _, _ => rfl
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, [], _ => rfl
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, _ :: _, [] => rfl
  | a :: A, b :: B, c :: C, d :: D => by
    show vecAdd (vecAdd a b) (vecAdd c d) :: matAdd (matAdd A B) (matAdd C D)
      = vecAdd (vecAdd a c) (vecAdd b d) :: matAdd (matAdd A C) (matAdd B D)
    rw [vecAdd_add_comm a b c d, matAdd_shuffle A B C D]

/

name: vecAdd_swapMap
statement:
theorem vecAdd_swapMap : ∀ u v : List BPair,
    (vecAdd u v).map BPair.swap
      = vecAdd (u.map BPair.swap) (v.map BPair.swap)
  | [], _ => rfl
  | _ :: _, [] => rfl
  | a :: u, b :: v => by
    show (a + b).swap :: (vecAdd u v).map BPair.swap
      = (a.swap + b.swap) :: vecAdd (u.map BPair.swap) (v.map BPair.swap)
    rw [BPair.swap_add, vecAdd_swapMap u v]

/

name: matSwap_matAdd
statement:
theorem matSwap_matAdd : ∀ A B : Mat,
    matSwap (matAdd A B) = matAdd (matSwap A) (matSwap B)
  | [], _ => rfl
  | _ :: _, [] => rfl
  | r :: A, s :: B => by
    show (vecAdd r s).map BPair.swap :: matSwap (matAdd A B)
      = vecAdd (r.map BPair.swap) (s.map BPair.swap)
        :: matAdd (matSwap A) (matSwap B)
    rw [vecAdd_swapMap r s, matSwap_matAdd A B]

/
row. -/

name: matSwap_matSwap
statement:
theorem matSwap_matSwap : ∀ A : Mat, matSwap (matSwap A) = A
  | [] => rfl
  | r :: A => by
    show (r.map BPair.swap).map BPair.swap :: matSwap (matSwap A) = r :: A
    rw [show (r.map BPair.swap).map BPair.swap = r from poly.neg_neg r,
      matSwap_matSwap A]

/

name: matSwap_congr
statement:
theorem matSwap_congr : ∀ {A B : Mat}, matOneValue A B →
    matOneValue (matSwap A) (matSwap B)
  | [], [], _ => trivial
  | [], _ :: _, h => h.elim
  | _ :: _, [], h => h.elim
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, h => ⟨poly.swapMap_oneValue h.1, matSwap_congr h.2⟩

/
product's swap. -/

name: matMul_swapL
statement:
theorem matMul_swapL (a b : Mat) :
    matMul (matSwap a) b = matSwap (matMul a b)
proof:
:= by
  show (a.map (fun r => r.map BPair.swap)).map
      (fun r => (transposeM b).map (fun c => dotN r c))
    = (a.map (fun r => (transposeM b).map (fun c => dotN r c))).map
      (fun r => r.map BPair.swap)
  rw [ground.map_map, ground.map_map]
  refine ground.map_congr_all _ _ (fun r => ?_) a
  rw [ground.map_map]
  refine ground.map_congr_all _ _ (fun c => ?_) (transposeM b)
  exact dotN_swapLeft r c

name: vecSwap_double
statement:
private theorem vecSwap_double : ∀ r : List BPair,
    poly.oneValue (vecAdd (r.map BPair.swap) (vecAdd r r)) r
  | [] => trivial
  | x :: r =>
    ⟨by
      show (x.swap + (x + x)).oneValue x
      rw [← BPair.add_assoc]
      exact BPair.oneValue_trans
        (BPair.add_congr (BPair.swap_add_null (BPair.oneValue_refl x))
          (BPair.oneValue_refl x))
        (BPair.unit_add x),
     vecSwap_double r⟩

/
the matrix, the balance carrier's doubling entry by entry. -/

name: matSwap_double
statement:
theorem matSwap_double : ∀ P : Mat,
    matOneValue (matAdd (matSwap P) (matAdd P P)) P
  | [] => trivial
  | r :: t => ⟨vecSwap_double r, matSwap_double t⟩

/

name: matOne_refl
statement: theorem matOne_refl : ∀ M : Mat, matOneValue M M
proof:
:=
  ground.matched_refl (fun r => poly.oneValue_refl r)

name: polyOne_vecAddT
statement:
theorem polyOne_vecAddT : ∀ (u u' w w' : List BPair),
    poly.oneValue u u' → poly.oneValue w w' →
    w.length = w'.length →
    (List.zipWith (fun a b : BPair => a + b) u w).length
      = (List.zipWith (fun a b : BPair => a + b) u' w').length →
    poly.oneValue (List.zipWith (fun a b : BPair => a + b) u w)
      (List.zipWith (fun a b : BPair => a + b) u' w')
  | [], [], _, _, _, _, _, _ => trivial
  | [], _ :: _, [], [], _, _, _, _ => trivial
  | [], _ :: _, [], _ :: _, _, _, hw, _ => Nat.noConfusion hw
  | [], _ :: _, _ :: _, [], _, _, hw, _ => Nat.noConfusion hw
  | [], _ :: _, _ :: _, _ :: _, _, _, _, hz => Nat.noConfusion hz
  | _ :: _, [], [], [], _, _, _, _ => trivial
  | _ :: _, [], [], _ :: _, _, _, hw, _ => Nat.noConfusion hw
  | _ :: _, [], _ :: _, [], _, _, hw, _ => Nat.noConfusion hw
  | _ :: _, [], _ :: _, _ :: _, _, _, _, hz => Nat.noConfusion hz
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, [], [], _, _, _, _ => trivial
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, [], _ :: _, _, _, hw, _ => Nat.noConfusion hw
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, _ :: _, [], _, _, hw, _ => Nat.noConfusion hw
  | _ :: u, _ :: u', _ :: w, _ :: w', h1, h2, hw, hz =>
    ⟨BPair.add_congr h1.1 h2.1,
     polyOne_vecAddT u u' w w' h1.2 h2.2 (Nat.succ.inj hw)
       (Nat.succ.inj hz)⟩

/
on the second member and on the two sums, the first member's excess
read off by the truncation — the sum congruence's weakest-binder
form, `matAdd_cong2` its four-frame instance. -/

name: matAdd_congT
statement:
theorem matAdd_congT (n : Nat) : ∀ (A A' B B' : Mat),
    matOneValue A A' → matOneValue B B' →
    rowsLen n B → rowsLen n B' →
    rowsLen n (matAdd A B) → rowsLen n (matAdd A' B') →
    matOneValue (matAdd A B) (matAdd A' B')
  | [], [], _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _ => trivial
  | [], _ :: _, _, _, h, _, _, _, _, _ => h.elim
  | _ :: _, [], _, _, h, _, _, _, _, _ => h.elim
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, [], [], _, _, _, _, _, _ => trivial
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, [], _ :: _, _, h, _, _, _, _ => h.elim
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, _ :: _, [], _, h, _, _, _, _ => h.elim
  | _ :: A, _ :: A', _ :: B, _ :: B', h1, h2, hB, hB', hR, hR' =>
    ⟨polyOne_vecAddT _ _ _ _ h1.1 h2.1 (hB.1.trans hB'.1.symm)
      (hR.1.trans hR'.1.symm),
     matAdd_congT n A A' B B' h1.2 h2.2 hB.2 hB'.2 hR.2 hR'.2⟩

/-! The product's shape algebra: the fold's symmetry, the key-list
exchange as an involution and its two splittings, and the product's
association.  `def:elim`'s matrix is total over stated finite key
lists, so every read below binds the shapes it needs — the exchange
is an involution only at an occupied rectangle, and the product's
association reads the inner factors' exchange reversed.  The
consumers are the chord tier's operator identities
(`lem:fiberdec`'s word and annihilation, its doubling's band read)
and `thm:trigpencil`'s symbol. -/


/
read. -/

name: dotN_comm
statement:
theorem dotN_comm (u v : List BPair) :
    (dotN u v).oneValue (dotN v u)
proof:
:=
  BPair.oneValue_trans (dotN_read u v)
    (BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.oneValue_of_eq (dotP_comm u v))
      (BPair.oneValue_symm (dotN_read v u)))

name: length_matAdd
statement:
theorem length_matAdd : ∀ a b : Mat,
    a.length = b.length → (matAdd a b).length = a.length
  | [], _, _ => rfl
  | _ :: _, [], h => Nat.noConfusion h
  | _ :: a, _ :: b, h =>
    congrArg Nat.succ (length_matAdd a b (Nat.succ.inj h))

/

name: rowsLen_matAdd
statement:
theorem rowsLen_matAdd (n : Nat) : ∀ a b : Mat,
    rowsLen n a → rowsLen n b → rowsLen n (matAdd a b)
  | [], _, _, _ => trivial
  | _ :: _, [], _, _ => trivial
  | r :: a, s :: b, ha, hb =>
    ⟨length_vecAdd r s n ha.1 hb.1, rowsLen_matAdd n a b ha.2 hb.2⟩

/
four row frames, `matAdd_congT`'s instance at the sums' derived
widths. -/

name: matAdd_cong2
statement:
theorem matAdd_cong2 (n : Nat) (A B A' B' : Mat)
    (hA : rowsLen n A) (hB : rowsLen n B) (hA' : rowsLen n A')
    (hB' : rowsLen n B') (h1 : matOneValue A A')
    (h2 : matOneValue B B') :
    matOneValue (matAdd A B) (matAdd A' B')
proof:
:=
  matAdd_congT n A A' B B' h1 h2 hB hB'
    (rowsLen_matAdd n A B hA hB) (rowsLen_matAdd n A' B' hA' hB')

name: sqAt_matAdd
statement:
theorem sqAt_matAdd (o : Nat) (A B : Mat)
    (hA : sqAt A o) (hB : sqAt B o) : sqAt (matAdd A B) o
proof:
:=
  sqAt_of
    ((length_matAdd A B ((sqAt_len hA).trans (sqAt_len hB).symm)).trans
      (sqAt_len hA))
    (rowsLen_matAdd o A B (rowsLen_of_sqAt hA) (rowsLen_of_sqAt hB))

name: sqAt_matSwap
statement:
theorem sqAt_matSwap (o : Nat) (M : Mat) (h : sqAt M o) :
    sqAt (matSwap M) o
proof:
:=
  sqAt_of ((length_matSwap M).trans (sqAt_len h))
    (rowsLen_mapRows BPair.swap M o (rowsLen_of_sqAt h))

name: getAt_matAdd
statement:
theorem getAt_matAdd : ∀ (a b : Mat) (p : Nat),
    p < a.length → p < b.length →
    ground.getAt ([] : List BPair) (matAdd a b) p
      = vecAdd (ground.getAt [] a p) (ground.getAt [] b p)
  | [], _, p, hp, _ => absurd hp (Nat.not_lt_zero p)
  | _ :: _, [], p, _, hp => absurd hp (Nat.not_lt_zero p)
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, 0, _, _ => rfl
  | _ :: a, _ :: b, p + 1, hp, hq =>
    getAt_matAdd a b p (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hp)
      (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hq)

/

name: transposeM_transposeM
statement:
theorem transposeM_transposeM {n : Nat} (M : Mat) (hM : rowsLen n M)
    (hn : 0 < n) (h0 : 0 < M.length) :
    transposeM (transposeM M) = M
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (transposeM M).length = n := length_transposeM M hM h0
  have h2 : rowsLen M.length (transposeM M) := rowsLen_transposeM M
  have h3 : (transposeM (transposeM M)).length = M.length :=
    length_transposeM (transposeM M) h2 (by rw [h1]; exact hn)
  refine ground.getAt_ext [] _ _ (by rw [h3]) ?_
  intro p hp
  rw [h3] at hp
  have hrp : (ground.getAt ([] : List BPair)
      (transposeM (transposeM M)) p).length = n := by
    rw [rowsLen_getAt (transposeM (transposeM M)) p
      (rowsLen_cast h1 (rowsLen_transposeM (transposeM M)))
      (by rw [h3]; exact hp)]
  refine ground.getAt_ext BPair.unit _ _
    (by rw [hrp, rowsLen_getAt M p hM hp]) ?_
  intro q hq
  rw [hrp] at hq
  rw [getAt_transposeM BPair.unit (transposeM M) h2 p q hp (by rw [h1]; exact hq),
    getAt_transposeM BPair.unit M hM q p hq hp]

name: transposeM_matAdd
statement:
theorem transposeM_matAdd {n : Nat} (A B : Mat) (hA : rowsLen n A)
    (hB : rowsLen n B) (hl : A.length = B.length)
    (h0 : 0 < A.length) :
    transposeM (matAdd A B)
      = matAdd (transposeM A) (transposeM B)
proof:
:= by
  have hAB : rowsLen n (matAdd A B) := rowsLen_matAdd n A B hA hB
  have hlAB : (matAdd A B).length = A.length := length_matAdd A B hl
  have h1 : (transposeM (matAdd A B)).length = n :=
    length_transposeM (matAdd A B) hAB (by rw [hlAB]; exact h0)
  have h2 : (transposeM A).length = n := length_transposeM A hA h0
  have h3 : (transposeM B).length = n :=
    length_transposeM B hB (by rw [← hl]; exact h0)
  refine ground.getAt_ext [] _ _
    (by rw [h1, length_matAdd (transposeM A) (transposeM B) (h2.trans h3.symm), h2]) ?_
  intro p hp
  rw [h1] at hp
  have hrA : rowsLen A.length (transposeM A) := rowsLen_transposeM A
  have hrB : rowsLen B.length (transposeM B) := rowsLen_transposeM B
  rw [getAt_matAdd (transposeM A) (transposeM B) p (by rw [h2]; exact hp)
    (by rw [h3]; exact hp)]
  refine ground.getAt_ext BPair.unit _ _ ?_ ?_
  · rw [rowsLen_getAt (transposeM (matAdd A B)) p
      (rowsLen_cast hlAB (rowsLen_transposeM (matAdd A B)))
      (by rw [h1]; exact hp),
      length_vecAdd (ground.getAt [] (transposeM A) p)
        (ground.getAt [] (transposeM B) p) A.length
        (rowsLen_getAt (transposeM A) p hrA (by rw [h2]; exact hp))
        (by rw [rowsLen_getAt (transposeM B) p hrB (by rw [h3]; exact hp)]
            exact hl.symm)]
  · intro q hq
    rw [rowsLen_getAt (transposeM (matAdd A B)) p
      (rowsLen_cast hlAB (rowsLen_transposeM (matAdd A B)))
      (by rw [h1]; exact hp)] at hq
    rw [getAt_transposeM BPair.unit (matAdd A B) hAB p q hp
        (by rw [hlAB]; exact hq),
      getAt_vecAdd _ _ q
        (by rw [rowsLen_getAt (transposeM A) p hrA (by rw [h2]; exact hp)]
            exact hq)
        (by rw [rowsLen_getAt (transposeM B) p hrB (by rw [h3]; exact hp)]
            rw [← hl]; exact hq),
      getAt_transposeM BPair.unit A hA p q hp hq,
      getAt_transposeM BPair.unit B hB p q hp (by rw [← hl]; exact hq),
      getAt_matAdd A B q hq (by rw [← hl]; exact hq),
      getAt_vecAdd _ _ p
        (by rw [rowsLen_getAt A q hA hq]; exact hp)
        (by rw [rowsLen_getAt B q hB (by rw [← hl]; exact hq)]; exact hp)]

name: transposeM_matAdd_sym
statement:
theorem transposeM_matAdd_sym {n : Nat} (A B : Mat)
    (hA : sqAt A n) (hB : sqAt B n)
    (hsA : matOneValue (transposeM A) A)
    (hsB : matOneValue (transposeM B) B) :
    matOneValue (transposeM (matAdd A B)) (matAdd A B)
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    rw [List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp (sqAt_len hA),
      List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp (sqAt_len hB)]
    exact trivial
  | succ m =>
    have hAr : rowsLen (m + 1) A := rowsLen_of_sqAt hA
    have hBr : rowsLen (m + 1) B := rowsLen_of_sqAt hB
    have hAl : A.length = m + 1 := sqAt_len hA
    have hBl : B.length = m + 1 := sqAt_len hB
    have h0 : 0 < A.length := by rw [hAl]; exact Nat.succ_pos m
    rw [transposeM_matAdd A B hAr hBr (hAl.trans hBl.symm) h0]
    exact matAdd_cong2 (m + 1) _ _ _ _
      (rowsLen_cast hAl (rowsLen_transposeM A))
      (rowsLen_cast hBl (rowsLen_transposeM B)) hAr hBr hsA hsB

name: getAt_matMul
statement:
theorem getAt_matMul (a b : Mat) (p : Nat) (hp : p < a.length) :
    ground.getAt ([] : List BPair) (matMul a b) p
      = (transposeM b).map (fun c => dotN (ground.getAt [] a p) c)
proof:
:=
  ground.getAt_map ([] : List BPair) ([] : List BPair)
    (fun r => (transposeM b).map (fun c => dotN r c)) a p hp

name: transposeM_matMul
statement:
theorem transposeM_matMul {r n k : Nat} (B C : Mat)
    (hB : rowsLen n B) (hC : rowsLen k C)
    (hBl : B.length = r) (hCl : C.length = n)
    (hr : 0 < r) (hn : 0 < n) :
    matOneValue (transposeM (matMul B C))
      (matMul (transposeM C) (transposeM B))
proof:
:= by
  have hCt : (transposeM C).length = k :=
    length_transposeM C hC (by rw [hCl]; exact hn)
  have hBt : (transposeM B).length = n :=
    length_transposeM B hB (by rw [hBl]; exact hr)
  have hBtr : rowsLen r (transposeM B) :=
    rowsLen_cast hBl (rowsLen_transposeM B)
  have hCtr : rowsLen n (transposeM C) :=
    rowsLen_cast hCl (rowsLen_transposeM C)
  have hBB : transposeM (transposeM B) = B :=
    transposeM_transposeM B hB hn (by rw [hBl]; exact hr)
  have hMl : (matMul B C).length = r :=
    (ground.length_map _ B).trans hBl
  have hMr : rowsLen k (matMul B C) :=
    rowsLen_cast hCt (rowsLen_matMul B C)
  have hTl : (transposeM (matMul B C)).length = k :=
    length_transposeM (matMul B C) hMr (by rw [hMl]; exact hr)
  have hRl : (matMul (transposeM C) (transposeM B)).length = k :=
    (ground.length_map _ (transposeM C)).trans hCt
  refine matOne_getAt _ _ (by rw [hTl, hRl]) ?_
  intro p hp
  rw [hTl] at hp
  have hrowL : (ground.getAt ([] : List BPair)
      (transposeM (matMul B C)) p).length = r :=
    rowsLen_getAt (transposeM (matMul B C)) p
      (rowsLen_cast hMl (rowsLen_transposeM (matMul B C)))
      (by rw [hTl]; exact hp)
  have hrowR : (ground.getAt ([] : List BPair)
      (matMul (transposeM C) (transposeM B)) p).length = r := by
    rw [getAt_matMul (transposeM C) (transposeM B) p (by rw [hCt]; exact hp),
      ground.length_map, hBB, hBl]
  refine poly.oneValue_of_entries _ _ (by rw [hrowL, hrowR]) ?_
  intro q hq
  rw [hrowL] at hq
  rw [getAt_transposeM BPair.unit (matMul B C) hMr p q hp
      (by rw [hMl]; exact hq),
    getAt_matMul B C q (by rw [hBl]; exact hq),
    ground.getAt_map ([] : List BPair) BPair.unit
      (fun c => dotN (ground.getAt [] B q) c) (transposeM C) p
      (by rw [hCt]; exact hp),
    getAt_matMul (transposeM C) (transposeM B) p (by rw [hCt]; exact hp),
    ground.getAt_map ([] : List BPair) BPair.unit
      (fun c => dotN (ground.getAt [] (transposeM C) p) c)
      (transposeM (transposeM B)) q (by rw [hBB, hBl]; exact hq), hBB]
  exact dotN_comm _ _

name: matMul_assoc
statement:
theorem matMul_assoc {n k s : Nat} (A B C : Mat)
    (hA : rowsLen n A) (hB : rowsLen k B) (hC : rowsLen s C)
    (hBl : B.length = n) (hCl : C.length = k)
    (hn : 0 < n) (hk : 0 < k) :
    matOneValue (matMul (matMul A B) C) (matMul A (matMul B C))
proof:
:= by
  have hBt : (transposeM B).length = k :=
    length_transposeM B hB (by rw [hBl]; exact hn)
  have hBtr : rowsLen n (transposeM B) :=
    rowsLen_cast hBl (rowsLen_transposeM B)
  have hCtr : rowsLen k (transposeM C) :=
    rowsLen_cast hCl (rowsLen_transposeM C)
  have hT : matOneValue (matMul (transposeM C) (transposeM B))
      (transposeM (matMul B C)) :=
    matOne_symm (transposeM_matMul B C hB hC hBl hCl hn hk)
  have key : ∀ x : List BPair, x.length = n →
      poly.oneValue
        ((transposeM C).map (fun c =>
          dotN ((transposeM B).map (fun c' => dotN x c')) c))
        ((transposeM (matMul B C)).map (fun c => dotN x c)) := by
    intro x hx
    refine poly.oneValue_trans
      (dotN_map_comm (transposeM C)
        ((transposeM B).map (fun c' => dotN x c'))) ?_
    refine poly.oneValue_trans
      (matVec_congr_go (transposeM C) _ (matVec (transposeM B) x)
        ((matVec_length (transposeM B) x).symm ▸
          (ground.length_map (fun c' => dotN x c') (transposeM B)))
        (dotN_map_comm (transposeM B) x)) ?_
    refine poly.oneValue_trans
      (matVec_comp (transposeM C) (transposeM B) x n hBtr hx
        (rowsLen_cast hBt.symm hCtr)) ?_
    exact poly.oneValue_trans (matVec_matOne _ _ x hT)
      (poly.oneValue_symm (dotN_map_comm (transposeM (matMul B C)) x))
  show matOneValue
    ((A.map (fun x => (transposeM B).map (fun c => dotN x c))).map
      (fun y => (transposeM C).map (fun c => dotN y c)))
    (A.map (fun x => (transposeM (matMul B C)).map (fun c => dotN x c)))
  rw [ground.map_map]
  clear hT
  induction A with
  | nil => trivial
  | cons row t ih =>
    exact ⟨key row hA.1, ih hA.2⟩

name: dotN_addRow_right
statement:
theorem dotN_addRow_right (r p q : List BPair)
    (hp : p.length = r.length) (hq : q.length = r.length) :
    (dotN r (vecAdd p q)).oneValue (dotN r p + dotN r q)
proof:
:=
  BPair.oneValue_trans (dotN_comm r (vecAdd p q))
    (BPair.oneValue_trans (dotN_addRow p q r hp hq)
      (BPair.add_congr (dotN_comm p r) (dotN_comm q r)))

name: map_dotN_matAdd
statement:
private theorem map_dotN_matAdd (r : List BPair) : ∀ P Q : Mat,
    rowsLen r.length P → rowsLen r.length Q →
    poly.oneValue ((matAdd P Q).map (fun c => dotN r c))
      (vecAdd (P.map (fun c => dotN r c)) (Q.map (fun c => dotN r c)))
  | [], _, _, _ => trivial
  | _ :: _, [], _, _ => trivial
  | p :: P, q :: Q, hP, hQ =>
    ⟨dotN_addRow_right r p q hP.1 hQ.1,
     map_dotN_matAdd r P Q hP.2 hQ.2⟩

/
private theorem dotN_addRow_map (ra rb : List BPair) (n : Nat)
    (ha : ra.length = n) (hb : rb.length = n) :
    ∀ C : Mat, rowsLen n C →
    poly.oneValue (C.map (fun c => dotN (vecAdd ra rb) c))
      (vecAdd (C.map (fun c => dotN ra c)) (C.map (fun c => dotN rb c)))
  | [], _ => trivial
  | c :: t, h =>
    ⟨dotN_addRow ra rb c (ha.trans h.1.symm) (hb.trans h.1.symm),
     dotN_addRow_map ra rb n ha hb t h.2⟩

/

name: dotN_addRow_map
statement:
private theorem dotN_addRow_map (ra rb : List BPair) (n : Nat)
    (ha : ra.length = n) (hb : rb.length = n) :
    ∀ C : Mat, rowsLen n C →
    poly.oneValue (C.map (fun c => dotN (vecAdd ra rb) c))
      (vecAdd (C.map (fun c => dotN ra c)) (C.map (fun c => dotN rb c)))
  | [], _ => trivial
  | c :: t, h =>
    ⟨dotN_addRow ra rb c (ha.trans h.1.symm) (hb.trans h.1.symm),
     dotN_addRow_map ra rb n ha hb t h.2⟩

/

name: matMul_addL
statement:
theorem matMul_addL (n : Nat) (X : Mat)
    (hX : rowsLen n (transposeM X)) : ∀ A B : Mat,
    rowsLen n A → rowsLen n B →
    matOneValue (matMul (matAdd A B) X)
      (matAdd (matMul A X) (matMul B X))
  | [], _, _, _ => trivial
  | _ :: _, [], _, _ => trivial
  | ra :: A, rb :: B, hA, hB =>
    ⟨dotN_addRow_map ra rb n hA.1 hB.1 (transposeM X) hX,
     matMul_addL n X hX A B hA.2 hB.2⟩

/
sum, the key-list exchange of the sum its route. -/

name: matMul_addR
statement:
theorem matMul_addR {n : Nat} (A B : Mat) (hA : rowsLen n A)
    (hB : rowsLen n B) (hl : A.length = B.length)
    (h0 : 0 < A.length) : ∀ X : Mat, rowsLen A.length X →
    matOneValue (matMul X (matAdd A B))
      (matAdd (matMul X A) (matMul X B))
  | [], _ => trivial
  | r :: t, hXr => by
    refine ⟨?_, matMul_addR A B hA hB hl h0 t hXr.2⟩
    rw [transposeM_matAdd A B hA hB hl h0]
    exact map_dotN_matAdd r (transposeM A) (transposeM B)
      (rowsLen_cast hXr.1.symm (rowsLen_transposeM A))
      (rowsLen_cast (hl ▸ hXr.1.symm) (rowsLen_transposeM B))

/
exchanged entry is the entry exchanged, so the class read passes
through key by key. -/
private theorem transposeM_congr {n : Nat} (A B : Mat) (hA : rowsLen n A)
    (hB : rowsLen n B) (hl : A.length = B.length) (h0 : 0 < A.length)
    (h : matOneValue A B) :
    matOneValue (transposeM A) (transposeM B)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (transposeM A).length = n := length_transposeM A hA h0
  have h2 : (transposeM B).length = n :=
    length_transposeM B hB (by rw [← hl]; exact h0)
  refine matOne_getAt _ _ (by rw [h1, h2]) ?_
  intro p hp
  rw [h1] at hp
  have hrA : (ground.getAt ([] : List BPair) (transposeM A) p).length
      = A.length :=
    rowsLen_getAt (transposeM A) p (rowsLen_transposeM A)
      (by rw [h1]; exact hp)
  have hrB : (ground.getAt ([] : List BPair) (transposeM B) p).length
      = B.length :=
    rowsLen_getAt (transposeM B) p (rowsLen_transposeM B)
      (by rw [h2]; exact hp)
  refine poly.oneValue_of_entries _ _ (by rw [hrA, hrB, hl]) ?_
  intro q hq
  rw [hrA] at hq
  rw [getAt_transposeM BPair.unit A hA p q hp hq,
    getAt_transposeM BPair.unit B hB p q hp (by rw [← hl]; exact hq)]
  exact poly.oneValue_getAt p (matOne_entries A B h q hq)

name: transposeM_congr
statement:
private theorem transposeM_congr {n : Nat} (A B : Mat) (hA : rowsLen n A)
    (hB : rowsLen n B) (hl : A.length = B.length) (h0 : 0 < A.length)
    (h : matOneValue A B) :
    matOneValue (transposeM A) (transposeM B)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (transposeM A).length = n := length_transposeM A hA h0
  have h2 : (transposeM B).length = n :=
    length_transposeM B hB (by rw [← hl]; exact h0)
  refine matOne_getAt _ _ (by rw [h1, h2]) ?_
  intro p hp
  rw [h1] at hp
  have hrA : (ground.getAt ([] : List BPair) (transposeM A) p).length
      = A.length :=
    rowsLen_getAt (transposeM A) p (rowsLen_transposeM A)
      (by rw [h1]; exact hp)
  have hrB : (ground.getAt ([] : List BPair) (transposeM B) p).length
      = B.length :=
    rowsLen_getAt (transposeM B) p (rowsLen_transposeM B)
      (by rw [h2]; exact hp)
  refine poly.oneValue_of_entries _ _ (by rw [hrA, hrB, hl]) ?_
  intro q hq
  rw [hrA] at hq
  rw [getAt_transposeM BPair.unit A hA p q hp hq,
    getAt_transposeM BPair.unit B hB p q hp (by rw [← hl]; exact hq)]
  exact poly.oneValue_getAt p (matOne_entries A B h q hq)

name: transposeM_congrM
statement:
theorem transposeM_congrM (n : Nat) : ∀ (A B : Mat),
    rowsLen n A → rowsLen n B → A.length = B.length →
    matOneValue A B → matOneValue (transposeM A) (transposeM B)
  | [], [], _, _, _, _ => trivial
  | [], _ :: _, _, _, _, h => h.elim
  | _ :: _, [], _, _, _, h => h.elim
  | r :: t, s :: u, hA, hB, hlen, h =>
    transposeM_congr (r :: t) (s :: u) hA hB hlen
      (Nat.succ_pos _) h

/
factors' own class read: the key-list exchange is what the row folds
consume, so the exchange's read is the primitive and no shape binder
enters. -/

name: matMul_congrR_of
statement:
theorem matMul_congrR_of (A B B' : Mat)
    (h : matOneValue (transposeM B) (transposeM B')) :
    matOneValue (matMul A B) (matMul A B')
proof:
:= by
  show matOneValue (A.map (fun r => (transposeM B).map (fun c => dotN r c)))
    (A.map (fun r => (transposeM B').map (fun c => dotN r c)))
  refine matOne_map _ _ (fun r => ?_) A
  exact poly.oneValue_trans (dotN_map_comm (transposeM B) r)
    (poly.oneValue_trans (matVec_matOne _ _ r h)
      (poly.oneValue_symm (dotN_map_comm (transposeM B') r)))

name: matMul_congrR
statement:
theorem matMul_congrR {n k : Nat} (A B B' : Mat) (hB : rowsLen k B)
    (hB' : rowsLen k B') (hBl : B.length = n) (hB'l : B'.length = n)
    (hn : 0 < n) (h : matOneValue B B') :
    matOneValue (matMul A B) (matMul A B')
proof:
:=
  matMul_congrR_of A B B'
    (transposeM_congr B B' hB hB' (hBl.trans hB'l.symm)
      (by rw [hBl]; exact hn) h)

name: selM_append
statement:
theorem selM_append (I J : List Nat) (S : Mat) :
    selM (I ++ J) (I ++ J) S
      = List.zipWith (· ++ ·) (selM I I S) (selM I J S)
        ++ List.zipWith (· ++ ·) (selM J I S) (selM J J S)
proof:
:= by
  show (I ++ J).map (fun i => (I ++ J).map (fun j =>
      ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] S i) j))
    = List.zipWith (fun u v : List BPair => u ++ v)
        (I.map (fun i => I.map (fun j =>
          ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] S i) j)))
        (I.map (fun i => J.map (fun j =>
          ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] S i) j)))
      ++ List.zipWith (fun u v : List BPair => u ++ v)
        (J.map (fun i => I.map (fun j =>
          ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] S i) j)))
        (J.map (fun i => J.map (fun j =>
          ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] S i) j)))
  rw [ground.zipWith_map_map (fun u v : List BPair => u ++ v)
      (fun i => I.map (fun j =>
        ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] S i) j))
      (fun i => J.map (fun j =>
        ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] S i) j)) I,
    ground.zipWith_map_map (fun u v : List BPair => u ++ v)
      (fun i => I.map (fun j =>
        ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] S i) j))
      (fun i => J.map (fun j =>
        ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] S i) j)) J,
    ground.map_congr_all
      (fun i => (I ++ J).map (fun j =>
        ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] S i) j))
      (fun i => I.map (fun j =>
        ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] S i) j)
        ++ J.map (fun j =>
          ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] S i) j))
      (fun i => ground.map_append
        (fun j => ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] S i) j) I J)
      (I ++ J),
    ground.map_append _ I J]

name: length_permM
statement:
theorem length_permM (n : Nat) (idx : List Nat) :
    (permM n idx).length = idx.length
proof: := ground.length_map _ idx

name: rowsLen_permM
statement:
theorem rowsLen_permM (n : Nat) : ∀ idx : List Nat,
    rowsLen n (permM n idx)
  | [] => trivial
  | k :: t => ⟨length_idRow n k, rowsLen_permM n t⟩

/
indicator. -/
private theorem getAt_permM (n : Nat) (idx : List Nat) (p : Nat)
    (hp : p < idx.length) :
    ground.getAt ([] : List BPair) (permM n idx) p
      = idRow n (ground.getAt 0 idx p)
proof:
:=
  ground.getAt_map (0 : Nat) ([] : List BPair) (idRow n) idx p hp

name: getAt_permM
statement:
private theorem getAt_permM (n : Nat) (idx : List Nat) (p : Nat)
    (hp : p < idx.length) :
    ground.getAt ([] : List BPair) (permM n idx) p
      = idRow n (ground.getAt 0 idx p)
proof:
:=
  ground.getAt_map (0 : Nat) ([] : List BPair) (idRow n) idx p hp

name: rowsLen_mapSel
statement:
private theorem rowsLen_mapSel (J : List Nat) : ∀ S : Mat,
    rowsLen J.length (S.map (fun r => J.map (fun j =>
      ground.getAt BPair.unit r j)))
  | [] => trivial
  | _ :: t => ⟨ground.length_map _ J, rowsLen_mapSel J t⟩

/
block, at row keys within the datum's order. -/
private theorem selM_rowSel (n : Nat) (J : List Nat) (S : Mat)
    (hSl : S.length = n) : ∀ I : List Nat,
    (I.all (fun i => Nat.blt i n)) = true →
    I.map (fun i => ground.getAt ([] : List BPair)
        (S.map (fun r => J.map (fun j =>
          ground.getAt BPair.unit r j))) i)
      = selM I J S
  | [], _ => rfl
  | k :: t, h => by
    have hs
proof:
:= ground.andSplitB
      (show (Nat.blt k n && t.all (fun i => Nat.blt i n)) = true from h)
    show ground.getAt ([] : List BPair)
        (S.map (fun r => J.map (fun j =>
          ground.getAt BPair.unit r j))) k
        :: t.map (fun i => ground.getAt ([] : List BPair)
          (S.map (fun r => J.map (fun j =>
            ground.getAt BPair.unit r j))) i)
      = J.map (fun j =>
          ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] S k) j)
        :: selM t J S
    rw [selM_rowSel n J S hSl t hs.2,
      ground.getAt_map ([] : List BPair) ([] : List BPair)
        (fun r => J.map (fun j => ground.getAt BPair.unit r j)) S k
        (by rw [hSl]; exact ground.bltLt hs.1)]

name: selM_rowSel
statement:
private theorem selM_rowSel (n : Nat) (J : List Nat) (S : Mat)
    (hSl : S.length = n) : ∀ I : List Nat,
    (I.all (fun i => Nat.blt i n)) = true →
    I.map (fun i => ground.getAt ([] : List BPair)
        (S.map (fun r => J.map (fun j =>
          ground.getAt BPair.unit r j))) i)
      = selM I J S
  | [], _ => rfl
  | k :: t, h => by
    have hs
proof:
:= ground.andSplitB
      (show (Nat.blt k n && t.all (fun i => Nat.blt i n)) = true from h)
    show ground.getAt ([] : List BPair)
        (S.map (fun r => J.map (fun j =>
          ground.getAt BPair.unit r j))) k
        :: t.map (fun i => ground.getAt ([] : List BPair)
          (S.map (fun r => J.map (fun j =>
            ground.getAt BPair.unit r j))) i)
      = J.map (fun j =>
          ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] S k) j)
        :: selM t J S
    rw [selM_rowSel n J S hSl t hs.2,
      ground.getAt_map ([] : List BPair) ([] : List BPair)
        (fun r => J.map (fun j => ground.getAt BPair.unit r j)) S k
        (by rw [hSl]; exact ground.bltLt hs.1)]

name: matMul_permT
statement:
private theorem matMul_permT (n : Nat) (S : Mat) (hS : rowsLen n S)
    (hn : 0 < n) : ∀ idx : List Nat,
    (idx.all (fun i => Nat.blt i n)) = true →
    matOneValue (matMul S (transposeM (permM n idx)))
      (S.map (fun r => idx.map (fun j => ground.getAt BPair.unit r j)))
  | [], _ => matOne_refl _
  | k :: t, hidx => by
    have hPl : (permM n (k :: t)).length = (k :: t).length
proof:
:=
      length_permM n (k :: t)
    have hPr : rowsLen n (permM n (k :: t)) := rowsLen_permM n (k :: t)
    have hPpos : 0 < (permM n (k :: t)).length := by
      rw [hPl]; exact Nat.succ_pos _
    have hTT : transposeM (transposeM (permM n (k :: t)))
        = permM n (k :: t) :=
      transposeM_transposeM (permM n (k :: t)) hPr hn hPpos
    have hMl : (matMul S (transposeM (permM n (k :: t)))).length
        = S.length := length_matMul _ _
    refine matOne_getAt _ _ (by rw [hMl, ground.length_map]) ?_
    intro i hi
    rw [hMl] at hi
    rw [getAt_matMul S (transposeM (permM n (k :: t))) i hi, hTT,
      ground.getAt_map ([] : List BPair) ([] : List BPair)
        (fun r => (k :: t).map (fun j =>
          ground.getAt BPair.unit r j)) S i hi]
    have hrl : (ground.getAt ([] : List BPair) S i).length = n :=
      rowsLen_getAt S i hS hi
    refine poly.oneValue_of_entries _ _
      (by rw [ground.length_map, ground.length_map, hPl]) ?_
    intro q hq
    rw [ground.length_map, hPl] at hq
    rw [ground.getAt_map ([] : List BPair) BPair.unit
        (fun c => dotN (ground.getAt [] S i) c) (permM n (k :: t)) q
        (by rw [hPl]; exact hq),
      ground.getAt_map (0 : Nat) BPair.unit
        (fun j => ground.getAt BPair.unit
          (ground.getAt [] S i) j) (k :: t) q hq,
      getAt_permM n (k :: t) q hq]
    exact BPair.oneValue_trans
      (dotN_read (ground.getAt [] S i) _)
      (dotP_idRow (ground.getAt [] S i) n
        (ground.getAt 0 (k :: t) q) hrl
        (ground.bltLt (ground.all_getAt (0 : Nat) (k :: t) hidx q hq)))

name: permM_matMul
statement:
private theorem permM_matMul (n w : Nat) (X : Mat) (hX : rowsLen w X)
    (hXl : X.length = n) (hn : 0 < n) : ∀ idx : List Nat,
    (idx.all (fun i => Nat.blt i n)) = true →
    matOneValue (matMul (permM n idx) X)
      (idx.map (fun i => ground.getAt ([] : List BPair) X i))
proof:
:= by
  intro idx hidx
  have hXpos : 0 < X.length := by rw [hXl]; exact hn
  have hTl : (transposeM X).length = w := length_transposeM X hX hXpos
  have hMl : (matMul (permM n idx) X).length = idx.length :=
    (length_matMul _ _).trans (length_permM n idx)
  refine matOne_getAt _ _ (by rw [hMl, ground.length_map]) ?_
  intro p hp
  rw [hMl] at hp
  have hip : ground.getAt (0 : Nat) idx p < n :=
    ground.bltLt (ground.all_getAt (0 : Nat) idx hidx p hp)
  have hipX : ground.getAt (0 : Nat) idx p < X.length := by
    rw [hXl]; exact hip
  rw [getAt_matMul (permM n idx) X p (by rw [length_permM]; exact hp),
    getAt_permM n idx p hp,
    ground.getAt_map (0 : Nat) ([] : List BPair)
      (fun i => ground.getAt ([] : List BPair) X i) idx p hp]
  refine poly.oneValue_of_entries _ _
    (by rw [ground.length_map, hTl,
      rowsLen_getAt X (ground.getAt (0 : Nat) idx p) hX hipX]) ?_
  intro q hq
  rw [ground.length_map, hTl] at hq
  have hcol : (ground.getAt ([] : List BPair) (transposeM X) q).length
      = n := by
    rw [rowsLen_getAt (transposeM X) q (rowsLen_transposeM X)
      (by rw [hTl]; exact hq), hXl]
  rw [ground.getAt_map ([] : List BPair) BPair.unit
      (fun c => dotN (idRow n (ground.getAt 0 idx p)) c)
      (transposeM X) q (by rw [hTl]; exact hq),
    ← getAt_transposeM BPair.unit X hX q
      (ground.getAt (0 : Nat) idx p) hq hipX]
  exact BPair.oneValue_trans (dotN_comm _ _)
    (BPair.oneValue_trans
      (dotN_read (ground.getAt [] (transposeM X) q) _)
      (dotP_idRow (ground.getAt [] (transposeM X) q) n
        (ground.getAt 0 idx p) hcol hip))

name: permM_conj
statement:
theorem permM_conj (n : Nat) (idx : List Nat) (S : Mat)
    (hS : sqAt S n)
    (hidx : (idx.all (fun i => Nat.blt i n)) = true) :
    matOneValue
      (matMul (permM n idx) (matMul S (transposeM (permM n idx))))
      (selM idx idx S)
proof:
:= by
  cases idx with
  | nil => trivial
  | cons k t =>
    have hn : 0 < n :=
      Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le k)
        (ground.bltLt (ground.all_getAt (0 : Nat) (k :: t) hidx 0
          (Nat.succ_pos _)))
    have hSr : rowsLen n S := rowsLen_of_sqAt hS
    have hSl : S.length = n := sqAt_len hS
    have hTT : transposeM (transposeM (permM n (k :: t)))
        = permM n (k :: t) :=
      transposeM_transposeM (permM n (k :: t)) (rowsLen_permM n (k :: t))
        hn (by rw [length_permM]; exact Nat.succ_pos _)
    have hCl : (S.map (fun r => (k :: t).map (fun j =>
        ground.getAt BPair.unit r j))).length = n :=
      (ground.length_map _ S).trans hSl
    have hCr : rowsLen (k :: t).length (S.map (fun r =>
        (k :: t).map (fun j => ground.getAt BPair.unit r j))) :=
      rowsLen_mapSel (k :: t) S
    have hYr : rowsLen (k :: t).length
        (matMul S (transposeM (permM n (k :: t)))) :=
      rowsLen_cast (by rw [hTT, length_permM])
        (rowsLen_matMul S (transposeM (permM n (k :: t))))
    have hYl : (matMul S (transposeM (permM n (k :: t)))).length = n :=
      (length_matMul _ _).trans hSl
    have step2 := permM_matMul n (k :: t).length
      (S.map (fun r => (k :: t).map (fun j =>
        ground.getAt BPair.unit r j))) hCr hCl hn (k :: t) hidx
    rw [selM_rowSel n (k :: t) S hSl (k :: t) hidx] at step2
    exact matOne_trans
      (matMul_congrR (n := n) (k := (k :: t).length)
        (permM n (k :: t)) _ _ hYr hCr hYl hCl hn
        (matMul_permT n S hSr hn (k :: t) hidx))
      step2

name: length_selM
statement:
theorem length_selM (I J : List Nat) (S : Mat) :
    (selM I J S).length = I.length
proof:
:=
  length_selMO BPair.unit I J S

name: rowsLen_selM
statement:
theorem rowsLen_selM (J : List Nat) (S : Mat) (I : List Nat) :
    rowsLen J.length (selM I J S)
proof:
:=
  rowsLen_selMO BPair.unit J S I

name: symEntry
statement:
theorem symEntry (n : Nat) (S : Mat) (hSr : rowsLen n S)
    (hSl : S.length = n) (hsym : matOneValue (transposeM S) S)
    (a b : Nat) (ha : a < n) (hb : b < n) :
    (ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] S b) a).oneValue
      (ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] S a) b)
proof:
:= by
  have hTl : (transposeM S).length = n :=
    length_transposeM S hSr
      (by rw [hSl]; exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le a) ha)
  have hrow := matOne_entries (transposeM S) S hsym a
    (by rw [hTl]; exact ha)
  have hent := poly.oneValue_getAt b hrow
  rw [getAt_transposeM BPair.unit S hSr a b ha
    (by rw [hSl]; exact hb)] at hent
  exact hent

name: transposeM_selM
statement:
theorem transposeM_selM (I J : List Nat) (S : Mat) (n : Nat)
    (hS : sqAt S n) (hsym : matOneValue (transposeM S) S)
    (hI0 : 0 < I.length)
    (hI : (I.all (fun i => Nat.blt i n)) = true)
    (hJ : (J.all (fun j => Nat.blt j n)) = true) :
    matOneValue (transposeM (selM I J S)) (selM J I S)
proof:
:= by
  have hSr : rowsLen n S := rowsLen_of_sqAt hS
  have hSl : S.length = n := sqAt_len hS
  have hMl : (selM I J S).length = I.length := ground.length_map _ I
  have hMr : rowsLen J.length (selM I J S) := rowsLen_selM J S I
  have hTl : (transposeM (selM I J S)).length = J.length :=
    length_transposeM (selM I J S) hMr (by rw [hMl]; exact hI0)
  have hM2 : (selM J I S).length = J.length := ground.length_map _ J
  refine matOne_getAt _ _ (by rw [hTl, hM2]) ?_
  intro p hp
  rw [hTl] at hp
  have hrowL : (ground.getAt ([] : List BPair)
      (transposeM (selM I J S)) p).length = I.length := by
    rw [rowsLen_getAt (transposeM (selM I J S)) p
      (rowsLen_cast hMl (rowsLen_transposeM (selM I J S)))
      (by rw [hTl]; exact hp)]
  have hjp : ground.getAt (0 : Nat) J p < n :=
    ground.bltLt (ground.all_getAt (0 : Nat) J hJ p hp)
  have hrowR : (ground.getAt ([] : List BPair) (selM J I S) p).length
      = I.length := by
    rw [show selM J I S = J.map (fun j => I.map (fun i =>
        ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] S j) i)) from rfl,
      ground.getAt_map (0 : Nat) ([] : List BPair)
        (fun j => I.map (fun i =>
          ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] S j) i)) J p hp,
      ground.length_map]
  refine poly.oneValue_of_entries _ _ (by rw [hrowL, hrowR]) ?_
  intro q hq
  rw [hrowL] at hq
  have hiq : ground.getAt (0 : Nat) I q < n :=
    ground.bltLt (ground.all_getAt (0 : Nat) I hI q hq)
  rw [getAt_transposeM BPair.unit (selM I J S) hMr p q hp
      (by rw [hMl]; exact hq),
    show selM I J S = I.map (fun i => J.map (fun j =>
        ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] S i) j)) from rfl,
    ground.getAt_map (0 : Nat) ([] : List BPair)
      (fun i => J.map (fun j =>
        ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] S i) j)) I q hq,
    ground.getAt_map (0 : Nat) BPair.unit
      (fun j => ground.getAt BPair.unit
        (ground.getAt [] S (ground.getAt 0 I q)) j) J p hp,
    show selM J I S = J.map (fun j => I.map (fun i =>
        ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] S j) i)) from rfl,
    ground.getAt_map (0 : Nat) ([] : List BPair)
      (fun j => I.map (fun i =>
        ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] S j) i)) J p hp,
    ground.getAt_map (0 : Nat) BPair.unit
      (fun i => ground.getAt BPair.unit
        (ground.getAt [] S (ground.getAt 0 J p)) i) I q hq]
  exact symEntry n S hSr hSl hsym (ground.getAt 0 J p)
    (ground.getAt 0 I q) hjp hiq

name: length_nullMat
statement: theorem length_nullMat (k m : Nat) : (nullMat k m).length = k
proof:
:=
  ground.length_replicate (List.replicate m BPair.unit) k

name: rowsLen_nullMat
statement: theorem rowsLen_nullMat (k m : Nat) : rowsLen m (nullMat k m)
proof:
:=
  rowsLen_replicate m k

name: matAdd_nullL
statement:
theorem matAdd_nullL {n : Nat} : ∀ (Z X : Mat), matNull Z →
    Z.length = X.length → rowsLen n Z → rowsLen n X →
    matOneValue (matAdd Z X) X
  | [], [], _, _, _, _ => trivial
  | [], _ :: _, _, h, _, _ => Nat.noConfusion h
  | _ :: _, [], _, h, _, _ => Nat.noConfusion h
  | z :: Z, x :: X, hn, h, hZ, hX =>
    ⟨vecAdd_null_left z x (hZ.1.trans hX.1.symm) hn.1,
     matAdd_nullL Z X hn.2 (Nat.succ.inj h) hZ.2 hX.2⟩

/
every entry at the sum's unit. -/

name: matNull_add_swap
statement: theorem matNull_add_swap (M : Mat) : matNull (matAdd M (matSwap M))
proof:
:= by
  rw [matAdd_comm M (matSwap M)]
  exact matNull_swap_add (matOne_refl M)

name: matNull_matAdd
statement:
theorem matNull_matAdd : ∀ {X Y : Mat}, matNull X → matNull Y →
    matNull (matAdd X Y)
  | [], _, _, _ => trivial
  | _ :: _, [], _, _ => trivial
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, hX, hY =>
    ⟨unitTail_vecAdd_of hX.1 hY.1, matNull_matAdd hX.2 hY.2⟩

/

name: matNull_rowAt
statement:
theorem matNull_rowAt : ∀ (M : Mat), matNull M → ∀ i : Nat,
    poly.unitTail (ground.getAt ([] : List BPair) M i)
  | [], _, _ => trivial
  | _ :: _, h, 0 => h.1
  | _ :: t, h, i + 1 => matNull_rowAt t h.2 i

/
row read's entry. -/

name: matNull_getAt
statement:
theorem matNull_getAt (S : Mat) (h : matNull S) (i j : Nat) :
    BPair.oneValue
      (ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt ([] : List BPair) S i) j)
      BPair.unit
proof:
:=
  poly.getAt_unitTail (matNull_rowAt S h i) j

name: matAdd_nullR
statement:
theorem matAdd_nullR {o : Nat} (X Z : Mat) (hX : sqAt X o)
    (hZ : sqAt Z o) (hn : matNull Z) : matOneValue (matAdd X Z) X
proof:
:= by
  rw [matAdd_comm X Z]
  exact matAdd_nullL Z X hn
    ((sqAt_len hZ).trans (sqAt_len hX).symm)
    (rowsLen_of_sqAt hZ) (rowsLen_of_sqAt hX)

name: matSwapMove
statement:
theorem matSwapMove {o : Nat} (X Y Z : Mat)
    (hX : sqAt X o) (hY : sqAt Y o) (hZ : sqAt Z o)
    (h : matOneValue X (matAdd Y (matSwap Z))) :
    matOneValue (matAdd X Z) Y
proof:
:= by
  have hZs : sqAt (matSwap Z) o := sqAt_matSwap o Z hZ
  have hYZ : sqAt (matAdd Y (matSwap Z)) o :=
    sqAt_matAdd o Y (matSwap Z) hY hZs
  have hstep : matOneValue (matAdd X Z)
      (matAdd (matAdd Y (matSwap Z)) Z) :=
    matAdd_cong2 o X Z _ Z (rowsLen_of_sqAt hX)
      (rowsLen_of_sqAt hZ) (rowsLen_of_sqAt hYZ)
      (rowsLen_of_sqAt hZ) h (matOne_refl Z)
  rw [matAdd_assoc] at hstep
  refine matOne_trans hstep ?_
  exact matAdd_nullR Y (matAdd (matSwap Z) Z) hY
    (sqAt_matAdd o _ _ hZs hZ)
    (matNull_swap_add (matOne_refl Z))

name: matNull_nullMat
statement:
theorem matNull_nullMat (m : Nat) : ∀ k : Nat, matNull (nullMat k m)
  | 0 => trivial
  | k + 1 => ⟨poly.unitTail_replicate m, matNull_nullMat m k⟩

/
every vector. -/

name: matVec_matNull
statement:
theorem matVec_matNull : ∀ (M : Mat) (v : List BPair),
    matNull M → poly.unitTail (matVec M v)
  | [], _, _ => trivial
  | r :: t, v, h =>
    ⟨BPair.oneValue_trans (dotN_read r v)
       (dotP_null_tail_left r v h.1), matVec_matNull t v h.2⟩

/

name: matVec_nullMat
statement:
theorem matVec_nullMat (k m : Nat) (v : List BPair) :
    poly.unitTail (matVec (nullMat k m) v)
proof:
:=
  matVec_matNull _ v (matNull_nullMat m k)

name: msumAcc
statement:
private theorem msumAcc (n : Nat) (g : Nat → Mat) :
    ∀ (l : List Nat) (a b : Mat),
      (l.foldl (fun c k => matAdd c (g k)) (matAdd a b))
        = matAdd a (l.foldl (fun c k => matAdd c (g k)) b)
  | [], _, _ => rfl
  | k :: t, a, b => by
    show (t.foldl (fun c k' => matAdd c (g k')) (matAdd (matAdd a b) (g k)))
      = matAdd a (t.foldl (fun c k' => matAdd c (g k')) (matAdd b (g k)))
    rw [matAdd_assoc a b (g k)]
    exact msumAcc n g t a (matAdd b (g k))

/

name: msum_cons
statement:
theorem msum_cons (n : Nat) (g : Nat → Mat) (k : Nat) (t : List Nat) :
    msum n g (k :: t) = matAdd (g k) (msum n g t)
proof:
:= by
  show (t.foldl (fun c k' => matAdd c (g k')) (matAdd (nullMat n n) (g k)))
    = matAdd (g k) (msum n g t)
  rw [matAdd_comm (nullMat n n) (g k), msumAcc n g t (g k) (nullMat n n)]
  rfl

name: msum_shape_mem
statement:
theorem msum_shape_mem (n : Nat) (g : Nat → Mat) :
    ∀ l : List Nat, (∀ k, k ∈ l → rowsLen n (g k) ∧ (g k).length = n) →
      rowsLen n (msum n g l) ∧ (msum n g l).length = n
  | [], _ => ⟨rowsLen_nullMat n n, length_nullMat n n⟩
  | k :: t, hg => by
    rw [msum_cons n g k t]
    have hk
proof:
:= hg k (List.Mem.head t)
    have ht := msum_shape_mem n g t (fun j hj => hg j (List.Mem.tail k hj))
    exact ⟨rowsLen_matAdd n _ _ hk.1 ht.1,
      (length_matAdd _ _ (hk.2.trans ht.2.symm)).trans hk.2⟩

name: msum_shape
statement:
theorem msum_shape (n : Nat) (g : Nat → Mat)
    (hg : ∀ k, rowsLen n (g k) ∧ (g k).length = n) (l : List Nat) :
    rowsLen n (msum n g l) ∧ (msum n g l).length = n
proof:
:=
  msum_shape_mem n g l (fun k _ => hg k)

name: msum_congr
statement:
theorem msum_congr (n : Nat) (f g : Nat → Mat)
    (hf : ∀ k, rowsLen n (f k) ∧ (f k).length = n)
    (hg : ∀ k, rowsLen n (g k) ∧ (g k).length = n)
    (h : ∀ k, matOneValue (f k) (g k)) :
    ∀ l : List Nat, matOneValue (msum n f l) (msum n g l)
  | [] => matOne_refl _
  | k :: t => by
    rw [msum_cons n f k t, msum_cons n g k t]
    exact matAdd_cong2 n _ _ (g k) (msum n g t)
      (hf k).1 (msum_shape n f hf t).1 (hg k).1
      (msum_shape n g hg t).1 (h k)
      (msum_congr n f g hf hg h t)

/

name: msum_append
statement:
theorem msum_append (n : Nat) (g : Nat → Mat) (l : List Nat) (k : Nat) :
    msum n g (l ++ [k]) = matAdd (msum n g l) (g k)
proof:
:=
  ground.foldl_append (fun c k' => matAdd c (g k')) l [k] (nullMat n n)

name: matAdd_cancelR
statement:
theorem matAdd_cancelR (n : Nat) : ∀ A B S : Mat,
    rowsLen n A → rowsLen n B → rowsLen n S →
    A.length = B.length → A.length = S.length →
    matOneValue (matAdd A S) (matAdd B S) → matOneValue A B
  | [], [], _, _, _, _, _, _, _ => trivial
  | [], _ :: _, _, _, _, _, hl, _, _ => Nat.noConfusion hl
  | _ :: _, [], _, _, _, _, hl, _, _ => Nat.noConfusion hl
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, [], _, _, _, _, hs, _ => Nat.noConfusion hs
  | a :: A, b :: B, s :: S, hA, hB, hS, hl, hs, h =>
    ⟨vecAdd_cancel_right a b s (hA.1.trans hB.1.symm)
      (hA.1.trans hS.1.symm) h.1,
     matAdd_cancelR n A B S hA.2 hB.2 hS.2 (Nat.succ.inj hl)
       (Nat.succ.inj hs) h.2⟩

/
fold. -/

name: dotN_congrL
statement:
theorem dotN_congrL (r s c : List BPair) (h : poly.oneValue r s) :
    (dotN r c).oneValue (dotN s c)
proof:
:=
  BPair.oneValue_trans (dotN_read r c)
    (BPair.oneValue_trans (dotP_oneValue_left r s c h)
      (BPair.oneValue_symm (dotN_read s c)))

name: dotN_congrR
statement:
theorem dotN_congrR (c r s : List BPair) (h : poly.oneValue r s) :
    (dotN c r).oneValue (dotN c s)
proof:
:=
  BPair.oneValue_trans (dotN_read c r)
    (BPair.oneValue_trans (dotP_oneValue_right c r s h)
      (BPair.oneValue_symm (dotN_read c s)))

name: dotN_matVec_congrM
statement:
theorem dotN_matVec_congrM (A B : Mat) (u w : List BPair)
    (h : matOneValue A B) :
    (dotN u (matVec A w)).oneValue (dotN u (matVec B w))
proof:
:=
  dotN_congrR u _ _ (matVec_matOne A B w h)

name: dotN_transpose_flip
statement:
theorem dotN_transpose_flip (A : Mat) (n : Nat) (hAr : rowsLen n A)
    (u w : List BPair) (hu : u.length = n) (hw : w.length = A.length) :
    (dotN u (matVec (transposeM A) w)).oneValue (dotN w (matVec A u))
proof:
:= by
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans (dotN_read _ _) ?_
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans
    (BPair.oneValue_symm (dotP_matVec_transpose n A u w hAr hu hw)) ?_
  rw [dotP_comm (matVec A u) w]
  exact BPair.oneValue_symm (dotN_read w (matVec A u))

name: dotN_sym_flip
statement:
theorem dotN_sym_flip (A : Mat) (n : Nat) (hAr : rowsLen n A)
    (hAl : A.length = n) (hsym : matOneValue (transposeM A) A)
    (u w : List BPair) (hu : u.length = n) (hw : w.length = n) :
    (dotN w (matVec A u)).oneValue (dotN u (matVec A w))
proof:
:=
  BPair.oneValue_trans
    (BPair.oneValue_symm
      (dotN_transpose_flip A n hAr u w hu (hw.trans hAl.symm)))
    (dotN_matVec_congrM (transposeM A) A u w hsym)

name: getAt_matVec
statement:
theorem getAt_matVec (T : Mat) (v : List BPair)
    (t : Nat) (ht : t < T.length) :
    ground.getAt BPair.unit (matVec T v) t
      = dotN (ground.getAt [] T t) v
proof:
:= by
  rw [show matVec T v = T.map (fun r => dotN r v) from rfl,
    ground.getAt_map ([] : List BPair) BPair.unit
      (fun r => dotN r v) T t ht]

name: dotP_ofNat_fold
statement:
theorem dotP_ofNat_fold (F G : List Nat → Nat) :
    ∀ (l : List (List Nat)) (r c : List BPair),
      r.length = l.length → c.length = l.length →
      (∀ t, t < l.length →
        (ground.getAt BPair.unit r t).oneValue
          (BPair.ofNat (F (ground.getAt [] l t)))) →
      (∀ t, t < l.length →
        (ground.getAt BPair.unit c t).oneValue
          (BPair.ofNat (G (ground.getAt [] l t)))) →
      (dotP r c).oneValue
        (BPair.ofNat (ground.famFold Nat.add 0
          (fun m => F m * G m) l))
  | [], [], [], _, _, _, _ => BPair.oneValue_refl _
  | [], [], _ :: _, _, hc, _, _ => Nat.noConfusion hc
  | [], _ :: _, _, hr, _, _, _ => Nat.noConfusion hr
  | _ :: _, [], _, hr, _, _, _ => Nat.noConfusion hr
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, [], _, hc, _, _ => Nat.noConfusion hc
  | m :: ms, _ :: r', _ :: c', hr, hc, hF, hG =>
    BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.add_congr
        (BPair.oneValue_trans
          (BPair.mul_congr (hF 0 (Nat.succ_pos _))
            (hG 0 (Nat.succ_pos _)))
          (BPair.oneValue_symm (BPair.ofNat_mul (F m) (G m))))
        (dotP_ofNat_fold F G ms r' c' (Nat.succ.inj hr)
          (Nat.succ.inj hc)
          (fun t ht => hF (t + 1) (Nat.succ_lt_succ ht))
          (fun t ht => hG (t + 1) (Nat.succ_lt_succ ht))))
      (BPair.oneValue_symm (BPair.ofNat_add (F m * G m)
        (ground.famFold Nat.add 0 (fun m => F m * G m) ms)))

/
argument, the rows' congruence. -/

name: matVec_rows_congr
statement:
theorem matVec_rows_congr (n : Nat) (A B : Mat)
    (hlen : A.length = B.length) (hA : rowsLen n A)
    (hB : rowsLen n B)
    (hent : ∀ p, p < A.length → ∀ q, q < n →
      (ground.getAt BPair.unit
        (ground.getAt [] A p) q).oneValue
        (ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] B p) q))
    (x : List BPair) :
    poly.oneValue (matVec A x) (matVec B x)
proof:
:= by
  refine poly.oneValue_of_entries _ _ ?_ ?_
  · rw [matVec_length, matVec_length, hlen]
  · intro p hp
    rw [matVec_length] at hp
    have hpB : p < B.length := by rw [← hlen]; exact hp
    rw [getAt_matVec A x p hp, getAt_matVec B x p hpB]
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans (dotN_read _ x) ?_
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans ?_
      (BPair.oneValue_symm (dotN_read _ x))
    rw [dotP_comm (ground.getAt [] A p) x,
      dotP_comm (ground.getAt [] B p) x]
    refine dotP_oneValue_right x _ _ ?_
    refine poly.oneValue_of_entries _ _ ?_ ?_
    · rw [rowsLen_getAt A p hA hp,
        rowsLen_getAt B p hB hpB]
    · intro q hq
      rw [rowsLen_getAt A p hA hp] at hq
      exact hent p hp q hq

name: matVec_congr
statement:
theorem matVec_congr : ∀ (T : Mat) (u u' : List BPair),
    poly.oneValue u u' → poly.oneValue (matVec T u) (matVec T u')
  | [], _, _, _ => trivial
  | r :: t, u, u', h => ⟨dotN_congrR r u u' h, matVec_congr t u u' h⟩

/
fold lists one at a time, so the class read passes row by row and
no shape binder enters. -/

name: matMul_congrL
statement:
theorem matMul_congrL : ∀ (A A' B : Mat), matOneValue A A' →
    matOneValue (matMul A B) (matMul A' B)
  | [], [], _, _ => trivial
  | [], _ :: _, _, h => h.elim
  | _ :: _, [], _, h => h.elim
  | r :: A, s :: A', B, h =>
    ⟨poly.oneValue_map _ _ (transposeM B) (fun x _ => (fun c => dotN_congrL r s c h.1) x),
     matMul_congrL A A' B h.2⟩

/
through any rectangular carrier reads its own exchange, the
transposes' composition regrouped at the product. -/

name: congrSym
statement:
theorem congrSym {k k' : Nat} (S T : Mat)
    (hSr : rowsLen k' S) (hSl : S.length = k')
    (hTr : rowsLen k T) (hTl : T.length = k')
    (hk : 0 < k) (hk' : 0 < k')
    (hS : matOneValue (transposeM S) S) :
    matOneValue
      (transposeM (matMul (transposeM T) (matMul S T)))
      (matMul (transposeM T) (matMul S T))
proof:
:= by
  have hTtl : (transposeM T).length = k :=
    length_transposeM T hTr (by rw [hTl]; exact hk')
  have hTtr : rowsLen k' (transposeM T) :=
    rowsLen_cast hTl (rowsLen_transposeM T)
  have hSTl : (matMul S T).length = k' :=
    (length_matMul S T).trans hSl
  have hSTr : rowsLen k (matMul S T) :=
    rowsLen_matMul_of S T (fun _ => by rw [hTl]; exact hk') hTr
  have hStr : matOneValue (transposeM (matMul S T))
      (matMul (transposeM T) (transposeM S)) :=
    transposeM_matMul S T hSr hTr hSl hTl hk' hk'
  have hSt : (transposeM S).length = k' :=
    length_transposeM S hSr (by rw [hSl]; exact hk')
  have hStr2 : rowsLen k' (transposeM S) :=
    rowsLen_cast hSl (rowsLen_transposeM S)
  refine matOne_trans
    (transposeM_matMul (transposeM T) (matMul S T)
      hTtr hSTr hTtl hSTl hk hk') ?_
  rw [transposeM_transposeM T hTr hk (by rw [hTl]; exact hk')]
  refine matOne_trans
    (matMul_congrL _ _ T hStr) ?_
  refine matOne_trans
    (matMul_assoc (transposeM T) (transposeM S) T
      hTtr hStr2 hTr hSt hTl hk' hk') ?_
  exact matMul_congrR (n := k') (k := k) (transposeM T) _ _
    (rowsLen_matMul_of (transposeM S) T
      (fun _ => by rw [hTl]; exact hk') hTr)
    hSTr
    ((length_matMul _ T).trans hSt) hSTl hk'
    (matMul_congrL _ _ T hS)

name: permM_orthL
statement:
theorem permM_orthL (o : Nat) (l : List Nat)
    (hlen : l.length = o) (hd : ground.distinctList l)
    (hb : (l.all (fun i => Nat.blt i o)) = true) :
    matOneValue
      (matMul (permM o l) (transposeM (permM o l)))
      (permM o (List.range o))
proof:
:= by
  match l, hlen, hd, hb with
  | [], hlen, _, _ =>
    match o, hlen with
    | _, rfl => trivial
  | k :: t, hlen, hd, hb =>
    have hn : 0 < o := by
      rw [← hlen]; exact Nat.succ_pos _
    have step1 := matMul_permT o (permM o (k :: t))
      (rowsLen_permM o (k :: t)) hn (k :: t) hb
    refine matOne_trans step1 (matOne_getAt _ _ ?_ ?_)
    · rw [ground.length_map, length_permM, hlen, length_permM,
        ground.length_range]
    · intro p hp
      rw [ground.length_map, length_permM] at hp
      have hpo : p < o := by rw [← hlen]; exact hp
      have hlp : ground.getAt 0 (k :: t) p < o :=
        ground.bltLt (ground.all_getAt 0 (k :: t) hb p hp)
      rw [ground.getAt_map ([] : List BPair) ([] : List BPair)
          (fun r => (k :: t).map (fun j =>
            ground.getAt BPair.unit r j)) (permM o (k :: t)) p
          (by rw [length_permM]; exact hp),
        show permM o (k :: t) = (k :: t).map (idRow o) from rfl,
        ground.getAt_map 0 ([] : List BPair) (idRow o) (k :: t) p hp,
        show permM o (List.range o) = (List.range o).map (idRow o)
          from rfl,
        ground.getAt_map 0 ([] : List BPair) (idRow o) (List.range o)
          p (by rw [ground.length_range]; exact hpo),
        ground.getAt_range o p hpo]
      refine poly.oneValue_of_entries _ _ (by rw [ground.length_map,
        length_idRow, hlen]) ?_
      intro q hq
      rw [ground.length_map] at hq
      have hqo : q < o := by rw [← hlen]; exact hq
      have hlq : ground.getAt 0 (k :: t) q < o :=
        ground.bltLt (ground.all_getAt 0 (k :: t) hb q hq)
      rw [ground.getAt_map (0 : Nat) BPair.unit
          (fun j => ground.getAt BPair.unit (idRow o
            (ground.getAt 0 (k :: t) p)) j) (k :: t) q hq,
        getAt_idRow o (ground.getAt 0 (k :: t) p)
          (ground.getAt 0 (k :: t) q) hlq,
        getAt_idRow o p q hqo]
      match Nat.decEq q p with
      | isTrue he =>
        rw [if_pos he, if_pos (by rw [he])]
        exact BPair.oneValue_refl _
      | isFalse hne =>
        have hvne : ¬ ground.getAt 0 (k :: t) q
            = ground.getAt 0 (k :: t) p := by
          match Nat.lt_or_ge q p with
          | Or.inl hlt =>
            exact ground.getAt_ne_of_distinct
              (fun x => ground.distinctList_all hd x) hlt hp
          | Or.inr hge =>
            have hlt : p < q :=
              Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne hge (fun e => hne e.symm)
            exact fun e => ground.getAt_ne_of_distinct
              (fun x => ground.distinctList_all hd x) hlt hq e.symm
        rw [if_neg hvne, if_neg hne]
        exact BPair.oneValue_refl _

name: permM_orthR
statement:
theorem permM_orthR (o : Nat) (l : List Nat)
    (hlen : l.length = o) (hd : ground.distinctList l)
    (hb : (l.all (fun i => Nat.blt i o)) = true)
    (hcov : ∀ j, j < o → 0 < ground.countOf j l) :
    matOneValue
      (matMul (transposeM (permM o l)) (permM o l))
      (permM o (List.range o))
proof:
:= by
  match l, hlen, hd, hb, hcov with
  | [], hlen, _, _, _ =>
    match o, hlen with
    | _, rfl => trivial
  | k :: t, hlen, hd, hb, hcov =>
    have hn : 0 < o := by
      rw [← hlen]; exact Nat.succ_pos _
    have hdist : ∀ z, ground.countOf z (k :: t) ≤ 1 :=
      fun z => ground.distinctList_all hd z
    have hPl : (permM o (k :: t)).length = o := by
      rw [length_permM]; exact hlen
    have hPr : rowsLen o (permM o (k :: t)) := rowsLen_permM o (k :: t)
    have hTl : (transposeM (permM o (k :: t))).length = o :=
      length_transposeM (permM o (k :: t)) hPr
        (by rw [hPl]; exact hn)
    have hTr : rowsLen (permM o (k :: t)).length
        (transposeM (permM o (k :: t))) :=
      rowsLen_transposeM (permM o (k :: t))
    
    have hinvb : (((List.range o).map
        (fun j => places.posOf j (k :: t))).all
          (fun i => Nat.blt i o)) = true := by
      rw [ground.all_map (fun j => places.posOf j (k :: t))
        (fun i => Nat.blt i o) (List.range o)]
      refine ground.all_range_intro o ?_
      intro j hj
      refine ground.ltBlt ?_
      rw [← hlen]
      exact places.posOf_lt j (k :: t) (hcov j hj)
    have hstep : matOneValue (transposeM (permM o (k :: t)))
        (permM o ((List.range o).map
          (fun j => places.posOf j (k :: t)))) := by
      refine matOne_getAt _ _ ?_ ?_
      · rw [hTl, length_permM, ground.length_map,
          ground.length_range]
      · intro p hp
        rw [hTl] at hp
        have hposp : places.posOf p (k :: t) < (k :: t).length :=
          places.posOf_lt p (k :: t) (hcov p hp)
        refine poly.oneValue_of_entries _ _ ?_ ?_
        · rw [rowsLen_getAt _ p (rowsLen_cast hPl hTr)
            (by rw [hTl]; exact hp),
            show permM o ((List.range o).map
                (fun j => places.posOf j (k :: t)))
              = ((List.range o).map
                (fun j => places.posOf j (k :: t))).map (idRow o)
              from rfl,
            ground.getAt_map 0 ([] : List BPair) (idRow o)
              ((List.range o).map (fun j => places.posOf j (k :: t)))
              p (by rw [ground.length_map, ground.length_range]
                    exact hp),
            length_idRow]
        · intro q hq
          rw [rowsLen_getAt _ p (rowsLen_cast hPl hTr)
            (by rw [hTl]; exact hp)] at hq
          have hql : q < (k :: t).length := by
            rw [hlen]; exact hq
          rw [getAt_transposeM BPair.unit (permM o (k :: t)) hPr p q
              hp (by rw [hPl]; exact hq),
            show permM o (k :: t) = (k :: t).map (idRow o) from rfl,
            ground.getAt_map 0 ([] : List BPair) (idRow o)
              (k :: t) q hql,
            getAt_idRow o (ground.getAt 0 (k :: t) q) p hp,
            show permM o ((List.range o).map
                (fun j => places.posOf j (k :: t)))
              = ((List.range o).map
                (fun j => places.posOf j (k :: t))).map (idRow o)
              from rfl,
            ground.map_map (fun j => places.posOf j (k :: t))
              (idRow o) (List.range o),
            ground.getAt_map 0 ([] : List BPair)
              (fun j => idRow o (places.posOf j (k :: t)))
              (List.range o) p
              (by rw [ground.length_range]; exact hp),
            ground.getAt_range o p hp,
            getAt_idRow o (places.posOf p (k :: t)) q
              (by rw [← hlen]; exact hql)]
          match Nat.decEq p (ground.getAt 0 (k :: t) q) with
          | isTrue he =>
            have hqpos : q = places.posOf p (k :: t) := by
              rw [he, places.posOf_getAt hdist q hql]
            rw [if_pos he, if_pos hqpos]
            exact BPair.oneValue_refl _
          | isFalse hne =>
            have hqpos : ¬ q = places.posOf p (k :: t) := by
              intro he
              refine hne ?_
              rw [he, places.getAt_posOf p (k :: t) (hcov p hp)]
            rw [if_neg hne, if_neg hqpos]
            exact BPair.oneValue_refl _
    refine matOne_trans
      (matMul_congrL _ _ (permM o (k :: t)) hstep) ?_
    have hstep2 := permM_matMul o o (permM o (k :: t)) hPr hPl hn
      ((List.range o).map (fun j => places.posOf j (k :: t))) hinvb
    refine matOne_trans hstep2 (matOne_getAt _ _ ?_ ?_)
    · rw [ground.length_map, ground.length_map, ground.length_range,
        length_permM, ground.length_range]
    · intro p hp
      rw [ground.length_map, ground.length_map,
        ground.length_range] at hp
      have hposp : places.posOf p (k :: t) < (k :: t).length :=
        places.posOf_lt p (k :: t) (hcov p hp)
      rw [ground.getAt_map 0 ([] : List BPair)
          (fun i => ground.getAt ([] : List BPair)
            (permM o (k :: t)) i)
          ((List.range o).map (fun j => places.posOf j (k :: t))) p
          (by rw [ground.length_map, ground.length_range]; exact hp),
        ground.getAt_map 0 0 (fun j => places.posOf j (k :: t))
          (List.range o) p
          (by rw [ground.length_range]; exact hp),
        ground.getAt_range o p hp,
        show permM o (k :: t) = (k :: t).map (idRow o) from rfl,
        ground.getAt_map 0 ([] : List BPair) (idRow o) (k :: t)
          (places.posOf p (k :: t)) hposp,
        places.getAt_posOf p (k :: t) (hcov p hp),
        show permM o (List.range o) = (List.range o).map (idRow o)
          from rfl,
        ground.getAt_map 0 ([] : List BPair) (idRow o) (List.range o)
          p (by rw [ground.length_range]; exact hp),
        ground.getAt_range o p hp]
      exact poly.oneValue_refl _

name: map_dotN_null
statement:
private theorem map_dotN_null : ∀ (M : Mat), matNull M →
    ∀ r : List BPair, poly.unitTail (M.map (fun c => dotN r c))
  | [], _, _ => trivial
  | c :: t, h, r =>
    ⟨BPair.oneValue_trans (dotN_read r c)
      (dotP_null_tail_right r c h.1),
     map_dotN_null t h.2 r⟩

name: matMul_nullMat
statement:
theorem matMul_nullMat (n : Nat) (X : Mat) (hXl : X.length = n) :
    matOneValue (matMul X (nullMat n n)) (nullMat n n)
proof:
:= by
  have hMl : (matMul X (nullMat n n)).length = n :=
    (length_matMul X (nullMat n n)).trans hXl
  refine matOne_getAt _ _ (by rw [hMl, length_nullMat]) ?_
  intro i hi
  rw [hMl] at hi
  rw [getAt_matMul X (nullMat n n) i (by rw [hXl]; exact hi),
    show nullMat n n = List.replicate n (List.replicate n BPair.unit) from rfl,
    ground.getAt_replicate ([] : List BPair) (List.replicate n BPair.unit)
      n i hi]
  exact poly.unitTail_oneValue
    (map_dotN_null (transposeM (nullMat n n))
      (matNull_transposeM (nullMat n n) (matNull_nullMat n n)) _)
    (poly.unitTail_replicate n)

name: matMul_msum
statement:
theorem matMul_msum (n : Nat) (X : Mat) (hX : rowsLen n X)
    (hXl : X.length = n) (hn : 0 < n) (g : Nat → Mat)
    (hg : ∀ k, rowsLen n (g k) ∧ (g k).length = n) :
    ∀ l : List Nat,
      matOneValue (matMul X (msum n g l))
        (msum n (fun k => matMul X (g k)) l)
  | [] => matMul_nullMat n X hXl
  | k :: t => by
    have hg' : ∀ k, rowsLen n (matMul X (g k))
        ∧ (matMul X (g k)).length = n
proof:
:= fun k =>
      ⟨rowsLen_matMul_of X (g k) (fun _ => by rw [(hg k).2]; exact hn)
                                   (hg k).1,
       (length_matMul X (g k)).trans hXl⟩
    rw [msum_cons n g k t, msum_cons n (fun k => matMul X (g k)) k t]
    refine matOne_trans
      (matMul_addR (n := n) (g k) (msum n g t) (hg k).1
        (msum_shape n g hg t).1
        ((hg k).2.trans (msum_shape n g hg t).2.symm)
        (by rw [(hg k).2]; exact hn) X
        (rowsLen_cast (hg k).2.symm hX)) ?_
    exact matAdd_cong2 n (matMul X (g k)) (matMul X (msum n g t))
      (matMul X (g k)) (msum n (fun k => matMul X (g k)) t)
      (hg' k).1
      (rowsLen_matMul_of X (msum n g t)
        (fun _ => by rw [(msum_shape n g hg t).2]; exact hn)
        (msum_shape n g hg t).1)
      (hg' k).1 (msum_shape n (fun k => matMul X (g k)) hg' t).1
      (matOne_refl _) (matMul_msum n X hX hXl hn g hg t)

name: msum_shift
statement:
theorem msum_shift (n : Nat) (f : Nat → Mat) : ∀ L : Nat,
    matAdd (f 0) (msum n (fun b => f (b + 1)) (List.range L))
      = matAdd (msum n f (List.range L)) (f L)
  | 0 => matAdd_comm (f 0) (nullMat n n)
  | L + 1 => by
    rw [ground.range_succ L,
      msum_append n (fun b => f (b + 1)) (List.range L) L,
      msum_append n f (List.range L) L,
      ← matAdd_assoc (f 0) (msum n (fun b => f (b + 1)) (List.range L))
        (f (L + 1)), msum_shift n f L]

/
range's own length reads its head, the shifted family's fold reads
the family's, the wrapped key clearing against the head. -/

name: msum_wrap
statement:
theorem msum_wrap (n : Nat) (f : Nat → Mat)
    (hf : ∀ k, rowsLen n (f k) ∧ (f k).length = n) (L : Nat)
    (hw : matOneValue (f L) (f 0)) :
    matOneValue (msum n (fun b => f (b + 1)) (List.range L))
      (msum n f (List.range L))
proof:
:= by
  have hf' : ∀ k, rowsLen n (f (k + 1)) ∧ (f (k + 1)).length = n :=
    fun k => hf (k + 1)
  have hA := msum_shape n (fun b => f (b + 1)) hf' (List.range L)
  have hB := msum_shape n f hf (List.range L)
  have hs := msum_shift n f L
  rw [matAdd_comm (f 0) (msum n (fun b => f (b + 1)) (List.range L))] at hs
  refine matAdd_cancelR n _ _ (f 0) hA.1 hB.1 (hf 0).1
    (hA.2.trans hB.2.symm) (hA.2.trans (hf 0).2.symm) ?_
  rw [hs]
  exact matAdd_cong2 n (msum n f (List.range L)) (f L)
    (msum n f (List.range L)) (f 0) hB.1 (hf L).1 hB.1 (hf 0).1
    (matOne_refl _) hw

name: addShift
statement: private theorem addShift (k i : Nat) : k + 1 + i = k + (i + 1)
proof:
:=
  Nat.succ_add k i

statement:

statement:
private theorem length_drop1 {α : Type} : ∀ l : List α,

exchange per crossing. -/
private def moveRow {α : Type} : Nat → Nat → List α → List α
  | 0, _, m => m
  | i + 1, k, m => ground.adjSwap k (moveRow i (k + 1) m)

/
private theorem length_moveRow {α : Type} : ∀ (i k : Nat) (m : List α),
    (moveRow i k m).length = m.length
  | 0, _, _ => rfl
  | i + 1, k, m => by
    show (ground.adjSwap k (moveRow i (k + 1) m)).length = m.length
    rw [ground.length_adjSwap, length_moveRow i (k + 1) m]

/
private theorem rowsLen_moveRow {γ : Type} {n : Nat} :
    ∀ (i k : Nat) (m : List (List γ)),
    rowsLen n m → rowsLen n (moveRow i k m)
  | 0, _, _, h => h
  | i + 1, k, m, h =>
    rowsLen_adjSwap k _ (rowsLen_moveRow i (k + 1) m h)

/
private theorem getAt_moveRow_lt {α : Type} (d : α) :
    ∀ (i k : Nat) (m : List α) (a : Nat),
    a < k → k + i < m.length →
    ground.getAt d (moveRow i k m) a = ground.getAt d m a
  | 0, _, _, _, _, _ => rfl
  | i + 1, k, m, a, hak, hki => by
    have hki' : k + 1 + i < m.length
proof:
:= by
      rw [addShift]
      exact hki
    have hk1 : k + 1 < (moveRow i (k + 1) m).length := by
      rw [length_moveRow i (k + 1) m]
      exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_add_right (k + 1) i) hki'
    show ground.getAt d (ground.adjSwap k (moveRow i (k + 1) m)) a = _
    rw [getAt_adjSwap d k (moveRow i (k + 1) m) hk1 a,
      ground.swapIx_off (Nat.ne_of_lt hak)
        (Nat.ne_of_lt (Nat.lt_trans hak (Nat.lt_succ_self k))),
      getAt_moveRow_lt d i (k + 1) m a
        (Nat.lt_trans hak (Nat.lt_succ_self k)) hki']

    k + i < m.length →
    ground.getAt d (moveRow i k m) k = ground.getAt d m (k + i)
  | 0, _, _, _ => rfl
  | i + 1, k, m, hki => by
    have hki' : k + 1 + i < m.length
proof:
:= by

name: getAt_moveRow_tail
statement:
private theorem getAt_moveRow_tail {α : Type} (d : α) :
    ∀ (i k : Nat) (m : List α) (b : Nat),
    k + i < m.length → k + 1 + b < m.length →
    ground.getAt d (moveRow i k m) (k + 1 + b)
      = ground.getAt d m (k + liftIx i b)
  | 0, k, m, b, _, _ => by
    show ground.getAt d m (k + 1 + b)
      = ground.getAt d m (k + if b < 0 then b else b + 1)
    rw [if_neg (Nat.not_lt_zero b), addShift]
  | i + 1, k, m, b, hki, hkb => by
    have hki' : k + 1 + i < m.length
proof:
:= by
      rw [addShift]
      exact hki
    have hk1 : k + 1 < (moveRow i (k + 1) m).length := by
      rw [length_moveRow i (k + 1) m]
      exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_add_right (k + 1) i) hki'
    match b with
    | 0 =>
      show ground.getAt d (ground.adjSwap k (moveRow i (k + 1) m))
        (k + 1) = ground.getAt d m (k + liftIx (i + 1) 0)
      rw [getAt_adjSwap d k (moveRow i (k + 1) m) hk1 (k + 1),
        ground.swapIx_snd (Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.lt_succ_self k)),
        getAt_moveRow_lt d i (k + 1) m k (Nat.lt_succ_self k) hki',
        show liftIx (i + 1) 0 = 0 from by
          show (if 0 < i + 1 then 0 else 1) = 0
          rw [if_pos (Nat.succ_pos i)]]
      rfl
    | c + 1 =>
      have hstep : k + 1 + (c + 1) = k + 1 + 1 + c :=
        Nat.add_right_comm (k + 1) c 1
      have hgt1 : k + 1 < k + 1 + 1 + c :=
        Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_succ_self (k + 1))
          (Nat.le_add_right (k + 1 + 1) c)
      have hgt0 : k < k + 1 + 1 + c :=
        Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self k) hgt1
      show ground.getAt d (ground.adjSwap k (moveRow i (k + 1) m))
          (k + 1 + (c + 1))
        = ground.getAt d m (k + liftIx (i + 1) (c + 1))
      rw [hstep,
        getAt_adjSwap d k (moveRow i (k + 1) m) hk1
          (k + 1 + 1 + c),
        ground.swapIx_off (Nat.ne_of_gt hgt0) (Nat.ne_of_gt hgt1),
        getAt_moveRow_tail d i (k + 1) m c hki'
          (by rw [← hstep]; exact hkb),
        liftIx_succ i c, addShift k (liftIx i c)]

statement:
private theorem signAtO_comp {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (C : DCore γ ops R.rel) (a b : Bool) (x : γ) :
    R.rel (signAtO ops a (signAtO ops b x))
      (signAtO ops (Bool.xor b a) x)
proof:
:= by
  cases a with
  | false => cases b with
    | false => exact C.ovRefl _
    | true => exact C.ovRefl _
  | true => cases b with
    | false => exact C.ovRefl _
    | true => exact C.swapSwap x

name: detO_moveRow
statement:
private theorem detO_moveRow {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (C : DCore γ ops R.rel) :
    ∀ (i k : Nat) (m : List (List γ)), k + i < m.length →
    R.rel (detO ops (moveRow i k m))
      (signAtO ops (places.parityOf i) (detO ops m))
  | 0, _, _, _ => C.ovRefl _
  | i + 1, k, m, hki => by
    have hki' : k + 1 + i < m.length
proof:
:= by
      rw [addShift]
      exact hki
    have hk1 : k + 1 < (moveRow i (k + 1) m).length := by
      rw [length_moveRow i (k + 1) m]
      exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_add_right (k + 1) i) hki'
    show R.rel (detO ops (ground.adjSwap k (moveRow i (k + 1) m))) _
    refine C.ovTrans (detO_swapAdj C k (moveRow i (k + 1) m) hk1) ?_
    refine C.ovTrans
      (C.swapCongr (detO_moveRow C i (k + 1) m hki')) ?_
    show R.rel (ops.swap (signAtO ops (places.parityOf i) (detO ops m)))
      (signAtO ops (!(places.parityOf i)) (detO ops m))
    cases places.parityOf i with
    | false => exact C.ovRefl _
    | true => exact C.swapSwap _

name: findPivO_read
statement:
private theorem findPivO_read {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ)
    (u : γ → Bool) : ∀ (m : List (List γ)) (i : Nat),
    findPivO ops u m = some i →
    i < m.length ∧ u (ground.getAt ops.unit
      (ground.getAt [] m i) 0) = false
  | [], i, h => by
    nomatch (show (none : Option Nat) = some i from h)
  | r :: rows, i, h => by
    revert h
    show (match u (ground.getAt ops.unit r 0) with
        | false => some 0
        | true =>
          match findPivO ops u rows with
          | some j => some (j + 1)
          | none => none) = some i →
      i < (r :: rows).length ∧ u (ground.getAt ops.unit
        (ground.getAt [] (r :: rows) i) 0) = false
    cases hu : u (ground.getAt ops.unit r 0) with
    | false =>
      intro h
      rw [← Option.some.inj h]
      exact ⟨Nat.succ_pos _, hu⟩
    | true =>
      cases hf : findPivO ops u rows with
      | none =>
        intro h
        nomatch (show (none : Option Nat) = some i from h)
      | some j =>
        intro h
        rw [← Option.some.inj h]
        exact ⟨Nat.succ_lt_succ (findPivO_read ops u rows j hf).1,
          (findPivO_read ops u rows j hf).2⟩

test. -/

    (u : γ → Bool) : ∀ (m : List (List γ)),

      u (ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] m a) 0) = true
  | [], _, a, ha => absurd ha (Nat.not_lt_zero a)
  | r :: rows, h, a, ha => by
    revert h
    show (match u (ground.getAt ops.unit r 0) with
        | false => some 0
        | true =>
          match findPivO ops u rows with
          | some j => some (j + 1)
          | none => none) = none →
      u (ground.getAt ops.unit
        (ground.getAt [] (r :: rows) a) 0) = true
    cases hu : u (ground.getAt ops.unit r 0) with
    | false =>
      intro h
      nomatch (show some 0 = (none : Option Nat) from h)
    | true =>
      cases hf : findPivO ops u rows with
      | some j =>
        intro h
        nomatch (show some (j + 1) = (none : Option Nat) from h)
      | none =>
        intro _

        | 0 => exact hu
