name: browO_len
statement:
private theorem browO_len {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (Cf : DCof γ ops R.rel) :
    ∀ (prev piv h : γ) (ta tb : List γ), ta.length = tb.length →
    (browO Cf prev piv h ta tb).length = ta.length
  | _, _, _, [], _, _ => rfl
  | _, _, _, _ :: _, [], hl => Nat.noConfusion hl
  | prev, piv, h, _ :: ta, _ :: tb, hl => by
    show (browO Cf prev piv h ta tb).length + 1 = ta.length + 1
    rw [browO_len Cf prev piv h ta tb (Nat.succ.inj hl)]

/
prior pivot's cofactor. -/
private theorem browO_entry {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (Cf : DCof γ ops R.rel) :
    ∀ (prev piv h : γ) (ta tb : List γ) (c : Nat), c < ta.length →
    ta.length = tb.length →
    ground.getAt ops.unit (browO Cf prev piv h ta tb) c
      = jointEntryO Cf prev piv (ground.getAt ops.unit tb c) h
          (ground.getAt ops.unit ta c)
  | _, _, _, [], _, _, hc, _ => absurd hc (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | _, _, _, _ :: _, [], _, _, hl => Nat.noConfusion hl
  | _, _, _, _ :: _, _ :: _, 0, _, _ => rfl
  | prev, piv, h, _ :: ta, _ :: tb, c + 1, hc, hl => by
    show ground.getAt ops.unit (browO Cf prev piv h ta tb) c = _
    rw [browO_entry Cf prev piv h ta tb c
      (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hc) (Nat.succ.inj hl)]
    rfl

/
the prior pivot and the current block: the vacant block reads the
graded one, a lone row its own leading entry graded, and a wider
block pivots at its first test-failing leading entry, the pivot
row moved to the front and every further row stepped through the
exact cofactor, with a pivot-free leading column reading the sum's
unit outright. -/
private def detDGoO {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ} {ov : γ → γ → Prop}
    (Cf : DCof γ ops ov) : Nat → Bool → γ → List (List γ) → γ
  | _, _, _, [] => ops.one
  | _ + 1, s, _, [r] => signAtO ops s (ground.getAt ops.unit r 0)
  | fuel + 1, s, prev, r :: r' :: rest =>
    match findPivO ops Cf.unitB (r :: r' :: rest) with
    | none => ops.unit
    | some i =>
      let rows
proof:
:= r :: r' :: rest
      let r0 := ground.getAt [] rows i
      let piv := ground.getAt ops.unit r0 0
      let r0t := r0.drop 1
      detDGoO Cf fuel (Bool.xor s (places.parityOf i)) piv
        ((rows.eraseIdx i).map (fun ri =>
          browO Cf prev piv (ground.getAt ops.unit ri 0)
            (ri.drop 1) r0t))
  | 0, _, _, _ :: _ => ops.unit

name: lovOfBoundedO
statement:
private theorem lovOfBoundedO {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (C : DCore γ ops R.rel) :
    ∀ (u v : List γ), u.length = v.length →
    (∀ i, i < u.length →
      R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit u i) (ground.getAt ops.unit v i)) →
    poly.listOV ops R u v
  | [], [], _, _ => trivial
  | [], _ :: _, hl, _ => nomatch hl
  | _ :: _, [], hl, _ => nomatch hl
  | _ :: u, _ :: v, hl, h =>
    ⟨h 0 (Nat.succ_pos _),
     lovOfBoundedO C u v (Nat.succ.inj hl)
       (fun i hi => h (i + 1) (Nat.succ_lt_succ hi))⟩

/
private theorem utOfBoundedO {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (C : DCore γ ops R.rel) :
    ∀ u : List γ,
    (∀ i, i < u.length →
      R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit u i) ops.unit) →
    poly.unitTailO ops R u
  | [], _ => trivial
  | _ :: u, h =>
    ⟨h 0 (Nat.succ_pos _),
     utOfBoundedO C u (fun i hi => h (i + 1) (Nat.succ_lt_succ hi))⟩

/
private theorem utTransferO {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (C : DCore γ ops R.rel) {q r : List γ}
    (h : poly.listOV ops R q r) (hq : poly.unitTailO ops R q) :
    poly.unitTailO ops R r
proof:
:=
  utOfGetAt (fun k =>
    C.ovTrans (C.ovSymm (lovGetAt C h k)) (utGetAt C hq k))

name: swapOfNullAddO
statement:
private theorem swapOfNullAddO {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel) :
    ∀ (a b : List γ), a.length = b.length →
    poly.unitTailO ops R (vecAddO ops a b) →
    poly.listOV ops R b (a.map ops.swap)
  | [], [], _, _ => trivial
  | [], _ :: _, hl, _ => nomatch hl
  | _ :: _, [], hl, _ => nomatch hl
  | x :: a, _ :: b, hl, h =>
    ⟨L.addCancel
        (L.ovTrans h.1 (L.ovSymm (annihDerived L x)))
        (L.ovRefl x),

/
row's clearing. -/
private theorem comboO_append_one {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel) (n : Nat) :
    ∀ (cs : List γ) (c : γ) (M : List (List γ)) (v : List γ),
    cs.length = M.length → rowsLen n M → v.length = n →
    poly.listOV ops R (comboO ops n (cs ++ [c]) (M ++ [v]))
      (vecAddO ops (comboO ops n cs M) (vecScaleO ops c v))
  | [], c, [], v, _, _, hv => by
    show poly.listOV ops R
      (vecAddO ops (vecScaleO ops c v) (List.replicate n ops.unit))
      (vecAddO ops (List.replicate n ops.unit) (vecScaleO ops c v))
    refine lovOfBoundedO L.toDCore _ _ ?_ ?_
    · rw [length_vecAddO ops _ _ n
          (by rw [length_vecScaleO, hv])
          (ground.length_replicate ops.unit n),
        length_vecAddO ops _ _ n
          (ground.length_replicate ops.unit n)
          (by rw [length_vecScaleO, hv])]
    · intro i hi
      rw [length_vecAddO ops _ _ n
          (by rw [length_vecScaleO, hv])
          (ground.length_replicate ops.unit n)] at hi
      rw [getAt_vecAddO ops _ _ i
          (by rw [length_vecScaleO, hv]; exact hi)
          (by rw [ground.length_replicate ops.unit n]; exact hi),
        getAt_vecAddO ops _ _ i
          (by rw [ground.length_replicate ops.unit n]; exact hi)
          (by rw [length_vecScaleO, hv]; exact hi)]
      exact L.addComm _ _
  | [], _, _ :: _, _, hcl, _, _ => nomatch hcl
  | _ :: _, _, [], _, hcl, _, _ => nomatch hcl
  | c' :: cs, c, r :: M, v, hcl, hM, hv => by
    have hIH
proof:
:= comboO_append_one L n cs c M v
      (Nat.succ.inj hcl) hM.2 hv
    have hMv : rowsLen n (M ++ [v]) := by
      refine rowsLen_intro (M ++ [v]) (fun p hp => ?_)
      rw [ground.length_append] at hp
      rw [ground.getAt_append ([] : List γ) M [v] p]
      match Nat.lt_or_ge p M.length with
      | .inl hpM =>
        rw [if_pos hpM]
        exact rowsLen_getAt M p hM.2 hpM
      | .inr hge =>
        rw [if_neg (fun hlt =>
            Nat.lt_irrefl p (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hlt hge)),
          show p = M.length from
            Nat.le_antisymm (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hp) hge,
          Nat.sub_self]
        exact hv
    have hl1 : (comboO ops n (cs ++ [c]) (M ++ [v])).length = n :=
      length_comboO ops n _ _ hMv
    show poly.listOV ops R
      (vecAddO ops (vecScaleO ops c' r)
        (comboO ops n (cs ++ [c]) (M ++ [v])))
      (vecAddO ops
        (vecAddO ops (vecScaleO ops c' r) (comboO ops n cs M))
        (vecScaleO ops c v))
    refine lovOfBoundedO L.toDCore _ _ ?_ ?_
    · rw [length_vecAddO ops _ _ n
          (by rw [length_vecScaleO, hM.1]) hl1,
        length_vecAddO ops _ _ n
          (length_vecAddO ops _ _ n
            (by rw [length_vecScaleO, hM.1])
            (length_comboO ops n cs M hM.2))
          (by rw [length_vecScaleO, hv])]
    · intro i hi
      rw [length_vecAddO ops _ _ n
          (by rw [length_vecScaleO, hM.1]) hl1] at hi
      have h1 : i < (vecScaleO ops c' r).length := by
        rw [length_vecScaleO, hM.1]; exact hi
      have h2 : i < (comboO ops n cs M).length := by
        rw [length_comboO ops n cs M hM.2]; exact hi
      have h3 : i < (vecScaleO ops c v).length := by
        rw [length_vecScaleO, hv]; exact hi
      have h4 : i < (comboO ops n (cs ++ [c]) (M ++ [v])).length := by
        rw [hl1]; exact hi
      rw [getAt_vecAddO ops _ _ i h1 h4,
        getAt_vecAddO ops _ _ i
          (by
            rw [length_vecAddO ops _ _ n
              (by rw [length_vecScaleO, hM.1])
              (length_comboO ops n cs M hM.2)]
            exact hi)
          h3,
        getAt_vecAddO ops _ _ i h1 h2]
      refine L.ovTrans
        (L.addCongr (L.ovRefl _) (lovGetAt L.toDCore hIH i)) ?_
      rw [getAt_vecAddO ops _ _ i h2 h3]
      exact L.ovSymm (L.addAssoc _ _ _)

        ops.swap)
    refine lovTrans C

          rw [length_comboO_mapCoef ops n ops.swap cs M,

    exact vecAddO_swapMap C (vecScaleO ops c r) (comboO ops n cs M)

name: length_comboO_mapCoef
statement:
private theorem length_comboO_mapCoef {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ)
    (n : Nat) (f : γ → γ) :
    ∀ (cs : List γ) (M : List (List γ)),
    (comboO ops n (cs.map f) M).length

  | [], _ => rfl
  | _ :: _, [] => rfl

        (comboO ops n (cs.map f) M)).length

        (comboO ops n cs M)).length
    exact length_vecAddO_congr ops _ _ _ _
      (by rw [length_vecScaleO, length_vecScaleO])
      (length_comboO_mapCoef ops n f cs M)

/
balance partner memberwise. -/

        (comboO ops n (cs.map ops.swap) M))
      ((vecAddO ops (vecScaleO ops c r) (comboO ops n cs M)).map
        ops.swap)
    refine lovTrans C
      (vecAddO_lovCongr C
        (by rw [length_vecScaleO, ground.length_map,
          length_vecScaleO])
        (by
          rw [length_comboO_mapCoef ops n ops.swap cs M,
            ground.length_map])
        (vecScaleO_swapMap C c r) (comboO_swapMap C n cs M)) ?_
    exact vecAddO_swapMap C (vecScaleO ops c r) (comboO ops n cs M)

name: leadAtO_congr
statement:
private theorem leadAtO_congr {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ) (k : Nat)
    (m1 m2 : List (List γ))
    (hlead : ∀ a, a < k →
      ground.getAt [] m1 a = ground.getAt [] m2 a) :
    leadAtO ops k m1 = leadAtO ops k m2
proof:
:= by
  show (List.range k).map (fun a =>
      keepColsO ops (List.range k) (ground.getAt [] m1 a))
    = (List.range k).map (fun a =>
      keepColsO ops (List.range k) (ground.getAt [] m2 a))
  exact ground.map_congr_members _ _ (List.range k)
    (fun a ha => by rw [hlead a (ground.ltOfMem ha)])

name: borderAtO_diag
proof:
:= by
  show ((List.range k) ++ [k]).map (fun a =>
      keepColsO ops ((List.range k) ++ [k]) (ground.getAt [] m a))
    = (List.range (k + 1)).map (fun a =>
      keepColsO ops (List.range (k + 1)) (ground.getAt [] m a))
  rw [ground.range_succ k]

name: keepColsO_range
proof:
:= by
  refine ground.getAt_ext ops.unit _ _
    (by rw [keepColsO_len, ground.length_range, hr]) ?_
  intro i hi
  rw [keepColsO_len, ground.length_range] at hi
  rw [keepColsO_entry ops _ _ i
      (by rw [ground.length_range]; exact hi),
    ground.getAt_range n i hi]

name: leadAtO_full
proof:
:= by
  refine ground.getAt_ext [] _ _ (by rw [leadAtO_len]) ?_
  intro a ha
  rw [leadAtO_len] at ha
  show ground.getAt [] ((List.range m.length).map (fun a =>
    keepColsO ops (List.range m.length) (ground.getAt [] m a))) a = _
  rw [ground.getAt_map 0 [] _ (List.range m.length) a
      (by rw [ground.length_range]; exact ha),
    ground.getAt_range m.length a ha,
    keepColsO_range ops m.length (ground.getAt [] m a)
      (rowsLen_getAt m a hsq ha)]

name: keepColsO_eraseIdx
statement:
private theorem keepColsO_eraseIdx {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ)
    (ks : List Nat) (x : Nat) (r : List γ) (k : Nat)
    (hk : ks.length = k) :
    (keepColsO ops (ks ++ [x]) r).eraseIdx k = keepColsO ops ks r
proof:
:= by
  show ((ks ++ [x]).map
      (fun j => ground.getAt ops.unit r j)).eraseIdx k = _
  rw [ground.map_append]
  exact eraseIdx_append_len _ _ k (by rw [ground.length_map, hk])

name: leadBordO_len
statement:
private theorem leadBordO_len {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ) (k : Nat)
    (m : List (List γ)) : (leadBordO ops k m).length = k
proof:
:=
  ground.length_mapRange _ k

name: borderAtO_erase
proof:
:= by
  show (((List.range k) ++ [i]).map (fun a =>
    keepColsO ops ((List.range k) ++ [k])
      (ground.getAt [] m a))).eraseIdx k = _
  rw [ground.map_append]
  exact eraseIdx_append_len _ _ k
    (ground.length_mapRange _ _)

name: leadBordO_strike
statement:
private theorem leadBordO_strike {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ)
    (k : Nat) (m : List (List γ)) :
    (leadBordO ops k m).map (fun r => r.eraseIdx k)
      = leadAtO ops k m
proof:
:= by
  show ((List.range k).map (fun a =>
    keepColsO ops (List.range k ++ [k]) (ground.getAt [] m a))).map
      (fun r => r.eraseIdx k) = _
  rw [ground.map_map]
  show (List.range k).map (fun a =>
      (keepColsO ops (List.range k ++ [k])
        (ground.getAt [] m a)).eraseIdx k)
    = (List.range k).map (fun a =>
      keepColsO ops (List.range k) (ground.getAt [] m a))
  exact ground.map_congr_all _ _
    (fun a => keepColsO_eraseIdx ops (List.range k) k
      (ground.getAt [] m a) k (ground.length_range k)) (List.range k)

name: bordFamO_len
statement:
private theorem bordFamO_len {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ) (k : Nat)
    (m : List (List γ)) : (bordFamO ops k m).length = k
proof:
:=

name: bordVecO_range
statement:
private theorem bordVecO_range {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ) (k : Nat)
    (m : List (List γ)) :
    bordVecO ops k m = (List.range (k + 1)).map
      (fun j => sgnPO ops (k + j) (cof0O ops (leadBordO ops k m) j))
proof:
:= by
  rw [ground.range_succ k, ground.map_append]
  rfl

name: cofVecO_bord
proof:
:= by
  show (List.range (borderAtO ops k i k m).length).map (fun j =>
      sgnPO ops (k + j)
        (cof0O ops ((borderAtO ops k i k m).eraseIdx k) j))
    = bordVecO ops k m
  rw [borderAtO_len, borderAtO_erase, bordVecO_range]

name: bordO_expand
statement:
private theorem bordO_expand {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
    (m : List (List γ)) (k i : Nat) :
    R.rel (detO ops (borderAtO ops k i k m))
      (dotO ops
        (keepColsO ops (List.range k ++ [k]) (ground.getAt [] m i))
        (bordVecO ops k m))
proof:
:= by
  have hkB : k < (borderAtO ops k i k m).length := by
    rw [borderAtO_len]
    exact Nat.lt_succ_self k
  have hrow : ground.getAt [] (borderAtO ops k i k m) k
      = keepColsO ops (List.range k ++ [k])
        (ground.getAt [] m i) := by
    rw [borderAtO_row ops k i k m k (Nat.lt_succ_self k),
      if_neg (Nat.lt_irrefl k)]
  have hb : (ground.getAt [] (borderAtO ops k i k m) k).length
      = (borderAtO ops k i k m).length := by
    rw [hrow, keepColsO_len, borderKeys_len, borderAtO_len]
  have h1 := detO_List.set_dot L (borderAtO ops k i k m) k hkB
    (ground.getAt [] (borderAtO ops k i k m) k) hb
  rw [ground.set_self ([] : List γ) (borderAtO ops k i k m) k hkB,
    cofVecO_bord ops m k i, hrow] at h1
  exact h1

name: bordVecO_last_off
statement:
private theorem bordVecO_last_off {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (C : DCore γ ops R.rel)
    (m : List (List γ)) (k : Nat)
    (hP : ¬ R.rel (detO ops (leadAtO ops k m)) ops.unit) :
    ¬ R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit (bordVecO ops k m) k)
      ops.unit
proof:
:= by
  have hlast := cof0O_last C (leadBordO ops k m)
  rw [leadBordO_len, leadBordO_strike] at hlast
  have hget : ground.getAt ops.unit (bordVecO ops k m) k
      = sgnPO ops (k + k) (cof0O ops (leadBordO ops k m) k) := by
    show ground.getAt ops.unit
      (bordFamO ops k m
        ++ [sgnPO ops (k + k) (cof0O ops (leadBordO ops k m) k)]) k
      = _
    rw [ground.getAt_append ops.unit (bordFamO ops k m) _ k,
      bordFamO_len, if_neg (Nat.lt_irrefl k),
      show k - k = 0 from Nat.sub_self k]
    rfl
  rw [hget]
  intro hu
  exact hP (C.ovTrans (C.ovSymm hlast) (sgnPO_unit C hu))

statement:
private theorem colRowsO_len {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ) (k : Nat)

proof:

name: colRowsO_getAt
statement:
private theorem colRowsO_getAt {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ) (k : Nat)
    (m : List (List γ)) (i : Nat) (hi : i < k) :
    ground.getAt [] (colRowsO ops k m) i
      = ground.getAt [] (transposeO ops m) i
proof:
:= by
  show ground.getAt [] ((List.range k).map
    (fun j => ground.getAt [] (transposeO ops m) j)) i = _
  rw [ground.getAt_map 0 [] _ (List.range k) i
      (by rw [ground.length_range]; exact hi),
    ground.getAt_range k i hi]

name: colRowsO_succ
statement:
private theorem colRowsO_succ {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ) (k : Nat)
    (m : List (List γ)) :
    colRowsO ops (k + 1) m
      = colRowsO ops k m ++ [ground.getAt [] (transposeO ops m) k]
proof:
:= by
  show (List.range (k + 1)).map
    (fun j => ground.getAt [] (transposeO ops m) j) = _
  rw [ground.range_succ k, ground.map_append]
  rfl

name: colRowsO_rows
statement:
private theorem colRowsO_rows {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ) (k : Nat)
    (m : List (List γ)) (hsq : rowsLen m.length m)
    (hkm : k ≤ m.length) :
    rowsLen m.length (colRowsO ops k m)
proof:
:= by
  refine rowsLen_intro (colRowsO ops k m) (fun i hi => ?_)
  rw [colRowsO_len] at hi
  rw [colRowsO_getAt ops k m i hi]
  exact rowsLen_getAt (transposeO ops m) i (rowsLen_transposeO ops m)
    (by
      rw [length_transposeO ops m hsq
        (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le i)
          (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hi hkm))]
      exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hi hkm)

name: stall_unitO
statement:
private theorem stall_unitO {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
    (Cf : DCof γ ops R.rel)
    (m : List (List γ)) (hsq : rowsLen m.length m)
    (k : Nat) (hk : k < m.length)
    (hP : ¬ R.rel (detO ops (leadAtO ops k m)) ops.unit)
    (hB : ∀ i, k ≤ i → i < m.length →
      R.rel (detO ops (borderAtO ops k i k m)) ops.unit) :
    R.rel (detO ops m) ops.unit
proof:
:= by
  have hall : ∀ i, i < m.length →
      R.rel (detO ops (borderAtO ops k i k m)) ops.unit := by
    intro i hi
    match Nat.lt_or_ge i k with
    | .inr hik => exact hB i hik hi
    | .inl hik =>
      refine detO_rows_equal L (m := borderAtO ops k i k m) hik
        (by rw [borderAtO_len]; exact Nat.lt_succ_self k) ?_
      rw [borderAtO_row ops k i k m i
          (Nat.lt_trans hik (Nat.lt_succ_self k)),
        borderAtO_row ops k i k m k (Nat.lt_succ_self k),
        if_pos hik, if_neg (Nat.lt_irrefl k)]
  have hpos : 0 < m.length := Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le k) hk
  have hMl : (transposeO ops m).length = m.length :=
    length_transposeO ops m hsq hpos
  have hMrow : ∀ j, j < m.length →
      (ground.getAt [] (transposeO ops m) j).length = m.length :=
    fun j hj => rowsLen_getAt (transposeO ops m) j
      (rowsLen_transposeO ops m) (by rw [hMl]; exact hj)
  have hkM : k < (transposeO ops m).length := by
    rw [hMl]
    exact hk
  have hcr1 : rowsLen m.length (colRowsO ops (k + 1) m) :=
    colRowsO_rows ops (k + 1) m hsq hk
  have hcr0 : rowsLen m.length (colRowsO ops k m) :=
    colRowsO_rows ops k m hsq (Nat.le_of_lt hk)
  have hnull : ∀ i, i < m.length →
      R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit
        (comboO ops m.length (bordVecO ops k m)
          (colRowsO ops (k + 1) m)) i) ops.unit := by
    intro i hi
    have hmap : (colRowsO ops (k + 1) m).map
        (fun r => ground.getAt ops.unit r i)
      = keepColsO ops (List.range k ++ [k])
          (ground.getAt [] m i) := by
      show ((List.range (k + 1)).map
          (fun j => ground.getAt [] (transposeO ops m) j)).map
          (fun r => ground.getAt ops.unit r i)
        = (List.range k ++ [k]).map
          (fun j => ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] m i) j)
      rw [ground.map_map, ← ground.range_succ k]
      refine ground.map_congr_members _ _ (List.range (k + 1))
        (fun j hj => ?_)
      have hjk : j < k + 1 := ground.ltOfMem hj
      exact getAt_transposeO ops ops.unit m hsq j i
        (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hjk) hk) hi
    refine L.ovTrans
      (comboO_getAt L m.length (bordVecO ops k m)
        (colRowsO ops (k + 1) m) i hcr1 hi) ?_
    rw [hmap]
    refine L.ovTrans (dotO_comm L.toDCore _ _) ?_
    exact L.ovTrans (L.ovSymm (bordO_expand L m k i)) (hall i hi)
  have hwl : (ground.getAt [] (transposeO ops m) k).length
      = m.length := hMrow k hk
  have hsplit := comboO_append_one L m.length (bordFamO ops k m)
    (sgnPO ops (k + k) (cof0O ops (leadBordO ops k m) k))
    (colRowsO ops k m)
    (ground.getAt [] (transposeO ops m) k)
    (by rw [bordFamO_len, colRowsO_len]) hcr0 hwl
  rw [← colRowsO_succ ops k m] at hsplit
  have hutX : poly.unitTailO ops R
      (comboO ops m.length (bordVecO ops k m)
        (colRowsO ops (k + 1) m)) :=
    utOfBoundedO L.toDCore _ (fun p hp => by
      rw [length_comboO ops m.length _ _ hcr1] at hp
      exact hnull p hp)
  have hut : poly.unitTailO ops R
      (vecAddO ops (comboO ops m.length (bordFamO ops k m)
          (colRowsO ops k m))
        (vecScaleO ops
          (sgnPO ops (k + k) (cof0O ops (leadBordO ops k m) k))
          (ground.getAt [] (transposeO ops m) k))) :=
    utTransferO L.toDCore hsplit hutX
  have hcl := swapOfNullAddO L
    (comboO ops m.length (bordFamO ops k m) (colRowsO ops k m))
    (vecScaleO ops
      (sgnPO ops (k + k) (cof0O ops (leadBordO ops k m) k))
      (ground.getAt [] (transposeO ops m) k))
    (by
      rw [length_comboO ops m.length _ _ hcr0, length_vecScaleO,
        hwl])
    hut
  have hcl2 := lovTrans L.toDCore hcl
    (lovSymm L.toDCore
      (comboO_swapMap L.toDCore m.length (bordFamO ops k m)
        (colRowsO ops k m)))
  have hclen : (vecScaleO ops
      (sgnPO ops (k + k) (cof0O ops (leadBordO ops k m) k))
      (ground.getAt [] (transposeO ops m) k)).length
      = (transposeO ops m).length := by
    rw [length_vecScaleO, hwl, hMl]
  have hcomlen : (comboO ops m.length
      ((bordFamO ops k m).map ops.swap)
      (colRowsO ops k m)).length = (transposeO ops m).length := by
    rw [length_comboO ops m.length _ _ hcr0, hMl]
  have hd1 : R.rel (detO ops (List.set (transposeO ops m) k
      (vecScaleO ops
        (sgnPO ops (k + k) (cof0O ops (leadBordO ops k m) k))
        (ground.getAt [] (transposeO ops m) k))))
      (ops.mul (sgnPO ops (k + k) (cof0O ops (leadBordO ops k m) k))
        (detO ops (transposeO ops m))) := by
    refine L.ovTrans
      (detO_List.set_dot L (transposeO ops m) k hkM _ hclen) ?_
    refine L.ovTrans (dotO_vecScale_left L _ _ _) ?_
    exact L.mulCongr (L.ovRefl _)
      (cofVecO_diag L (transposeO ops m) k hkM
        (by rw [hMl]; exact hwl))
  have hd2 : R.rel (detO ops (List.set (transposeO ops m) k
      (vecScaleO ops
        (sgnPO ops (k + k) (cof0O ops (leadBordO ops k m) k))
        (ground.getAt [] (transposeO ops m) k))))
      (detO ops (List.set (transposeO ops m) k
        (comboO ops m.length ((bordFamO ops k m).map ops.swap)
          (colRowsO ops k m)))) := by
    refine L.ovTrans
      (detO_List.set_dot L (transposeO ops m) k hkM _ hclen) ?_
    refine L.ovTrans (dotO_comm L.toDCore _ _) ?_
    refine L.ovTrans
      (dotO_congr_right L (cofVecO ops (transposeO ops m) k) _ _
        (by rw [hclen, hcomlen])
        (fun p _ => lovGetAt L.toDCore hcl2 p)) ?_
    refine L.ovTrans (dotO_comm L.toDCore _ _) ?_
    exact L.ovSymm
      (detO_List.set_dot L (transposeO ops m) k hkM _ hcomlen)
  have hd3 : R.rel (detO ops (List.set (transposeO ops m) k
      (comboO ops m.length ((bordFamO ops k m).map ops.swap)
        (colRowsO ops k m)))) ops.unit := by
    have hcomb := detO_List.set_combo L (transposeO ops m) k hkM
      ((bordFamO ops k m).map ops.swap) (colRowsO ops k m)
      (by rw [hMl]; exact hcr0)
    rw [hMl] at hcomb
    refine L.ovTrans hcomb ?_
    refine dotO_null_right L _ _ (fun p hp => ?_)
    rw [ground.length_map, colRowsO_len] at hp
    rw [ground.getAt_map ([] : List γ) ops.unit
      (fun row => detO ops (List.set (transposeO ops m) k row))
      (colRowsO ops k m) p (by rw [colRowsO_len]; exact hp),
      colRowsO_getAt ops k m p hp]
    refine detO_rows_equal L
      (m := List.set (transposeO ops m) k
        (ground.getAt [] (transposeO ops m) p)) hp
      (by rw [ground.length_set]; exact hkM) ?_
    rw [ground.getAt_set_ne [] (transposeO ops m) k p _
        (Nat.ne_of_lt hp),
      ground.getAt_set_self [] (ground.getAt [] (transposeO ops m) p)
        (transposeO ops m) k hkM]
  have hfin : R.rel (ops.mul
      (sgnPO ops (k + k) (cof0O ops (leadBordO ops k m) k))
      (detO ops (transposeO ops m))) ops.unit :=
    L.ovTrans (L.ovSymm hd1) (L.ovTrans hd2 hd3)
  have hoff : ¬ R.rel (sgnPO ops (k + k)
      (cof0O ops (leadBordO ops k m) k)) ops.unit := by
    have h := bordVecO_last_off L.toDCore m k hP
    have hget : ground.getAt ops.unit (bordVecO ops k m) k
        = sgnPO ops (k + k) (cof0O ops (leadBordO ops k m) k) := by
      show ground.getAt ops.unit
        (bordFamO ops k m
          ++ [sgnPO ops (k + k)
            (cof0O ops (leadBordO ops k m) k)]) k = _
      rw [ground.getAt_append ops.unit (bordFamO ops k m) _ k,
        bordFamO_len, if_neg (Nat.lt_irrefl k),
        show k - k = 0 from Nat.sub_self k]
      rfl
    rw [hget] at h
    exact h
  have hMdet : R.rel (detO ops (transposeO ops m)) ops.unit :=
    mulCancelUnitO L Cf hoff hfin
  exact L.ovTrans
    (L.ovSymm (detO_transpose L.toDCore m hsq)) hMdet

name: detDGo_eqO
statement:
private theorem detDGo_eqO {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
    (Cf : DCof γ ops R.rel) :
    ∀ (fuel : Nat) (s : Bool) (prev : γ)
      (block : List (List γ))
      (k : Nat) (m m' : List (List γ)),
      rowsLen m'.length m' →
      m'.length = m.length →
      R.rel (detO ops m') (signAtO ops s (detO ops m)) →
      k + block.length = m.length →
      fuel = block.length →
      rowsLen block.length block →
      R.rel prev (detO ops (leadAtO ops k m')) →
      ¬ R.rel prev ops.unit →
      (∀ a b, a < block.length → b < block.length →
        R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit
          (ground.getAt [] block a) b)
          (detO ops (borderAtO ops k (k + a) (k + b) m'))) →
      (block = [] → R.rel ops.one (detO ops m)) →
      R.rel (detDGoO Cf fuel s prev block) (detO ops m)
  | 0, _, _, [], _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, hnil =>
    hnil rfl
  | _ + 1, _, _, [], _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, hnil =>
    hnil rfl
  | 0, _, _, _ :: _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, hfuel, _, _, _, _, _ =>
    Nat.noConfusion hfuel
  | _ + 1, s, prev, [r], k, m, m', hsq', hlen, hdet, hkn, _, _,
      _, _, hentry, _ => by
    have h1 : R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit r 0)
        (detO ops (borderAtO ops k k k m'))
proof:
:=
      hentry 0 0 (Nat.succ_pos 0) (Nat.succ_pos 0)
    have hk1 : k + 1 = m'.length := by
      rw [hlen]
      exact hkn
    rw [borderAtO_diag ops k m', hk1, leadAtO_full ops m' hsq']
      at h1
    show R.rel (signAtO ops s (ground.getAt ops.unit r 0))
      (detO ops m)
    refine L.ovTrans
      (signAtO_congr L.toDCore s (L.ovTrans h1 hdet)) ?_
    exact signAtO_signAtO L.toDCore s (detO ops m)
  | fuel + 1, s, prev, r :: r' :: rest, k, m, m', hsq', hlen,
      hdet, hkn, hfuel, hrows, hprev, hpoff, hentry, _ => by
    have hklt : k < m.length := by
      rw [← hkn]
      exact Nat.add_lt_add_left (Nat.succ_pos (rest.length + 1)) k
    have hklt' : k < m'.length := by
      rw [hlen]
      exact hklt
    show R.rel (match findPivO ops Cf.unitB (r :: r' :: rest) with
        | none => ops.unit
        | some i =>
          detDGoO Cf fuel (Bool.xor s (places.parityOf i))
            (ground.getAt ops.unit
              (ground.getAt [] (r :: r' :: rest) i) 0)
            (((r :: r' :: rest).eraseIdx i).map (fun ri =>
              browO Cf prev
                (ground.getAt ops.unit
                  (ground.getAt [] (r :: r' :: rest) i) 0)
                (ground.getAt ops.unit ri 0)
                (ri.drop 1)
                ((ground.getAt [] (r :: r' :: rest) i).drop 1))))
      (detO ops m)
    cases hfp : findPivO ops Cf.unitB (r :: r' :: rest) with
    | none =>
      have hstall : ∀ x, k ≤ x → x < m'.length →
          R.rel (detO ops (borderAtO ops k x k m')) ops.unit := by
        intro x hkx hxm
        match Nat.le.dest hkx with
        | ⟨a, hka⟩ =>
          have hab : a < (r :: r' :: rest).length :=
            Nat.lt_of_add_lt_add_left
              (show k + a < k + (r :: r' :: rest).length from by
                rw [hkn, ← hlen, hka]
                exact hxm)
          have hxu : R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit
              (ground.getAt [] (r :: r' :: rest) a) 0)
              ops.unit :=
            Cf.unitB_true
              (findPivO_none ops Cf.unitB (r :: r' :: rest) hfp
                a hab)
          have h3 : R.rel (detO ops (borderAtO ops k (k + a) k m'))
              ops.unit :=
            L.ovTrans
              (L.ovSymm (hentry a 0 hab (Nat.succ_pos _))) hxu
          rw [hka] at h3
          exact h3
      have hPoff : ¬ R.rel (detO ops (leadAtO ops k m')) ops.unit :=
        fun hu => hpoff (L.ovTrans hprev hu)
      have hfinal := stall_unitO L Cf m' hsq' k hklt' hPoff hstall
      have h4 := signAtO_congr L.toDCore s
        (L.ovTrans (L.ovSymm hfinal) hdet)
      exact L.ovTrans (L.ovSymm (signAtO_unit L.toDCore s))
        (L.ovTrans h4 (signAtO_signAtO L.toDCore s _))
    | some i =>
      have hi := findPivO_read ops Cf.unitB (r :: r' :: rest) i hfp
      have hilt : i < (r :: r' :: rest).length := hi.1
      have hki : k + i < m'.length := by
        rw [hlen, ← hkn]
        exact Nat.add_lt_add_left hilt k
      have hml : (moveRow i k m').length = m'.length :=
        length_moveRow i k m'
      have hmsq : rowsLen (moveRow i k m').length
          (moveRow i k m') := by
        rw [hml]
        exact rowsLen_moveRow i k m' hsq'
      have hmlen : (moveRow i k m').length = m.length := by
        rw [hml, hlen]
      have hlead : ∀ a, a < k →
          ground.getAt [] (moveRow i k m') a
            = ground.getAt [] m' a :=
        fun a ha => getAt_moveRow_lt ([] : List γ) i k m' a ha hki
      have hpivrow : ground.getAt [] (moveRow i k m') k
          = ground.getAt [] m' (k + i) :=
        getAt_moveRow_self ([] : List γ) i k m' hki
      have hleadeq : leadAtO ops k (moveRow i k m')
          = leadAtO ops k m' :=
        leadAtO_congr ops k (moveRow i k m') m' hlead
      have hb0 : borderAtO ops k k k (moveRow i k m')
          = borderAtO ops k (k + i) k m' :=
        borderAtO_congr ops k k (k + i) k (moveRow i k m') m'
          hlead hpivrow
      have hpiv : R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit
            (ground.getAt [] (r :: r' :: rest) i) 0)
          (detO ops (leadAtO ops (k + 1) (moveRow i k m'))) := by
        have h1 : R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit
              (ground.getAt [] (r :: r' :: rest) i) 0)
            (detO ops (borderAtO ops k (k + i) k m')) :=
          hentry i 0 hilt (Nat.succ_pos _)
        rw [← hb0, borderAtO_diag] at h1
        exact h1
      have hpivoff : ¬ R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit
            (ground.getAt [] (r :: r' :: rest) i) 0) ops.unit :=
        Cf.unitB_false hi.2
      have hdet2 : R.rel (detO ops (moveRow i k m'))
          (signAtO ops (Bool.xor s (places.parityOf i))
            (detO ops m)) :=
        L.ovTrans (detO_moveRow L.toDCore i k m' hki)
          (L.ovTrans
            (signAtO_congr L.toDCore (places.parityOf i) hdet)
            (signAtO_comp L.toDCore (places.parityOf i) s
              (detO ops m)))
      have herl : ((r :: r' :: rest).eraseIdx i).length
          = rest.length + 1 :=
        Nat.succ.inj (ground.length_eraseIdx (r :: r' :: rest) i
          hilt)
      have hblen : (((r :: r' :: rest).eraseIdx i).map (fun ri =>
          browO Cf prev (ground.getAt ops.unit
              (ground.getAt [] (r :: r' :: rest) i) 0)
            (ground.getAt ops.unit ri 0) (ri.drop 1)
            ((ground.getAt [] (r :: r' :: rest) i).drop 1))).length
          = rest.length + 1 := by
        rw [ground.length_map, herl]
      have hrowlen : ∀ x, x < (r :: r' :: rest).length →
          (ground.getAt [] (r :: r' :: rest) x).length
            = rest.length + 2 :=
        fun x hx => rowsLen_getAt (r :: r' :: rest) x hrows hx
      have hdrop : ∀ x, x < (r :: r' :: rest).length →
          ((ground.getAt [] (r :: r' :: rest) x).drop 1).length
            = rest.length + 1 := by
        intro x hx
        have h1 := length_drop1 (ground.getAt [] (r :: r' :: rest) x)
          (by rw [hrowlen x hx]; exact Nat.succ_pos _)
        rw [hrowlen x hx] at h1
        exact Nat.succ.inj h1
      have hrowl : ∀ p, p < rest.length + 1 →
          ground.getAt []
            (((r :: r' :: rest).eraseIdx i).map (fun ri =>
              browO Cf prev (ground.getAt ops.unit
                  (ground.getAt [] (r :: r' :: rest) i) 0)
                (ground.getAt ops.unit ri 0) (ri.drop 1)
                ((ground.getAt []
                  (r :: r' :: rest) i).drop 1))) p
            = browO Cf prev (ground.getAt ops.unit
                (ground.getAt [] (r :: r' :: rest) i) 0)
              (ground.getAt ops.unit
                (ground.getAt [] (r :: r' :: rest) (liftIx i p)) 0)
              ((ground.getAt [] (r :: r' :: rest)
                (liftIx i p)).drop 1)
              ((ground.getAt [] (r :: r' :: rest) i).drop 1) := by
        intro p hp
        rw [ground.getAt_map ([] : List γ) ([] : List γ)
            (fun ri => browO Cf prev (ground.getAt ops.unit
              (ground.getAt [] (r :: r' :: rest) i) 0)
              (ground.getAt ops.unit ri 0) (ri.drop 1)
              ((ground.getAt [] (r :: r' :: rest) i).drop 1))
            ((r :: r' :: rest).eraseIdx i) p
            (by rw [herl]; exact hp),
          getAt_eraseIdx_lift]
      refine detDGo_eqO L Cf fuel (Bool.xor s (places.parityOf i))
        (ground.getAt ops.unit
          (ground.getAt [] (r :: r' :: rest) i) 0)
        (((r :: r' :: rest).eraseIdx i).map (fun ri =>
          browO Cf prev (ground.getAt ops.unit
              (ground.getAt [] (r :: r' :: rest) i) 0)
            (ground.getAt ops.unit ri 0) (ri.drop 1)
            ((ground.getAt [] (r :: r' :: rest) i).drop 1)))
        (k + 1) m (moveRow i k m') hmsq hmlen hdet2 ?_ ?_ ?_
        hpiv hpivoff ?_ ?_
      · rw [hblen, addShift]
        exact hkn
      · rw [hblen]
        exact Nat.succ.inj hfuel
      · refine rowsLen_intro
          (((r :: r' :: rest).eraseIdx i).map (fun ri =>
            browO Cf prev (ground.getAt ops.unit
                (ground.getAt [] (r :: r' :: rest) i) 0)
              (ground.getAt ops.unit ri 0) (ri.drop 1)
              ((ground.getAt [] (r :: r' :: rest) i).drop 1)))
          (fun p hp => ?_)
        rw [hblen] at hp
        rw [hrowl p hp, hblen,
          browO_len Cf prev (ground.getAt ops.unit
              (ground.getAt [] (r :: r' :: rest) i) 0)
            (ground.getAt ops.unit
              (ground.getAt [] (r :: r' :: rest) (liftIx i p)) 0)
            ((ground.getAt [] (r :: r' :: rest)
              (liftIx i p)).drop 1)
            ((ground.getAt [] (r :: r' :: rest) i).drop 1)
            (by rw [hdrop _ (liftIx_lt hp), hdrop _ hilt]),
          hdrop _ (liftIx_lt hp)]
      · intro a b ha hb
        rw [hblen] at ha hb
        have hIm : k + 1 + a < m'.length := by
          rw [hlen, ← hkn, addShift]
          exact Nat.add_lt_add_left (Nat.succ_lt_succ ha) k
        have hJm : k + 1 + b < m'.length := by
          rw [hlen, ← hkn, addShift]
          exact Nat.add_lt_add_left (Nat.succ_lt_succ hb) k
        have hlifta : liftIx i a < (r :: r' :: rest).length :=
          liftIx_lt ha
        have hcol : k + 1 + b = k + (b + 1) := addShift k b
        have hrowmove : ground.getAt [] (moveRow i k m') (k + 1 + a)
            = ground.getAt [] m' (k + liftIx i a) :=
          getAt_moveRow_tail ([] : List γ) i k m' a hki hIm
        have hbA : borderAtO ops k (k + 1 + a) (k + 1 + b)
            (moveRow i k m')
            = borderAtO ops k (k + liftIx i a) (k + (b + 1)) m' := by
          rw [hcol]
          exact borderAtO_congr ops k (k + 1 + a) (k + liftIx i a)
            (k + (b + 1)) (moveRow i k m') m' hlead hrowmove
        have hbB : borderAtO ops k (k + 1 + a) k (moveRow i k m')
            = borderAtO ops k (k + liftIx i a) k m' :=
          borderAtO_congr ops k (k + 1 + a) (k + liftIx i a) k
            (moveRow i k m') m' hlead hrowmove
        have hbC : borderAtO ops k k (k + 1 + b) (moveRow i k m')
            = borderAtO ops k (k + i) (k + (b + 1)) m' := by
          rw [hcol]
          exact borderAtO_congr ops k k (k + i) (k + (b + 1))
            (moveRow i k m') m' hlead hpivrow
        have eA : R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit
              (ground.getAt [] (r :: r' :: rest) (liftIx i a))
              (b + 1))
            (detO ops (borderAtO ops k (k + 1 + a) (k + 1 + b)
              (moveRow i k m'))) := by
          rw [hbA]
          exact hentry (liftIx i a) (b + 1) hlifta
            (Nat.succ_lt_succ hb)
        have eH : R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit
              (ground.getAt [] (r :: r' :: rest) (liftIx i a)) 0)
            (detO ops (borderAtO ops k (k + 1 + a) k
              (moveRow i k m'))) := by
          rw [hbB]
          exact hentry (liftIx i a) 0 hlifta (Nat.succ_pos _)
        have eB : R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit
              (ground.getAt [] (r :: r' :: rest) i) (b + 1))
            (detO ops (borderAtO ops k k (k + 1 + b)
              (moveRow i k m'))) := by
          rw [hbC]
          exact hentry i (b + 1) hilt (Nat.succ_lt_succ hb)
        have eP : R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit
              (ground.getAt [] (r :: r' :: rest) i) 0)
            (detO ops (borderAtO ops k k k (moveRow i k m'))) := by
          rw [hb0]
          exact hentry i 0 hilt (Nat.succ_pos _)
        have hsyl := sylvesterO L (moveRow i k m') k (k + 1 + a)
          (k + 1 + b)
        have hsyl2 : R.rel (ops.add
            (ops.mul (detO ops (leadAtO ops k (moveRow i k m')))
              (detO ops (borderAtO ops (k + 1) (k + 1 + a)
                (k + 1 + b) (moveRow i k m'))))
            (ops.swap (ops.swap
              (ops.mul (detO ops (borderAtO ops k (k + 1 + a) k
                  (moveRow i k m')))
                (detO ops (borderAtO ops k k (k + 1 + b)
                  (moveRow i k m')))))))
            (ops.mul (detO ops (borderAtO ops k k k
                (moveRow i k m')))
              (detO ops (borderAtO ops k (k + 1 + a) (k + 1 + b)
                (moveRow i k m')))) :=
          L.ovTrans
            (L.addCongr (L.ovRefl _)
              (L.toDCore.swapSwap _)) hsyl
        have hprod := L.ovSymm (swapMoveO L hsyl2)
        have hprev' : R.rel prev
            (detO ops (leadAtO ops k (moveRow i k m'))) := by
          rw [hleadeq]
          exact hprev
        have hEN : R.rel (ops.add
            (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit
                (ground.getAt [] (r :: r' :: rest) i) 0)
              (ground.getAt ops.unit
                (ground.getAt [] (r :: r' :: rest) (liftIx i a))
                (b + 1)))
            (ops.swap (ops.mul
              (ground.getAt ops.unit
                (ground.getAt [] (r :: r' :: rest) (liftIx i a)) 0)
              (ground.getAt ops.unit
                (ground.getAt [] (r :: r' :: rest) i) (b + 1)))))
            (ops.add
              (ops.mul (detO ops (borderAtO ops k k k
                  (moveRow i k m')))
                (detO ops (borderAtO ops k (k + 1 + a) (k + 1 + b)
                  (moveRow i k m'))))
              (ops.swap (ops.mul
                (detO ops (borderAtO ops k (k + 1 + a) k
                  (moveRow i k m')))
                (detO ops (borderAtO ops k k (k + 1 + b)
                  (moveRow i k m')))))) :=
          L.addCongr (L.mulCongr eP eA)
            (L.toDCore.swapCongr (L.mulCongr eH eB))
        have hE := L.ovTrans
          (L.mulCongr hprev'
            (L.ovRefl
              (detO ops (borderAtO ops (k + 1) (k + 1 + a)
                (k + 1 + b) (moveRow i k m')))))
          (L.ovTrans hprod (L.ovSymm hEN))
        have hsound := Cf.cofSound hpoff hE
        have hcancel := Cf.mulCancel hpoff
          (L.ovTrans hsound (L.ovSymm hE))
        rw [hrowl a ha, browO_entry Cf prev
            (ground.getAt ops.unit
              (ground.getAt [] (r :: r' :: rest) i) 0)
            (ground.getAt ops.unit
              (ground.getAt [] (r :: r' :: rest) (liftIx i a)) 0)
            ((ground.getAt [] (r :: r' :: rest)
              (liftIx i a)).drop 1)
            ((ground.getAt [] (r :: r' :: rest) i).drop 1) b
            (by rw [hdrop _ hlifta]; exact hb)
            (by rw [hdrop _ hlifta, hdrop _ hilt]),
          getAt_drop1, getAt_drop1]
        exact hcancel
      · intro hnl
        rw [hnl] at hblen
        exact Nat.noConfusion hblen

name: detDO_eq
statement:
private theorem detDO_eq {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
    (Cf : DCof γ ops R.rel) (m : List (List γ))
    (hsq : rowsLen m.length m) :
    R.rel (detDO Cf m) (detO ops m)
proof:
:= by
  refine detDGo_eqO L Cf m.length false ops.one m 0 m m hsq
    rfl (L.ovRefl _) (Nat.zero_add m.length) rfl hsq ?_ Cf.oneOff
    ?_ ?_
  · show R.rel ops.one (ops.add ops.one ops.unit)
    exact L.ovSymm (L.addUnit ops.one)
  · intro a b ha hb
    rw [Nat.zero_add, Nat.zero_add,
      show borderAtO ops 0 a b m
        = [[ground.getAt ops.unit
            (ground.getAt [] m a) b]] from rfl]
    exact L.ovSymm (detO_single L _)
  · intro hm
    rw [hm]
    show R.rel ops.one (ops.add ops.one ops.unit)
    exact L.ovSymm (L.addUnit ops.one)

name: unitBL_index
statement:
private theorem unitBL_index {γ : Type} (u : γ → Bool) (d : γ) :
    ∀ p : List γ, unitBL u p = true →
    ∀ k, k < p.length → u (ground.getAt d p k) = true
  | [], _, k, hk => absurd hk (Nat.not_lt_zero k)
  | c :: p, h, k, hk => by
    have hs
proof:
:= ground.andSplitB (show (u c && unitBL u p) = true from h)
    match k with
    | 0 => exact hs.1
    | k + 1 =>
      exact unitBL_index u d p hs.2 k (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hk)

name: unitBL_ut
statement:
private theorem unitBL_ut {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (Cf : DCof γ ops R.rel) :
    ∀ p : List γ, unitBL Cf.unitB p = true →
    poly.unitTailO ops R p
  | [], _ => trivial
  | c :: p, h => by
    have hs
proof:
:= ground.andSplitB

name: utReadB
statement:
private theorem utReadB {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}

    unitBL Cf.unitB p = true

private theorem lastOffIdx_none {γ : Type} (u : γ → Bool) :

    unitBL u p = true

    revert h

    | none =>

private theorem lastOffIdx_read {γ : Type} (u : γ → Bool) (d : γ) :
    ∀ (p : List γ) (t : Nat), lastOffIdx u p = some t →
    t < p.length ∧ u (ground.getAt d p t) = false ∧
      ∀ k, t < k → u (ground.getAt d p k) = true ∨ p.length ≤ k
  | [], t, h => by
    nomatch (show (none : Option Nat) = some t from h)
  | c :: p, t, h => by
    revert h

        | some t' => some (t' + 1)
        | none =>

          | false => some 0
          | true => none) = some t →
      t < (c :: p).length ∧

    cases hp : lastOffIdx u p with
    | some t' =>
      intro h
      have ht
proof:
:= Option.some.inj h
      have hr := lastOffIdx_read u d p t' hp
      rw [← ht]
      refine ⟨Nat.succ_lt_succ hr.1, hr.2.1, fun k hk => ?_⟩
      match k, hk with
      | k + 1, hk =>
        match hr.2.2 k (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hk) with
        | .inl ht2 => exact .inl ht2
        | .inr hlen => exact .inr (Nat.succ_le_succ hlen)
    | none =>
      cases hc : u c with
      | false =>
        intro h
        have ht := Option.some.inj h
        rw [← ht]
        refine ⟨Nat.succ_pos _, hc, fun k hk => ?_⟩
        match k, hk with
        | k + 1, _ =>
          match Nat.lt_or_ge k p.length with
          | .inl hkp =>
            exact .inl (unitBL_index u d p
              (lastOffIdx_none u p hp) k hkp)
          | .inr hge => exact .inr (Nat.succ_le_succ hge)
      | true =>

        nomatch (show (none : Option Nat) = some t from h)

name: utMulLeftO
proof:
:= by

name: mulBeyondTopO
statement:
private theorem mulBeyondTopO {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel) :
    ∀ (P : List γ) (tP : Nat) (d : List γ) (tD : Nat),
    (∀ k, tP < k → R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit P k) ops.unit) →
    (∀ k, tD < k → R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit d k) ops.unit) →
    ∀ j, tP + tD < j →
    R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit (poly.mulLO ops P d) j) ops.unit
  | [], _, _, _, _, _, j, _ => by
    show R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit ([] : List γ) j) ops.unit
    rw [ground.getAt_over ops.unit ([] : List γ) j (Nat.zero_le j)]
    exact L.ovRefl _
  | c :: P', tP, d, tD, hP, hD, j, hj => by
    show R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit
        (poly.addLO ops (d.map (ops.mul c))
          (ops.unit :: poly.mulLO ops P' d)) j) ops.unit
    refine L.ovTrans (getAtAddO L _ _ j) ?_
    have hfirst : R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit (d.map (ops.mul c)) j)
        ops.unit
proof:
:= by
      match Nat.lt_or_ge j d.length with
      | .inl hjd =>
        rw [ground.getAt_map ops.unit ops.unit (fun y => ops.mul c y)
          d j hjd]
        refine L.ovTrans
          (L.mulCongr (L.ovRefl c)
            (hD j (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_add_left tD tP) hj)))
          (L.mulUnit c)
      | .inr hge =>
        rw [ground.getAt_over ops.unit (d.map (ops.mul c)) j
          (by rw [ground.length_map]; exact hge)]
        exact L.ovRefl _
    match tP, j, hj with
    | 0, j + 1, _ =>
      have hut : poly.unitTailO ops R P' :=
        utOfGetAt (fun k =>
          hP (k + 1) (Nat.succ_pos k))
      have hsec : R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit
          (ops.unit :: poly.mulLO ops P' d) (j + 1)) ops.unit := by
        show R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit (poly.mulLO ops P' d) j)
          ops.unit
        exact utGetAt L.toDCore (utMulLeftO L hut d) j
      exact L.ovTrans (L.addCongr hfirst hsec) (L.unitAdd ops.unit)
    | tP + 1, j + 1, hj =>
      have hsec : R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit
          (ops.unit :: poly.mulLO ops P' d) (j + 1)) ops.unit := by
        show R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit (poly.mulLO ops P' d) j)
          ops.unit
        exact mulBeyondTopO L P' tP d tD
          (fun k hk => hP (k + 1) (Nat.succ_lt_succ hk)) hD j
          (by
            have h1 : tP + 1 + tD < j + 1 := hj
            rw [Nat.add_right_comm tP 1 tD] at h1
            exact Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ h1)
      exact L.ovTrans (L.addCongr hfirst hsec) (L.unitAdd ops.unit)

name: mulTopCoeffO
statement:
private theorem mulTopCoeffO {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel) :
    ∀ (P : List γ) (tP : Nat) (d : List γ) (tD : Nat),
    (∀ k, tP < k → R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit P k) ops.unit) →
    (∀ k, tD < k → R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit d k) ops.unit) →
    R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit (poly.mulLO ops P d) (tP + tD))
      (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit P tP)
        (ground.getAt ops.unit d tD))
  | [], tP, d, tD, _, _ => by
    show R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit ([] : List γ) (tP + tD))
      (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit ([] : List γ) tP)
        (ground.getAt ops.unit d tD))
    rw [ground.getAt_over ops.unit ([] : List γ) (tP + tD)
        (Nat.zero_le _),
      ground.getAt_over ops.unit ([] : List γ) tP (Nat.zero_le _)]
    exact L.toDCore.ovSymm (mulUnitLeftO L _)
  | c :: P', 0, d, tD, hP, hD => by
    show R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit
        (poly.addLO ops (d.map (ops.mul c))
          (ops.unit :: poly.mulLO ops P' d)) (0 + tD))
      (ops.mul c (ground.getAt ops.unit d tD))
    rw [Nat.zero_add]
    refine L.ovTrans (getAtAddO L _ _ tD) ?_
    have hfirst : R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit (d.map (ops.mul c)) tD)
        (ops.mul c (ground.getAt ops.unit d tD))
proof:
:= by
      match Nat.lt_or_ge tD d.length with
      | .inl hjd =>
        rw [ground.getAt_map ops.unit ops.unit (fun y => ops.mul c y)
          d tD hjd]
        exact L.ovRefl _
      | .inr hge =>
        rw [ground.getAt_over ops.unit (d.map (ops.mul c)) tD
            (by rw [ground.length_map]; exact hge),
          ground.getAt_over ops.unit d tD hge]
        exact L.toDCore.ovSymm (L.mulUnit c)
    have hut : poly.unitTailO ops R P' :=
      utOfGetAt (fun k => hP (k + 1) (Nat.succ_pos k))
    have hsec : R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit
        (ops.unit :: poly.mulLO ops P' d) tD) ops.unit := by
      match tD with
      | 0 => exact L.ovRefl _
      | t + 1 =>
        show R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit (poly.mulLO ops P' d) t)
          ops.unit
        exact utGetAt L.toDCore (utMulLeftO L hut d) t
    exact L.ovTrans (L.addCongr hfirst hsec) (L.addUnit _)
  | c :: P', tP + 1, d, tD, hP, hD => by
    show R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit
        (poly.addLO ops (d.map (ops.mul c))
          (ops.unit :: poly.mulLO ops P' d)) (tP + 1 + tD))
      (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit P' tP)
        (ground.getAt ops.unit d tD))
    refine L.ovTrans (getAtAddO L _ _ (tP + 1 + tD)) ?_
    have hstep : tP + 1 + tD = (tP + tD) + 1 :=
      Nat.add_right_comm tP 1 tD
    have hfirst : R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit (d.map (ops.mul c))
        (tP + 1 + tD)) ops.unit := by
      match Nat.lt_or_ge (tP + 1 + tD) d.length with
      | .inl hjd =>
        rw [ground.getAt_map ops.unit ops.unit (fun y => ops.mul c y)
          d _ hjd]
        refine L.ovTrans
          (L.mulCongr (L.ovRefl c) (hD _ (by
            rw [hstep]
            exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_add_left tD tP)
              (Nat.lt_succ_self (tP + tD))))) ?_
        exact L.mulUnit c
      | .inr hge =>
        rw [ground.getAt_over ops.unit (d.map (ops.mul c)) _
          (by rw [ground.length_map]; exact hge)]
        exact L.ovRefl _
    have hsec : R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit
        (ops.unit :: poly.mulLO ops P' d) (tP + 1 + tD))
        (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit P' tP)
          (ground.getAt ops.unit d tD)) := by
      rw [hstep]
      show R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit (poly.mulLO ops P' d) (tP + tD))
        _
      exact mulTopCoeffO L P' tP d tD
        (fun k hk => hP (k + 1) (Nat.succ_lt_succ hk)) hD
    exact L.ovTrans (L.addCongr hfirst hsec) (L.unitAdd _)

name: zeroDivL
proof:
:= by
  cases hsP : lastOffIdx Cf.unitB P with
  | none => rw [lastOffIdx_none Cf.unitB P hsP] at hPB; nomatch hPB
  | some tP =>
  cases hsD : lastOffIdx Cf.unitB d with
  | none => rw [lastOffIdx_none Cf.unitB d hsD] at hdB; nomatch hdB
  | some tD =>
    have hPr := lastOffIdx_read Cf.unitB ops.unit P tP hsP
    have hDr := lastOffIdx_read Cf.unitB ops.unit d tD hsD
    have hPbey : ∀ k, tP < k →
        R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit P k) ops.unit := fun k hk => by
      match hPr.2.2 k hk with
      | .inl hb => exact Cf.unitB_true hb
      | .inr hlen =>
        rw [ground.getAt_over ops.unit P k hlen]
        exact L.ovRefl _
    have hDbey : ∀ k, tD < k →
        R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit d k) ops.unit := fun k hk => by
      match hDr.2.2 k hk with
      | .inl hb => exact Cf.unitB_true hb
      | .inr hlen =>
        rw [ground.getAt_over ops.unit d k hlen]
        exact L.ovRefl _
    have htop := mulTopCoeffO L P tP d tD hPbey hDbey
    have hcoeff := utGetAt L.toDCore hut (tP + tD)
    have hmul : R.rel (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit P tP)
        (ground.getAt ops.unit d tD)) ops.unit :=
      L.ovTrans (L.ovSymm htop) hcoeff
    exact absurd
      (mulCancelUnitO L Cf (Cf.unitB_false hPr.2.1) hmul)
      (Cf.unitB_false hDr.2.1)

name: mulCancelL
proof:
:= by
  have hPB : unitBL Cf.unitB P = false := by
    cases hb : unitBL Cf.unitB P with
    | true => exact absurd (poly.lovNilO _ _ (unitBL_ut Cf P hb)) hP
    | false => rfl
  have hut : poly.unitTailO ops R
      (poly.addLO ops (poly.mulLO ops P a)
        ((poly.mulLO ops P b).map ops.swap)) := diffUtO L h
  have hchain : poly.listOV ops R
      (poly.mulLO ops P (poly.addLO ops a (b.map ops.swap)))
      (poly.addLO ops (poly.mulLO ops P a)
        ((poly.mulLO ops P b).map ops.swap)) :=
    lovTrans L.toDCore (mulSumO L P a (b.map ops.swap))
      (addCongrO L (lovRefl L.toDCore _) (mulSwapRightO L P b))
  have hutd : poly.unitTailO ops R
      (poly.mulLO ops P (poly.addLO ops a (b.map ops.swap))) :=
    utTransferO L.toDCore (lovSymm L.toDCore hchain) hut
  cases hd : unitBL Cf.unitB (poly.addLO ops a (b.map ops.swap)) with
  | true => exact ovOfDiffO L (unitBL_ut Cf _ hd)
  | false => exact (zeroDivL L Cf hPB hd hutd).elim

name: cofGo_sound
statement:
private theorem cofGo_sound {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
    (Cf : DCof γ ops R.rel) {P : List γ} {tP : Nat}
    (hPbey : ∀ k, tP < k → R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit P k) ops.unit)
    (hPoff : ¬ R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit P tP) ops.unit) :
    ∀ (fuel : Nat) (E X : List γ),
    (∀ k, fuel ≤ k → R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit E k) ops.unit) →
    poly.listOV ops R (poly.mulLO ops P X) E →
    poly.listOV ops R
      (poly.mulLO ops P
        (cofGo Cf tP (ground.getAt ops.unit P tP) P fuel E)) E
  | 0, E, _, hfE, _ =>
    utOv L.toDCore (mulNilO L.toDCore P)
      (utOfGetAt (fun k => hfE k (Nat.zero_le k)))
  | fuel + 1, E, X, hfE, hE => by
    show poly.listOV ops R (poly.mulLO ops P
      (match lastOffIdx Cf.unitB E with
       | none => []
       | some tE =>
         match Nat.ble tP tE with
         | false => []
         | true =>
           let m := shiftUpO ops (tE - tP)
             [Cf.cof (ground.getAt ops.unit E tE)
               (ground.getAt ops.unit P tP)]
           poly.addLO ops m
             (cofGo Cf tP (ground.getAt ops.unit P tP) P fuel
               ((poly.addLO ops E
                 ((poly.mulLO ops P m).map ops.swap)).map
                 Cf.nrm)))) E
    cases hsE : lastOffIdx Cf.unitB E with
    | none =>
      show poly.listOV ops R (poly.mulLO ops P []) E
      exact utOv L.toDCore (mulNilO L.toDCore P)
        (unitBL_ut Cf E (lastOffIdx_none Cf.unitB E hsE))
    | some tE =>
    show poly.listOV ops R (poly.mulLO ops P
      (match Nat.ble tP tE with
       | false => []
       | true =>
         let m := shiftUpO ops (tE - tP)
           [Cf.cof (ground.getAt ops.unit E tE)
             (ground.getAt ops.unit P tP)]
         poly.addLO ops m
           (cofGo Cf tP (ground.getAt ops.unit P tP) P fuel
             ((poly.addLO ops E
               ((poly.mulLO ops P m).map ops.swap)).map
               Cf.nrm)))) E
    have hEr
proof:
:= lastOffIdx_read Cf.unitB ops.unit E tE hsE
    have hEbey : ∀ k, tE < k →
        R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit E k) ops.unit := fun k hk => by
      match hEr.2.2 k hk with
      | .inl hb => exact Cf.unitB_true hb
      | .inr hlen =>
        rw [ground.getAt_over ops.unit E k hlen]
        exact L.ovRefl _
    have hEoff : ¬ R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit E tE) ops.unit :=
      Cf.unitB_false hEr.2.1
    cases hXB : unitBL Cf.unitB X with
    | true =>
      have hutPX : poly.unitTailO ops R (poly.mulLO ops P X) :=
        utTransferO L.toDCore
          (lovSymm L.toDCore
            (mulCongrO L P (poly.lovNilO _ _ (unitBL_ut Cf X hXB))))
          (mulNilO L.toDCore P)
      have hutE : poly.unitTailO ops R E :=
        utTransferO L.toDCore hE hutPX
      exact absurd (utGetAt L.toDCore hutE tE) hEoff
    | false =>
    cases hsX : lastOffIdx Cf.unitB X with
    | none =>
      rw [lastOffIdx_none Cf.unitB X hsX] at hXB
      nomatch hXB
    | some tX =>
      have hXr := lastOffIdx_read Cf.unitB ops.unit X tX hsX
      have hXbey : ∀ k, tX < k →
          R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit X k) ops.unit :=
        fun k hk => by
        match hXr.2.2 k hk with
        | .inl hb => exact Cf.unitB_true hb
        | .inr hlen =>
          rw [ground.getAt_over ops.unit X k hlen]
          exact L.ovRefl _
      have hXoff : ¬ R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit X tX) ops.unit :=
        Cf.unitB_false hXr.2.1
      have htopX := mulTopCoeffO L P tP X tX hPbey hXbey
      have hcoeffE : R.rel (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit P tP)
          (ground.getAt ops.unit X tX))
          (ground.getAt ops.unit E (tP + tX)) :=
        L.ovTrans (L.ovSymm htopX)
          (lovGetAt L.toDCore hE (tP + tX))
      have hEc_off : ¬ R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit E (tP + tX))
          ops.unit := fun hu =>
        absurd
          (mulCancelUnitO L Cf hPoff (L.ovTrans hcoeffE hu))
          hXoff
      have hbeyPX : ∀ k, tP + tX < k →
          R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit E k) ops.unit := fun k hk =>
        L.ovTrans
          (L.ovSymm (lovGetAt L.toDCore hE k))
          (mulBeyondTopO L P tP X tX hPbey hXbey k hk)
      have htE_le : tE ≤ tP + tX := by
        match Nat.lt_or_ge (tP + tX) tE with
        | .inl h => exact absurd (hbeyPX tE h) hEoff
        | .inr h => exact h
      have htE_ge : tP + tX ≤ tE := by
        match Nat.lt_or_ge tE (tP + tX) with
        | .inl h =>
          refine absurd ?_ hEc_off
          match hEr.2.2 (tP + tX) h with
          | .inl hb => exact Cf.unitB_true hb
          | .inr hlen =>
            rw [ground.getAt_over ops.unit E (tP + tX) hlen]
            exact L.ovRefl _
        | .inr h => exact h
      have htE_eq : tE = tP + tX := Nat.le_antisymm htE_le htE_ge
      cases hble : Nat.ble tP tE with
      | false =>
        have hge : tP ≤ tE := by
          rw [htE_eq]
          exact Nat.le_add_right tP tX
        have hbt : Nat.ble tP tE = true := Nat.ble_eq_true_of_le hge
        rw [hble] at hbt
        nomatch hbt
      | true =>
        show poly.listOV ops R (poly.mulLO ops P
          (poly.addLO ops
            (shiftUpO ops (tE - tP)
              [Cf.cof (ground.getAt ops.unit E tE)
                (ground.getAt ops.unit P tP)])
            (cofGo Cf tP (ground.getAt ops.unit P tP) P fuel
              ((poly.addLO ops E
                ((poly.mulLO ops P
                  (shiftUpO ops (tE - tP)
                    [Cf.cof (ground.getAt ops.unit E tE)
                      (ground.getAt ops.unit P tP)])).map
                  ops.swap)).map Cf.nrm)))) E
        have hgs : tE - tP = tX := by
          rw [htE_eq, ground.addSubSelfL]
        rw [hgs]
        have hs_bey : ∀ k, tX < k →
            R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit
              (shiftUpO ops tX
                [Cf.cof (ground.getAt ops.unit E tE)
                  (ground.getAt ops.unit P tP)]) k)
              ops.unit := by
          intro k hk
          rw [ground.getAt_over ops.unit _ k
            (by rw [lenShiftO ops tX]; exact hk)]
          exact L.ovRefl _
        have hcoeffE' : R.rel (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit P tP)
            (ground.getAt ops.unit X tX))
            (ground.getAt ops.unit E tE) := by
          rw [htE_eq]
          exact hcoeffE
        have hc : R.rel (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit P tP)
            (Cf.cof (ground.getAt ops.unit E tE)
              (ground.getAt ops.unit P tP)))
            (ground.getAt ops.unit E tE) :=
          Cf.cofSound hPoff hcoeffE'
        have hs_top := mulTopCoeffO L P tP
          (shiftUpO ops tX
            [Cf.cof (ground.getAt ops.unit E tE)
              (ground.getAt ops.unit P tP)]) tX hPbey hs_bey
        have hs_at : ground.getAt ops.unit
            (shiftUpO ops tX
              [Cf.cof (ground.getAt ops.unit E tE)
                (ground.getAt ops.unit P tP)]) tX
            = Cf.cof (ground.getAt ops.unit E tE)
                (ground.getAt ops.unit P tP) :=
          getAtShiftAddO ops tX
            [Cf.cof (ground.getAt ops.unit E tE)
              (ground.getAt ops.unit P tP)] 0
        have hPs_top : R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit
            (poly.mulLO ops P
              (shiftUpO ops tX
                [Cf.cof (ground.getAt ops.unit E tE)
                  (ground.getAt ops.unit P tP)])) (tP + tX))
            (ground.getAt ops.unit E tE) := by
          rw [hs_at] at hs_top
          exact L.ovTrans hs_top hc
        have hPs_topE := hPs_top
        rw [← htE_eq] at hPs_topE
        have hPs_bey : ∀ k, tE < k →
            R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit
              (poly.mulLO ops P
                (shiftUpO ops tX
                  [Cf.cof (ground.getAt ops.unit E tE)
                    (ground.getAt ops.unit P tP)])) k)
              ops.unit := by
          intro k hk
          refine mulBeyondTopO L P tP _ tX hPbey hs_bey k ?_
          rw [← htE_eq]
          exact hk
        have hE'bey0 : ∀ k, fuel ≤ k →
            R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit
              (poly.addLO ops E
                ((poly.mulLO ops P
                  (shiftUpO ops tX
                    [Cf.cof (ground.getAt ops.unit E tE)
                      (ground.getAt ops.unit P tP)])).map
                  ops.swap)) k) ops.unit := by
          intro k hk
          have htEf : tE ≤ fuel := by
            match Nat.lt_or_ge fuel tE with
            | .inl h => exact absurd (hfE tE h) hEoff
            | .inr h => exact h
          have htEk : tE ≤ k := Nat.le_trans htEf hk
          refine L.ovTrans (getAtAddO L _ _ k) ?_
          refine L.ovTrans
            (L.addCongr (L.ovRefl _)
              (getAtNegO L.toDCore _ k)) ?_
          match Nat.lt_or_ge tE k with
          | .inl hlt =>
            refine L.ovTrans
              (L.addCongr (hEbey k hlt)
                (L.toDCore.swapCongr (hPs_bey k hlt))) ?_
            exact L.ovTrans
              (L.addCongr (L.ovRefl _) L.toDCore.swapUnit)
              (L.addUnit _)
          | .inr hge =>
            have hkE : k = tE := Nat.le_antisymm hge htEk
            rw [hkE]
            refine L.ovTrans
              (L.addCongr (L.ovRefl _)
                (L.toDCore.swapCongr hPs_topE)) ?_
            exact annihDerived L _
        have hE'bey : ∀ k, fuel ≤ k →
            R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit
              ((poly.addLO ops E
                ((poly.mulLO ops P
                  (shiftUpO ops tX
                    [Cf.cof (ground.getAt ops.unit E tE)
                      (ground.getAt ops.unit P tP)])).map
                  ops.swap)).map Cf.nrm) k) ops.unit := by
          intro k hk
          match Nat.lt_or_ge k (poly.addLO ops E
              ((poly.mulLO ops P
                (shiftUpO ops tX
                  [Cf.cof (ground.getAt ops.unit E tE)
                    (ground.getAt ops.unit P tP)])).map
                ops.swap)).length with
          | .inl hlt =>
            rw [ground.getAt_map ops.unit ops.unit Cf.nrm _ k hlt]
            exact L.ovTrans (Cf.nrmOv _) (hE'bey0 k hk)
          | .inr hge =>
            rw [ground.getAt_over ops.unit _ k
              (by rw [ground.length_map]; exact hge)]
            exact L.ovRefl _
        have hX' : poly.listOV ops R
            (poly.mulLO ops P
              (poly.addLO ops X
                ((shiftUpO ops tX
                  [Cf.cof (ground.getAt ops.unit E tE)
                    (ground.getAt ops.unit P tP)]).map ops.swap)))
            ((poly.addLO ops E
              ((poly.mulLO ops P
                (shiftUpO ops tX
                  [Cf.cof (ground.getAt ops.unit E tE)
                    (ground.getAt ops.unit P tP)])).map
                ops.swap)).map Cf.nrm) :=
          lovTrans L.toDCore
            (lovTrans L.toDCore
              (mulSumO L P X _)
              (addCongrO L hE (mulSwapRightO L P _)))
            (lovSymm L.toDCore
              (mapSelfLov Cf.nrm Cf.nrmOv _))
        have hIH := cofGo_sound L Cf hPbey hPoff fuel
          ((poly.addLO ops E
            ((poly.mulLO ops P
              (shiftUpO ops tX
                [Cf.cof (ground.getAt ops.unit E tE)
                  (ground.getAt ops.unit P tP)])).map ops.swap)).map
            Cf.nrm)
          (poly.addLO ops X
            ((shiftUpO ops tX
              [Cf.cof (ground.getAt ops.unit E tE)
                (ground.getAt ops.unit P tP)]).map ops.swap))
          hE'bey hX'
        refine lovTrans L.toDCore (mulSumO L P _ _) ?_
        refine lovTrans L.toDCore
          (addCongrO L (lovRefl L.toDCore _) hIH) ?_
        refine lovTrans L.toDCore
          (addCongrO L (lovRefl L.toDCore _)
            (mapSelfLov Cf.nrm Cf.nrmOv _)) ?_
        refine lovTrans L.toDCore
          (addCommO L _ _) ?_
        refine lovTrans L.toDCore
          (addAssocO L _ _ _) ?_
        refine lovTrans L.toDCore (addCommO L _ _) ?_
        refine utAddLovO L ?_ E
        exact utTransferO L.toDCore
          (addCommO L _ _)
          (diffUtO L (lovRefl L.toDCore
            (poly.mulLO ops P
              (shiftUpO ops tX
                [Cf.cof (ground.getAt ops.unit E tE)
                  (ground.getAt ops.unit P tP)]))))

name: pdetD_eq
statement:
theorem pdetD_eq : ∀ (m : List (List poly.Poly)),
    rowsLen m.length m →
    poly.oneValue (pdetD m)
      (minorO poly.polyOps poly.pnorm id m)
proof:
:=
  fun m hsq =>
  lovTrans (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairCore
    (detDO_eq (R := poly.polyRead)
      (polyLawsO (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairLaws)
      (polyCofO (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairLaws bpairCof) m hsq)
    (lovSymm (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairCore
      (minorO_detO (R := poly.polyRead)
        (polyLawsO (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairLaws)
        poly.pnorm id
        (fun x => poly.pnorm_oneValue x)
        (fun x => lovRefl (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairCore x)
        m hsq))

name: ppdetD_eq
statement:
theorem ppdetD_eq : ∀ (m : List (List poly.PPoly)),
    rowsLen m.length m →
    poly.ppOneValue (ppdetD m)
      (minorO (poly.polyO poly.polyOps) poly.pnormP id m)
proof:
:=
  fun m hsq =>
  lovTrans (R := poly.polyRead)
    (polyLawsO (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairLaws).toDCore
    (detDO_eq (R := poly.listRead poly.polyOps poly.polyRead)
      (polyLawsO (R := poly.polyRead)
        (polyLawsO (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairLaws))
      (polyCofO (R := poly.polyRead)
        (polyLawsO (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairLaws)
        (polyCofO (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairLaws bpairCof)) m hsq)
    (lovSymm (R := poly.polyRead)
      (polyLawsO (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairLaws).toDCore
      (minorO_detO (R := poly.listRead poly.polyOps poly.polyRead)
        (polyLawsO (R := poly.polyRead)
          (polyLawsO (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairLaws))
        poly.pnormP id
        (fun x => poly.pnormP_ppOneValue x)
        (fun x => lovRefl (R := poly.polyRead)
          (polyLawsO (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairLaws).toDCore x)
        m hsq))

name: joinIndep_single
statement:
theorem joinIndep_single {α : Type} (dot : α → α → BPair) (v : α)
    (hv : ¬ (dot v v).oneValue BPair.unit) : joinIndep dot [] v = true
proof:
:= by
  show (if (detD [[dot v v]]).oneValue BPair.unit then false else true)
    = true
  refine if_neg (fun hu => hv ?_)
  exact BPair.oneValue_trans (BPair.oneValue_symm (detL_single _))
    (BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.oneValue_symm (detD_eq [[dot v v]] ⟨rfl, trivial⟩)) hu)

name: traceB_read
statement:
private theorem traceB_read {st : DState} {k n : Nat} {G : Mat}
    (h : traceB st k n G = true) : TraceP st k n G
proof:
:= by
  have hs := ground.andSplitB h
  refine ⟨ground.beqEqOf hs.1, fun j hj => ?_⟩
  have hj' : (decide ((stepAt st j).1.oneValue
        (detL (borderAt (k + j) (k + j) (k + j) G)))
      && !(decide ((stepAt st j).1.oneValue BPair.unit))
      && ((stepAt st j).2.length + (k + j) + 1 == n)
      && (List.range (stepAt st j).2.length).all (fun c =>
        decide ((ground.getAt BPair.unit (stepAt st j).2 c).oneValue
          (detL (borderAt (k + j) (k + j) (k + j + 1 + c) G)))))
      = true :=
    ground.all_range_read st.length hs.2 j hj
  have h1 := ground.andSplitB hj'
  have h2 := ground.andSplitB h1.1
  have h3 := ground.andSplitB h2.1
  refine ⟨of_decide_eq_true h3.1,
    of_decide_eq_false (ground.boolFalseOfNot h3.2),
    ground.beqEqOf h2.2, fun c hc => ?_⟩
  exact of_decide_eq_true (ground.all_range_read _ h1.2 c hc)

name: traceB_intro
statement:
private theorem traceB_intro {st : DState} {k n : Nat} {G : Mat}
    (h : TraceP st k n G) : traceB st k n G = true
proof:
:= by
  refine ground.andIntroB (ground.eqBeqOf h.1) ?_
  refine ground.all_range_intro st.length (fun j hj => ?_)
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := h.2 j hj
  show (decide ((stepAt st j).1.oneValue
        (detL (borderAt (k + j) (k + j) (k + j) G)))
      && !(decide ((stepAt st j).1.oneValue BPair.unit))
      && ((stepAt st j).2.length + (k + j) + 1 == n)
      && (List.range (stepAt st j).2.length).all (fun c =>
        decide ((ground.getAt BPair.unit (stepAt st j).2 c).oneValue
          (detL (borderAt (k + j) (k + j) (k + j + 1 + c) G)))))
      = true
  refine ground.andIntroB (ground.andIntroB (ground.andIntroB
    (decide_eq_true h1) ?_) (ground.eqBeqOf h3))
    (ground.all_range_intro _ (fun c hc => decide_eq_true (h4 c hc)))
  rw [decide_eq_false h2]
  rfl
