name: borderAt_symm
statement:
private theorem borderAt_symm (M : Mat) (hsq : rowsLen M.length M)
    (hsym : symmRead M) (k i j : Nat) (hk : k ≤ M.length)
    (hi : i < M.length) (hj : j < M.length) :
    (detL (borderAt k i j M)).oneValue (detL (borderAt k j i M))
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : (borderAt k j i M).length = k + 1 := borderAt_len k j i M
  have hrows : rowsLen (k + 1) (borderAt k j i M) := borderAt_rows k j i M
  have hsqB : rowsLen (borderAt k j i M).length (borderAt k j i M) := by
    rw [hlen]
    exact hrows
  rw [← detL_transpose (borderAt k j i M) hsqB]
  refine detL_congr_letters _ _ ?_ ?_
  · rw [borderAt_len, length_transposeM (borderAt k j i M) hrows
      (by rw [hlen]; exact Nat.succ_pos k)]
  · intro a ha b hb
    rw [borderAt_len] at ha hb
    rw [borderAt_entry k i j M a b ha hb,
      getAt_transposeM BPair.unit (borderAt k j i M) hrows a b ha
        (by rw [hlen]; exact hb),
      borderAt_entry k j i M b a hb ha]
    have hra : (if a < k then a else i) < M.length := by
      by_cases hak : a < k
      · rw [if_pos hak]
        exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hak hk
      · rw [if_neg hak]
        exact hi
    have hcb : (if b < k then b else j) < M.length := by
      by_cases hbk : b < k
      · rw [if_pos hbk]
        exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hbk hk
      · rw [if_neg hbk]
        exact hj
    have h1 := poly.oneValue_getAt (if b < k then b else j)
      (ground.matched_entry [] hsym (if a < k then a else i) hra)
    rw [getAt_transposeM BPair.unit M hsq _ _ hra hcb] at h1
    exact h1

name: length_grownBy
statement:
private theorem length_grownBy (G : Mat) (row : List BPair) :
    (grownBy G row).length = G.length + 1
proof:
:= by
  show ((List.range G.length).map (fun a =>
    ground.getAt [] G a ++ [ground.getAt BPair.unit row a])
      ++ [row]).length = _
  rw [ground.length_append, ground.length_map, ground.length_range]
  rfl

name: getAt_grownBy_lt
statement:
private theorem getAt_grownBy_lt (G : Mat) (row : List BPair) (a : Nat)
    (ha : a < G.length) :
    ground.getAt [] (grownBy G row) a
      = ground.getAt [] G a ++ [ground.getAt BPair.unit row a]
proof:
:= by
  show ground.getAt [] ((List.range G.length).map (fun a =>
    ground.getAt [] G a ++ [ground.getAt BPair.unit row a])
      ++ [row]) a = _
  rw [ground.getAt_append [] _ _ a, ground.length_map, ground.length_range,
    if_pos ha,
    ground.getAt_map 0 [] _ (List.range G.length) a
      (by rw [ground.length_range]; exact ha),
    ground.getAt_range G.length a ha]

name: getAt_grownBy_last
statement:
private theorem getAt_grownBy_last (G : Mat) (row : List BPair) :
    ground.getAt [] (grownBy G row) G.length = row
proof:
:= by
  show ground.getAt [] ((List.range G.length).map (fun a =>
    ground.getAt [] G a ++ [ground.getAt BPair.unit row a])
      ++ [row]) G.length = _
  rw [ground.getAt_append [] _ _ G.length, ground.length_map,
    ground.length_range, if_neg (Nat.lt_irrefl _), Nat.sub_self]
  rfl

name: rowsLen_grownBy
proof:
:= by
  refine rowsLen_append (G.length + 1) ?_ ⟨hrow, trivial⟩
  refine rowsLen_map _ (G.length + 1) (List.range G.length)
    (fun a ha => ?_)
  rw [ground.length_append, rowsLen_getAt G a hsq (ground.ltOfMemRange ha)]
  rfl

name: entry_grownBy_lt
statement:
private theorem entry_grownBy_lt (G : Mat) (row : List BPair)
    (hsq : rowsLen G.length G) (a b : Nat) (ha : a < G.length)
    (hb : b < G.length) :
    ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] (grownBy G row) a) b
      = ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] G a) b
proof:
:= by
  rw [getAt_grownBy_lt G row a ha, ground.getAt_append BPair.unit _ _ b,
    rowsLen_getAt G a hsq ha, if_pos hb]

name: entry_grownBy_col
statement:
private theorem entry_grownBy_col (G : Mat) (row : List BPair)
    (hsq : rowsLen G.length G) (a : Nat) (ha : a < G.length) :
    ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] (grownBy G row) a) G.length
      = ground.getAt BPair.unit row a
proof:
:= by
  rw [getAt_grownBy_lt G row a ha,
    ground.getAt_append BPair.unit _ _ G.length, rowsLen_getAt G a hsq ha,
    if_neg (Nat.lt_irrefl _), Nat.sub_self]
  rfl

name: symmRead_grownBy
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : (grownBy G row).length = G.length + 1 := length_grownBy G row
  have hrows : rowsLen (G.length + 1) (grownBy G row) :=
    rowsLen_grownBy G row hsq hrow
  have hpos : 0 < (grownBy G row).length := by
    rw [hlen]
    exact Nat.succ_pos _
  have hrowsT : rowsLen (G.length + 1) (transposeM (grownBy G row)) := by
    rw [← hlen]
    exact rowsLen_transposeM _
  refine matOne_of_entries _ _ (G.length + 1) hlen hrows
    (length_transposeM _ hrows hpos) hrowsT ?_
  intro i j hi hj
  rw [getAt_transposeM BPair.unit _ hrows i j hi (by rw [hlen]; exact hj)]
  cases Nat.lt_or_ge i G.length with
  | inl hig =>
    cases Nat.lt_or_ge j G.length with
    | inl hjg =>
      rw [entry_grownBy_lt G row hsq i j hig hjg,
        entry_grownBy_lt G row hsq j i hjg hig]
      have h1 := poly.oneValue_getAt j (ground.matched_entry [] hsym i hig)
      rw [getAt_transposeM BPair.unit G hsq i j hig hjg] at h1
      exact h1
    | inr hjg =>
      have hje : j = G.length := Nat.le_antisymm (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hj) hjg
      rw [hje, entry_grownBy_col G row hsq i hig, getAt_grownBy_last G row]
      exact BPair.oneValue_refl _
  | inr hig =>
    have hie : i = G.length := Nat.le_antisymm (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hi) hig
    rw [hie, getAt_grownBy_last G row]
    cases Nat.lt_or_ge j G.length with
    | inl hjg =>
      rw [entry_grownBy_col G row hsq j hjg]
      exact BPair.oneValue_refl _
    | inr hjg =>
      have hje : j = G.length := Nat.le_antisymm (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hj) hjg
      rw [hje, getAt_grownBy_last G row]
      exact BPair.oneValue_refl _

name: borderAt_grown
statement:
private theorem borderAt_grown (G : Mat) (row : List BPair)
    (hsq : rowsLen G.length G) (k i j : Nat) (hk : k ≤ G.length)
    (hi : i < G.length) (hj : j < G.length) :
    borderAt k i j (grownBy G row) = borderAt k i j G
proof:
:= by
  refine ground.getAt_ext [] _ _ (by rw [borderAt_len, borderAt_len]) ?_
  intro a ha
  rw [borderAt_len] at ha
  rw [borderAt_row k i j _ a ha, borderAt_row k i j G a ha]
  have hra : (if a < k then a else i) < G.length := by
    by_cases hak : a < k
    · rw [if_pos hak]
      exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hak hk
    · rw [if_neg hak]
      exact hi
  rw [getAt_grownBy_lt G row _ hra]
  refine ground.getAt_ext BPair.unit _ _
    (by rw [keepCols_len, keepCols_len]) ?_
  intro b hb
  rw [keepCols_len] at hb
  rw [keepCols_entry _ _ b hb, keepCols_entry _ _ b hb]
  rw [borderKeys_len] at hb
  rw [borderKeys k j b hb]
  have hcb : (if b < k then b else j)
      < (ground.getAt [] G (if a < k then a else i)).length := by
    rw [rowsLen_getAt G _ hsq hra]
    by_cases hbk : b < k
    · rw [if_pos hbk]
      exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hbk hk
    · rw [if_neg hbk]
      exact hj
  rw [ground.getAt_append BPair.unit _ _ _, if_pos hcb]

name: growGo_read
statement:
private theorem growGo_read (M : Mat) (g : Nat) (hM : M.length = g + 1)
    (hsq : rowsLen M.length M) (hsym : symmRead M) :
    ∀ (st : DState) (k : Nat) (prev : BPair) (row : List BPair),
      TraceP st k g M →
      prev.oneValue (detL (leadAt k M)) →
      ¬ prev.oneValue BPair.unit →
      row.length + k = g + 1 →
      (∀ c, c < row.length →
        (ground.getAt BPair.unit row c).oneValue
          (detL (borderAt k g (k + c) M))) →
      (growGo prev st row).2.oneValue (detL M)
      ∧ (¬ (growGo prev st row).2.oneValue BPair.unit →
          TraceP (growGo prev st row).1 k (g + 1) M)
  | [], k, prev, row, ht, _, _, hrow, hent => by
    have hk : k = g
proof:
:= (Nat.zero_add k).symm.trans ht.1
    have hrow1 : row.length = 1 := by
      have h1 : row.length + k = 1 + k := by
        rw [hrow, hk, Nat.add_comm]
      exact ground.addCancelR k h1
    have hpos : 0 < row.length := by
      rw [hrow1]
      exact Nat.succ_pos 0
    have h0 := hent 0 hpos
    have hfull : borderAt k g (k + 0) M = M := by
      rw [hk]
      show borderAt g g g M = M
      rw [borderAt_diag g M, ← hM]
      exact leadAt_full M hsq
    rw [hfull] at h0
    refine ⟨h0, fun hoff => ⟨?_, fun j hj => ?_⟩⟩
    · show 1 + k = g + 1
      rw [hk, Nat.add_comm]
    · match j, hj with
      | 0, _ =>
        refine ⟨?_, hoff, ?_, fun c hc => absurd hc (Nat.not_lt_zero c)⟩
        · show (ground.getAt BPair.unit row 0).oneValue
            (detL (borderAt (k + 0) (k + 0) (k + 0) M))
          rw [hk]
          show (ground.getAt BPair.unit row 0).oneValue
            (detL (borderAt g g g M))
          rw [borderAt_diag g M, ← hM, leadAt_full M hsq]
          exact h0
        · show 0 + (k + 0) + 1 = g + 1
          rw [Nat.zero_add, hk]
      | j + 1, hj => exact absurd (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hj) (Nat.not_lt_zero j)
  | (piv, tail) :: st', k, prev, row, ht, hprev, hpoff, hrow, hent => by
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := ht.2 0 (Nat.succ_pos _)
    have hlen : st'.length + 1 + k = g := ht.1
    have hkg : k < g := by
      show k + 1 ≤ g
      rw [← hlen, Nat.add_right_comm]
      exact Nat.le_add_left (k + 1) st'.length
    have htl : tail.length + k + 1 = g := h3
    have hg : g < M.length := by
      rw [hM]
      exact Nat.lt_succ_self g
    have hkM : k < M.length := Nat.lt_trans hkg hg
    have hrowlen : row.length = tail.length + 2 := by
      have h5 : row.length + k = tail.length + 2 + k := by
        rw [hrow, ← htl]
        show tail.length + k + 1 + 1 = tail.length + 2 + k
        rw [Nat.add_right_comm (tail.length + k) 1 1,
          Nat.add_right_comm tail.length k 2]
      exact ground.addCancelR k h5
    have hrowpos : 0 < row.length := by
      rw [hrowlen]
      exact Nat.succ_pos _
    have hh : (ground.getAt BPair.unit row 0).oneValue
        (detL (borderAt k g k M)) := hent 0 hrowpos
    have hh' : (ground.getAt BPair.unit row 0).oneValue
        (detL (borderAt k k g M)) :=
      BPair.oneValue_trans hh
        (borderAt_symm M hsq hsym k g k (Nat.le_of_lt hkM) hg hkM)
    have hkg' : k + 1 + tail.length = g := by
      rw [Nat.add_right_comm k 1 tail.length, Nat.add_comm k tail.length]
      exact htl
    have htail' : ∀ c, c < (tail ++ [ground.getAt BPair.unit row 0]).length →
        (ground.getAt BPair.unit (tail ++ [ground.getAt BPair.unit row 0])
          c).oneValue (detL (borderAt k k (k + 1 + c) M)) := by
      intro c hc
      rw [ground.length_append] at hc
      rw [ground.getAt_append BPair.unit tail _ c]
      by_cases hct : c < tail.length
      · rw [if_pos hct]
        exact h4 c hct
      · rw [if_neg hct]
        have hce : c = tail.length :=
          Nat.le_antisymm (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hc) (Nat.le_of_not_lt hct)
        rw [hce, Nat.sub_self]
        show (ground.getAt BPair.unit row 0).oneValue
          (detL (borderAt k k (k + 1 + tail.length) M))
        rw [hkg']
        exact hh'
    have hdroplen : (row.drop 1).length
        = (tail ++ [ground.getAt BPair.unit row 0]).length := by
      rw [ground.length_append]
      have h6 := length_drop1 row hrowpos
      rw [hrowlen] at h6
      exact Nat.succ.inj h6
    have hbl : (browO bpairCof prev piv (ground.getAt BPair.unit row 0)
        (row.drop 1) (tail ++ [ground.getAt BPair.unit row 0])).length
        = (row.drop 1).length :=
      browO_len (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairCof prev piv _ _ _ hdroplen
    have hrow'len : (browO bpairCof prev piv (ground.getAt BPair.unit row 0)
        (row.drop 1) (tail ++ [ground.getAt BPair.unit row 0])).length
        = tail.length + 1 := by
      rw [hbl, hdroplen, ground.length_append]
      rfl
    have hrow'ent : ∀ c, c < (browO bpairCof prev piv
          (ground.getAt BPair.unit row 0) (row.drop 1)
          (tail ++ [ground.getAt BPair.unit row 0])).length →
        (ground.getAt BPair.unit (browO bpairCof prev piv
          (ground.getAt BPair.unit row 0) (row.drop 1)
          (tail ++ [ground.getAt BPair.unit row 0])) c).oneValue
          (detL (borderAt (k + 1) g (k + 1 + c) M)) := by
      intro c hc
      rw [hrow'len] at hc
      have hbe : ground.getAt BPair.unit (browO bpairCof prev piv
            (ground.getAt BPair.unit row 0) (row.drop 1)
            (tail ++ [ground.getAt BPair.unit row 0])) c
          = jointEntryO bpairCof prev piv
            (ground.getAt BPair.unit
              (tail ++ [ground.getAt BPair.unit row 0]) c)
            (ground.getAt BPair.unit row 0)
            (ground.getAt BPair.unit (row.drop 1) c) :=
        browO_entry (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairCof prev piv _ _ _ c
          (by rw [hdroplen, ground.length_append]; exact hc) hdroplen
      rw [hbe]
      show (cofactorAt (piv * ground.getAt BPair.unit (row.drop 1) c
          + (ground.getAt BPair.unit row 0
            * ground.getAt BPair.unit
                (tail ++ [ground.getAt BPair.unit row 0]) c).swap)
          prev).oneValue _
      rw [getAt_drop1 BPair.unit row c]
      have hj : k + 1 + c < M.length := by
        rw [hM]
        exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le (by
          rw [← hkg']
          exact Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hc) (k + 1))
      have hsyl := sylvester M hsq k g (k + 1 + c) hkg hg
        (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_succ_self k) (Nat.le_add_right (k + 1) c))
        hj
      have eA : (ground.getAt BPair.unit row (c + 1)).oneValue
          (detL (borderAt k g (k + 1 + c) M)) := by
        rw [Nat.add_right_comm k 1 c]
        exact hent (c + 1) (by rw [hrowlen]; exact Nat.succ_lt_succ hc)
      have eB := htail' c (by rw [ground.length_append]; exact hc)
      have hE : (piv * ground.getAt BPair.unit row (c + 1)
          + (ground.getAt BPair.unit row 0
            * ground.getAt BPair.unit
                (tail ++ [ground.getAt BPair.unit row 0]) c).swap).oneValue
          (detL (borderAt k k k M) * detL (borderAt k g (k + 1 + c) M)
            + (detL (borderAt k g k M)
              * detL (borderAt k k (k + 1 + c) M)).swap) :=
        BPair.add_congr (BPair.mul_congr h1 eA)
          (swap_congr (BPair.mul_congr hh eB))
      have hsyl' : (BPair.add
          (BPair.mul (detL (leadAt k M))
            (detL (borderAt (k + 1) g (k + 1 + c) M)))
          ((BPair.mul (detL (borderAt k g k M))
            (detL (borderAt k k (k + 1 + c) M))).swap.swap)).oneValue
          (BPair.mul (detL (borderAt k k k M))
            (detL (borderAt k g (k + 1 + c) M))) := by
        rw [BPair.swap_swap]
        exact hsyl
      have hprod := swapMove hsyl'
      have hE2 : (prev * detL (borderAt (k + 1) g (k + 1 + c) M)).oneValue
          (piv * ground.getAt BPair.unit row (c + 1)
            + (ground.getAt BPair.unit row 0
              * ground.getAt BPair.unit
                  (tail ++ [ground.getAt BPair.unit row 0]) c).swap) :=
        BPair.oneValue_trans
          (BPair.mul_congr hprev (BPair.oneValue_refl _))
          (BPair.oneValue_trans (BPair.oneValue_symm hprod)
            (BPair.oneValue_symm hE))
      have hsound := cofactorAt_sound hpoff hE2
      exact ground.mulCancel hpoff
        (BPair.oneValue_trans hsound (BPair.oneValue_symm hE2))
    have hprev2 : piv.oneValue (detL (leadAt (k + 1) M)) := by
      rw [← borderAt_diag k M]
      exact h1
    have ht' : TraceP st' (k + 1) g M := by
      refine ⟨by rw [← hlen, Nat.add_right_comm]; rfl, fun j hj => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨a1, a2, a3, a4⟩ := ht.2 (j + 1) (Nat.succ_lt_succ hj)
      rw [show k + (j + 1) = k + 1 + j from
        (Nat.add_right_comm k 1 j).symm] at a1 a3 a4
      exact ⟨a1, a2, a3, a4⟩
    have hrow'k : (browO bpairCof prev piv (ground.getAt BPair.unit row 0)
        (row.drop 1) (tail ++ [ground.getAt BPair.unit row 0])).length
        + (k + 1) = g + 1 := by
      rw [hrow'len, Nat.add_right_comm tail.length 1 (k + 1), ← htl]
      show tail.length + (k + 1) + 1 = tail.length + k + 1 + 1
      rfl
    obtain ⟨hd, htr⟩ := growGo_read M g hM hsq hsym st' (k + 1) piv
      (browO bpairCof prev piv (ground.getAt BPair.unit row 0)
        (row.drop 1) (tail ++ [ground.getAt BPair.unit row 0]))
      ht' hprev2 h2 hrow'k hrow'ent
    refine ⟨hd, fun hoff => ?_⟩
    have htr' := htr hoff
    refine ⟨?_, fun j hj => ?_⟩
    · show (growGo piv st' (browO bpairCof prev piv
          (ground.getAt BPair.unit row 0) (row.drop 1)
          (tail ++ [ground.getAt BPair.unit row 0]))).1.length + 1 + k
        = g + 1
      rw [Nat.add_right_comm]
      exact htr'.1
    · match j, hj with
      | 0, _ =>
        refine ⟨h1, h2, ?_, fun c hc => htail' c hc⟩
        show (tail ++ [ground.getAt BPair.unit row 0]).length + (k + 0) + 1
          = g + 1
        rw [ground.length_append, ← htl]
        show tail.length + 1 + k + 1 = tail.length + k + 1 + 1
        rw [Nat.add_right_comm tail.length 1 k]
      | j + 1, hj =>
        obtain ⟨b1, b2, b3, b4⟩ := htr'.2 j (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hj)
        rw [Nat.add_right_comm k 1 j] at b1 b3 b4
        exact ⟨b1, b2, b3, b4⟩

name: growS_read
statement:
theorem growS_read (G : Mat) (row : List BPair) (hsq : rowsLen G.length G)
    (hrow : row.length = G.length + 1) (hsym : symmRead G)
    (st : DState) (ht : traceOf st G) :
    (growS st row).2.oneValue (detL (grownBy G row))
    ∧ (¬ (growS st row).2.oneValue BPair.unit →
        traceOf (growS st row).1 (grownBy G row))
proof:
:= by
  have hM : (grownBy G row).length = G.length + 1 := length_grownBy G row
  have hsq' : rowsLen (grownBy G row).length (grownBy G row) := by
    rw [hM]
    exact rowsLen_grownBy G row hsq hrow
  have htG : TraceP st 0 G.length G := traceB_read ht
  have htP : TraceP st 0 G.length (grownBy G row) := by
    refine ⟨htG.1, fun j hj => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨a1, a2, a3, a4⟩ := htG.2 j hj
    have hjg : 0 + j < G.length := by
      rw [Nat.zero_add]
      exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hj (Nat.le_of_eq htG.1)
    refine ⟨?_, a2, a3, fun c hc => ?_⟩
    · rw [borderAt_grown G row hsq _ _ _ (Nat.le_of_lt hjg) hjg hjg]
      exact a1
    · have hcg : 0 + j + 1 + c < G.length := by
        rw [← a3, Nat.add_comm (stepAt st j).2.length (0 + j),
          Nat.add_right_comm (0 + j) (stepAt st j).2.length 1]
        exact Nat.add_lt_add_left hc (0 + j + 1)
      rw [borderAt_grown G row hsq _ _ _ (Nat.le_of_lt hjg) hjg hcg]
      exact a4 c hc
  have h := growGo_read (grownBy G row) G.length hM hsq'
    (symmRead_grownBy G row hsq hrow hsym) st 0
    (BPair.ofPos .one) row htP
    (BPair.oneValue_symm detL_nil) (by decide +kernel)
    (by rw [Nat.add_zero]; exact hrow)
    (fun c hc => by
      rw [Nat.zero_add]
      show (ground.getAt BPair.unit row c).oneValue
        (detL [[ground.getAt BPair.unit
          (ground.getAt [] (grownBy G row) G.length) c]])
      rw [getAt_grownBy_last G row]
      exact BPair.oneValue_symm (detL_single _))
  refine ⟨h.1, fun hoff => ?_⟩
  show traceB (growS st row).1 0 (grownBy G row).length (grownBy G row) = true
  rw [hM]
  exact traceB_intro (h.2 hoff)

name: length_gramRow
statement:
private theorem length_gramRow {α : Type} (dot : α → α → BPair)
    (l : List α) (v : α) : (gramRow dot l v).length = l.length + 1
proof:
:= by
  show (l.map (fun w => dot w v) ++ [dot v v]).length = _
  rw [ground.length_append, ground.length_map]
  rfl

name: getAt_gramRow
statement:
private theorem getAt_gramRow {α : Type} (dot : α → α → BPair)
    (l : List α) (v : α) (a : Nat) (ha : a < l.length + 1) :
    ground.getAt BPair.unit (gramRow dot l v) a
      = if a < l.length then dot (ground.getAt v l a) v else dot v v
proof:
:= by
  show ground.getAt BPair.unit (l.map (fun w => dot w v) ++ [dot v v]) a = _
  rw [ground.getAt_append BPair.unit _ _ a, ground.length_map]
  by_cases hal : a < l.length
  · rw [if_pos hal, if_pos hal, ground.getAt_map v BPair.unit _ l a hal]
  · rw [if_neg hal, if_neg hal,
      Nat.le_antisymm (Nat.le_of_lt_succ ha) (Nat.le_of_not_lt hal),
      Nat.sub_self]
    rfl

name: gramBy_grown_entry
statement:
private theorem gramBy_grown_entry {α : Type} (dot : α → α → BPair)
    (hc : ∀ u w, (dot u w).oneValue (dot w u)) (l : List α) (v : α)
    (a b : Nat) (ha : a < l.length + 1) (hb : b < l.length + 1) :
    (ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt []
        (grownBy (gramBy dot l) (gramRow dot l v)) a) b).oneValue
      (ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt []
        (gramBy dot (l ++ [v])) a) b)
proof:
:= by
  have hl : (l ++ [v]).length = l.length + 1 := by
    rw [ground.length_append]
    rfl
  have hgl : (gramBy dot l).length = l.length := length_gramBy dot l
  have hsq : rowsLen (gramBy dot l).length (gramBy dot l) := gramBy_sq dot l
  rw [gramBy_entry dot v (l ++ [v]) a b (by rw [hl]; exact ha)
      (by rw [hl]; exact hb),
    ground.getAt_append v l [v] a, ground.getAt_append v l [v] b]
  cases Nat.lt_or_ge a l.length with
  | inl hal =>
    rw [if_pos hal]
    cases Nat.lt_or_ge b l.length with
    | inl hbl =>
      rw [if_pos hbl, entry_grownBy_lt (gramBy dot l) (gramRow dot l v) hsq a b
          (by rw [hgl]; exact hal) (by rw [hgl]; exact hbl),
        gramBy_entry dot v l a b hal hbl]
      exact BPair.oneValue_refl _
    | inr hbg =>
      have hbe : b = l.length := Nat.le_antisymm (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hb) hbg
      rw [if_neg (Nat.not_lt_of_ge hbg), hbe, Nat.sub_self, ← hgl,
        entry_grownBy_col (gramBy dot l) (gramRow dot l v) hsq a
          (by rw [hgl]; exact hal),
        getAt_gramRow dot l v a ha, if_pos hal]
      exact BPair.oneValue_refl _
  | inr hag =>
    have hae : a = l.length := Nat.le_antisymm (Nat.le_of_lt_succ ha) hag
    rw [if_neg (Nat.not_lt_of_ge hag), hae, Nat.sub_self, ← hgl,
      getAt_grownBy_last (gramBy dot l) (gramRow dot l v),
      getAt_gramRow dot l v b hb, hgl]
    cases Nat.lt_or_ge b l.length with
    | inl hbl =>
      rw [if_pos hbl, if_pos hbl]
      exact hc _ _
    | inr hbg =>
      have hbe : b = l.length := Nat.le_antisymm (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hb) hbg
      rw [if_neg (Nat.not_lt_of_ge hbg), if_neg (Nat.not_lt_of_ge hbg), hbe,
        Nat.sub_self]
      exact BPair.oneValue_refl _

name: gramBy_symm
proof:
:= by
  cases l with
  | nil => exact trivial
  | cons x t =>
    have hlen : (gramBy dot (x :: t)).length = (x :: t).length :=
      length_gramBy dot (x :: t)
    have hrows : rowsLen (x :: t).length (gramBy dot (x :: t)) :=
      rowsLen_gramBy dot (x :: t)
    have hpos : 0 < (gramBy dot (x :: t)).length := by
      rw [hlen]
      exact Nat.succ_pos _
    have hrowsT : rowsLen (x :: t).length (transposeM (gramBy dot (x :: t))) := by
      rw [← hlen]
      exact rowsLen_transposeM _
    refine matOne_of_entries _ _ (x :: t).length hlen hrows
      (length_transposeM _ hrows hpos) hrowsT ?_
    intro i j hi hj
    rw [getAt_transposeM BPair.unit _ hrows i j hi (by rw [hlen]; exact hj),
      gramBy_entry dot x (x :: t) i j hi hj,
      gramBy_entry dot x (x :: t) j i hj hi]
    exact hc _ _

name: borderAt_congr_ov
statement:
private theorem borderAt_congr_ov (G G' : Mat)
    (hent : ∀ a, a < G.length → ∀ b, b < G.length →
      (ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] G a) b).oneValue
        (ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] G' a) b))
    (k i j : Nat) (hk : k ≤ G.length) (hi : i < G.length)
    (hj : j < G.length) :
    (detL (borderAt k i j G)).oneValue (detL (borderAt k i j G'))
proof:
:= by
  refine detL_congr_letters _ _ (by rw [borderAt_len, borderAt_len]) ?_
  intro a ha b hb
  rw [borderAt_len] at ha hb
  rw [borderAt_entry k i j G a b ha hb, borderAt_entry k i j G' a b ha hb]
  refine hent _ ?_ _ ?_
  · by_cases hak : a < k
    · rw [if_pos hak]
      exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hak hk
    · rw [if_neg hak]
      exact hi
  · by_cases hbk : b < k
    · rw [if_pos hbk]
      exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hbk hk
    · rw [if_neg hbk]
      exact hj

name: traceOf_congr
statement:
private theorem traceOf_congr (G G' : Mat) (hl : G.length = G'.length)
    (hent : ∀ a, a < G.length → ∀ b, b < G.length →
      (ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] G a) b).oneValue
        (ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] G' a) b))
    (st : DState) (ht : traceOf st G) : traceOf st G'
proof:
:= by
  have hP : TraceP st 0 G.length G := traceB_read ht
  show traceB st 0 G'.length G' = true
  rw [← hl]
  refine traceB_intro ⟨hP.1, fun j hj => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨a1, a2, a3, a4⟩ := hP.2 j hj
  have hjg : 0 + j < G.length := by
    rw [Nat.zero_add]
    exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hj (Nat.le_of_eq hP.1)
  refine ⟨BPair.oneValue_trans a1
    (borderAt_congr_ov G G' hent _ _ _ (Nat.le_of_lt hjg) hjg hjg),
    a2, a3, fun c hc => ?_⟩
  have hcg : 0 + j + 1 + c < G.length := by
    rw [← a3, Nat.add_comm (stepAt st j).2.length (0 + j),
      Nat.add_right_comm (0 + j) (stepAt st j).2.length 1]
    exact Nat.add_lt_add_left hc (0 + j + 1)
  exact BPair.oneValue_trans (a4 c hc)
    (borderAt_congr_ov G G' hent _ _ _ (Nat.le_of_lt hjg) hjg hcg)

name: joinS_read
statement:
theorem joinS_read {α : Type} (dot : α → α → BPair)
    (hc : ∀ u w, (dot u w).oneValue (dot w u)) (st : DState) (l : List α)
    (v : α) (ht : traceOf st (gramBy dot l)) :
    (joinS dot st l v).2 = joinIndep dot l v
    ∧ ((joinS dot st l v).2 = true →
        traceOf (joinS dot st l v).1 (gramBy dot (l ++ [v])))
proof:
:= by
  have hg := growS_read (gramBy dot l) (gramRow dot l v) (gramBy_sq dot l)
    (by rw [length_gramRow, length_gramBy]) (gramBy_symm dot hc l) st ht
  have hlen : (grownBy (gramBy dot l) (gramRow dot l v)).length
      = (gramBy dot (l ++ [v])).length := by
    rw [length_grownBy, length_gramBy, length_gramBy, ground.length_append]
    rfl
  have hent : ∀ a, a < (grownBy (gramBy dot l) (gramRow dot l v)).length →
      ∀ b, b < (grownBy (gramBy dot l) (gramRow dot l v)).length →
      (ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt []
          (grownBy (gramBy dot l) (gramRow dot l v)) a) b).oneValue
        (ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt []
          (gramBy dot (l ++ [v])) a) b) := by
    intro a ha b hb
    rw [length_grownBy, length_gramBy] at ha hb
    exact gramBy_grown_entry dot hc l v a b ha hb
  have hdet : (growS st (gramRow dot l v)).2.oneValue
      (detD (gramBy dot (l ++ [v]))) :=
    BPair.oneValue_trans hg.1
      (BPair.oneValue_trans (detL_congr_letters _ _ hlen hent)
        (BPair.oneValue_symm (detD_eq _ (gramBy_sq dot (l ++ [v])))))
  refine ⟨?_, fun hpass => ?_⟩
  · show (!(decide ((growS st (gramRow dot l v)).2.oneValue BPair.unit)))
      = (if (detD (gramBy dot (l ++ [v]))).oneValue BPair.unit then false
        else true)
    cases hd : decide ((growS st (gramRow dot l v)).2.oneValue BPair.unit) with
    | true =>
      rw [if_pos (BPair.oneValue_trans (BPair.oneValue_symm hdet)
        (of_decide_eq_true hd))]
      rfl
    | false =>
      rw [if_neg (fun hu => of_decide_eq_false hd
        (BPair.oneValue_trans hdet hu))]
      rfl
  · have hoff : ¬ (growS st (gramRow dot l v)).2.oneValue BPair.unit :=
      of_decide_eq_false (ground.boolFalseOfNot hpass)
    exact traceOf_congr _ _ hlen hent _ (hg.2 hoff)

name: tryAddK_keep
statement:
private theorem tryAddK_keep {α κ : Type} (keq : κ → κ → Bool) (key : α → κ)
    (dot : α → α → BPair) (skip : α → Bool)
    (hkeq : ∀ a b, keq a b = true → a = b) (hkr : ∀ a, keq a a = true)
    (hc : ∀ u w, (dot u w).oneValue (dot w u)) (s : PoolS α κ) (v : α)
    (h : tracesK keq key dot s) :
    tracesK keq key dot (tryAddK keq key dot skip s v)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hu : skip v = true
  · rw [show tryAddK keq key dot skip s v = s from if_pos hu]
    exact h
  · have hj := joinS_read dot hc (stateAtK keq s (key v))
      (s.1.filter (fun w => keq (key w) (key v))) v (h (key v))
    rw [show tryAddK keq key dot skip s v
        = (if (joinS dot (stateAtK keq s (key v))
            (s.1.filter (fun w => keq (key w) (key v))) v).2
          then (s.1 ++ [v], ground.keyPut keq (key v)
            (joinS dot (stateAtK keq s (key v))
              (s.1.filter (fun w => keq (key w) (key v))) v).1 s.2)
          else s) from if_neg hu]
    cases hr : (joinS dot (stateAtK keq s (key v))
        (s.1.filter (fun w => keq (key w) (key v))) v).2 with
    | false =>
      rw [if_neg (fun hh : (false : Bool) = true => Bool.noConfusion hh)]
      exact h
    | true =>
      rw [if_pos rfl]
      intro k
      show traceOf (ground.keyAt keq [] k (ground.keyPut keq (key v)
          (joinS dot (stateAtK keq s (key v))
            (s.1.filter (fun w => keq (key w) (key v))) v).1 s.2))
        (gramBy dot ((s.1 ++ [v]).filter (fun w => keq (key w) k)))
      rw [ground.keyAt_keyPut keq hkeq hkr, ground.filter_append]
      cases hb : keq (key v) k with
      | true =>
        rw [ground.filter_cons_true (p := fun w => keq (key w) k) (a := v)
          (l := []) hb, ← hkeq (key v) k hb]
        exact hj.2 hr
      | false =>
        rw [ground.filter_cons_false (p := fun w => keq (key w) k) (a := v)
          (l := []) hb,
          show List.filter (fun w => keq (key w) k) ([] : List α) = [] from rfl,
          ground.append_nil]
        exact h k

name: tryAddK_proj
statement:
private theorem tryAddK_proj {α κ : Type} (keq : κ → κ → Bool) (key : α → κ)
    (dot : α → α → BPair) (skip : α → Bool)
    (hc : ∀ u w, (dot u w).oneValue (dot w u)) (s : PoolS α κ) (v : α)
    (h : tracesK keq key dot s) :
    (tryAddK keq key dot skip s v).1 = tryAddL keq key dot skip s.1 v
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hu : skip v = true
  · rw [show tryAddK keq key dot skip s v = s from if_pos hu,
      show tryAddL keq key dot skip s.1 v = s.1 from if_pos hu]
  · have hj := joinS_read dot hc (stateAtK keq s (key v))
      (s.1.filter (fun w => keq (key w) (key v))) v (h (key v))
    rw [show tryAddK keq key dot skip s v
        = (if (joinS dot (stateAtK keq s (key v))
            (s.1.filter (fun w => keq (key w) (key v))) v).2
          then (s.1 ++ [v], ground.keyPut keq (key v)
            (joinS dot (stateAtK keq s (key v))
              (s.1.filter (fun w => keq (key w) (key v))) v).1 s.2)
          else s) from if_neg hu,
      show tryAddL keq key dot skip s.1 v
        = (if joinIndep dot (s.1.filter (fun w => keq (key w) (key v))) v
          then s.1 ++ [v] else s.1) from if_neg hu,
      ← hj.1]
    cases (joinS dot (stateAtK keq s (key v))
        (s.1.filter (fun w => keq (key w) (key v))) v).2 with
    | false => rfl
    | true => rfl

name: seedK_traces
statement:
private theorem seedK_traces {α κ : Type} (keq : κ → κ → Bool)
    (key : α → κ) (dot : α → α → BPair)
    (hc : ∀ u w, (dot u w).oneValue (dot w u)) (v : α)
    (hv : joinIndep dot [] v = true) :
    tracesK keq key dot (seedK key dot v)
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  show traceOf (cond (keq (key v) k) (joinS dot [] [] v).1 [])
    (gramBy dot ([v].filter (fun w => keq (key w) k)))
  cases hb : keq (key v) k with
  | true =>
    rw [ground.filter_cons_true (p := fun w => keq (key w) k) (a := v)
      (l := []) hb]
    refine (joinS_read dot hc [] [] v traceOf_nil).2 ?_
    rw [(joinS_read dot hc [] [] v traceOf_nil).1]
    exact hv
  | false =>
    rw [ground.filter_cons_false (p := fun w => keq (key w) k) (a := v)
      (l := []) hb]
    exact traceOf_nil

name: closeK_eq
statement:
theorem closeK_eq {α κ : Type} (keq : κ → κ → Bool) (key : α → κ)
    (dot : α → α → BPair) (skip : α → Bool)
    (hkeq : ∀ a b, keq a b = true → a = b) (hkr : ∀ a, keq a a = true)
    (hc : ∀ u w, (dot u w).oneValue (dot w u)) (step : α → List α)
    (fuel : Nat) (v : α) (fr : List α) (hv : joinIndep dot [] v = true) :
    (closeK keq key dot skip step fuel (seedK key dot v) fr).1
      = ground.closeBy step (tryAddL keq key dot skip) fuel [v] fr
proof:
:=
  (ground.closeByS_proj step (tryAddK keq key dot skip)
    (tryAddL keq key dot skip) (fun s => s.1) (tracesK keq key dot)
    (tryAddK_keep keq key dot skip hkeq hkr hc)
    (tryAddK_proj keq key dot skip hc) fuel (seedK key dot v) fr
    (seedK_traces keq key dot hc v hv)).2

name: tracesK_vacant
proof:
:=
  fun _ => traceOf_nil

name: closeK_eq_vacant
statement:
theorem closeK_eq_vacant {α κ : Type} (keq : κ → κ → Bool) (key : α → κ)
    (dot : α → α → BPair) (skip : α → Bool)
    (hkeq : ∀ a b, keq a b = true → a = b) (hkr : ∀ a, keq a a = true)
    (hc : ∀ u w, (dot u w).oneValue (dot w u)) (step : α → List α)
    (fuel : Nat) (v : α) (fr : List α) :
    (closeK keq key dot skip step fuel
        (tryAddK keq key dot skip ([], []) v) fr).1
      = ground.closeBy step (tryAddL keq key dot skip) fuel
          (tryAddL keq key dot skip [] v) fr
proof:
:= by
  show _ = ground.closeBy step (tryAddL keq key dot skip) fuel
    (tryAddL keq key dot skip (([], []) : PoolS α κ).1 v) fr
  rw [← tryAddK_proj keq key dot skip hc ([], []) v
    (tracesK_vacant keq key dot)]
  exact (ground.closeByS_proj step (tryAddK keq key dot skip)
    (tryAddL keq key dot skip) (fun s => s.1) (tracesK keq key dot)
    (tryAddK_keep keq key dot skip hkeq hkr hc)
    (tryAddK_proj keq key dot skip hc) fuel
    (tryAddK keq key dot skip ([], []) v) fr
    (tryAddK_keep keq key dot skip hkeq hkr hc ([], []) v
      (tracesK_vacant keq key dot))).2

name: dropCol_eraseIdx
statement:
private theorem dropCol_eraseIdx {γ : Type} :
    ∀ m : List (List γ), dropCol m = m.map (fun r => r.eraseIdx 0)
  | [] => rfl
  | r :: t => by
    show r.drop 1 :: dropCol t
      = r.eraseIdx 0 :: t.map (fun s => s.eraseIdx 0)
    rw [dropCol_eraseIdx t]
    cases r with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons _ _ => rfl

/
of rows before: the cofactor at the walk determinant. -/
private def cofacD (m : Mat) (r : Nat) : BPair
proof:
:=
  cofO detD BPair.swap m r 0

name: bezoutBD_eq
statement:
theorem bezoutBD_eq (p q : poly.Poly)
    (hsq : rowsLen (shiftMat p q).length (shiftMat p q)) :
    poly.oneValue (bezoutBD p q) (bezoutB p q)
proof:
:= by
  refine poly.ov_of_getAt (fun k => ?_)
  cases Nat.lt_or_ge k (p.length - 1) with
  | inr hk =>
    have hlen : (List.range (p.length - 1)).length = p.length - 1 :=
      ground.length_range _
    have h1 : ground.getAt BPair.unit (bezoutBD p q) k = BPair.unit := by
      unfold bezoutBD
      exact ground.getAt_over _ _ _
        (by rw [ground.length_map, hlen]; exact hk)
    have h2 : ground.getAt BPair.unit (bezoutB p q) k = BPair.unit := by
      unfold bezoutB
      exact ground.getAt_over _ _ _
        (by rw [ground.length_map, hlen]; exact hk)
    rw [h1, h2]
    exact BPair.oneValue_refl _
  | inl hk =>
    have hlen : (List.range (p.length - 1)).length = p.length - 1 :=
      ground.length_range _
    have hkr : k < (List.range (p.length - 1)).length := by
      rw [hlen]; exact hk
    have h1 : ground.getAt BPair.unit (bezoutBD p q) k
        = cofacD (shiftMat p q) k := by
      unfold bezoutBD
      rw [ground.getAt_map 0 BPair.unit _ _ k hkr,
        ground.getAt_range _ k hk]
    have h2 : ground.getAt BPair.unit (bezoutB p q) k
        = cofacCol0 (shiftMat p q) k := by
      unfold bezoutB
      rw [ground.getAt_map 0 BPair.unit _ _ k hkr,
        ground.getAt_range _ k hk]
    rw [h1, h2]
    have hkN : k < (shiftMat p q).length := by
      have hle : p.length - 1 ≤ (shiftMat p q).length := by
        show p.length - 1 ≤ ((List.range (p.length - 1)).map _
          ++ (List.range (q.length - 1)).map _).length
        rw [ground.length_append, ground.length_map, hlen]
        exact Nat.le_add_right _ _
      exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hk hle
    have hE : rowsLen
        (dropCol ((shiftMat p q).eraseIdx k)).length
        (dropCol ((shiftMat p q).eraseIdx k)) := by
      have he1 : ((shiftMat p q).eraseIdx k).length + 1
          = (shiftMat p q).length :=
        ground.length_eraseIdx _ k hkN
      have hr1 : rowsLen (((shiftMat p q).eraseIdx k).length + 1)
          ((shiftMat p q).eraseIdx k) := by
        rw [he1]
        exact rowsLen_eraseIdx _ _ k hsq
      have hd := rowsLen_dropCol _ _ hr1
      rw [length_dropCol]
      exact hd
    have hDM : (detD (dropCol ((shiftMat p q).eraseIdx k))).oneValue
        (minor (dropCol ((shiftMat p q).eraseIdx k))) :=
      BPair.oneValue_trans (detD_eq _ hE)
        (BPair.oneValue_symm (minor_detL _ hE))
    rw [dropCol_eraseIdx] at hDM
    show (cofO detD BPair.swap (shiftMat p q) k 0).oneValue
      (cofO minor BPair.swap (shiftMat p q) k 0)
    unfold cofO
    cases places.parityOf (k + 0) with
    | true => exact ground.swap_congr hDM
    | false => exact hDM

name: POcc.den_off
statement: private theorem POcc.den_off (x : POcc) : ¬ poly.unitTail x.val.2
proof:
:=
  fun h => Bool.noConfusion ((decide_eq_true h).symm.trans x.occ)

name: denOffB
statement:
private theorem denOffB {p : poly.Poly} (h : ¬ poly.unitTail p) :
    unitBL bpairCof.unitB p = false
proof:
:= by
  cases hB : unitBL bpairCof.unitB p with
  | true => exact absurd (unitBL_ut bpairCof p hB) h
  | false => rfl

name: mulDenOff
proof:
:=
  fun hut => zeroDivL bpairLaws bpairCof (denOffB ha) (denOffB hb) hut

name: unitBL_eraseIdx
statement:
private theorem unitBL_eraseIdx {γ : Type} (u : γ → Bool) :
    ∀ (l : List γ) (j : Nat), unitBL u l = true →
    unitBL u (l.eraseIdx j) = true
  | [], _, _ => rfl
  | _ :: _, 0, h => (ground.andSplitB h).2
  | c :: l, j + 1, h => by
    have hs
proof:
:= ground.andSplitB
      (show (u c && unitBL u l) = true from h)
    show (u c && unitBL u (l.eraseIdx j)) = true
    rw [hs.1, unitBL_eraseIdx u l j hs.2]
    rfl

name: unitBL_map
statement:
private theorem unitBL_map {γ δ : Type} (u : γ → Bool) (v : δ → Bool)
    (f : γ → δ) (h : ∀ x, u x = true → v (f x) = true) :
    ∀ l : List γ, unitBL u l = true → unitBL v (l.map f) = true
  | [], _ => rfl
  | c :: l, hl => by
    have hs
proof:
:= ground.andSplitB
      (show (u c && unitBL u l) = true from hl)
    show (v (f c) && unitBL v (l.map f)) = true
    rw [h c hs.1, unitBL_map u v f h l hs.2]
    rfl

name: unitBL_intro
statement:
private theorem unitBL_intro {γ : Type} (u : γ → Bool) (d : γ) :
    ∀ l : List γ,
    (∀ k, k < l.length → u (ground.getAt d l k) = true) →
    unitBL u l = true
  | [], _ => rfl
  | c :: l, h => by
    show (u (ground.getAt d (c :: l) 0) && unitBL u l) = true
    rw [h 0 (Nat.succ_pos _),
      unitBL_intro u d l (fun k hk => h (k + 1) (Nat.succ_lt_succ hk))]
    rfl

/
entry's own beyond the count. -/

name: rowOcc_read
statement:
theorem rowOcc_read (r : List poly.PPair) (h : rowOcc r = true) :
    ∀ k, ¬ poly.unitTail (ground.getAt poly.pZero r k).2
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  cases Nat.lt_or_ge k r.length with
  | inl hk =>
    have hu := unitBL_index _ poly.pZero r h k hk
    intro hut
    cases hd : decide
        (poly.unitTail (ground.getAt poly.pZero r k).2) with
    | true =>
      rw [hd] at hu
      exact Bool.noConfusion hu
    | false =>
      exact Bool.noConfusion ((decide_eq_true hut).symm.trans hd)
  | inr hk =>
    rw [ground.getAt_over poly.pZero r k hk]
    decide +kernel

name: matOcc_read
statement:
theorem matOcc_read (m : List (List poly.PPair))
    (h : matOcc m = true) :
    ∀ i, rowOcc (ground.getAt [] m i) = true
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  cases Nat.lt_or_ge i m.length with
  | inl hi => exact unitBL_index rowOcc [] m h i hi
  | inr hi =>
    rw [ground.getAt_over [] m i hi]
    rfl

name: rowOcc_intro
statement:
theorem rowOcc_intro (r : List poly.PPair)
    (h : ∀ k, k < r.length →
      ¬ poly.unitTail (ground.getAt poly.pZero r k).2) :
    rowOcc r = true
proof:
:=
  unitBL_intro _ poly.pZero r (fun k hk => by
    rw [decide_eq_false (h k hk)]
    rfl)

name: matOcc_intro
statement:
theorem matOcc_intro (m : List (List poly.PPair))
    (h : ∀ i, i < m.length →
      rowOcc (ground.getAt [] m i) = true) :
    matOcc m = true
proof:
:=
  unitBL_intro rowOcc [] m h

name: matOcc_erase
statement:
theorem matOcc_erase (m : List (List poly.PPair)) (i j : Nat)
    (h : matOcc m = true) :
    matOcc ((m.eraseIdx i).map (fun r => r.eraseIdx j)) = true
proof:
:=
  unitBL_map rowOcc rowOcc _
    (fun r hr => unitBL_eraseIdx _ r j hr)
    (m.eraseIdx i) (unitBL_eraseIdx rowOcc m i h)

name: rowOcc_replicate
statement:
theorem rowOcc_replicate (x : poly.PPair)
    (hx : ¬ poly.unitTail x.2) :
    ∀ n : Nat, rowOcc (List.replicate n x) = true
  | 0 => rfl
  | n + 1 => by
    show ((!decide (poly.unitTail x.2))
      && rowOcc (List.replicate n x)) = true
    rw [decide_eq_false hx, rowOcc_replicate x hx n]
    rfl

/

name: matOcc_entry_den
statement:
theorem matOcc_entry_den (m : List (List poly.PPair))
    (h : matOcc m = true) :
    ∀ k j, ¬ poly.unitTail
      (ground.getAt poly.pZero (ground.getAt [] m k) j).2
proof:
:=
  fun k j => rowOcc_read _ (matOcc_read m h k) j

name: denFoldO
statement:
private theorem denFoldO (r : List poly.PPair)
    (b : List (List poly.PPair))
    (hr : ∀ k, ¬ poly.unitTail (ground.getAt poly.pZero r k).2)
    (hb : ∀ k j, ¬ poly.unitTail
      (ground.getAt poly.pZero (ground.getAt [] b k) j).2)
    (j : Nat) :
    ∀ (ks : List Nat) {acc : poly.PPair}, ¬ poly.unitTail acc.2 →
    ¬ poly.unitTail
      ((ks.foldl (fun acc k => poly.pAdd acc
        (poly.pMul (ground.getAt poly.pZero r k)
          (ground.getAt poly.pZero (ground.getAt [] b k) j)))
        acc).2)
  | [], _, hacc => hacc
  | k :: ks, _, hacc =>
    denFoldO r b hr hb j ks
      (mulDenOff hacc (mulDenOff (hr k) (hb k j)))

/

name: matOcc_matMulO
statement:
theorem matOcc_matMulO (a b : List (List poly.PPair))
    (ha : matOcc a = true) (hb : matOcc b = true) :
    matOcc (matMulO poly.ppairOps a b) = true
proof:
:=
  unitBL_map rowOcc rowOcc _
    (fun r hr => rowOcc_intro _ (fun k hk => by
      have hkr : k < (List.range (b.headD []).length).length := by
        rw [ground.length_map] at hk
        exact hk
      rw [ground.getAt_map 0 poly.pZero _
        (List.range (b.headD []).length) k hkr]
      exact denFoldO r b (rowOcc_read r hr)
        (matOcc_entry_den b hb) _ (List.range r.length) (by decide +kernel)))
    a ha

name: matOcc_diagO
statement:
theorem matOcc_diagO (ds : List poly.PPair)
    (h : rowOcc ds = true) :
    matOcc (diagO poly.ppairOps ds) = true
proof:
:=
  matOcc_intro _ (fun i hi => by
    rw [show (diagO poly.ppairOps ds).length = ds.length from
      ground.matOf_length ds.length ds.length _] at hi
    show rowOcc (ground.getAt []
      (ground.matOf ds.length ds.length (fun i j =>
        if j = i
        then ground.getAt poly.ppairOps.unit ds i
        else poly.ppairOps.unit)) i) = true
    rw [ground.matOf_row ([] : List poly.PPair) ds.length ds.length
      (fun i j => if j = i
        then ground.getAt poly.ppairOps.unit ds i
        else poly.ppairOps.unit) i hi]
    refine rowOcc_intro _ (fun k hk => ?_)
    have hkr : k < (List.range ds.length).length := by
      rw [ground.length_map] at hk
      exact hk
    rw [ground.getAt_map 0 poly.pZero _ (List.range ds.length) k hkr]
    by_cases hik : ground.getAt 0 (List.range ds.length) k = i
    · rw [if_pos hik]
      show ¬ poly.unitTail (ground.getAt poly.pZero ds i).2
      exact rowOcc_read ds h _
    · rw [if_neg hik]
      exact (show ¬ poly.unitTail poly.ppairOps.unit.2 by decide +kernel))

name: rowOcc_cons
proof:
:= by
  have hh := ground.andSplitB
    (show ((!decide (poly.unitTail x.2))
      && unitBL (fun x => !decide (poly.unitTail x.2)) t) = true from h)
  refine ⟨?_, hh.2⟩
  cases hd : decide (poly.unitTail x.2) with
  | true =>
    have h1 := hh.1
    rw [hd] at h1
    nomatch h1
  | false => rfl

name: matOcc_cons
proof:
:=
  ground.andSplitB
    (show (rowOcc r && unitBL rowOcc t) = true from h)

name: liftT_val
statement:
private theorem liftT_val {x : poly.PPair}
    (hx : ¬ poly.unitTail x.2) : (liftT x).val = x
proof:
:= by
  unfold liftT
  rw [dif_neg hx]

name: liftRow_val
statement:
private theorem liftRow_val : ∀ (r : List poly.PPair),
    rowOcc r = true → (r.map liftT).map POcc.val = r
  | [], _ => rfl
  | x :: t, h => by
    show (liftT x).val :: (t.map liftT).map POcc.val = x :: t
    rw [liftT_val (fun hu => Bool.noConfusion
        ((decide_eq_true hu).symm.trans (rowOcc_cons h).1)),
      liftRow_val t (rowOcc_cons h).2]

private theorem liftMat_val : ∀ (m : List (List poly.PPair)),
    matOcc m = true → (liftMat m).map (List.map POcc.val) = m
  | [], _ => rfl
  | r :: t, h => by
    show (r.map liftT).map POcc.val
      :: (liftMat t).map (List.map POcc.val) = r :: t
    rw [liftRow_val r (matOcc_cons h).1, liftMat_val t (matOcc_cons h).2]

/-! The lifted matrix's shape reads, and the fold's projection back
to the raw pair carrier: the occupied ops project to the displayed
reads value by value, so the fold at the occupied carrier is the
raw fold at the values. -/

private theorem liftMat_rowsLen (n : Nat) :
    ∀ m : List (List poly.PPair),
    rowsLen n m → rowsLen n (liftMat m)
  | [], _ => trivial
  | r :: t, hL =>
    ⟨(ground.length_map liftT r).trans hL.1,
     liftMat_rowsLen n t hL.2⟩

private theorem valMat_erase : ∀ (rest : List (List POcc)) (j : Nat),
    (rest.map (fun l => l.eraseIdx j)).map (List.map POcc.val)
      = (rest.map (List.map POcc.val)).map (fun l => l.eraseIdx j)
  | [], _ => rfl

    poly.oneValue p []
proof:
:=
  show poly.listOV ground.bpairOps ground.bpairRead p [] from
    poly.lovNilO _ _ h

statement:

    poly.oneValue (poly.mul p []) []
proof: := ovNilOfUt (poly.mul_nil p)

name: mulShuffle
proof:
:=
  poly.oneValue_trans (poly.mul_assoc p q r)
    (poly.oneValue_trans (poly.mul_congr p (poly.mul_comm q r))
      (poly.oneValue_symm (poly.mul_assoc p r q)))

proof:
:=
  poly.oneValue_trans
    (poly.mul_congr (poly.mul p q) (poly.mul_comm r s))
    (poly.oneValue_trans (poly.mul_exchange4 p q s r)
      (poly.mul_congr (poly.mul p s) (poly.mul_comm q r)))

proof:
:=

name: cross_trans
statement:
theorem cross_trans {x y z : poly.PPair} (hy : ¬ poly.unitTail y.2)
    (h1 : poly.oneValue (poly.mul x.1 y.2) (poly.mul y.1 x.2))
    (h2 : poly.oneValue (poly.mul y.1 z.2) (poly.mul z.1 y.2)) :
    poly.oneValue (poly.mul x.1 z.2) (poly.mul z.1 x.2)
proof:
:=
  poly.pmul_cancel y.2 _ _ hy
    (poly.oneValue_trans
      (poly.oneValue_trans
        (poly.mul_left_comm y.2 x.1 z.2)
        (poly.oneValue_symm (poly.mul_assoc x.1 y.2 z.2)))
      (poly.oneValue_trans (poly.mul_congr_left h1 z.2)
        (poly.oneValue_trans (mulShuffle y.1 x.2 z.2)

name: pairLawsP
statement: private theorem pairLawsP : DLaws POcc opsP ovP
proof:
:=
  { ovRefl := fun x => poly.oneValue_refl _
    ovSymm := fun h => poly.oneValue_symm h
    ovTrans := fun {x y z} h1 h2 => cross_trans y.den_off h1 h2
    addCongr := fun h1 h2 => poly.pAdd_cross h1 h2
    mulCongr := fun h1 h2 => poly.pMul_cross h1 h2
    swapCongr := fun h => poly.pSwap_cross h
    addComm := fun x y =>
      crossOf
        (poly.add_comm (poly.mul x.val.1 y.val.2)
          (poly.mul y.val.1 x.val.2))
        (poly.mul_comm x.val.2 y.val.2)
    addAssoc := fun x y z =>
      crossOf
        (poly.oneValue_trans
          (poly.add_congr
            (poly.sum_mul (poly.mul x.val.1 y.val.2)
              (poly.mul y.val.1 x.val.2) z.val.2)
            (poly.oneValue_refl
              (poly.mul z.val.1 (poly.mul x.val.2 y.val.2))))
          (poly.oneValue_trans
            ((polyCoreO (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairLaws).addAssoc (poly.mul (poly.mul x.val.1 y.val.2) z.val.2)
              (poly.mul (poly.mul y.val.1 x.val.2) z.val.2)
              (poly.mul z.val.1 (poly.mul x.val.2 y.val.2)))
            (poly.oneValue_trans
              (poly.add_congr
                (poly.mul_assoc x.val.1 y.val.2 z.val.2)
                (poly.add_congr
                  (mulShuffle y.val.1 x.val.2 z.val.2)
                  (poly.oneValue_trans
                    (poly.oneValue_symm
                      (poly.mul_assoc z.val.1 x.val.2 y.val.2))
                    (mulShuffle z.val.1 x.val.2 y.val.2))))
              (poly.add_congr
                (poly.oneValue_refl
                  (poly.mul x.val.1 (poly.mul y.val.2 z.val.2)))
                (poly.oneValue_symm
                  (poly.sum_mul (poly.mul y.val.1 z.val.2)
                    (poly.mul z.val.1 y.val.2) x.val.2))))))
        (poly.mul_assoc x.val.2 y.val.2 z.val.2)
    mulComm := fun x y =>
      crossOf (poly.mul_comm x.val.1 y.val.1)
        (poly.mul_comm x.val.2 y.val.2)
    mulAssoc := fun x y z =>
      crossOf (poly.mul_assoc x.val.1 y.val.1 z.val.1)
        (poly.mul_assoc x.val.2 y.val.2 z.val.2)
    leftDistrib := fun x y z =>
      poly.oneValue_trans
        (poly.mul_congr_left
          (poly.mul_sum x.val.1 (poly.mul y.val.1 z.val.2)
            (poly.mul z.val.1 y.val.2))
          (poly.mul (poly.mul x.val.2 y.val.2)
            (poly.mul x.val.2 z.val.2)))
        (poly.oneValue_trans
          (poly.sum_mul (poly.mul x.val.1 (poly.mul y.val.1 z.val.2))
            (poly.mul x.val.1 (poly.mul z.val.1 y.val.2))
            (poly.mul (poly.mul x.val.2 y.val.2)
              (poly.mul x.val.2 z.val.2)))
          (poly.oneValue_trans
            (poly.add_congr
              (poly.oneValue_trans
                (poly.mul_congr_left
                  (poly.oneValue_symm
                    (poly.mul_assoc x.val.1 y.val.1 z.val.2))
                  (poly.mul (poly.mul x.val.2 y.val.2)
                    (poly.mul x.val.2 z.val.2)))
                (poly.oneValue_trans
                  (mulMulComm24 (poly.mul x.val.1 y.val.1) z.val.2
                    (poly.mul x.val.2 y.val.2)
                    (poly.mul x.val.2 z.val.2))
                  (poly.mul_congr
                    (poly.mul (poly.mul x.val.1 y.val.1)
                      (poly.mul x.val.2 z.val.2))
                    (poly.mul_assoc x.val.2 y.val.2 z.val.2))))
              (poly.oneValue_trans
                (poly.mul_congr_left
                  (poly.oneValue_symm
                    (poly.mul_assoc x.val.1 z.val.1 y.val.2))
                  (poly.mul (poly.mul x.val.2 y.val.2)
                    (poly.mul x.val.2 z.val.2)))
                (poly.oneValue_trans
                  (poly.mul_exchange4 (poly.mul x.val.1 z.val.1) y.val.2
                    (poly.mul x.val.2 y.val.2)
                    (poly.mul x.val.2 z.val.2))
                  (poly.mul_congr
                    (poly.mul (poly.mul x.val.1 z.val.1)
                      (poly.mul x.val.2 y.val.2))
                    (poly.mul_left_comm y.val.2 x.val.2 z.val.2)))))
            (poly.oneValue_symm
              (poly.sum_mul
                (poly.mul (poly.mul x.val.1 y.val.1)
                  (poly.mul x.val.2 z.val.2))
                (poly.mul (poly.mul x.val.1 z.val.1)
                  (poly.mul x.val.2 y.val.2))
                (poly.mul x.val.2 (poly.mul y.val.2 z.val.2))))))
    swapAdd := fun x y =>
      crossOf
        (poly.oneValue_trans
          (ovOfEq (R := poly.polyRead) (polyCoreO (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairLaws) (poly.neg_sum (poly.mul x.val.1 y.val.2)
            (poly.mul y.val.1 x.val.2)))
          (poly.add_congr
            (poly.oneValue_symm (poly.neg_prod_left x.val.1 y.val.2))
            (poly.oneValue_symm (poly.neg_prod_left y.val.1 x.val.2))))
        (poly.oneValue_refl (poly.mul x.val.2 y.val.2))
    swapSwap := fun x =>
      crossOf (ovOfEq (R := poly.polyRead) (polyCoreO (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairLaws) (poly.neg_neg x.val.1))

    swapUnit := poly.oneValue_refl []
    mulSwapRight := fun x y =>
      crossOf (ovOfEq (R := poly.polyRead) (polyCoreO (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairLaws) (poly.neg_prod x.val.1 y.val.1).symm)

      crossOf (mulOneOv x.val.1) (poly.one_mul x.val.2)
    addUnit := fun x =>
      crossOf
        (poly.oneValue_trans
          (ovOfEq (R := poly.polyRead) (polyCoreO (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairLaws) (poly.add_nil (poly.mul x.val.1 poly.one)))

      have hbB : unitBL bpairCof.unitB x.val.2 = false :=
        denOffB x.den_off

        poly.unitTail_of_negRead
          (poly.oneValue_trans h (poly.neg_prod_left x.val.1 x.val.2))

        cases hB : unitBL bpairCof.unitB x.val.1 with
        | true => exact unitBL_ut bpairCof x.val.1 hB

          exact (zeroDivL bpairLaws bpairCof hB hbB hut).elim

    oneMul := fun x =>
      crossOf (poly.one_mul x.val.1) (poly.one_mul x.val.2)

      poly.pmul_cancel _ _ _ (mulDenOff x.den_off x'.den_off)

          (poly.oneValue_symm
            (poly.oneValue_trans

          (poly.oneValue_trans
            (poly.add_cancel
              (poly.oneValue_trans
                (poly.oneValue_symm
                  (poly.sum_mul (poly.mul x.val.1 y.val.2)
                    (poly.mul y.val.1 x.val.2)
                    (poly.mul x'.val.2 y'.val.2)))

              (poly.mul_congr_left (poly.mul_comm y'.val.1 x'.val.2)

name: pairDetD_eq
statement:
theorem pairDetD_eq (m : List (List poly.PPair))
    (hsq : rowsLen m.length m) :
    poly.oneValue
      (poly.mul (pairDetD m).1
        (minorO poly.ppairOps poly.pnormPair id m).2)
      (poly.mul (minorO poly.ppairOps poly.pnormPair id m).1
        (pairDetD m).2)
proof:
:= by
  cases hocc : matOcc m with
  | false =>
    show poly.oneValue
      (poly.mul (match matOcc m with
        | true => (detDO pairCof (liftMat m)).val
        | false => minorO poly.ppairOps poly.pnormPair id m).1
        (minorO poly.ppairOps poly.pnormPair id m).2)
      (poly.mul (minorO poly.ppairOps poly.pnormPair id m).1
        (match matOcc m with
          | true => (detDO pairCof (liftMat m)).val
          | false => minorO poly.ppairOps poly.pnormPair id m).2)
    rw [hocc]
    exact poly.oneValue_refl _
  | true =>
  have hsq' : rowsLen (liftMat m).length (liftMat m) := by
    rw [show (liftMat m).length = m.length from
      ground.length_map (List.map liftT) m]
    exact liftMat_rowsLen m.length m hsq
  have h1 : ovP (detDO pairCof (liftMat m))
      (detO opsP (liftMat m)) :=
    detDO_eq (R := povRead) pairLawsP pairCof (liftMat m) hsq'
  have h2 : ovP (minorO opsP pnrmP id (liftMat m))
      (detO opsP (liftMat m)) :=
    minorO_detO (R := povRead) pairLawsP pnrmP id
      (fun x => pairCof.nrmOv x)
      (fun x => pairLawsP.toDCore.ovRefl x) (liftMat m) hsq'
  have hM : ovP (detDO pairCof (liftMat m))
      (minorO opsP pnrmP id (liftMat m)) :=
    pairLawsP.toDCore.ovTrans h1 (pairLawsP.toDCore.ovSymm h2)
  have hval : (minorO opsP pnrmP id (liftMat m)).val
      = minorO poly.ppairOps poly.pnormPair id m := by
    rw [minorO_val (liftMat m), liftMat_val m hocc]
  have hM' : poly.oneValue
      (poly.mul (detDO pairCof (liftMat m)).val.1
        (minorO poly.ppairOps poly.pnormPair id m).2)
      (poly.mul (minorO poly.ppairOps poly.pnormPair id m).1
        (detDO pairCof (liftMat m)).val.2) := by
    rw [← hval]
    exact hM
  show poly.oneValue
    (poly.mul (match matOcc m with
      | true => (detDO pairCof (liftMat m)).val
      | false => minorO poly.ppairOps poly.pnormPair id m).1
      (minorO poly.ppairOps poly.pnormPair id m).2)
    (poly.mul (minorO poly.ppairOps poly.pnormPair id m).1
      (match matOcc m with
        | true => (detDO pairCof (liftMat m)).val
        | false => minorO poly.ppairOps poly.pnormPair id m).2)
  rw [hocc]
  exact hM'

    | false => minorO poly.ppairOps poly.pnormPair id m).2

name: dotP_append
statement:
theorem dotP_append : ∀ (p v q w : List BPair), p.length = v.length →
    (dotP (p ++ q) (v ++ w)).oneValue (dotP p v + dotP q w)
  | [], [], q, w, _ => BPair.oneValue_symm (BPair.unit_add (dotP q w))
  | [], _ :: _, _, _, hl => nomatch hl
  | _ :: _, [], _, _, hl => nomatch hl
  | a :: p, b :: v, q, w, hl => by
    show (a * b + dotP (p ++ q) (v ++ w)).oneValue
      (a * b + dotP p v + dotP q w)
    exact BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.add_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl (a * b))
        (dotP_append p v q w (Nat.succ.inj hl)))
      (BPair.oneValue_of_eq
        (BPair.add_assoc (a * b) (dotP p v) (dotP q w)).symm)

/

name: vecAdd_app
statement:
theorem vecAdd_app : ∀ (a b c d : List BPair),
    a.length = c.length →
    vecAdd (a ++ b) (c ++ d) = vecAdd a c ++ vecAdd b d
  | [], _, [], _, _ => rfl
  | [], _, _ :: _, _, hl => nomatch hl
  | _ :: _, _, [], _, hl => nomatch hl
  | x :: a, b, y :: c, d, hl => by
    show (x + y) :: vecAdd (a ++ b) (c ++ d)
      = (x + y) :: (vecAdd a c ++ vecAdd b d)
    rw [vecAdd_app a b c d (Nat.succ.inj hl)]

class read the equality's own. -/

name: rowsLen_zipJoinO
statement:
private theorem rowsLen_zipJoinO {γ : Type} :
    ∀ (na nb : Nat) {P Q : List (List γ)}, rowsLen na P →
      rowsLen nb Q → rowsLen (na + nb) (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P Q)
  | _, _, [], _, _, _ => trivial
  | _, _, _ :: _, [], _, _ => trivial
  | na, nb, r :: P, s :: Q, hP, hQ => by
    show (r ++ s).length = na + nb
      ∧ rowsLen (na + nb) (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P Q)
    refine ⟨?_, rowsLen_zipJoinO na nb hP.2 hQ.2⟩
    rw [ground.length_append r s, hP.1, hQ.1]

/

proof:
:= by

  exact rowsLen_zipJoinO na nb hP hQ

name: matOne_rowJoin
statement:
theorem matOne_rowJoin {a : Nat} : ∀ (T T' U U' : Mat),
    rowsLen a T → rowsLen a T' →
    matOneValue T T' → matOneValue U U' →
    matOneValue (rowJoin T U) (rowJoin T' U')
  | [], [], _, _, _, _, _, _ => trivial
  | [], _ :: _, _, _, _, _, hT, _ => hT.elim
  | _ :: _, [], _, _, _, _, hT, _ => hT.elim
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, [], [], _, _, _, _ => trivial
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, [], _ :: _, _, _, _, hU => hU.elim
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, _ :: _, [], _, _, _, hU => hU.elim
  | t :: T, t' :: T', u :: U, u' :: U', hTr, hTr', hT, hU =>
    ⟨poly.oneValue_append t t' u u' (hTr.1.trans hTr'.1.symm)
        hT.1 hU.1,
     matOne_rowJoin T T' U U' hTr.2 hTr'.2 hT.2 hU.2⟩

/
vector's image is the two sides' images' componentwise sum. -/

name: matVec_rowJoin
statement:
theorem matVec_rowJoin : ∀ (na : Nat) (P Q : Mat)
    (v w : List BPair),
    rowsLen na P → v.length = na →
    poly.oneValue (matVec (rowJoin P Q) (v ++ w))
      (vecAdd (matVec P v) (matVec Q w))
  | _, [], _, _, _, _, _ => trivial
  | _, _ :: _, [], _, _, _, _ => trivial
  | na, r :: P, s :: Q, v, w, hP, hv => by
    show (dotN (r ++ s) (v ++ w)).oneValue (dotN r v + dotN s w)
      ∧ poly.oneValue (matVec (rowJoin P Q) (v ++ w))
        (vecAdd (matVec P v) (matVec Q w))
    refine ⟨?_, matVec_rowJoin na P Q v w hP.2 hv⟩
    exact BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.oneValue_trans (dotN_read (r ++ s) (v ++ w))
        (dotP_append r v s w (hP.1.trans hv.symm)))
      (BPair.add_congr (BPair.oneValue_symm (dotN_read r v))
        (BPair.oneValue_symm (dotN_read s w)))


/-! The block-triangular determinant: the expansion at the vacant
slab's head row, the crossing keys reading the sum's unit and the
trailing block's own expansion collecting the diagonal blocks'
product. -/

/
side. -/
private theorem eraseIdx_append_off {α : Type} :
    ∀ (u v : List α) (j : Nat),
      (u ++ v).eraseIdx (u.length + j) = u ++ v.eraseIdx j
  | [], v, j => by
    show v.eraseIdx (0 + j) = v.eraseIdx j
    rw [Nat.zero_add]
  | a :: u, v, j => by
    show (a :: (u ++ v)).eraseIdx (u.length + 1 + j)
      = a :: (u ++ v.eraseIdx j)
    rw [Nat.add_right_comm u.length 1 j]
    show a :: ((u ++ v).eraseIdx (u.length + j))
      = a :: (u ++ v.eraseIdx j)
    rw [eraseIdx_append_off u v j]

/
alone, row by row. -/
private theorem map_eraseIdx_rowJoin {γ : Type} (k j : Nat) :
    ∀ P B : List (List γ), rowsLen k P →
      (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P B).map (fun r => r.eraseIdx (k + j))
        = List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P (B.map (fun r => r.eraseIdx j))
  | [], _, _ => rfl
  | _ :: _, [], _ => rfl
  | p :: P, b :: B, h => by
    show (p ++ b).eraseIdx (k + j)
        :: (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P B).map
          (fun r => r.eraseIdx (k + j))
      = (p ++ b.eraseIdx j)
        :: List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P (B.map (fun r => r.eraseIdx j))
    rw [show (p ++ b).eraseIdx (k + j) = p ++ b.eraseIdx j from by
        rw [← h.1]
        exact eraseIdx_append_off p b j,
      map_eraseIdx_rowJoin k j P B h.2]

/
private theorem rowJoin_nilRows {γ : Type} :
    ∀ P B : List (List γ), P.length = B.length →
      rowsLen 0 B → List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P B = P
  | [], [], _, _ => rfl
  | [], _ :: _, h, _ => Nat.noConfusion h
  | _ :: _, [], h, _ => Nat.noConfusion h
  | p :: P, b :: B, h, hb => by
    have hbn : b = []
proof:
:= by
      cases b with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons _ t => exact Nat.noConfusion hb.1
    show (p ++ b) :: List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P B = p :: P
    rw [hbn, ground.append_nil p,
      rowJoin_nilRows P B (Nat.succ.inj h) hb.2]

      (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P B).map (fun r => r.eraseIdx (k + j))
        = List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P (B.map (fun r => r.eraseIdx j))
  | [], _, _ => rfl
  | _ :: _, [], _ => rfl
  | p :: P, b :: B, h => by
    show (p ++ b).eraseIdx (k + j)
        :: (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P B).map
          (fun r => r.eraseIdx (k + j))
      = (p ++ b.eraseIdx j)
        :: List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P (B.map (fun r => r.eraseIdx j))
    rw [show (p ++ b).eraseIdx (k + j) = p ++ b.eraseIdx j from by
        rw [← h.1]
        exact eraseIdx_append_off p b j,
      map_eraseIdx_rowJoin k j P B h.2]

/
private theorem rowJoin_nilRows {γ : Type} :
    ∀ P B : List (List γ), P.length = B.length →
      rowsLen 0 B → List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P B = P
  | [], [], _, _ => rfl
  | [], _ :: _, h, _ => Nat.noConfusion h
  | _ :: _, [], h, _ => Nat.noConfusion h
  | p :: P, b :: B, h, hb => by
    have hbn : b = []
proof:
:= by
      cases b with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons _ t => exact Nat.noConfusion hb.1
    show (p ++ b) :: List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P B = p :: P
    rw [hbn, ground.append_nil p,
      rowJoin_nilRows P B (Nat.succ.inj h) hb.2]

statement:
private theorem rowJoin_nilRows {γ : Type} :
    ∀ P B : List (List γ), P.length = B.length →

  | [], [], _, _ => rfl
  | [], _ :: _, h, _ => Nat.noConfusion h
  | _ :: _, [], h, _ => Nat.noConfusion h
  | p :: P, b :: B, h, hb => by
    have hbn : b = []
proof:
:= by
      cases b with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons _ t => exact Nat.noConfusion hb.1
    show (p ++ b) :: List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P B = p :: P
    rw [hbn, ground.append_nil p,
      rowJoin_nilRows P B (Nat.succ.inj h) hb.2]

name: detO_rowSplit
statement:
private theorem detO_rowSplit {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
    (top rest : List (List γ)) (z : List γ)
    (k n : Nat) (htop : top.length = k)
    (hn : (top ++ rest).length = n) :
    R.rel (detO ops (top ++ z :: rest))
      (ground.famFold ops.add ops.unit
        (fun j => sgnPO ops (k + j)
          (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit z j)
            (cof0O ops (top ++ rest) j)))
        (List.range (n + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : (top ++ z :: rest).length = k + (z :: rest).length := by
    rw [ground.length_append, htop]
  have hk : k < (top ++ z :: rest).length := by
    rw [hlen]
    exact Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.le_add_right k rest.length)
  have hget : ground.getAt ([] : List γ) (top ++ z :: rest) k = z := by
    rw [← htop]
    exact ground.getAt_append_add [] top (z :: rest) 0
  have herase : (top ++ z :: rest).eraseIdx k = top ++ rest := by
    rw [← htop]
    exact eraseIdx_append_off top (z :: rest) 0
  have hexp := detO_replace L (top ++ z :: rest) k hk
    (ground.getAt [] (top ++ z :: rest) k)
  rw [ground.set_self [] (top ++ z :: rest) k hk, hget, herase, hn] at hexp
  exact hexp

name: foldRange_shift
statement:
private theorem foldRange_shift {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
    (f : Nat → γ) (k n N : Nat) (hN : N = k + n)
    (hnull : ∀ j, j < k → R.rel (f j) ops.unit) :
    R.rel (ground.famFold ops.add ops.unit f (List.range N))
      (ground.famFold ops.add ops.unit (fun j => f (k + j))
        (List.range n))
proof:
:= by
  rw [hN, ground.range_split k n]
  refine L.ovTrans
    (ground.famFold_append_ov (foldLawsOf L) f (List.range k)
      ((List.range n).map (fun c => k + c))) ?_
  rw [ground.famFold_map ops.add ops.unit f (fun c => k + c)
    (List.range n)]
  refine L.ovTrans
    (L.addCongr
      (ground.famFold_null_ov (foldLawsOf L) f (List.range k)
        (fun x hx => hnull x (by
          cases Nat.lt_or_ge x k with
          | inl h => exact h
          | inr h =>
            rw [ground.countOf_range x k,
              if_neg (fun hlt : x < k =>
                Nat.lt_irrefl x (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hlt h))] at hx
            exact absurd hx (Nat.lt_irrefl 0))))
      (L.ovRefl _)) ?_
  exact L.unitAdd _

name: detO_blockTriGo
statement:
private theorem detO_blockTriGo {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
    (P : List (List γ)) (k : Nat)
    (hPl : P.length = k) (hPr : rowsLen k P) :
    ∀ (m : Nat) (B Rm : List (List γ)), B.length = k → rowsLen m B →
      Rm.length = m → rowsLen m Rm →
      R.rel (detO ops (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P B
        ++ List.zipWith (· ++ ·)
          (List.replicate m (List.replicate k ops.unit)) Rm))
        (ops.mul (detO ops P) (detO ops Rm))
  | 0, B, Rm, hBl, hBr, hRl, _ => by
    match Rm, hRl with
    | [], _ =>
      show R.rel (detO ops (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P B ++ []))
        (ops.mul (detO ops P) (detO ops []))
      rw [ground.append_nil (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P B),
        rowJoin_nilRows P B (hPl.trans hBl.symm) hBr]
      exact L.ovSymm
        (L.ovTrans (L.mulCongr (L.ovRefl (detO ops P)) (detO_nil L))
          (L.ovTrans (L.mulComm (detO ops P) ops.one)
            (L.oneMul (detO ops P))))
    | _ :: _, h => exact Nat.noConfusion h
  | m + 1, B, Rm, hBl, hBr, hRl, hRr => by
    match Rm, hRl, hRr with
    | [], h, _ => exact Nat.noConfusion h
    | r0 :: R', hRl, hRr =>
      have hR'l : R'.length = m
proof:
:= Nat.succ.inj hRl
      have hZ : (List.replicate k ops.unit).length = k :=
        ground.length_replicate ops.unit k
      have htop : (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P B).length = k :=
        ground.length_zipWith (· ++ ·) P B k hPl hBl
      have hrest : (List.zipWith (· ++ ·)
          (List.replicate m (List.replicate k ops.unit))
          R').length = m :=
        ground.length_zipWith (· ++ ·) _ R' m
          (ground.length_replicate (List.replicate k ops.unit) m) hR'l
      have hsgnU : ∀ s : Nat, R.rel (sgnPO ops s ops.unit) ops.unit := by
        intro s
        show R.rel (if places.parityOf s then ops.swap ops.unit
            else ops.unit) ops.unit
        cases places.parityOf s with
        | true => exact L.swapUnit
        | false => exact L.ovRefl _
      have hsign : ∀ (i : Nat) (Y : γ),
          R.rel (sgnPO ops (k + (k + i)) Y) (sgnPO ops i Y) := by
        intro i Y
        rw [show k + (k + i) = k + k + i from (Nat.add_assoc k k i).symm]
        exact L.ovTrans
          (L.ovSymm (sgnPO_add L.toDCore (k + k) i Y))
          (ovOfEq L.toDCore (sgnPO_even ops k (sgnPO ops i Y)))
      show R.rel (detO ops (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P B
          ++ (List.replicate k ops.unit ++ r0)
            :: List.zipWith (· ++ ·)
              (List.replicate m (List.replicate k ops.unit))
              R')) (ops.mul (detO ops P) (detO ops (r0 :: R')))
      refine L.ovTrans
        (detO_rowSplit L (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P B)
          (List.zipWith (· ++ ·)
            (List.replicate m (List.replicate k ops.unit)) R')
          (List.replicate k ops.unit ++ r0) k (k + m) htop
          (by rw [ground.length_append, htop, hrest])) ?_
      refine L.ovTrans
        (foldRange_shift L _ k (m + 1) (k + m + 1)
          (Nat.add_assoc k m 1) (fun j hj => ?_)) ?_
      · refine L.ovTrans
          (sgnPO_congr L.toDCore
            (L.ovTrans
              (L.mulCongr
                (ovOfEq L.toDCore (by
                  rw [ground.getAt_append ops.unit
                      (List.replicate k ops.unit) r0 j,
                    if_pos (show j
                        < (List.replicate k ops.unit).length from by
                      rw [hZ]
                      exact hj),
                    ground.getAt_replicate ops.unit ops.unit k j hj]))
                (L.ovRefl _))
              (mulUnitLeftO L _)))
          (hsgnU (k + j))
      refine L.ovTrans
        (foldO_congr_members L.toDCore _
          (fun j => ops.mul (detO ops P) (sgnPO ops j
            (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit r0 j) (cof0O ops R' j))))
          (List.range (m + 1)) (fun j hj => ?_)) ?_
      · have hjm : j < m + 1 := by
          cases Nat.lt_or_ge j (m + 1) with
          | inl h => exact h
          | inr h =>
            rw [ground.countOf_range j (m + 1),
              if_neg (fun hlt : j < m + 1 =>
                Nat.lt_irrefl j (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hlt h))] at hj
            exact absurd hj (Nat.lt_irrefl 0)
        have hent : ground.getAt ops.unit
            (List.replicate k ops.unit ++ r0) (k + j)
            = ground.getAt ops.unit r0 j := by
          have h := ground.getAt_append_add ops.unit
            (List.replicate k ops.unit) r0 j
          rw [hZ] at h
          exact h
        have hstruck : ((List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P B
              ++ List.zipWith (· ++ ·)
                (List.replicate m (List.replicate k ops.unit))
                R').map (fun r => r.eraseIdx (k + j)))
            = List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P (B.map (fun r => r.eraseIdx j))
              ++ List.zipWith (· ++ ·)
                (List.replicate m (List.replicate k ops.unit))
                (R'.map (fun r => r.eraseIdx j)) := by
          rw [ground.map_append, map_eraseIdx_rowJoin k j P B hPr,
            map_eraseIdx_rowJoin k j
              (List.replicate m (List.replicate k ops.unit)) R'
              (rowsLen_replicateO ops.unit k m)]
        have hcof : R.rel (cof0O ops (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P B
              ++ List.zipWith (· ++ ·)
                (List.replicate m (List.replicate k ops.unit)) R')
            (k + j)) (ops.mul (detO ops P) (cof0O ops R' j)) := by
          refine L.ovTrans
            (cof0O_strike L.toDCore _ (k + j)
              (by
                rw [ground.length_append, htop, hrest]
                exact Nat.add_le_add_left
                  (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hjm) k)) ?_
          rw [hstruck]
          have hih := detO_blockTriGo L P k hPl hPr m
            (B.map (fun r => r.eraseIdx j))
            (R'.map (fun r => r.eraseIdx j))
            ((ground.length_map (fun r => List.eraseIdx r j) B).trans hBl)
            (rowsLen_eraseCol m j hjm B hBr)
            ((ground.length_map (fun r => List.eraseIdx r j) R').trans hR'l)
            (rowsLen_eraseCol m j hjm R' hRr.2)
          refine L.ovTrans hih ?_
          exact L.mulCongr (L.ovRefl (detO ops P))
            (L.ovSymm
              (cof0O_strike L.toDCore R' j
                (by
                  rw [hR'l]
                  exact Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hjm)))
        refine L.ovTrans (hsign j _) ?_
        refine L.ovTrans
          (sgnPO_congr L.toDCore
            (L.ovTrans
              (L.mulCongr (ovOfEq L.toDCore hent) hcof)
              (mulSwapLeftO L.toDCore _ _ _))) ?_
        exact sgnPO_mul L.toDCore j _ _
      refine L.ovTrans (foldO_mul_left L (detO ops P) _ _) ?_
      refine L.mulCongr (L.ovRefl (detO ops P)) (L.ovSymm ?_)
      have hcons := detO_cons L r0 R'
      rw [hR'l] at hcons
      exact hcons

name: detO_blockTri
statement:
private theorem detO_blockTri {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
    (P B Rm : List (List γ)) (k m : Nat)
    (hPl : P.length = k) (hPr : rowsLen k P)
    (hBl : B.length = k) (hBr : rowsLen m B)
    (hRl : Rm.length = m) (hRr : rowsLen m Rm) :
    R.rel (detO ops (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P B
      ++ List.zipWith (· ++ ·)
        (List.replicate m (List.replicate k ops.unit)) Rm))
      (ops.mul (detO ops P) (detO ops Rm))
proof:
:=
  detO_blockTriGo L P k hPl hPr m B Rm hBl hBr hRl hRr

name: detL_blockTri
statement:
theorem detL_blockTri (P B R : Mat) (k m : Nat) (hP : sqAt P k)

    (detL (rowJoin P B
      ++ rowJoin (List.replicate m (List.replicate k BPair.unit)) R)).oneValue
      (detL P * detL R)
proof:

name: entry_matAdd
statement:
theorem entry_matAdd (A B : Mat) (n : Nat) (hA : rowsLen n A)
    (hB : rowsLen n B) (i j : Nat) (hiA : i < A.length) (hiB : i < B.length)
    (hj : j < n) :
    ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] (matAdd A B) i) j
      = ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] A i) j
        + ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] B i) j
proof:
:= by
  rw [getAt_matAdd A B i hiA hiB]
  exact getAt_vecAdd _ _ j (by rw [rowsLen_getAt A i hA hiA]; exact hj)
    (by rw [rowsLen_getAt B i hB hiB]; exact hj)

name: entry_msum
statement:
theorem entry_msum (n : Nat) (g : Nat → Mat) (i j : Nat) (hi : i < n)
    (hj : j < n) :
    ∀ l : List Nat, (∀ k, k ∈ l → rowsLen n (g k) ∧ (g k).length = n) →
      ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] (msum n g l) i) j
        = ground.famFold BPair.add BPair.unit
            (fun k => ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] (g k) i) j) l
  | [], _ => by
    show ground.getAt BPair.unit
      (ground.getAt [] (List.replicate n (List.replicate n BPair.unit)) i) j
      = BPair.unit
    rw [ground.getAt_replicate [] _ n i hi]
    exact ground.getAt_replicate BPair.unit BPair.unit n j hj
  | k :: t, hg => by
    have hk
proof:
:= hg k (List.Mem.head t)
    have ht := msum_shape_mem n g t (fun l hl => hg l (List.Mem.tail k hl))
    rw [msum_cons n g k t,
      entry_matAdd (g k) (msum n g t) n hk.1 ht.1 i j
        (by rw [hk.2]; exact hi) (by rw [ht.2]; exact hi) hj,
      entry_msum n g i j hi hj t (fun l hl => hg l (List.Mem.tail k hl))]
    rfl

name: entry_matSwap
statement:
theorem entry_matSwap (A : Mat) (n : Nat) (hA : rowsLen n A)

      = (ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] A i) j).swap
proof:

name: length_redGoO
statement:
private theorem length_redGoO {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ)
    (M : List (List γ)) (k : Nat) (y : Nat → List γ) :
    ∀ i, (redGoO ops M k y i).length = M.length
  | 0 => rfl
  | i + 1 => by
    show (List.set (redGoO ops M k y i) (k + i) _).length = M.length
    rw [ground.length_set, length_redGoO ops M k y i]

private theorem getAt_redGoO_lt {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ)
    (M : List (List γ)) (k : Nat) (y : Nat → List γ)
    (t : Nat) (ht : t < k) :
    ∀ i, ground.getAt [] (redGoO ops M k y i) t = ground.getAt [] M t
  | 0 => rfl
  | i + 1 => by
    show ground.getAt [] (List.set (redGoO ops M k y i) (k + i) _) t = _
    rw [ground.getAt_set_ne [] _ (k + i) t _ (fun he => by
        rw [he] at ht
        exact Nat.lt_irrefl k
          (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_add_right k i) ht)),
      getAt_redGoO_lt ops M k y t ht i]

private theorem getAt_redGoO_ge {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ)
    (M : List (List γ)) (k : Nat) (y : Nat → List γ) (t : Nat) :
    ∀ i, k + i ≤ t →
      ground.getAt [] (redGoO ops M k y i) t = ground.getAt [] M t
  | 0, _ => rfl
  | i + 1, ht => by
    show ground.getAt [] (List.set (redGoO ops M k y i) (k + i) _) t = _
    rw [ground.getAt_set_ne [] _ (k + i) t _ (fun he => by
        rw [he] at ht
        exact Nat.lt_irrefl _
          (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_succ_self (k + i)) ht)),
      getAt_redGoO_ge ops M k y t i (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_succ (k + i)) ht)]

private theorem getAt_redGoO_mid {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ)
    (M : List (List γ)) (k : Nat) (y : Nat → List γ) (i' : Nat) :
    ∀ i, i' < i → k + i ≤ M.length →
      ground.getAt [] (redGoO ops M k y i) (k + i')
        = comboO ops M.length (y i') M
  | 0, h, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero i')
  | i + 1, h, hle => by
    show ground.getAt [] (List.set (redGoO ops M k y i) (k + i)
      (comboO ops M.length (y i) M)) (k + i') = _
    by_cases he : i' = i
    · rw [he]
      exact ground.getAt_set_self [] _ _ (k + i)
        (by rw [length_redGoO]; exact Nat.lt_of_succ_le hle)
    · rw [ground.getAt_set_ne [] _ (k + i) (k + i') _
        (fun h2 => he (ground.addCancelL k h2))]
      exact getAt_redGoO_mid ops M k y i' i
        (by
          match Nat.lt_or_ge i' i with
          | .inl hh => exact hh
          | .inr hh =>
            exact absurd (Nat.le_antisymm (Nat.le_of_lt_succ h) hh) he)
        (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_succ (k + i)) hle)

/
determinant once, the power at the replaced count. -/
private theorem detO_redGo {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
    (M : List (List γ)) (k m : Nat) (d : γ) (c : Nat → Nat → γ)
    (hn : M.length = k + m) (hM : rowsLen M.length M) :
    ∀ i, i ≤ m →
      R.rel (detO ops (redGoO ops M k (redCoefO ops M.length k d c) i))
        (ops.mul (poly.powO ops d i) (detO ops M))
  | 0, _ => L.ovSymm (L.oneMul (detO ops M))
  | i + 1, hi => by
    have hki : k + i < M.length
proof:
:= by
      rw [hn]
      exact Nat.add_lt_add_left (Nat.lt_of_succ_le hi) k
    have hlen : (redGoO ops M k (redCoefO ops M.length k d c) i).length
        = M.length := length_redGoO ops M k _ i
    show R.rel (detO ops (List.set
      (redGoO ops M k (redCoefO ops M.length k d c) i) (k + i)
      (comboO ops M.length (redCoefO ops M.length k d c i) M))) _
    have hcomb := detO_comboRow L M
      (redGoO ops M k (redCoefO ops M.length k d c) i)
      (k + i) (by rw [hlen]; exact hki) (by rw [hlen]; exact hM) hlen.symm
      (redCoefO ops M.length k d c i)
      (by rw [hlen]; exact length_redCoefO ops _ _ _ _ _)
      (fun t ht htk => by
        have htn : t < M.length := by
          rw [← hlen]
          exact ht
        by_cases htk' : t < k
        · exact Or.inr (getAt_redGoO_lt ops M k _ t htk' i).symm
        · cases Nat.lt_or_ge t (k + i) with
          | inl _ =>
            refine Or.inl ?_
            rw [getAt_redCoefO ops M.length k d c i t htn,
              if_neg htk', if_neg htk]
            exact L.ovRefl _
          | inr hge =>
            exact Or.inr (getAt_redGoO_ge ops M k _ t i hge).symm)
