name: redCoefO_dot
statement:
private theorem redCoefO_dot {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
    (k m : Nat) (d : γ) (c : Nat → Nat → γ) (i : Nat) (hi : i < m)
    (g : Nat → γ) :
    R.rel (dotO ops (redCoefO ops (k + m) k d c i)
        ((List.range (k + m)).map g))
      (ops.add
        (ground.famFold ops.add ops.unit
          (fun s => ops.mul (ops.swap (c s i)) (g s)) (List.range k))
        (ops.mul d (g (k + i))))
proof:
:= by
  rw [dotO_map_range ops g (k + m) _ (length_redCoefO ops _ _ _ _ _),
    ground.range_split k m]
  refine L.ovTrans
    (ground.famFold_append_ov (foldLawsOf L) _ (List.range k)
      ((List.range m).map (fun e => k + e))) ?_
  rw [ground.famFold_map ops.add ops.unit _ (fun e => k + e)
    (List.range m)]
  refine L.addCongr ?_ ?_
  · refine foldO_congr_members L.toDCore _ _ (List.range k) ?_
    intro s hs
    have hsk : s < k := ground.ltOfMem hs
    rw [getAt_redCoefO ops (k + m) k d c i s
        (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hsk (Nat.le_add_right k m)), if_pos hsk]
    exact L.ovRefl _
  · refine ground.famFold_pick_ov (foldLawsOf L) _ i _ (List.range m)
      (ground.countOf_range_one hi) ?_ ?_
    · rw [getAt_redCoefO ops (k + m) k d c i (k + i)
          (Nat.add_lt_add_left hi k),
        if_neg (fun h => Nat.lt_irrefl k
          (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_add_right k i) h)),
        if_pos rfl]
      exact L.ovRefl _
    · intro j hj hji
      rw [getAt_redCoefO ops (k + m) k d c i (k + j)
          (Nat.add_lt_add_left (ground.ltOfMem hj) k),
        if_neg (fun h => Nat.lt_irrefl k
          (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_add_right k j) h)),
        if_neg (fun h => hji (ground.addCancelL k h))]
      exact mulUnitLeftO L _

name: detO_slabReduce
statement:
private theorem detO_slabReduce {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
    (P B X Y Lr Rr : List (List γ)) (k m : Nat) (d : γ)
    (c : Nat → Nat → γ)
    (hPl : P.length = k) (hPr : rowsLen k P)
    (hBl : B.length = k) (hBr : rowsLen m B)
    (hX : X.length = m) (hXr : rowsLen k X)
    (hYl : Y.length = m) (hYr : rowsLen m Y)
    (hLl : Lr.length = m) (hLr : rowsLen k Lr)
    (hRl : Rr.length = m)
    (hL : ∀ i b, i < m → b < k →
      R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] Lr i) b)
        (ops.add (ops.mul d (ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] X i) b))
          (ops.swap (ground.famFold ops.add ops.unit
            (fun s => ops.mul (c s i)
              (ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] P s) b))
            (List.range k)))))
    (hR : ∀ i v, i < m → v < m →
      R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] Rr i) v)
        (ops.add (ops.mul d (ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] Y i) v))
          (ops.swap (ground.famFold ops.add ops.unit
            (fun s => ops.mul (c s i)
              (ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] B s) v))
            (List.range k))))) :
    R.rel (ops.mul (poly.powO ops d m)
        (detO ops (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P B
          ++ List.zipWith (· ++ ·) X Y)))
      (detO ops (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P B
        ++ List.zipWith (· ++ ·) Lr Rr))
proof:
:= by
  have hPBl : (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P B).length = k :=
    ground.length_zipWith (· ++ ·) P B k hPl hBl
  have hXYl : (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) X Y).length = m :=
    ground.length_zipWith (· ++ ·) X Y m hX hYl
  have hMl : (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P B
      ++ List.zipWith (· ++ ·) X Y).length = k + m := by
    rw [ground.length_append, hPBl, hXYl]
  have hMr : rowsLen (k + m) (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P B
      ++ List.zipWith (· ++ ·) X Y) :=
    rowsLen_appendO (k + m) (rowsLen_zipJoinO k m hPr hBr)
      (rowsLen_zipJoinO k m hXr hYr)
  have hMr' : rowsLen (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P B
      ++ List.zipWith (· ++ ·) X Y).length
      (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P B ++ List.zipWith (· ++ ·) X Y) := by
    rw [hMl]
    exact hMr
  have hLRl : (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) Lr Rr).length = m :=
    ground.length_zipWith (· ++ ·) Lr Rr m hLl hRl
  have hTl : (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P B
      ++ List.zipWith (· ++ ·) Lr Rr).length = k + m := by
    rw [ground.length_append, hPBl, hLRl]
  refine L.ovTrans
    (L.ovSymm (detO_redGo L (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P B
      ++ List.zipWith (· ++ ·) X Y) k m d c hMl hMr' m (Nat.le_refl m))) ?_
  refine detO_congr_letters L.toDCore _ _
    (by rw [length_redGoO, hMl, hTl]) ?_
  intro a ha b hb
  rw [length_redGoO, hMl] at ha hb
  by_cases hak : a < k
  · rw [getAt_redGoO_lt ops _ k _ a hak m,
      ground.getAt_append ([] : List γ) (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P B)
        (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) X Y) a,
      ground.getAt_append ([] : List γ) (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P B)
        (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) Lr Rr) a,
      hPBl, if_pos hak, if_pos hak]
    exact L.ovRefl _
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Nat.le.dest (Nat.le_of_not_lt hak)
    rw [← hi] at ha ⊢
    have him : i < m := by
      match Nat.lt_or_ge i m with
      | .inl h => exact h
      | .inr h =>
        exact absurd ha (Nat.not_lt_of_le (Nat.add_le_add_left h k))
    rw [getAt_redGoO_mid ops _ k _ i m him
      (by rw [hMl]; exact Nat.le_refl _)]
    rw [show ground.getAt ([] : List γ) (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P B
          ++ List.zipWith (· ++ ·) Lr Rr) (k + i)
        = ground.getAt ([] : List γ) Lr i
          ++ ground.getAt ([] : List γ) Rr i from by
      rw [← hPBl, ground.getAt_append_add ([] : List γ) _ _ i,
        ground.getAt_zipWith [] [] [] (· ++ ·) Lr Rr i
          (by rw [hLl]; exact him) (by rw [hRl]; exact him)]]
    rw [hMl]
    refine L.ovTrans (comboO_getAt L (k + m) _ _ b hMr hb) ?_
    have hcol : (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P B
          ++ List.zipWith (· ++ ·) X Y).map
          (fun r => ground.getAt ops.unit r b)
        = (List.range (k + m)).map (fun s =>
          ground.getAt ops.unit
            (ground.getAt [] (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P B
              ++ List.zipWith (· ++ ·) X Y) s) b) := by
      conv => lhs; rw [← ground.range_map_getAt [] (k + m)
        (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P B ++ List.zipWith (· ++ ·) X Y) hMl]
      exact ground.map_map _ _ _
    rw [hcol]
    refine L.ovTrans (redCoefO_dot L k m d c i him _) ?_
    have hXi : (ground.getAt ([] : List γ) X i).length = k :=
      rowsLen_getAt X i hXr (by rw [hX]; exact him)
    have hLi : (ground.getAt ([] : List γ) Lr i).length = k :=
      rowsLen_getAt Lr i hLr (by rw [hLl]; exact him)
    have hrowki : ground.getAt ([] : List γ)
        (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P B ++ List.zipWith (· ++ ·) X Y) (k + i)
        = ground.getAt [] X i ++ ground.getAt [] Y i := by
      rw [← hPBl, ground.getAt_append_add ([] : List γ) _ _ i,
        ground.getAt_zipWith [] [] [] (· ++ ·) X Y i
          (by rw [hX]; exact him) (by rw [hYl]; exact him)]
    rw [hrowki, ground.getAt_append ops.unit
      (ground.getAt [] Lr i) (ground.getAt [] Rr i) b, hLi]
    by_cases hbk : b < k
    · rw [if_pos hbk, ground.getAt_append ops.unit
        (ground.getAt [] X i) (ground.getAt [] Y i) b, hXi, if_pos hbk]
      refine L.ovTrans ?_ (L.ovSymm (hL i b him hbk))
      refine L.ovTrans (L.addComm _ _) ?_
      refine L.addCongr (L.ovRefl _) ?_
      refine L.ovTrans ?_ (foldO_swap L.toDCore _ (List.range k))
      refine foldO_congr_members L.toDCore _ _ (List.range k) ?_
      intro s hs
      have hsk : s < k := ground.ltOfMem hs
      rw [ground.getAt_append ([] : List γ) (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P B)
          (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) X Y) s, hPBl, if_pos hsk,
        ground.getAt_zipWith [] [] [] (· ++ ·) P B s
          (by rw [hPl]; exact hsk) (by rw [hBl]; exact hsk),
        ground.getAt_append ops.unit (ground.getAt [] P s)
          (ground.getAt [] B s) b,
        rowsLen_getAt P s hPr (by rw [hPl]; exact hsk), if_pos hbk]
      exact mulSwapLeft L.toDCore _ _
    · obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := Nat.le.dest (Nat.le_of_not_lt hbk)
      have hvm : v < m := by
        match Nat.lt_or_ge v m with
        | .inl h => exact h
        | .inr h =>
          rw [← hv] at hb
          exact absurd hb (Nat.not_lt_of_le (Nat.add_le_add_left h k))
      rw [if_neg hbk, ← hv, ground.addSubSelfL k v,
        ground.getAt_append ops.unit (ground.getAt [] X i)
          (ground.getAt [] Y i) (k + v), hXi,
        if_neg (fun h => Nat.lt_irrefl k
          (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_add_right k v) h)),
        ground.addSubSelfL k v]
      refine L.ovTrans ?_ (L.ovSymm (hR i v him hvm))
      refine L.ovTrans (L.addComm _ _) ?_
      refine L.addCongr (L.ovRefl _) ?_
      refine L.ovTrans ?_ (foldO_swap L.toDCore _ (List.range k))
      refine foldO_congr_members L.toDCore _ _ (List.range k) ?_
      intro s hs
      have hsk : s < k := ground.ltOfMem hs
      rw [ground.getAt_append ([] : List γ) (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P B)
          (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) X Y) s, hPBl, if_pos hsk,
        ground.getAt_zipWith [] [] [] (· ++ ·) P B s
          (by rw [hPl]; exact hsk) (by rw [hBl]; exact hsk),
        ground.getAt_append ops.unit (ground.getAt [] P s)
          (ground.getAt [] B s) (k + v),
        rowsLen_getAt P s hPr (by rw [hPl]; exact hsk),
        if_neg (fun h => Nat.lt_irrefl k
          (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_add_right k v) h)),
        ground.addSubSelfL k v]
      exact mulSwapLeft L.toDCore _ _

name: transMul_entry
statement:
private theorem transMul_entry (C Z : Mat) (k m w : Nat) (hk : 0 < k)
    (hCl : C.length = k) (hCr : rowsLen m C) (hZl : Z.length = k)
    (hZr : rowsLen w Z) (i b : Nat) (hi : i < m) (hb : b < w) :
    (ground.getAt BPair.unit
      (ground.getAt [] (matMul (transposeM C) Z) i) b).oneValue
      (ground.famFold BPair.add BPair.unit
        (fun s => ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] C s) i
          * ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] Z s) b)
        (List.range k))
proof:
:= by
  have hCt : (transposeM C).length = m :=
    length_transposeM C hCr (by rw [hCl]; exact hk)
  have hCtr : rowsLen k (transposeM C) :=
    rowsLen_cast hCl (rowsLen_transposeM C)
  have hZt : (transposeM Z).length = w :=
    length_transposeM Z hZr (by rw [hZl]; exact hk)
  have hZtr : rowsLen k (transposeM Z) :=
    rowsLen_cast hZl (rowsLen_transposeM Z)
  rw [getAt_matMul (transposeM C) Z i (by rw [hCt]; exact hi),
    ground.getAt_map ([] : List BPair) BPair.unit _ (transposeM Z) b
      (by rw [hZt]; exact hb)]
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans (dotN_read _ _) ?_
  have hrC : (ground.getAt [] (transposeM C) i).length = k :=
    rowsLen_getAt _ i hCtr (by rw [hCt]; exact hi)
  have hrZ : (ground.getAt [] (transposeM Z) b).length = k :=
    rowsLen_getAt _ b hZtr (by rw [hZt]; exact hb)
  rw [← ground.range_map_getAt BPair.unit k _ hrC,
    ← ground.range_map_getAt BPair.unit k _ hrZ, dotP_map_pair]
  refine ground.foldB_congr_members _ _ (List.range k) ?_
  intro s hs
  have hsk : s < k := ground.ltOfMem hs
  rw [getAt_transposeM BPair.unit C hCr i s hi (by rw [hCl]; exact hsk),
    getAt_transposeM BPair.unit Z hZr b s hb (by rw [hZl]; exact hsk)]
  exact BPair.oneValue_refl _

name: detL_slabReduce
statement:
theorem detL_slabReduce (P B X Y C : Mat) (k m : Nat) (d : BPair)
    (hk : 0 < k) (hP : sqAt P k) (hBl : B.length = k) (hBr : rowsLen m B)
    (hX : X.length = m) (hXr : rowsLen k X) (hY : sqAt Y m)
    (hCl : C.length = k) (hCr : rowsLen m C) :
    (ground.bpow d m * detL (rowJoin P B ++ rowJoin X Y)).oneValue
      (detL (rowJoin P B
        ++ rowJoin
          (matAdd (X.map (vecScale d)) (matSwap (matMul (transposeM C) P)))
          (matAdd (Y.map (vecScale d)) (matSwap (matMul (transposeM C) B)))))
proof:
:= by
  have hPl : P.length = k := sqAt_len hP
  have hPr : rowsLen k P := rowsLen_of_sqAt hP
  have hYl : Y.length = m := sqAt_len hY
  have hYr : rowsLen m Y := rowsLen_of_sqAt hY
  have hCt : (transposeM C).length = m :=
    length_transposeM C hCr (by rw [hCl]; exact hk)
  have hPt : (transposeM P).length = k :=
    length_transposeM P hPr (by rw [hPl]; exact hk)
  have hBt : (transposeM B).length = m :=
    length_transposeM B hBr (by rw [hBl]; exact hk)
  have hCPl : (matMul (transposeM C) P).length = m := by
    rw [length_matMul, hCt]
  have hCPr : rowsLen k (matMul (transposeM C) P) :=
    rowsLen_cast hPt (rowsLen_matMul _ _)
  have hCBl : (matMul (transposeM C) B).length = m := by
    rw [length_matMul, hCt]
  have hCBr : rowsLen m (matMul (transposeM C) B) :=
    rowsLen_cast hBt (rowsLen_matMul _ _)
  have hXsl : (X.map (vecScale d)).length = m := by
    rw [ground.length_map, hX]
  have hXsr : rowsLen k (X.map (vecScale d)) := rowsLen_mapRows _ X k hXr
  have hYsl : (Y.map (vecScale d)).length = m := by
    rw [ground.length_map, hYl]
  have hYsr : rowsLen m (Y.map (vecScale d)) := rowsLen_mapRows _ Y m hYr
  have hSPl : (matSwap (matMul (transposeM C) P)).length = m := by
    rw [length_matSwap, hCPl]
  have hSPr : rowsLen k (matSwap (matMul (transposeM C) P)) :=
    rowsLen_mapRows _ _ k hCPr
  have hSBl : (matSwap (matMul (transposeM C) B)).length = m := by
    rw [length_matSwap, hCBl]
  have hSBr : rowsLen m (matSwap (matMul (transposeM C) B)) :=
    rowsLen_mapRows _ _ m hCBr
  have hLl : (matAdd (X.map (vecScale d))
      (matSwap (matMul (transposeM C) P))).length = m := by
    rw [length_matAdd _ _ (hXsl.trans hSPl.symm), hXsl]
  have hLr : rowsLen k (matAdd (X.map (vecScale d))
      (matSwap (matMul (transposeM C) P))) :=
    rowsLen_matAdd k _ _ hXsr hSPr
  have hRl : (matAdd (Y.map (vecScale d))
      (matSwap (matMul (transposeM C) B))).length = m := by
    rw [length_matAdd _ _ (hYsl.trans hSBl.symm), hYsl]
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans
    (BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_symm (powO_bpow d m))
      (BPair.oneValue_refl _)) ?_
  refine detO_slabReduce (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairLaws P B X Y
    (matAdd (X.map (vecScale d)) (matSwap (matMul (transposeM C) P)))
    (matAdd (Y.map (vecScale d)) (matSwap (matMul (transposeM C) B)))
    k m d (fun s i => ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] C s) i)
    hPl hPr hBl hBr hX hXr hYl hYr hLl hLr hRl ?_ ?_
  · intro i b him hbk
    show (ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt []
          (matAdd (X.map (vecScale d))
            (matSwap (matMul (transposeM C) P))) i) b).oneValue
        (d * ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] X i) b
          + (ground.famFold BPair.add BPair.unit
              (fun s => ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] C s) i
                * ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] P s) b)
              (List.range k)).swap)
    rw [getAt_matAdd _ _ i (by rw [hXsl]; exact him)
        (by rw [hSPl]; exact him),
      getAt_vecAdd _ _ b
        (by rw [rowsLen_getAt _ i hXsr (by rw [hXsl]; exact him)]; exact hbk)
        (by rw [rowsLen_getAt _ i hSPr (by rw [hSPl]; exact him)]; exact hbk),
      ground.getAt_map ([] : List BPair) [] (vecScale d) X i
        (by rw [hX]; exact him),
      getAt_vecScale d _ b
        (by rw [rowsLen_getAt X i hXr (by rw [hX]; exact him)]; exact hbk),
      getAt_matSwap _ i (by rw [hCPl]; exact him),
      ground.getAt_map BPair.unit BPair.unit BPair.swap _ b
        (by rw [rowsLen_getAt _ i hCPr (by rw [hCPl]; exact him)]; exact hbk)]
    exact BPair.add_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl _)
      (bpairCore.swapCongr
        (transMul_entry C P k m k hk hCl hCr hPl hPr i b him hbk))
  · intro i v him hvm
    show (ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt []
          (matAdd (Y.map (vecScale d))
            (matSwap (matMul (transposeM C) B))) i) v).oneValue
        (d * ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] Y i) v
          + (ground.famFold BPair.add BPair.unit
              (fun s => ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] C s) i
                * ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] B s) v)
              (List.range k)).swap)
    rw [getAt_matAdd _ _ i (by rw [hYsl]; exact him)
        (by rw [hSBl]; exact him),
      getAt_vecAdd _ _ v
        (by rw [rowsLen_getAt _ i hYsr (by rw [hYsl]; exact him)]; exact hvm)
        (by rw [rowsLen_getAt _ i hSBr (by rw [hSBl]; exact him)]; exact hvm),
      ground.getAt_map ([] : List BPair) [] (vecScale d) Y i
        (by rw [hYl]; exact him),
      getAt_vecScale d _ v
        (by rw [rowsLen_getAt Y i hYr (by rw [hYl]; exact him)]; exact hvm),
      getAt_matSwap _ i (by rw [hCBl]; exact him),
      ground.getAt_map BPair.unit BPair.unit BPair.swap _ v
        (by rw [rowsLen_getAt _ i hCBr (by rw [hCBl]; exact him)]; exact hvm)]
    exact BPair.add_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl _)
      (bpairCore.swapCongr
        (transMul_entry C B k m m hk hCl hCr hBl hBr i v him hvm))

name: diagO_len
statement:
theorem diagO_len {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ) (ds : List γ) :
    (diagO ops ds).length = ds.length
proof:
:=
  ground.matOf_length ds.length ds.length _

name: diagO_rows
statement:
theorem diagO_rows {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ) (ds : List γ) :
    rowsLen ds.length (diagO ops ds)
proof:
:=
  rowsLen_matOf ds.length ds.length _

name: diagO_entry
statement:
theorem diagO_entry {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ) (ds : List γ)
    (i j : Nat) (hi : i < ds.length) (hj : j < ds.length) :
    ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] (diagO ops ds) i) j
      = if j = i then ground.getAt ops.unit ds i else ops.unit
proof:
:=
  ground.matOf_entry [] ops.unit ds.length ds.length _ i j hi hj

name: diagO_row
statement:
theorem diagO_row (ds w : List BPair) (t : Nat)
    (ht : t < ds.length) (hw : w.length = ds.length) :
    (dotN (ground.getAt ([] : List BPair)
        (diagO ground.bpairOps ds) t) w).oneValue
      (ground.getAt BPair.unit ds t * ground.getAt BPair.unit w t)
proof:
:= by
  have hrl : (ground.getAt ([] : List BPair)
      (diagO ground.bpairOps ds) t).length = ds.length :=
    rowsLen_getAt (diagO ground.bpairOps ds) t
      (diagO_rows ground.bpairOps ds)
      (by rw [diagO_len]; exact ht)
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans (dotN_read _ w) ?_
  rw [dotP_comm _ w]
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans
    (dotP_oneIndex w _ t (by rw [hw, hrl]) (by rw [hrl]; exact ht) ?_) ?_
  · intro q hq hne
    rw [hrl] at hq
    rw [show ground.getAt BPair.unit
          (ground.getAt ([] : List BPair) (diagO ground.bpairOps ds) t) q
        = if q = t then ground.getAt BPair.unit ds t else BPair.unit from
        diagO_entry ground.bpairOps ds t q ht hq, if_neg hne]
    exact BPair.oneValue_refl _
  · rw [show ground.getAt BPair.unit
          (ground.getAt ([] : List BPair) (diagO ground.bpairOps ds) t) t
        = if t = t then ground.getAt BPair.unit ds t else BPair.unit from
        diagO_entry ground.bpairOps ds t t ht ht, if_pos rfl]
    exact BPair.oneValue_of_eq (BPair.mul_comm _ _)

name: foldMulO_pull
statement:
private theorem foldMulO_pull {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (C : DCore γ ops R.rel) (a : γ) :
    ∀ (ds : List γ) (b : γ),
      R.rel (ds.foldl (fun x e => ops.mul x e) (ops.mul a b))
        (ops.mul a (ds.foldl (fun x e => ops.mul x e) b))
  | [], _ => C.ovRefl _
  | e :: t, b =>
    C.ovTrans (ground.foldl_congr_seed R.rel (fun x e => ops.mul x e)
      (fun e h => C.mulCongr h (C.ovRefl e)) t (C.mulAssoc a b e))
      (foldMulO_pull C a t (ops.mul b e))

/
product. -/
private theorem detO_diagO {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel) :
    ∀ ds : List γ,
      R.rel (detO ops (diagO ops ds))
        (ds.foldl (fun a e => ops.mul a e) ops.one)
  | [] => detO_nil L
  | d :: ds => by
    have hsplit : R.rel (detO ops
        (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) [[d]] [List.replicate ds.length ops.unit]
          ++ List.zipWith (· ++ ·)
            (List.replicate ds.length (List.replicate 1 ops.unit))
            (diagO ops ds)))
        (ops.mul (detO ops [[d]]) (detO ops (diagO ops ds)))
proof:
:=
      detO_blockTri L [[d]] [List.replicate ds.length ops.unit]
        (diagO ops ds) 1 ds.length rfl ⟨rfl, trivial⟩ rfl
        ⟨ground.length_replicate ops.unit ds.length, trivial⟩
        (diagO_len ops ds) (diagO_rows ops ds)
    have hent : R.rel (detO ops (diagO ops (d :: ds)))
        (detO ops
          (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) [[d]] [List.replicate ds.length ops.unit]
            ++ List.zipWith (· ++ ·)
              (List.replicate ds.length (List.replicate 1 ops.unit))
              (diagO ops ds))) := by
      refine detO_congr_letters L.toDCore _ _ ?_ ?_
      · rw [diagO_len, ground.length_append,
          ground.length_zipWith (· ++ ·) [[d]]
            [List.replicate ds.length ops.unit] 1 rfl rfl,
          ground.length_zipWith (· ++ ·)
            (List.replicate ds.length (List.replicate 1 ops.unit))
            (diagO ops ds) ds.length
            (ground.length_replicate _ ds.length) (diagO_len ops ds)]
        show ds.length + 1 = 1 + ds.length
        exact Nat.add_comm ds.length 1
      · intro a ha b hb
        rw [diagO_len] at ha hb
        have haa : a < ds.length + 1 := ha
        have hbb : b < ds.length + 1 := hb
        rw [diagO_entry ops (d :: ds) a b haa hbb]
        cases a with
        | zero =>
          show R.rel (if b = 0 then d else ops.unit)
            (ground.getAt ops.unit
              (d :: List.replicate ds.length ops.unit) b)
          cases b with
          | zero => exact L.ovRefl _
          | succ b' =>
            rw [if_neg (fun he => Nat.noConfusion he)]
            show R.rel ops.unit
              (ground.getAt ops.unit
                (List.replicate ds.length ops.unit) b')
            rw [ground.getAt_replicate ops.unit ops.unit ds.length b'
              (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hbb)]
            exact L.ovRefl _
        | succ a' =>
          have ha' : a' < ds.length := Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ haa
          have hrow : ground.getAt ([] : List γ)
              (List.zipWith (· ++ ·)
                (List.replicate ds.length (List.replicate 1 ops.unit))
                (diagO ops ds)) a'
              = ops.unit :: ground.getAt [] (diagO ops ds) a' := by
            rw [ground.getAt_zipWith [] [] [] (· ++ ·)
                (List.replicate ds.length (List.replicate 1 ops.unit))
                (diagO ops ds) a'
                (by rw [ground.length_replicate]; exact ha')
                (by rw [diagO_len]; exact ha'),
              ground.getAt_replicate ([] : List γ)
                (List.replicate 1 ops.unit) ds.length a' ha']
            rfl
          show R.rel
            (if b = a' + 1 then ground.getAt ops.unit ds a' else ops.unit)
            (ground.getAt ops.unit
              (ground.getAt []
                (List.zipWith (· ++ ·)
                  (List.replicate ds.length (List.replicate 1 ops.unit))
                  (diagO ops ds)) a') b)
          rw [hrow]
          cases b with
          | zero =>
            rw [if_neg (fun he => Nat.noConfusion he)]
            exact L.ovRefl _
          | succ b' =>
            have hb' : b' < ds.length := Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hbb
            show R.rel
              (if b' + 1 = a' + 1 then ground.getAt ops.unit ds a'
                else ops.unit)
              (ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] (diagO ops ds) a') b')
            rw [diagO_entry ops ds a' b' ha' hb']
            by_cases he : b' = a'
            · rw [if_pos he, if_pos (congrArg (fun x => x + 1) he)]
              exact L.ovRefl _
            · rw [if_neg he,
                if_neg (fun h2 => he (Nat.succ.inj h2))]
              exact L.ovRefl _
    refine L.ovTrans hent (L.ovTrans hsplit ?_)
    refine L.ovTrans
      (L.mulCongr (detO_single L d) (detO_diagO L ds)) ?_
    show R.rel (ops.mul d (ds.foldl (fun a e => ops.mul a e) ops.one))
      (ds.foldl (fun a e => ops.mul a e) (ops.mul ops.one d))
    exact L.ovSymm
      (L.ovTrans
        (ground.foldl_congr_seed R.rel (fun x e => ops.mul x e)
          (fun e h => L.mulCongr h (L.ovRefl e)) ds
          (L.mulComm ops.one d))
        (foldMulO_pull L.toDCore d ds ops.one))

name: detO_diagO
statement:
private theorem detO_diagO {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel) :
    ∀ ds : List γ,
      R.rel (detO ops (diagO ops ds))
        (ds.foldl (fun a e => ops.mul a e) ops.one)
  | [] => detO_nil L
  | d :: ds => by
    have hsplit : R.rel (detO ops
        (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) [[d]] [List.replicate ds.length ops.unit]
          ++ List.zipWith (· ++ ·)
            (List.replicate ds.length (List.replicate 1 ops.unit))
            (diagO ops ds)))
        (ops.mul (detO ops [[d]]) (detO ops (diagO ops ds)))
proof:
:=
      detO_blockTri L [[d]] [List.replicate ds.length ops.unit]
        (diagO ops ds) 1 ds.length rfl ⟨rfl, trivial⟩ rfl
        ⟨ground.length_replicate ops.unit ds.length, trivial⟩
        (diagO_len ops ds) (diagO_rows ops ds)
    have hent : R.rel (detO ops (diagO ops (d :: ds)))
        (detO ops
          (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) [[d]] [List.replicate ds.length ops.unit]
            ++ List.zipWith (· ++ ·)
              (List.replicate ds.length (List.replicate 1 ops.unit))
              (diagO ops ds))) := by
      refine detO_congr_letters L.toDCore _ _ ?_ ?_
      · rw [diagO_len, ground.length_append,
          ground.length_zipWith (· ++ ·) [[d]]
            [List.replicate ds.length ops.unit] 1 rfl rfl,
          ground.length_zipWith (· ++ ·)
            (List.replicate ds.length (List.replicate 1 ops.unit))
            (diagO ops ds) ds.length
            (ground.length_replicate _ ds.length) (diagO_len ops ds)]
        show ds.length + 1 = 1 + ds.length
        exact Nat.add_comm ds.length 1
      · intro a ha b hb
        rw [diagO_len] at ha hb
        have haa : a < ds.length + 1 := ha
        have hbb : b < ds.length + 1 := hb
        rw [diagO_entry ops (d :: ds) a b haa hbb]
        cases a with
        | zero =>
          show R.rel (if b = 0 then d else ops.unit)
            (ground.getAt ops.unit
              (d :: List.replicate ds.length ops.unit) b)
          cases b with
          | zero => exact L.ovRefl _
          | succ b' =>
            rw [if_neg (fun he => Nat.noConfusion he)]
            show R.rel ops.unit
              (ground.getAt ops.unit
                (List.replicate ds.length ops.unit) b')
            rw [ground.getAt_replicate ops.unit ops.unit ds.length b'
              (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hbb)]
            exact L.ovRefl _
        | succ a' =>
          have ha' : a' < ds.length := Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ haa
          have hrow : ground.getAt ([] : List γ)
              (List.zipWith (· ++ ·)
                (List.replicate ds.length (List.replicate 1 ops.unit))
                (diagO ops ds)) a'
              = ops.unit :: ground.getAt [] (diagO ops ds) a' := by
            rw [ground.getAt_zipWith [] [] [] (· ++ ·)
                (List.replicate ds.length (List.replicate 1 ops.unit))
                (diagO ops ds) a'
                (by rw [ground.length_replicate]; exact ha')
                (by rw [diagO_len]; exact ha'),
              ground.getAt_replicate ([] : List γ)
                (List.replicate 1 ops.unit) ds.length a' ha']
            rfl
          show R.rel
            (if b = a' + 1 then ground.getAt ops.unit ds a' else ops.unit)
            (ground.getAt ops.unit
              (ground.getAt []
                (List.zipWith (· ++ ·)
                  (List.replicate ds.length (List.replicate 1 ops.unit))
                  (diagO ops ds)) a') b)
          rw [hrow]
          cases b with
          | zero =>
            rw [if_neg (fun he => Nat.noConfusion he)]
            exact L.ovRefl _
          | succ b' =>
            have hb' : b' < ds.length := Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hbb
            show R.rel
              (if b' + 1 = a' + 1 then ground.getAt ops.unit ds a'
                else ops.unit)
              (ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] (diagO ops ds) a') b')
            rw [diagO_entry ops ds a' b' ha' hb']
            by_cases he : b' = a'
            · rw [if_pos he, if_pos (congrArg (fun x => x + 1) he)]
              exact L.ovRefl _
            · rw [if_neg he,
                if_neg (fun h2 => he (Nat.succ.inj h2))]
              exact L.ovRefl _
    refine L.ovTrans hent (L.ovTrans hsplit ?_)
    refine L.ovTrans
      (L.mulCongr (detO_single L d) (detO_diagO L ds)) ?_
    show R.rel (ops.mul d (ds.foldl (fun a e => ops.mul a e) ops.one))
      (ds.foldl (fun a e => ops.mul a e) (ops.mul ops.one d))
    exact L.ovSymm
      (L.ovTrans
        (ground.foldl_congr_seed R.rel (fun x e => ops.mul x e)
          (fun e h => L.mulCongr h (L.ovRefl e)) ds
          (L.mulComm ops.one d))
        (foldMulO_pull L.toDCore d ds ops.one))

name: detL_diag
statement:
theorem detL_diag (ds : List BPair) :
    (detL (diagO bpairOps ds)).oneValue
      (ds.foldl (fun a d => a * d) (BPair.ofNat 1))
proof:
:=
  detO_diagO (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairLaws ds

name: minorP_detP
statement:
theorem minorP_detP (X : List (List poly.Poly))
    (hX : rowsLen X.length X) :
    poly.oneValue (minorO poly.polyOps poly.pnorm id X)
      (detO poly.polyOps X)
proof:
:=
  minorO_detO (R := poly.polyRead)
    (polyLawsO (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairLaws) poly.pnorm id
    (fun x => poly.pnorm_oneValue x)
    (fun x => lovRefl (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairCore x) X hX

name: pminor_diag
statement:
theorem pminor_diag (ds : List poly.Poly) :
    poly.oneValue
      (minorO poly.polyOps poly.pnorm id (diagO poly.polyOps ds))
      (poly.prodFold ds)
proof:
:=
  (polyCoreO (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairLaws).ovTrans
    (minorP_detP (diagO poly.polyOps ds)
      (by rw [diagO_len]; exact diagO_rows poly.polyOps ds))
    (detO_diagO (R := poly.polyRead)
      (polyLawsO (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairLaws) ds)

name: powO_one
statement:
private theorem powO_one {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel) :
    ∀ i : Nat, R.rel (poly.powO ops ops.one i) ops.one
  | 0 => L.ovRefl _
  | i + 1 =>
    L.ovTrans (L.oneMul (poly.powO ops ops.one i)) (powO_one L i)

/
blocks' product: the vacant block above the diagonal, the split
read at the exchanged key lists. -/
private theorem detO_blockTriLow {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
    (P X Rm : List (List γ)) (k m : Nat)
    (hPl : P.length = k) (hPr : rowsLen k P)
    (hXl : X.length = m) (hXr : rowsLen k X)
    (hRl : Rm.length = m) (hRr : rowsLen m Rm) :
    R.rel (detO ops (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P
        (List.replicate k (List.replicate m ops.unit))
      ++ List.zipWith (· ++ ·) X Rm))
      (ops.mul (detO ops P) (detO ops Rm))
proof:
:= by
  have hTopl : (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P
      (List.replicate k (List.replicate m ops.unit))).length = k :=
    ground.length_zipWith (· ++ ·) P _ k hPl
      (ground.length_replicate _ k)
  have hBotl : (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) X Rm).length = m :=
    ground.length_zipWith (· ++ ·) X Rm m hXl hRl
  have hMl : (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P
      (List.replicate k (List.replicate m ops.unit))
      ++ List.zipWith (· ++ ·) X Rm).length = k + m := by
    rw [ground.length_append, hTopl, hBotl]
  have hMr : rowsLen (k + m) (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P
      (List.replicate k (List.replicate m ops.unit))
      ++ List.zipWith (· ++ ·) X Rm) :=
    rowsLen_appendO (k + m)
      (rowsLen_zipJoinO k m hPr (rowsLen_replicateO ops.unit m k))
      (rowsLen_zipJoinO k m hXr hRr)
  have hrowP : ∀ t, t < k → ground.getAt ([] : List γ)
      (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P
        (List.replicate k (List.replicate m ops.unit))
        ++ List.zipWith (· ++ ·) X Rm) t
      = ground.getAt [] P t ++ List.replicate m ops.unit := by
    intro t ht
    rw [ground.getAt_append ([] : List γ) _ _ t, hTopl, if_pos ht,
      ground.getAt_zipWith [] [] [] (· ++ ·) P _ t
        (by rw [hPl]; exact ht)
        (by rw [ground.length_replicate]; exact ht),
      ground.getAt_replicate ([] : List γ)
        (List.replicate m ops.unit) k t ht]
  have hrowX : ∀ t, t < m → ground.getAt ([] : List γ)
      (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P
        (List.replicate k (List.replicate m ops.unit))
        ++ List.zipWith (· ++ ·) X Rm) (k + t)
      = ground.getAt [] X t ++ ground.getAt [] Rm t := by
    intro t ht
    have h := ground.getAt_append_add ([] : List γ)
      (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P
        (List.replicate k (List.replicate m ops.unit)))
      (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) X Rm) t
    rw [hTopl] at h
    rw [h, ground.getAt_zipWith [] [] [] (· ++ ·) X Rm t
      (by rw [hXl]; exact ht) (by rw [hRl]; exact ht)]
  have hUtopl : (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) (transM ops k P)
      (ground.matOf k m (fun a b =>
        ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] X b) a))).length = k :=
    ground.length_zipWith (· ++ ·) (transM ops k P) _ k
      (transM_len ops k P) (ground.matOf_length k m _)
  have hUl : (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) (transM ops k P)
      (ground.matOf k m (fun a b =>
        ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] X b) a))
      ++ List.zipWith (· ++ ·)
        (List.replicate m (List.replicate k ops.unit))
        (transM ops m Rm)).length = k + m := by
    rw [ground.length_append, hUtopl,
      ground.length_zipWith (· ++ ·) _ (transM ops m Rm) m
        (ground.length_replicate _ m) (transM_len ops m Rm)]
  refine L.ovTrans
    (L.ovSymm (transM_det L.toDCore (k + m) _ hMl hMr)) ?_
  refine L.ovTrans
    (detO_congr_letters L.toDCore _
      (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) (transM ops k P)
        (ground.matOf k m (fun a b =>
          ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] X b) a))
        ++ List.zipWith (· ++ ·)
          (List.replicate m (List.replicate k ops.unit))
          (transM ops m Rm))
      (by rw [transM_len, hUl]) ?_) ?_
  · intro a ha b hb
    rw [transM_len] at ha hb
    refine ovOfEq L.toDCore ?_
    rw [transM_entry ops (k + m) _ a b ha hb]
    match Nat.lt_or_ge a k with
    | .inl hak =>
      have hUa : ground.getAt ([] : List γ)
          (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) (transM ops k P)
            (ground.matOf k m (fun a b =>
              ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] X b) a))
            ++ List.zipWith (· ++ ·)
              (List.replicate m (List.replicate k ops.unit))
              (transM ops m Rm)) a
          = ground.getAt [] (transM ops k P) a
            ++ ground.getAt [] (ground.matOf k m (fun a b =>
              ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] X b) a)) a := by
        rw [ground.getAt_append ([] : List γ) _ _ a, hUtopl, if_pos hak,
          ground.getAt_zipWith [] [] [] (· ++ ·) (transM ops k P) _ a
            (by rw [transM_len]; exact hak)
            (by rw [ground.matOf_length]; exact hak)]
      have hPta : (ground.getAt ([] : List γ) (transM ops k P) a).length
          = k :=
        rowsLen_getAt _ a (transM_rows ops k P)
          (by rw [transM_len]; exact hak)
      match Nat.lt_or_ge b k with
      | .inl hbk =>
        rw [hrowP b hbk, hUa,
          ground.getAt_append ops.unit (ground.getAt [] P b) _ a,
          rowsLen_getAt P b hPr (by rw [hPl]; exact hbk), if_pos hak,
          ground.getAt_append ops.unit
            (ground.getAt [] (transM ops k P) a) _ b,
          hPta, if_pos hbk, transM_entry ops k P a b hak hbk]
      | .inr hbk =>
        obtain ⟨b', hb'⟩ := Nat.le.dest hbk
        have hb'm : b' < m := by
          match Nat.lt_or_ge b' m with
          | .inl h => exact h
          | .inr h =>
            rw [← hb'] at hb
            exact absurd hb (Nat.not_lt_of_le (Nat.add_le_add_left h k))
        have h2 := ground.getAt_append_add ops.unit
          (ground.getAt ([] : List γ) (transM ops k P) a)
          (ground.getAt ([] : List γ) (ground.matOf k m (fun a b =>
            ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] X b) a)) a) b'
        rw [hPta] at h2
        rw [← hb', hrowX b' hb'm, hUa, h2,
          ground.getAt_append ops.unit (ground.getAt [] X b') _ a,
          rowsLen_getAt X b' hXr (by rw [hXl]; exact hb'm), if_pos hak,
          ground.matOf_entry [] ops.unit k m _ a b' hak hb'm]
    | .inr hak =>
      obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := Nat.le.dest hak
      have ha'm : a' < m := by
        match Nat.lt_or_ge a' m with
        | .inl h => exact h
        | .inr h =>
          rw [← ha'] at ha
          exact absurd ha (Nat.not_lt_of_le (Nat.add_le_add_left h k))
      have hUa : ground.getAt ([] : List γ)
          (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) (transM ops k P)
            (ground.matOf k m (fun a b =>
              ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] X b) a))
            ++ List.zipWith (· ++ ·)
              (List.replicate m (List.replicate k ops.unit))
              (transM ops m Rm)) (k + a')
          = List.replicate k ops.unit
            ++ ground.getAt [] (transM ops m Rm) a' := by
        have h := ground.getAt_append_add ([] : List γ)
          (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) (transM ops k P)
            (ground.matOf k m (fun a b =>
              ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] X b) a)))
          (List.zipWith (· ++ ·)
            (List.replicate m (List.replicate k ops.unit))
            (transM ops m Rm)) a'
        rw [hUtopl] at h
        rw [h, ground.getAt_zipWith [] [] [] (· ++ ·) _
            (transM ops m Rm) a'
            (by rw [ground.length_replicate]; exact ha'm)
            (by rw [transM_len]; exact ha'm),
          ground.getAt_replicate ([] : List γ)
            (List.replicate k ops.unit) m a' ha'm]
      match Nat.lt_or_ge b k with
      | .inl hbk =>
        have h3 := ground.getAt_append_add ops.unit
          (ground.getAt ([] : List γ) P b)
          (List.replicate m ops.unit) a'
        rw [rowsLen_getAt P b hPr (by rw [hPl]; exact hbk)] at h3
        rw [← ha', hrowP b hbk, h3, hUa,
          ground.getAt_replicate ops.unit ops.unit m a' ha'm,
          ground.getAt_append ops.unit (List.replicate k ops.unit) _ b,
          ground.length_replicate, if_pos hbk,
          ground.getAt_replicate ops.unit ops.unit k b hbk]
      | .inr hbk =>
        obtain ⟨b', hb'⟩ := Nat.le.dest hbk
        have hb'm : b' < m := by
          match Nat.lt_or_ge b' m with
          | .inl h => exact h
          | .inr h =>
            rw [← hb'] at hb
            exact absurd hb (Nat.not_lt_of_le (Nat.add_le_add_left h k))
        have h3 := ground.getAt_append_add ops.unit
          (ground.getAt ([] : List γ) X b')
          (ground.getAt ([] : List γ) Rm b') a'
        rw [rowsLen_getAt X b' hXr (by rw [hXl]; exact hb'm)] at h3
        have h4 := ground.getAt_append_add ops.unit
          (List.replicate k ops.unit)
          (ground.getAt ([] : List γ) (transM ops m Rm) a') b'
        rw [ground.length_replicate] at h4
        rw [← ha', ← hb', hrowX b' hb'm, h3, hUa, h4,
          transM_entry ops m Rm a' b' ha'm hb'm]
  · refine L.ovTrans
      (detO_blockTri L (transM ops k P)
        (ground.matOf k m (fun a b =>
          ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] X b) a))
        (transM ops m Rm) k m
        (transM_len ops k P) (transM_rows ops k P)
        (ground.matOf_length k m _) (rowsLen_matOf k m _)
        (transM_len ops m Rm) (transM_rows ops m Rm)) ?_
    exact L.mulCongr (transM_det L.toDCore k P hPl hPr)
      (transM_det L.toDCore m Rm hRl hRr)

name: detO_blockTriLow
statement:
private theorem detO_blockTriLow {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
    (P X Rm : List (List γ)) (k m : Nat)
    (hPl : P.length = k) (hPr : rowsLen k P)
    (hXl : X.length = m) (hXr : rowsLen k X)
    (hRl : Rm.length = m) (hRr : rowsLen m Rm) :
    R.rel (detO ops (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P
        (List.replicate k (List.replicate m ops.unit))
      ++ List.zipWith (· ++ ·) X Rm))
      (ops.mul (detO ops P) (detO ops Rm))
proof:
:= by
  have hTopl : (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P
      (List.replicate k (List.replicate m ops.unit))).length = k :=
    ground.length_zipWith (· ++ ·) P _ k hPl
      (ground.length_replicate _ k)
  have hBotl : (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) X Rm).length = m :=
    ground.length_zipWith (· ++ ·) X Rm m hXl hRl
  have hMl : (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P
      (List.replicate k (List.replicate m ops.unit))
      ++ List.zipWith (· ++ ·) X Rm).length = k + m := by
    rw [ground.length_append, hTopl, hBotl]
  have hMr : rowsLen (k + m) (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P
      (List.replicate k (List.replicate m ops.unit))
      ++ List.zipWith (· ++ ·) X Rm) :=
    rowsLen_appendO (k + m)
      (rowsLen_zipJoinO k m hPr (rowsLen_replicateO ops.unit m k))
      (rowsLen_zipJoinO k m hXr hRr)
  have hrowP : ∀ t, t < k → ground.getAt ([] : List γ)
      (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P
        (List.replicate k (List.replicate m ops.unit))
        ++ List.zipWith (· ++ ·) X Rm) t
      = ground.getAt [] P t ++ List.replicate m ops.unit := by
    intro t ht
    rw [ground.getAt_append ([] : List γ) _ _ t, hTopl, if_pos ht,
      ground.getAt_zipWith [] [] [] (· ++ ·) P _ t
        (by rw [hPl]; exact ht)
        (by rw [ground.length_replicate]; exact ht),
      ground.getAt_replicate ([] : List γ)
        (List.replicate m ops.unit) k t ht]
  have hrowX : ∀ t, t < m → ground.getAt ([] : List γ)
      (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P
        (List.replicate k (List.replicate m ops.unit))
        ++ List.zipWith (· ++ ·) X Rm) (k + t)
      = ground.getAt [] X t ++ ground.getAt [] Rm t := by
    intro t ht
    have h := ground.getAt_append_add ([] : List γ)
      (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) P
        (List.replicate k (List.replicate m ops.unit)))
      (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) X Rm) t
    rw [hTopl] at h
    rw [h, ground.getAt_zipWith [] [] [] (· ++ ·) X Rm t
      (by rw [hXl]; exact ht) (by rw [hRl]; exact ht)]
  have hUtopl : (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) (transM ops k P)
      (ground.matOf k m (fun a b =>
        ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] X b) a))).length = k :=
    ground.length_zipWith (· ++ ·) (transM ops k P) _ k
      (transM_len ops k P) (ground.matOf_length k m _)
  have hUl : (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) (transM ops k P)
      (ground.matOf k m (fun a b =>
        ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] X b) a))
      ++ List.zipWith (· ++ ·)
        (List.replicate m (List.replicate k ops.unit))
        (transM ops m Rm)).length = k + m := by
    rw [ground.length_append, hUtopl,
      ground.length_zipWith (· ++ ·) _ (transM ops m Rm) m
        (ground.length_replicate _ m) (transM_len ops m Rm)]
  refine L.ovTrans
    (L.ovSymm (transM_det L.toDCore (k + m) _ hMl hMr)) ?_
  refine L.ovTrans
    (detO_congr_letters L.toDCore _
      (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) (transM ops k P)
        (ground.matOf k m (fun a b =>
          ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] X b) a))
        ++ List.zipWith (· ++ ·)
          (List.replicate m (List.replicate k ops.unit))
          (transM ops m Rm))
      (by rw [transM_len, hUl]) ?_) ?_
  · intro a ha b hb
    rw [transM_len] at ha hb
    refine ovOfEq L.toDCore ?_
    rw [transM_entry ops (k + m) _ a b ha hb]
    match Nat.lt_or_ge a k with
    | .inl hak =>
      have hUa : ground.getAt ([] : List γ)
          (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) (transM ops k P)
            (ground.matOf k m (fun a b =>
              ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] X b) a))
            ++ List.zipWith (· ++ ·)
              (List.replicate m (List.replicate k ops.unit))
              (transM ops m Rm)) a
          = ground.getAt [] (transM ops k P) a
            ++ ground.getAt [] (ground.matOf k m (fun a b =>
              ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] X b) a)) a := by
        rw [ground.getAt_append ([] : List γ) _ _ a, hUtopl, if_pos hak,
          ground.getAt_zipWith [] [] [] (· ++ ·) (transM ops k P) _ a
            (by rw [transM_len]; exact hak)
            (by rw [ground.matOf_length]; exact hak)]
      have hPta : (ground.getAt ([] : List γ) (transM ops k P) a).length
          = k :=
        rowsLen_getAt _ a (transM_rows ops k P)
          (by rw [transM_len]; exact hak)
      match Nat.lt_or_ge b k with
      | .inl hbk =>
        rw [hrowP b hbk, hUa,
          ground.getAt_append ops.unit (ground.getAt [] P b) _ a,
          rowsLen_getAt P b hPr (by rw [hPl]; exact hbk), if_pos hak,
          ground.getAt_append ops.unit
            (ground.getAt [] (transM ops k P) a) _ b,
          hPta, if_pos hbk, transM_entry ops k P a b hak hbk]
      | .inr hbk =>
        obtain ⟨b', hb'⟩ := Nat.le.dest hbk
        have hb'm : b' < m := by
          match Nat.lt_or_ge b' m with
          | .inl h => exact h
          | .inr h =>
            rw [← hb'] at hb
            exact absurd hb (Nat.not_lt_of_le (Nat.add_le_add_left h k))
        have h2 := ground.getAt_append_add ops.unit
          (ground.getAt ([] : List γ) (transM ops k P) a)
          (ground.getAt ([] : List γ) (ground.matOf k m (fun a b =>
            ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] X b) a)) a) b'
        rw [hPta] at h2
        rw [← hb', hrowX b' hb'm, hUa, h2,
          ground.getAt_append ops.unit (ground.getAt [] X b') _ a,
          rowsLen_getAt X b' hXr (by rw [hXl]; exact hb'm), if_pos hak,
          ground.matOf_entry [] ops.unit k m _ a b' hak hb'm]
    | .inr hak =>
      obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := Nat.le.dest hak
      have ha'm : a' < m := by
        match Nat.lt_or_ge a' m with
        | .inl h => exact h
        | .inr h =>
          rw [← ha'] at ha
          exact absurd ha (Nat.not_lt_of_le (Nat.add_le_add_left h k))
      have hUa : ground.getAt ([] : List γ)
          (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) (transM ops k P)
            (ground.matOf k m (fun a b =>
              ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] X b) a))
            ++ List.zipWith (· ++ ·)
              (List.replicate m (List.replicate k ops.unit))
              (transM ops m Rm)) (k + a')
          = List.replicate k ops.unit
            ++ ground.getAt [] (transM ops m Rm) a' := by
        have h := ground.getAt_append_add ([] : List γ)
          (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) (transM ops k P)
            (ground.matOf k m (fun a b =>
              ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] X b) a)))
          (List.zipWith (· ++ ·)
            (List.replicate m (List.replicate k ops.unit))
            (transM ops m Rm)) a'
        rw [hUtopl] at h
        rw [h, ground.getAt_zipWith [] [] [] (· ++ ·) _
            (transM ops m Rm) a'
            (by rw [ground.length_replicate]; exact ha'm)
            (by rw [transM_len]; exact ha'm),
          ground.getAt_replicate ([] : List γ)
            (List.replicate k ops.unit) m a' ha'm]
      match Nat.lt_or_ge b k with
      | .inl hbk =>
        have h3 := ground.getAt_append_add ops.unit
          (ground.getAt ([] : List γ) P b)
          (List.replicate m ops.unit) a'
        rw [rowsLen_getAt P b hPr (by rw [hPl]; exact hbk)] at h3
        rw [← ha', hrowP b hbk, h3, hUa,
          ground.getAt_replicate ops.unit ops.unit m a' ha'm,
          ground.getAt_append ops.unit (List.replicate k ops.unit) _ b,
          ground.length_replicate, if_pos hbk,
          ground.getAt_replicate ops.unit ops.unit k b hbk]
      | .inr hbk =>
        obtain ⟨b', hb'⟩ := Nat.le.dest hbk
        have hb'm : b' < m := by
          match Nat.lt_or_ge b' m with
          | .inl h => exact h
          | .inr h =>
            rw [← hb'] at hb
            exact absurd hb (Nat.not_lt_of_le (Nat.add_le_add_left h k))
        have h3 := ground.getAt_append_add ops.unit
          (ground.getAt ([] : List γ) X b')
          (ground.getAt ([] : List γ) Rm b') a'
        rw [rowsLen_getAt X b' hXr (by rw [hXl]; exact hb'm)] at h3
        have h4 := ground.getAt_append_add ops.unit
          (List.replicate k ops.unit)
          (ground.getAt ([] : List γ) (transM ops m Rm) a') b'
        rw [ground.length_replicate] at h4
        rw [← ha', ← hb', hrowX b' hb'm, h3, hUa, h4,
          transM_entry ops m Rm a' b' ha'm hb'm]
  · refine L.ovTrans
      (detO_blockTri L (transM ops k P)
        (ground.matOf k m (fun a b =>
          ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] X b) a))
        (transM ops m Rm) k m
        (transM_len ops k P) (transM_rows ops k P)
        (ground.matOf_length k m _) (rowsLen_matOf k m _)
        (transM_len ops m Rm) (transM_rows ops m Rm)) ?_
    exact L.mulCongr (transM_det L.toDCore k P hPl hPr)
      (transM_det L.toDCore m Rm hRl hRr)

name: adjSwap_append
statement:
private theorem adjSwap_append {α : Type} :
    ∀ (W : List α) (x y : α) (t : List α),
      ground.adjSwap W.length (W ++ x :: y :: t) = W ++ y :: x :: t
  | [], _, _, _ => rfl
  | w :: W, x, y, t => by
    show w :: ground.adjSwap W.length (W ++ x :: y :: t)
      = w :: (W ++ y :: x :: t)
    rw [adjSwap_append W x y t]

/
the trailing family. -/
private theorem append_single_shift {α : Type} (W : List α) (v : α)
    (T : List α) : (W ++ [v]) ++ T = W ++ v :: T
proof:
:= by
  rw [ground.append_assoc]
  rfl

name: append_single_shift
statement:
private theorem append_single_shift {α : Type} (W : List α) (v : α)
    (T : List α) : (W ++ [v]) ++ T = W ++ v :: T
proof:
:= by
  rw [ground.append_assoc]
  rfl

name: moveRow_append
statement:
private theorem moveRow_append {α : Type} :
    ∀ (U W : List α) (v : α) (V : List α),
      moveRow U.length W.length (W ++ U ++ v :: V) = W ++ v :: (U ++ V)
  | [], W, v, V => by
    show W ++ [] ++ v :: V = W ++ v :: ([] ++ V)
    rw [ground.append_nil]
    rfl
  | u :: U, W, v, V => by
    have hassoc : W ++ (u :: U) = (W ++ [u]) ++ U
proof:
:=
      (append_single_shift W u U).symm
    have hlen : (W ++ [u]).length = W.length + 1 := by
      rw [ground.length_append]
      rfl
    show ground.adjSwap W.length
        (moveRow U.length (W.length + 1) (W ++ (u :: U) ++ v :: V))
      = W ++ v :: ((u :: U) ++ V)
    rw [hassoc, ← hlen, moveRow_append U (W ++ [u]) v V,
      append_single_shift W u (v :: (U ++ V))]
    exact adjSwap_append W u v (U ++ V)

name: detO_rotGo
statement:
private theorem detO_rotGo {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (C : DCore γ ops R.rel)
    (U : List (List γ)) :
    ∀ (V W : List (List γ)),
      R.rel (detO ops (W ++ U ++ V))
        (signAtO ops (places.parityOf (U.length * V.length))
          (detO ops (W ++ V ++ U)))
  | [], W => by
    show R.rel (detO ops (W ++ U ++ []))
      (signAtO ops (places.parityOf (U.length * 0))
        (detO ops (W ++ [] ++ U)))
    rw [ground.append_nil (W ++ U), ground.append_nil W]
    exact C.ovRefl _
  | v :: V, W => by
    have hmv
proof:
:= detO_moveRow C U.length W.length (W ++ U ++ (v :: V))
      (by
        rw [ground.length_append, ground.length_append]
        exact Nat.add_lt_add_left (Nat.succ_pos V.length)
          (W.length + U.length))
    rw [moveRow_append U W v V] at hmv
    have hih := detO_rotGo C U V (W ++ [v])
    rw [ground.append_assoc (W ++ [v]) U V,
      append_single_shift W v (U ++ V),
      ground.append_assoc (W ++ [v]) V U,
      append_single_shift W v (V ++ U)] at hih
    have hpar := places.parityOf_add (U.length * V.length) U.length
    show R.rel (detO ops (W ++ U ++ (v :: V)))
      (signAtO ops
        (places.parityOf (U.length * V.length + U.length))
        (detO ops (W ++ (v :: V) ++ U)))
    rw [hpar, ground.append_assoc W (v :: V) U]
    refine C.ovTrans
      (C.ovSymm (C.ovTrans
        (signAtO_congr C (places.parityOf U.length) hmv)
        (signAtO_signAtO C (places.parityOf U.length)
          (detO ops (W ++ U ++ (v :: V)))))) ?_
    refine C.ovTrans
      (signAtO_congr C (places.parityOf U.length) hih) ?_
    exact signAtO_comp C (places.parityOf U.length)
      (places.parityOf (U.length * V.length))
      (detO ops (W ++ v :: (V ++ U)))

name: detO_slabRotate
statement:
private theorem detO_slabRotate {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (C : DCore γ ops R.rel)
    (U V : List (List γ)) :
    R.rel (detO ops (U ++ V))
      (signAtO ops (places.parityOf (U.length * V.length))
        (detO ops (V ++ U)))
proof:
:=
  detO_rotGo C U V []

name: foldlAddO_famFold
statement:
private theorem foldlAddO_famFold {γ α : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel) (f : α → γ) :
    ∀ (l : List α) (acc : γ),
      R.rel (l.foldl (fun a x => ops.add a (f x)) acc)
        (ops.add acc (ground.famFold ops.add ops.unit f l))
  | [], acc => L.ovSymm (L.addUnit acc)
  | x :: t, acc =>
    L.ovTrans (foldlAddO_famFold L f t (ops.add acc (f x)))
      (L.addAssoc acc (f x) (ground.famFold ops.add ops.unit f t))

/
one fold over the shared keys. -/
private theorem matMulO_entry {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
    (A B : List (List γ)) (n w : Nat) (hAr : rowsLen n A)
    (hw : (B.headD []).length = w) (i j : Nat)
    (hi : i < A.length) (hj : j < w) :
    R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit
        (ground.getAt [] (matMulO ops A B) i) j)
      (ground.famFold ops.add ops.unit
        (fun s => ops.mul
          (ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] A i) s)
          (ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] B s) j))
        (List.range n))
proof:
:= by
  have hrow : ground.getAt ([] : List γ) (matMulO ops A B) i
      = (List.range (B.headD ([] : List γ)).length).map (fun q =>
        (List.range (ground.getAt ([] : List γ) A i).length).foldl
          (fun acc t => ops.add acc
            (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] A i) t)
              (ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] B t) q)))
          ops.unit) :=
    ground.getAt_map ([] : List γ) ([] : List γ) _ A i hi
  rw [hrow, ground.getAt_map_range ops.unit _ _ j, hw, if_pos hj,
    rowsLen_getAt A i hAr hi]
  refine L.ovTrans (foldlAddO_famFold L _ (List.range n) ops.unit) ?_
  exact L.unitAdd _

name: matMulO_entry
statement:
private theorem matMulO_entry {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
    (A B : List (List γ)) (n w : Nat) (hAr : rowsLen n A)
    (hw : (B.headD []).length = w) (i j : Nat)
    (hi : i < A.length) (hj : j < w) :
    R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit
        (ground.getAt [] (matMulO ops A B) i) j)
      (ground.famFold ops.add ops.unit
        (fun s => ops.mul
          (ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] A i) s)
          (ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] B s) j))
        (List.range n))
proof:
:= by
  have hrow : ground.getAt ([] : List γ) (matMulO ops A B) i
      = (List.range (B.headD ([] : List γ)).length).map (fun q =>
        (List.range (ground.getAt ([] : List γ) A i).length).foldl
          (fun acc t => ops.add acc
            (ops.mul (ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] A i) t)
              (ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] B t) q)))
          ops.unit) :=
    ground.getAt_map ([] : List γ) ([] : List γ) _ A i hi
  rw [hrow, ground.getAt_map_range ops.unit _ _ j, hw, if_pos hj,
    rowsLen_getAt A i hAr hi]
  refine L.ovTrans (foldlAddO_famFold L _ (List.range n) ops.unit) ?_
  exact L.unitAdd _

name: matMulP_entry
statement:
theorem matMulP_entry (A B : List (List poly.Poly)) (n w : Nat)
    (hAr : rowsLen n A) (hw : (B.headD []).length = w) (i j : Nat)
    (hi : i < A.length) (hj : j < w) :
    poly.oneValue
      (ground.getAt ([] : poly.Poly)
        (ground.getAt ([] : List poly.Poly)
          (matMulO poly.polyOps A B) i) j)
      (ground.famFold poly.add []
        (fun s => poly.mul
          (ground.getAt ([] : poly.Poly)
            (ground.getAt ([] : List poly.Poly) A i) s)
          (ground.getAt ([] : poly.Poly)
            (ground.getAt ([] : List poly.Poly) B s) j))
        (List.range n))
proof:
:=
  matMulO_entry (R := poly.polyRead)
    (polyLawsO (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairLaws) A B n w hAr hw i j hi hj

name: headD_len_of
statement:
theorem headD_len_of {γ : Type} :
    ∀ (B : List (List γ)) (n : Nat), B.length = n → rowsLen n B →
      (B.headD []).length = n
  | [], _, hl, _ => hl
  | _ :: _, _, _, hr => hr.1

/
every left factor. -/

name: rowsLen_matMulO
statement:
theorem rowsLen_matMulO {γ : Type} (ops : DOps γ)
    (A B : List (List γ)) (w : Nat)
    (hw : (B.headD []).length = w) :
    rowsLen w (matMulO ops A B)
proof:
:=
  rowsLen_map _ w A (fun _ _ => by
    rw [ground.length_mapRange]
    exact hw)

name: parityOf_sqAdd
statement:
private theorem parityOf_sqAdd : ∀ n : Nat,
    places.parityOf (n * n + n) = false
  | 0 => rfl
  | n + 1 => by
    have harith : (n + 1) * (n + 1) + (n + 1)
        = n * n + n + 2 * (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
      rw [Nat.left_distrib (n + 1) n 1, Nat.mul_one (n + 1),
        Nat.mul_comm (n + 1) n, Nat.mul_succ n n,
        Nat.two_mul (n + 1)]
      exact Nat.add_assoc (n * n + n) (n + 1) (n + 1)
    rw [harith, places.parityOf_add_two_mul (n * n + n) (n + 1)]
    exact parityOf_sqAdd n

name: foldMulO_negOne
statement:
private theorem foldMulO_negOne {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (a : γ),
      R.rel ((List.replicate n (ops.swap ops.one)).foldl
          (fun x e => ops.mul x e) a)
        (signAtO ops (places.parityOf n) a)
  | 0, a => L.ovRefl a
  | n + 1, a => by
    show R.rel ((List.replicate n (ops.swap ops.one)).foldl
        (fun x e => ops.mul x e) (ops.mul a (ops.swap ops.one)))
      (signAtO ops (places.parityOf (n + 1)) a)
    refine L.ovTrans
      (foldMulO_negOne L n (ops.mul a (ops.swap ops.one))) ?_
    refine L.ovTrans (signAtO_congr L.toDCore (places.parityOf n)
      (show R.rel (ops.mul a (ops.swap ops.one)) (ops.swap a) from
        L.ovTrans (L.mulSwapRight a ops.one)
          (L.swapCongr (L.ovTrans (L.mulComm a ops.one)
            (L.oneMul a))))) ?_
    refine L.ovTrans
      (signAtO_comp L.toDCore (places.parityOf n) true a) ?_
    show R.rel (signAtO ops (Bool.xor true (places.parityOf n)) a)
      (signAtO ops (!(places.parityOf n)) a)
    cases places.parityOf n with
    | false => exact L.ovRefl _
    | true => exact L.ovRefl _

/
private theorem signAtO_mulLeft {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (C : DCore γ ops R.rel) (s : Bool) (x y : γ) :
    R.rel (ops.mul (signAtO ops s x) y)
      (signAtO ops s (ops.mul x y))
proof:
:= by
  cases s with
  | false => exact C.ovRefl _
  | true => exact mulSwapLeft C x y

name: signAtO_mulLeft
statement:
private theorem signAtO_mulLeft {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (C : DCore γ ops R.rel) (s : Bool) (x y : γ) :
    R.rel (ops.mul (signAtO ops s x) y)
      (signAtO ops s (ops.mul x y))
proof:
:= by
  cases s with
  | false => exact C.ovRefl _
  | true => exact mulSwapLeft C x y

name: detO_mul
statement:
private theorem detO_mul {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
    (A B : List (List γ)) (n : Nat)
    (hAl : A.length = n) (hAr : rowsLen n A)
    (hBl : B.length = n) (hBr : rowsLen n B) :
    R.rel (detO ops (matMulO ops A B))
      (ops.mul (detO ops A) (detO ops B))
proof:
:= by
  have hNl : (diagO ops (List.replicate n (ops.swap ops.one))).length
      = n := by
    rw [diagO_len, ground.length_replicate]
  have hNr : rowsLen n (diagO ops (List.replicate n (ops.swap ops.one))) := by
    have h := diagO_rows ops (List.replicate n (ops.swap ops.one))
    rw [ground.length_replicate] at h
    exact h
  have hNe : ∀ i j, i < n → j < n →
      ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt []
          (diagO ops (List.replicate n (ops.swap ops.one))) i) j
        = if j = i then ops.swap ops.one else ops.unit := by
    intro i j hi hj
    rw [diagO_entry ops (List.replicate n (ops.swap ops.one)) i j
        (by rw [ground.length_replicate]; exact hi)
        (by rw [ground.length_replicate]; exact hj),
      ground.getAt_replicate ops.unit (ops.swap ops.one) n i hi]
  have hvacl : (List.replicate n (List.replicate n ops.unit)).length = n :=
    ground.length_replicate _ n
  have hvacr : rowsLen n (List.replicate n (List.replicate n ops.unit)) :=
    rowsLen_replicateO ops.unit n n
  have hvace : ∀ i j, i < n → j < n →
      ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt []
        (List.replicate n (List.replicate n ops.unit)) i) j
        = ops.unit := by
    intro i j hi hj
    rw [ground.getAt_replicate ([] : List γ)
        (List.replicate n ops.unit) n i hi,
      ground.getAt_replicate ops.unit ops.unit n j hj]
  have hABl : (matMulO ops A B).length = n :=
    (ground.length_map _ A).trans hAl
  have hABr : rowsLen n (matMulO ops A B) :=
    rowsLen_matMulO ops A B n (headD_len_of B n hBl hBr)
  have hBh : (B.headD []).length = n := headD_len_of B n hBl hBr
  have hstep1 : R.rel (ops.mul (poly.powO ops ops.one n)
      (detO ops (List.zipWith (· ++ ·)
          (diagO ops (List.replicate n (ops.swap ops.one))) B
        ++ List.zipWith (· ++ ·) A
          (List.replicate n (List.replicate n ops.unit)))))
      (detO ops (List.zipWith (· ++ ·)
          (diagO ops (List.replicate n (ops.swap ops.one))) B
        ++ List.zipWith (· ++ ·)
          (List.replicate n (List.replicate n ops.unit))
          (matMulO ops A B))) := by
    refine detO_slabReduce L
      (diagO ops (List.replicate n (ops.swap ops.one))) B A
      (List.replicate n (List.replicate n ops.unit))
      (List.replicate n (List.replicate n ops.unit))
      (matMulO ops A B) n n ops.one
      (fun s i => ops.swap
        (ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] A i) s))
      hNl hNr hBl hBr hAl hAr hvacl hvacr hvacl hvacr hABl ?_ ?_
    · intro i b him hbk
      rw [hvace i b him hbk]
      have hfold : R.rel (ground.famFold ops.add ops.unit
          (fun s => ops.mul (ops.swap
              (ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] A i) s))
            (ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt []
              (diagO ops (List.replicate n (ops.swap ops.one))) s) b))
          (List.range n))
          (ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] A i) b) := by
        refine L.ovTrans (foldO_congr_members L.toDCore _
          (fun s => if b = s
            then ops.mul (ops.swap
              (ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] A i) s))
              (ops.swap ops.one)
            else ops.unit) (List.range n) (fun s hs => ?_)) ?_
        · rw [hNe s b (ground.ltOfMem hs) hbk]
          by_cases he : b = s
          · rw [if_pos he, if_pos he]
            exact L.ovRefl _
          · rw [if_neg he, if_neg he]
            exact L.mulUnit _
        · refine L.ovTrans (foldO_pick L _ (List.range n) b
            (ground.countOf_range_one hbk)) ?_
          refine L.ovTrans (L.mulSwapRight _ ops.one) ?_
          refine L.ovTrans (L.swapCongr (L.ovTrans
            (L.mulComm _ ops.one) (L.oneMul _))) ?_
          exact L.swapSwap _
      refine L.ovSymm ?_
      refine L.ovTrans
        (L.addCongr (L.oneMul _) (L.swapCongr hfold)) ?_
      exact annihDerived L
        (ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] A i) b)
    · intro i v him hvm
      rw [hvace i v him hvm]
      refine L.ovTrans (matMulO_entry L A B n n hAr hBh i v
        (by rw [hAl]; exact him) hvm) ?_
      refine L.ovSymm ?_
      refine L.ovTrans (L.addCongr (L.mulUnit ops.one) (L.ovRefl _)) ?_
      refine L.ovTrans (L.unitAdd _) ?_
      refine L.ovTrans (L.swapCongr ?_) (L.swapSwap _)
      refine L.ovTrans (foldO_congr_members L.toDCore _
        (fun s => ops.swap (ops.mul
          (ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] A i) s)
          (ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] B s) v)))
        (List.range n) (fun _ _ => mulSwapLeft L.toDCore _ _)) ?_
      exact foldO_swap L.toDCore _ (List.range n)
  have hM01 : R.rel
      (detO ops (List.zipWith (· ++ ·)
          (diagO ops (List.replicate n (ops.swap ops.one))) B
        ++ List.zipWith (· ++ ·) A
          (List.replicate n (List.replicate n ops.unit))))
      (detO ops (List.zipWith (· ++ ·)
          (diagO ops (List.replicate n (ops.swap ops.one))) B
        ++ List.zipWith (· ++ ·)
          (List.replicate n (List.replicate n ops.unit))
          (matMulO ops A B))) :=
    L.ovTrans (L.ovSymm (L.ovTrans
      (L.mulCongr (powO_one L n) (L.ovRefl _)) (L.oneMul _))) hstep1
  have hstep2 := detO_blockTri L
    (diagO ops (List.replicate n (ops.swap ops.one))) B
    (matMulO ops A B) n n hNl hNr hBl hBr hABl hABr
  have hstep3 := detO_blockTriLow L A
    (diagO ops (List.replicate n (ops.swap ops.one))) B n n
    hAl hAr hNl hNr hBl hBr
  have hstep4 : R.rel
      (detO ops (List.zipWith (· ++ ·)
          (diagO ops (List.replicate n (ops.swap ops.one))) B
        ++ List.zipWith (· ++ ·) A
          (List.replicate n (List.replicate n ops.unit))))
      (signAtO ops (places.parityOf (n * n))
        (detO ops (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) A
            (List.replicate n (List.replicate n ops.unit))
          ++ List.zipWith (· ++ ·)
            (diagO ops (List.replicate n (ops.swap ops.one))) B))) := by
    have h := detO_slabRotate L.toDCore
      (List.zipWith (· ++ ·)
        (diagO ops (List.replicate n (ops.swap ops.one))) B)
      (List.zipWith (· ++ ·) A
        (List.replicate n (List.replicate n ops.unit)))
    rw [ground.length_zipWith (· ++ ·)
        (diagO ops (List.replicate n (ops.swap ops.one))) B n hNl hBl,
      ground.length_zipWith (· ++ ·) A
        (List.replicate n (List.replicate n ops.unit)) n hAl hvacl] at h
    exact h
  have hstep5 : R.rel
      (detO ops (diagO ops (List.replicate n (ops.swap ops.one))))
      (signAtO ops (places.parityOf n) ops.one) :=
    L.ovTrans (detO_diagO L (List.replicate n (ops.swap ops.one)))
      (foldMulO_negOne L n ops.one)
  have h1 : R.rel
      (ops.mul (detO ops (diagO ops (List.replicate n (ops.swap ops.one))))
        (detO ops (matMulO ops A B)))
      (signAtO ops (places.parityOf n) (detO ops (matMulO ops A B))) :=
    L.ovTrans (L.mulCongr hstep5 (L.ovRefl _))
      (L.ovTrans (signAtO_mulLeft L.toDCore (places.parityOf n)
        ops.one (detO ops (matMulO ops A B)))
        (signAtO_congr L.toDCore (places.parityOf n)
          (L.oneMul (detO ops (matMulO ops A B)))))
  have hcomb : R.rel
      (signAtO ops (places.parityOf n) (detO ops (matMulO ops A B)))
      (signAtO ops (places.parityOf (n * n))
        (ops.mul (detO ops A) (detO ops B))) :=
    L.ovTrans (L.ovSymm h1)
      (L.ovTrans (L.ovSymm (L.ovTrans hM01 hstep2))
        (L.ovTrans hstep4
          (signAtO_congr L.toDCore (places.parityOf (n * n)) hstep3)))
  have hfalse : Bool.xor (places.parityOf (n * n)) (places.parityOf n)
      = false := by
    rw [← places.parityOf_add (n * n) n]
    exact parityOf_sqAdd n
  refine L.ovTrans (L.ovSymm (signAtO_signAtO L.toDCore
    (places.parityOf n) (detO ops (matMulO ops A B)))) ?_
  refine L.ovTrans
    (signAtO_congr L.toDCore (places.parityOf n) hcomb) ?_
  refine L.ovTrans (signAtO_comp L.toDCore (places.parityOf n)
    (places.parityOf (n * n))
    (ops.mul (detO ops A) (detO ops B))) ?_
  rw [hfalse]
  exact L.ovRefl _

name: matMul_matMulO
statement:
private theorem matMul_matMulO (A B : Mat) (n : Nat) (h0 : 0 < n)
    (hAl : A.length = n) (hAr : rowsLen n A)
    (hBl : B.length = n) (hBr : rowsLen n B) (i j : Nat)
    (hi : i < n) (hj : j < n) :
    (ground.getAt BPair.unit
        (ground.getAt [] (matMul A B) i) j).oneValue
      (ground.getAt BPair.unit
        (ground.getAt [] (matMulO bpairOps A B) i) j)
proof:
:= by
  have hBt : (transposeM B).length = n :=
    length_transposeM B hBr (by rw [hBl]; exact h0)
  have hBtr : rowsLen n (transposeM B) :=
    rowsLen_cast hBl (rowsLen_transposeM B)
  rw [getAt_matMul A B i (by rw [hAl]; exact hi),
    ground.getAt_map ([] : List BPair) BPair.unit _ (transposeM B) j
      (by rw [hBt]; exact hj)]
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans (dotN_read _ _) ?_
  have hrA : (ground.getAt ([] : List BPair) A i).length = n :=
    rowsLen_getAt A i hAr (by rw [hAl]; exact hi)
  have hrB : (ground.getAt ([] : List BPair) (transposeM B) j).length
      = n := rowsLen_getAt _ j hBtr (by rw [hBt]; exact hj)
  rw [← ground.range_map_getAt BPair.unit n _ hrA,
    ← ground.range_map_getAt BPair.unit n _ hrB, dotP_map_pair]
  refine BPair.oneValue_symm ?_
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans
    (matMulO_entry (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairLaws A B n n hAr
      (headD_len_of B n hBl hBr) i j
      (by rw [hAl]; exact hi) hj) ?_
  refine ground.foldB_congr_members _ _ (List.range n) ?_
  intro s hs
  rw [getAt_transposeM BPair.unit B hBr j s hj
    (by rw [hBl]; exact ground.ltOfMem hs)]
  exact BPair.oneValue_refl _

name: detL_mul
statement:
theorem detL_mul (A B : Mat) (n : Nat) (hA : sqAt A n) (hB : sqAt B n) :
    (detL (matMul A B)).oneValue (detL A * detL B)
proof:
:= by
  have hAl : A.length = n := sqAt_len hA
  have hAr : rowsLen n A := rowsLen_of_sqAt hA
  have hBl : B.length = n := sqAt_len hB
  have hBr : rowsLen n B := rowsLen_of_sqAt hB
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans
    (detL_congr_letters (matMul A B) (matMulO bpairOps A B)
      ((length_matMul A B).trans (ground.length_map _ A).symm) ?_) ?_
  · intro a ha b hb
    rw [length_matMul, hAl] at ha hb
    exact matMul_matMulO A B n
      (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le a) ha) hAl hAr hBl hBr a b ha hb
  · exact detO_mul (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairLaws A B n
      hAl hAr hBl hBr

name: minorP_congr
statement:
theorem minorP_congr (M N : List (List poly.Poly)) (n : Nat)
    (hMl : M.length = n) (hNl : N.length = n)
    (hMr : rowsLen n M) (hNr : rowsLen n N)
    (hent : ∀ a, a < n → ∀ b, b < n → poly.oneValue
      (ground.getAt ([] : poly.Poly) (ground.getAt [] M a) b)
      (ground.getAt ([] : poly.Poly) (ground.getAt [] N a) b)) :
    poly.oneValue (minorO poly.polyOps poly.pnorm id M)
      (minorO poly.polyOps poly.pnorm id N)
proof:
:= by
  have C : DCore poly.Poly poly.polyOps poly.polyRead.rel :=
    polyCoreO (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairLaws
  refine C.ovTrans (minorP_detP M (by rw [hMl]; exact hMr))
    (C.ovTrans ?_
      (C.ovSymm (minorP_detP N (by rw [hNl]; exact hNr))))
  refine detO_congr_letters C M N (hMl.trans hNl.symm)
    (fun a ha b hb => ?_)
  rw [hMl] at ha hb
  exact hent a ha b hb

name: pminor_mul
statement:
theorem pminor_mul (A B : List (List poly.Poly)) (n : Nat)
    (hAl : A.length = n) (hAr : rowsLen n A)
    (hBl : B.length = n) (hBr : rowsLen n B) :
    poly.oneValue
      (minorO poly.polyOps poly.pnorm id (matMulO poly.polyOps A B))
      (poly.mul (minorO poly.polyOps poly.pnorm id A)
        (minorO poly.polyOps poly.pnorm id B))
proof:
:= by
  have C : DCore poly.Poly poly.polyOps poly.polyRead.rel :=
    polyCoreO (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairLaws
  have hABl : (matMulO poly.polyOps A B).length = n :=
    (ground.length_map _ A).trans hAl
  refine C.ovTrans (minorP_detP (matMulO poly.polyOps A B)
    (by
      rw [hABl]
      exact rowsLen_matMulO poly.polyOps A B n
        (headD_len_of B n hBl hBr))) ?_
  refine C.ovTrans (detO_mul (R := poly.polyRead)
    (polyLawsO (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairLaws) A B n
    hAl hAr hBl hBr) ?_
  exact C.mulCongr (C.ovSymm (minorP_detP A (by rw [hAl]; exact hAr)))
    (C.ovSymm (minorP_detP B (by rw [hBl]; exact hBr)))

name: pminor_embed
statement:
theorem pminor_embed (M : Mat) (n : Nat) (hM : sqAt M n) :
    poly.oneValue (minorO poly.polyOps poly.pnorm id (embedP M))
      [detL M]
proof:
:= by
  have hMl : M.length = n := sqAt_len hM
  have hMr : rowsLen n M := rowsLen_of_sqAt hM
  have hEl : (embedP M).length = n := (ground.length_map _ M).trans hMl
  have hEr : rowsLen n (embedP M) := rowsLen_mapRowsO _ M n hMr
  have C : DCore poly.Poly poly.polyOps poly.polyRead.rel :=
    polyCoreO (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairLaws
  refine C.ovTrans (minorP_detP (embedP M) (by rw [hEl]; exact hEr)) ?_
  exact C.ovSymm
    (detO_hom (Rδ := poly.polyRead) bpairOps poly.polyOps C
      (fun b => ([b] : poly.Poly))
      (fun x y => lovRefl (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairCore
        [bpairOps.add x y])
      (fun x y => ⟨BPair.oneValue_symm
        (BPair.add_unit (bpairOps.mul x y)), trivial⟩)
      (fun x => lovRefl (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairCore
        [bpairOps.swap x])
      ⟨BPair.oneValue_refl BPair.unit, trivial⟩
      (lovRefl (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairCore [bpairOps.one]) M)

name: rowsLen_padR
statement:
private theorem rowsLen_padR (na nb : Nat) : ∀ L : Mat,
    rowsLen na L →
    rowsLen (na + nb)
      (L.map (fun c => c ++ List.replicate nb BPair.unit))
  | [], _ => trivial
  | r :: L, h => by
    refine ⟨?_, rowsLen_padR na nb L h.2⟩
    show (r ++ List.replicate nb BPair.unit).length = na + nb
    rw [ground.length_append r (List.replicate nb BPair.unit),
      ground.length_replicate BPair.unit nb, h.1]

statement:
theorem rowsLen_padL (na nb : Nat) : ∀ L : Mat,
