name: kernelJoin_rowsLen
statement:
theorem kernelJoin_rowsLen : ∀ (na nb : Nat) (P Q : Mat),
    rowsLen (na + nb) (kernelJoin na nb P Q)
proof:
:=
  fun na nb P Q =>
    rowsLen_append (na + nb)
      (rowsLen_padR na nb (kernelList na P)
        (kernelList_rowsLen na P))
      (rowsLen_padL na nb (kernelList nb Q)
        (kernelList_rowsLen nb Q))

name: kernelJoin_members
statement:
theorem kernelJoin_members : ∀ (na nb : Nat) (P Q : Mat),
    rowsLen na P → rowsLen nb Q →
    ∀ k, k < (kernelJoin na nb P Q).length →
      poly.unitTail (matVec (rowJoin P Q)
        (ground.getAt [] (kernelJoin na nb P Q) k))
proof:
:= by
  intro na nb P Q hP hQ k hk
  have hAl : ((kernelList na P).map
      (fun c => c ++ List.replicate nb BPair.unit)).length
      = (kernelList na P).length := ground.length_map _ _
  have hBl : ((kernelList nb Q).map
      (fun c => List.replicate na BPair.unit ++ c)).length
      = (kernelList nb Q).length := ground.length_map _ _
  have hk' : k < ((kernelList na P).map
        (fun c => c ++ List.replicate nb BPair.unit)).length
      + ((kernelList nb Q).map
        (fun c => List.replicate na BPair.unit ++ c)).length := by
    rw [← ground.length_append]
    exact hk
  show poly.unitTail (matVec (rowJoin P Q)
    (ground.getAt []
      ((kernelList na P).map
          (fun c => c ++ List.replicate nb BPair.unit)
        ++ (kernelList nb Q).map
          (fun c => List.replicate na BPair.unit ++ c)) k))
  rw [ground.getAt_append ([] : List BPair) _ _ k]
  by_cases hkA : k < ((kernelList na P).map
      (fun c => c ++ List.replicate nb BPair.unit)).length
  · rw [if_pos hkA]
    have hkA' : k < (kernelList na P).length := by
      rw [← hAl]; exact hkA
    rw [ground.getAt_map ([] : List BPair) ([] : List BPair)
      (fun c => c ++ List.replicate nb BPair.unit)
      (kernelList na P) k hkA']
    refine poly.oneValue_unitTail
      (matVec_rowJoin na P Q _ (List.replicate nb BPair.unit)
        hP
        (rowsLen_getAt (kernelList na P) k
          (kernelList_rowsLen na P) hkA')) ?_
    exact unitTail_vecAdd_of (kernelList_members na P hP k hkA')
      (matVec_units Q nb)
  · rw [if_neg hkA]
    have hkB : k - ((kernelList na P).map
        (fun c => c ++ List.replicate nb BPair.unit)).length
        < ((kernelList nb Q).map
          (fun c => List.replicate na BPair.unit ++ c)).length :=
      ground.subLt (Nat.le_of_not_lt hkA) hk'
    have hkB' : k - ((kernelList na P).map
        (fun c => c ++ List.replicate nb BPair.unit)).length
        < (kernelList nb Q).length := by
      rw [← hBl]; exact hkB
    rw [ground.getAt_map ([] : List BPair) ([] : List BPair)
      (fun c => List.replicate na BPair.unit ++ c)
      (kernelList nb Q) _ hkB']
    refine poly.oneValue_unitTail
      (matVec_rowJoin na P Q (List.replicate na BPair.unit) _
        hP (ground.length_replicate BPair.unit na)) ?_
    exact unitTail_vecAdd_of (matVec_units P na)
      (kernelList_members nb Q hQ _ hkB')

name: combo_padR
statement:
private theorem combo_padR : ∀ (na nb : Nat) (cs : List BPair)
    (X : Mat), rowsLen na X →
    poly.oneValue
      (combo (na + nb) cs
        (X.map (fun r => r ++ List.replicate nb BPair.unit)))
      (combo na cs X ++ List.replicate nb BPair.unit)
  | na, nb, [], _, _ => by
    show poly.oneValue (List.replicate (na + nb) BPair.unit)
      (List.replicate na BPair.unit ++ List.replicate nb BPair.unit)
    exact poly.unitTail_oneValue (poly.unitTail_replicate (na + nb))
      (unitTail_append (poly.unitTail_replicate na)
        (poly.unitTail_replicate nb))
  | na, nb, _ :: _, [], _ => by
    show poly.oneValue (List.replicate (na + nb) BPair.unit)
      (List.replicate na BPair.unit ++ List.replicate nb BPair.unit)
    exact poly.unitTail_oneValue (poly.unitTail_replicate (na + nb))
      (unitTail_append (poly.unitTail_replicate na)
        (poly.unitTail_replicate nb))
  | na, nb, c :: cs, x :: X, hX => by
    have hsc : vecScale c (x ++ List.replicate nb BPair.unit)
        = vecScale c x ++ vecScale c (List.replicate nb BPair.unit)
proof:
:=
      ground.map_append (fun t => c * t) x
        (List.replicate nb BPair.unit)
    have h1 : poly.oneValue
        (vecScale c (x ++ List.replicate nb BPair.unit))
        (vecScale c x ++ List.replicate nb BPair.unit) := by
      rw [hsc]
      exact poly.oneValue_append (vecScale c x) (vecScale c x)
        (vecScale c (List.replicate nb BPair.unit))
        (List.replicate nb BPair.unit)
        rfl (poly.oneValue_refl _)
        (poly.unitTail_oneValue
          (unitTail_vecScale c _ (poly.unitTail_replicate nb))
          (poly.unitTail_replicate nb))
    have hL1 : (vecScale c (x ++ List.replicate nb BPair.unit)).length
        = na + nb := by
      rw [length_vecScale, ground.length_append,
        ground.length_replicate, hX.1]
    have hR1 : (vecScale c x ++ List.replicate nb BPair.unit).length
        = na + nb := by
      rw [ground.length_append, length_vecScale,
        ground.length_replicate, hX.1]
    have hL2 : (combo (na + nb) cs
        (X.map (fun r => r ++ List.replicate nb BPair.unit))).length
        = na + nb :=
      length_combo (na + nb) cs _ (rowsLen_padR na nb X hX.2)
    have hR2 : (combo na cs X ++ List.replicate nb BPair.unit).length
        = na + nb := by
      rw [ground.length_append, length_combo na cs X hX.2,
        ground.length_replicate]
    have h3 := polyOne_vecAdd
      (vecScale c (x ++ List.replicate nb BPair.unit))
      (vecScale c x ++ List.replicate nb BPair.unit)
      (combo (na + nb) cs
        (X.map (fun r => r ++ List.replicate nb BPair.unit)))
      (combo na cs X ++ List.replicate nb BPair.unit)
      h1 (combo_padR na nb cs X hX.2)
      (hL1.trans hR1.symm) (hL2.trans hR2.symm)
    have h4 := vecAdd_append (vecScale c x)
      (List.replicate nb BPair.unit) (combo na cs X)
      (List.replicate nb BPair.unit)
      (by rw [length_vecScale, hX.1, length_combo na cs X hX.2])
    have h5 := poly.oneValue_append
      (vecAdd (vecScale c x) (combo na cs X))
      (vecAdd (vecScale c x) (combo na cs X))
      (vecAdd (List.replicate nb BPair.unit)
        (List.replicate nb BPair.unit))
      (List.replicate nb BPair.unit)
      rfl (poly.oneValue_refl _)
      (poly.unitTail_oneValue
        (unitTail_vecAdd_of (poly.unitTail_replicate nb)
          (poly.unitTail_replicate nb))
        (poly.unitTail_replicate nb))
    exact poly.oneValue_trans h3 (poly.oneValue_trans h4 h5)

name: combo_padL
statement:
private theorem combo_padL : ∀ (na nb : Nat) (cs : List BPair)
    (X : Mat), rowsLen nb X →
    poly.oneValue
      (combo (na + nb) cs
        (X.map (fun r => List.replicate na BPair.unit ++ r)))
      (List.replicate na BPair.unit ++ combo nb cs X)
  | na, nb, [], _, _ => by
    show poly.oneValue (List.replicate (na + nb) BPair.unit)
      (List.replicate na BPair.unit ++ List.replicate nb BPair.unit)
    exact poly.unitTail_oneValue (poly.unitTail_replicate (na + nb))
      (unitTail_append (poly.unitTail_replicate na)
        (poly.unitTail_replicate nb))
  | na, nb, _ :: _, [], _ => by
    show poly.oneValue (List.replicate (na + nb) BPair.unit)
      (List.replicate na BPair.unit ++ List.replicate nb BPair.unit)
    exact poly.unitTail_oneValue (poly.unitTail_replicate (na + nb))
      (unitTail_append (poly.unitTail_replicate na)
        (poly.unitTail_replicate nb))
  | na, nb, c :: cs, x :: X, hX => by
    have hsc : vecScale c (List.replicate na BPair.unit ++ x)
        = vecScale c (List.replicate na BPair.unit) ++ vecScale c x
proof:
:=
      ground.map_append (fun t => c * t)
        (List.replicate na BPair.unit) x
    have h1 : poly.oneValue
        (vecScale c (List.replicate na BPair.unit ++ x))
        (List.replicate na BPair.unit ++ vecScale c x) := by
      rw [hsc]
      exact poly.oneValue_append
        (vecScale c (List.replicate na BPair.unit))
        (List.replicate na BPair.unit)
        (vecScale c x) (vecScale c x)
        (length_vecScale c (List.replicate na BPair.unit))
        (poly.unitTail_oneValue
          (unitTail_vecScale c _ (poly.unitTail_replicate na))
          (poly.unitTail_replicate na))
        (poly.oneValue_refl _)
    have hL1 : (vecScale c (List.replicate na BPair.unit ++ x)).length
        = na + nb := by
      rw [length_vecScale, ground.length_append,
        ground.length_replicate, hX.1]
    have hR1 : (List.replicate na BPair.unit ++ vecScale c x).length
        = na + nb := by
      rw [ground.length_append, ground.length_replicate,
        length_vecScale, hX.1]
    have hL2 : (combo (na + nb) cs
        (X.map (fun r => List.replicate na BPair.unit ++ r))).length
        = na + nb :=
      length_combo (na + nb) cs _ (rowsLen_padL na nb X hX.2)
    have hR2 : (List.replicate na BPair.unit ++ combo nb cs X).length
        = na + nb := by
      rw [ground.length_append, ground.length_replicate,
        length_combo nb cs X hX.2]
    have h3 := polyOne_vecAdd
      (vecScale c (List.replicate na BPair.unit ++ x))
      (List.replicate na BPair.unit ++ vecScale c x)
      (combo (na + nb) cs
        (X.map (fun r => List.replicate na BPair.unit ++ r)))
      (List.replicate na BPair.unit ++ combo nb cs X)
      h1 (combo_padL na nb cs X hX.2)
      (hL1.trans hR1.symm) (hL2.trans hR2.symm)
    have h4 := vecAdd_append (List.replicate na BPair.unit)
      (vecScale c x) (List.replicate na BPair.unit)
      (combo nb cs X) rfl
    have h5 := poly.oneValue_append
      (vecAdd (List.replicate na BPair.unit)
        (List.replicate na BPair.unit))
      (List.replicate na BPair.unit)
      (vecAdd (vecScale c x) (combo nb cs X))
      (vecAdd (vecScale c x) (combo nb cs X))
      (by rw [length_vecAdd (List.replicate na BPair.unit)
          (List.replicate na BPair.unit) na
          (ground.length_replicate BPair.unit na)
          (ground.length_replicate BPair.unit na),
        ground.length_replicate])
      (poly.unitTail_oneValue
        (unitTail_vecAdd_of (poly.unitTail_replicate na)
          (poly.unitTail_replicate na))
        (poly.unitTail_replicate na))
      (poly.oneValue_refl _)
    exact poly.oneValue_trans h3 (poly.oneValue_trans h4 h5)

name: append_vecAdd_units
statement:
private theorem append_vecAdd_units : ∀ (na : Nat)
    (v w : List BPair), v.length = na →
    poly.oneValue
      (vecAdd (v ++ List.replicate w.length BPair.unit)
        (List.replicate na BPair.unit ++ w))
      (v ++ w)
proof:
:= by
  intro na v w hv
  have h1 := vecAdd_append v (List.replicate w.length BPair.unit)
    (List.replicate na BPair.unit) w
    (by rw [ground.length_replicate]; exact hv)
  have h2 : poly.oneValue
      (vecAdd v (List.replicate na BPair.unit)) v :=
    vecAdd_null_right v (List.replicate na BPair.unit)
      (by rw [ground.length_replicate]; exact hv)
      (poly.unitTail_replicate na)
  have h3 : poly.oneValue
      (vecAdd (List.replicate w.length BPair.unit) w) w :=
    vecAdd_null_left (List.replicate w.length BPair.unit) w
      (ground.length_replicate BPair.unit w.length)
      (poly.unitTail_replicate w.length)
  have h4 := poly.oneValue_append
    (vecAdd v (List.replicate na BPair.unit)) v
    (vecAdd (List.replicate w.length BPair.unit) w) w
    (by rw [length_vecAdd v (List.replicate na BPair.unit) na hv
        (ground.length_replicate BPair.unit na)]; exact hv.symm)
    h2
    h3
  exact poly.oneValue_trans h1 h4

name: kernelJoin_indep
statement:
theorem kernelJoin_indep : ∀ (na nb : Nat) (P Q : Mat),
    rowsLen na P → rowsLen nb Q →
    indepRows (na + nb) (kernelJoin na nb P Q)
proof:
:= by
  intro na nb P Q hP hQ
  refine indep_intro (na + nb) (kernelJoin na nb P Q)
    (kernelJoin_rowsLen na nb P Q) ?_
  intro cs hcs hnull
  have hAr := rowsLen_padR na nb (kernelList na P)
    (kernelList_rowsLen na P)
  have hBr := rowsLen_padL na nb (kernelList nb Q)
    (kernelList_rowsLen nb Q)
  have hcsAB : cs.length = ((kernelList na P).map
        (fun c => c ++ List.replicate nb BPair.unit)).length
      + ((kernelList nb Q).map
        (fun c => List.replicate na BPair.unit ++ c)).length := by
    rw [← ground.length_append]
    exact hcs
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab, hal⟩ := ground.listSplit cs
    ((kernelList na P).map
      (fun c => c ++ List.replicate nb BPair.unit)).length
    (by rw [hcsAB]; exact Nat.le_add_right _ _)
  have hbl : b.length = ((kernelList nb Q).map
      (fun c => List.replicate na BPair.unit ++ c)).length := by
    have h1 : a.length + b.length = ((kernelList na P).map
          (fun c => c ++ List.replicate nb BPair.unit)).length
        + ((kernelList nb Q).map
          (fun c => List.replicate na BPair.unit ++ c)).length := by
      rw [← ground.length_append a b, ← hab]
      exact hcsAB
    rw [hal] at h1
    exact ground.addCancelL _ h1
  have haK : a.length = (kernelList na P).length :=
    hal.trans (ground.length_map _ _)
  have hbK : b.length = (kernelList nb Q).length :=
    hbl.trans (ground.length_map _ _)
  rw [hab] at hnull
  have hn2 : poly.unitTail
      (vecAdd
        (combo (na + nb) a ((kernelList na P).map
          (fun c => c ++ List.replicate nb BPair.unit)))
        (combo (na + nb) b ((kernelList nb Q).map
          (fun c => List.replicate na BPair.unit ++ c)))) :=
    poly.unitTail_oneValue_right hnull
      (combo_append (na + nb) a
        ((kernelList na P).map
          (fun c => c ++ List.replicate nb BPair.unit))
        b
        ((kernelList nb Q).map
          (fun c => List.replicate na BPair.unit ++ c))
        hal hAr hBr)
  have hXl : (combo na a (kernelList na P)).length = na :=
    length_combo na a (kernelList na P) (kernelList_rowsLen na P)
  have hYl : (combo nb b (kernelList nb Q)).length = nb :=
    length_combo nb b (kernelList nb Q) (kernelList_rowsLen nb Q)
  have hn3 : poly.unitTail
      (vecAdd
        (combo na a (kernelList na P)
          ++ List.replicate nb BPair.unit)
        (List.replicate na BPair.unit
          ++ combo nb b (kernelList nb Q))) :=
    poly.unitTail_oneValue_right hn2
      (polyOne_vecAdd
        (combo (na + nb) a ((kernelList na P).map
          (fun c => c ++ List.replicate nb BPair.unit)))
        (combo na a (kernelList na P)
          ++ List.replicate nb BPair.unit)
        (combo (na + nb) b ((kernelList nb Q).map
          (fun c => List.replicate na BPair.unit ++ c)))
        (List.replicate na BPair.unit
          ++ combo nb b (kernelList nb Q))
        (combo_padR na nb a (kernelList na P)
          (kernelList_rowsLen na P))
        (combo_padL na nb b (kernelList nb Q)
          (kernelList_rowsLen nb Q))
        (by
          rw [length_combo (na + nb) a _ hAr, ground.length_append,
            hXl, ground.length_replicate])
        (by
          rw [length_combo (na + nb) b _ hBr, ground.length_append,
            ground.length_replicate, hYl]))
  have hau := append_vecAdd_units na (combo na a (kernelList na P))
    (combo nb b (kernelList nb Q)) hXl
  have hrep : List.replicate (combo nb b (kernelList nb Q)).length
      BPair.unit = List.replicate nb BPair.unit :=
    congrArg (fun t => List.replicate t BPair.unit) hYl
  rw [hrep] at hau
  obtain ⟨hXu, hYu⟩ := unitTail_append_split
    (combo na a (kernelList na P)) (combo nb b (kernelList nb Q))
    (poly.unitTail_oneValue_right hn3 hau)
  rw [hab]
  exact unitTail_append
    (indep_elim (kernelList_indep na P hP) a haK hXu)
    (indep_elim (kernelList_indep nb Q hQ) b hbK hYu)

name: rowsLen_of_mem
proof:

name: vecScale_append
statement:

name: flatCat_cons
statement:
theorem flatCat_cons (r : List BPair) (M : Mat) :

proof: := rfl

name: length_flatCat
statement:
theorem length_flatCat (w : Nat) :
    ∀ M : Mat, rowsLen w M → (flatCat M).length = M.length * w
  | [], _ => (Nat.zero_mul w).symm
  | a :: M, h => by
    show (a ++ flatCat M).length = (M.length + 1) * w
    rw [ground.length_append a (flatCat M), h.1,
      length_flatCat w M h.2, Nat.mul_comm (M.length + 1) w,
      Nat.mul_comm M.length w]
    exact Nat.add_comm w (w * M.length)

/
padded list's span, the further columns the unit family's. -/

name: spanRel_padR
statement:
theorem spanRel_padR : ∀ (na nb : Nat) (X : Mat)
    (v : List BPair), spanRel na X v →
    spanRel (na + nb)
      (X.map (fun r => r ++ List.replicate nb BPair.unit))
      (v ++ List.replicate nb BPair.unit)
proof:
:= by
  intro na nb X v h
  obtain ⟨c₀, cs, hc₀, hcl, hone⟩ := span_elim h
  refine span_intro (na + nb)
    (X.map (fun r => r ++ List.replicate nb BPair.unit))
    (v ++ List.replicate nb BPair.unit)
    (rowsLen_padR na nb X h.1)
    (by rw [ground.length_append, ground.length_replicate, h.2.1])
    ⟨c₀, cs, hc₀, hcl.trans (ground.length_map _ X).symm, ?_⟩
  have hsc : vecScale c₀ (v ++ List.replicate nb BPair.unit)
      = vecScale c₀ v ++ vecScale c₀ (List.replicate nb BPair.unit) :=
    ground.map_append (fun t => c₀ * t) v
      (List.replicate nb BPair.unit)
  have h1 : poly.oneValue
      (vecScale c₀ (v ++ List.replicate nb BPair.unit))
      (combo na cs X ++ List.replicate nb BPair.unit) := by
    rw [hsc]
    exact poly.oneValue_append (vecScale c₀ v) (combo na cs X)
      (vecScale c₀ (List.replicate nb BPair.unit))
      (List.replicate nb BPair.unit)
      ((length_vecScale c₀ v).trans
        (h.2.1.trans (length_combo na cs X h.1).symm))
      hone
      (poly.unitTail_oneValue
        (unitTail_vecScale c₀ _ (poly.unitTail_replicate nb))
        (poly.unitTail_replicate nb))
  exact poly.oneValue_trans h1
    (poly.oneValue_symm (combo_padR na nb cs X h.1))

name: spanRel_padL
statement:
theorem spanRel_padL : ∀ (na nb : Nat) (X : Mat)
    (v : List BPair), spanRel nb X v →
    spanRel (na + nb)
      (X.map (fun r => List.replicate na BPair.unit ++ r))
      (List.replicate na BPair.unit ++ v)
proof:
:= by
  intro na nb X v h
  obtain ⟨c₀, cs, hc₀, hcl, hone⟩ := span_elim h
  refine span_intro (na + nb)
    (X.map (fun r => List.replicate na BPair.unit ++ r))
    (List.replicate na BPair.unit ++ v)
    (rowsLen_padL na nb X h.1)
    (by rw [ground.length_append, ground.length_replicate, h.2.1])
    ⟨c₀, cs, hc₀, hcl.trans (ground.length_map _ X).symm, ?_⟩
  have hsc : vecScale c₀ (List.replicate na BPair.unit ++ v)
      = vecScale c₀ (List.replicate na BPair.unit) ++ vecScale c₀ v :=
    ground.map_append (fun t => c₀ * t)
      (List.replicate na BPair.unit) v
  have h1 : poly.oneValue
      (vecScale c₀ (List.replicate na BPair.unit ++ v))
      (List.replicate na BPair.unit ++ combo nb cs X) := by
    rw [hsc]
    exact poly.oneValue_append
      (vecScale c₀ (List.replicate na BPair.unit))
      (List.replicate na BPair.unit)
      (vecScale c₀ v) (combo nb cs X)
      (length_vecScale c₀ (List.replicate na BPair.unit))
      (poly.unitTail_oneValue
        (unitTail_vecScale c₀ _ (poly.unitTail_replicate na))
        (poly.unitTail_replicate na))
      hone
  exact poly.oneValue_trans h1
    (poly.oneValue_symm (combo_padL na nb cs X h.1))

name: kernelJoin_span
statement:
theorem kernelJoin_span : ∀ (na nb : Nat) (P Q : Mat),
    rowsLen na P → rowsLen nb Q → P.length = Q.length →
    (∀ v w : List BPair, v.length = na → w.length = nb →
      poly.unitTail (matVec (rowJoin P Q) (v ++ w)) →
      poly.unitTail (matVec P v)) →
    ∀ u : List BPair, u.length = na + nb →
      poly.unitTail (matVec (rowJoin P Q) u) →
      spanRel (na + nb) (kernelJoin na nb P Q) u
proof:
:= by
  intro na nb P Q hP hQ hl hyp u hu hker
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab, hal⟩ := ground.listSplit u na
    (by rw [hu]; exact Nat.le_add_right na nb)
  have hbl : b.length = nb := by
    have h1 : a.length + b.length = na + nb := by
      rw [← ground.length_append a b, ← hab]
      exact hu
    rw [hal] at h1
    exact ground.addCancelL na h1
  rw [hab] at hker
  have hA : poly.unitTail (matVec P a) := hyp a b hal hbl hker
  have hsum : poly.unitTail (vecAdd (matVec P a) (matVec Q b)) :=
    poly.unitTail_oneValue_right hker
      (matVec_rowJoin na P Q a b hP hal)
  have hlen : (matVec Q b).length = (matVec P a).length := by
    rw [matVec_length, matVec_length]
    exact hl.symm
  have hsum' : poly.unitTail (vecAdd (matVec Q b) (matVec P a)) := by
    rw [vecAdd_comm (matVec Q b) (matVec P a)]
    exact hsum
  have hB : poly.unitTail (matVec Q b) :=
    unitTail_split_left hlen hsum' hA
  have hAr := rowsLen_padR na nb (kernelList na P)
    (kernelList_rowsLen na P)
  have hBr := rowsLen_padL na nb (kernelList nb Q)
    (kernelList_rowsLen nb Q)
  have h1 : spanRel (na + nb) (kernelJoin na nb P Q)
      (a ++ List.replicate nb BPair.unit) :=
    spanRel_mono (na + nb) _ _ _ hAr hBr
      (spanRel_padR na nb (kernelList na P) a
        (kernelList_span na P hP a hal hA))
  have h2 : spanRel (na + nb) (kernelJoin na nb P Q)
      (List.replicate na BPair.unit ++ b) :=
    spanRel_mono_left (na + nb) _ _ _ hAr hBr
      (spanRel_padL na nb (kernelList nb Q) b
        (kernelList_span nb Q hQ b hbl hB))
  have h3 := spanRel_add (na + nb) (kernelJoin na nb P Q)
    (a ++ List.replicate nb BPair.unit)
    (List.replicate na BPair.unit ++ b)
    (kernelJoin_rowsLen na nb P Q)
    (by rw [ground.length_append, ground.length_replicate, hal])
    (by rw [ground.length_append, ground.length_replicate, hbl])
    h1 h2
  have hau := append_vecAdd_units na a b hal
  have hrep : List.replicate b.length BPair.unit
      = List.replicate nb BPair.unit :=
    congrArg (fun t => List.replicate t BPair.unit) hbl
  rw [hrep] at hau
  rw [hab]
  exact spanRel_congr (na + nb) (kernelJoin na nb P Q) _ (a ++ b)
    hau h3 (by rw [ground.length_append, hal, hbl])

name: kernelDim_rowJoin
statement:
theorem kernelDim_rowJoin : ∀ (na nb : Nat) (P Q : Mat),
    rowsLen na P → rowsLen nb Q → P.length = Q.length →
    (∀ v w : List BPair, v.length = na → w.length = nb →
      poly.unitTail (matVec (rowJoin P Q) (v ++ w)) →
      poly.unitTail (matVec P v)) →
    kernelDim na P + kernelDim nb Q
      = kernelDim (na + nb) (rowJoin P Q)
proof:
:= by
  intro na nb P Q hP hQ hl hyp
  have hR : rowsLen (na + nb) (rowJoin P Q) :=
    rowsLen_rowJoin na nb hP hQ
  have hcount := span_count_eq (na + nb) (kernelJoin na nb P Q)
    (kernelList (na + nb) (rowJoin P Q))
    (kernelJoin_rowsLen na nb P Q)
    (kernelList_rowsLen (na + nb) (rowJoin P Q))
    (kernelJoin_indep na nb P Q hP hQ)
    (kernelList_indep (na + nb) (rowJoin P Q) hR)
    (fun k hk => kernelList_span (na + nb) (rowJoin P Q) hR _
      (rowsLen_getAt (kernelJoin na nb P Q) k
        (kernelJoin_rowsLen na nb P Q) hk)
      (kernelJoin_members na nb P Q hP hQ k hk))
    (fun k hk => kernelJoin_span na nb P Q hP hQ hl hyp _
      (rowsLen_getAt (kernelList (na + nb) (rowJoin P Q)) k
        (kernelList_rowsLen (na + nb) (rowJoin P Q)) hk)
      (kernelList_members (na + nb) (rowJoin P Q) hR k hk))
  have hjl : (kernelJoin na nb P Q).length
      = kernelDim na P + kernelDim nb Q := by
    show (((kernelList na P).map
        (fun c => c ++ List.replicate nb BPair.unit))
      ++ ((kernelList nb Q).map
        (fun c => List.replicate na BPair.unit ++ c))).length
      = kernelDim na P + kernelDim nb Q
    rw [ground.length_append, ground.length_map, ground.length_map,
      kernelList_dim, kernelList_dim]
  rw [← hjl, hcount, kernelList_dim]

statement:
theorem length_crossM : ∀ (R L : Mat),
    (crossM R L).length = R.length
proof:
:=
  fun R _ => ground.length_map _ R

name: rowsLen_crossM
statement:

    rowsLen L.length (crossM R L)

:=
  fun R L => rowsLen_map _ L.length R (fun x _ => (fun _ => ground.length_map _ L) x)

name: polyOne_map_dotN
statement:
private theorem polyOne_map_dotN (r : List BPair) : ∀ L : Mat,
    poly.oneValue (L.map (fun x => dotN r x))
      (L.map (fun x => dotP r x))
  | [] => trivial
  | x :: L => ⟨dotN_read r x, polyOne_map_dotN r L⟩

/
combination: a coefficient vector's read against the cross rows is
the stacked rows' read of its combination.  The width binders are
`def:elim`'s stated-key-list frame, the matrices total over stated
finite lists. -/

name: matVec_crossM
statement:
theorem matVec_crossM : ∀ (n : Nat) (R L : Mat) (c : List BPair),
    rowsLen n R → rowsLen n L →
    poly.oneValue (matVec (crossM R L) c)
      (matVec R (combo n c L))
  | _, [], _, _, _, _ => trivial
  | n, r :: R, L, c, hR, hL => by
    show (dotN (L.map (fun x => dotN r x)) c).oneValue
        (dotN r (combo n c L))
      ∧ poly.oneValue (matVec (crossM R L) c)
        (matVec R (combo n c L))
    refine ⟨?_, matVec_crossM n R L c hR.2 hL⟩
    exact BPair.oneValue_trans
      (dotN_read (L.map (fun x => dotN r x)) c)
      (BPair.oneValue_trans
        (BPair.oneValue_of_eq
          (dotP_comm (L.map (fun x => dotN r x)) c))
        (BPair.oneValue_trans
          (dotP_oneValue_right c (L.map (fun x => dotN r x))
            (L.map (fun x => dotP r x)) (polyOne_map_dotN r L))
          (BPair.oneValue_symm
            (BPair.oneValue_trans (dotN_read r (combo n c L))
              (dotP_combo c L r n hL)))))

/
row for row. -/

name: crossM_append
statement:
theorem crossM_append : ∀ (R LA LB : Mat),
    crossM R (LA ++ LB) = rowJoin (crossM R LA) (crossM R LB)
  | [], _, _ => rfl
  | r :: R, LA, LB => by
    show (LA ++ LB).map (fun x => dotN r x) :: crossM R (LA ++ LB)
      = (LA.map (fun x => dotN r x) ++ LB.map (fun x => dotN r x))
        :: rowJoin (crossM R LA) (crossM R LB)
    rw [ground.map_append (fun x => dotN r x) LA LB,
      crossM_append R LA LB]

/
a null combination's two parts are perpendicular span members
summing to the unit, the positive pairing withdrawing both, and
each side's independence reads its coefficients at the unit. -/

name: indep_append_perp
statement:
theorem indep_append_perp : ∀ (n : Nat) (LA LB : Mat),
    rowsLen n LA → rowsLen n LB →
    indepRows n LA → indepRows n LB →
    (∀ k, k < LA.length → ∀ l, l < LB.length →
      (dotP (ground.getAt [] LA k)
        (ground.getAt [] LB l)).oneValue BPair.unit) →
    indepRows n (LA ++ LB)
proof:
:= by
  intro n LA LB hA hB hiA hiB hperp
  refine indep_intro n (LA ++ LB) (rowsLen_append n hA hB) ?_
  intro cs hcs hnull
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab, hal⟩ := ground.listSplit cs LA.length
    (by rw [hcs, ground.length_append]; exact Nat.le_add_right _ _)
  have hbl : b.length = LB.length := by
    have h1 : a.length + b.length = LA.length + LB.length := by
      rw [← ground.length_append a b, ← hab, hcs,
        ground.length_append]
    rw [hal] at h1
    exact ground.addCancelL LA.length h1
  rw [hab] at hnull
  have hsplit : poly.unitTail
      (vecAdd (combo n a LA) (combo n b LB)) :=
    poly.unitTail_oneValue_right hnull
      (combo_append n a LA b LB hal hA hB)
  have hxs : spanRel n LA (combo n a LA) :=
    spanRel_combo n LA hA LA a hA
      (fun k hk => spanRel_getAt n LA k hk hA)
  have hys : spanRel n LB (combo n b LB) :=
    spanRel_combo n LB hB LB b hB
      (fun k hk => spanRel_getAt n LB k hk hB)
  have hrow : ∀ k, k < LA.length →
      (dotP (combo n b LB) (ground.getAt [] LA k)).oneValue
        BPair.unit := by
    intro k hk
    have h1 : (dotP (ground.getAt [] LA k) (combo n b LB)).oneValue
        BPair.unit :=
      perp_span n LB (ground.getAt [] LA k) (combo n b LB) hB
        (rowsLen_getAt LA k hA hk) (hperp k hk) hys
    rw [dotP_comm (combo n b LB) (ground.getAt [] LA k)]
    exact h1
  have hpair : (dotP (combo n a LA) (combo n b LB)).oneValue
      BPair.unit := by
    rw [dotP_comm (combo n a LA) (combo n b LB)]
    exact perp_span n LA (combo n b LB) (combo n a LA) hA
      (length_combo n b LB hB) hrow hxs
  obtain ⟨hxu, hyu⟩ := vecAdd_perp_null (combo n a LA) (combo n b LB)
    ((length_combo n b LB hB).trans (length_combo n a LA hA).symm)
    hsplit hpair
  rw [hab]
  exact unitTail_append (indep_elim hiA a hal hxu)
    (indep_elim hiB b hbl hyu)

name: combo_combo
statement:
private theorem combo_combo : ∀ (n : Nat) (ds : List BPair)
    (C : List (List BPair)) (L : Mat),
    rowsLen L.length C → rowsLen n L →
    poly.oneValue (combo n (combo L.length ds C) L)
      (combo n ds (C.map (fun c => combo n c L)))
  | n, [], _, L, _, _ =>
    poly.unitTail_oneValue (combo_unitsT n L L.length)
      (poly.unitTail_replicate n)
  | n, _ :: _, [], L, _, _ =>
    poly.unitTail_oneValue (combo_unitsT n L L.length)
      (poly.unitTail_replicate n)
  | n, d :: ds, c :: C, L, hC, hL => by
    have hfr : rowsLen n (C.map (fun c => combo n c L))
proof:
:=
      rowsLen_map _ n C (fun x _ => (fun a => length_combo n a L hL) x)
    show poly.oneValue
        (combo n (vecAdd (vecScale d c) (combo L.length ds C)) L)
        (vecAdd (vecScale d (combo n c L))
          (combo n ds (C.map (fun c => combo n c L))))
    refine poly.oneValue_trans
      (combo_vecAdd n (vecScale d c) (combo L.length ds C) L
        (((length_vecScale d c).trans hC.1).trans
          (length_combo L.length ds C hC.2).symm)) ?_
    exact polyOne_vecAdd _ _ _ _
      (poly.oneValue_symm (vecScale_combo d n c L))
      (combo_combo n ds C L hC.2 hL)
      ((length_combo n (vecScale d c) L hL).trans
        ((length_vecScale d (combo n c L)).trans
          (length_combo n c L hL)).symm)
      ((length_combo n (combo L.length ds C) L hL).trans
        (length_combo n ds (C.map (fun c => combo n c L)) hfr).symm)

name: combo_congr
statement:
theorem combo_congr (n : Nat) : ∀ (cs cs' : List BPair) (L : Mat),
    cs.length = cs'.length → poly.oneValue cs cs' →
    poly.oneValue (combo n cs L) (combo n cs' L)
  | [], [], _, _, _ => poly.oneValue_refl _
  | [], _ :: _, _, hl, _ => Nat.noConfusion hl
  | _ :: _, [], _, hl, _ => Nat.noConfusion hl
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, [], _, _ => poly.oneValue_refl _
  | c :: cs, c' :: cs', r :: L, hl, h =>
    vecAdd_congr2 (vecScale c r) (vecScale c' r) (combo n cs L)
      (combo n cs' L)
      (by rw [length_vecScale, length_vecScale])
      (length_combo_congr n cs cs' L (Nat.succ.inj hl))
      (vecScale_congr h.1 r)
      (combo_congr n cs cs' L (Nat.succ.inj hl) h.2)

/
combination of them is a combination of the basis at the inner
coefficients, independent there, and the stacked family's own
kernel list is independent at its coefficients. -/
private theorem crossKer_indep (n : Nat) (R L : Mat)
    (hL : rowsLen n L) (hiL : indepRows n L) :
    indepRows n ((kernelList L.length (crossM R L)).map
      (fun c => combo n c L))
proof:
:= by
  refine indep_intro n
    ((kernelList L.length (crossM R L)).map (fun c => combo n c L))
    (rowsLen_map _ n _ (fun x _ => (fun a => length_combo n a L hL) x)) ?_
  intro ds hds hnull
  have hK : rowsLen L.length (kernelList L.length (crossM R L)) :=
    kernelList_rowsLen L.length (crossM R L)
  have h1 : poly.unitTail (combo n
      (combo L.length ds (kernelList L.length (crossM R L))) L) :=
    poly.oneValue_unitTail
      (combo_combo n ds (kernelList L.length (crossM R L)) L hK hL)
      hnull
  exact indep_elim
    (kernelList_indep L.length (crossM R L) (rowsLen_crossM R L))
    ds (hds.trans (ground.length_map _ _))
    (indep_elim hiL
      (combo L.length ds (kernelList L.length (crossM R L)))
      (length_combo L.length ds _ hK) h1)

name: crossKer_indep
statement:
private theorem crossKer_indep (n : Nat) (R L : Mat)

name: crossKer_span
statement:
private theorem crossKer_span (n : Nat) (R L L' : Mat)
    (hR : rowsLen n R) (hL : rowsLen n L) (hL' : rowsLen n L')
    (hmut : ∀ k, k < L.length → spanRel n L' (ground.getAt [] L k)) :
    ∀ k, k < ((kernelList L.length (crossM R L)).map
        (fun c => combo n c L)).length →
      spanRel n ((kernelList L'.length (crossM R L')).map
          (fun c => combo n c L'))
        (ground.getAt []
          ((kernelList L.length (crossM R L)).map
            (fun c => combo n c L)) k)
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  have hkK : k < (kernelList L.length (crossM R L)).length := by
    rw [← ground.length_map (fun c => combo n c L)
      (kernelList L.length (crossM R L))]
    exact hk
  rw [ground.getAt_map ([] : List BPair) ([] : List BPair)
    (fun c => combo n c L) (kernelList L.length (crossM R L)) k hkK]
  have hv : (combo n (ground.getAt []
      (kernelList L.length (crossM R L)) k) L).length = n :=
    length_combo n _ L hL
  have hsp' : spanRel n L' (combo n (ground.getAt []
      (kernelList L.length (crossM R L)) k) L) :=
    spanRel_trans n L L' _ hL hL' hmut
      (spanRel_combo n L hL L _ hL
        (fun j hj => spanRel_getAt n L j hj hL))
  have hker : poly.unitTail (matVec R (combo n (ground.getAt []
      (kernelList L.length (crossM R L)) k) L)) :=
    poly.unitTail_oneValue_right
      (kernelList_members L.length (crossM R L)
        (rowsLen_crossM R L) k hkK)
      (matVec_crossM n R L _ hR hL)
  obtain ⟨c₀, cs, hc₀, hcsl, hone⟩ := span_elim hsp'
  have hcsker : poly.unitTail (matVec (crossM R L') cs) :=
    poly.oneValue_unitTail
      (poly.oneValue_trans (matVec_crossM n R L' cs hR hL')
        (poly.oneValue_trans
          (matVec_congr R (combo n cs L')
            (vecScale c₀ (combo n (ground.getAt []
              (kernelList L.length (crossM R L)) k) L))
            (poly.oneValue_symm hone))
          (matVec_vecScale_free R c₀ _)))
      (unitTail_vecScale c₀ _ hker)
  obtain ⟨d₀, ds, hd₀, hdsl, hdone⟩ := span_elim
    (kernelList_span L'.length (crossM R L') (rowsLen_crossM R L')
      cs hcsl hcsker)
  have hK' : rowsLen L'.length
      (kernelList L'.length (crossM R L')) :=
    kernelList_rowsLen L'.length (crossM R L')
  have hfin : poly.oneValue
      (vecScale (d₀ * c₀) (combo n (ground.getAt []
        (kernelList L.length (crossM R L)) k) L))
      (combo n ds ((kernelList L'.length (crossM R L')).map
        (fun c => combo n c L'))) := by
    rw [← vecScale_vecScale d₀ c₀]
    refine poly.oneValue_trans
      (vecScale_oneValue d₀ _ (combo n cs L') hone) ?_
    refine poly.oneValue_trans (vecScale_combo d₀ n cs L') ?_
    refine poly.oneValue_trans
      (combo_congr n (vecScale d₀ cs)
        (combo L'.length ds (kernelList L'.length (crossM R L'))) L'
        (((length_vecScale d₀ cs).trans hcsl).trans
          (length_combo L'.length ds _ hK').symm) hdone) ?_
    exact combo_combo n ds (kernelList L'.length (crossM R L')) L'
      hK' hL'
  exact span_intro n
    ((kernelList L'.length (crossM R L')).map
      (fun c => combo n c L')) _
    (rowsLen_map _ n _ (fun x _ => (fun a => length_combo n a L' hL') x)) hv
    ⟨d₀ * c₀, ds, (fun hcon => hc₀ (mul_cancel_unit hd₀ hcon)),
      hdsl.trans (ground.length_map _ _).symm, hfin⟩

name: kernelDim_congr
statement:
theorem kernelDim_congr : ∀ (n : Nat) (R L L' : Mat),
    rowsLen n R → rowsLen n L → rowsLen n L' →
    indepRows n L → indepRows n L' →
    (∀ k, k < L.length → spanRel n L' (ground.getAt [] L k)) →
    (∀ k, k < L'.length → spanRel n L (ground.getAt [] L' k)) →
    kernelDim L.length (crossM R L)
      = kernelDim L'.length (crossM R L')
proof:
:= by
  intro n R L L' hR hL hL' hiL hiL' hmut hmut'
  have hcount := span_count_eq n
    ((kernelList L.length (crossM R L)).map (fun c => combo n c L))
    ((kernelList L'.length (crossM R L')).map
      (fun c => combo n c L'))
    (rowsLen_map _ n _ (fun x _ => (fun a => length_combo n a L hL) x))
    (rowsLen_map _ n _ (fun x _ => (fun a => length_combo n a L' hL') x))
    (crossKer_indep n R L hL hiL) (crossKer_indep n R L' hL' hiL')
    (crossKer_span n R L L' hR hL hL' hmut)
    (crossKer_span n R L' L hR hL' hL hmut')
  rw [← kernelList_dim L.length (crossM R L),
    ← kernelList_dim L'.length (crossM R L'),
    ← ground.length_map (fun c => combo n c L)
      (kernelList L.length (crossM R L)),
    ← ground.length_map (fun c => combo n c L')
      (kernelList L'.length (crossM R L')),
    hcount]

name: kernelDim_kerIff
statement:
theorem kernelDim_kerIff (R L R' L' : Mat)
    (hlen : L.length = L'.length)
    (hiff : ∀ x : List BPair, x.length = L.length →
      (poly.unitTail (matVec (crossM R L) x)
        ↔ poly.unitTail (matVec (crossM R' L') x))) :
    kernelDim L.length (crossM R L)
      = kernelDim L'.length (crossM R' L')
proof:
:= by
  have hKA : rowsLen L.length (kernelList L.length (crossM R L)) :=
    kernelList_rowsLen L.length (crossM R L)
  have hKB : rowsLen L'.length
      (kernelList L'.length (crossM R' L')) :=
    kernelList_rowsLen L'.length (crossM R' L')
  have hconv : ∀ v : List BPair,
      spanRel L'.length (kernelList L'.length (crossM R' L')) v →
      spanRel L.length (kernelList L'.length (crossM R' L')) v := by
    rw [hlen]
    exact fun _ h => h
  have hKB' : rowsLen L.length
      (kernelList L'.length (crossM R' L')) := by
    rw [hlen]
    exact hKB
  have hIB : indepRows L.length
      (kernelList L'.length (crossM R' L')) := by
    rw [hlen]
    exact kernelList_indep L'.length (crossM R' L')
      (rowsLen_crossM R' L')
  have hAB : ∀ k, k < (kernelList L.length (crossM R L)).length →
      spanRel L.length (kernelList L'.length (crossM R' L'))
        (ground.getAt [] (kernelList L.length (crossM R L)) k) := by
    intro k hk
    have hx : (ground.getAt []
        (kernelList L.length (crossM R L)) k).length = L.length :=
      rowsLen_getAt _ k hKA hk
    exact hconv _ (kernelList_span L'.length (crossM R' L')
      (rowsLen_crossM R' L') _ (hx.trans hlen)
      ((hiff _ hx).mp (kernelList_members L.length (crossM R L)
        (rowsLen_crossM R L) k hk)))
  have hBA : ∀ k, k < (kernelList L'.length (crossM R' L')).length →
      spanRel L.length (kernelList L.length (crossM R L))
        (ground.getAt []
          (kernelList L'.length (crossM R' L')) k) := by
    intro k hk
    have hx : (ground.getAt []
        (kernelList L'.length (crossM R' L')) k).length
        = L.length := (rowsLen_getAt _ k hKB hk).trans hlen.symm
    exact kernelList_span L.length (crossM R L)
      (rowsLen_crossM R L) _ hx
      ((hiff _ hx).mpr (kernelList_members L'.length (crossM R' L')
        (rowsLen_crossM R' L') k hk))
  rw [← kernelList_dim L.length (crossM R L),
    ← kernelList_dim L'.length (crossM R' L')]
  exact span_count_eq L.length (kernelList L.length (crossM R L))
    (kernelList L'.length (crossM R' L')) hKA hKB'
    (kernelList_indep L.length (crossM R L) (rowsLen_crossM R L))
    hIB hAB hBA

name: dotP_scaleTransport
statement:
theorem dotP_scaleTransport (s s' : BPair) :
    ∀ (cs g g' : List BPair), g'.length = g.length →
    (∀ k, k < g.length →
      (s' * ground.getAt BPair.unit g' k).oneValue
        (s * ground.getAt BPair.unit g k)) →
    (s' * dotP cs g').oneValue (s * dotP cs g)
  | [], _, _, _, _ =>
    BPair.oneValue_trans (BPair.mul_unit s')
      (BPair.oneValue_symm (BPair.mul_unit s))
  | _ :: _, [], [], _, _ =>
    BPair.oneValue_trans (BPair.mul_unit s')
      (BPair.oneValue_symm (BPair.mul_unit s))
  | _ :: _, [], _ :: _, hl, _ => nomatch hl
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, [], hl, _ => nomatch hl
  | c :: cs, a :: g, a' :: g', hl, h => by
    show (s' * (c * a' + dotP cs g')).oneValue
      (s * (c * a + dotP cs g))
    rw [BPair.left_distrib s' (c * a') (dotP cs g'),
      BPair.left_distrib s (c * a) (dotP cs g),
      BPair.mul_left_comm s' c a', BPair.mul_left_comm s c a]
    exact BPair.add_congr
      (BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl c)
        (h 0 (Nat.succ_pos g.length)))
      (dotP_scaleTransport s s' cs g g' (Nat.succ.inj hl)
        (fun k hk => h (k + 1) (Nat.succ_lt_succ hk)))

/
Grams: two families whose pairwise folds agree at the
cross-multiplied scales carry that agreement to every
combination's self-pairing — the pairing against a combination is
the coefficients' fold over the family's own pairings
(`dotP_combo`), so the scaled read passes to the Gram entries once
per side (`lem:blockcount`(iii)'s transport read). -/

name: dotP_comboGram
statement:
theorem dotP_comboGram (m : Nat) (s s' : BPair) (P P' : Mat)
    (hP : rowsLen m P) (hP' : rowsLen m P')
    (hlen : P'.length = P.length)
    (hgram : ∀ k, k < P.length → ∀ l, l < P.length →
      (s' * dotP (ground.getAt [] P' k)
          (ground.getAt [] P' l)).oneValue
        (s * dotP (ground.getAt [] P k) (ground.getAt [] P l)))
    (cs : List BPair) :
    (s' * dotP (combo m cs P') (combo m cs P')).oneValue
      (s * dotP (combo m cs P) (combo m cs P))
proof:
:= by
  have hrow : ∀ k, k < P.length →
      (s' * dotP (ground.getAt [] P' k) (combo m cs P')).oneValue
        (s * dotP (ground.getAt [] P k) (combo m cs P)) := by
    intro k hk
    have hk' : k < P'.length := by rw [hlen]; exact hk
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl s')
        (dotP_combo cs P' (ground.getAt [] P' k) m hP')) ?_
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans ?_
      (BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl s)
        (BPair.oneValue_symm
          (dotP_combo cs P (ground.getAt [] P k) m hP)))
    refine dotP_scaleTransport s s' cs
      (P.map (fun row => dotP (ground.getAt [] P k) row))
      (P'.map (fun row => dotP (ground.getAt [] P' k) row))
      (by rw [ground.length_map, ground.length_map]; exact hlen) ?_
    intro l hl
    rw [ground.length_map] at hl
    have hl' : l < P'.length := by rw [hlen]; exact hl
    rw [ground.getAt_map ([] : List BPair) BPair.unit
        (fun row => dotP (ground.getAt [] P' k) row) P' l hl',
      ground.getAt_map ([] : List BPair) BPair.unit
        (fun row => dotP (ground.getAt [] P k) row) P l hl]
    exact hgram k hk l hl
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans
    (BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl s')
      (dotP_combo cs P' (combo m cs P') m hP')) ?_
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans ?_
    (BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl s)
      (BPair.oneValue_symm
        (dotP_combo cs P (combo m cs P) m hP)))
  refine dotP_scaleTransport s s' cs
    (P.map (fun row => dotP (combo m cs P) row))
    (P'.map (fun row => dotP (combo m cs P') row))
    (by rw [ground.length_map, ground.length_map]; exact hlen) ?_
  intro k hk
  rw [ground.length_map] at hk
  have hk' : k < P'.length := by rw [hlen]; exact hk
  rw [ground.getAt_map ([] : List BPair) BPair.unit
      (fun row => dotP (combo m cs P') row) P' k hk',
    ground.getAt_map ([] : List BPair) BPair.unit
      (fun row => dotP (combo m cs P) row) P k hk,
    dotP_comm (combo m cs P') (ground.getAt [] P' k),
    dotP_comm (combo m cs P) (ground.getAt [] P k)]
  exact hrow k hk

name: kernelDim_gram
statement:
theorem kernelDim_gram (n : Nat) (R L L' : Mat) (s s' : BPair)
    (hs : ¬ s.oneValue BPair.unit) (hs' : ¬ s'.oneValue BPair.unit)
    (hR : rowsLen n R) (hL : rowsLen n L) (hL' : rowsLen n L')
    (hlen : L'.length = L.length)
    (hgram : ∀ k, k < L.length → ∀ l, l < L.length →
      (s' * dotP (matVec R (ground.getAt [] L' k))
          (matVec R (ground.getAt [] L' l))).oneValue
        (s * dotP (matVec R (ground.getAt [] L k))
          (matVec R (ground.getAt [] L l)))) :
    kernelDim L'.length (crossM R L') = kernelDim L.length (crossM R L)
proof:
:= by
  have hP : rowsLen R.length (L.map (matVec R)) :=
    rowsLen_map (matVec R) R.length L
      (fun x _ => (fun y => matVec_length R y) x)
  have hP' : rowsLen R.length (L'.map (matVec R)) :=
    rowsLen_map (matVec R) R.length L'
      (fun x _ => (fun y => matVec_length R y) x)
  have hPlen : (L'.map (matVec R)).length = (L.map (matVec R)).length := by
    rw [ground.length_map, ground.length_map]; exact hlen
  have hgramP : ∀ k, k < (L.map (matVec R)).length →
      ∀ l, l < (L.map (matVec R)).length →
      (s' * dotP (ground.getAt [] (L'.map (matVec R)) k)
          (ground.getAt [] (L'.map (matVec R)) l)).oneValue
        (s * dotP (ground.getAt [] (L.map (matVec R)) k)
          (ground.getAt [] (L.map (matVec R)) l)) := by
    intro k hk l hl
    rw [ground.length_map] at hk
    rw [ground.length_map] at hl
    have hk' : k < L'.length := by rw [hlen]; exact hk
    have hl' : l < L'.length := by rw [hlen]; exact hl
    rw [ground.getAt_map ([] : List BPair) ([] : List BPair)
        (matVec R) L' k hk',
      ground.getAt_map ([] : List BPair) ([] : List BPair)
        (matVec R) L' l hl',
      ground.getAt_map ([] : List BPair) ([] : List BPair)
        (matVec R) L k hk,
      ground.getAt_map ([] : List BPair) ([] : List BPair)
        (matVec R) L l hl]
    exact hgram k hk l hl
  have hchain : ∀ (M : Mat), rowsLen n M → ∀ cs : List BPair,
      poly.oneValue (matVec (crossM R M) cs)
        (combo R.length cs (M.map (matVec R))) :=
    fun M hM cs => poly.oneValue_trans
      (matVec_crossM n R M cs hR hM) (matVec_combo R n cs M hM)
  have hfwd : ∀ cs : List BPair,
      poly.unitTail (matVec (crossM R L) cs) →
      poly.unitTail (matVec (crossM R L') cs) := by
    intro cs h
    refine poly.oneValue_unitTail (hchain L' hL' cs)
      (dotP_self_null _ (ground.mul_cancel_unit hs' ?_))
    exact BPair.oneValue_trans
      (dotP_comboGram R.length s s' (L.map (matVec R))
        (L'.map (matVec R)) hP hP' hPlen hgramP cs)
      (oneValue_mul_unit s _
        (dotP_null_tail_left _ _
          (poly.unitTail_oneValue_right h (hchain L hL cs))))
  have hbwd : ∀ cs : List BPair,
      poly.unitTail (matVec (crossM R L') cs) →
      poly.unitTail (matVec (crossM R L) cs) := by
    intro cs h
    refine poly.oneValue_unitTail (hchain L hL cs)
      (dotP_self_null _ (ground.mul_cancel_unit hs ?_))
    exact BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.oneValue_symm
        (dotP_comboGram R.length s s' (L.map (matVec R))
          (L'.map (matVec R)) hP hP' hPlen hgramP cs))
      (oneValue_mul_unit s' _
        (dotP_null_tail_left _ _
          (poly.unitTail_oneValue_right h (hchain L' hL' cs))))
  have convR : ∀ K : Mat, rowsLen L'.length K → rowsLen L.length K := by
    rw [hlen]
    exact fun _ h => h
  have convI : ∀ K : Mat, indepRows L'.length K →
      indepRows L.length K := by
    rw [hlen]
    exact fun _ h => h
  have convS : ∀ (K : Mat) (v : List BPair),
      spanRel L'.length K v → spanRel L.length K v := by
    rw [hlen]
    exact fun _ _ h => h
  have hA : rowsLen L.length (kernelList L.length (crossM R L)) :=
    kernelList_rowsLen L.length (crossM R L)
  have hB : rowsLen L.length (kernelList L'.length (crossM R L')) :=
    convR _ (kernelList_rowsLen L'.length (crossM R L'))
  have hiA : indepRows L.length (kernelList L.length (crossM R L)) :=
    kernelList_indep L.length (crossM R L) (rowsLen_crossM R L)
  have hiB : indepRows L.length
      (kernelList L'.length (crossM R L')) :=
    convI _ (kernelList_indep L'.length (crossM R L')
      (rowsLen_crossM R L'))
  have hAB : ∀ k, k < (kernelList L.length (crossM R L)).length →
      spanRel L.length (kernelList L'.length (crossM R L'))
        (ground.getAt [] (kernelList L.length (crossM R L)) k) := by
    intro k hk
    have hv : (ground.getAt []
        (kernelList L.length (crossM R L)) k).length = L'.length :=
      (rowsLen_getAt (kernelList L.length (crossM R L)) k hA hk).trans
        hlen.symm
    exact convS _ _ (kernelList_span L'.length (crossM R L')
      (rowsLen_crossM R L') _ hv
      (hfwd _ (kernelList_members L.length (crossM R L)
        (rowsLen_crossM R L) k hk)))
  have hBA : ∀ k, k < (kernelList L'.length (crossM R L')).length →
      spanRel L.length (kernelList L.length (crossM R L))
        (ground.getAt [] (kernelList L'.length (crossM R L')) k) := by
    intro k hk
    have hv : (ground.getAt []
        (kernelList L'.length (crossM R L')) k).length = L.length :=
      rowsLen_getAt (kernelList L'.length (crossM R L')) k hB hk
    exact kernelList_span L.length (crossM R L) (rowsLen_crossM R L)
      _ hv
      (hbwd _ (kernelList_members L'.length (crossM R L')
        (rowsLen_crossM R L') k hk))
  have hcount := span_count_eq L.length
    (kernelList L.length (crossM R L))
    (kernelList L'.length (crossM R L'))
    hA hB hiA hiB hAB hBA
  rw [← kernelList_dim L.length (crossM R L),
    ← kernelList_dim L'.length (crossM R L')]
  exact hcount.symm

name: ofRowFrom_units
statement:
private theorem ofRowFrom_units : ∀ (r : List BPair) (k : Nat),
    poly.unitTail r → ofRowFrom k r = []
  | [], _, _ => rfl
  | e :: es, k, h => by
    show (match e.norm.isUnitRep with
      | true => ofRowFrom (k + 1) es
      | false => (k, e.norm) :: ofRowFrom (k + 1) es) = []
    rw [ground.BPair.isUnitRep_norm_of_unit h.1]
    exact ofRowFrom_units es (k + 1) h.2

/
the pivot search answers nothing. -/
private theorem sFind_ofRow_none : ∀ m : Mat,
    (∀ k, k < m.length → poly.unitTail (ground.getAt [] m k)) →
    sFind (m.map ofRow) = none
  | [], _ => rfl
  | a :: t, h => by
    have ha : ofRow a = (a.length, [])
proof:
:= by
      show (a.length, ofRowFrom 0 a) = (a.length, [])
      rw [ofRowFrom_units a 0 (h 0 (Nat.succ_pos t.length))]
    show sFind (ofRow a :: t.map ofRow) = none
    rw [ha]
    show (match sFind (t.map ofRow) with
      | none => none
      | some (i, j) => some (i + 1, j)) = none
    rw [sFind_ofRow_none t
      (fun k hk => h (k + 1) (Nat.succ_lt_succ hk))]

name: sFind_ofRow_none
statement:
private theorem sFind_ofRow_none : ∀ m : Mat,
    (∀ k, k < m.length → poly.unitTail (ground.getAt [] m k)) →
    sFind (m.map ofRow) = none
  | [], _ => rfl
  | a :: t, h => by
    have ha : ofRow a = (a.length, [])
proof:
:= by
      show (a.length, ofRowFrom 0 a) = (a.length, [])
      rw [ofRowFrom_units a 0 (h 0 (Nat.succ_pos t.length))]
    show sFind (ofRow a :: t.map ofRow) = none
    rw [ha]
    show (match sFind (t.map ofRow) with
      | none => none
      | some (i, j) => some (i + 1, j)) = none
    rw [sFind_ofRow_none t
      (fun k hk => h (k + 1) (Nat.succ_lt_succ hk))]

name: sdescend_of_none
statement:
private theorem sdescend_of_none : ∀ (fuel : Nat) (prev : BPair)
    (rows : List SRow), sFind rows = none → sdescend fuel prev rows = 0
  | 0, prev, rows, _ =>
    descGo_zero (fun _ => 0) (fun _ _ _ n => 1 + n) 0 prev rows
  | fuel + 1, prev, rows, hf =>
    descGo_none (fun _ => 0) (fun _ _ _ n => 1 + n) fuel 0 prev rows hf

/
entry is dropped at the normed unit test, the pivot search reads
none, and the descent seeds its own floor. -/

name: rank_null
statement:
theorem rank_null : ∀ m : Mat,
    (∀ k, k < m.length → poly.unitTail (ground.getAt [] m k)) →
    rank m = 0
proof:
:=
  fun m h => sdescend_of_none m.length (BPair.ofPos .one)
    (m.map ofRow) (sFind_ofRow_none m h)

name: matVec_idMat
statement:
theorem matVec_idMat : ∀ (n : Nat) (u : List BPair),
    u.length = n →
    poly.oneValue (matVec (idMat n) u) u
proof:
:= by
  intro n u hu
  refine poly.oneValue_of_entries _ _ ?_ ?_
  · rw [matVec_length, length_idMat, hu]
  · intro i hi
    rw [matVec_length, length_idMat] at hi
    have hmap : ground.getAt BPair.unit (matVec (idMat n) u) i
        = dotN (ground.getAt ([] : List BPair) (idMat n) i) u := by
      show ground.getAt BPair.unit
          ((idMat n).map (fun r => dotN r u)) i
        = dotN (ground.getAt ([] : List BPair) (idMat n) i) u
      exact ground.getAt_map ([] : List BPair) BPair.unit
        (fun r => dotN r u) (idMat n) i
        (by rw [length_idMat]; exact hi)
    rw [hmap, idMat_row n i hi]
    exact BPair.oneValue_trans (dotN_read _ u)
      (BPair.oneValue_trans (BPair.oneValue_of_eq (dotP_comm _ _))
        (dotP_idRow u n i hu hi))

name: sqAt_idMat
statement: theorem sqAt_idMat : ∀ n : Nat, sqAt (idMat n) n
proof:
:=
  fun n => sqAt_of (length_idMat n) (rowsLen_idMat n)

name: selfProd_one
statement:
private theorem selfProd_one : ∀ L : Mat,
    (∀ k, k < L.length →
      (dotP (ground.getAt [] L k) (ground.getAt [] L k)).oneValue
        (BPair.ofPos Pos.one)) →
    (selfProd L).oneValue (BPair.ofPos Pos.one)
  | [], _ => BPair.oneValue_refl _
  | r :: t, h => by
    show ((dotP r r * selfProd t).norm).oneValue (BPair.ofPos Pos.one)
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans (BPair.norm_oneValue _) ?_
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans
      (BPair.mul_congr (h 0 (Nat.zero_lt_succ _))
        (selfProd_one t
          (fun k hk => h (k + 1) (Nat.succ_lt_succ hk)))) ?_
    decide +kernel

/
pairing picks the other member's entry at its own key, where the
unit family stands. -/
private theorem perpAll_idMat (n : Nat) : perpAll (idMat n)
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp q hq hpq
  rw [length_idMat] at hp hq
  rw [idMat_row n p hp, idMat_row n q hq]
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans
    (BPair.oneValue_trans (BPair.oneValue_of_eq (dotP_comm _ _))
      (dotP_idRow _ n p (length_idRow n q) hp)) ?_
  rw [getAt_idRow n q p hp, if_neg hpq]
  exact BPair.oneValue_refl _

name: perpAll_idMat
statement: private theorem perpAll_idMat (n : Nat) : perpAll (idMat n)
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp q hq hpq
  rw [length_idMat] at hp hq
  rw [idMat_row n p hp, idMat_row n q hq]
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans
    (BPair.oneValue_trans (BPair.oneValue_of_eq (dotP_comm _ _))
      (dotP_idRow _ n p (length_idRow n q) hp)) ?_
  rw [getAt_idRow n q p hp, if_neg hpq]
  exact BPair.oneValue_refl _

name: indepRows_idMat
statement: theorem indepRows_idMat (n : Nat) : indepRows n (idMat n)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨rowsLen_idMat n, ?_⟩
  intro hone
  have hsp : (selfProd (idMat n)).oneValue (BPair.ofPos Pos.one) := by
    refine selfProd_one (idMat n) (fun k hk => ?_)
    rw [length_idMat] at hk
    rw [idMat_row n k hk]
    refine BPair.oneValue_trans
      (dotP_idRow _ n k (length_idRow n k) hk) ?_
    rw [getAt_idRow n k k hk, if_pos rfl]
    exact BPair.oneValue_refl _
  exact absurd
    (BPair.oneValue_trans (BPair.oneValue_symm hsp)
      (BPair.oneValue_trans
        (BPair.oneValue_symm (detL_perp (idMat n) (perpAll_idMat n)))
        hone))
    (by decide +kernel)

name: ofRowFrom_congr
statement:
private theorem ofRowFrom_congr : ∀ (a b : List BPair) (k : Nat),
    a.length = b.length →
    (∀ i, i < a.length →
      (ground.getAt BPair.unit a i).norm
        = (ground.getAt BPair.unit b i).norm) →
    ofRowFrom k a = ofRowFrom k b
  | [], [], _, _, _ => rfl
  | [], _ :: _, _, h, _ => Nat.noConfusion h
  | _ :: _, [], _, h, _ => Nat.noConfusion h
  | a :: s, b :: t, k, h, hg => by
    have h0 : a.norm = b.norm
proof:
:= hg 0 (Nat.zero_lt_succ _)
    show (match (a.norm).isUnitRep with
        | true => ofRowFrom (k + 1) s
        | false => (k, a.norm) :: ofRowFrom (k + 1) s)
      = (match (b.norm).isUnitRep with
        | true => ofRowFrom (k + 1) t
        | false => (k, b.norm) :: ofRowFrom (k + 1) t)
    rw [h0,
      ofRowFrom_congr s t (k + 1) (Nat.succ.inj h)
        (fun i hi => hg (i + 1) (Nat.succ_lt_succ hi))]

name: dotN_idMat_entry
statement:
theorem dotN_idMat_entry (n : Nat) (r : List BPair)
    (hr : r.length = n) (i : Nat) (hi : i < n) :
    (dotN r (ground.getAt ([] : List BPair) (idMat n) i)).oneValue
      (ground.getAt BPair.unit r i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [idMat_row n i hi]
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans (dotN_read r _) ?_
  exact dotP_idRow r n i hr hi

name: ofRow_dotN_idMat
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : ((idMat n).map (fun x => dotN r x)).length
      = r.length := by
    rw [ground.length_map, length_idMat, hr]
  have hg : ∀ i, i < ((idMat n).map (fun x => dotN r x)).length →
      (ground.getAt BPair.unit
          ((idMat n).map (fun x => dotN r x)) i).norm
        = (ground.getAt BPair.unit r i).norm := by
    intro i hi
    rw [ground.length_map, length_idMat] at hi
    rw [ground.getAt_map ([] : List BPair) BPair.unit
      (fun x => dotN r x) (idMat n) i
      (by rw [length_idMat]; exact hi)]
    exact BPair.norm_congr (dotN_idMat_entry n r hr i hi)
  show (((idMat n).map (fun x => dotN r x)).length,
      ofRowFrom 0 ((idMat n).map (fun x => dotN r x)))
    = (r.length, ofRowFrom 0 r)
  rw [hlen, ofRowFrom_congr ((idMat n).map (fun x => dotN r x)) r 0
    hlen hg]

name: ofRow_crossM_idMat
statement:
private theorem ofRow_crossM_idMat (n : Nat) : ∀ R : Mat, rowsLen n R →
    (crossM R (idMat n)).map ofRow = R.map ofRow
  | [], _ => rfl
  | r :: t, h => by
    show ofRow ((idMat n).map (fun x => dotN r x))
        :: (crossM t (idMat n)).map ofRow
      = ofRow r :: t.map ofRow
    rw [ofRow_dotN_idMat n r h.1, ofRow_crossM_idMat n t h.2]

/
datum at the identity family is the stacked family itself, entry by
entry at the norms, so the two kernel dimensions are one count. -/

name: kernelDim_idMat
statement:
theorem kernelDim_idMat (n : Nat) (R : Mat) (hR : rowsLen n R) :
    kernelDim n (crossM R (idMat n)) = kernelDim n R
proof:
:= by
  have hrank : rank (crossM R (idMat n)) = rank R := by
    show sdescend (crossM R (idMat n)).length (BPair.ofPos Pos.one)
        ((crossM R (idMat n)).map ofRow)
      = sdescend R.length (BPair.ofPos Pos.one) (R.map ofRow)
    rw [length_crossM R (idMat n), ofRow_crossM_idMat n R hR]
  show n - rank (crossM R (idMat n)) = n - rank R
  rw [hrank]

name: collect_single
statement:
theorem collect_single : ∀ (n : Nat) (r : List BPair),
    r.length = n → ¬ poly.unitTail r → collectOf n [r] = [r]
proof:
:= by
  intro n r hlen hoff
  have hneg : ¬ poly.unitTail (residV n ([] : Mat) r) := by
    intro hu
    exact hoff (spanRel_nil_unit n r ⟨trivial, hlen, hu⟩)
  show (if poly.unitTail (residV n ([] : Mat) r) then ([] : Mat)
      else [] ++ [r]) = [r]
  rw [if_neg hneg]
  rfl

name: adjM_transpose
proof:
:=
  transposeM_transposeM _ (cofRows_rowsLen G) h
    (by rw [cofRows_len G]; exact h)

name: adjM_len
statement:
private theorem adjM_len (G : Mat) (h : 0 < G.length) :
    (adjM G).length = G.length
proof:
:=
  length_transposeM _ (cofRows_rowsLen G)
    (by rw [cofRows_len G]; exact h)

name: adjM_rowsLen
statement: private theorem adjM_rowsLen (G : Mat) : rowsLen G.length (adjM G)
proof:
:=
  rowsLen_cast (cofRows_len G) (rowsLen_transposeM _)

name: adjM_entry
statement:
private theorem adjM_entry (G : Mat) {n : Nat} (hsq : sqAt G n)
    (i j : Nat) (hi : i < n) (hj : j < n) :
    ground.getAt BPair.unit
        (ground.getAt [] (matMul G (adjM G)) i) j
      = dotN (ground.getAt [] G i) (cofVec G j)
proof:
:= by
  have hGl : G.length = n := sqAt_len hsq
  have hn : 0 < G.length := by
    rw [hGl]
    exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le i) hi
  rw [getAt_matMul G (adjM G) i (by rw [hGl]; exact hi),
    adjM_transpose G hn,
    ground.getAt_map ([] : List BPair) BPair.unit
      (fun c => dotN (ground.getAt [] G i) c)
      ((List.range G.length).map (fun k => cofVec G k)) j
      (by rw [cofRows_len G, hGl]; exact hj),
    ground.getAt_map 0 ([] : List BPair) (fun k => cofVec G k)
      (List.range G.length) j
      (by rw [ground.length_range, hGl]; exact hj),
    ground.getAt_range G.length j (by rw [hGl]; exact hj)]

name: adjM_row_diag
statement:
theorem adjM_row_diag (G : Mat) {n : Nat} (hsq : sqAt G n) (i : Nat)
    (hi : i < n) :
    (ground.getAt BPair.unit
      (ground.getAt [] (matMul G (adjM G)) i) i).oneValue (detL G)
proof:
:= by
  have hGl : G.length = n := sqAt_len hsq
  have hiG : i < G.length := by rw [hGl]; exact hi
  rw [adjM_entry G hsq i i hi hi]
  exact BPair.oneValue_trans (dotN_read _ _)
    (cofVec_diag G i hiG (by rw [sqAt_row_len hsq i hiG, hGl]))

name: adjM_row_off
statement:
theorem adjM_row_off (G : Mat) {n : Nat} (hsq : sqAt G n) (i j : Nat)
    (hi : i < n) (hj : j < n) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    (ground.getAt BPair.unit
      (ground.getAt [] (matMul G (adjM G)) i) j).oneValue BPair.unit
proof:
:= by
  have hGl : G.length = n := sqAt_len hsq
  have hiG : i < G.length := by rw [hGl]; exact hi
  have hjG : j < G.length := by rw [hGl]; exact hj
  rw [adjM_entry G hsq i j hi hj]
  exact BPair.oneValue_trans (dotN_read _ _)
    (cofVec_off G i j hiG hjG hij
      (by rw [sqAt_row_len hsq i hiG, hGl]))

name: sgnP_congr
proof:
:= by
  show (if places.parityOf k then bpairOps.swap x else x).oneValue
    (if places.parityOf k then bpairOps.swap y else y)
  cases places.parityOf k with
  | false => exact h
  | true => exact ground.swap_congr h

name: rowLen_of_rowsLen
statement:
private theorem rowLen_of_rowsLen {n : Nat} :
    ∀ (M : Mat) (j : Nat), rowsLen n M → j < M.length →
      (ground.getAt [] M j).length = n
  | [], _, _, hj => absurd hj (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | _ :: _, 0, h, _ => h.1
  | _ :: t, j + 1, h, hj =>
    rowLen_of_rowsLen t j h.2 (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hj)

/
keys. -/
private theorem adjM_read (G : Mat) (i k : Nat) (hi : i < G.length)
    (hk : k < G.length) :
    ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] (adjM G) i) k
      = ground.getAt BPair.unit (cofVec G k) i
proof:
:= by
  rw [show adjM G = transposeM ((List.range G.length).map
        (fun j => cofVec G j)) from rfl,
    getAt_transposeM BPair.unit _ (cofRows_rowsLen G) i k hi
      (by rw [cofRows_len G]; exact hk),
    ground.getAt_map 0 ([] : List BPair) (fun j => cofVec G j)
      (List.range G.length) k (by rw [ground.length_range]; exact hk),
    ground.getAt_range G.length k hk]

name: adjM_read
statement:
private theorem adjM_read (G : Mat) (i k : Nat) (hi : i < G.length)
    (hk : k < G.length) :
    ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] (adjM G) i) k
      = ground.getAt BPair.unit (cofVec G k) i
proof:
:= by
  rw [show adjM G = transposeM ((List.range G.length).map
        (fun j => cofVec G j)) from rfl,
    getAt_transposeM BPair.unit _ (cofRows_rowsLen G) i k hi
      (by rw [cofRows_len G]; exact hk),
    ground.getAt_map 0 ([] : List BPair) (fun j => cofVec G j)
      (List.range G.length) k (by rw [ground.length_range]; exact hk),
    ground.getAt_range G.length k hk]

name: strike_exchange
statement:
private theorem strike_exchange (G : Mat) {w : Nat}
    (hsq : sqAt G (w + 1)) (k i : Nat) (hk : k < w + 1)
    (hi : i < w + 1) :
    (detL (((transposeM G).eraseIdx i).map
        (fun r => r.eraseIdx k))).oneValue
      (detL ((G.eraseIdx k).map (fun r => r.eraseIdx i)))
proof:
:= by
  have hGl : G.length = w + 1 := sqAt_len hsq
  have hGr : rowsLen (w + 1) G := rowsLen_of_sqAt hsq
  have hTr : rowsLen (w + 1) (transposeM G) :=
    rowsLen_cast hGl (rowsLen_transposeM G)
  have hTl : (transposeM G).length = w + 1 := transposeLen G hGr hGl
  have hkG : k < G.length := by rw [hGl]; exact hk
  have hiT : i < (transposeM G).length := by rw [hTl]; exact hi
  have hEG : (G.eraseIdx k).length = w :=
    Nat.succ.inj ((ground.length_eraseIdx G k hkG).trans hGl)
  have hET : ((transposeM G).eraseIdx i).length = w :=
    Nat.succ.inj
      ((ground.length_eraseIdx (transposeM G) i hiT).trans hTl)
  have hYr : rowsLen w ((G.eraseIdx k).map (fun r => r.eraseIdx i)) :=
    rowsLen_eraseCol _ _ hi (G.eraseIdx k)
      (rowsLen_eraseIdx (w + 1) G k hGr)
  have hYl : ((G.eraseIdx k).map (fun r => r.eraseIdx i)).length
      = w := by
    rw [ground.length_map]; exact hEG
  have hXl : (((transposeM G).eraseIdx i).map
      (fun r => r.eraseIdx k)).length = w := by
    rw [ground.length_map]; exact hET
  have hYr' : rowsLen ((G.eraseIdx k).map
      (fun r => r.eraseIdx i)).length
      ((G.eraseIdx k).map (fun r => r.eraseIdx i)) :=
    rowsLen_cast hYl.symm hYr
  have hTYl : (transposeM ((G.eraseIdx k).map
      (fun r => r.eraseIdx i))).length = w :=
    (transposeLen _ hYr hYl)
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans
    (detL_congr_letters _ _ (hXl.trans hTYl.symm) ?_) ?_
  · intro a ha b hb
    rw [hXl] at ha hb
    have haw : a < ((transposeM G).eraseIdx i).length := by
      rw [hET]; exact ha
    have hbw : b < (G.eraseIdx k).length := by
      rw [hEG]; exact hb
    have ha1 : a + 1 < w + 1 := Nat.succ_lt_succ ha
    have hb1 : b + 1 < w + 1 := Nat.succ_lt_succ hb
    have han : a < w + 1 := Nat.lt_of_succ_lt ha1
    have hbn : b < w + 1 := Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hb1
    rw [ground.getAt_map ([] : List BPair) ([] : List BPair)
        (fun r => r.eraseIdx k) ((transposeM G).eraseIdx i) a haw,
      getAt_transposeM BPair.unit _ hYr a b ha
        (by rw [hYl]; exact hb),
      ground.getAt_map ([] : List BPair) ([] : List BPair)
        (fun r => r.eraseIdx i) (G.eraseIdx k) b hbw]
    show (ground.getAt BPair.unit
        ((ground.getAt [] ((transposeM G).eraseIdx i) a).eraseIdx k)
        b).oneValue
      (ground.getAt BPair.unit
        ((ground.getAt [] (G.eraseIdx k) b).eraseIdx i) a)
    rw [getAt_eraseIdx BPair.unit
        (ground.getAt [] ((transposeM G).eraseIdx i) a) k b,
      getAt_eraseIdx BPair.unit
        (ground.getAt [] (G.eraseIdx k) b) i a,
      getAt_eraseIdx ([] : List BPair) (transposeM G) i a,
      getAt_eraseIdx ([] : List BPair) G k b]
    by_cases hai : a < i
    · rw [if_pos hai, if_pos hai]
      by_cases hbk : b < k
      · rw [if_pos hbk, if_pos hbk,
          getAt_transposeM BPair.unit G hGr a b han
            (by rw [hGl]; exact hbn)]
        exact BPair.oneValue_refl _
      · rw [if_neg hbk, if_neg hbk,
          getAt_transposeM BPair.unit G hGr a (b + 1) han
            (by rw [hGl]; exact hb1)]
        exact BPair.oneValue_refl _
    · rw [if_neg hai, if_neg hai]
      by_cases hbk : b < k
      · rw [if_pos hbk, if_pos hbk,
          getAt_transposeM BPair.unit G hGr (a + 1) b ha1
            (by rw [hGl]; exact hbn)]
        exact BPair.oneValue_refl _
      · rw [if_neg hbk, if_neg hbk,
          getAt_transposeM BPair.unit G hGr (a + 1) (b + 1) ha1
            (by rw [hGl]; exact hb1)]
        exact BPair.oneValue_refl _
  · exact BPair.oneValue_of_eq (detL_transpose _ hYr')

name: cofVec_transpose
statement:
private theorem cofVec_transpose (G : Mat) {n : Nat}
    (hsq : sqAt G n) (i k : Nat) (hi : i < n) (hk : k < n) :
    (ground.getAt BPair.unit (cofVec (transposeM G) i) k).oneValue
      (ground.getAt BPair.unit (cofVec G k) i)
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => exact absurd hi (Nat.not_lt_zero i)
  | succ w =>
    have hGl : G.length = w + 1 := sqAt_len hsq
    have hGr : rowsLen (w + 1) G := rowsLen_of_sqAt hsq
    have hTr : rowsLen (w + 1) (transposeM G) :=
      rowsLen_cast hGl (rowsLen_transposeM G)
    have hTl : (transposeM G).length = w + 1 := transposeLen G hGr hGl
    have hkG : k < G.length := by rw [hGl]; exact hk
    have hiG : i < G.length := by rw [hGl]; exact hi
    have hkT : k < (transposeM G).length := by rw [hTl]; exact hk
    have hiT : i < (transposeM G).length := by rw [hTl]; exact hi
    have hET : ((transposeM G).eraseIdx i).length = w :=
      Nat.succ.inj
        ((ground.length_eraseIdx (transposeM G) i hiT).trans hTl)
    have hEG : (G.eraseIdx k).length = w :=
      Nat.succ.inj ((ground.length_eraseIdx G k hkG).trans hGl)
    show (ground.getAt BPair.unit
        ((List.range (transposeM G).length).map (fun j =>
          sgnPO bpairOps (i + j)
            (cof0O bpairOps ((transposeM G).eraseIdx i) j)))
        k).oneValue
      (ground.getAt BPair.unit
        ((List.range G.length).map (fun j =>
          sgnPO bpairOps (k + j)
            (cof0O bpairOps (G.eraseIdx k) j))) i)
    rw [ground.getAt_map 0 BPair.unit _
        (List.range (transposeM G).length) k
        (by rw [ground.length_range]; exact hkT),
      ground.getAt_range (transposeM G).length k hkT,
      ground.getAt_map 0 BPair.unit _ (List.range G.length) i
        (by rw [ground.length_range]; exact hiG),
      ground.getAt_range G.length i hiG,
      cof0O_strike (R := bpairEqRead) bpairEqCore ((transposeM G).eraseIdx i) k
        (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (by rw [hET]; exact hk)),
      cof0O_strike (R := bpairEqRead) bpairEqCore (G.eraseIdx k) i
        (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (by rw [hEG]; exact hi)),
      Nat.add_comm k i]
    exact sgnP_congr (i + k) (strike_exchange G hsq k i hk hi)

name: transposeM_symm
statement:
private theorem transposeM_symm (G : Mat) {n : Nat}
    (hsq : sqAt G n)
    (hsym : ∀ i j, i < n → j < n →
      ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] G i) j
        = ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] G j) i) :
    transposeM G = G
proof:
:= by
  have hGl : G.length = n := sqAt_len hsq
  have hGr : rowsLen n G := rowsLen_of_sqAt hsq
  have hTl : (transposeM G).length = n := transposeLen G hGr hGl
  have hTr : rowsLen G.length (transposeM G) := rowsLen_transposeM G
  refine ground.getAt_ext ([] : List BPair) _ _
    (hTl.trans hGl.symm) ?_
  intro p hp
  rw [hTl] at hp
  have hpG : p < G.length := by rw [hGl]; exact hp
  have hpT : p < (transposeM G).length := by rw [hTl]; exact hp
  refine ground.getAt_ext BPair.unit _ _ ?_ ?_
  · rw [rowsLen_getAt (transposeM G) p hTr hpT,
      rowsLen_getAt G p hGr hpG, hGl]
  · intro q hq
    rw [rowsLen_getAt (transposeM G) p hTr hpT] at hq
    rw [getAt_transposeM BPair.unit G hGr p q hp hq]
    exact hsym q p (by rw [← hGl]; exact hq) hp

name: cof0_strike_symm
statement:
private theorem cof0_strike_symm (G : Mat) {n : Nat}
    (hsq : sqAt G n)
    (hsym : ∀ i j, i < n → j < n →
      ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] G i) j
        = ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] G j) i)
    (k j : Nat) (hk : k < n) (hj : j < n) :
    (cof0 (G.eraseIdx k) j).oneValue (cof0 (G.eraseIdx j) k)
proof:
:= by
  match n, hsq, hsym, hk, hj with
  | 0, _, _, hk0, _ => exact absurd hk0 (Nat.not_lt_zero k)
  | w + 1, hsq, hsym, hk, hj =>
    have hGl : G.length = w + 1 := sqAt_len hsq
    have hEk : (G.eraseIdx k).length = w :=
      Nat.succ.inj ((ground.length_eraseIdx G k
        (by rw [hGl]; exact hk)).trans hGl)
    have hEj : (G.eraseIdx j).length = w :=
      Nat.succ.inj ((ground.length_eraseIdx G j
        (by rw [hGl]; exact hj)).trans hGl)
    have hSk := cof0O_strike (R := ground.bpairRead)
      bpairLaws.toDCore (G.eraseIdx k) j
      (by rw [hEk]; exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ hj)
    have hSj := cof0O_strike (R := ground.bpairRead)
      bpairLaws.toDCore (G.eraseIdx j) k
      (by rw [hEj]; exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ hk)
    have hex := strike_exchange G hsq j k hj hk
    rw [transposeM_symm G hsq hsym] at hex
    exact BPair.oneValue_trans hSk
      (BPair.oneValue_trans hex (BPair.oneValue_symm hSj))

name: adjP_row_fold
statement:
theorem adjP_row_fold (G : Mat) {n : Nat} (hsq : sqAt G n)
    (hsym : ∀ i < n, ∀ j < n,
      ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] G i) j
        = ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] G j) i)
    (b' j : Nat) (hb' : b' < n) (hj : j < n) (B : Nat → BPair)
    (hB : ∀ k, k < n →
      B k = ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] G b') k) :
    (ground.famFold BPair.add BPair.unit
      (fun k => B k * ground.getAt BPair.unit (cofVec G k) j)
      (List.range n)).oneValue
      (if j = b' then detL G else BPair.unit)
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : G.length = n := sqAt_len hsq
  have hrows : rowsLen n G := rowsLen_of_sqAt hsq
  have hjG : j < G.length := by rw [hlen]; exact hj
  have hbG : b' < G.length := by rw [hlen]; exact hb'
  have hrow : (ground.getAt [] G b').length = G.length := by
    rw [rowsLen_getAt G b' hrows hbG, hlen]
  have h3 : dotP (ground.getAt [] G b') (cofVec G j)
      = ground.famFold BPair.add BPair.unit
        (fun k => ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] G b') k
          * sgnP (j + k) (cof0 (G.eraseIdx j) k))
        (List.range G.length) :=
    dotO_map_range bpairOps
      (fun k => sgnP (j + k) (cof0 (G.eraseIdx j) k))
      G.length (ground.getAt [] G b') hrow
  rw [hlen] at h3
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans
    (ground.foldB_congr_members
      (fun k => B k * ground.getAt BPair.unit (cofVec G k) j)
      (fun k => ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] G b') k
        * sgnP (j + k) (cof0 (G.eraseIdx j) k))
      (List.range n) ?_)
    (BPair.oneValue_trans (BPair.oneValue_of_eq h3.symm) ?_)
  · intro t ht
    have htn : t < n := ground.ltOfMem ht
    have htG : t < G.length := by rw [hlen]; exact htn
    have hentry : ground.getAt BPair.unit (cofVec G t) j
        = sgnP (t + j) (cof0 (G.eraseIdx t) j) := by
      show ground.getAt BPair.unit
          ((List.range G.length).map
            (fun i => sgnP (t + i) (cof0 (G.eraseIdx t) i))) j
        = sgnP (t + j) (cof0 (G.eraseIdx t) j)
      rw [ground.getAt_map 0 BPair.unit _ (List.range G.length) j
          (by rw [ground.length_range]; exact hjG),
        ground.getAt_range G.length j hjG]
    show (B t * ground.getAt BPair.unit (cofVec G t) j).oneValue
      (ground.getAt BPair.unit (ground.getAt [] G b') t
        * sgnP (j + t) (cof0 (G.eraseIdx j) t))
    rw [hB t htn, hentry, Nat.add_comm t j]
    exact BPair.mul_congr (BPair.oneValue_refl _)
      (sgnPO_congr (R := ground.bpairRead) bpairLaws.toDCore
        (cof0_strike_symm G hsq
          (fun i j hi hj => hsym i hi j hj) t j htn hj))
  · by_cases hjb : j = b'
    · rw [if_pos hjb, hjb]
      exact cofVec_diag G b' hbG hrow
    · rw [if_neg hjb]
      exact cofVec_off G b' j hbG hjG (fun he => hjb he.symm) hrow

name: adjM_row_cofT
statement:
private theorem adjM_row_cofT (G : Mat) {n : Nat} (hsq : sqAt G n)
    (i : Nat) (hi : i < n) :
    poly.oneValue (ground.getAt [] (adjM G) i)
      (cofVec (transposeM G) i)
proof:
:= by
  have hGl : G.length = n := sqAt_len hsq
  have hGr : rowsLen n G := rowsLen_of_sqAt hsq
  have hnG : 0 < G.length := by
    rw [hGl]; exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le i) hi
  have hTl : (transposeM G).length = n := transposeLen G hGr hGl
  have hiA : i < (adjM G).length := by
    rw [adjM_len G hnG, hGl]; exact hi
  have hrowA : (ground.getAt [] (adjM G) i).length = G.length :=
    rowLen_of_rowsLen (adjM G) i (adjM_rowsLen G) hiA
  have hcofT : (cofVec (transposeM G) i).length = G.length := by
    rw [length_cofVec, hTl, hGl]
  refine poly.ov_of_getAt (fun j => ?_)
  by_cases hj : j < G.length
  · rw [adjM_read G i j (by rw [hGl]; exact hi) hj]
    exact BPair.oneValue_symm
      (cofVec_transpose G hsq i j hi (by rw [← hGl]; exact hj))
  · rw [ground.getAt_over BPair.unit _ j
        (by rw [hrowA]; exact Nat.le_of_not_lt hj),
      ground.getAt_over BPair.unit _ j
        (by rw [hcofT]; exact Nat.le_of_not_lt hj)]
    exact BPair.oneValue_refl _

name: adjM_col_diag
statement:
theorem adjM_col_diag (G : Mat) {n : Nat} (hsq : sqAt G n)
    (i : Nat) (hi : i < n) :
    (ground.getAt BPair.unit
      (ground.getAt [] (matMul (adjM G) G) i) i).oneValue (detL G)
proof:
:= by
  have hGl : G.length = n := sqAt_len hsq
  have hGr : rowsLen n G := rowsLen_of_sqAt hsq
  have hnG : 0 < G.length := by
    rw [hGl]; exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le i) hi
  have hTr : rowsLen n (transposeM G) :=
    rowsLen_cast hGl (rowsLen_transposeM G)
  have hTl : (transposeM G).length = n := transposeLen G hGr hGl
  have hiA : i < (adjM G).length := by
    rw [adjM_len G hnG, hGl]; exact hi
  rw [getAt_matMul (adjM G) G i hiA,
    ground.getAt_map ([] : List BPair) BPair.unit
      (fun c => dotN (ground.getAt [] (adjM G) i) c) (transposeM G)
      i (by rw [hTl]; exact hi)]
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans (dotN_read _ _) ?_
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans
    (dotP_oneValue_left _ (cofVec (transposeM G) i) _
      (adjM_row_cofT G hsq i hi)) ?_
  rw [dotP_comm]
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans
    (cofVec_diag (transposeM G) i (by rw [hTl]; exact hi)
      (by rw [rowLen_of_rowsLen (transposeM G) i hTr
          (by rw [hTl]; exact hi), hTl])) ?_
  exact BPair.oneValue_of_eq
    (detL_transpose G (rowsLen_cast hGl.symm hGr))

name: adjM_col_off
statement:
theorem adjM_col_off (G : Mat) {n : Nat} (hsq : sqAt G n)
    (i j : Nat) (hi : i < n) (hj : j < n) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    (ground.getAt BPair.unit
      (ground.getAt [] (matMul (adjM G) G) i) j).oneValue
      BPair.unit
proof:
:= by
  have hGl : G.length = n := sqAt_len hsq
  have hGr : rowsLen n G := rowsLen_of_sqAt hsq
  have hnG : 0 < G.length := by
    rw [hGl]; exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le i) hi
  have hTr : rowsLen n (transposeM G) :=
    rowsLen_cast hGl (rowsLen_transposeM G)
  have hTl : (transposeM G).length = n := transposeLen G hGr hGl
  have hiA : i < (adjM G).length := by
    rw [adjM_len G hnG, hGl]; exact hi
  rw [getAt_matMul (adjM G) G i hiA,
    ground.getAt_map ([] : List BPair) BPair.unit
      (fun c => dotN (ground.getAt [] (adjM G) i) c) (transposeM G)
      j (by rw [hTl]; exact hj)]
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans (dotN_read _ _) ?_
  refine BPair.oneValue_trans
    (dotP_oneValue_left _ (cofVec (transposeM G) i) _
      (adjM_row_cofT G hsq i hi)) ?_
  rw [dotP_comm]
  exact cofVec_off (transposeM G) j i (by rw [hTl]; exact hj)
    (by rw [hTl]; exact hi) (fun h => hij h.symm)
    (by rw [rowLen_of_rowsLen (transposeM G) j hTr
        (by rw [hTl]; exact hj), hTl])

name: length_adjD
statement:
theorem length_adjD (G : Mat) (p : List BPair) :
    (adjD G p).length = G.length
proof:
:=
  ground.length_mapRange _ G.length

name: cofO_read
statement:
private theorem cofO_read {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (C : DCore γ ops R.rel)
    (det : List (List γ) → γ) (sw : γ → γ)
    (hdet : ∀ E : List (List γ), rowsLen E.length E →
      R.rel (det E) (detO ops E))
    (hsw : ∀ x : γ, R.rel (sw x) (ops.swap x))
    (m : List (List γ)) (hsq : rowsLen m.length m)
    (j s : Nat) (hj : j < m.length) (hs : s < m.length) :
    R.rel (cofO det sw m j s)
      (sgnPO ops (j + s) (cof0O ops (m.eraseIdx j) s))
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : (m.eraseIdx j).length + 1 = m.length :=
    ground.length_eraseIdx m j hj
  have hsl1 : s < (m.eraseIdx j).length + 1 := by
    rw [hlen]
    exact hs
  have hsle : s ≤ (m.eraseIdx j).length := Nat.le_of_lt_succ hsl1
  have hEr : rowsLen (m.eraseIdx j).length
      ((m.eraseIdx j).map (fun r => r.eraseIdx s)) :=
    rowsLen_eraseCol _ s (by rw [hlen]; exact hs) (m.eraseIdx j)
      (by rw [hlen]; exact rowsLen_eraseIdx m.length m j hsq)
  have hEsq : rowsLen ((m.eraseIdx j).map
      (fun r => r.eraseIdx s)).length
      ((m.eraseIdx j).map (fun r => r.eraseIdx s)) := by
    rw [ground.length_map]
    exact hEr
  have hst := cof0O_strike C (m.eraseIdx j) s hsle
  show R.rel (if places.parityOf (j + s)
      then sw (det ((m.eraseIdx j).map (fun r => r.eraseIdx s)))
      else det ((m.eraseIdx j).map (fun r => r.eraseIdx s)))
    (if places.parityOf (j + s)
      then ops.swap (cof0O ops (m.eraseIdx j) s)
      else cof0O ops (m.eraseIdx j) s)
  cases places.parityOf (j + s) with
  | true =>
    exact C.ovTrans (hsw _)
      (C.swapCongr (C.ovTrans (hdet _ hEsq) (C.ovSymm hst)))
  | false => exact C.ovTrans (hdet _ hEsq) (C.ovSymm hst)

name: adjO_rowFold
statement:
private theorem adjO_rowFold {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
    (det : List (List γ) → γ) (sw : γ → γ)
    (hdet : ∀ E : List (List γ), rowsLen E.length E →
      R.rel (det E) (detO ops E))
    (hsw : ∀ x : γ, R.rel (sw x) (ops.swap x))
    (m : List (List γ)) (hsq : rowsLen m.length m)
    (i j : Nat) (hi : i < m.length) (hj : j < m.length) :
    R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit
        (ground.getAt [] (matMulO ops m (adjO det sw m)) i) j)
      (dotO ops (ground.getAt [] m i) (cofVecO ops m j))
proof:
:= by
  have hrow : (ground.getAt [] m i).length = m.length :=
    rowsLen_getAt m i hsq hi
  have hAl : (adjO det sw m).length = m.length :=
    ground.matOf_length m.length m.length _
  have hAr : rowsLen m.length (adjO det sw m) :=
    rowsLen_matOf m.length m.length _
  have hw : ((adjO det sw m).headD []).length = m.length :=
    headD_len_of _ m.length hAl hAr
  have hentry : ∀ s, s < m.length →
      ground.getAt ops.unit
        (ground.getAt [] (adjO det sw m) s) j = cofO det sw m j s :=
    fun s hs => ground.matOf_entry ([] : List γ) ops.unit
      m.length m.length (fun p q => cofO det sw m q p) s j hs hj
  rw [show dotO ops (ground.getAt [] m i) (cofVecO ops m j)
      = ground.famFold ops.add ops.unit
        (fun s => ops.mul
          (ground.getAt ops.unit (ground.getAt [] m i) s)
          (sgnPO ops (j + s) (cof0O ops (m.eraseIdx j) s)))
        (List.range m.length) from
    dotO_map_range ops _ m.length (ground.getAt [] m i) hrow]
  refine L.ovTrans (matMulO_entry L m (adjO det sw m) m.length
    m.length hsq hw i j hi hj) ?_
  refine foldO_congr_members L.toDCore _ _ (List.range m.length)
    (fun s hs => ?_)
  have hsm : s < m.length := ground.ltOfMem hs
  rw [hentry s hsm]
  exact L.mulCongr (L.ovRefl _)
    (cofO_read L.toDCore det sw hdet hsw m hsq j s hj hsm)

name: adjO_row_diag
statement:
theorem adjO_row_diag {γ : Type} {ops : DOps γ}
    {R : ground.DRead γ} (L : DLaws γ ops R.rel)
    (det : List (List γ) → γ) (sw : γ → γ)
    (hdet : ∀ E : List (List γ), rowsLen E.length E →
      R.rel (det E) (detO ops E))
    (hsw : ∀ x : γ, R.rel (sw x) (ops.swap x))
    (m : List (List γ)) (hsq : rowsLen m.length m)
    (i : Nat) (hi : i < m.length) :
    R.rel (ground.getAt ops.unit
        (ground.getAt [] (matMulO ops m (adjO det sw m)) i) i)
      (det m)
proof:
:=
